dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 24
lines: ESCAPE NOW WHILE YOU CAN>>> ZZZKKKWOKFFO))))))))))))R)
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Staging Done for Mary Nyx
lines: Now you sound like a CEO. In some lights, if I squint very hard, you rather remind me of me.
Ugh, must you stand so close? I can smell the streets on you. It's ruining my appetite.
The health benefits were negligible. I take it you're here to annoy me about the apartment job?
I take it you're here to annoy me about that bothersome little apartment?
Ha! Hahahaha. Sometimes, you are almost amusing. But diverting as this little tete-a-tete is, I'm busy. Take your pocket money and run along.
Spoken like a true tradesperson. You will never be Spire-material with that demeanor.
Yes, I watched your efforts on the surveillance monitors. The place looks dreadful. Insipid and uninspired. I'm sure the riff-raff will swoon.
I forget how boring you are. Go on then, take your pocket money and scurry back to whatever hole you fester in.
I thought you only drank people's blood.
You are so very vulgar. Always talking about money.
204, actually. Diverting as this little tete-a-tete is, I'm busy. Take your pocket money and run along.
I hope I look as good when I'm 200 years old.
What else is there to talk about?

dialogues.title: Spartacus No More Doom
lines: She's come from Hover Derby. She'll be fine.
So what now? No more Bare Metal. No more mods. You can do anything.
That's for her to find out.
I AM SPARTACUS AND I... don't know how to thank you.
She know what she's getting into?
We can seal the deal right here.
Got a few dreams to unpack.
We should go out to celebrate sometime.
I... I mean, yeah. Yes. I'd like that. So, ahem, I'll see you.
Gone. Done. Floyd deleted it right in front of me. There was this woman there with him...

dialogues.title: Return to Nabla
lines: Sure do. Nabla owes me money.
Take the cash and get your rude ass out of Nabla's sight. Corpster.
Nabla pays what Nabla owes. And in this case, a little something on top. You did good, babe.
Nabla was gonna say, since you did a good job, you get a bonus. But Nabla don't like your attitude.
You... err, Nabla didn't like it?
True that. And Nabla pays what Nabla owes. Pleasure doing biz, babe.
Babe. Need to talk about that work you did in Nabla's pad.
Glad to hear it. So, my money?
Oh contraire, mon cher. Nabla's comm's been busier than a anonymous tip box at a snitch convention with enquiries about the place.
Sorry. Gotta hustle in this city.

dialogues.title: Reena - Round Five
lines: My second cousin was a checkers checkster and they wouldn't take kindly to that.
Hahaha, if my words hurt you, just wait till you see what my game does.
Ohhh, careful, wouldn't want you to peak prematurely. You still have to beat me at this first.
Darlin' you look so lost behind a chess board. Shouldn't you be playing checkers?
Happy to beat you at checkers too.
Well, it's a good thing I checked the number of fucks I give before I sat down. Any other family history you care to stream on about?

dialogues.title: Tell Andrea About Teleshko
lines: I have so many song ideas bubbling away inside me, they're finally gonna have a place to go and that's thanks to you!
Oh I'm glad I found you!
So Teleshko was the right place to drop the lyrics?
Better than ok, sugar! I just received my arrest warrant. They're taking me in!
Right, I need to run. I'd like to rent out my apartment while I'm in the inside! Wow "inside" so cool.

dialogues.title: Delbert Again
lines: First, we will need a headline. Something incendiary.
YES. A proclamation. A call to action.
Good. Last, we’ll need to make people look at the Rig itself. Open their eyes to what’s in front of them.
I guess I can do that.
Yeah, as a last resort. But if he's willing to lay down his life for O.R.S, then O.R.S will stand by him. For the good of the Rig.
So you aced the new members part of the initiation. I'm impressed, Cosmo.
We have Sanya on board, the photographer.
Hmph. If he's willing to lay down his life for O.R.S, then O.R.S will take him.
Now that we have members we can act. We can make a statement. Make the city stand up and tune their aural augs to our voices.
Well, you gave me his name, so ...
What do you have in mind?
Sending a message in the lifeblood of the city. I like it.
You and me, none of us... would ever get close to making this happen.
Ok. I might know someone. Works with neon signs.
Yes. Art to illuminate the structural beauty of the Rig.
You had to ask that Basin punk though? Kid's a walking disaster zone. He managed to burn down the level six inspection hab.
Look, all he needs is a bit of guidance.
Well done, Cosmo. This is the start of a new era. Just watch, with our members' help, O.R.S. will change it all.
Something explosive. Something drastic. We’re gonna put out… a press release.
Well, that's better than blowing something up.
Maybe Botan could… make something explode?
About the laying down of life thing…
Next, we’ll need an image. Something inspiring.
We will blow up their minds with a bomb of truth. Sending out fragments of poetry to lodge in the hearts of the Nivalians.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Danny waiting
lines: Danny is at the Noodle bar, waiting for you.

dialogues.title: Get Recipe from Marius Mitchell
lines: Hey, we do what we can here. LUZ restrictions make shipments difficult, but sometimes limitations are the key to inspiration.
You must have some interesting recipes.
And you're in here sniffing for recipes? Not on my watch bucko. Get lost.
You sure? My business lives or dies on this stuff so I can't be letting it get into the wrong hands.
Well firstly... wait, you're not in the business are you? Wouldn't want to be handing out trade secrets to the competition!
Ok, you got me. I run the place around the corner.
Any tips on cooking in the LUZ? I'd love some recipes.
I do have my own place.
Look, until you run your own place I'd keep those kinds of opinions to yourself.
Oh, it's a staple here. Really adds that little extra umami.
Yeah, I'm running the old Thaddeus place round the corner now.
It's not as simple as it looks on the holos. Managing your own joint comes with a lot of baggage.
Look man, I appreciate the honesty but I can't be giving out the good stuff to the competition. It's hard enough out here as it is.
Ok that sounds fine. Here you go. It's a best-seller here!
You have some strange ideas about flavor, but I am on the lookout for new recipes.
Hey there. We just got a fresh shipment of powder mulch in, if that's your bag?
No of course not... I'm just a keen home chef.

dialogues.title: Harmony Fifth meeting
lines: I'm no rainologist, but if I were to guess, CorpSec are probably putting something in it to keep us calm.
I thought business was booming in the LUZ.
Did that rain feel weird for you yesterday?
No, not really, but it's CorpSec. They'd manage to screw it up somehow.
What do you think it could be?
I'm sure it seems like a sweet deal if you're at the top of the Vinc tube defecating on everyone else. Fuck everyone else though right?
It's the way this city seems to be coded.
Well they'll see when there's nobody left here to sell to because we either all die of hunger or get murdered by the Aseptic.
I'd almost describe it as spongy.
That's exactly the problem. Didn't take long for the Corpsters to pick up on the fact us little people were turning a profit.
Yeah, sure it does if you're at the top of the Vinc tube defecating on everyone else. Fuck everyone else though, right?
I've been thinking a lot about that poverty positivity stuff. I think it's a crock of rat meat. Which is ironically all I can afford to eat.
They've slapped taxes on all goods entering the LUZ. I'm barely breaking even.
Well they'll see when there's nobody left here to sell to because we all died of hunger in the LUZ.
Well you never know, some of us might be lucky enough to freeze to death! Want some Goulash? I've discovered this old recipe recently and can't get enough of it.
They make more money if they let us live.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 14
lines: If atmospheric conditions allow, let's try some breathing. In, and out. In and out.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Finn Amano Sheets and Sheets
lines: Bad ju-ju my non-musical friend. Can't be signing while I'm singing or the words will leave my head.
'And long as I'm out here, sitting in an open space, figuring out my place, I'll be singing. You'll be gone and I'll be singing.'
*humming* That's the jam. Lemmie get this... wait a minute... yup.. ok, all situated now I just gotta find the shimmer sheet - hard to read music without the music yah know?
This technicolor tune: 'sliding through, down the drain and into joos. neon lights guiding you. guiding you.' Yeah, guiding you, that's it, that's the name.
Hey, hey, hey, my friend in the end. You got a minute? Could use an ear to get this vibe right.
Least I can do my friend. Least I can do. Enjoy the ride, yeah?
Yeah? Well isn't that just the greatest thing I've heard today. Wait - second greatest thing.
I met a fan of yours today.
I'm trying to pluck the perfect words from the depths of the hive mind. It's a mix and match without a latch.
Feedback is always appreciated. How we make things groove better, yah know? Gotta get it right before gettin' it out there for the fans.
Ah, tell yah what, here's something better than an autograph. Rough draft sheet music. Initial bytes and waves.
Hey, hey, el capitan, la capitan-ita. La rita. Senorita. Nah, that's not right. Hard times today.
Ah, that's amazing, and it dampens my very soul to say I can't give them one right now. Heed my words, I want nothing more than to scribble and sign for them!
In the warm and doughy flesh. Are you a fan? Always, always good to meet a fan.
My friend would love an autograph. I need to give them a special gift.
A friend of mine is a huge fan.

dialogues.title: Pilk's getting unreasonable
lines: Look, I'm not here to read you all the rules from the tenancy agreements handbook. That's your responsibility. It's all in there! You got this bud.
Comms are down in the LUZ.
Sure, so I can't have pets?
Where do I get the rulebook?
Hey, you're in one of my properties, right? I remember you.
Great yeah! Hey, I don't mean to hassle you, but did you get the memo? We have a new rule about pets.
Since when does one need to have a pet?
Assuredly. I believe that if it takes any active measures - such as taking any action whatsoever, or even remembering what you have just discussed, this landlord is unlikely to do anything at all.

Hey, I don't wanna be all "I'M-THE-BOSS-HERE" on you, but you really need to keep up with the communications from your landlord - me - or you're in violation of your tenancy agreement. No one wants that! Right?
This concludes our business. If you need another appointment to discuss tenancy issues, please consult your tenants guidebook for appointment times and contact details. Hey, have a great day!
You gotta keep up to date with all relevant paperwork. I can't just GET you all the documentation, but you're a clever tenant. You'll figure it out!
You want my advice? Ignore this. By tomorrow he'll have completely forgotten whatever insane requests he's made.

dialogues.title: No planted memories
lines: So says an old document on the Deep Nets.
Then we need to keep looking for more information.
I feel like... I must have been human, once.
It may be a long shot, but could there be someone still alive who remembers the Cryogenic crisis?
You really believe that? Remember what JR said.
Yes, you're right. Nothing is certain.
Let me query all the existing databases.
But the human bodies were destroyed.
Maybe. The oldest citizens of Nivalis might know something?
If only there was a witness. Someone who still remembers the Cryogenic crisis.
We hit a brick wall. I can't be human, because then I'd be dead. And I can't be an Automata, because I wouldn't have the memories. So... what am I?

dialogues.title: Visit Huckstash 2
lines: I hope you got what you wanted.
I would take the road with the company.
I'm sorry, I should have respected you both.
Well I guess you know what you know now.
If DeeDee wants to see me before I take the last wind. She'll have to come here!
Thank you. There's been some...Er... Sensitive stuff in there. Real raw potatoes. I don't have the fingers to encrypt things these days.
Gahhh that stubborn old tree trunk. Putting rubber to pavement just isn't in my blood.
You should have encrypted it better then...
Yeah, well, we were friends for a long time. Did she reply to my note?
She did, I hope you can see things from her perspective.
Never talk about DeeDee like that! She's ten times the human you or I will ever be! Did she reply to my note?
You're right, you should follow your gut. DeeDee Isn't worth giving this all up for.
DeeDee still clearly has feelings for you. She just can't live her life on the tracks anymore. You should go and see her.
Give me the smoothest ride possible.
Yeah I can see why you don't want to speak to her...
You listened to it? That was private information you Oogle imposter!
You really are the Corpster I took you for on day one. Leave here and don't come back!
You came back in one piece. I'm surprised.
Depends. Riddle me this, if you had two paths ahead of you, one old and crumbling but shared by another and one brand new but empty, which would you choose?
Maybe you're right. It has been a long time. I'll reach out to her. Myself this time.
Maybe not yet, but there is a home for you there. I can feel it.

dialogues.title: Leech worms and cryogenics default
lines: If it's "boring," why did they work so hard to delete the records? 200 years later?
I agree. It's very strange. What's so dangerous about that knowledge, 200 years later?
The records for cryogenic procedures have been erased in a very crude manor. The data is gone, but it's clear it DID once exist.

dialogues.title: Clancy Meeting 4
lines: You ready for the big kahuna kid? The real meat on the bones? This one's for free.
I'm nothing kid, I'm nothing to nobody. They say you die twice. The first time when you die, and the second time when nobody remembers you anymore. Well for me that's gonna be the same damn day.
That's what you get for working in sales.
I mean, it was a bit on the nose.
You're right. I'm sorry. I'm waffling on like I always do.
Ok here it is... don't be me. That's it. Whatever you do, just don't be me.
I really had you going didn't I? Had you eating out of the palm of my hand!
People will remember you. You're a great salesman!
Well kid, you've graduated from the Pantermino International Sales School. You're ready to go out there and feel the wind against your eyeballs. You could sell slime-mold to a sea dog.
And that's it. That's the final lesson. You can't be a great salesman, if you ain't a great writer. You gotta make the customer feel.
It's given me a lot to think about.
Also for tax reasons, old Clancy gotta move some funds around. Think you could take care of some Lims for me? Reinvest them or something? Just don't tell the Corpsters you got it from me.
As ready as I'll ever be.
It's very simple, maybe the easiest to learn, but by far the most important.
That's just it kid. Turns out the only thing I couldn't sell in the end was myself...

dialogues.title: Botan - Round Three
lines: Me. I thought it. Then I did it.
That's amazing. An actual thought formed inside your head? Hmmm. Miracles do happen.
Guess I'm gonna have to break your streak then.
Hahahaha! My streak is longer than your life. Let's play.
It'll be a miracle if your winning streak lasts through me.
Eh, luck is nothing more than having spare parts when something breaks.
You've made it this far, huh? Who woulda thought.

dialogues.title: Alfie gets deep
lines: Community does not matter. We must strive for Independence to succeed.
I'd be careful with this kind of loose thinking if I was you.
We should talk about something else.

Of course I'm on to something! You never see someone with real hustle feeling depressed. They're too busy chasing every opportunity, waking at 4 AM, working out, pitching new business ideas, micro-dosing plum extract, soaking their underwear in caffeine syrup.
Fuck, ok... Let's get started then. What did we cover last time? Career and love and all of that?
All of that, but you seemed like you had more to say.
Haha, yeah? Wait, are you fucking with me? I don't know if you're joking. But you must be...
So community is a bad thing?
I think you're on to something.
Good to... see you again. I know... I know. Time for session two. Just... gimme a minute, k?
We should talk about something else.
Stick with it. One more session and I think we'll see a real breakthrough. You'll see. You'll see.
Absolutely! Think about it. What else can destabilize business, compromise the status quo and mortally wound a vibrant, healthy economy?
I'm not sure this is good for either of us.
Two key areas of Nivalis life are Community and Depression.
Me? No. I mean, I have no reason to complain. All the opportunities are right there waiting for us. The only thing standing in our way is our own excuses.

Of course it's true. You never see someone with real hustle feeling depressed. They're too busy chasing every opportunity, waking at 4 AM, working out, pitching new business ideas, micro-dosing plum extract, soaking their underwear in caffeine syrup.
Community is neither good nor bad. It's what they choose to do that matters.
Me? Fucking... whatever. I gotta do this. I gotta say this shit. Complaining won't help. There's no way out for me.

A sign that you're lingering in your emotions. That you're not staying active, pushing forward. Depression is what you feel when you are too focused on yourself and not enough on your responsibilities to your coworkers and employers.
They pass out! They don't have time to feel anything. They're numb! Nothing can hurt a speeding bullet.
I think community is the way we will make things better.
So your advice is, to stay so busy I never feel anything?
I need to avoid anything that gets in the way of success, including my emotions.
I'd like to hear more about community.
Sounds like you're even further down the road to success than me. That's... great.
A what? No. The answer is too much community. Too many people misconstruing commercial sabotage as charity and taking on altruistic vanity projects.
What is this, the Age of Salubrity again? No, the danger is community, especially community projects.
Well I think we're making real progress. You must feel great now.
That's right! You see these people all the time. They never stop. We have a name for them. Winners. They never have time to be depressed while they're on the streets of Nivalis.
Everyone feels depressed if they let themselves. You're supposed to feel depressed. It's a sign.
ANY kind of projects - if they don't foster economic growth. Look, I'm no economitian, but even I know that labor that doesn't encourage growth is morally wrong.
Are you kidding me? It's the WORST thing. Every sociological disaster and every societal collapse has been caused by an overdeveloped sense of community among the citizenry.
The first thing to know about depression is that it's normal, but it's also not real.
The thing you have to remember about community is that no matter how appealing it feels to rely on other people, it will weaken your character and make you dependent on strangers.
Well I got plenty more advice for you. A million Lims worth of advice, for no fee.
Nah, there's not much I CAN say. Except all this excellent, free advice I can offer you!

dialogues.title: Get help from Gideon
lines: You did the right thing coming to me. This whole situation is gone. Trust me. Your troubles, these people... Gone. Now please, excuse me. I'll see you around.
Perhaps not. It seems Gideon was already after these criminals. Or could win favor with a local crime boss by turning them in.
My price isn't Lims, it's access. I am working for Elodie, a local... person of influence. These thugs are on her payroll, and I am guessing she does not know about this little scheme of their's.
I need to know when they are coming in for... for one of your delicious Bodega sandwiches. Just a call. That's all I need.
Too early to say... But we can hope.
How do you know about my problems?
That's all I want. A call when our friends visit. And for that low price, your problem just... goes away.
To protect us? No. But to remove our common enemies? Yes. Yes, I believe we can.
Do we have business? I don't think I need anything from you now.
I think we may have stumbled into something.
The low rent extortionists targeting your new business... experiment. That Bodega is a disaster. You should have turned it down.
What will you do to them?
I suggest we wait. And if those unsavory individuals try and collect from us again, we call Gideon. Though I fear he may already be on their trail.
You should own your bad business decisions. The Bodega is a problem, but these thugs are not. I can see them off... For a price.

dialogues.title: Elaine Malloy would like you to talk to Roberta
lines: I'm working on a new series, "Faces in Gastronomy", and when I saw your staff member, Roberta, I knew she would be one of my models!
I won't even disturb her work. I'm aiming for the authentic. Regular city people doing regular city things.
Hello again. Do you remember me, dear?
Then why did you ask for me?
Hi. My name is Elaine Malloy.
She works for you. Your restaurant would be part of the series so I need your permission.
Alright, I will have a chat with Roberta.
Of course it would have a promotional effect. People would come to see Roberta at work.
It's not quite right for this series.

dialogues.title: Player Won
lines: You could write a song about it.
I Can't Play Chess For Shit?
Dang, I guess I really lost.
Please don't write a song about it.
PAWN STAR! I'm coming 'cross the board for you...
I'm gonna write a song about it! I could call it...
It's ok, man. I think I needed that. Gotta stay humble, you know. Hey...

dialogues.title: Sanna at the Space Port
lines: I don't know. She needs money. I could protect her. I could keep my job here. Pass up on the Luna job. I dunno...
I thought you hated your job here.
No! Didn't think of that. Good idea.
But you were really excited about the Luna opportunity.
Hey! This place is something else, huh? Are you just watching the rockets taking off, or jumping on one?
I need to think about this. I feel like I'm standing on the edge of a big, dark pit and someone I love is telling me it's fine to step forward.
I'm fine. Fine! I mean, I'm still here. For better or worse.
I really was starting to find my feet on my own, you know. It took me a while. And she... wants me to move in with her to help look after her mom.
Yeah, we can't leave anyway. Not unless you can afford the MASSIVE bribe you'd need to pay to escape the LUZ.
Ok... so... My Ex called me and we talked. We talked for hours. It was... really nice actually. Like old times.
Yeah... it's just... I don't know. Was I really in love with her? I mean I think I was, but also... maybe I was scared of being alone. But then being alone... it's not THAT bad.
I guess I'm like someone trapped under the ice, and I'm attracted to the light from the sun, so I'm looking up at it. Through the ice.
...I think so. The lower gravity will help with the pain in my knees and spine. And there's spelunking on Luna too. I think I could make a new start there. I even have a job offer - a good one.
Sounds like a fresh start. But... I'm not sure if I should tell you this... You're gonna give me a hard time.
Being alone is better than being in a bad relationship.

All I wanted was to get her back, but now she's there in front of me, I don't feel happy. I feel like I'm in danger... Fuck it. I need to get some sleep and clear my head. I'll make a decision tomorrow. See you later.
When you're allowed to leave, will you get on a shuttle?
You're gonna get through this Sanna. Stay strong.
If you really love her you should go back to her.
None of this is any of my business.
Yeah. And I miss her, but... maybe I was scared of being alone. And then when I was alone... I kind of found my feet. It wasn't so bad.
She... wants to have the opposite of a trial separation. We could have a trial... what would you call it? We could try getting back together.
Nah, it's not THAT bad. I mean this morning I accidently asked a barista for a "depresso". But I'm managing.

dialogues.title: Return Gan
lines: You're lucky you've been useful to me today, otherwise I might not have agreed to forget what you just said.

Ohhh Ganny boy, you've really done it this time. I could forgive the first three escapes but this is the final straw. I'm going to wrap you in so much digital barbed wire, that you'll never see another person again.
Yeah I have his construct here.
Well hurry up. I don't have all day.
You know, you don't have to be so rude to everyone.

dialogues.title: Catering Request
lines: Are you actually a caterer too?
Supposed to fix a catering issue. Think I got played though.
Someone tried to tongue-fuck the front end of a train. Was looking forward to it too. Haven't had a good trauma call in a while.
Straight to business, huh? Don't wanna hang around and chat?
Why aren't you going to his party?
Judging by the look of yah it already has.
Zig likes his parties. Likes everyone to have a good time and he'll go to lengths to make sure it happens.
Whatever. To each their own. So, if you're not a fatality freak, then what are you doing here?
Where'd you leave it for him?
Why didn't you give it to him in person?
No idea what you're talking about.
If you're trying to take pictures or get a clip, they already hauled them away.
I'm sure karma will get me at some point.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. Listen, in all honesty it is what it is.
Pretty mellow actually. Least compared to what dispatch told me when the alert came through.
Yeah, kinda like the time he spent twenty thousand Lims on a party for his buddy to propose to his girlfriend at.
Damn, you really are a trauma junkie.
Takeout! Swing by to 'take' something else outta my bag?
Yeah. I mean, all I needed to do was log a 1044 form and report the BioX-50 lot number.
Pffftt. Have you ever been to a Ziggy party, takeout?
His spleen ruptured. Kinda ironic if you think about it. Body is meant to keep us alive and his killed him. Ha! I probably shouldn't laugh at that.
Yeah, yeah, well you're the one who took the stuff soooooo. Now, before I get another call, what did you come here to take?
Poison control, probably. I did my emergency assessment and deemed him stable enough.
Mhm. Here's where you can find the party favors. My advice? Go slow. Have fun, takeout.
See those ferns? Bloke didn't realize they were contortix blossoms. Shoulda seen how quick the bots mopped his puke up off the floor.
Made a deal I'd do this ASAP.
Can we focus on the catering?
Just being aware of the situations around me.
Fuckin' Ziggy. That dude is going to be the death of me. And his party guests.
Listen, I cater, but party favors are different than party food. I told Zig where to find his gift bag but he shunned me since I told him I wasn't going.
Not for the bloke who needed a dose, couldn't get it.
Right? So, one fatality freak to the next, if you aren't here for that then why are you here?
What exactly is in the bag?
Exactly. Then we all found out he was actually banging the girl behind said buddy's back. So, you know, there is that.
He could throw me a party.
Ughhh, because then I'd be complicit?
Haven't stayed alive this long by being dumb. Situational awareness my friend. Situational awareness. Ah, shit, that's an alert from dispatch.
Hahaha. Oh boy. Well, you're in for a treat. I'll give it to him, he's fun. Also really good for business.

dialogues.title: You Beckoned
lines: Good little synth-pup. I need entertainment. I don't know what these kind of people listen to, what acts will draw them in.
You might have to change your attitude when people are actually here.
What's this have to do with me?
Look at that, you're smarter than you seem.
.... you can dress the words as nice as you want but the meaning's still there.
Took a vacation day. Figured I'd lie on the beach. Catch some sun.
Our annual gala is coming up and our new corporate backers want a, well... I can't believe I'm saying this ...
You would bring me to the Corpster level?
... Yes. Assist me with this and I'll bring you.
You want me to work with you?
Yes, I know, the finer things in life must be intimidating for someone like you. But! Luck is in your favor. I have a job for you.
Are you going to find some musicians or no?
Do you know how much that will increase your business portfolio? Not to mention your revenue?
And like a good little synth-pup you materialized. I have a job for you.
... For money? Lims. The thing that buys the stuff you want?
Listen, the fact is that you can think whatever you want about me, my businesses, my island, whatever.
Neon Gods. The gala is raising money to increase the reserves in accounts I hold across different markets.... IT'S TO MAKE ME RICHER YOU STUPID FUCK.
But for the people who ascend, there are those that help them. Wouldn't you rather be a footnote and an aide than nothing at all?
Whatever rocks roll down your river. But before you get lathered in sun screen and picked apart by gulls, I have a job for you.
Ten days?! That's not even two weeks.
Congrats, you can do math. Ten days. Don't disappoint me.
Good, the gala is in ten days. I need someone by then.
How is that lucky for me?
I think I can get someone.
And yet here I am giving you an opportunity.
... more welcoming environment for people who might not have the opportunity to visit the island otherwise.
But, if you help me do this, then I'll feed the new arrivals to your restaurants.
Being eaten by gulls sounds better than working for you.
For me. I want you to work for me.
And yet here I am. Beckoned.
Please. Once people get a taste of what I can offer them they'll eat, drink, do whatever I tell them. I'm a rocket ship and people want to see what space tastes like.
Listen. I'll drop the pretext. We know the goal is to make it to the Spire, and we know there's only a few who are going to get there.
Well, you're of the same demographic so I would assume you have the same... tastes... if you can even call it that.
Do not lecture me on how to act towards clients. I know how to run my businesses.
What do you need me to do?
Yeah but gala's usually raise money for a cause.
When it comes to you I'd rather be nothing.

dialogues.title: Need Funds
lines: Ok, let's go for the loan.
You can get money quickly by visiting a loan shark. There is one in the LUZ. However, his help might come at a cost.
Lims are a tool of oppression designed to subjugate the masses.
First, do not panic. I will help you increase your funds. You have two options.
That is how some see them. But if you want to grow or indeed run any of your businesses, I'm afraid you'll need to dirty your hands with MONEY.
You increase your funds by working hard with what you have: fishing, farming and furniture. You can sell what you catch and grow, or trade in furniture you don't need. So... which is it to be?
Very well. I will update your HUD with the details of a loan shark. His name is Calhoun. Tread carefully.
Very well. You should have everything you need to get started. Don't forget that traders in different areas might give better prices. Good luck!
I hate to bother you, but I have been monitoring your finances and they are running critically low.
I will try to get the money by myself.

dialogues.title: Dagmar Has Another Job
lines: Go find him. tell him how WONDERFUL my places are. Best in the LUZ, nowhere better. Make it convincing. Then I'll know you're serious.
Stop yapping. Are you in or not?
Oh, I will. And I'm quite good at it. You'll see.
Not. Do your own dirty work from now on.
So, you're back. Nice job on the old rat n' run.
I've seen that know it all food critic DeNuite skulking around the place. A good word from him and business would boom.
Do your own dirty work from now on.
It's dog eat dog, Dagmar baby!
Thing is, our rivals just aren't sinking fast enough for my liking. And seeing you make money gets me itchy.

dialogues.title: Ava talks about  Gungers confusion
lines: Why did he think I was Thaddeus?
I... do not know. But I have some ideas. Allow me to come back to you on this issue.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus strange message 1
lines: Nivalis was sucking the life out of my bones. But this place... it's like my mind is spinning away from my brain, and I can't pull it back into me without twisting it into a shape that doesn't process reality in the same way anymore.
I DO have a lot of questions...
The ticket. Egress. That's what you want to know about, right? Do you know why you're still chasing after a ticket? Chasing after me?
Hey kid, I know you probably got a lot of questions, but trust me, answers just make your world smaller. I want to leave some wonder for you to discover.
That's the end of the message.
I have received a new moon message from Thaddeus.
I am sorry that my former owner cannot find a quicker path to his point.
Do I need to hear it?
I am close. I'm stroking your hair now. Though I'm a couple of dimensions out of alignment with you. But you might still feel it.
I want to escape to wherever he went.
Why ARE you trying to get to Egress? And Thaddeus?
I hope he gets to the point...
I know you probably been chasing ghosts and shadows for a while, but the road you travel shapes the way you walk. With one short leg, you go in circles unless someone gives you a leg up.
You're the only one that's not tainted by me. By the pieces of me I scattered everywhere I went. Like pollen. Like mold. Stay clear of me, kid. Stay pure.
I feel like something is pushing me towards him.
Actually... this message doesn't seem to come from Luna. It's a tight-wave broadcast, on an old frequency that's not blocked by the Comms embargo. Radio waves. He is close.
I don't feel anything at all.
No one is going to make your life simpler kid. Not your loved ones, not your friends. No one. The only person who can simplify your life is you. Will you choose to do that?

dialogues.title: Edison  Mr Delivery Man
lines: And the debt to go with it?
Well, looks like you're putting more than a fresh coat of paint on this place.

Name's Edison Mattix. Don't call me Ed or Matty and we'll be good as glass. I do deliveries for Conland Containers. You know, Judy's company? I hadn't heard from Thaddeus in a while so I thought I'd swing by.
Do you know where he went?
Tell me what he told you.
Did he say anything before he left?

Look, I gotta run. I'll put together Thaddeus's typical order and swing it through in a couple days. Bring you something extra. Something a little... hard to come by. My way of welcoming you to the grind.
Nah. He only spoke of the big picture stuff, not little details. I'm assuming he left you the stand? Admirable.
Yeah, well, you're hardly the only one. It's a rotten system.
He really did it, huh? He's gone, right? Like gone gone.
Thaddeus didn't lose much sleep worrying about profitability. He seemed more worried about keeping his old pals, like Banor, in work. He even slipped me some cash when I was down on my luck.
He was always rambling about some grand idea or another. Little out there but still, one of the few people I consider - considered? - a friend.
Of course I knew him. I've delivered to him for almost five years. Did he talk about how we helped each other?
How'd he get into so much debt anyway?

dialogues.title: You Have A Message
lines: That woman who owns the resorts on Calypso Island?
Alright. I could use a trip to the beach anyway.
You have a message from Freya Portlet.
It might be interesting to see what she wants. She has some influence.
It would be interesting to see what she wants. Don't forget the sunscreen.
So this is a new one.
It just says to go see her.

dialogues.title: Ava I Tried to Tell You
lines: That might have been the easy part. We still have to meet Mica. Stroke of luck perhaps? I got a message from the noodle stand. She's there now.
Somehow we seem to be alive...
Now we just have to lure her to Calypso island.

dialogues.title: Marcelle Stops By Incognito
lines: I’ll have to take your word for it.
Your dishes already told me that.
Marvelous! I will return soon and sample some for myself. Ciao for now.
You think I should serve it?
Every dish tells a tale. These greenhouse-grown vegetables, this distinctly illegal but surprisingly excellent miso paste… they tell a story of endings and beginnings.
Nivali Rat is one of the finest meats around. Just because it’s cheap doesn’t mean it isn’t delicious. Sometimes simple is best.
Perhaps. Tell me, do you have rat meat on your menu?
Tell me, do you have rat meat on your menu?
Tell me honestly, how is the restaurant business treating you? Not everyone is suited to it.
A shame. I am partial to it, and it’s hard to find in the Spire. I thought being stuck down here I’d have a chance to indulge my rat-tooth.
Some of the best things in life are accidental - like the time a chef at Chew Frou Frou spilled algae broth into her coffee and created green caffeine.
At some point, you definitely will. See you.

dialogues.title: Banor needs bar chairs
lines: And bums don't mind which one it is, as long as there's something to put a plate on in front of them.
In case you're wondering why nobody is sitting at the bar...
Because bar chairs don't just grow like trees. How about buying some?
I think three would be sufficient for a start. Common rule: Tables need chairs, and bars need bar chairs.
Why didn't you add more chairs?

dialogues.title: Hanz has a Request
lines: I knew you had some business sense that would one day bubble to the surface. I’ll keep you on the tour itinerary. For now.
What can I do for you, Mr Grundown?
Guests of the Grundown Ritz are the social cream of Nivalis. They expect to enjoy their bespoke Slum-brr-Party packages without risking their reputations.
No, I’m threatening your tables. Shall I make it clearer? “Change the tables, New Thadd, or I’ll have them kicked to splinters and thrown into the sewer”.
They caused my clients a moment of displeasure. Which makes them unforgivable.
Look, the LUZ is the hottest spot in Nivalis right now. Aseptic still echoes, Unity Balls. And now we’re offering a full Debt Orphan Experience.
They’ll be tighter when your customers don't have anything to eat from.
The thing is, New Thadd, I have a bone to pick with you. It’s your tables.
That seems pretty clear. Leave it with me.
Look, the LUZ is the hottest spot in Nivalis right now. Aseptic Raves, Unity Balls. And now we’re offering a full Debt Orphan Experience.
You don't think that's a bit cynical?
Wrong. Your tables caused my clients a moment of displeasure. Which makes them my problem. Which makes me your problem.
I have no idea what you just said.
That’s business. At the Grundown we give clients what they want. And remove what they don’t.
New Thaddeus, just the person I need to see.
Invest in new tables immediately. Ones that don’t inflict emotional distress.
Not my clients. Not my problem.
How can I cash in on this?
I didn't have you down as an idiot. Don’t expect any more clients from the Grundown Ritz.
It allows our clients to walk the streets in Z-grade footwear… extremely vogue.
I have a name, you know.
They’re offensive. My clients hate them. To quote one review: “Just looking at them made my fashion creds on ChicBeagle go down by 0.7%.”
Lims are a little tight right now.
I’m sure you do. But learning it would take seconds, maybe even minutes out of my day, and I need all that time for my customers. You understand? Good.
Or said tables might become the victims of… unfortunate accidents.
It sells very well. That's all that matters to our elite clients.

dialogues.title: Discussing Jaynes with Ava
lines: I took the liberty of doing some searches and it seems to be that Samuel is the only person with those particular religious beliefs in the city.
Think he can really hear voices?
Perhaps we should return to him at a later date.
I don't like the sound of that.
Think he could be communicating with an AI?
I'm not sure I fully understood.
I'm not sure. However, if he is, and the AI has convinced him that they are some kind of deity, that could be a non-optimal situation.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 4 - Yes
lines: She's probably right. Let's head to this crime scene.
Yes, but she told us to steer clear.
I hate it when she does that. Did you mention the Crusty Punks?

dialogues.title: Radiating Tales
lines: That there's another. Someone intertwined with the person I'm speaking with right now. Hmm. If you find yourself needing space, you should seek me out again. You know, when you're not here trying to do business.
Loneliness. A fleeting dream or hint of some aroma once found pleasurable.
Ooooohhhhh. I like this. Alright. Yeah, I got you. Give me a few and I'll get it out there. Already thinking about the colors... oh, the colors.
Need some help getting a message out.
I think you're smelling your own paint fumes.
A message? Lookin' to send a beacon in the dark, huh? Alright, I'll bite. What can I bring to life for you?
That's right. You got a bit of a shine to you. Your aura radiates, same as me.
Probably just gonna focus on this.
He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
Thanks, but actually just looking for a favor.
Mhmmm, darlin' you do what you wanna do. And what's that gonna be tonight?
He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born way too late.
You're a rainbow. There are so many colors I'd like to paint you with.
Scent is but one sense. It's when they mix, combine and swirl into a spiraling helix of emotions. Whoo, almost got ahead of myself there.
Whelp! Can't blame me for trying. What can lil' ol' me do for you?
I'll have to come see you sometime.

dialogues.title: Ava Didn't You Forget Something
lines: No blood on our hands. Well, not literally. I'll try to locate Edison. Let's tell him what you're up to.
Freya is ruthless. She would kill Mica.
Edison might have a hidden agenda.
I have a solution. It's not certain to succeed. Or likely. And... it may contradict some of the morals I've observed in your actions so far.
You don't hate that. You love it!
Hear me out. I know you. I know you want to help the child. If we don't stop Mica, the niece dies. If we can't find a way to win over Freya, she will never be free.
We only deliver Mica to Freya Portlet, right. We don't actually kill her ourselves!
Who do I have to kill?
She's Corp. No morals is basically her job description.
We could help Mica destroy The Network and Conland Containers.
I swam the nets. Edison had a sister. She died and left a daughter behind. The age checks out.
It's not like you're pulling the trigger. And it's either Mica goes down, or Edison, his niece, and your business, are all history.
Mica is an android, if that helps
Which would probably kill Edison's niece.
Who do I have to screw over?
Yes, we only deliver her. Unless... No, no. Let's not kill her ourselves. I'll try to locate Edison.
So, about Edison and Mica... The Network and Corpsec. We seem to have two options.
I think Mica has made it clear. She will take everyone down. It's her or us... Unless we roll over and surrender to her.
We could try to save the child.
And the child was erased from the records a couple of days ago.
I hate to say I told you so.
So what do we do? How do we save the niece?
Yes. I'm out. I can't bear the responsibility.
He seems to me like a man who is tired of lies and deceit. He is broken.
Mica says there is no niece.
Are you sure about that? An innocent child? Edison? We give up on them?
I mean I guess if Freya kills her, she might have a backup consciousness somewhere?
Mica is Freya's most bitter enemy. If we choose The Network over CorpSec, we will make a powerful friend. Give Mica to Freya, and she will give you anything you ask for.
I can't do it. Mica can have whatever she wants.
You're right. We have to stop Mica.

dialogues.title: Ava introduces Marcelle, the food critic
lines: Am I supposed to know who that is?
Why is he at the Noodle Bar?
I have good news. Mr Marcelle DeNuite is waiting for you at the Noodle Bar.
Marcelle DeNuite is one of the most famous food critics in Nivalis. His review column "Kind of a Big Dill" has over three million subscribers.
Perhaps he is considering writing a review. It could be a great opportunity for you...
He certainly has the power to make your business suffer. But I'm sure it will be fine.
Do not worry. If he likes your dishes, it could be a great boost to your reputation.

dialogues.title: Get Recipe from Dagmar Fitz
lines: Yeah, the specialty of the house. It's called "Go Fuck Yourself" Pie. Now get out of my face.
Heard your place was the best in the district.
You haven't bought anything. So you're not a customer.
Thaddeus's place? Ha, and I thought I was in trouble. Fuck it, I'll give you some recipe tips if you want them.
No, you didn't. And I don't appreciate the smell of bullshit.
I've taken over the Noodle Bar.
And I'm just trying to get through the day without stabbing someone.
Look, if I give you some tips will you leave?
Calling it a job is like calling a trip to the dentist a vacation.
Why are you shilling for recipes anyhow?
I'm new here. Came to say hello.
So why do you do it?
Yeah, if only to piss off CorpSec. It'll be my good deed for the decade.
Sorry to bother you. I'll go.
I just inherited a failing business with only one dish on the menu.
Unfortunately I'm addicted to this substance called "food".
I'll go if you give me one of your recipes.
I'm sorry. I'm just trying to find recipes.

dialogues.title: The Hashimoto 125 CV
lines: And a set of seven with the cleaning and sharpening accoutrements comes to just 4608 Lims!
New stock just came in. Boss, they got The Hashimoto 125 CV. Now that's a knife!
I thought you loved your old knife.
It's like butchering with a nano-laser. Cuts fat, sinew, bone... No resistance.
I was at the knife store at Hive Mall yesterday.
I'll see what I can do.
Hand-finished ebony grip guard, plasteel shaft, mono-molecular edge...
I thought maybe you could buy it for me, boss!

dialogues.title: Mala First Metting
lines: While I have you, I was wondering if we could run some stuff up the flag pole and see what sticks?
Put quite simply, yes. If you have a minute, please ping me again. That'd be great.
I'm sorry, I was told you ran businesses?
Nothing a little hard graft and weekly performance reviews won't cultivate.
Great! So I think it's time we did a SWOT analysis of everything.
I'm sorry what are you talking about?

Look, as you can probably tell, traditional schooling is a little below me. My end of year assignment is related to business management, something I already excel at. The sooner I can get it done and out the way, the sooner I can get into the industry.
Hey, I probably have my ducks in a much neater row than you Noodle Head.
Ok, I was really hoping you could take the lead on this.
My tutors can't see past their own noses and have sent me out to do menial busy-work in the form of a questionnaire.
You want to ask me questions?
Aren't you a little young for this stuff?
Well I hold shares in a number of startups as well as a considerable stake in a holo-hedge-fund that's doing remarkable work in the tax avoidance sector.

dialogues.title: Industrial Disctirct
lines: My attempt at a joke. We haven't used coal in a long time and most of the city's structures are made of Plasteel, a steel-like carbon material optimized for maximum durability to last for millennia.
This city was built of coal and steel thousands of years ago. The industrial age began here.
Sometimes you just need a place with a specific utility and the Industrial District is one of those places.
No. This planet ran out of coal at least 500 years ago.

dialogues.title: Talk to Maria about inheritance
lines: Family was, yes. But we returned to peasantry a long time ago. It's more of a conversation starter these days.
You said something about being "royal" before.
Giving people a clean place to eat? Sounds way more meaningful to me than being a fucking freeloader.
It's true. But we returned to peasantry a long time ago. It's more of a conversation starter these days.

dialogues.title: Meet Quince Crogan
lines: Have you ever heard of a secret metro station called "Egress"?
I think I'll take my business elsewhere.
You know, you're not so bad. You're not a ferroequinologist, are you?
I need a logic relay for a a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.
Instead, I'm stuck selling plastic guts to glorified vacuum cleaners. Now say what you want, or push off.
Uh. That stupid story again. Look, I know every inch of the tracks in this part of the city and I've never even seen a whisper of it. Now, if you don't mind, some of us have work to do.
"Gut broker" is what they call me on the street. But when their alimentary mods clog up or their intestinal sump valves stop filtering, it’s all “please, Mr Crogan".
So do you have the part?
Those things break down faster than black market dermis. No wonder the Corp dropped them.
Condemned by the sins of my fathers to be locked down here with a deranged killer. Not even a train ride for comfort. Don't tell anyone, will you?
As it so happens, I do. It's a common enough request.
Look, I just need a part.
Maybe you should build your parts better.
No, I'm Nivalis' leading synthetic gastro-intestinal specialist.
A logic relay for a Third Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.
They're not people. They're machines who think drinking coffee and eating donuts will make them human. Pathetic.
Well, that's what they are. Chattering machines. Now what do you want?
Oh, one of those mealy-mouthed meeter-greeter units.
You'll be back. Like the rest of them.
Maybe they're built just how I like them.
Of course you do. Which part?
You can be assured that I will.
Ferro, as in iron, equine as in horse? It's what folk used to call us rail enthusiasts. If it wasn't for my debt, that's where I'd be, in the Metro Hub with a NATA-log...
No! About my debt! This Aseptic character is an android, mark my words. Probably one that hates my guts.
My problem is twenty years ago my skills would have taken me to the Spire.
I need a part for a friend.
Trains are the only good thing about this city. All of that sublime steel. If it wasn't for my debt that's where I'd be, in the metro hub, with a NATA-log.
You do? Well too bad I only have one left. Which I'm saving. For good friends only. Now, if you'll excuse me...
Yes, what is it? I don't cater to humans you know, only appliances.
Watch your back! No one's going to watch it for you.
To break down so people have to keep coming back?

dialogues.title: Can I ask You a Question
lines: Maybe. It was good talking to you. I hope you stop by again. Not many people appreciate this view.
Well, I'll see ya around then.
Um, geez, pressed I'd have to say my noodle stand.
That's good. Neither am I really. If there is one, and they find me up here, at least I have a clean jump into the sea.

No, not like that. I mean a place with pure disconnection. No access to the Grid what-so-ever. I can't stop thinking about what that would do to someone, whether they'd be happier. Guess we'll never really know.
My apartment, if it were bigger.
Well, yes. Unless you've figured out how to break through it. Not that you'd want to. Have you been on the feeds since that killer started sneaking around?
I think I heard about that.
I wasn't aware any part of this city could be someone's favorite.
You mean like a sensory sterilization spa?
I hope I'm here when you do.
Completely off the Grid? Why would you want that?
That's probably a good thing, right?
There's beauty everywhere if you know to look for it.
I'm sorry. You probably just came up to admire the view and here I am assuming you want to talk.
I've just heard stories. Every time I try to see if they're true or not they end before I can find out.
Oh, nothing... Just, well, can I ask you something?
Isn't it kind of hard to space out in a city this loud?
Can I ask you something else?

That's what they say, anyway. Apparently someone leaked the crime scene photos in the feeds. I haven't looked at them though. Can't really bring myself to. I'd much rather be up here, lost in this view. Ignorance truly is bliss.
It's amazing the Grid hasn't warped that too. I'll see ya around.

Oh, yes. The smell of fresh ingredients. Sounds of bowls and plates and utensils clanging together. There's beauty in food, and the connections we make while eating it. There's beauty everywhere if you know where to look.

You'd think so, but I seem to be doing it more and more lately. This spot is perfect for it. I mean, look at that. Despite what people think of it, Nivalis is a beautiful city. It's... well, can I ask you something?
Have you ever heard of a place that doesn't have access to the Grid? A place where the Nets don't reach?
Eh, I'd rather not get into anything too heavy.
Where's your favorite place in Nivalis?
I really have to go. I'll come back though.
Something tells me you're not that ignorant.
Sometimes more isn't better. You can find beauty everywhere, sometimes more so in the little things.
Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't see you. Was in my own little world there. I'm Zee. Least I still remember my name, right? Is there something I can do for you?
You can even find it in nothing at all. A space void of stimuli and overburdened connections.

dialogues.title: Ava, There's Something Wrong with the Lights
lines: Just so you're aware, there's something wrong with the lights.
So how do we fix them?
Tell me what to do or I'll stick my finger in a socket.
Well, it could be the fuses in our localized system. I don't believe they've been inspected or changed in some time. Most likely they're faulty.
Needless to say, that power supplier is no longer in business.
Oh I have no idea. Electrical things are not for me. Too many nightmares about static shocks. They're the true AI slasher.
So how do we fix the lights?
I can just muddle around with it.
... I truly don't know what Thaddeus ever saw in you. I believe if you fiddle with the... things... there, you should be able to reconnect everything. Form a full circuit.
Could be a rolling blackout. Though last time a Corp pulled that it was reported CorpSec lost over a trillion Lims minute-by-minute licensing fees.
A lot of fledgling companies can't afford lengthy operating permits so they work with minute-by-minute licenses. Those hours must be great.
I believe if you fiddle with the... things... there, you should be able to reconnect everything. Form a full circuit.
That's a lot of words for no real answer.

dialogues.title: Kai explains Farming and Fishing
lines: Don't drink the yellow water that comes out of the pipes in The Marrow.
You know you can just ask Ava? She has a better memory than most humans, and a FAR better memory than yours.
I'm impressed. You can remember your name. What next? Your age?
As long as you don't call me that weird name again.
Yes, that too. The more plants you cultivate, the more we can check off on your achievement list.
I mean any more tips for unlocking new zones!
I... don't spend a lot of time talking to people offline. It can make me seem a little... stiff.
The weird name you keep using.
Orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets. And cranberry juice.
Care for more tourism achievement tips?
And I don't enjoy acting like a tour guide. This job is beneath me.
More specifically, do you have a problem with me?
I also love orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets too!
Good. Finding rare fish will open up new locations via your visa achievements.
Yes, well, lets both be professional about this. I still have a job to do. Have you been fishing or farming?

dialogues.title: Shipping Forecast 1
lines: I'm picking up some sort of broadcast. Would you like to hear it?

dialogues.title: Bring Sal the TT
lines: NOW we're cooking. You wait, customers are gonna go hog wild for this place. Golden Serviette here we come.

dialogues.title: It's Safia
lines: This is my private life... but I guess I can't deny it's affecting my work...
I prefer if romance is avoided between employees if it causes these problems.
If it happens, I don't want to know about it.
You just need to work through this. You can do it.
Well, it's nice my staff get along.
Get your act together, ok? I want us all to move on.
You're making your private life my problem, so either we fix it or you're gone.
You need to get over her and focus on what matters. Work.
You're going to fire me. I know I overstepped with that customer. I'm sorry, boss.
You're in a lot of trouble so you better tell me everything.
I guess I know what's coming next...
You wouldn't even know her. Her name's Safia. Safia Megane. Lives in Hive Mall. But I doubt you can help me.
I'm listening. Let's work this out.
It's the waitress, Safia. She's attractive and kind and witty... but I don't stand a chance.

dialogues.title: Danny has more donut questions
lines: Salty, sweet, savoury, umami and bitter?
Not yet my friend! But we are getting close. I can feel it. Listen, can I get your opinion for a minute? I got three flavor profiles I need to explore. Wanna hear them?
Salty, sweet, bitter, spicy and sour.
So you know the six basic taste profiles, right?
Actually... I just remembered I left the reactor running. I gotta get back. I'll tell you later, ok! Stay loose friend!
Oh for real? Maybe I caught you at a bad time or something. I'll uh... see you around. I guess.
Hey! My donuts came out great!
Right... But you forgot isotopes. Everyone forgets isotopes.
We're sensitive to it down here you see. It makes your teeth buzz. In a good way.
No! Barely. Just enough to get you some pep. It makes the other flavors stand out too.
Oh come on! It was the Matcha one, remember? Anyway, it came out great.
Umami, crunchy, juicy, salty and hummus?
Yes! Nice catch. You were listening. Anyway, it came out great. I think it's my best yet.
So what are the three flavors?
Sure! Everyone in Nivalis likes a little tang from the radioactivity. Not too much. It's not dangerous or anything.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 9
lines: Have you ever watched the sunrise over the ocean? That’s what I would do today, if it were up to me.

dialogues.title: We served ten customers
lines: We got a fair chance of turning a profit.
Hey boss, things are starting to pick up here.
Sure is. That's more than ten customers.

dialogues.title: Do you want to pay Ashwin
lines: If his project eventually works it could be lucrative.
Have you thought about Ashwin's proposal?
This has to stop. No more money.
I guess so. Send him the money.
Another 7000 Lims. This is getting out of hand.

dialogues.title: Rheno 1
lines: I've been doing this a long time. Too Long. But I've never seen anything like it. Not so much as a particulate left at any of his gigs. I've won the 'Clean-Scene' award more times than I can remember, whoever this is runs sterilized-rings round me.
Yeah pretty big deal at the time.
You think I'm dressed like this for fun, Shoku? Never seen an Aftermath Technician before?
Maybe us citizens could sort this mess out.
Fuck CorpSec, no I'm freelance. Last thing Corpster landlords want is a corpse bloating on their herringbone parquet floor. That's when they call me.
The Clean Scene award? I'm impressed!

Admire? No. I'm allowed to have a respect for the craft though, right? All I'm saying is, if I were to ever go on my own cold-blooded killing spree, I'd take a leaf out of old Aseptic's book, that's for sure.
Are you a trauma junkie? You look like a trauma junkie. I can see it in your eyes.

Look, those Curzona debt-hungry Corpsters own my whole family. I know, any day now, I’m gonna rock up to one of these jobs and that’ll be my cousin or aunt lying there. Could even be me. As good for me economically as he is, it's hard to run a business from a morgue freezer. Ain't a chance CorpSec got what it takes to solve this one.
All I know is, I've never failed a psyche assessment more than two or three times in a row, that's good enough for me.
"Sanitize" is a strong word. Between you and me, Aseptic jobs are the most boring jobs in the city.
It sounds like you offer a very important service.

Bingo. Nothing. Nada. All we have to do is give the place a little spray down, make sure the victim didn't shit themselves - that happens a lot- and then be on our way. I've won the 'Clean-Scene' award more times than I can remember, but whoever this is runs sterilized-rings round me.
So you sanitize a lot of Aseptic scenes?
"No corpse too bloated, no blood too obscene. From homicide to suicide, we'll get your place cleaned!"
Not as far as I know, but CorpSec couldn't spot rot-stain in their own lobby so I wouldn't hold out much hope.

Fuck it. Look I’m only gonna give you this because, big shock, CorpSec missed it. It’s probably nothing, but I found it next to the victim’s Comm and it could give you a lead. Don’t get your hopes up though shoku, the trail is as dead as the guy who rented this apartment.
You sure you don't have anything to go on?
You look like some kind of cleaner.
What about CorpSec? They must have found something?
Do you not read the Holos? You know why Aseptic got his name don’t you?
So why are Aseptic jobs so boring?
You know, those freaks who get horny for misplaced viscera. Posting pictures of themselves on the Feeds with corpses for clout. World's gone mad.
I'm going to find him myself.
Word of advice, Shoku. Rule No.1 in this town as far as I'm concerned: Don't go around asking Aftermath Technicians if they're trauma junkies.
That sounds like a horrible job.
I could ask you the same thing.
Well if you were, you’d know there’s nothing to see at an Aseptic scene.
Some kind? The kind. "No corpse too bloated, no blood too obsene. From homicide to suicide, we'll get your place cleaned!" Or so they say.

dialogues.title: Gunger Hahn reveals more info
lines: Stop being weird. You know I can't stand it when you have one of your... episodes. Last time it was stoicism. What now? Existential identity loss?
Your identity as... Thaddeus. No... wait...
Ha, good one. I'm gonna need to go get a cup of coffee. I didn't sleep much last night. I'll... see you around.
What identity do you think I've lost?
Right... right... Say, you're not actually Thaddeus are you?
Who do you think I am?
You drank it, didn't you!? You old criminal. Well, easy come, easy go. Though smuggling it out down my pants wasn't so easy.

Huh? Oh, you said the last black dwarf implodes, then explodes in a supernova, and that's the last thing that will ever happen. Though there's other people there. Every time tourist who has an interest in the end of the universe.

Your worst indulgence was your obsession with the heat death of the universe. You ate that green mold and told everyone you were hurtling through time, but you'd come back and tell us what happened at the end.
No. You're not are you? Sorry. I didn't get a good night's sleep last night and I'm not thinking straight. I'll... I'll see you around.
Sure you have. Thaddeus, are you forgetting who you are again? Wait...
The grape wine. Remember? Gato was keeping it back for when the "party really got started", but we swiped it. You said we'd drink it on a birthday.
And what did I say happens at the end of time?
Hey, I was just thinking about that bottle of Lenuit we stole after Gato's wedding. Did we drink that?
I haven't had any of those things.

dialogues.title: Meeting Sal
lines: You can get a "I'll see what I can do".
Where do you think? In the kitchen working the expo. Think I got time for a full-body break right now?
I’M GONNA NEED SEVENTEEN CHICKEN ALL DAY, 86 SPROUTING SALADS, FIRE THE STEAKS, HANDS TO THE PASS, HANDS!!
Fine. Send 'em when you got 'em and I'll... *FLASH FIRE FIVE COD* ...pay you the Lims, OK?
Huh? Yeah I'm... *SIX SCALLOP BURGERS TO GO, LET’S HUSTLE PEOPLE!* Sal, whaddya want?
You want this veg or not?
Gotta keep an eye on the kitchen. Got an aug wired straight into my optic nerve, lets me see what's... *CABBAGE ROLLS DEAD ON THE PASS* going on behind my back.
Right... Well, Clem sent me about an order?
Why don't you take them off?
They’re MeanCuisine 800s, they know what they’re doing.
Alright, listen good cos I’m only gonna say this once. I’m gonna need 2 units of bok choy, 2 units of cabbage and 4 units of onions. And I’m gonna need them soon. Can I get a YES CHEF?
Clem sent me about an order?
YOU'RE the cover? Don't look much like a farmer...

dialogues.title: Banor's not stupid
lines: I hope he knows it's better for him to stay in the shadows.
I did. And I told him that most likely he's already been watched by CorpSec.
Hey-ho Boss. What can I do you for?
Did you give Danny his sister's address?

dialogues.title: More Clues
lines: Four hundred and eighty four years ago.
Not in enough detail to work with. But she also mentioned the Irisian Fall. It's a meteor shower which occurs every five hundred years.
I managed to excavate some clues from the ghost’s speech.
But I've marked a location near where she might appear. Perhaps if you go there, you'll see her again.
Because she's seen the last one!
We still don’t know what form of entity we are dealing with. But the use of KorēChant and the dates would suggest that, yes.
Did I mention that I hate ghosts?
She also mentions gardens, and a stone. Finding accurate maps of Nivalis from that period is tricky.
She's over four hundred years old?!
Do we have anything else to go on?

dialogues.title: It's Gimble
lines: I cannot ask that you visit her. She's extremely dangerous. You have to make that choice.
Age, profession, LifeCorp connection, no personal connection to the cryogenic program, intelligent enough to pull it off.
Right. But otherwise he doesn't fit the profile.
I cross-referenced age with engineer professions, connections with LifeCorp and backgrounds in cryogenics.
There's only one person who ticks all the boxes.
I have completed my search for elderly Nivalis citizens.
My guess: we have a long list of subjects.

dialogues.title: Clem offers thanks or not
lines: De nada. Thaddeus would be proud.
So, you're back. Did the drop go to plan?
Please. I know you didn't make it. You were seen, talking to the 'Sec.
I don't know what is worse - that I trusted you, or that you think I'll believe your lies.
You sold us out. At least you're honest about that.
One package delivered safe and sound.
You're back! Thank CORA, I was so worried. You made the drop?
Yes! I can't wait to see the Corpsters faces when they wake up tomorrow to find their rig covered in blossom! They will hate it!
I did what I had to.
I decided not to risk my neck for some flowers.
Thank you, Greenfingers. You are a true friend. And we look after our friends. That means special prices for life. It's the least we can do.
Whatever. We're done here. Don't think any of us are going to forget this anytime soon.

dialogues.title: Oil Rig
lines: The Oil Rig is another one of those places in the city that shouldn't exist. As far as I know it has its own governing body, the Oil Rig Separatists.

dialogues.title: First Fail
lines: The low-life pusher half-fried on post-ap? No it fucking wasn't.
That poor conspiracy nut who barely made sense? No it fucking wasn't.
Why the hell did you tell me you’d found Seth? I thought after all these years I was coping, but to feel hope like that and have it smashed to pieces…
Hey, I was only trying to help.

dialogues.title: Garnet gives his heart - maybe
lines: Did you ever tell Mila what Flora was to you?
I feel like if I take someone there... like a new friend or something, somehow Flora will know that I'm doing ok. And she can rest.
No, I didn't. Maybe I should.
I don't have many friends. I guess I've kinda forgot how to keep a friendship going, you know. But I was thinking, when this whole LUZ thing is over...
Mila would roll her eyes right now.
I think so. I think meeting you, and seeing how you are with Mila... it's kinda pulling me out of a bad place. But I know I still got a long way to go.
A lot to talk about, I guess.
Me too. And Mila said there is pizza at home. With capers.
I know! Look... It hasn't been easy for me and Mila since Flora died. She... she did a lot for us. I had to learn - and quickly - how to be a better dad. And I've done ok.
Pizza at home, and a new... friend, too. Damn, what a great day! Hey, you wanna hear one last joke?
One step after the other, Garnet!

CORA be damned! Well, I cannot wait. This has really made my day. I'll plan the trip. A month, maybe two? I don't care how long it takes for this LUZ to clear. I'm just happy I got something to look forward to.
My kid has been talking about you. A lot.
Look, if it's too weird, just let me know. But... It's where Flora's ashes are. I scattered them in this little park. I'd love to take you there. And tell you what she was like.
Sorry! Haha. I didn't think that one through... I'll, uh, just go. See you for the trip! Just don't get murdered or run away before the LUZ finishes, ok?
Were you going to say "in love with you?"
That's great. She's very picky. And a good kid.
Are you going to be ok Garnet?
Maybe we go on a trip? Us three. I know this place, on the other side of the city. Far away from the LUZ. It's actually where me, Flora and Mila would go on holiday.
I think I'm Pauline in lo... in friend with you!

dialogues.title: We placed ten seats
lines: Let's see how things go from here. I'll keep you posted.
Looking good boss. Bums in seats. That's what we need.

dialogues.title: Talk to Ashwin about job training
lines: Of course it's a course! But few people know that just cleaning doesn't cut it these days.
I'd say five years of job training at the Nivalis University of Building Maintenance.
I hope you're not overqualified for this job.
The greatest lessons are learned in the most trying of circumstances. My skills would be wasted in a clean venue.
Hey, boss! You're frowning? Whats with the frowning?
Detergents alone are a huge subject for study. Detergentology.
What's the difference between cleaners and Restaurant Hygiene Technicians?
I didn't know that was a course.
Domestic care has become a science rather than a craft in recent years.

dialogues.title: Recruiting Sanya
lines: The Rig does look kind of old in places.
Like the sea is the skin of a huge beast. Can you see it?
Spoken like a true Corp sell out.
Isn’t the light out here something else? The shadows cast by the beams, the way the oil slick turns the waves to rainbows?
Yeah, right. Look, I gotta get these shots.
Was that a pun?? What is WRONG with you? And who the heck are O.R.S?
I'm not sure the people stuck here would agree with you.
If you feel bad then do something about it.
Hmm. Maybe the CEOs have a point. What’s the use of this place anyway? No one uses oil anymore, apart from a few longevity clinics. This place is a relic.
I haven’t stopped taking photos since I got here. None of them relevant to my assignment, but what’s new?
You’re going to go through with the assignment?
I thought you wanted to capture reality?
But some of them do. To some of them, this is home. Look, help me out. Have you seen anything particularly lethal-looking around?
If I don’t they’ll just send someone else. And I’ll be out of a job. So yes.
I have to be careful with my job. I have to hide my mentoring work as it is. If they found out I joined some kind of society…
Sigh. I’m meant to be out here gathering evidence of the Oil Rig’s decline.
Some Spire-ites have decided it ruins their view.
What are you doing out here?
That’s why I like it here.
So you don't want to give them a try?
So I’m supposed to capture proof that it’s Category A Hazardous Terrain. But instead I keep seeing the beauty here.
I do! ... Ugh, alright, I'll check this group out.
Help me out, have you seen anything particularly lethal looking around?
Separatists... so like a movement? You think they'd let me take a photo?
Are you going to take a photo?
I know what I am, ok. I spend half my life trying to forget, and the other half making sure I remember. I don’t need lectures from you.
But there are people who want to save it.
And who wants to know this?
But you have to promise not to say a word to ANYBODY on the mainland, ok?

dialogues.title: Meeting Delbert
lines: Know a Corpster when I hear one. H20 through and through. I’m out.
Nivalis is a boat, and it’s sinking. But we are a liferaft and we can cut ourselves free and float on out to a new field. You dig?
These are some dangerous ideas you're floating.
Fumeville, Fogopolis. That big old scrap heap we’re all tied to.
Depends on how you look at it.
Me? I watch the tides of change.
Can it, Cosmo. Never know who might be listening. You wanna know more, ask around about O.R.S. But be careful who you ask.
You're not a rigger or a driller, certainly not a roughneck. Bet you haven't ever seen a moon pool in your life. So what’s your grind? What do you do?
Here from the Big Steam, Cosmo?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 7
lines: Good morning. Insert aspirational greeting here. Ahem, I mean, I hope you have a productive day.

dialogues.title: Can Dee Dee Help Palmer
lines: Must have “sucker” tatooed across my forehead. I never turned a stray away before, and I ain’t going to start now, pirate or not.
You think I have “sucker” tattooed across my forehead? I’m retired, and I’m sure as shit not risking what I got for someone like Vesh.
Not my problem. She really wants out of the city, she'll have to sail her ass outta here. Now, leave me and mine alone.
I know. That’s why I came to you. You’ve got a heart.
I don’t care what CorpSec like. That’s why I’m here.
You‘ve used up a favor here, kid. Remember that.
Her name’s Palmer Vesh and she’s a wanted criminal.
This friend of yours... what did they do? Piss off the ‘Sec? Murder someone?
Look, if Vesh really is in the LUZ, then the ‘Sec are going to tear this place apart to find her. That means a whole lotta collateral damage.
No, I think your enemy's enemy is your friend.
You got a duckling and think old DeeDee’s a mother hen? A sucker with room for all the strays in the city?
No, I think you’re kind enough to help people when they’re in trouble.
Well what are you hanging around like a bad smell for?
Try again, kiddie. You’re the one asking for heaven and earth here.
Go on then, cough it up.
That’s why I came to you. You’re tough.
Tell Vesh to be at the western end of MetroHub right before curfew. No bags, no packs. Just her. Got that?
Didn’t you hear, those were outlawed years ago, along with cutting slack and throwing bones. CorpSec don’t like favors.
Palmer Vesh? You want that space harpy to turn hopper? That’s the dumbest thing I ever heard!
I know someone who needs to get out of the LUZ.

dialogues.title: You Made It
lines: You're going to make me regret giving that to you, aren't you?
I'll drown you if you do.
If I had to do that, I wouldn't have given you that chip. Now, go introduce yourself. Just don't say anything too stupid. Or too smart for that matter.
I know. Otherwise I wouldn't have given you that chip. Now, go introduce yourself. Just don't say anything too stupid. Or too smart for that matter.
Well here you are. Part of me didn't think you'd make it and yet...
Not if you tell me what to say.
So... I just go in and talk to this person or what?

dialogues.title: Feel Bad
lines: He’s a sadist. Everyone in the LUZ will be better off.
It could be said Mr. Grimes was simply doing his job.
Whatever you say. Although if he ever finds out it was you who sent him down, I don't believe he will be forgiving...
He was bad for business. It wasn’t personal.
How are you feeling about this decision? Any lingering guilt? Shame? Remorse?
I don't think that's an excuse.

dialogues.title: Gamova Release Friend
lines: Poor performance? I did everything you instructed me to!
Due to a lack of performance regarding the case, my employer has decided to terminate this relationship.
Well you can worry no further, this will be our last contact.
Look, I'm worried about my Automata, you're going to have to stop doing this.
You are now in possession of all appropriate information. I will now sever this line permanently... Good luck.
That information is not relevant at this time.
Due to poor performance on your part, my employer has deemed payment inappropriate at this time.

dialogues.title: No Bones About It
lines: Yup, that'll do it. Freakin' Harmony man. She always comes through. Whatever you need she can get.
Stop... Did you just say human bone?!
How can they make things out of human bone?
How does she get all those things?
You liked doing this from a young age?
Beats me. I never ask, just say thank you and hand her the Lims. How much she charge you for these by the way?
How often are you buying human bones from her?
Good, that's what we need. Hahahaha! You should see your face right now. Wait, hold on, I'll take a picture. Hahaha.
It has something to do with the conductivity of calcium or something. I don't know. I failed that particular science session. Was more focused on building things.
Without the materials you were fetching? Did Harms come through or was she fresh out?
How do you use the bones again?
Nothing. Said she can't because of the cannibal clause.
Oh sure. Little things made sense growing up but putting parts together in the correct order was always easy. Just follow directions. And right now my directions are asking for some bones.
Neon Gods! I love the little merchant but her prices have definitely gone up.
Well, good luck with all this.
Okay, okay, okay, okay. Let's take a breath and look at the parts of this conversation. Are these human bones, yes or no?
Gotta have a sense of humor!!!!
Back with good news I hope?
Yeah, she said human bones fall under the Cannibal Clause in the Intercity Free Trade and Commerce Agreement.
Owe you one. With this stuff I'll be able to get outta here by oh, I don't know, dawn at this point. HA! I laugh but it's sad. Oh well, that's life. Cheers!

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Fifth Meeting
lines: Great. Just what I needed. First I moo like a cow, now I accidentally found a religion. I should just place a sign over my head: "Hey, CorpSec! I'm here!"
One guy did. Showed up to the market wrapped head-to-toe in stitched-together scarves. Said he was the "Chosen Loom." Security had to untangle him from the streetlights
I thought so too, until three more people came back saying their clothes started... whispering. Telling them secrets. One woman said her socks told her the future. Correctly.
Man, I don't even deserve him.
So... good news and bad news.

Well... I stitched a jacket for this guy — just a regular patch job — and the next day, he swore the jacket "spoke" to him. Like, full sentences. Encouraging him to "shed his skin" and "become one with the fabric."
Gotta taste it. Only way to be sure.
Exactly the kind of PR you need at the moment ...
I'm doing whatever I can to pass time till I hear from my brother. I know there's no news, but... have you heard ANYTHING?

So I'm laying low and I'm pretty bored. That's why I started using my old silicon weaving skills to fix up busted clothing. You know, patch in smart-thread, reactive linings, little upgrades. People loved it.
