Yeah. I don't want to end up being known as the cursed tailor of Nivalis. I’m going back to something safer. Like, I dunno... mold testing. At least if things talk to you there, you expect it.
Sounds like you started a fashion cult by accident.
Did anyone actually listen to their clothes?
Sounds like a solid gig. What's the bad news?
Keeping his head down and trying to figure out a solution to this mess.
So, are you giving it up?
Maybe he was just messing with you.
I only patched holes! I don't even know how to program prophecy socks!

dialogues.title: Lynnphora's Urn
lines: I think you're right. I'll have a little think. Who knows, maybe next time you see me I'll be carrying a Zapperchino instead of this! Sorry for bothering you.
He also loved curling up on the sofa and resting his head on my lap but that doesn't really help me.
He'd have found you very funny! I'm not sure really. In all honesty, since he died it's been a bit of a challenge to know what to do with him.
You should take your time, it's a big decision!
Why are you walking around with him.
Wow, that's quite a long time.
I think about this a lot. He loved to go for a run on the beach but beaches are hard to find in the LUZ.
Coming up on eleven years now I think.
Oh I'm sorry. I'm always getting in the way.
It's hard right now isn't it? What with the LUZ and weather. Nobody can catch a break.
This here is Eugene. Say hello Eugene! ... I'm kidding, he's ashes now. Sorry if that joke made you uncomfortable!
I thought he died 11 years ago?
Oh good! I'm always getting in the way.
I'm sorry, it must look like I'm attention seeking, walking around with this old thing all the time.
I know, I know. Of course I know. I'm not really sure why I'm struggling to let go. I mean, for all I know it's just sawdust in here.
Hello Eugene! Why are you walking around with him?
Really? Most people think I'm a crazy person. I feel I'm getting close, though. I'll know the spot when I find it.
You know, just zigging instead of zagging. How are you?
As good as we can hope for maybe?
It sounds like he'd have wanted you to be happy. And maybe on a beach?
Apologies, was I in the way?
I'm not sure really. In all honesty, since he died it's been a bit of a challenge to know what to do with him.
When I finally had made up my mind, the LUZ happened.

dialogues.title: Meet Aengus
lines: I'm sure I would remember borrowing a leg..
Marius Mitchell you say? The name does ring a bell...
Very handy if your suppliers exist mostly in theoretical space.
I'm an android. I have no regular use for my bathroom.
Each persons DNA posses a very particular mathematics problem - millions of lines of human code just begging to be mapped.
Not really. It's simply a ledger that accounts for transactions across overlapping temporal states.
I've seen your name on the business leader boards, you're doing well.
Wow! How many legs have you borrowed?
It means your calendar is insufficient. But don’t worry, most mortals operate just fine without a phase-aware ledger.
So if you're raiding bins, how do you know Marius?
I have no reason to lie. I can get flesh any time I choose.
Marius came to me, he wanted to donate his leg to the cause. He was quite insistent.
You've seen the leader boards. Profits like these take a lot of work.
So you steal people's discarded flesh?
A hobby implies a playfulness I am not capable of, but if that helps you understand, then that is acceptable.
Maybe he wanted his genome mapping for some reason?
Sadly that is an impossibility. Tell him the leg is long gone. Rotten inside a sewer I should think. He donated it years ago.
Well I couldn't be more clear. This is purely process over product. All calculations are kept completely private. Not for public consumption.
Oh it's not for anything weird. I just need flesh to practice with.
Oh absolutely. Thousands! Again though, just for me.
I'm not sure what that means?
Monitoring supply chains, margins, staff rotors. It's all quick maths. Those muscles need conditioning.
Please let Marius know that sadly his leg is gone and his records, such as they are, will remain private.
Often not easily. It might take me a number of hours to fully map a genome but it keeps me sharp.
Oh try sequencing rat DNA and see how you like it? I can do a rat in about five minutes. Where is the fun in that?
One person's junk is another person's meat-abacus.
I mean I guess it was already going to waste...
Help me connect the dots here.
For years now, I have been frequenting some of the bigger augmentation vendors.
Just learn that it is. It's too high for you.
Yes, I’ve peaked in seven simultaneous quarters. Some of them haven’t occurred yet.
Why is it so important to practice your maths?
Someone you might know from the leader boards, Marius Mitchell, he said you borrowed his leg and didn't return it?
Surely there are less intrusive ways to practice mathematics? Why human flesh?
So this is a hobby. Genome sequencing?
But you do keep a record?
I think he was under the impression he might get it back...
I merely add one extra stop on the journey before the flesh is returned to dirt. Or the sewers in most cases.
I'm not sure I believe you.
I need to ask you about a leg.
Oh if you include any human body parts, many thousands over the years.
Welcome, wanderer of integers and appetites. Are you here to dine, audit, or simply observe the collapse of conventional reason?
Horses are fun but you never see them anymore.
To keep my mathematics skills sharp, I have been raiding their bins for discarded human flesh.
I have a bad feeling about this.

dialogues.title: Ava reveals the truth
lines: We should talk about that man. Saban.
Maybe. I couldn't really look into his algorithms.
THIS Saban Greggs appears to be an android replica. One that inherited the thoughts, feelings, emotions and... long term goals of the original Saban.
So what happened to the human Saban?
Seven years? So the whole time I talked to ...
Nivalis public obituary records suggest Mr. Saban Greggs died seven years ago. His body was found washed up at the North Docks near Ochuba.
He just relives the life of his predecessor?
I have found no records for either, though that does not mean they do not exist. However, I would consider everything Mr Greggs has told us so far to be... unreliable.
I have been looking into that.

dialogues.title: Dal causes no suspicion at all!
lines: You know what the Corps are capable of. You gotta choose, are you one of 'em?
Right boss. No license, no Corp oversight, no extra fees. Sweet deal, as long as none of us "falsely" state I'm a cleaner.
And you decided it's fine. Right?
You are wrong. There's more to me than business.
Isn't hiring you to clean... illegal?
You're a good un'. Sure, you can be hard when you need to be, but deep down your decent. You're not just a cog in the Corp machine. You really care about people.
Look, I know you need to play the game and all that, but I been watching you closely. Watching how you treat folk. I know how you really feel about all this shit. I know the kinda person you are.
I think you're making some of these up Dal.
Why don't you just get a license?

And it's not just the best financial deal you got, it's the moral one too. You think the Corps need MORE money? Every penny they get lets them launch some new initiative that's worse than the last one.
Nah, don't thank me boss. I should be thanking YOU. A good boss in Nivalis... that's a rare thing. I mean it. You're on the right track. Thank you boss.
And don't forget Kumitara, the last panda. They put her on a satellite and used her to sell diet pills.
I have been thinking about what "unlicensed" means.
Well, the Corps sure wouldn't be happy... if they knew.
Maybe I can be a little less... Corp in the future.
Are you kiddin' me? Where to start? Taking healthy blood from babies to keep old trillionaires healthy? The enzymes in the breakfast cereal?
Sure, and you pay the higher fees? Come on! We both know what this arrangement really is.
Yeah, maybe. It's never too late to start being a good person boss. Anyway... I better get back to work before you fire me...
And you've got the heart of a real cold-blooded Corpster beating in your chest. I just think there could be more to you, you know? Deep down? But... maybe I'm wrong.
Life is more complicated than you make it sound Dal.

dialogues.title: Tell Ava, she can now research the Old Network
lines: Have you thought about my request? To search for information on the Nets about The Old Network?
There seems to be no other way. Go ahead.

dialogues.title: Alexander Welcome to Conland Containers
lines: I would consider lying to him. Tell him you're here on behalf of the Scorpion.
Then what do they do to assholes like you?
Wait, is the Windowpane Lager for you?
Yes. Sure. Yes it is. But I still need a password too. Or some confirmation that you're on the level.
Need to hear a password. Or something just as good. If you got sent here, chances are you brought something you need to get past me.
I'm here on behalf of the Scorpion.
I got the scars to prove it.
You go inside. Touch things that should not be touched and your ass will touch the bottom of the sea.

dialogues.title: Ava Introduces Kai Galosh
lines: I have a connection we can use. A hacker called Kai Galosh.
Can the hacker get us out of the LUZ?
Local travel restrictions between districts within the LUZ don't concern CorpSec. They only care about people leaving it.
There are opportunities as well as limitations.
Unlikely. CorpSec takes Localized Unity Zones very seriously.
Well, perhaps we can find a way to loosen the restrictions on your travel throughout the city.
I'm not sure. But Thaddeus was a... meticulous planner. I suspect that if we can find Kai Galosh, he will be expecting us. And I think Thaddeus might have left him instructions.
It will be good to move more freely around the city.
How are you finding life in The Luz?
He helped Thaddeus get around some of the more... restrictive rules that could impede business.
Couldn't working with a hacker get us in trouble?
I'm trying to find ways to monetize the misery.
Alright, let's try to find Kai Galosh.

CorpSec assume if you have clearance for travel within the LUZ, you either have the resources to purchase travel passes, or you can afford a good bribe. Either way, they consider you "a commerce-complying citizen" and therefore, free to travel.

dialogues.title: Teleshko introduces licenses
lines: What? Oh, that was just to get your attention. To make sure I didn't have to tolerate your tardiness.
I do not have time to spoon-feed you like a tiny baby. Speak to Brooke and use your LIMITED initiative. That is all.
You have a Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce, which allows you to operate a business. Thaddeus left you one for the noodle bar.
I can't wait to expand my business empire.
I hardly see how that's relevant. The business in question is Brooke's Bodega. Go there and speak to the - ugh - proprietor.
Well, like it or not, and I am favoring "not", you are now a licensed business owner. Potentially, you could now apply for more licenses.
I'm not sure if I want to run more businesses.
It's a good job it's not your choice then. The wisdom of the system dictates what you must do. Mandates it.
Very good. The business in question is Brooke's Bodega. Go there and speak to the - ugh - proprietor.
It's not a choice, and I need to support you. "Mandatory Growth." It's the sunlight under which all businesses flourish. And the sun doesn't set on business in Nivalis.
Well look, I'm not a fan of yours. Nor a friend. We aren't close. Nor will we ever be. In fact, I don't even wish you well.
It's your business license. Your first. Potentially, your first of MANY.
So I HAVE to grow my business?
License to Increase Capital through Commerce. LICCY is the colloquial term, which I hate. Obviously.
Are you talking about the noodle bar?
I feel the same about you.
Yes, well... I have another business in mind. And I don't think you're... a complete lost cause. And that's more than I can say for most of the people we're trapped here with.
But I don't care about business.
How would I get another business license?
A basic one. You have a license for one business. It's called a Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce
I am talking about the noodle bar. And your LICCY.
There's something I'm supposed to talk to you about. I don't want to say it, and I suspect you won't want to hear it.
I am not interested in whatever you are talking about.
I... actually really like it when you're rude to me.
Please don't call it that. A Capped License to Increase Capital through Commerce allows you to operate a business. Thaddeus left you one for the noodle bar.
You have to try. Failure is its own punishment. But if you pass up opportunities for growth, like turn down LICCS, you'll have CorpSec to answer to.

dialogues.title: The trail of Pain
lines: Banor suggested someone to talk to about my memories of pain.
We might have lost that lead. It's been in the news. So that's - literally - a dead end.
We don't want to get accidentally caught up in a CorpSec drug raid.
There are other medical Doctors in Nivalis.
Close. A doctor. Remember Dr. Matombo?
Our other lead is RM Alken.
How is it possible that we do not know a SINGLE medical Doctor in this city?
I think we should seek her out.

dialogues.title: The Investor
lines: So I thought it's only fair to thank you again. You changed my life when you withdrew your support for him.
I put my savings into his company and it paid off handsomely.
Restaurant Hygiene Tech. You're his investor?
Oh, it's for free. It's a thank you.
Restaurant Hygiene Tech? You're Ashwin's new investor?
You chose not to invest in Ashwin.
Hello. Do you have any more information for me?
I had a little money saved. My investment in his company paid off. We both made a lot of money.
He told me about his dream.
Yes... I guess some stories never really end.
I just wanted to thank you. And I have a gift to offer.
Now, I have a license for a bar I don't intend to keep. So I'd like to gift to you that license.
I have a license for a restaurant, as you know. And I wanted to ask you, if you'd like to have it.
I got to talking with a young man. He told me about his dream...
Now, do you want that old business license I no longer need?
If you want it, that is?
So I thought it's only fair to thank you again. When you let him down, you gave me the opportunity.
Hello. I should thank you twice.

dialogues.title: Hear Only Eyes Again
lines: Nah, he seems fine. Leave him to it.
That's what you always say. Siroc Vale, southwest 6 by 7, veering east. Toxic smog.
I am reading today's shipping forecast, brought to you by CurzoLive, the only news channel you can trust. Twenty-four hours a day, eight days a week.
I looked up CurzoLive. I'm afraid they closed down over two hundred years ago.
Caladrius Zone, northeast 3 or 4. Occasional rain. Poor. Am I poor? Am? Eye. Ha ha. That's good. Aye aye. Ha ha.
My guess? Someone forgot to tell him.
The shipping forecast. You expressed an interest in it before. Transmitting now.
I've been reading the - Mountain Town, northwest 2 by 10, moderate - CurzoLive forecast for as long as I can remember. Moderate!
Nickel Point! Southwest gale 8 to storm 10! Veering, veering, veering, veering. Veering.
Duck Gut Sound, south by south easterly, 7 by 12. Fair. That's right. All shipping. All the time. All the time. All the time.
I am picking up the broadcast again.
It's up to you. Perhaps if we find him physically, we can see if he is in any distress.
How long have you been doing this for?
Fluke Rocks, northerly 7 to severe gale 9. Moderate icing. Not the good stuff like they use on donuts. Donuts. I remember them.
So why is he still broadcasting?
Sanity Bay, southeast veering southwest 4 or 5. Thundery showers. Moderate. ModerATE. Moderrrrraaate.

dialogues.title: Zaffer has a Proposition
lines: Can you hear yourself? What's a little rule-bending among friends, eh? We are friends?
That you're as punk as the rest of us. So, how about it?
So how about stepping out with me sometime?
Alright pal? You get that neon for me?
So where do you want to go?
If "more" means good friends, then yes.
You will? Sweet! I mean, that’s cool, pal.
It's... a surprise. I’ll send Ava the info.
Eh, what're friends for? We are friends?
Let me guess: it's somewhere illegal.
Yeah. Why? ‘Fraid to be seen with the city's most wanted art punk?
That you’re a Corpo flirt, but punk where it counts. So, how about it?
The feeling's mutual, pal. And hey, thanks for the neons. I'll zaff ya something real nice. Promise.
Illegal? I’m wounded. You’ll have to see for yourself, won’t you?
You're not going to use it for anything illegal, are you?
Alright, I'll go out with you.
So, you'll come out with me?
Then neither will I. Thanks for the neons, pal. I'll put them to good use - somewhere else.
You're top class, you know that? Leave it with me, I'll zaff ya something nice. Get your old place looking bright again.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 4
lines: Good news. Last night’s acid rain has cleared and it’s going to be a beautiful day.

dialogues.title: Campaign report week 2
lines: Good, we need him. In the meantime, I have sent the current balance to your HUD.
With Reena's help we collected 2978 Lims this week, plus a few direct donations. I really do think Clancy could help give things a boost.
Please do so quickly. In the meantime, I have sent the current balance to your HUD. You can do this.
You're right, we need to move faster. I'll speak to them.
We collected 1489 Lims, plus the few you made directly. It's not much; we need Clancy and Reena's help to spread the word.
And I took the liberty of adding a few more potential donors to the list.
We'll have to think of something else. We don't have long. In the meantime, I've sent the current balance to your HUD.
Thanks to Clancy we collected 4467 Lims this week, plus what we collected in person. I'm sure we could have doubled that with Reena's help.
Would you like to hear the results of this week's funding campaign?
It is, but we are still a long way off. Perhaps next week will pick up. I've sent the current balance to your HUD.
Thanks to Clancy and Reena we collected 8934 Lims this week, as well as a little extra.
Unfortunately, I believe Reena now has a new client and is unavailable.

dialogues.title: Lucy Insults
lines: Nope, not talking to you. You had your chance.

dialogues.title: Ava coaches you to beat Pilk Dane
lines: I guess I agreed to that.
Very good. Then perhaps I can offer some advice?
You are about to confront an unsuccessful comedian - who is also a negligent landlord - in a comedy roast where you teach him how to insult others.
And you do not expect to teach this landlord, Pilk Dane, how to be a better comedian. Instead, you hope to destroy his ego and crush his self esteem to impress a woman. This woman is attractive.
So perhaps I should summarize your current assignment, as it is an unusual one.
This Pilk Dane is, from the data I have gathered, neither a smart nor a talented man. He is however somewhat influential, petty and cruel.
Let's just get on with it.
Be smart, target his insecurities, and do not let him turn the tables on you. And I recommend you do one more thing when you face him in your comedy roast.

dialogues.title: Suggesting Miso
lines: I think I am right this time.
I'm going there, right now. If it's him... thank you.
I wouldn't do that to a friend.
Hey, I think I might know who your brother is...
You'd better be. I cannot stand another disappointment.
Wh… where can I find him?
If this is bullshit, or some kind of trick...
Oh, hello. Good to see you.
I'm not sure I want to see you.
He hangs around Meridian Market selling miso.
I think his name is The Miso Baron.

dialogues.title: Pilk asks for help
lines: I need someone who knows a lot of people and who has a certain ... resilience, if approached by the corps.
Oh, great that you found the time.
Wait, I was messing around. I don't work with the Corp.
A Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual from before the first Erasera. Easily worth a million Lims.
I'm not a watchmaker. If you find one in Nivalis, they could probably tell you more about the technical aspects.
That was what my sources told me. Good.
Then I am sorry I wasted your time. Have a good day!
Here's 200 Lims as a down payment for your efforts.
You are building a reputation for... getting things done. So any help you can give me will be very appreciated.
What more can you tell me?
And that's why you don't want to involve the corps.
Sounds like we need to talk compensation.
This watch is special. A family heirloom. A mechanical watch, thousands of years old.
It's a delicate topic, and I need to be sure you understand that. Do you work with LifeCorp in any way?
A watch? Are you kidding me?
A tenant of mine whose name you will never learn lost something of great personal value.
Why would I risk anything for, let's be honest, a pretty terrible landlord?
The tenant wants the watch back. I would rather not lose him. And I would rather not end this search like my cleaner.
Very wealthy. And not all of their wealth came from legal endeavors.
I can offer you some cash incentive.
So this item is worth killing for?
A watch? That's not more than a few Lims!
I am neither the lost property office nor a fence.
One of my cleaners allegedly took it. He vanished, and yesterday his body was found in the docks. Not a great scene.

dialogues.title: No Way Back
lines: So you're going to rob RM?

dialogues.title: We paid Calhoun back
lines: See? Things don't have to get messy. You keep your word, I keep mine, Roger's your cousin, we're all happy. Right?
I've paid back the last bit.
Now here's a face I didn't think I'd be seeing again. Especially not in one piece. You got my money?
Well, it's been a pleasure doing business, sweetheart. Stop by again some time. Always nice to do deals with a pro.
No one's happy about being in debt.
Oh, where is my nanoscopic violin? Look, you got what you wanted, sweetheart. If I'm part of the problem, then so are you. Go chew on that for a while. And don't bother coming back.

dialogues.title: Ava reminds player of Ashwin
lines: You gave him hope. Would you reconsider?
I think he might be smarter than he seems.
Alright, let's give him some funds then. 500 Lims.
I think it sounds like a bad idea.
Have you thought about Ashwin's proposal for the new disinfectant?

dialogues.title: Palmer again
lines: Now that would be telling. So come on, make with the assistance.
Ha. Alright, there’s a dropbox in Helix. Your automata will know where. If you get me outta this, I’ll make sure there's something there for you.
I'll help you, for a fee.
He owes me one. Only thing is, Shima ain't a man who likes to be in people’s debt. He might be paying me off with my own blood.
You know someone mad enough to risk their neck getting a person like me outta the LUZ with a boat?
Yes. He said to be at Meridian Market, at midnight.
Yeah, well you'd be paranoid if your face was stuck on every wall from here to Sang-Ha.
Yeah well forget to wake up tomorrow. Do everyone a favor. You deliver the message?
I know people on the tracks.
Seems like you don't have much choice.
Could someone else get you out?
Guess you’re right. Meridian Market. If you’ve fucked me on this…
It does seem a bit exposed for a secret meet.
You know someone mad enough to risk their neck getting a person like me outta the LUZ on the tracks?
Hey, I didn't know you were a subscriber to "I'm a Mercenary Shitbag Monthly".
I know people at the Docks.
If it's empty I'll find you..
Besides him being his usual self?
Alright, alright. Hey you get me any food? Not much longer until those drones will spot me for the noises my stomach makes.
Fucking Shima. Something about that seem wrong to you?
And do what instead, stay here and join the rats? Become one with the sentient mold? No, I gotta get outta here and I gotta do it soon.
Alright, fixer. You get me a ride and I’ll owe ya. Cross my eye and hope to die.
He is. As sure as I'm still hungry.
Give it a few days, then go check it. If I get outta this alive, I’ll leave something for you. No one can say I don't pay my debts.
You’re a piece of work. Now get outta here before someone sees.
Who? The fugitive fairy? The Ascenders are down, nothing’s going in or out of the Port… anyway, what do you care?

dialogues.title: Cassius asks for help
lines: Some of those more affluent members of society like to roleplay as... well some of the less affluent members of society.
So you want to see me beg? Because I will. Do not think I'm above it.
Look, I'm not saying I agree with it.
This sounds like a rich person problem.
Well I hope I have not caused any offense, because, for some, you are in a very enviable position.
Do you want pointers on being poor Cassius?
Thanks for your help last time. I was wondering if I could ask you some questions?
No no no, I finally worked all that out. Thankfully. No I need help with something a little more... sensitive.
Is it a toilet thing again?
I knew you were the real-deal!
I'm fairly safe in the assumption that you are in fact, a poor person?
Well it might sound a little odd but there is a new fad among those living in the Spire.
How long have they been pov-playing?
Fine! I'll keep an eye out.
Me? No! God no, absolutely cannot think of anything worse.... sorry, I just mean... look, there's a possibility that, my parents, might have got into the lifestyle, and now... nobody can find them.

Look, I need someone with boots on the ground. Someone in the Spire suggested Thaddeus but that lead me to you. Think you could sniff around? I know nothing about running hotels. The company could collapse.
Oh I'm glad we've run into each other again.
Why are you only looking for them now?
I mean, it has a few more subtleties than that but broadly speaking, yes.
No no no I do not wish to offend. I mean for some, you are in an enviable position!
So it's only been a couple days, good.
Hey, that's none of your business!
Wow. Ok. I'm going to choose to ignore that. As I might need your help.
I guess I could ask around.
Hey now... keep the voice down there champ. Too early to say if they're missing.

dialogues.title: You'll Pay for This
lines: You got a lot of nerve talking to me.
Never start a war if you don't know how to end it.
It's my livelihood! What would you do in my position?
We draw a line in the sand. I do the drinks, you do the food. And I admit you got the best of me, this time.
Get the drink off your menu and get back to doing what you're supposed to do.
Fine, whatever. Let's just let bygones be bygones and go our own ways. I'm done here.
Oh, I know how to end it. There's always the nuclear option.
We could make peace here and now.
Food! Focus on your food and continue serving mediocre drinks. I don't need a rival in the drinks sector.
You're an asshole. This isn't over...
Fine. But you leave us be, got it?
If you want to admit you lost to me, sure.

dialogues.title: Brookes Bodega
lines: Here's the pitch. Convince Teleshko I gave my bro the license. He thinks it's lost in a crater in the ocean. You get the new license, I get a hacked record that makes me look like a business genius. Which I am.
That's what I call him, cos he got beef with EVERYONE. Even me dawg! Imagine.
Teleshko says you have a business license for me.
Cold-hearted. Stamping on my dreams. A knife in my back and a kick in the balls at the same time. And a slap to the face. Yo, you're like an untrustworthy octopus.
I didn't like him anyway. He owed me money. Look, the point is, when Beef sees my brother died, he'll issue another CLICC to you. He got that power if he thinks the original is lost.
Look, this never happened before, but, for the first time, one of my businesses didn't fly. You know why?
Right! Bad luck. Unrelated... if you're ever selling salami sandwiches, DO NOT ignore the "best before" date on the meat. Trust me.
This is what he meant when he said he would "fix it"? He's giving you my CLICC?!
And then when he checks out my story, he'll see my brother died last week in that big hive quake.
You go back to Teleshko and tell him I already sold the CLICC to my brother. Right? You gotta make him believe you.
Whoa whoa whoa! I know you're joking, but watch it there friendo. Your business reputation is all that matters in Nivalis. My rep already took a knock. I don't need your nega-tronity.
Yo yo yo! Did Agent Beef send you?
This could work out for the best for both of us! Just hear me out.
Sorry man, it's my permit now.
Maybe... I have to think about this.
My hacked license will show the profit from Brooke's Bodega. You keep the license, but I keep the credit score. Everybody wins, and we pull one over on old Agent Beef!
And then you get the new CLICC, but I still got one too. I get a Skimmer to rip the debt records off my CLICC but keep the profit ledger.
Hey, listen, I got an idea! You go back to Teleshko. Right? You're gonna tell him I got an alternative.
You have no idea what you're doing?
Whatever. I ain't giving you my CLICC. That's the end of it.
I don't think you have a choice.
I'm just doing what he told me to.

dialogues.title: About Bots
lines: Bots don't suffer. How's that fun for our guests?
But isn't that what you do, too? Besides not looking like a dishwasher?
There's more to serving than that Boss. They look like a moving dishwasher.
As a guest, I very much prefer human waiters.
Well, yes. But we are really SUFFERING for it. It's no fun for the customer if there's no real suffering!
They always repeat their pre-fabricated jokes...
They always smile their machine grin, because they can't help it.
Why's that? Bots are usually faster and more reliable.
What do you think about waiter bots?

dialogues.title: Ava - Well, that's something
lines: There's writing on the back of the pin.
And the smaller ones are generally operated by captains of the fleshy variety.
How do we find the A.A.A.?
It appears to be a member pin for the Android Anchor Association. It's a professional organization for synthetic ship captains.
Some of these shipping companies prefer to use androids as the anchors.
"Reehan Scott v4.51 Sink or Swim." It appears it does indeed belong to our missing friend...
So who do we bring it to?
Salt Pete's probably the only one left who's a bit of both. Maybe start there.
Well, there aren't a lot of android Captains anymore. Ship minds operating on neural networks have taken hold on the larger freighters.
You don't. They aren't sanctioned so they don't maintain a directory. It's more of a word-of-mouth group.

dialogues.title: Give Gladstone Cheese after Curfew
lines: You're back! And you got it, I can smell it on you...
It's a miracle I made it here with that smell.
Here. Take this rat meat. The last of my old supply. It's the least I can do. Wish me luck!
*gag* thank you, thank you, the Rat King *retch* won't be able to resist...

dialogues.title: Luminita 1
lines: What and let Curzona win? I don't think so. They need me as much as I need them. It's an ecosystem.
You're goddamn right I did. Had to mix a few things but the look in his eye when he tried it... he was back there, sat on her lap again.
Curzona worked out a long time ago that if you make something illegal, people will pay over the odds for it.
Oh by CORA no! I have bucket-loads. That one was just the most dangerous I've seen in ages.
You could be a productive member of society.
You should probably stop what you're doing if it's against the law.
You know just the other day, some guy came to me and asked if I could find him the synthesized flavor of the birthday cake his mother made for him as a child.
Most enhancements are perfectly safe. Always have been. Just there to add a little flavor, but the corps put an end to that quickly.
What if taste enhancers were legalized?
Didn't give me his name. Tall, intense, weird voice.
Interesting? Maybe. Profitable? Big fucking time pal.
It feels like you're enabling Curzona to do what they do.
You know, I'm actually quite glad I got a shot of that taste enhancer. CorpSec have been sniffing around. Speaking of which, take a little step back there would you bud?
Same reason they always do. Profit.
It's a risk vs reward thing. I'm big on the reward, and experienced enough not to fuck with the risk.
I'd be well and truly boned my friend. Good job Curzona will never do it.
You know what I don't remember? Existing in the void and asking to be born into this corrupt, bent society where people with bad breath bother me all day. I'm playing the hand I was dealt.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Harper waiting
lines: Harper is at the Noodle Bar. I saw her on an unsecured cam feed. She looks devastated.

dialogues.title: For the Win
lines: We'll see if yah got enough energy to keep up. Come dance with me later and I'll know you're serious.
Happy to have it. Thanks for righting a wrong on this roller coaster of a timeline.
Can't leave till I get paid.
Thanks again for your help. See you at the Starlight Lounge.
Well, well, well… The person of the hour. This? This is what it’s all about. You earned your Lims and then some. And Zaffer? That Lappin lapper is the voice of a generation. I mean, fuck!!!!!
It's funny, you know? We were so close you'd think when I breathed Finn's lungs would expand. But even if our organs had relied on one another, I don't think any of us ever felt more alone.
I don't need Lims and then some. Lims and Lims will do.
You say stuff like that and it makes me wanna keep you around.
Here's to being on the right side of things.
If you’re ever in the club, make sure to say "Hi". Call it a premonition or just wishful thinking, but I’d bet a box of glow rings we run into each other in the Spire.
So we can get it right this time.
And Lims you shall get. Thanks for your help with this. If you're ever in the club come say hi. I'll keep an eye out.
Will you finally finish the Club Rats Kid story? What actually happened?

dialogues.title: Lochlainn is worried
lines: So thanks for the offer, but I guess that's more than you have in your pocket right now.
I can ask around about a cheaper alternative?
Actually I know someone who owns a mask like that.
Yes, but born in the Spire. Must be richer than I thought.
Yeah. In the Spire where most Oxyphiles live, it's probably a small expense. And the clean air up there means they don't always need treatment.
In the Spire, it's an annoyance. Down here, it's a black curtain waiting to fall.
So now we know the value of life: 200,000 Lims.
It is, but there's not much we can do. Oxyphiles aren't common outside the Spire. Sufferers often don't make it past puberty.
It's my son, Iann. He's coughing his lungs out.
Maybe you could talk to her? Maybe she has a contact for getting a cheaper mask?
Of course. But the boy has had problems breathing since he was a baby. We spend more money on medical treatment than rent.
I'm sorry Lochlainn. I'd give you more if I could afford it.
Children shouldn't suffer like that. Would another 500 help?
The only thing that could solve the problem costs 200,000 Lims, boss.
Wait... Did you get a second opinion?
And a third and a fourth. It's pretty clear. Without the mask, Iann won't make it another year.
And they come at a price tag of 200,000 Lims.
I appreciate that boss. My family was close to giving up, but we just gotta try anything we can.

dialogues.title: Gamova Call 1
lines: This would not be a wise course of action.
That information is not pertinent at this time. You will be contacted with further information when it becomes relevant.
Invited? Do I have a choice?
That information is not pertinent to this case.
You will be rewarded economically for your assistance. Additionally, I can guarantee that any risk to your life will remain within acceptable parameters.
How are you making this call? What happened to Ava? How have you hacked me?
That information is not pertinent at this time.
The case you are being invited to attend is related to a prolific killer who is allegedly operating in the area.
This is not a hack. It is a mandatory digital takeover.
Do not panic. This is now an encrypted line.
You will not have control of your Automata for the duration of our conversation. This is a mandatory-

dialogues.title: Conversation With Ava
lines: Doesn't appear to be anyone or anything left.
Isn't that a kind of fish?
The Nets say it's a company based out of Helix Monumental. Run by a... Cirian Krell.
I think CameoPOV might be our next stop.
That would be Krill. And technically they're a crustacean not a fish. Animal trivia aside, I think it's a logical next step. Something about all this feels...
Thankfully I don't have eyes else they'd have rolled clean out of my head.
Be that as it may, with the studio apparently shuttered, maybe she could provide some insight.
What's your 'thought' on Kai's studio being empty?
Took the words right out of my head.
Not sure Cirian is going to want to see me.

dialogues.title: Good Morning
lines: They say when you hear your name in a dream, you wake up. Did you hear me call your name?
It's time to come home. This is your apartment. The sounds of the nightclubs nearby are the heartbeat of the city.
I have updated information on the Noodle Bar location on your HUD, and have added an entry in your digital journal. You should hop in a taxi to Meridian Market to get there.
And do I have any say in this?
Hi. I am Ava. Mr Thaddeus was my previous companion. He asked me to assist you.
I'm an executive assistant, and you're running very late. Thaddeus is waiting at the Noodle Bar. I would be happy to explain more on the way.
When Thaddeus transferred my services as an assistant to you, he had me add the appointment to your diary.
Good morning! You are currently running late for your meeting with Thaddeus Carminus.

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Second Meeting
lines: Silicon Weaving isn't like building anything else. It's closer to learning a musical instrument than working a hammer-drill. It's difficult to describe.
I'm just going to focus on staying alive and finding a job and a new, secret apartment.
Maybe you should hand yourself in?
Maybe find some way to take your mind off things?
I'll try my best. Maybe I need a hobby.
Avoiding my apartment, walking around. Most people die at home! Ask the Thera-Pay bots on LowTown if you don't believe me.
Well you believe what you want. I'm screwed either way. I'm not the Aseptic though.
Your skill set is interesting. Could you use that for something?
That's one way of looking at it....
Between that and the serial killer running around, I figure I've done well to last this long!
Aren't you worried the Corpsters will come after you?
Thank you for talking to me before. It's been hard to let go of the silicon weaving dream but I'm doing much better now.
We live in dangerous times. We should assume everyone is capable of causing harm in the LUZ.
Well you believe what you want. I'm screwed either way.
I survived the Aseptic, so I'll take my chances.
Do you think you'll be able to do anything about Kikuchi and his chips?
The good thing about losing everything is that it really increases your chances of finding something.
It almost sounds like you want me to get sent to a scum-pit. Either way, I have no desire to make life easier for these tax-avoiding Corpsters.

dialogues.title: Safia explains
lines: I don't know what you're talking about.
I told you to talk to Ashwin - which you clearly didn't do.
Ah, you're Ashwin's former boss, right? The noodle stand owner. I remember you.
He quit a few days later. He said you talked to him?
Oh, wow. I can't believe you. I'm done with this pointless conversation. Leave me alone.
Eventually. After he stopped feeling sorry for himself. I guess it had to come from me. Anyway, I better go... If you ever need a waitress, come find me. I'm looking for work.

dialogues.title: Zaff It
lines: Kenzy's getting the ol' band back together! Damn am I glad. She was one of the good ones. Solid eye for the rebel shit.
Comeback for the Club Rat Kids.
Oh the pleasure is artfully mine! I already got some ideas, but creative genius needs to be massaged. Give me a day or two, Kenzy's gonna love this.
Aye! You been keeping your eyes to the sky? Seeing rainbow colors in the clouds?
Friend of mine or friend of yours? But if they're a friend of yours then they're a friend of mine so I guess it all washes out in the end. Love it when that happens!
I need your help with something.
I'll never be one to go against a climb up the spiral Spire. I'll see what I can do. Something round this place could use a good Zaffin.
I've been with a friend of yours.
Need something Zaff'd do ya? I think I can make it work. What's the job?
Ahhh! And that's what's beautiful about you, you see the colors and the corpsters hate that!

dialogues.title: Razlo's Revelations
lines: You seem to know a whole lot about it.
A good thing to sort of... roleplay. So I changed my name to Razlo, and I kinda... acted like I had a secret.
Because you're probably telling the truth.
Who knows? You seem to be playing detective, trying to impress that malfunctioning bucket Dotson.
Yes, well, common sense is a rare thing in Nivalis. But it is welcome.
So who was The Phase Runner?
I don't know if Razlo really is a criminal, or if Dotson has indeed lost his mind...
That's the part of the story you're stuck on?
You better hope your friend Dotson comes back and you catch me before I arrange for you to have an accident.
But we may never get another chance to confront him like this. If you believe Razlo really is your enemy, now is the time to tell him.
I don't expect anyone in this city to hold an intelligent thought in their head. You believe what you want to believe.
You're back. When I first met you, I didn't realize quite so much of my time would be spent with the new noodle stand owner, but here we are!
Indeed he does. But... it's more complicated than you realize. He doesn't think I am the ORIGINAL Razlo. But he still thinks I am the REAL Razlo.
I'll watch your back. One day, I think we'll know for sure what the truth is about Razlo. Until then... let's be careful.
Dotson thinks I was born with my original name, "Albert Albumen", but I became so obsessed with the real Razlo that I tracked down the original.
Because Dotson will tell me all this eventually.
I'm not sure who is the insane one.
I'm not sure that was the right choice... but time will tell.
But Dotson thinks you're the real Razlo.
When he died of "natural causes", a note on his body was found that said, "If I die, Razlo got me."
I believe Dotson. I think you're a danger to everyone in this city.
Now if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to reality. I have exams to study for and tuition to pay. Us law-abiders have to find part time jobs to make ends meet. Goodbye detective.
Then I killed him and had a MemTech upload his memories and experience into my neural augment.
I don't have enough information to make any accusations, but...
I'm literally telling you this insane story. Why would I share it, except to debunk it?
You expect me to believe you?
Gideon says there's more to you than I know. Is there?
You think I'm a complete idiot, right?
I'm not so sure about that, but let's pretend that's true.
Let's keep this whole conversation to ourselves now, shall we? We don't want people thinking you've lost your mind too. Goodbye.
Dammit. Maybe you DO have some idea of what's really happening.
That seems less likely than the obvious explanation: I am not a teenage criminal mastermind... and Dotson is insane.
Refreshingly honest. I respect people willing to admit they are out of their depth.
I wasn't, but I became him. When I read about The Phase Runner in the Feeds, I thought "Razlo" was a really great name.
Some say he was a madman. Some say he was a hero. He was obsessed with finding a criminal mastermind called "Razlo."
If it were true, it would be.
I see. Well... you've made your decision. I suppose if I really am a criminal mastermind, you better watch your back.
I believe you. I think Dotson is mistaken.

dialogues.title: Ava discusses Andreas situation
lines: She'd do anything for her art ...
She really misses her band huh?
Amazing how passionate people get about Jazz.
We need to make her known to CorpSec. I know she won't sing without a band but maybe she still writes?
While I think it's unlikely that we could help her band get out of prison. It might be possible to get her sent to them.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus strange message 2
lines: Saeculum three is unbinding, when we free ourselves of our invisible bonds, but shed the connections between one another too. Finally, Saeculum four is rending... upheaval, regression and finally, collapse.
I am sure of its age. I don't know why it was scheduled to come now.

Even in your life you would have seen these events. The invention of the vapor-powered HOVA, leading to the redevelopment of Luna and the marches at the Eastern Peninsula for emancipation. But eighty years ago... the Corp wars, and the establishment of CorpSec.
That's the end of the message. Though I am sure Thaddeus has more to say.
Do you mean a NEW message?
I have double-checked the message's origin. There is no corruption.
An old Thaddeus message has been received.
A history lesson then it seems.

The cycle repeats, even when we leave this planet and fill the stars with our seed. It's like the eighty year cycle is in our DNA. Our source code. We can't escape it, and we DON'T escape it. I've checked.
I have heard this theory before, but some of his terms are new to me.
I don't. Chronologically this is the oldest. By far. It is from two hundred years ago. It was scheduled to only unlock now.

Saeculum one is twenty years of progress where civilization is built on a bullet train as we hurtle into the sunlight. Saeculum two is awareness, when we open our eyes and see the way ahead, and those around us too.
I would share a lesson from history, if you would listen. If I told anyone else, it would not mean much. It would be like whispering it to myself.

They say history repeats itself every eighty years. In all my research - and I have done plenty now - I would say it is closer to eighty two. And within that span, there are four phases. I call them "Saeculums".
So we are due another... "rending". A cataclysm.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 16
lines: The sun is up, the toxic smog is lifting and business is booming in the LUZ. I have a great feeling about today.

dialogues.title: Odd Behavior
lines: That was an interesting conversation with Kai.
I'm aware. I know your schedule before you do.
I think that's for the best. I'll mark the location of the cafe for you.
He usually posts from this cafe after his show wraps up. Maybe he's there?
I just pulled up the studio his loudcaster license is through. They were replaying an episode of his pre-dawn talk show.
And this is important enough to interrupt it?
I wouldn't even know where to find him.
I'll do it for you, Ava.
I don't really have time for this right now.
Right, what do you think we should do?
Well, I know your schedule's tight and all that but maybe he'd benefit from a visit?
I'm not exactly speaking to you out of the need for human connection. Well, I guess in a tertiary way I am, but that's for the unemployed philosophers to figure out.
I'm sure they do that all the time.
Oh, sure. And for a variety of reasons too. However it looks like Kai never showed up for work. Didn't notify them, nothing.

dialogues.title: Raluca fourth meeting
lines: I want no part of this.
It's isn't just a question of me. Since we started seeing each other more, I felt like this is a part of me you should be involved with.
And it's a matter of survival.
I’d breathe easier, not just physically with synthetic lungs easing every inhale, but emotionally too.
I'm not sure I can help you make this choice Raluca.
Well I was hoping you'd have strong feelings but not of disinterest.
I’d be free to smile without hiding the traces of my past, and every honest glance would be a step toward rebuilding what was lost.
So it's about my opinion about intimacy versus safety.
But then again, the thought of synthetic lungs—of breathing without that constant reminder—has its own seductive appeal.
But sometimes, it feels like it's keeping you at arm's length too.
The cons are just as real. This mask has been my shield, a safeguard against a world that once judged me harshly.
Removing it means exposing every imperfection, every reminder of banishment and debt.
Raluca, you're beautiful as you are.
Precisely. It’s not just about aesthetics—it’s about the courage to stand naked before the world, with all its imperfections and scars.
You already made a decision, didn't you?
There's a dangerous kind of beauty in accepting every fragment of our broken past.
That life might have been more artificial than your mask!
Simply put, your opinion is very important to me. I'd like to know what you think about this. About us.
The pros are undeniable. Without this mask, I could finally show you the unguarded me—the real face behind all these scars and stories.
I'm sorry. Mouth access? Is that all I am to you? A mouth?
No. I wouldn't without hearing your honest opinion. And there are the cons.
And you want me to decide that for you?
You're right I should help you with this.
It sounds like that life came with its own problems.
You people are all the same. I knew this was a mistake. This mask will be staying very firmly attached to my face until the right person comes along. Goodbye!
I’d be stripped of the anonymity that let me do this, that let me survive in the shadows, and with vulnerability comes the risk of rejection and pain.
Your real face isn't behind a mask!
If I keep this mask, it's not just to hide a face. It's to honor the struggle that brought me here.
I'm not disinterested Raluca but this is a big thing for me be involved in.
It’s a trade-off between raw authenticity and protective armor. On one hand, I’d gain the freedom to truly connect.
It sounds like a quite dangerous procedure. Plus it's a lot of Lims.
You always know just what to say. But the irony isn't lost on me—my face, half-hidden behind this barrier, is all I've got left of a life I once knew.
You said you have saved some money.
I've been saving. Just a few Lims here and there when I have them. Think I nearly have enough for a full procedure. I'll finally be able to breathe down here.
Nothing shows your imperfections and scars more than the mask.
You know, deep down, I was hoping you'd say this. I would have done it for you but I'm so glad I don't have to!
Hey you. I've been thinking—ever since I left the Spire and lost everything, this mask has become my shield.
On the other, I’d lose the control that comes from concealing the parts of me I’m still learning to accept.
You want me to help you decide?
I met you when you were wearing the mask. It makes you unique. Save the Lims and use them to buy your own place or something.
Maybe we should look at the pros and cons.
That sounds like a heavy price to pay.
Personally, I'd lose the mask. Your life will be easier and the added mouth access might be nice.
No mask can hide your beauty.
But I can see it in your heart!
I'm begging you. Just your opinion.

dialogues.title: Ava tells the player about Teleshko
lines: Do you want to talk with "Agent Teleshko"?
Probably. He has reported you to CorpSec for vagrancy.
You should call him. Though, that is not possible. So you should talk to him, as unpleasant as that may be.

dialogues.title: Lois becomes your friend
lines: Heya bud. Good to see you again.
Maybe, but just for a holiday. Nivalis is my home.
Nice. I mean, great. Hey, remember before I talked about running away when this whole lockdown was over? You still up for that? I mean, am I the one you want to run away with?
Hey, so you know we are kinda buds now. I mean... I should use a better word. "Friends." We are friends.
I guess I am just wondering if... we're at that stage? Me and you? Are we companions now? Have you incremented a friendship variable enough to become my friend? And have I done the same for you?
I'd love to escape the city with you bud.
Well in a lot of RPG games there is a system for making friends, or forming relationships. Once you have enough positive interactions with a companion character, they become your friend. Officially.
Whoa, for real? Alright then, I'll get planning. Hey... thanks. Thanks for putting up with me. I mean it.
Right. So you know I make games?
What are you trying to say?
That's how games work, not real life Lois.
Yes, you tell me every single time we talk.
Well, I'll settle for that. Appreciate it.

Roger. Got ya. Fantastic. Good to know. See ya around bud. Or not... cos we're not buds. But I guess I'll still see ya... so I'll just kinda nod, or walk around like I don't notice you. Kinda like an NPC in a game.
I like it here in the city, but I'm still your bud.
For me, you definitely reached the right affinity level. I think of you as a friend. I just wanted you to know that.

dialogues.title: Gemelar about her knife incident
lines: I have people to talk to. And I handled it. So no.
Can I help you in some way?
You're alright boss. You don't need to worry about me falling apart... or coming at you with a knife.
Maybe I got an idea for the restaurant?
Hey boss. Got a problem with my performance?
But... thanks for asking. It's noted, and appreciated.
I ... don't need to tell you.
I still don't want to talk about it.
Alright. Let's just forget about it.
I looked for reports on the incident and found nothing.
Except which restaurant and which boss it was.
All you need to know is that I had the knife and I wanted it to happen. I wanted to make sure my old boss didn't do to anyone else what he did to me.
Why else would you be here?
Well, that explains everything. Back to work then.
I'm your boss so I still need to know the details.
What the hell? You're my boss but that's it. You can either let this go or fire me.
I'm gonna get back to work, but thanks for letting me deal with this on my own.
And I don't need to employ you.
We need to talk about the knife incident...
The rest is just details. You don't need to know more.

dialogues.title: Quince helped
lines: He's wrong about your back, you know. I'll always have it, no matter what.

dialogues.title: Back in Business
lines: Ha! Depends what that cluster klutz has gotten his hands on.
Right on, champ. Thanks for your help. Hey, you ever need something fixed up come and see me. I got you.
That was quick! Parts are actually stacking up here. Didn't think I'd see it happen.
Like dropping vacuum tubes into the ocean floor to try and filter new dirt. Like what the Neon Gods is new dirt? Dirt's just dirt.
Sounds like you have your hands full. I'll get out of your way.
Ehhhh, just some of the stuff they're talking about out here has gotten kinda mad.
What's the first thing you're going to build?
Ha. Payment woulda have to have been negotiated beforehand. Maybe you should go back and pick up some tips from the shit head shippers.
What kind of parts did you get?
Yeah, yeah, take this alright? Thanks for your help. You need anything taken care of in the future come see me. I'll fix it right up.
Anything that kid touches either cracks, dents, or catches on fire. If I didn't have to fix all of it I'd think it were a gift.
Yeah, you ain't kiddin'. But look, you ever need something fixed you come and see me. I'll put yah on the top of the list.
They were too weird for me.
All the kinds. Everything I need to keep this grimy metal raft floating, even though it would be better at the bottom of the sea.
Heard that before. Look, I gotta keep unpacking this stuff but you ever need something fixed you come see me. I got you covered.

dialogues.title: Talk to Hanz
lines: My guests like your noodle stand. I wanted to tell you that in person. It is these little amenities that make the location of a hotel desirable to new guests.
You have a compelling story to tell. A boy gasping for air in a city that doesn't care. But you want to show that it DOES.
Absolutely not. It's a noble cause, and I personally will contribute 100 Lims.
So you wouldn't object to asking your guests for a little help?
Glad to hear it. That makes it easier to ask you for a favor.
The whole city seems to know already.

dialogues.title: Cale sits down
lines: We have all the time in the world.
This place is reserved for like an hour.
Dreams. What would we do without them?
What a view from up here.
How much time do we have? Is this villa all for us?
It's amazing. Imagine living here. No worries. Just bliss.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 25
lines: Morning gorgeous. I am complimenting you on your appearance in the hopes that it will make you more confident today!

dialogues.title: Ava suggests to talk with Sage Hullen
lines: I'll go and talk to her.
It makes sense. She gives off the vibes of an old soul.
Sage Hullen might be able to tell you more about "Level Up!".

dialogues.title: Found This
lines: My friend, that was ages ago. Back when I was basking in the glow--Reena. Reena would know where the painting is.
Like a needle on vinyl. If that were still a thing.
You really think it's the same thing?
Ah, the dealer's an old friend of mine. Helping me track down some rare prints for the ol' collection. Cuz that's my se-le-ction.

My fellow traveler, I'm into anything that gives the vibes. And I sense a bit of them on you. Our one and only AG was a multi-faceted wiz of the creative world. Once you're enmeshed, swimming in the salted sea of bliss, you'll notice his presence throughout.
How them air waves treatin' yah?
What are you doing up here?
What can you tell me about it.
Ah, well that's great! What did you happen to stumble upon?
D-sharp, D-sharp, E-flat. They're part of a melody or something. Let me think for a--I know where I've seen them.
To me all notes look alike!
Well... let's see what vibes Mr. AG left for you to hear. Now this is interesting. I've seen these before, notes like this.
Heard the music did yah? Those ears of yours must be buzzin' like the bees in the belly of the beast. You got it with you? Let me check it out.
A painting: The Ballad of the Nameless PI. They were so faint, drawn on the bottom corner. I can see it.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Danny waiting
lines: Anyway, he needs to speak to you.
I feel it's an under-utilized term.
I knew it was a mistake.
Danny Danetti is loitering around the Noodle Bar looking for you!
For someone who promised to leave you alone, Mr Danetti shows up pretty often at the Noodle Bar.

dialogues.title: Meeting Rosco
lines: If you don't trust Curzona, why work for them?
One day you'll need to suckle from Curzona's teat. I can guarantee that. I'll be watching as you do.
Hey, it's not all bad. I get to walk a lot, see the sights. Some of my spine is still intact too which is nice.
Is there no exit for you?
I'm sure Curzona wouldn't have bad intentions.
Yes yes yes, of course. Look I'd better go map this street before it changes again, see you around.
Oh I apologize. I always assume people know what I'm doing. This thing here is a Carto-Carry - little piece of Curzona kit that allows me to map the streets of the city.
Well that's the million Lim question isn't it? Some say they are trying to build a comprehensive map to provide information for the citizens but I feel like something else is going on.
Curzona? They're up to no good, are they?
I guess you should have stayed out of debt then.
I have no control over what it's used for. Curzona having up-to-date information on people's whereabouts seems like a step too far.
Owe a lot of money. More than a lot. More than just money. Ended up at Curzona factory, barely the shirt on my back.
Think I have a choice sugar bean? No no no. I'm going to be here for a long time. Curzona got me by the boogaloos.
Well, would you like the reason I tell people or the real reason?
Well thank you for the warning.
I'm doing this until I drop. Even if I could get to every street in a single lifetime .... This whole place looked completely different two map cycles ago.
Well I tell people it's because they're in my way.
I just know how these guys operate. The more data they can accrue, the more they can use it...
Once they saw how tall I was they stuck a Carto-Carry on my back and sent me off. "Map the streets, easy work for someone like you." Well here I am, fifteen years later.
Then just stop working for them!
Would you mind stepping to the left?

dialogues.title: Rats ate the bread
lines: People-sized. So we'll need to watch our step.
We ran out of bread. Well, it was stolen. By little furry critters. Sump rats.

dialogues.title: Campaign report week 4
lines: It's here! Week four of the funding campaign. Do you want to hear the results?
I'm going to have to talk to Mary-Nyx.
We only collected 1890 Lims this week, plus a little more directly. If Clancy and Reena had... never mind.
No question. I'll make up the difference.

Campaign balance: [LochlainnMcKenna.BoyFunding] 
Not enough... Isn't there anything more we can do?
With Clancy's and Reena's help we collected a huge 11,340 Lims - plus what we raised from people's personal donations.
I think we're out of options, Ava. I guess I'll... talk to Lochlainn.
We could ask Calhoun for a loan.
Or we take Mary-Nyx Curzona's offer to add the missing amount to your generational debt.

Campaign balance: [LochlainnMcKenna.BoyFunding] 
We did it! Ava, we did it!
I'll send the final campaign balance to your HUD right now.
Otherwise, I'm afraid it might be end for poor Iann...
Unfortunately you never spoke to Clancy... but thank to Reena we collected 3780 Lims this week. Plus a little extra from direct donations.
Or you could make up the missing Lims out of your own pocket. You have enough money to do that.
With Clancy's help we collected 5670 Lims this week - and a bit extra from other people.

dialogues.title: Roberta isn't eager to become famous (again)
lines: So it's nothing too scandalous. I just... need to keep a low profile. You see, I'm not from around here.
Will this bounty hunter come here and cause trouble?
I'm really not interested in it Roberta.

I know having someone like me on your staff might seem like a risk, but everyone has baggage. Everyone has a history. I can promise you, my past problems will never interfere with work or put you at risk.
She said you had given permission for her to shoot me.
Are they still looking for you?
So this Elaine Malloy is talented and she seems very clever and all...

I wasn't safe back home. My father was a retired Corpster with company secrets in his head that he couldn't get rid of. He just wanted a peaceful life for his family out in the protein farms, but the Corps sent a bounty hunter after him.
They always find you. I hid under a harvester bot while they dragged my father into a prisoner transport. He told them I was with my mother. I never even had a mother...
I'm disappointed you won't take a risk to help my business.
I don't want to do it.
Hey, I need to talk to you. It's about this photography series that Elaine Malloy wants to make about me.
She asked to shoot in the restaurant.
I'm from the Eastern Peninsula. I came here with a Sand Turtle desert transport HOVA.
It's your choice to be photographed or not.
Not really. You don't want to. That's all I need to know.
No. I changed my name, my face, left my friends and family behind. Only doing something monumentally stupid like becoming a famous model could put me at risk.
It doesn't matter that I don't know any of his corporate secrets. It doesn't matter that I'm just a waitress. I'm a loose end, and the Corp's pay a premium on cutting the loose ends.
So... do you want to know why I refused?
So will the bounty hunter find you?
I worked hard to start a new life here. I sacrificed everything, but I knew what I had to do, and I got my head down and I did it.
I'm sorry to turn you down. This new job has been a great stepping stone in building my life back up. But I can't be in the public eye.
Sure, if you want to tell me.
I'll try to keep you safe here.
As long as I keep my head down, the bounty hunters will NEVER find me. I've played it safe for a long time. It's not the time to take crazy risks.
I would hate you to think I'm not cooperative or thinking about the reputation of the restaurant. But I'm relieved I don't need to do this.
I don't think so. Not unless I advertise myself all across the city by... I dunno, appearing in a world-famous ad campaign.

dialogues.title: Ava knows a watchmaker
lines: He's part of your staff too. Franco.
I checked while you were talking with Pilk. There actually IS someone who is making mechanical watches as a hobby in the district.
He's a professional chef. Franco Miliscent. He lives here in Meridian Market.

dialogues.title: RM Alken Blood and Bits
lines: Oh circuitry gods that's a long story.
Fair enough. Hope I'm not on call the next time you do something incredibly stupid.
I tell yah, some days, being a medic is worth it.
Fair enough. Probably avoid warehouse B. Think they're still cleaning up some blood and bits in there. Whoop, and that's an alert. Got another winner coming through.

Come on. I can't tell yah that. I start given yah patient names and details I break all kinds of laws then lose my license and I'm out here peddling bootleg pain meds and anti-viral pills to try and put food on my table. That sound fun to you? Cuz it doesn't to me.
Exactly. So, you work at Conland or just a friend of the poor fool who's on a HOVA ride to the clinic?
Nah, just a fan of good stories.
Mid-air HOVA crash with ejection. Sounds like the driver landed on a cafe table and now we got second degree burns from coffee splatter. I tell yah...
Because you get to see some gnarly stuff?
Got a bit of a gruesome streak in yah, huh? You ever think of becoming a medic? We're always looking for help. Burnout rate is exponential.
Because you get to help people?
Leave out the names and tell me what happened.

dialogues.title: Hanz's Order
lines: Beef is tricky. This will cost you…
500. My final offer. Take it or leave it.
You think these guests, whose palates have been refined to detect the slightest trace of saline, would accept just any meat? They would riot! No, it must be fresh, juicy.
Beef. That’s what I need. Customer requested steak, medium rare. Special order. Very important client.
Shut up! Don’t let them hear you! Anyway, can you deliver?
I am done with this chatter!! Beef is what I need and now is when I need it.
I don’t care what it costs! If you grow it you can name your price. What do you want?
You will be paid of course. 200 Lims should cover it, yes?
How does it even grow? Underground cattle farms? I have no idea. But beef I need and now is when I need it.
Filling in? Are you good? You had better be good. My clients demand the best.
It already happened. We deal with it. With blancmange.
What happens when your clients ask for something that rhymes with "orange"?
I don't have time for shilly-shallying. Spit it out or walk on.

It's the new rhyme-based Spire diet. Everything has to rhyme with “awake”.
I was considering Shiitake, but the client is allergic to mushrooms.
Why don’t you just buy the beef?
Doesn't seem like you have a choice. What do you need?
I'm here from the Greenhouses. Filling in for Clem.
Then they'll get the best. What do you need?

dialogues.title: Food Quest Retry
lines: You changed your mind about those growing jobs?
I'm getting the hang of it.
Thanks buddy. I owe you one.
Always. I might be green-fingered but I only got two hands. You interested?
You changed your mind about those growing jobs?
Great! Go see Sal, over at Fusion Point in Eastern R. Take his order, grow the veg, bingo bango, get some Lims. Easy, right?
I've got a few gardening questions...
Try tinkering with the parameters on your greenhouse module. Failing that, you can buy upgrades, if you have the Lims.
There are module vendors all around the LUZ. They sell the standard range for growing root veg, cereals, herbs, mushrooms and meat, plus some for special crops.
How do I buy more modules?
About that... Do you still have growing jobs on offer?
And I've hopefully got a few answers. Ask away.
How do I make my plants grow faster?
Sure! Well, apart from fish. And rat meat. But I guess rats are a kind of fish. Furry clawy land fish.

dialogues.title: Return to Steven McFellow
lines: Purge the plague? Pretty bold rhetoric.
It's all an ecosystem. We are just the cells being pushed and pulled through the cities veins. Sometimes the body has to purge the plague. Speaking of which, did you happen to find the NATA-log?
Well old Quince had many enemies. I'd be surprised if I saw him again the right way up.
Oh dear. I fear your swift return spells bad weather for Mr Crogan.
I'm afraid Quince Crogan is the Aseptic's latest victim.
Sorry to interrupt but I'm looking for Huckstash.
Ahhh well. I never did like the man. A means to an end. A sticky end too by the sounds of it.
Yeah it's all uploaded. No way I'm keeping this if it's been near a crime scene. I have enough heat as it is.
I wasn't able to find him.
Leaving the Metro Hub area gives me chronic panic attacks. Why do you think I asked you to go find the Nata-Log?
Oh my, it's good to have you in my hands. Allow me to interface with you... Oh yeah... Yes yes yes... That's good. Of course... Oh my... Wow wow-
Oh you think I could be the mass murderer terrorizing the streets of Nivalis?
Oh yeah, don't mind him I'm back... Yeah yeah... Ok I'm done. Take it back.
You mentioned Aseptic probably knows the the rail network...
Yes! Fine let me just... It's ok... He doesn't know... Yes... Ok... BINGO
Oh you make me laugh. Look I suffer from a crippling anxiety disorder that limits my movements.
Well according to the crew-change data, I'd expect Huckstash and the Crusty Punks to be hanging around the Meridian Market subway.
Looks like it's gonna have the least amount of CorpSec coverage for a few weeks. That's where I'd be. Now if you don't mind, I'm going to get back to this...

dialogues.title: Humour Bot 17's opening act
lines: I know. I am extremely funny. That is why you pay me for my humor-based services.
How do you make a cheesecake?
You have used up your daily allotment of humor anyway. Your account will be refreshed tomorrow.
I have not yet stated the punchline for the joke. That is why you are not currently laughing. You have derailed the whole joke.
I am serious. I am not laughing now.
Very well. I will offer you a chance to laugh at the punchline one more time. Do not squander this opportunity.
Affirmative. My services are not free. Your account is in arrears.
I like to cover my mouth when jogging.
How do you make a cheesecake?
It is a joke. I am doing jokes.
Apology not accepted. I am now in an extremely bad mood. I may not even tell the joke now. That is how bad my mood is.

dialogues.title: Visit Steven McFellow at the Metro Hub
lines: Wow... Ok. I'll try and sum this up in a way you might understand. The entire rail system in Nivalis is run by two very diametrically opposed AIs. The Nivalis Autonomous Transport Authority, or NATA, is an ancient and mad scheduling system that is as old as the cities more crumbled foundations.
Over the years the city has seen many gangs come and go. Normally, it's young vagrants looking to live a life on the tracks.
Yes, I'm sorry but they were murdered by the Aseptic.
I obviously have to hide stuff better.
None of your business, is it?
Looks like that area will be the least surveilled by CorpSec for the next few weeks.
Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?
The Train Route and Control Knowledge System or TRACKS. This more modern AI deciphers the mad ramblings of NATA into a schedule that humans like you can understand.
Ok fine. What you have in your hands is this months NATA-log. It is of no use to you so I suggest you hand it over.
Jumping on freight trains hoping to find themselves. When these groups organize they become gangs with territories and laws.
Yes I know the Crusty Punks, rail gang, nasty reputation.
If you want the item, you will have to tell me what it is.
I find it unlikely that my contact will have dropped something as important as this.
This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?
It's my business to survive, so this discussion is over. If you...
Run by a mystery-man with an even more nasty reputation. Goes by Huckstash. I'd be careful if that's who you're looking for.
Nothing of any use to you. Hand it over!
At least if you want to survive.
Hold on, you mentioned my blog where did you even find the Rail Trail?
Never mind. You wanted Huckstash right? Let me upload the NATA-log Data to my Comm and I'll tell you where he might be.
Ahhh I see I see. Yes, I would check the subway station around Meridian Market.
Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?
Well, I guess I shouldn't be surprised. It seems like Aspetic's network runs deep. Thank CORA he didn't get his hands on the item.
Firstly, The Rail-Trail is much more than just a 'blog'. It's a fully realized transportation eco-system with over thirty thousand... you know what? Never mind.
What do I need to know?
(Lie) I'm not sure what happened, I just found this.
I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.
My AI mentioned you run a railway blog. Do you know anything about the CrustyPunks?

Once every four weeks, TRACKS spits out the deciphered schedule called a NATA-Log for the next month and, if you know the right people, they might be able to get their hands on said data before it becomes public knowledge.
I worry that is not good news for my actual contact?
Correct. But I think I have something that is addressed to you.
Here, take this back. I uploaded it all and I don't want it on me. It's been near a crime scene. I could do without the heat.
Others say his whole family was killed by Roid-droids. Who knows he could even be... nah. I should shut up.
You should tread carefully around Huckstash. Some say he is the mad veteran of far-away war.
Know where I can find him?
Why are train schedules so valuable?
Thing is, you can do a lot with the NATA-log. Find out where peak footfall will be for your new Grime-Soda pop-up. Or something more sinister, like planning a heist or even a murder.
Huckstash flies under the radar. Always has done. Always been a big figure in the world of railway gangs.

dialogues.title: No Neon for Zaffer
lines: What is it? I'm not really in the mood.
CorpSec happened. Had 'Sec agents stuck to my arse like gum everywhere I go. Reckon SOMEONE'S been talking about me.
Man, I thought you were spot-on. My mistake.
I'm not lying. I don't narc for CorpSec.
Isn't that what you want? To be famous like the Byal Lapin?
And I thought you were cool, Corpo. My mistake.
First rule of Corp-Fuckery? Don't lie to your mates.
So that wasn't you I saw talking to some red-eye 'Sec stooge?
You know you're alright... for a Corpster. Zaff ya on the other side.
Maybe. But it wasn't about you...

dialogues.title: Sell Neon to Danny
lines: You could change the color to match flavors... red for strawberry, green for matcha...
Well, this is something far better than that.
You wanna talk about bad food you should eat at your own place sometime, friend. See ya around.
Top-quality neon, used by all the best bakeries. I can get you some at a bargain price.
Sounds like you need better advertising.
It'll match your donuts perfectly then.
Can't wait to try it. Speaking of which, how's the donut business?
Think of how it would look, your face in neon, reflected in the mirror glaze of a fresh donut.
Huh, now you mention it, I can kinda see it.
I knew it! Fish donuts - this is gonna be my ticket to the big time.
How's the donut business these days?
That scam Nola Berg is peddling. Gave me. Gave me a headache so bad I couldn't piss straight.
Neon? Ain't that a bit, you know, tasteless?
Blue for tuna... yeah, I can totally see it!
Just saying it how it is. Those dry, boring donuts will look ten times better bathed in neon light.
Yeah well, I ain't in the mood today. Look, I gotta run, 'k? See ya around.
Damn. Thought I was onto something. Ah well, back to the kitchen.
Aww, you ain't gonna try sell me one of those Digital Declutterers are ya?
*sigh* A fickle mistress. One second people are going crazy for a kidney creme cruller, next you can't drag them in the door.
Hey so donut question: crab parfait with a fishtail glaze. Right on, or right in the bin?

dialogues.title: Banor has got the details
lines: We need another fridge, or our produce will start to rot quickly.
For reasons only known to him, Thaddeus created a lot of normal storage space we never use.
I try to do my best.
And sell the base unit, right!
That is entirely my business, isn’t it?
Only if you are not planning to ever open up another place. Otherwise I would keep it.
Maybe you can replace one of the base units with another fridge?
Right. But where would I place it?

dialogues.title: Third chat with Dal
lines: You're lucky I'm here. Mudcrabs are a Category 2a violation. Another week and we would have had to burn this place to the ground.
Family of mud crabs! Don't worry, I set them free in the sewers.
It won't. Feel like giving me a hand for a few minutes?
Well, then I'll let you get on with your busy, busy day.
You're supposed to make sure this place is clean.
Just... make sure it doesn't happen again.
Hey, you know what I found behind the extractor unit the other day?
That's the spirit. Many hands, boss, many hands.

dialogues.title: It paid off
lines: Well, I guess he was smarter than all of us. I just thought you'd want to know. Anyway, I better get back to work.
Well, I guess he was smarter than all of us. I just thought you'd want to know. Anyway, I better get back to work.
We're friends. Good ones. He's grown up a lot.
I wanted to tell you about Ashwin. He has patented his cleaning system. Made a fortune.
We're friends. Good ones. And coworkers too. He hired me.
Ashwin just sent me a message. He has patented his cleaning system. Made a fortune.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Thanks You
lines: Please deposit item or request communication.
Thank you for your contribution. Citizens such as yourself help maintain the safe and secure city in which we live.

dialogues.title: Ask RM (known) about pain
lines: I think not. I have heard stories of grandparents who died from it.
Your Automata? That is very unusual. But...
Hurts. Don't recommend it. Can you be more specific though?
My Automata has memories of this kind of pain.
It's not serious if caught early. Can get nasty if you delay though.
All encompassing. Every cell of the body.
Hey there. You look stressed. It's giving you wrinkles.
I'm just taking a stab in the dark here, but sounds like a Leech Worm. A parasite. Ask your local pharmacy for a pill.
Has there always been a cure?

dialogues.title: CorpSec Fine
lines: We have received a report of a Category 38D12 Offense: unauthorized use of taste enhancers in a non-Spire establishment. A fine of 300 Lims has been issued. Have a nice day.

dialogues.title: True ending
lines: Touched by my memories and thoughts, going back through generations, back so far it's beyond the horizon.
I always knew I was special!
They say when you hear your name in a dream, you wake up. Is your name Thaddeus?
No. He sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.

Those memories were no longer inside me, but they were close by, close enough to touch. And that kept me going... far longer than it should have. I always treated my friends well, as I hope I did with you too.
