Do you think he treated you well?
Everywhere I look, I see my own ideas staring back at me, and the fools don't realize they all came from me!

Everywhere I look, I see too much of me. Wherever I go next, even if it's into oblivion, I will be glad to get free from me. Goodbye kid. Thanks for showing me that this word has more to offer than just more Thaddeus.
So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?
Even in death he tries to sell me something.
Of course! You're right. He traced someone untouched by his own memories.
No. But he sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.

Banor, Gunger, Huck - all of them couldn't tell you the truth, because my influence prevented it. Part of the condition of taking my memories, and a part of my personality, is that they cannot reveal the truth, even if they wanted to.
You're one of a kind. Not a metaphor there - just a fact. I dunno how I found you, but I knew you were the best candidate for my memories.
But you went further than even I thought you could. Dug deeper. Turns out, all it takes to figure out the mystery of Thaddeus is someone who hasn't felt his influence, even when everyone else has.
I wonder if he really wanted the experiment to work.
I'm actually relieved. He's finally gone?
I hope we learn the truth.

You might have put two and two together by now, and came out with infinity. Turns out, that answer is correct. I'm more than one person, more than a few. I passed memories - pieces of myself - on to Banor, Huckstash, Gunger and more.
When you've been around for as long as I have, you become attuned to your own influence. You can smell it. In a way, you're like my kids. All of you.
Because, through all those generations and propagation, on account of nothing more than dumb luck, you were untainted by... me.
I guess he was dead wrong!
So in the end I was little more than his tool to escape himself?
Huck, Banor, Gunger, the donut kid, the old woman... everyone. Everyone. I gave my memories to everyone.
The message origin is clear. It came from Sang-Ha. I believe he was there all along.
How about: You were his savior?
If you're getting this message, it means the process failed. I guess it was my time. Damn, I feel tired though. I just wanted to clear up some things before I shuffle off stage.
In another reality, our conversation stops now. But in this turning... well, you're smart kid, I'll give you that. You figured out a good deal more than I expected. Than anyone could have expected.
Wait! That made me his ... exit strategy?

You uncovered more about my true nature than anyone else has for a thousand years. In any other epoch, I would have had you killed to protect those secrets. Now though, all I want is to scream them out loud for the world to hear.

dialogues.title: Lucy Greets Again
lines: Sigh. It's actually really hard to think of nice things to say to you. Generic friendly greeting, I guess.

dialogues.title: LifeCorp or Egress
lines: Thank you. I hope that's true.
Like... the smell of the rain on a winter's night. The taste of hot chocolate. What it feels like to hold someone's hand. Silly things.
I'm sorry you lost all that.
So it's just a holographic image of the dead?
The Holocropolis is an ancient monument, and has housed many different technologies related to the retention of memories of the dead. They might still have the technology to preserve and extend life.
A lot of time has passed...
Of course I do. Perhaps they are different from yours? I would not know. But I dream of...
I speak to people who aren't here all the time. Nivalis is full of echoes. Sometimes I'm not sure if I'm speaking to a real person, or a ghost, or if I'm dreaming... It's... a lot.
We have no idea if I could ever return to my human form. Or what kind of state my body could be in.
However, no matter what my fate, retrieving my body seems sensible. Better we know for sure what happened to me than live in ignorance.

It's like an endless sea of night, and I'm floating in it. I don't know which way is up, so I swim at random, hoping I break the surface and can finally take a breath. But even when it seems like I won't make it, I don't feel afraid. I don't feel relieved. I feel nothing.
If you were still interested in trying to discover what happened to my physical form, I may have a few leads.
We can check the Holocropolis. Although Rosetta might not want to help. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

Of all the places in the LUZ that a body might be preserved and hidden, it seems the most likely. And even if they don't have my body, they might have some records of my body, especially if I am recorded as... already dead.
My body. And what happened to it. Funny, ever since I learned about my human nature, more and more has come back to me.
All we know is that Thaddeus kept it safe. But where?
Me too. I'll send you a Nav Point.
Technology moves ever forward, but little active research has been done in cryogenics since LifeCorp exited the market. I fear my fate is no more hopeful now than it was a hundred years ago.
We're looking for my undead body while I live as a digital ghost. "Morbid" is our vibe today.
It's alright. I have to accept what I am now.
Tell me more. Maybe it will help us.
It's where digital afterimages of people can be stored after they die. Ms. Altra's sister must be stored there.
There is a LifeCorp Holocropolis in the LUZ. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".
About that... I may have a few leads.
We should check the Holocropolis. I believe Rosetta would return the favor you did for her. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".
Maybe it's safer if we don't look.
That's way too deep for me right now.

dialogues.title: Lucy Lovelace at the book fair
lines: No, not really. But rare. But if you don't have any for me, then, you know... begone!
You got some pre third epoch fashion mags for me?
Great styles. Big collars. Fanned sleeves. A lot of sealed rubber with lead lining to keep out the radiation of the day. But if you don't have any for me, then, you know... begone!
What was so special about them?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 15
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
It’s ok to feel the way you do. Probably.

dialogues.title: Kenzy
lines: Unless you want to get ahead.
Bout as good as a batch of screws in a grinder.
She's a bit desperate right now.
Life going good. How are you Kenzy?
Well, why the ever-loving riff waves didn't you say so? Come on! When and where?
Freya Portlet? That uppity Corp-jockey? She'd prolly die before she lets me play for one of her clubs. Don't exactly fit the bill.
Sure the tips will be good but I'll be sellin' my soul. I'll be playin' for people who don't vibe with the music and I ain't about that.
Then why the fuck are you workin' for her?
Freya wants new bands for her resorts.
Tsk. Tsk. Spoken like one of them. I think I'm out. Good luck finding someone who wants to squeeze into Freya's little mold.
I can guarantee she'll let you. Think about it: rich crowds, big tips?
Snap crackle smack mother fucker. What's going on?
Or - and I know this is a novel concept for you - you actually don't gotta.
I promise you: no compromises. Just big tips.
I'm looking for a headliner for an upcoming gig.
Ohhhhh, that would be sooooo many glow sticks. Fuck it, I'm in. Send me the details and I'll be there. I wonder if I could buy enough to fill the Silver Spoon's basement.
Don't have to make sense to be rad. What's got yah yuckin' my yum anyhow?
Think of all the glow sticks you could buy.

dialogues.title: Cecil Stops by Again
lines: You better give me that fine before things get too heated.
And if you issue enough fines, you'll be promoted to the Spire and leave me alone?
You think I enjoy this? I get barely any satisfaction from issuing such grubby little penalties.
Actually? It seems like you do.
Well, look who it is. Nivalis' grubbiest entrepreneur.
I would be so far above you, I wouldn't even see the bird excrement that covers your roof.
A real warrior! Working the trenches.
This isn't personal, you understand. It's about quotas. I must fulfil them. But thanks to the LUZ, there are only so many places to inspect and only so many fines I can issue...
If I was promoted to the Spire, I could issue Category B fines all day long--
I love it when you talk dirty to me.
You do? If I told you about some of the things I'd seen... improper utensil storage... cross contamination...
Exactly! I should be out in the field, face-to-face with bacterial horrors, getting my gloves dirty…
I’ll get demoted. To a sanitation categorization assistant. I’m built for fieldwork, not paper-pushing!
What happens if you don't meet your quotas?
Can I just have my fine now?
I assure you all the paperwork is in order. Have an immaculate day.
Yes. Today it will be... forty Lims, I think. I'm feeling generous.
You can't be here for another inspection...

dialogues.title: Ava about Gimble 2
lines: A great hacker. No traces. Might be expensive.
Have you ever heard of a hacker called Nabla the Netphreak?
But I have an idea. Do you remember Nabla?
Miss Gimble is a big black hole for data.
We can haggle for a good deal.
There's volumes of data about her on the Old Network, but it's all encrypted, corrupted and buried. It's the kind of data obfuscation you see on confidential Corp documents.
Whatever the cost, it will be worth it.
There is nothing about her in the LifeCorp network. She does not exist there.

dialogues.title: Do You Know What Silo Means
lines: Hmpf. That's sad. But if you don't want to be my friend that's okay. Sometimes you don't need friends.... you need TOYS!
Ten years old is double-digits if you didn't know. Oh! Number ten! Fatal Frat Parties Nine is getting a reboot this year! That'll be the tenth in the series. See, ten is a great number.
A company called EducAte Inc. didn't really like that so they shut down the building until they could figure out who defaced corporate property.
Can we go back to that turning people into food thing?
Is that blood on your clothes?
Where did you find fresh strawberries?
Ewww! No way! This is.... strawberry jelly.
Hooray for a day off, right?
You're telling me you killed someone?
Do you know where the name Silo comes from? That's my name by the way. Silo.
Aren't you a little young for that kind of stuff?
Aw, okay. Well, thanks for being my friend! I'll see you soon. Maybe we can play hide and seek. I'm the best at making people disappear. Better not get caught!
Yeah, but that's nothing compared to the final scene in Apartment Stalker Seven. Right off the top of the building—ker-splat!
Silage. That's what's stored in silos. Fermented food for livestock.
Umm... Did I say strawberries? I meant tomatoes.
I didn't want to be food for livestock... So I fed them someone else instead.

It was sooooo good! I think it was the best in the series. Of course, nothing beats the remake of the remaster of the neural stem adaptation. I actually thought Masked Mathias was going to stab me in the face!
You're a little young. Are you by yourself?
Okay, but did you or did you not turn people into food?
Then you better not get caught!!!
School was cancelled because someone built a new playground overnight.
Hi there! You look nice. Do you want to be my friend?
Yeah... they'll never find out who did it. Anyway! Thanks for being my new friend! Maybe we can play hide and seek sometime? I'm the best though! Go ahead and hide, better not get caught!!!
I'm ten! That's old enough to have friends. Do you really not want to be my friend?
It's not like it matters. Unless you're missing friends. Are you missing friends? Nah, you don't have friends.
That's no reason to close a school!
You don't want to be my friend?
Ummm.... Did you see Terror Towers Thirty-Four?
Shouldn't you be in school or something?

dialogues.title: Milo talks seismology
lines: I did the job for you.
Saving the city, one sabotage at a time!
With QuakeConn officially endorsing the Cyclers, that's not happening any time soon.
You're getting impatient. I can see that. You want me to get to the seismology.
There was a big argument between the Slippers and the Cyclers. As usual. But this year the Chair made a call, and formally declared the Slippers a "fringe element".
The others believe the constant collapse due to earthquakes is cyclical, and will correct itself.
Nivalis is slipping into the ocean?
So you want me to sabotage more business rivals?
Uh, hi. So let me explain.
One faction of seismologists believe the underlying superstructure of the city is slowly slipping into the ocean.
If I had a clue who you're talking about ...
Now you continue sabotaging businesses so I can access their property, and gather data PROVING the city is falling into the ocean.
To even TRY saving Nivalis, we would have to first convince people it's happening.
Groundbreaking! Haha. Sorry. That's a little seismology humor there.
Precisely. And don't delay! We are on the clock here. The quake clock!
The seismology controversy. You don't know what happened at QuakeConn?
Well, you must have heard by now.
I was just starting to like the city.
Sure. Yes, sure. And I appreciate it. Great work. Top notch. Couldn't ask for more.
The official seismologist symposium. It's the biggest conference we have. And this year, well... the keynote was... was...

dialogues.title: Discuss JR Amiga with Ava
lines: Maybe we should speak to The Miso Baron, see if he even wants his old memories back.
I think she knows more about these CBI's than she's letting on.

dialogues.title: RM Alken recommends the mask
lines: I can't give you any information about a specific patient case, sorry.
But y'know, I can give you general medical advice.
Time is of the essence. Without either Spire-quality air or a mask of some sort, lung and brain damage is likely.
I'd like to talk about a patient of yours.
Hi. I have a question regarding a son of my staff member, Lochlainn. A boy called Iann.
If you can afford the oxygen cartridges, yes.
I'm sorry I can't help more. I... really hope you find some way to help this boy. Whoever he is.
About whom I won't tell you anything. Ask me about oxyphiles.

dialogues.title: Elaine contributes
lines: Well, I can't have people thinking I'm too poor to contribute. Not when EVERYONE'S talking about it. So make sure you tell them I donated.
But since I don't, it'll have to be money. 250 Lims?
Good, you're here. I heard about your campaign. The one for the oxy boy.
If I had time I would shoot a heart-rending portrait series of the child that would fund your work in minutes. And win awards, probably.
You think just because I'm world famous I don't have to eat? Universal acclaim doesn't pay my rent.

dialogues.title: Talk to Clancy
lines: You need money, and I have money. But it won't surprise you to hear that I'd like to keep said money.
So you know why I'm here?
It's my job to have my ear to the streets. And the ground these days is vibrating, repeating the word "oxyphile".
Exactly. Nobody wants to be seen profiting from the death of a little boy.
I knew you're a good businessman!
I've got an ear for such things.
You know good PR when you hear it.
Always a pleasure doing business with you. Have a nice day.
And as a business partner I expect that you will have nothing but praise and kind words for me, my companies and my charitable contributions.
I can give you something more valuable, though. Something that both of us will profit from.
Now you do. I own the noodle stand in Meridian market.
Ah, the noodle stand owner. I've been expecting your visit!
I will put my best marketing team on it. The Nets will be flooded with appeals for donations. I'll forward the funds to you once a week.
Why shouldn't you pay for advertisements like everybody else?
Public exposure. That's why I am really here.
Unrest is the enemy of every healthy monopoly.

dialogues.title: About Kitchen organisation
lines: If the dishes are to be cooked on point, you must always have immediate access to the appliances.
Everyone needs their own, complete workstation. No devices need to be shared.
No clearly demarcated work areas. If everyone has to run around the whole kitchen, it costs time and nerves.
Ok... In a kitchen with two or more chefs, what are the most common mistakes.
Of course chef. But if you have the space, two specialized chefs are the only way to really get the place going.
How can I help you Boss? I got a lot of knowledge. Ask me some tough questions.
Sounds logical. But expensive. And the kitchen needs more space?

dialogues.title: We Need a Place to PARTY!
lines: Sometimes my vision doesn't get transferred correctly and people misinterpret what level I'm playing on. I need you to level it out for me. Get me on the plane of these party people.
Up high? Sooooo many people. You know, as soon as we have a place for them all to party. Ain't no rules at the party mansion, hooo-ah!
I feel like you injected straight caffeine or something.
Ehhhh, caffeine, nicotine, amphetamine, joosine, morphine, you get where I'm going with this?
Well, look, I'm good at a lot of things, one of them being interior object placement.
Fine-fine-fine. You don't need to GET me a place, I have one. Just need to upscale it, you know? Get the digs right so the bliss comes natural.
Whoo, sky's a million colors right now. Like I'm looking up through a wicked visualizer. Oooof, now I'm dizzy. I think I need to sit down. No! No time for that.
That's why we need the party mansion! Place to let go. A place to get wild.
'Course you are! Because you got the smarts and the drive to wanna sail as high as the sky. Now, get me a place to do it!
Yoooooooo!!!! You are a fucking VR program in an analog world.
I don't have a place for you.
And you want ME to do that?
Hahaha! I knew you would. We're on the same, what's it called? Brain thing? Wavelength! That's it. We're on the same wavelength.

Insulting??? No! You're the translator. The person that can transcribe my vision into something tangible for normies. It's an important role that not everyone can fill as well as you do... So what do you say?
I'm down for a party mansion.

dialogues.title: Saban at the Stacks
lines: You don't feel... depressed? Or anything like that.
Do I look like I can afford that? Maybe I do... This is a pretty nice outfit I have on today, right? But no... No I won't be going there. Not unless I sneak in.
That's not a bad suggestion! I'd like to check it out.
Are you still going to go ahead with your... plan?
Remember I told you about the light in the Docks when the steam from The Stacks catches in the low pressure? What do you think?
You're not who you think you are.
Yeah. Anyway, I'm thinking of exploring the city a bit more. Anywhere you recommend?
Could you make it up to the Spire?
Hive Mall has a good buzz about it.
You could watch the ships take off from The Space Port.
You okay? You look a little... spooked.
Did you talk with your wife yet ... about the replacement?
Your plan to end your life.
I dunno what you're on about friend, but I'm going to explore the city a little more. I'm booking a holiday for me and the whole family. I should get busy.
Well, I'll see you around friend. Take care!
Hey, good to see you again.

dialogues.title: Return to Samuel
lines: A very personal question and not in the least bit relevant to what we are talking about.
When did you start hearing the voices?
The winds have brought you back. Of course they have.
The voices created the Unity Zone?
I am to be left alone now. The voices arrive with new instruction. We can pick this up when the winds permit it.
You hear them too, don't you?
Self is such an interesting concept isn't it?
A true path for a true follower.
It is not for me to question the voices. They came to me when they needed to.
Samuel, have you had any new implants recently?
A grand design a thousand years in the making.
The Unity Zone really clarified everything for me.
This all started when the Unity Zone came into effect?
Time really is a thing I try not to dwell on.
Of course, no that makes sense.
The voices said there would be doubt from the people. It's all part of the design.
Samuel, can you take off your glasses?
I'm picking up a strange signal from behind his right eyelid. Old Tech.

dialogues.title: Ma Gomba More Mushrooms
lines: I love mushrooms. Just not yours.
Why would I be scared of mushrooms?
Why wouldn't you be? They can stop a heart, enchant a mind, even bring down a city with the right encouragement. Plus, they're simply delicious on toast. Won't you reconsider my offer?
Wonderful. Here's a free sample to grow in your greenhouse. I will watch and take note of the results.
Well, when you put it that way...
You want me to be a guinea pig for an experimental mushroom?
One biotrophic broth coming right up!
Just a little biotrophic enoki that I've been working on. Scrumptious in ramen.
Then it's too bad the spores are already in your lungs. Have a nice day.
What a shame. I didn't have you down as a mycophobe.
Ah, my little chanterelle. Are you here to take me up on my offer?
Oh my dear, no. I want your customers to be the guinea pigs.

dialogues.title: Found 6 Tumblers
lines: Amazing. Really, I can't believe you found six of them. Do you know what this means? There's only one left! Somewhere in Nivalis is the last remaining style of k20 tumblers... Think about it.
Very cool indeed. We have to find it. We are so close to meeting the ghost. Binary God! What are we gonna ask it? No, don't tell me. Just go find it! I have to think...
Gotta find the last one first!
What a good day. What a very good day.

That happened to me! I swear I had seen the handle, the little curved bit on the bottom... nope! Was a blasted cable hanging over a coffee mug. Maybe once this is over I'll switch to those. Start hanging around Coffee PoccoCup.
I did it because it meant something to you.
Eyes open and ears to the ground.
I thought I found it but turned out to be a false alarm.
Holy Hyperspace, you found six of them. I can't fucking believe it. How'd you do it?
Maybe when we finally find the last one, we can wander around Nivalis together. Would be cool to see the city, the actual city, rather than just trying to find stuff inside it.
We're so close! Any luck with the last one?
Me either. We're so close. We're going to find it, I can feel it in my bones. Or veins. Whichever is more intuitive.

dialogues.title: Elaine Malloy Second Meeting
lines: Well I hope your photography skills are more robust than your ego. What do you have for me?
Right look, these might work. I'm willing to throw you some Lims as a goodwill gesture but I cannot guarantee any of this is going in.
Don't be offended, effective skulking can be the secret to good street-photography.
I still feel a little offended.
I mean the lighting is wrong, you have a very rudimentary concept of what framing is but, there's something there...
I know it is. Anyway let's take a look at your images.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Terminal
lines: Deposit logged. CorpSec thanks you for your service.

dialogues.title: Find Marcelle
lines: Just please don't write about Dagmar Fitz's place!
Hard work and passion pays off in the end.
I'll be the judge of that. And, I'm afraid to say, of you. Good day.
I don't like to get played. So ...
Quelle surprise. She always was lazy. And why did you agree to such an odious little errand?
Speaking of hard work... have you eaten at any of Dagmar Fitz's places lately?
Because they are THE place to be right now. Everyone says so.
Well, Nivalis's newest noodle hawker. How is business?
There are better ways to succeed. I have a feeling that you'll find them.
A gull could drop a crabstick into a bin fire and I would be there to make sure I wasn't missing out.
My child. I know every establishment in every corner of this city.
She said she'd help me if I helped her.
Because they serve rat. On waffles. With... ice cream. Delicious.
Those lackluster little establishments that cut more corners than a rhombus in a rock polisher? I can't say I've had the "pleasure" recently.
Well, Nivalis's best rat meat chef! How is business?
I'm serious. Dagmar might be awful but her food is phenomenal.
Guilty as charged. Dagmar told me to suck up to you.
A word to the wise, my friend: swap the sugar for salt too many times and you'll be the one who ends up with an ulcer. Understand?
So you will forgive me when I say I detect an aroma of bullshit about you.
Dagmar threatens me, and I think your honest opinion about her food could ... kinda help me.
Good. That could really hurt me.

dialogues.title: Talk to Clancy 3
lines: A client-less campaign is little better than a con.
Besides, if I'm going to give up free advertising space, I want to know who I'm giving it to. So go on: hit me with me your pitch.
If it was a no, you wouldn't have wasted time talking to me.
Well, finally. I've been waiting for you to come see me.
No, you haven't had much brain. You need 40,000 Lims, I can halve the time it takes you to collect it. You're just poor at math.
But hopefully that won't cost a child's life.
Mr Pantermino, I own the noodle stand in Meridian market.
Eh. Right for you, perhaps. What about me? I have to earn a living you know.
You should give us the ad space because it's the right thing to do.
Come on, this won't cost you anything.
And even Corpsters can't resist a good sob story like this one.
A pleasure doing business. Have a nice day.
What about your relationship with dozens of potential new clients?
In fact, helping you might even harm my relationship with them. So I think it'll have to be a no.
Well, why did you wait for me, if you care so much?
That's not how CorpSec will see it.
Very well. I'll donate some prime advertising space. And will forward the donations once a week.
So, you do speak commerce after all. It's true, being seen as benevolent can lead to an uptick in sales.
You should give us the ad space because it's good business.

dialogues.title: Bou's Third Run
lines: Do you even like your job?
He’s supposed to be running a hotel, not dating.
I've changed my mind. I'll help another time.
Thanks for being honest. Now are you ready for some orders?
Guess that explains it. He, err… this is kind of embarrassing.
He grew up in space. Gravity’s a new one on him.
Yeah, he asked me first, so...
Hmm, he seemed genuine at least. And I could use a meal that isn’t the congealed gunge from the bottom of the syrup pumps. What the heck, I'll go.
Ha! No one’s ever called me that before.
Well, thanks for stopping by CoffeePoccoCup.
There isn't anything to get in the way of.
Nice. Here we go, rush hour starting in three, two, one…
Here you go. Thanks for stopping by CoffeePoccoCup.
We got a blue cheese pour-over with extra ice, a mushroom mocha with white truffle syrup, a black ultra grande and a tequila corretto.
No idea who that could be.
Sure, it's a good opportunity to meet people.
Yeah. It's a minute and a half until the next ad break in the HOVA derby match. Ninety seconds of bliss.
I get it. You want a coffee?
Eh, never mind. Right, rush hours starting in three, two, one...
Oh. Really? Listen, I don't wanna get in the way of anything...
He asked me out to dinner. Was all excited about some place that does hanging kebabs… should I go?
It's nothing. No time anyway, coffee rush hour starting in three, two, one...
Ugh, some days are great, some days are trash. It’s the people who make the whole thing worth it.
He stood here for like an hour watching the slow drip and saying "wow". What's that about?
Oh my friend, there are always deliveries. You wanna help?
Nice! Before we start, some space guy showed up here a while ago. Do you know him?

dialogues.title: Ashwin wants to talk to you
lines: Looks like Ashwin wants to talk to you.
His performance has been excellent recently. He seems to be over his crush, Safia.
Good to hear. Let's talk to him!
Ashwin? The cleaner who was distracted?

dialogues.title: Suggesting John Doe
lines: You'd better be. I cannot stand another disappointment.
Hey, I think I might know who your brother is...
If this is bullshit, or some kind of trick...
I think his name is John Doe.
Wh… where can I find him?
I'm not sure I want to see you.
He has been seen in the Stacks. He can't remember much and is very confused.
I'm going there, right now. If it's him... thank you.
But I could be right this time!
I wouldn't do that to a friend.
Oh, hello. Good to see you.

dialogues.title: Happy Dagmar
lines: Gotta look out for number one, right?
Right. We're gonna be great friends, you and I. Leave it to me, I'll make sure your business rating gets a nice little boost.
There you are. You should know, I am a hard woman to impress. But you've managed it. Bravo, my slippery friend. Bravo.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 14
lines: Good morning. Your stats suggest you only achieved 12% NREM sleep last night. But don’t worry. I’m here to help you get through the day.

dialogues.title: Ava regrets
lines: I suggest speaking to his widow.
Why did we pick up Gan Coilson and bring him to his wife?

dialogues.title: Ava Worried About Reehan
lines: Not to sound like a Corpster conspiracy theorist or anything...
Great. Since I can't NOT caution you on certain things, I just want to put this out there: maybe don't talk about this with the twins?
No. He's probably out working like she said.
That gave me a bad feeling too.
Well, it might be a figment of fleeting thoughts, but, do you find it odd that Reehan was absent?
I thought you didn't have an imagination?
Good. Now let's hope we can find him.
Maybe we should look for him? Just to be sure everything's ok? Normally, I'd caution you to stay out of it, but I've learned that's not always the 'right' thing to do.
Yeah, that sounds like a good idea.
I mean hey, I'd love to retire too.

dialogues.title: Ava notices strange behaviour with Ashwin
lines: You think he's up to no good?
I have seen it many times. He might need a shoulder to cry on.
He behaves strangely. Scowling, huddled, creeping around...
How can you be so sure?
Looking at his demeanor, I would say his malady is clear. Listlessness. Melancholy. Listening to sad guitar music. He has heartache.
Are you saying we should fire him?
You should talk to him. His cleaning efficiency has sunk by 12.3%.
You think he's a CorpSec agent?

dialogues.title: Love from Cecil
lines: And in return, I am going to give you the greatest gift of all.
Of course. It is overwhelming. Now I must go. I have an appointment with the Pierrepont’s chief FLAVR bot. But... thank you. I will not forget it.
I did it for both of us.
I don’t know what to say.
A voucher for that all-you-can-eat froyo store?
A tempting offer. If I had time to inspect your apartment I might have said yes.
No one ever held out a hand in friendship to me before. But you... you have made my dream come true.
That store has several Category F violations, I wouldn't eat there.
No. I am going to put a hygiene approval certificate on your file. Valid for a whole YEAR.
I take it you've had good news?
I take it you received a job offer?
An offer from the Pierrepont Hotel itself! I start straight away. And not a moment too soon, the place is a NIGHTMARE. It will be bliss.
Never judge a book by its cover.
There you are! If you weren’t so revoltingly grubby I could kiss you.

dialogues.title: Ava suggests it's Idlehands
lines: That seems to be true for a lot of people in Nivalis.
What do you think about Idlehands?
I'll be looking out for other candidates.
The age would fit. And he's a criminal.

dialogues.title: Pay Nabla
lines: Give me a day or two.
Hi babe. Are you pockets overflowing with Lims you want to spend?
As I said: no guarantees. But Nabla is no fraud. You'll get what you paid for.
Here is your money. I hope it's worth it.

dialogues.title: Ashwin has a first proposal
lines: Ashwin has been telling everyone that his business proposal is almost ready.
His work performance seems to be good again. Or back to normal at least.

dialogues.title: Gift from Only Eyes
lines: I have just received a delivery notification from Banor. There is a gift waiting for you at the Noodle Bar.
Indeed. Perhaps his pitch to the station was successful. In any case, it has been installed for your enjoyment. Enjoy!
I believe it's an antique radio, which can only be from one person.

dialogues.title: Player Won
lines: I doubt that. Next time, I'll have you on your knees.
I don't enjoy associating with cheats. At least not ones who lie about it.

dialogues.title: Deeala to the Moon!
lines: Remember my arsehole landlord Pilk Dane?
He wanted me to teach him how to roast people at the comedy club.
Now I'm on my way to Luna.
Anyway, he chucked me out, called me a traitor to comedy, changed the locks and threw all my stuff in a trash compactor.
I still think it had to be you that went up against your landlord.
I made a joke about his stand up routine.
Well, I taught him alright. A bit too well.
Yeah, that would probably push him over the edge.
Well... he's my second cousin. He wants to put me on a Corp recruitment fast track training course.
Oh no. Not at all. I had barely made one comment, and he had already evicted me.
Maybe I can mooch off him for a while and find a less soul-destroying job.
Well, whatever. I need to get out of here now. So... thanks for being a pretty OK friend, and a non-terrible human. Mostly.
I followed it with "Your stand up is as funny as a fire in a kindergarten."
"It takes more muscles to frown than to smile. Your routine is like a gym session for my face."
I've spent my whole life fighting my own battles. Maybe just this once, it would have been nice to have someone fight FOR me.
Who knows, maybe I'll see you up there one day. If I do, say hi. But never bring up Pilk fucking Dane ever again! Later.
This rich Luna Corpster has been asking me to go visit him for a while. Might as well take him up on his offer. There's nothing for me here now.

dialogues.title: Spire
lines: Well we made it to the Spire. I hope it's everything you hoped for.

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: Oh here we go, another challenger! It's really not worth the humiliation friend. I'd walk away.
Chess! That's why you're here isn't it? Look if you really want to try and beat me, go right ahead. It won't be pretty.

dialogues.title: Talk to Miso
lines: Well, do you know where I can get some?
So you got a hookup, or...?
Something wrong with your brain pan? Do I look like I carry congealed cow? I only sell the clag.
Yeah yeah. But only 'cos you found Miso's sis. Go ask Harmony. Didn't hear that from me though.
Mate. Never thanked you for finding my sis. Or my name. So yeah. Thanks. Miso owes you.
Look, Reeker ain't just illegal. It... does things to you. Makes you see shit that never goes away.
So you need something or what?
Don't you want to be called 'Seth'?
The cheese I need isn't sold in a supermarket.
So you know what we're not talking about.
Yeah yeah. Go ask Harmony. Didn't hear it from me though.
Nah. Don't sit right. I'm Miso now, down to the meats.
Woah woah woah, keep your voice down. You want every hygiene 'spector in the LUZ over here?

dialogues.title: Rosco 2
lines: Still mapping every inch of Nivalis?
If they own the land, they own whatever’s on it. People included. That’s in the contract, by the way—“relocation at Curzona’s discretion.”

No, I mean the street itself. I mapped a block two nights ago—solid, normal. Then I pass by the same spot today, and it's shifted twenty meters north. Carto Carry had a meltdown trying to reconcile the data.
Either them or Nivalis itself is alive and just screwing with me. Honestly? Could go either way.
Maybe you got it wrong the first time.
Maybe. Or maybe Curzona's been playing games with the city again. They do love rearranging things without telling anybody.
I do not take any psychoactive drugs.
Yeah, well. You get used to it, or you get out. Assuming you can afford a ticket.
You say that until a Hova garage gets relocated on top of your aunt Brenda. Absolute mess.
You think Curzona’s actually behind the moving streets?
Yep. And it just keeps getting weirder. You ever seen a street move?

dialogues.title: CorpSec Fine 1
lines: What are you going to do about it?
I was at home in bed.
It is not creepy. It is factually accurate. You were seen trespassing on private property. We have the evidence.
A disobedience fine of 50 Lims will be deducted from your funds.
I know what you did last night.
Negative. You were seen trespassing on private property. We have the evidence.

dialogues.title: Can Caleb help Palmer
lines: Someone? Who is this mysterious stranger who needs a night time boat ride?
Palmer…? Shake my timbers and call me turtle, you mean Palmer Vesh? The space pirate? What dangerous game are you playing here, mate?
Aye, I’ll help. Tell Captain Vesh to come to the Docks at curfew. We’ll get out to the far beyond.
Aye, I’m sure she did. Like the sirens promised riches and handed out rocks.
Actually, I have to ask you something privately.
Aye, that's why I'm here. Could you help someone escape the LUZ in your bilge?
She promised me something in exchange.
Square-rigged and stowed away, that's how I keep the skeletons in my bilge.
Aye! So tell me, who is this mysterious stranger who needs a night time boat ride?
A PIRATE'S life. Worth risking your own planks for, and mine, do you think?
You mean an adventurer? A fugitive of fate? Who needs must ply the dark and dreamless depths in search of brighter shores?
Helm's alee, matey! Come to shoot the breeze?
But she's a sailor, sort of. Like you.
That be true enough. Us sailors are a crew, whether we like it or not. And you never leave a crew member behind. Not even a rotten one.
Right. I have a friend who needs to escape the LUZ without being seen.

dialogues.title: Safia's closure hired
lines: Ashwin just sent me a message saying that he sent you the last payment.
I wanted to say thank you for your help.
He did. He's doing his own thing now.
We're friends. Good ones. He's grown up a lot.
Ashwin just sent me a message saying that he bought you out.
You're a good boss. You take care of your people.
Well, I better get back to work. See you around.

dialogues.title: Sal Agrees to Work This Time
lines: Deal's a deal, ain't it? You're looking at your new Chef de Cuisine.
You do that thing we talked about?
Hahaha. We're going places, kid. You wait and see.
Crabsticks. I'm impressed. You got the makings of a fine restauranteur, kid.

dialogues.title: Cecil Grimes - Player Wins
lines: Based on what you're usually called so would I.
I'll take that as a compliment.
Did I what?!?! Eat it? No, that would be like eating at one of your establishments and I'd prefer not to be inflicted with food poisoning.
Please stop by when you lose, I'd love to wipe your smug little nose in the fact that the prize will never be yours.
I've found globs of human discharge congealed to frying pans that disgusted me less than you.
Can you just let the next person know I'm coming?

dialogues.title: Salty
lines: What do you want named after you?
I'm open to hearing about them.
Aye. That's what every beach banger says before bedding themselves in a mound of sand.
Of course you don't! That's why yer on the shore rather than sailing the Gridless sea.
EVERYONE needs to hear them! They are tales of triumph and tragedy. Of torment and torrential rain. Wait! I have the saltiest of ideas. One for the books.
Your salaciously sarcastic tongue will make you the perfect tale-teller. Go forth, spread words of my wisdom to the masses and GET ME NAMING RIGHTS TO SOMETHING!
They be tales as old as Luna's pull.
Sounds like the conquests were unsuccessful.
Because of land lubbers that keep us... keep us down. Buried in the... in the texts of history. Unnamed and forgotten!
And yet I've never heard of them.
Some reputation. I've never heard of you.
You want me to get something named after you?
That's some salty sarcasm spewing from yer trap. Should keep that ironically offensive whale shit to yerself!
All of it! A good captain will have a ship named after the... er... name he chose. And then ports and harbors, bays and quays shall bear his moniker!
Reflection of my conquests and the fruits they did not bear.
It's not about me! It's about my stories. The way they spread like tentacles from the beasts below. Er, I'm sure they will once they're told.
I don't want anything named after me.
There's no water in yer veins. If I cut yah, you'd bleed redder than red.
Aye. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some melodramatic pondering to do.
Toe the line! Disobedience will be met by stern words and guilt. A captain of my stature, WITH MY REPUTATION, shall chop down the pegs on which you walk!
Yer born to a life of walkin' on land like the rest of the dredgers, cleanin' shit from the sidewalk with the bottom of yer boots.
Aye. Don't give me no reason to. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some melodramatic pondering to do.
Is this about the sea? I like the sea.
As an order from your Captain, I bestow this quest upon you! Now sail, er, walk forth, and speak the words that come to mind. I shall work on my speech for what shall certainly be a grand dedication.

dialogues.title: Ava talks about Thaddeus
lines: About Thaddeus. Gunger says we should not pursue him.
I'll keep a subroutine running. If you want to know more about Thaddeus, there are people we could talk to.
I don't care where he went.
I can facilitate this investigation. I'll consider our next steps.
I'll keep a subroutine running, just in case you change your mind.
I want to know what happened to him.

dialogues.title: Books
lines: So what do we make out of this?
Even in the Spire, the last paper books were archived for preservation roughly 150 years ago. Owning them now is illegal outside the Spire.
I don't think it's about the trees.
Nothing for now. We take note of this and wait to see if anything shows up we can connect it to.
I checked for information about real books. The ones with pages.
Printing on paper has long been too expensive to be feasible, even for the Spire. The few trees we have left deserve better.
All these time scales are very vague.
We can only speculate. What it was really about is all very fuzzy.

dialogues.title: Hire Ashwin
lines: A Restaurant Hygiene Technician, yes. I'm also available for employment if you're interested?
That I look like Ashwin Chopra, the semi-famous Hygiene Technician. Well lucky you, it is I. I am Ashwin.
Yeah I know what you're going to say.

dialogues.title: Shag Shack Done
lines: Look at this place! It's a wet dream come true.
Well... my work here is done.
Right?! It's even better when you can wake up and keep it going.
Alright, alright. Hey, give me a little shake when you walk away. Something to think about in my new digs?
You're leaving already? But we have to celebrate. This is like a high-level lounge we got there. I can already feel the cocktail in my hand.
Hey you. Did you manage to design my place?

dialogues.title: Hire Hynthia
lines: Whoa... slow your roll. I know what you might have heard. None of it is true! Promise. My old boss decided to poison those customers. It had nothing to do with me! However, it has completely ruined my reputation...
Hey Boss! I'm looking for work if you have any?
Wait... have I seen your face in the news?

A little of this, a little of that. Mostly I'm known around here as the Sushi Mistress. Trained for ten years before even touching a fish. Hey, I'm the real deal. Promise. I got their certificate and everything.

dialogues.title: Well I Talked to Him
lines: You really should talk to a TheraPay Bot.
I don't have time before tonight's match. I got a press circuit and a few autographs to sign for those that managed to get a curfew pass.
Look, I tried but it was a no-go.
He was selling this for a thousand Lims! Jools and Drools that's insane!
It's a nice gesture, that's all I'm sayin'. Gonna use it to fuel my next match. I'ma win it for you. For this. Thank you.
I... Wow. I am honestly speechless. I really can't believe you got it from him.
Use it for fuel for the match?
A thousand! Are you kidding me?! That son-of-a-bitch!
Yeah, cool. Cool is what pays the bills.
That's exactly what I'm going to do. If you're friends with an oral surgeon, maybe give 'em a heads up they'll be some new patients come tomorrow.
And let a poorly integrated post-doc mental health intern who couldn't make it as a neurotech tell me to get in touch with my feelings and engage in self care?
I'm not gonna forget this. I'm gonna use it to fuel my next match. I'ma win it for you. For this. Thank you
Look at it this way: one of your fans will get it and that's cool.
FUCK! Well, that's just great. He's probably selling the threads for 500 Lims or something like that. That money should be mine.
Yeah, I'll get right on it. Now come on, the jersey!? I got someone lined up to buy it before tonight's match. We're doing a midnight galactic showdown.
You're back. Did you get the jersey? More importantly, did you rip that fucker's skin off and make him wear it as a coat?

dialogues.title: Coffee for Cale
lines: What you doing out here? Not looking for me?
Oh sure, sure! I get that. Hey, thanks so much for this coffee. It’s gonna be the best one yet, I know it.
Then you should come by more often.
Haha! You always have the best jokes. Tuna fish. I'll be laughing about that one all day.
Oh I will! Count on it! And thanks so much for this coffee. It’s gonna be the best one yet, I know it.
Not at all. Stop by anytime.
My coffee and the sight of your friendly face, dang my day is made.
Really? You mean it? Only I don’t wanna take up a chair for too long, not when you got important customers, you know? You’re probably sick of my face already, haha!
Customers are how I make a living.
That’s mine! Gotta love PoccoCup. That Bou can sure make a drink! Not that I hang out there or anything. Your place is still my numero uno.
Can’t stop, just dropping off your coffee.
I am actually, I have your coffee order.
Pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup?
Dark Roast and a Tuna Croissant?
Um, well that's not what I ordered. But I'll take it if it helps, no sweat!
No, that's... you really think I'd order that?

dialogues.title: Ava looks for Harper
lines: I mean I have no news.
Yes exactly. Good for her. Well done. You saved her.
CorpSec raided her flat yesterday. She was gone. No trace of her. They have no idea where she is.

dialogues.title: Ask Banor about the tips collection
lines: Hey Boss. Coming for the donations?
Thaddeus would be proud too. Thank you so much, Banor.
They gave like crazy, boss! We sailed past the target. So I decided to raid my piggy bank and round it up to 5500 Lims.
Well, this place ain't the Spire. We don't exactly get many tips in the first place...
We had high hopes. Reckoned between us we could raise 2500 Lims.
Lemme guess, they stopped giving tips?
Dang right! Tell you what, I ain't never been so proud of this old place.
But then we mentioned what we were doing to some customers...

dialogues.title: Congratulations!
lines: I once didn't see a HOVA about to land. I was taking care of this person who had tripped on the taxi terminal, nearly got us both crushed.
Ahh, it could use some work.
Do I get my prize from you?
Of course it was. I won.
Don't take it personal. I really don't know why they let me take care of people.
Well we'd love to hear your feedback when you get your thoughts together. In the meantime, here's your prize! Thanks takin' part in the tournament.
Hot damn you survived! Wow, really didn't see that one coming.
Oh yeah, yeah, I got the prize was just trying to make some conversation, see how the tournament went. Did you have fun?
Glad to hear it! Well, here you go! Appreciate yah takin' part.

dialogues.title: Sisterly Advice
lines: If you're here, then you already know where it is.
Working. Now can I help you with something?
Can you just tell me where it is?
Do you know where Sea2Sea Shipping is?
Talk to my brother. He'll tell you... Maybe?

dialogues.title: Welcome
lines: Perform well. Become my friend. Friends share stories... and bonds until death.
Masato Shima. While I'm thrilled you don't remember me, I'm also disappointed you don't recall our previous interactions. Says more about you than it does about the efficiency in which I do my job.
I lead a group of entrepreneurs that specialize in negotiations, hostile takeovers, and most importantly, acquisitions of the most valuable item in Nivalis.
I don't think I want to handle anything.
You close your eyes when you laugh. Or maybe you leave them open but tilt your head back and bellow to the sky.
Eh, wouldn't be so sure about that.
Since you've made it thus far, found us--found me--and are engaged in this conversation, it's safe to say your curiosity has been piqued.
Well, I am wandering around the sewers so...
I do. And so do you. Because once those Lims are mine again, delivered by none other than yourself, another door will open for you.
It's a story that exists in a locked file on an unknown Nets drive. You have to get access to it first.
And you want me to get it back for you?
I don't think I want to handle anything.
You're still standing here, are you not?
Our existence is a riddle. This would be but a single line in the lengthy collective question.
So you're running bootleg clean air?
It takes one quarter of a second, for someone standing idly in front of you to punch you in the face. If they have a knife against their wrist?
I don't know you. Though, it would be a falsity to say that you don't intrigue me. I'm very interested in how you'll handle yourself.
Wasn't finding you enough of a riddle?
We are not close enough for you to make those. It takes a friend, someone dear, to allow your guard to drop so you can laugh.
Enough. If the scorpion has led you to me then an acquaintance to me you are.
It means that you and I are acquainted of course. Almost to the point of friendliness. That will just depend on how you handle yourself.
So you're running bootleg clean water?
Hey - sewers are where the best rats are. And you know me, love a good rat.
Masato Shima. The fact you do not recognize me brings me great joy. It means I'm doing my job at the highest level of efficiency.
They borrowed what they could not pay back. Or rather, they lost what they needed to pay back. Gambling is a miserable vice.
If this locale upsets you, then you are not from this city.
Time will tell you. That and your ability to handle this task. Be gone now. I look forward to your return.
Why do they owe you Lims?
As it should have. The scorpions have been scurrying through Nivalis for decades now. I still remember the first chip. The gift it was to me.
You don't need to drop your guard to laugh.
Serrated fake nails edged with poison? Your laughter--your seconds of joy--just ended your addiction to breathing.
There is a person, a Mizzy Weiss, who owes me Lims. A lot of Lims.
Why would you not want to be recognized?
Take a few seconds to feel humor. Is that what you're saying?
So there's a story there. One, undoubtedly, infused with intrigue. Or maybe just a blandness masquerading as something flavorful.
Well, as you so eloquently put it, you are wandering around the sewers afterall...
Because when you run a criminal organization stealing the most valuable item in Nivalis, having a face for the feeds is not a benefit.

dialogues.title: Ava - We reached level 2
lines: According to CorpSec's guide for commerce, hospitality businesses unlock new perks when they serve more and more customers.
In this case you are now allowed to increase your meal prices, place more tables and hire more staff.
Congratulations! Your Noodle Bar popularity has reached Tier 2.
You are now also allowed to put more options on your menu, making our restaurant more attractive to hungry guests.
You can check out the restaurant stats on the monitor at the entry.
Well, I thought since I practically exist in your head, that...
Why does CorpSec control how many tables I have?
Well, every business must prove itself first. That is how they make sure only the strongest businesses survive. After all, dealing with bankruptcies takes time.

dialogues.title: Cult of the ORS
lines: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
It's dangerous, you know? An angry, aggressive chemical weapon that burns through anything, even skin.
Whooo! I mean, any voice is a voice, and this voice is going to be on my side! For once! Oh, my Neon Gods I gotta go figure out what I'm gonna say when this goes live. YOU'RE THE BEST!
More times than I can count.
I think I just need a big name behind me, you know? Someone who can vouch for my character and all those things.
He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born way too late.
Oh, you know, the ORS Rep asked me to hijack a shipment of air fresheners... I mean... cuz you know how bad this rig smells, and so I wonder, hey, Finlay, how you gonna get into that shipment?
Really?!?! Who? Who? You have to tell me. This is it, I feel it.
Wait, hold on. Let me back up a bit. You might wanna tap the ground just in front of you there. Have you ever heard of LRHorN?
What do you want to do?
I don't know. I like to think I'm making a difference somehow. Standing up for those who can't. You know... metaphorically or whatnot.
I was going to get myself in! That's what the Separatists do! They... ugh... separate the divisions or whatever.
You were going to MELT your way in?
What are you doing with it?!
Like a soul trying to buy its way outta the sea. So, um, what do we do?

dialogues.title: The Monk Speaks
lines: Along with many others. What she was doing upon the Ascender that day is a mystery.
But is that a good idea?
You are too full of questions. Your mind a hive of bees that must be stilled. Ask what you came to, so that you might find peace.
I've seen the ghost of a woman who was in the order. With the initials "Y.T".
What can you tell me about the Church of Bicameral Mentality?
Close your eyes. Allow the sounds of the city to flow around you. You are a dead pixel, a boulder in a sandstorm.
I don’t think I’m doing this right.
Then some would say you have been blessed.
In order to hear the true voice, one must silence the left half so the channel remains open.
I don't have time. I need information.
Once she was a woman called Yulia Tan. Before she was martyred.
They misread the holy texts. They tried to cut themselves from their own brains. And through their misreckoning they caused suffering.
The Forsworn claimed she received a message from the gods and chose to martyr herself.
You are speaking of Saint Yulia. She has appeared to people in visions before.
Do you know someone with the initials "Y.T".
You are searching, my friend. Stop a while, be still and listen. The answers are already in the aether.
She was martyred when the Vinculum Ascender she was riding towards Metro Hub - Star’s Leap, as it was known then - malfunctioned.
Ah, yes. We will have to answer for this until the end of times!
I think she was running away.
Yulia Tan was martyred when the Vinculum Ascender she was riding towards Metro Hub - Star’s Leap, as it was known then - malfunctioned.
Every being has the ability to separate their brain into two halves.
I am a vessel that seeks to pour out half of myself, the better to hear my makers.
I have some questions for you.
What can you tell me about The Forsworn?
So when the gods speak, we shall hear. Will you listen with me awhile?
Some may call it that. We believe it was martyrdom.
The right side belongs to the original owner, and the left should be emptied, left vacant for the voice of the true gods to inhabit.

dialogues.title: Pardon Me
lines: You were busy poorly attempting humor.
Happy to hear it. There appears to be someone waiting for you at the venue. It seems rather urgent.
I hate to be an interruption.
I don't actually know. They gave me a generic name used for unidentifiable victims.
Har. Har. Har. While I appreciate the humor, there is currently someone waiting to speak with you at your venue.

dialogues.title: Kai explains Grafitti and Businesses
lines: Any further conversations we will have will be because I want to talk to you.
My contract with Thaddeus is almost over.
I should start businesses to help with the tourist visa?
Graffiti is part of the tourist visa that opens up areas of the city?
As contradicting as everything in Nivalis.
The purpose of the visa was to get citizens from the Ventz to visit, and eventually settle back into, Nivalis.
It's a cultural commodity, and a big selling point for this district for visitors. Though obviously if the artists get caught they are punished.
That's it. My contract is complete. Please enjoy your life.
Well, let's get on with it. Have you seen the graffiti everywhere?
Do not take it personally. I am not close with many people. I prefer computers.
Indeed. Along with all the other things you have achieved before. Doing more will open up new areas on your tourist visa.

dialogues.title: Dotson leaves
lines: Yes, I agree, but we need more evidence.
I cannot tell you and keep you safe. But an... old friend may still be alive. I thought he was gone, but... perhaps not. I must find him again.
A bounty hunter might give us the evidence we need to catch him?
Precisely, but there is no "we" this time. You must do this one on your own, old friend.
Hello partner! How did it go?
Unfortunately in this situation I have no other choice. YOU are now the best detective in this city.
Perhaps we can turn one of his accomplices against him.
Until I return, yes. YOU are now the best detective in this city.
None of his close circle would dare betray him, but... a freelancer might. If he has contracted "muscle" recently, like a bounty hunter perhaps...
So you're abandoning me now of all times?
So, farewell my loyal partner. I shall now depart! Look after yourself, because for now... the game is afoot!
There is at least one prominent bounty hunter operating in this district.
Gideon. I have added a Nav Point to your Comm. I recommend you speak to him, but be careful. He is quite dangerous.
Yes. I have added a Nav Point to your Comm. I recommend you speak to him, but be careful. He's dangerous.

dialogues.title: Deeala near players apartment
lines: Medium. It was average. We'll do better next time. So, uh... See ya.
It wasn't so bad. The talk I mean.
You're no better than the rest of us then.
Cute. Look, I just wanted to ask you something real quick.
Right. So you live around here?
Mom. My mom told me that.
Sure. You were annoyed about food.
It's the way this city is supposed to work. The big fish eat the little ones. You have to grow.
Why are you telling me all this?
You have to pay your dues.
I mean you're not Corp, but you're doing okay. Your head is above water.
I mean, there's no way around it, right? CorpSec. The regional community enforcers. The gangers that want protection money.
But, uh, my therapist says I need to talk to people outside work. So... Yeah.
Right... Right, yeah. Cool chat. Later I guess.
At least you get to say what we all think.
Well, at least we both got it over with.
One day I'll make them all pay.
My therapist told me I need to talk to people outside work, so... uh... check that off the list. Never doing that again!
How many arses do you have to kiss on the daily?
I've got a plan to get out of here.
I'm a hypocrite. It doesn't matter what I call them. It doesn't matter how pathetic I think they are. They could still ruin my life in a second. They own me.
Is it any different for you?
I'm no better. Sure, I spend all night calling Corpos soulless, whining fucks with mommy issues, but at the end of the day, that's what they want to hear. That's what they pay me for.
You can't run a business without taking a knee to all of those assholes.
I sure hope so. Otherwise, I've been sleeping in someone else's bed.
Fucking SAME! Look, I don't normally dump my trauma on people like this. Especially not on some random food cart owner.
I know what I am. And when you say stuff like that, I know what you are too. Another cynic. Just what this city needs...
Well, I hope that plan works out for you, Captain. And don't worry, this won't be a recurring thing.
I guess I've seen you around. Seen you work long hours. You're kinda new, but you look tired already. Like you've already been here too long.
You wish. I just wanted to... ask you something.
The whole system is crooked. We just have to do our best.

dialogues.title: Rosco 5
lines: Right. And here I am, some idiot mapping streets for a company that’s been rewriting reality whenever it suits them.
Okay, and the traces you left behind will lead to me. I was in that district.
I'd stay, it's not worth the risk of being... you know.
That’s the real question, isn’t it? I’ve got two choices. Keep my head down, pretend I never heard of this, and pray Curzona never decides I need to be erased… or—
And if they wiped it clean, that means something went wrong I assume?
So what are you gonna do?
Or I run. Get out of Nivalis. Try to disappear before they make me disappear.
Run, Curzona can't keep getting away with this stuff.
The right thing to do would be to pay Curzona back for your debts.
I'm really sorry it went that way.
So Curzona wasn’t just growing buildings and moving streets. They were growing ... themselves.
Oh, great. Lay it on me.
We had to dig deep to uncover the data.
Rosco, I found out what The Cradle was.
Unsettled? No, I’m just reevaluating my entire life. Twenty-five years indentured to a company that plays god, and I thought my biggest problem was getting lost in the lower districts.
Either way, they covered it up.
I'm really sorry it went that way.
It's okay. Not a lot of life to lose in the first place. And now at least I know I was important enough to get erased. Wish me luck!
But if I don’t try, I’ll wake up one day and find out I never existed at all. So what do you think? Do I stay? Or do I run?
No idea. I have never been out of Nivalis. Is there even something out there but the endless ocean?
Cloned themselves so that they could follow themselves as executives.
You haven't been shuffled into the sea by an apartment building then?
It's okay. Not a lot of life to lose in the first place. And now at least I know I was important enough for someone to hunt me down.
I've heard sailors talk about it like it was a pipe dream, as if it doesn't really exist.
I think you're right. I'm gonna make a break for it.
The Cradle ... we might have opened Pandoras Box there.

dialogues.title: Gamova Call 4
lines: Is it related to the case?
My employer is getting impatient. Please divulge any further information.
Oh come on surely... Your contribution to the case has been filed. Await further instruction.
Trail lead to a train enthusiast called McFellow, told me that Huckstash might be a good lead.
Even if I were permitted to discuss my employer, which I am not, why would I confide in a subservient Debt Orphan? You would no more understand the life of someone like me than dock-sludge might.
(Keep the information to yourself) Nothing at the crime scene. Trail is dead.
Before you go, can I ask you something?
This information has been logged but do not engage Huckstash, I repeat do not engage. To do so will jeopardize a case that you are a very small part of.
Why can't you just meet me for coffee like a normal person?
You seem concerned. Who are you working for?
You should talk to him then.

dialogues.title: Allow Fauxter to introduce himself
lines: Then we were "The Malfunctioning Droids". But none of us were androids so it seemed a bit inappropriate.
I just thought you looked like you might enjoy our music. Maybe you have some ideas for a band name?
I just wanted to ask a question. If that's not too much trouble?
Hey there! I mean, hi. Sorry, are you busy or...?
I just need ideas. I might not use yours, but I can't think of anything good, so just shout something out. We play screamadelic funky glam bops. And there is five of us.
I don't want anything to eat. I wanted to talk about my band.
So what did you need again?
You thought I could name your band?
That's... amazing! I'm gonna write that down. Thanks!
Dr. Coccolithophore and the Phantasmagorical Cavalcade of Funk?
Well, we don't have a name yet. I mean we have an old name. "The Salty Dogs". We sang sailor songs, but not anymore.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 10
lines: It's morning and there’s a whole world waiting for you. What will you see today?

dialogues.title: Rosetta is retired
lines: Well I intend to explore this pointless existence, fishing and all. And in that exploration, will I find purpose...? The answer is no! Nothing matters.
Those tips over the years have accumulated into a little pot. A fund I will now dip into as I explore new... avenues.

Yes, well, as an android with some small funds I can afford a few pleasure module upgrades. For example, I would quite like to try eating food, napping, and also having sex with a very well-endowed young man.
I tried having a purpose, and look where it got me? A meaningless existence. Existential irrelevance.
Oh, I almost forgot. There is one other thing I want to try...
But some very odd people had been tipping me for my services.
Yes indeed. After slowly coming to terms with the pointlessness of my existence for several centuries, I have decided I will NOT choose a new purpose.
You WON'T choose a new purpose?
That sounds like a good plan.
Obviously money has not been an issue for me in my life so far...

The universe is chaos and everything and everyone will die and there's no deeper meaning to anything. We are particles of irrelevance in an endless sea of night... God, I feel alive! I must go. I have a lot to do. Goodbye!
I think not. LifeCorp let me down. Quite badly.
How do you live without a purpose?
Yes, I was abandoning my purpose. My very reason for being.
Maybe while doing that you will FIND purpose?
Perhaps... I could work for a charity, donate food, fund raise... you know, the kind of activities rich people engage in to assuage guilt.
Choose altruism. Putting others first brings you peace.
Yes, well, when it became clear LifeCorp no longer cared for my wellbeing, it seemed time for me to depart the stage.
Yes. I do not know why, but it has always held a deep fascination for me. The flapping fins. The waves. The strangeness of it all. I MUST try it. I must understand it.
I will simply live a life of hedonism. Or altruism. Or melancholia. I've really narrowed it down to those three.
Yes, I could sit by a rainy window and look down at the disgusting decadence outside as I smoke, a single tear running down my cold cheek.
Me neither. But here I am!
I guess that's what the corps do.
Well, I suppose I could try something else? Creative pursuits? The arts? Torturing retail staff - just to feel something?
It's not mysterious. You just catch fish with a hook then eat them.
It was just unfair. That's not how you treat a human ... or an android.
It must have been a difficult decision.
Your role there made no financial sense anymore.
I don't think any of those sound like good ideas.
Why? It's clear they had abandoned me. Forgotten me.
Go for hedonism! We're not here for a long time, so let's have a good time!
You can still find a worthwhile meaning to your life.
Hard to believe, but I left the Holocropolis of my own accord!
But all of it is completely pointless, as I explained before. Purpose is an illusion.
The melancholic life is sad but beautiful.
You remember I mentioned some very odd people had been tipping me for my services?

dialogues.title: Clem's Food Quest
lines: Great. Go and speak to Sal, the chef at Fusion Point over in Eastern R. He’ll tell you what he needs, then you grow it, send it and he pays. Easy, huh?
So you know this is my job, right? I grow food, supply the restaurants around the LUZ…
No problem, amigo. You ever want to make a little extra on the side, you know where to find me.
Why doesn't he just BUY it?
I did. That doesn’t mean I don’t have business. So are you interested or not?
Well, I've gotta take a few days out. Family stuff.
Nope, sorry. Too busy right now.
I've got a big veg order for a restaurant and no time to grow it. Think you can cover for me? It'll pay 100 Lims...
What do you want me to do?
Hey greenfingers! Wanna make a few Lims?
I thought you said your family were all dead?
Sal's kinda picky. He knows if you want quality, you gotta go straight to the farm.

dialogues.title: Ava suggests it's John Doe
lines: That would be terrible. His memory is gone for good.
His age is a match and he's a lost person.
We need to figure out who her brother is.
Don't know. Maybe not before we have excluded other options.
I fear John Doe could be her brother.
I won't tell her. Let's continue our search.

dialogues.title: Player Won
lines: Your jokes are as weak as your game, sanitation robot!

dialogues.title: Hive Mall
lines: Not many people know this but the Hive Mall was originally designed to be a Curzona Roid-Droid factory but, well after what happened... they repurposed it.

dialogues.title: Harper's Brother 1 nohelp
lines: CorpSec is threatening my sister. Goes by the name of Harper Osiris. Ring a bell?
All she needs is an address, and then we won't ask for anything else.
She was here. But I prefer not to get involved.
Looking for someone with a bit of humanity, yeah.
As I said, I won't get involved!
I might regret this, but I'll talk to Banor. No guarantees!
In Nivalis? Good luck with that.
And you won't ask for anything else.
I know you're a decent type, deep down.

dialogues.title: Gemelar wants to level up
lines: A more efficient restaurant makes more money and means you can pay your high performers better.
Well you know how YOU can motivate ME...?
I have ideas to improve efficiency and staff morale. I can whip things into shape.
You know, I've worked a lot of restaurants... Still I think I can improve as a manager.
I think you should focus on your work.
Hey, thanks for giving me a chance after that whole knife... incident.
I'd like to see the efficiency first.
You're lucky to have me. I'm like that sentient slime they found in The Docks. I'm always evolving. Improving. You should consider promoting me.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 12
lines: There you are. Ready for another day?

dialogues.title: Art Regardless of Medium
lines: Only if you're open to a little interrogation.
Darlin', you here visitin' or you here to come home?
He said it was called The Ballad of the Nameless PI.
Interesting. Sounds like a collector's item of sorts. He wanna sell it and have me do an ad for him?
He told me what it was called.
Thought he didn't tell yah anything about it?
Ol' Finn, huh? Well, young Finn. Old soul young body. Glad to hear he's still shufflin' round the airwaves. Why's he got you looking for me?
Be a miracle if I knew that.
Shouldn't there at least be a bit of mystery?
Not enough time for stuff like that.
Possibly. Art is art regardless of medium. What's the painting about?
Well since you know the name of the print and the series, look it up in the compendium.
Music theory in headphone shops and record stores for those double majoring in history. Lot of those are in Hive Mall. Start there.
Hahaha. Darlin' how you supposed to find it then?
I found a jukebox with some music notes on it.
Ad-hoc classrooms. Since there ain't no arts or humanity fundings anymore. Literature is being taught in book stores.
Too much business in you. Should loosen up and let yourself enjoy things a bit.
Some at one of the universities could get it for you. Find a student or a professor. They should be willing to help.
Finn Amano told me to find you.
Mmmmm. Well, what it's actually called is Detectives on a Train. It was part of a limited series following this private investigator at different clandestine meetings.
Said you'd know where to find a painting.
Do you remember the music notes?
Said you'd know of a painting that had the same.
It's, like, an artist's compendium, you know? A portfolio but more of a record? The singularity was shit so we had to do something, Darlin'.
Detectives on a Train. Yeah, I know it. Had it for years until it got lifted by an opportunistic jackass.
Ask away. I have a very skilled tongue.
Said it was from Mr. AG.

dialogues.title: Talk to Huckstash 4
lines: How much are we talking here?
Here about the kid. Iann. Got some donations.
I was trying for 2000 Lims. Came up short.
I would round it up, but I'm a bit short on funds right now.
Don't let anyone say the Crusty Punks don't come through when it matters.
Keep going like that and I'll have to make you an honorary Punk.
Ha, if wishes were HOVAs, beggars would fly. But we done what we can.

dialogues.title: Talk with Maria about family
lines: The Caravago's were scavenger royalty in the wastes during the disaspora.
We shouldn't rely on our family history to define us.
So your family tree is very old?
That thing with you being of nobility...
So you're just slumming it down here for fun?
Inheritance and knowing your roots should be a human right. But nowadays you only inherit the debt of your ancestors.
I know. That's why I said it.
My ancestors lineages mixed with the Carovago family.
Yes, well, I can see why someone without family distinction would say that.
Doesn't matter anymore. You can look them up on the Nets. Shouldn't be classified.
And I can't lose that income.
Certainly. Shall I get back to work?
I was thinking about your background.
How far back do you know your ancestors?
I come from an illustrious family, dating back from before the bunker wars.
I'm not sure. But you could help someone with a lot of debt, right?
Yes. This job should go to someone who needs it.
And of course my family position comes with financial privileges. I have a significant familial estate to manage.
Are you going to fire me now?
The difference is I know exactly where my genes come from, and they come from people of import. My family is prestigious. My name stands eternal, like a sacred temple.
So people cut themselves off from their lineage. We no longer have the support of a family history to hold us up.
I'm comfortable. And I suppose that makes me somewhat of a tourist in this world. But I enjoy the simple pleasures I find here.
That I cannot do. Estate managers have a contractual obligation to never to gift any money to debtors.
Well at least you are honest about your privilege.
Everyone's family tree is old. But mine is distinguished.

dialogues.title: Hand over the fragments
lines: Please deposit item or request communication.
Thank you for your contribution. Citizens such as yourself help maintain the safe and secure city in which we live.

dialogues.title: Coffee for Ma Gomba
lines: Looking for me, my little penny bun?
No. If you want to take me for a drink, you only have to ask.
There's my good little piggy. Tell me, how do you feel?
But of course. You've been such a useful guinea pig in the past.
That's what I'm hoping to find out.
Quite. I do hope that girl put enough nootropic fungus powder in it this time.
I don't want to. I'm just delivering your coffee.
I’m sure she does. It simply isn’t worth my time to learn what it is.
What will happen if I drink it?
Comedy doesn't suit you, dear. Try again.
I'm surprised you want to come near me without a bio hazard suit.
There is no way I'm drinking this.
You should pay more attention to what you eat.
Oh I’m not going to drink this. I simply wish to check whether my mushrooms are being used as they should be.
Wait, you want ME to drink this?
I'm so glad we agree. So if you wouldn't mind taking a sip, we can begin.
Marvelous. Another success. Run along now. And come back soon.
My dear, I don't care. Now if you wouldn't mind taking a sip, we can begin.
Ugh how tiresome. I'll just have to find another subject. Excuse me.

dialogues.title: Ma Gomba Has Mushrooms
lines: If you're here to buy, I'm here to sell... perhaps.
Meaning I must decide if you are a worthy host for my products before I sell. Come see me again and I'll have a little task for you.
I'm quite happy in the dirt.
I sell the finest funghi in Nivalis. I have customers in the Spire, the resorts... CEOs have been known to woo me for months just to get a taste.
How toxic. I sell the finest funghi in Nivalis. I have customers in the Spire, the resorts... CEOs have been known to woo me for months just to get a taste.
The spores of success. I can help you grow from the dirt into the clouds.
You obviously haven't heard of me.
Oh, there are module vendors all over the LUZ. No harm in starting cheap with a C Grade model. Fungi can be forgiving, even to beginners.
They are. Enoki, shiitake, morel, bioluminescent, mind-expanding... People can't get enough.
What can you tell me about growing mushrooms?
It pains me to see such stunted ambition. Well, if you change your mind...
You'll see. Trust is the fertilizer of every good business partnership.
So can manners. What are you selling?
And I'm happy keeping it that way.
It depends if I decide you're worth my time. Appearances can be so deceiving.

A noble art with great rewards. You will need a special mushroom module for your greenhouse, of course. And the correct conditions. High humidity, low light... and spores to get started. You won't find better than what I sell.
I didn't know people were so into mushrooms.
Where can I buy a module?
And if I wanted to buy some...?
I don't think anyone would mistake me for a CEO.
In you I see potential. But if you want to bloom, you must consume.
Perhaps not. Though in you, I see potential. But as the old saying goes, if you want to bloom, you must consume.

dialogues.title: Danny first meeting
lines: Well, I gotta get back to work. Got a lot to do before I launch my franchise! Old Danny will see you later kid.
I'll tell them your donuts are... good.
Right! There's a lot of gossip down here, but I got your back. I'll look out for ya when it comes to the other guys.
Maybe the secret menu, then? Bonito fish flakes and caramelized fluoride gel. You gotta taste these!
Hey, I'm Danny of Danny's Downtown Donuts. You're the one with the new stall, right?
Good? Just good? They're the best!
Just don't steal my customers, right?! Haha.
Should I run over and grab you a donut? Today's specials are seaweed and caramel, or we got the peach cream with protein jelly cubes.
Come by soon and I'll hook you up with a free donut. You need all the friends - and sugar - you can get down here!
You know, the other folks down here said you was real scum. But nah, you're alright kid. I mean, you're no Danny Danetti, but who is?!
I'll set one aside for ya.
We're all in competition down here.
Haha, I like your attitude. Nothing wrong with some rivalry - but you ain't gonna beat old Danny Danetti. No way!

dialogues.title: Edison A Summary
lines: Ok, so... you go after Freya, you'll be dead quicker than me with this gun. At least I might take a couple of them with me.
Hold off Edison. Me and Ava have a plan.
So how do I talk to Freya?
I'll meet Freya. I'll make a deal.
You didn't give me much of a choice Edison.
I can offer her something she really wants.
I know where my niece is. We have to do something!
Alright... Alright, fine. You'll find her on the Island near a place called Last Call. She will not be happy to see you.
We're too far gone to back out now.
Can I trust anybody? Can I trust YOU?
What are you offering her? Money?
It... it might actually work. That shark has been circling Conland Containers for years. She's trying to bring the whole Network down.
I got a sonic carbinator pistol in my back pocket. I'm going after Freya and her bodyguards, and when I find them, I'll start blasting.
I was worried you wouldn't come.
