She's on Calypso. Off on some digital detox Automata Absence challenge. Trying to realign with the island or something like that. She does it once or twice a year.
Edison, let me do this. Trust me!
No. Conland Containers is more than just her. The real masterminds of The Network are monsters living in the Spire. I'll kill her, then keep going till I get them too.
Anything I need to know before I meet her?
One of Freya Portlet's assistants let slip. She was a Gen Debtor we freed eight years ago.
Something more valuable. If this works out, we ALL get out of this.
Appreciate it. There's been a lot going on... I'm pretty sure I'm in over my head.
You have to play this smart.
You'd be throwing your life away.
I'm doing it, and you're gonna owe me.
No. No... You can't do it. You can't risk your life for me. It's too dangerous.
Hey friend, thanks for meeting me. I'm kinda at the end of my rope here. You're all I got.

dialogues.title: Thanks for the Food
lines: Guess that means you can go home!
I'm going to try and lay the rest of these cables while you go and see my girl Harmony. She can usually get her hands on anything.
It's what I get for using a discount delivery service.
You need someone to get one for you?
I'm down to the last two relays and come to find out one's busted worse than a self-driving HOVA powered with a narcissistic suicidal AI.
An endless amount. No, it's not really. I got a few more relays to install but I'm short one. Damn thing broke during transport.
Well I saw it on the news feeds so they're reporting it. Doesn't mean it's actually happening just that it's being reported.
You need me to get one of the relays for you?
Legal? Did you just fall off the habanero HOVA? The employers make the law, we just sign at the bottom.
They're version 2.1 and only a limited number were produced. See this diode? It's actually a bone needle meant to attract audio waves.
Well, well, got something for me? Half thought you were gonna take those Lims and run. Wouldn't be surprised. Probably woulda done it myself.
If I got a Lim for every time I heard that ...
This entire conversation is kind of a mouthful.
Ha. Like it actually matters. But that's a convo for another time. Right now I gotta figure out how to get this done with the mess they left me.
Oh, so I'm helping you now?
Don't need a night of "Level Up!" to figure out things are whacked right now.
What are you going to do?
There's more to life than work.
First, not supposed to leave an active job site, what with all the bullshit going on with lockdowns and unity zones and people stabbing each other and junk.
Yeah. Bone is a natural conductor. Should see some of the shamans in the wastes when they start ringing bowls with bleached femurs.
Like is a strong word. Puts food on the table or, you know, in the container you just gave me.
How much more do you have to do?
Ha! I could go home. Then again, if I did, my door'd be gettin' knocked on and I'd be dragged right back out here to finish the gig. Only, I wouldn't be getting paid anymore.
Look at that goodness. See, all it takes is a little food and moods change, exhaustion lifts and work goes on.
She can get her hands on bone?
Now there's a culinary scent worth carrying. Got my stomach growling louder than the voices these wires used to carry.
Oh, so don't go home then.
People are stabbing one another now?
Gee, thank you for that crack advice. You should host a talk show: Things you should and shouldn't do this side of the obvious.
Unfortunately, there are two major problems with that.
There in lies the major issue: you can't get these right now.

dialogues.title: Raluca paid a shitload (Raluca known)
lines: He's one of my restaurant managers.
That's bad news... Unless you're paying Spire-level wages?
I hope his parents are wealthy.
Took a while before a trader sourced it from the Spire for a 100 grand. Vik Ryan smuggled it down.
Fine. Even on the black market, this thing costs a small fortune.
Just for a moment, then I'm gone.
I know a boy. A child. He's an oxyphile like you and needs a mask.
How much did you pay for the mask and where did you get it?

Who knows how Ryan got it? Probably pulled it off a body. Best not to know. But you should ask him. He's a black market trader, but you'll have to find him yourself. He's elusive. That's all I got for ya.
One counts as charity for a dying boy.

dialogues.title: Get Recipe from Nola Berg
lines: I'm trying to change that. But I need more recipes.
You mean Thaddeus is gone? Ha! That's the best news I've had all day.
I'd hardly call it help, but yeah, sure. Don't think you'll be putting me out of business anytime soon.
So... do you have any tips?
Hello there, haven't seen you before.
He always acted like he was so much better than the rest of us. Even though that crummy bar of his never made a Lim.
Bit of banter never goes amiss. Warm people up first.
I just took over the Noodle Bar.
Ha! I like your grit. You'll do ok.
Alright alright, no need to be a kiss-ass. Normally I'd say no, but since you're new, I'll do you a favor this once.
You're like a dog with a bone aren't you? Normally I'd say no, but since you're new, I'll do you a favor this once.
I can tell you're a rookie or you wouldn't just ask like that. We're in competition, after all.
I don't have time for that.
Don't let CorpSec hear you say that.

dialogues.title: Confronting Razlo
lines: Well this has been very cute, but mind how you go, "detective." Stay safe now.
What do you want? Is this still about donuts?
Dotson thinks you are a criminal genius.
Yes. I am clearly a hardened criminal with an evil empire at my fingertips. I simply cannot believe you caught me. How did you figure it out?
And yet, you were willing to do business with me. Which makes you, what's the word? An "accomplice". Stay safe, "detective".
I've got my eye on you, Razlo.
Dotson is a mad old droid, and no one will ever listen to him. No one but you, and you hardly seem like a threat.
Oh what does it matter? Admit it? Deny it? It makes no difference either way.
I promise you, I am a threat.
I know what you really are.
I have a bad feeling about this. We should get back to Dotson.

dialogues.title: Gideon needs a favor
lines: I know you work for him.
What will you do with her?
I'm looking for someone. A girl that goes by the name "Mila." Anyone with a real fancy Automata might have the resources to find her...
I have a match on a young woman named "Mila". We could find her for him... or warn her.
Brains, yes. I know him. Why?
I could make it worth your while.
It's real sweet of you to appeal to my better nature, but I don't believe in wasting anyone's time. Altruism doesn't fit me kid. Try again.
Warning: If Gideon asks you to help him, I predict it is highly likely someone else will suffer.
I'm not interested in being owed. I need a favor done first.
Just talk. Here's the deal: you help me find Mila and I'll help you with Razlo. Take it or leave it. Now get going. I got nothing else to say.
I wouldn't be much of a bounty hunter if I didn't develop a sense for who can and who can't afford me, and you, my friend, cannot afford me. Try again
I would owe you a favor if you helped me.
You have a look in your eye. Like you're hiding something.
The kid with the hair that looks like brains?
He's dangerous. He's a threat to innocent people. Help me stop him.
I work for a lot of people, and most of them want me to respect their privacy. I'm giving you nothing.

dialogues.title: Black market Drugs
lines: Doesn't matter. I just need some BioX-50.
Sage Hullen. She said you had BioX-50.
But yours do take. Which means you have BioX-50.
Do you have some or not?
You think I got clag for brains? 500.
I'm looking for something to help with augment infections...
You sell augments right? So what happens when they go wrong?
Say I did have some, from my own personal supply. What would it be worth?
I’ll think on that. But if you swear, you swear in blood. We got a deal?
Now you’re really pissing me off. 350. And you do a favor for me. Or the deal’s off.
Not my problem if an aug doesn't take.
Dr Fred? Listen, if that Spire-born do-gooder has a problem, she can drag her ass here and talk to me herself.
350 Lims. And a favor. Or no deal.
What do I look like, a clinic? Beat it.
Stupid kid. Here, take the stuff. And don’t go blabbing where you got it.
Back again are ya? Thought anymore about that firmware?
And I ain’t got the patience for elliptical repartee. Spit out or get out.
You don’t wanna listen to Sage. She talks. Says all kinda things that ain't true.

dialogues.title: Now Will You Tell Me
lines: You mentioned the most valuable item in Nivalis... What is it?
And now I know I can trust you to help us. We're going to sting the ones that have ruined this city. Sting them and watch as they fall.
Ah, the one thing they try and fail to contain. Whether through Unity Zones or Comms disruptions, we still get them through.
Ideas, my new friend. Ideas for change and freedom. Siloed they are weak.
Get what through? What are they?
I lost you shortly after "fail to contain".
But when we filter them through and connect those that have them to each other, well... that's how we start revolutions.
I suppose you've earned that. I'm listening.
I want to know one thing.
You may have more venom in you than you first believed.
It's expensive to fly this far under the radar. Unfortunately, Mizzy lost money that was needed for something greater than herself.

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: Well yes but I've also got into Chess. Fancy a game?
Hey, you know how I've been passing the time now we're stuck in the LUZ?

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Fourth Meeting
lines: I’m going to have to move to a different district when they lift the LUZ. Maybe change my name. Grow horns and just commit to the bit.
Mooing? Like a cow sound? I don't think so...
Someone please remind him he's got a sister. And she's human again.
By the way, did you meet my brother?
Apparently, and this is just what I heard, I tried to organize a "Cow Choir." Like, I got a bunch of people to stand in a circle and moo in harmony.
Sounds like you're really MILKING it.
Sounds like the safest way to avoid CorpSec attention...
I really need him. If he contacts you again, please tell him where I live.
You gotta watch your doses with edibles.
Oh good! You must have spoken to me before it all started getting crazy.
Dead serious. I even gave a speech about "bovine unity."
You really should be more careful!
Hey, when we spoke last time, was I being weird?
No, no, it gets worse. Supposedly, I crowned a milk carton "King of the City" and made everyone bow to it. Someone took a video. It's... circulating.
Yeah, but I have a bad feeling he was observed. I didn't give him your address.
Meanwhile, can you maybe look out for my brother? You gave him the address, right?
No more than anyone else in this city.
What happened? You said you'd taken something?
One guy said I had "soulful mooing." Whatever that means. I've never even seen a cow.
Well that's pretty much it. I have been feeling a little... stressed recently, and Ma Gomba offered me some edibles. When you met me, was I... mooing?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 22
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Able to breathe? Do it. Able to sleep? Do that too!

dialogues.title: Return to Ma Gomba
lines: Maybe not. But if I succeed, you succeed...
What a shame you see it that way.
I don't HAVE to do anything, chicken. But in the spirit of mutual growth I'll give you some spores. Better than Lims.
Keep your spores. I don't appreciate being cheated.
I grew them. You have to pay me.
Oh, yes. My little wager. I had quite forgotten. They were distinctly average. Just what I wanted.
You're learning. Very well. In the spirit of mutual growth I'll give you some spores. Better than Lims.

dialogues.title: Hep is retired
lines: There. Now there's no need for things to get messy. I'm going to take a little rest now. Retirement is busier than I thought. Have a nice day.
What a lovely place this is. So many pretty flowers. So many people lying on the sand with their femoral arteries exposed.
Yes. It was a wrench to leave my garden. But the man said it would be for the best.
Oh, well I'm not sure what I know, dear. So many faces. So much blood.
There are people who'd like to kill you for what you know.
That's rather unkind, dear. Perhaps you should take it back.
Do you ever worry that you're a psychopath?
Well, you go ahead. But be careful on the paths when you leave. I'd hate for you to fall and impale yourself. So many accidents...
Why, no! Sociopathic tendencies are what made my career. I was terribly lucky to find a job that I loved. It hardly seemed like work at all.
Perhaps I should tell the people looking for you where you are.
It's funny, people do seem to drop dead right in front of me. The other day, I was having a lovely chat with a bartender until he broke his own neck.

dialogues.title: Harmony Player Won
lines: It's nice to meet someone who knows their way around the squares. We should play again sometime.
Well you were much better than I expected.

dialogues.title: Third meeting with Noe
lines: Since you were such a good student last time, I’ll be teacher again. What’s it to be? Fiendishly tricky or nice and easy?
Ugh no! Have you seen the fashions up there? All that chrome and grey. I’d wither like a radium rose.
Like the rest of the world. Go on then, run along.
Do you have any more recipes?
I’d give my best pair of vintage Dercloud heels for one more night with my old friends.
You asked for it, Icarus. I’ll give you… the Ikasumi. The ingredients are special: Gin, Dry Vermouth, Squid Ink and Olives.
My dear Icarus. How are those wings?
You should be able to handle a Nivalis Sunset. The ingredients are rum, tequila, mango, peach and oranges. A slice of paradise.
A small part of the Lily lives on. I'm so glad. I only wish I could go back there.
No, Nivalis is my home. She always will be. Now, how do you feel about reviving another recipe?
I’m toying with the idea of becoming an elegant ghost.
Have you thought anymore about what you’ll do now?
I have the Ultra 64 ingredients for you.
Nostalgia paints the past in brighter colors.
Hello darling. How’s that strut coming along?
I have obtained the Strawberry Stinger ingredients.

dialogues.title: Fauxter needs lyrical assistance
lines: I don't know! I am not exactly thinking clearly right now.
And now it's time for dumplings.
Oh, you're not just helping, you're a songwriter now! Or a lyricist at least. I'll make sure you get credit. LET'S GOOOOO!!!
Alright, safe but I like it.
Profits? Haha. Sure. As soon as the profits come flooding in, I will let you know.
Ouuhh. That's nice. Shows some resilience, but with some vulnerability too.
Sure! I liked your suggestion but we changed it a few times. Now we're "The Lunchable Bunchable".
Ok, well I actually have something I'm working on already and I just need to pull it all together. I've written some lyrics but... they're not soulful enough. How are you with a rhyming couplet?
Hey... I should use these feelings! I need some melancholy lyrics for our song "Synthetic House Music Blues." Want to help?
Ugh. I am. I'm starting to think we're not all so connected anymore. I think we're all separate and alone and we're probably all gonna die like... like REALLY soon. Aren't we?
Hmm. Good question. What IS the song called?
A bit dark. But so soulful!
I'm not sure I'm very good at this...
Did you find a name for your band?
We got this! Let's finish strong. Final line is: "Sweet girl, let me tell you one more thing."
Hey, it's you! I think it's you. I can't really tell you all apart right now.
"Pieces of me still sewn into you."
Yeah, thanks. Everybody seems to like it. So... I don't think we'll ever change it again.
"I never wanted you, I want a dumpling."
Uh... I... guess we could say that.
"Give my heart one more chance to sing."
I go call the band and tell them we're not done for the day! We gotta lay this down. Hey, thanks for the help. I mean it. Let's GOOOOOO!!!
My bandmates don't believe me either. But I think the Localized Unity Zone is here for us all. Not the one that CorpSec imposed. REAL unity! We're all joining into one super-organism.
"Shards of love cut through the air."

Ok, here's the first line:
"You broke my heart, now I just don't care."
So can I get some of the profits from streaming to the Feeds?
Hey, thanks for your honesty. That's... very clear.
"My love can endure the beating you bring."
Oh come on! You can't say... well actually... That kinda works.
Ouuhh. We could do that, yeah.

Nah. I was just jamming with my band and the vibrations we were making with the universe were really melting away the margins of my reality. Kinda like that "Level Up!" tech. Learning new things and all.
Give me your rhyming couplet and I'll... double it.
People. You all kinda blur together. I think we're all reverting back into the energy field that connects us and binds us together. We're all becoming one.

dialogues.title: Found Hanz's Necklace
lines: I need that jewelry. Did you find it?
If I ordered a truck load of idiots and got just you, I would have gotten my monies worth!
No. I think it's gone forever.
If I find out you pawned it, I'll make your life miserable. More miserable.
What? Oh yes. Here, 50 Lims for your trouble.
I'll tell everyone you don't honour your deals. And post bad reviews of your hotel on the Nets.
You'll take it and be grateful.
Thank CORA for that. The guest expected results, and I enjoy delivering good news.
Ugh, fine. I’ll see what I can do to boost the popularity of your… establishments. You can expect a 5 point boost. A word in the right ear can work wonders. Goodbye.

dialogues.title: Ava about Gan Coilson
lines: Several prominent scientific journals mention him.
So there's no way to overwrite those memories?
He really was the brilliant engineer - minus the ethics - that he claimed to be. Back when he was human.
And we don't even have a motive for why they would manipulate you.
Probably. Let's look into other leads.
So is he the vacuum cleaner of Death?
I hope you didn't leave traces.
Yes. Or just... skeptical. But at least now we know for sure.
I did some research on The Old Network. Remnants of it can still be accessed, and a small number of clever hackers still know how to use it.
So... I look pretty stupid now.
It's all encoded and packed by several blackbox algorithms, checksummed and constantly monitored by LifeCorp.
I was careful. I didn't go straight for LifeCorp access. Instead, I searched for Gan Coilson records.
Right. I would say we hit a dead end with that theory.
There's no reasonable way this could be manipulated. Not with today's technology. My memory could NOT be tampered with.
He designed the neural network that stores our memories.

dialogues.title: Second Meet with Zaffer
lines: We met the other day? Screw the corps?
Don't let the bastards grind you down.
Right! So how about I come round yours some time, zaff your gaff?
I like my neon how it is.
Yours isn't so bad either. Come round anytime.
Zaffed all the LUZ signs to say LOCAL NUDITY ZONE. Corpsters been running around after bare butts all morning.
Isn't that a bit childish when there's a killer on the loose?
For you, I'd zaff gratis. I like your face.
Yeah, well, I wouldn't expect a Corpo like you to understand art.
Sorry. Just got a lot on my mind.
That sounds kinda cool. How much?
You got the wrong bod, mate.
Haha, oh yeah! Sorry about that, got the 'Sec on my heels.
The sign at your bar. I could work my magic on it, gonzo your neon.
Yeah? So how about I come round yours some time, zaff your gaff?

dialogues.title: Band Member 2 - The Singer
lines: …New, huh? No forced reunion, no ghosts of what we used to be? Just music?
Yeah? Well, I’ll believe that when I see him sober enough to say it himself.
Then make something new. No past, no pressure.
Judge said the real punishment for me was to remain free, unable to perform Jazz.
Maybe you could just voice some tracks?
Fauxter sent me. He wants to get the old band back together.
That’s a dangerous offer to make a singer, kid. But you know what? I’ll bite. If Fauxter’s serious, tell him I’ll lend my voice. Something new. Not a revival—just… a beginning.
He says it won’t be the same without you.
He’ll be happy to hear that.
Fauxter’s still chasing nostalgia, huh? Look, kid, that band had its time. We played our hearts out, burned bright, and burned out. I’m not interested in reliving the past.
Or I could go to Luna and croon for rich CEO's. Uh...
Do you sing anything else but jazz?
Me! How come you're not in jail?
I've tried to sing in other genres, but my heart just doesn't beat to disco or pop or opera. Or... sea shanties.
I've tried to sing in other genres, but my heart just doesn't beat to disco or pop or opera. Or... sea shanties.
You’re a legend. Why let it end like this?
That’s sweet, but sentiment doesn’t change the past. Some things don’t come back, no matter how much you want them to.
A legend? That’s just a fancy way of saying I got old. The music never leaves you, but the stage… that’s a different story.

dialogues.title: Milo asks you to sabotage a rival
lines: I want them to let me do my work. I want to buy them out.
I see where this is going ...
What kind of answer is that?
That's good enough. Or I am desperate enough.
I have tried to purchase their properties with the discretionary funds allowed by the Nivalis Seismology Institute.
Well, these business are obviously far too successful to accept my lowball offers.
I'm a Municipal Seismologist. I use sonar to detect movements in the various strata of the city.
Yes, yes, whatever. Talking actually makes it harder for me to work, so...
There are various businesses that have been somewhat... intransigent when it comes to my seismology.
What have I got to do with all of this??
If I don't find some sort of buried treasure, they'll be paid off in five more generations.
Nola Berg. She has been most intransigent when approached on seismology issues.
Wait! I do need you for something. You're a business owner, right?
I need to scan that spot right there.
I got that part. But why?
Nivalis is built on top of every other city that has existed on this spot. And that creates a lot of opportunity for... instability.
In Nivalis, the older the technology looks - if it's still working - the more valuable. This thing is an antique, but my dad had a saying. "Old things know how to find old things."
I don't think I'm the right person to help you.
What do you want from them?
Do you know how many layers of civilizations lay under your feet?
I’d love to get down there and take a look, but, alas, I’m paid to use my ears, not my eyes.
Capital! I'll send you the addresses of a target you can sabotage. For seismology!
They value their businesses too highly. People are ALWAYS getting in the way.
I inherited this seismograph and the rest of my tools from my father... along with the debt associated with them.
Yes, well, if you think of a better plan, please do let me know. But for now I need you to go sabotage one of these businesses.
I can be ruthless and put these people out of business. I can beat them all. Seismology needs me! And I will heed the call. Will you?
Well... I gave it a shot. See you around... if the whole city doesn't collapse into the ocean first.
You want to buy them so you can... do more seismology?
What are you working on there?
Hello. Could you please step aside?
Look, I know all these business types are competing, and I'm the small fish in the big pond... but I can do this.
If their bottom line was suffering a little, they might be more amenable to selling up and moving on.
I’ve been tracking this disturbance for weeks now, and all I can do is report my findings back to HQ.
And you want me to help... how?
And you're not above some... industrial sabotage?
Isn't there a less nefarious way to get access?

dialogues.title: Hire Maria
lines: Sure, we could always use the help!
All I'm saying is, I'm not above having a job here. Are you hiring?
I'm not above it you know? Sure my family are descendants of royalty, but cleaning work is noble too. I'll do it. Don't think I won't.

dialogues.title: Ceres contributes
lines: If this is about your husband...
I joined this Nets forum, Spire-2-Sewer, and let me tell you, my love life is through the roof.
Oh no, no. I've just come to donate 500 Lims for the Iann boy.
Oh, I just love the taste of greasy food and cheap drinks. It gets me off.
Oh, it's pocket change for me. We are among the wealthiest 12% in this district you know. I could live up there, if I wanted.
Well, my Gan was a rather big cheese, when he was in his human form.
Mostly "vrouuummmm". Don't worry, I keep him busy.
Oh, don't ask me to explain what he did. Something in management, top tier. CEO class. Very respectable.
So why don't you move to the Spire?
What does Gan have to say about all this?
Everyone has their kink. Mine seems to be the whole Lowtown vibe. Who would have thought?

dialogues.title: Mobsters want protection money
lines: We should stand up to them.
That's what I think too. But what if we... nah. Forget it. Let's just pay them.
We could recruit a friendly face to get them onside with a kind word in their ear. Or we could try to obtain legal protection through the official channels - CorpSec.
Though the moral high ground might not be as effective as going low - and getting some more unsavory allies of our own.
It's risky... Really risky. But if Gideon was on your side, you'd have no problems with criminals. You'd have no problem with anyone.
I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope the authorities are the key to success.
We need protection from these criminals through official channels.
Easier said than done. And it's not even easy to SAY. If they heard us talk like this, they'd review bomb the place.
Well they were large and insistent. Rough looking fellas. Floss their teeth with nails. That type. They run a securities business.

The local CorpSec representative is Agent Teleshko, but his intransigence suggests he wouldn't be the best source of help. Instead, we could ask someone with CorpSec connections. My sources say Hanz Grundown might have such connections.
What if we tried to get some help form our friends instead?
What were you going to say?
I'm not sure... Tell me about the official channels.
It's a protection racket for sure. We just need to consider how we handle it. They have muscle and we have... cheap mayo and a leaky roof.
We need to raise some petty cash boss. For... miscellaneous expenses. For the two gents who came in yesterday.
I mean the Old Man never paid protection money. He always had schemes to get out of paying. Do you have any... schemes?
I have identified three possible options you could pursue to avoid paying the mobsters. There are three individuals who could help you.
I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope friendship is the key to success.
I have some suggestions on how you may avoid paying these unsavory gents.
Maybe, but what about the less... savory option?
The cheery donut salesman Danny Danetti has no doubt dealt with such criminals before. He seems willing to help anyone who deals honestly with him, even if they are a rival.
How do we get out of paying?
I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope ruthlessness is the key to success.
Let's keep it friendly and we can try to win them over.
Ok, how much do they want?
We need to get our hands DIRTY.
Well... look into it. If we need to pay, we need to pay. But I'm sure you could come up with something.

dialogues.title: Salt Pete at the book fair
lines: If by chance you run into one: I pay good money. Well, see ya!
Oh, no one really knows. It was very hot though. You can tell by the ruins left behind. And the name, obviously.
When seafaring was popular and profitable, they used the log book to document the journeys.

dialogues.title: Reporters are Trash
lines: Didn't mean to what? Degrade what I chose to do for work? How I make a living? If that's your thing then you and Deeala would be best friends.
If I didn't have a match tomorrow, I would. Why don't you come down to the Marrow and square up with me before the game? Would love to get the blood flowing beforehand.
Yeah, gotta play the hands we're dealt, right? Look, I gotta run. You should grab tickets for the match tomorrow night. It's a fun time.

The Battlefield Bits and the Neural Hornets. Whoever wins plays the Kettle Chaos Club tomorrow. That's the team I roll for. Course, there will be a couple of people rolling tomorrow... rolling to the med bus when I get done with 'em.
I'll tell you one thing, people like you make me want to say "to the sea!" with all of it, and go join the Crusty Punks.
Course, can't really call when the Comms don't work. Hell with 'em anyway. They can drink waste water for all I care.
Sure. It's listed in the Holocropolis along with a date of birth and a date of death.
Brutal sport. How'd you start playing?
I swear I don't work for a Feed. Was just curious.
Like I said: Hover Derby is the best sport around. If you're strong enough to compete in it. I gotta run, but you should come to the match tomorrow night. Going to be a good one.
Don't judge me. You would be too if you had reporters and Loudcasters chasing you down to make money off the shit you say.
But don't corps sponsor the teams?
You're right, I did. You should come to the match tomorrow night. We can finish talking then. Blood stains aren't easy to wash out, so dress accordingly.
There's a story behind these tattoos. Not so much battle scars but victory markings. One of a kind.
No shit. Catch a break from the garbage and come to the match tomorrow. You'll probably enjoy it.
Seriously? You're actually being serious right now? I have debt to pay and you're going to stand here and look down on me for it?
You think I don't know that? You think I don't burn inside when I look at the logo? Thing is, you can't eat hate. Think that makes me a sellout?
Well, let me emphasize the fact that I had some absolutely all-consuming anger. Turns out hover derby is a good outlet for blood boiling rage.
You from one of those gossip Feeds? Trying to get some sensational story bit so you can peddle adverts? Here, let me suggest one: "subtle reporter gets unsubtly punched in the throat."
I work at a restaurant. Noodles and stuff.
Take a swing. See how that ends.
Woah, hold on! I'm sorry. I didn't mean to—
Yeah, I play for my corporate captors whatever. What do you do that's so much better?
Whatever. If you must know, I started playing after I got canned from the InfoLex call center. Access cut without so much as a courtesy call!
Let's just say the crimson color is unique. You won't find it ever again.
Same game different pieces. Look, I'm sorry I snapped at you. First the LUZ, then the Comms being down... I don't know.
What's up? If you're looking for tickets to the Hover Derby match, you can get them at the tunnel kiosk. Grab a Roxi Fynx jersey while you're there and I'll sign it for you.
There's some weird stuff going on.
Wouldn't even know what I'm watching.
I think it makes you opportunistic.
Why do you have hashtag tattoos?
Yeah, get to running. If you find the guts to strap on a pair of hover clamps, meet me in the tunnels. Blood stains aren't easy to wash out, so dress accordingly.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus birthday party with Banor
lines: Remind me what you're talking about.
Ah, great you showed up. We thought you had forgotten!
He sure did. And plenty of stories too. We all do.
Thing is, on his birthday Thaddeus never wanted gifts. Instead, he gave everyone a bonus. Probably why his birthday was so popular.
He had a lot of "old times."
The old crew always dropped by on his birthday, back when he still owned the joint.

dialogues.title: Round Two - Dotson
lines: Chess is a game of calculation. Of anticipation. Of perception and cunning wits. The perfect activity for a detective.
Oh my oh my oh my how wrong you are my over eager beaver.
Set them up so I can knock them down.
Well, well, you've bested the mediocre medic I see!
I didn't know you played chess.

dialogues.title: Well done from Ma Gomba
lines: I see that you're bringing the fruits of your efforts, my little grisette. You have done yourself proud.
Here are the Lims I promised, plus a tip. You've earned it.
Now now, don't spoil my good opinion of you by asking questions. Here are the Lims I promised, plus a tip. You've earned it.

dialogues.title: Definitely Not a Front
lines: Sliced off actually. Knife fight in the Ventz. You know what's funny? It landed on a steam hatch.
Just gonna come right out and ask, huh? Just like that?
Lemme tell you, I got the best stock of firmware and component repair in the LUZ and not nobody knows a damn thing about what they're after.
I need a Logic Relay for a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Hospitality model.
Right, whatever. You actually need something or you just skulking around looking at what I got?
I need a Logic Relay for a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Hospitality model.
Well, so far you're all talk!
It was! Had to stand there watching my own ear cook like I was at a goddam Yakiniku joint.
And you might be a smartass that's actually smart. Why don't you use those brains and figure out what you want or hop on outta here.
That's the most badass thing I ever heard.
Can I help you? No? Then maybe stop staring at my fucking ear.
Yeah. Forget the droid. Save your Lims for a firmware upgrade for your automata instead.
Looks like someone bit it off.
Whatever. The relay's 50 Lims. You want it or not?
Well, praise CORA. Someone who actually knows what they want.
Kid, I know I'm right. You think about that firmware. You know where to find me.
Charity job, huh? Listen those models are done for. LifeCorp ain't supporting them. Better off saving your Lims.

dialogues.title: Gunger is Angry
lines: Don't give me that. You had a choice and you made it. Just glad Thaddeus isn't here to see what you've become.
Just glad Thaddeus isn't here to see what you've become.
Everyone knows what you did... the people you sold out to Mary Nyx, they were my friends. How could you?

dialogues.title: Ava says Salt Pete is calling
lines: Your old friend Salt Pete is trying to contact you.
He knew Thaddeus, so it's possible he is confused. Wait, let me be more clear. It is LIKELY he is confused.
Salt Pete. Despite the LUZ and the Comm lockdown, he keeps sending message requests. They are VERY... persistent.
The message requests fail due to the deactivation of the Grid in this zone, so I don't know. But if you could talk to him, and make them stop, I'd be very grateful.

dialogues.title: Finding Only Eyes
lines: And I won't let them down. This is Ivan McGuire, and you're listening to the shipping forecast. Sponsored by CurzoLive.
This is Ivan Iker McGuire with the shipping forecast from CurzoLive. For tidings you can trust... You are a very fine hallucination. Auditory AND visual.
Go for it! I'll ask Ava to send you the details.
But all I know is the forecast. Paradise Point, east by southeast, falling, falling...
Leave my post? But then who would read the forecast? Shipping would grind to a halt! It would - ChronoTown, north-easterly rising 3 or 4 - be chaos!
Then all the years of loneliness, of feeling my skin eaten away by the winds and rain and birds... it has all been worth it.
So, I... Indigo Shoals, southwest by... I... I've just been talking to myself? For years?
Then what's the point of me? Of - Sunshine beach, north by northwest, rising 3 or 4 - of continuing this miserable existence?
Well, then this is Ivan Iker McGuire, signing off.
Then what's the point of me? Of - Sunshine beach, north by northwest, rising 3 or 4 - of continuing this miserable existence?
People don't need the forecast. They have Automatas.
I know a studio in need of an announcer...
Canyon Crescent, southerly 2 to gale wind 5. Falling slowly. So slowly.
I apologize. It has been a long time since I have seen a meat-person.
I know a radio announcer who might take you on as an apprentice...
Fair point. The people need you.
A real radio announcer? I have never told anyone this, but... I always dreamed of having my own talk show. One where listeners speak back.
You're honest. I appreciate that. Now please, leave me. I have... a lot of thinking to do.
I know a studio in need of an announcer...
I don't know how to thank you.
I have been reading the shipping forecast - sponsored by Curzona - for as long as I can remember. Decades. Centuries.
I hate to tell you, but I don't think anyone is listening.
Why don't you just get new dermis?
A real studio? One that still exists? I have never told anyone this, but... I always dreamed of having my own talk show. One where listeners speak back.
That's true. Did my broadcast save you from peril on the waves?
Remain here at my post, of course. If I saved you, perhaps I will save another traveller with the shipping forecast, brought to you by me, Ivan Iker McGuire.
Eryka Rocks, south by southeast, squally showers, 4 or 5. Rising and rising!
My dermis and connective tissue were eaten away by the coastal wind. Luckily, my eyes are glass. They're all I need. Only eyes! Ha!

dialogues.title: The Baron is in doubt
lines: Doesn't seem like she has changed very much.
Maybe. I need to think. Thanks for telling me. Don't tell her.
What? I... remember. She... she told me to leave and never come back.
Not all of them. Your sister is still alive.
I think, I met someone you're missing.
She doesn't talk to me anymore.
And she's sorry. She's looking for you.
If you want, you can try the Ramen place at the Mountain Town pier. She's there often.

dialogues.title: How You Feeling
lines: Not last night, but a lifetime of piloting trams.
Huh. How 'bout that? So? What'd you learn last night?
If you put me at the helm I could drive a tram.
Oh, come on, come on, tell me what you learned last night.
You know what they say, old souls and all. Enjoy your vague recollection of knowledge!
Oh I get that. First time I gained some knowledge my head ached for a week. Enjoy your vague extra life!
So how you feelin' after Levelin' Up?
How many lifetimes have you lived?
Hahaha, you got the DRIVE! Nice. I had that once. I can still remember the tracks. The way they cruise beneath you. Spent a life time guiding steel along those rails.
That it is. That. It. is. Enjoy the vague recollection of knowledge!

dialogues.title: Kai explains Achievements
lines: It's a good thing. Hacked tourist visas go for thousands of Lims on the black market. For a fully unlocked one, millions.
No, not exactly. Or not straight away.

These visas were part of a scheme by the now-defunct Nivalis tourism board to get settlers born in the Ventz to visit the city. The idea was tourists would bring in lots of money. Problem is, the folks that live in the Ventz don't use money.
So with this tourist visa I can go anywhere?
There's an entry in your Comm for "achievements". That's the module for the Nivalis tourist board. You can follow those. The more you check off that list, the more you'll open up the city.
I guess I'll have a look at these tourist achievements then...
You know I'm a hacker, yes?
I was expecting you. Ava has been programmed to lead you to me. This was part of Thaddeus Carminus' plan.
I thought you were a hacker?
I like Mr Galosh. He seems like a clever fellow.
Well, Thaddeus arranged some exciting travel privileges for you here in Nivalis. Potentially.
But I didn't agree to this.

Right. Meanwhile, I have work to do. When you find your feet, come back to me and I might have more advice on how to unlock new areas. For now, I have other clients who need my time. Tik tok. Time is money for a hacker.

If we want to explore the city, yes. Clearly Thaddeus has some kind of plan for us. This tourist visa requires work, but it will be worthwhile. Let's focus on understanding our journal tasks, and look out for new vendors.
Hello. Why did you take so long? Tik tok. Time is money for a hacker.
Thaddeus asked me to hack a tourist visa for you. I've already updated your public access records with CorpSec.
Ava, do we need to do what he says?
The purpose of the tourist access visa was to make visitors explore the city to stimulate the local economy. The more activities you take part in, the more city access you'll get.
You want to learn how to move more freely around the city.

I don't know. Some sort of mold. Point is, these tourist visas were a great way for anyone who could get their hands on one to move around the city freely without buying a whole stack of local access cards.
I will assist you. But you will be required to do some work too.
Fine, I CAN do it. Ten million Lims. You got that much on you today?
The word "why" doesn't really fit Thaddeus. Asking "why" Thaddeus did something is like asking "What did the people who made the ground stand on?"
Just remember, you're a tourist now. You're going to have to act like it.
For now, Ava should point you in the right direction. Follow her instructions. She's an advanced Automata and her advice should be heeded.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 9
lines: And neither of us got fried... Yet.
We should have done as she said.
Well at least she's done with us.
She's been tracking us the whole time.
I suspect the outcome would have been similar. But it would have been nice to get paid.
I had no idea. If I'd have known...

dialogues.title: Olive talks about her manifesto tour
lines: Do better than try friendo! This is the final fire. We all gotta dance in the flames as the last lights burn out.

Look, it happened like this... Those rat bastards in the movement who want to ratify the charter decided we all have to vote, and voting was mandatory. But how are we supposed to enforce that, you know? We're getting as bad as the Corps at this stage.
I don't think that's for me.
Huh? The Movement to free Nivalis bay-bee! You know what it's about! You know what needs to happen.
Wait, you're not in the movement...
Realist? The reallest disappointment more like.
Meridian is next on the calendar. Just come! I swear, my words will change your life. Come see me talk, ok? It's just the start of the tour. If you come to every venue, I'll... give you a prize.
RIGHT! Hey, maybe I had you pegged all wrong. I had you down as a shill gronk with a bottom line addiction, but maybe you've got some headroll inclinations, am I right?
Soap...? Oh fuck! The soap! I totally forgot about the soap. Uh... no. The soap was a... not a mistake exactly. I mean it wasn't a success. What we need now is revolution.
I get it. Some people aren't ready to dance in the flames of the final fire. They're still looking at their bottom line, even as their designer suit catches aflame.

Right! I mean it should be. They call me an accelerationist, like that's a bad thing. But we're really gonna have to fuck this place up worse if we want to convince people that it needs to be un-fucked, right?
Huh? Yeah, whatever. Listen, I'm going on a speaking tour. I'm just worried no one will come. Or worse, my mom will come. Will you be in the crowd? Please.

I like the rhetoric, friendo. We should get galactic cocktails some time. I need someone to practice my speeches on. And maybe I need a proofreader for my manifesto. I can never tell the difference between there and their and that other one.
I'm not much of a proofreader.
Hey! What in CORA's name are you looking at me for!? I didn't lose your money, you spent it!
Typical shill gronk with a bottom line addiction, huh? Figured you might have some headroll inclinations, but I guess I was wrong.
Confused? CONFUSED?! I'm not confused! I'm drunk!
Something good! Not just a hug. Will you come?

dialogues.title: Ava remembers
lines: I can't believe he did that to you.
Yes. Far more time has been spent researching manipulation of human minds than artificial ones.
Didn't Nabla say that's almost impossible? And Coilson said it too.
He manipulated me. He found a way to change my memories. Made me think I'm an Automata.
And I know he saved me from the fire, but he... he must have changed my memories over and over and over again. Over a hundred years of resetting me...
What would we find? I just... I just can't see a happy end to my story... Leave me to think for a while, ok? I need some time.
Thaddeus always found a way to make things happen that seemed impossible. And as a human, my memories could be tampered with much more easily than an Automata's.
I... I had no idea Thaddeus was involved.
Believe me, I have mixed feelings about all of this. Not least, the difference between the value of my sentience as an Automata and as a human.
Right now, I'm not even sure I want to know where my body is.
What are we going to do about all this?

dialogues.title: Lochlainn about his kids
lines: Only with proof of earnings. Which is why I needed that new job so quickly.
So do I. That's why you'll never get a better manager than me.
My wife and I, we love 'em to death. But they're expensive.
They're luxuries, I know. I've got four of them.
I hope I never have to fire you.
I can't afford a license for that. No pets. Kids. Four of them.
I'll work hard. I've got some mouths to feed.
Reward me with your good work.

dialogues.title: Pilk's Questionaire
lines: I don't remember renting an apartment. I can't really tell. I think it could be worse.
Would you judge your current landlord - me - as "excellent", "highly excellent" or "beyond compare."
This is your chance to have your say. Ready?
I don't need anything else from you. Is there more you want to say?
I want you to do some repairs.
Yes. I gotta say, I've been the nice-guy landlord so far, but you might be pushing your luck a bit here bud. You need to HANDLE this stuff. I'm not too happy right now. I'm doing you a favor here.
Thanks for taking the time to complete the landlord questionnaire.
Haha, yes. Alright, thanks for your time. Remember, no parties!
It doesn't feel like a favor.
Please concentrate on the available options!
You don't even have a pen.
It's good you're here actually. I have a tenant questionnaire you have to fill in.

dialogues.title: Where do we start
lines: Not that I'm aware of. We might have better luck talking to androids about this than humans. Less taboo for them.
I don't know. Maybe we can find someone with knowledge about old illnesses?
I remember books. I remember the cold... being frozen. Blinding pain. And an old network, like a golden road of data.
I remember pain. Do you... care?
Again, assuming that the memory was not implanted...
It's hard, but I'll try to follow you.
But why would you get yourself frozen? Do we still freeze people?
Sure. What is happening with your memories? You were remembering old books, cryo-sleep...?
Do we know of anyone else who had their conscience transferred to an artificial construct?
We can try to ask his wife.
I felt like you didn't believe me.
First of all, there's the memories. Initially they were vague... fleeting. But now they have become more... solid.
I have no clue. We need to find someone who knows something about it.
But who would implant those memories?
There's been no new paper books for over 138 years. So if I remember them, why the large gap in my memory?
Of course I believe you. I owe it to you to find your answers.
I remember the bindings. They were printed on real paper.
Unbearable. Everywhere. Every cell in my body.
Let's hope his wife hasn't caught him yet!
... Gan Coilson. The vacuum cleaner! Right.
It's fallen out of favor for quite some time...
If you would just trust me, maybe I could try to explain.
Of course. But why would anyone do that?
Why can't you believe it? I can remember cryogenic freezing
I don't have much data, but generations of desperate humans have frozen themselves in hope of waking to a brighter future.
Maybe... but who? And why? For now, we have to believe they are real.
An old practice, but one that periodically draws interest and investments, before inevitably falling out of fashion.
I wonder if we are missing something.
A sickness, maybe. Something which affected the nerves? Although some injury cannot be ruled out. And this pain wasn't mental, it was in my body.
You're right. I'm sorry. I was tired, and you deserve better.
But what could cause such pain?
It's a Hail Mary, but I can ask any bot that's willing to speak to me.
Right. But how did you end up as an Automata?
What about Gan Coilson? The vacuum cleaner?
But you still don't believe me.
I believe you. I really do. But I cannot see how it's possible!
A lot of questions and no clear answers.
Why would you even ask that?
That would make you really old. Or really rich.

dialogues.title: Sewers
lines: Welcome to The Sewers, sorry about the smell. Do we need to build housing here? Probably not but never underestimate the value of cheap space.

dialogues.title: Find the Professor
lines: I have a question for you.
When you can find what you want in the Nets why attend a lecture and learn?
Do you know where I can find his compendium?
The original AG? Of course. I might teach history, specifically digital disembodiment, but I'd be ashamed if I had never heard of such a soul.
An inquisitor: someone making an inquiry. One who is searching for something.
When you spend as much time attempting to educate the populace, that tends to become a natural ability.
Oh, yes! That's this theory surrounding several multi-faceted ideas about digital... why were you asking about the original AG?
Well, you have the look of an inquisitor.
My university! I wish. If it were, I'd give it the funding and resources it needs. But the powers that be see differently.
Ah, the artist's compendium. The mark of a true creative. If that's what you're looking for then I would recommend turning your inquisition toward the appropriate Sec division.
As much as I'd love to have the paradigm shift, as long as people are consuming knowledge and not mindless drivel, I sleep soundly at night.
... I had never heard of him.
Those who seek knowledge shall find themselves in the search. Best of luck.
Does your university have a copy?
Ah, well one certainty in life is that there are so many things for us all to learn. The treasure trove of knowledge is endless! Why do you ask about them?
Have you heard of the artist, musician, and creative, Anthony G?
That is what an inquisitor is meant to do. Please, ask away.

dialogues.title: Dotson Interview task 1
lines: Pragmatic. But not wrong. Very good.
Suspect three: Razlo. Do not be fooled by his adorable curls. I detect a malice in the young man to rival any CEO.
Then it is up to Dotson to clean up the streets.
Hello my good friend. It has been too long. I assume you are here for your first test.
Attend closely. I shall outline your challenge, then accept no further queries or comments until it is complete. Are you ready?
Fair deal, leave it to me.
Suspect two: Calhoun the Loanshark. Word on the street is that Danny Danetti should be called Danny DEBTnetti.
Those are very nice words individually, but in that order they really make very little sense.
To detect is my calling. I cannot offer financial remuneration at this early stage of your detecting career. Only a badge of honor. An I.M.P.U.N.E.
An amateur considers all suspects equally, a master detective knows it was probably the husband.
Go forth and sniff out the stench of deception!
Do you take me for an amateur snoop? A lowly gumshoe? A paid peeper?
"What is... a good name for a detective?"
I'll figure it out myself, thanks.
Suspect one: Ma Gomba. The Fungal Femme Fatale. She and Danny were seen conspiring after hours.
"What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"
"What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"
An amateur tries to solve a crime, a master detective seeks only truth.
We will evaluate your deductive reasoning, your instincts, your perception and your logical problem-solving skills.
This will be the beginning of your entrance exam. Prepare yourself!
I have a list of suspects. People who could stand to profit from such a desperate act. Would you like to hear why?
"What does a detective in Nivalis need to always remember?"
An amateur tries to tell a story that explains the crime, a master detective knows reality does not have a plotline.
This task is simple enough. The first part of your entrance exam is this: "Find out who stole Danny Dannetti's new donut recipe." That is the length and breadth of your task.
There is a nugget of wisdom here, but I wonder if we both see it. For now, I will assume we do. Very good.
No. That is... were you not listening? At all?
Excellent. In our last meeting, I asked you a question and asked you to prepare an answer. Do you recall the question?
An Investigation Mandate for Private Unlimited and Neutral Examination.
It allows you to walk the mean streets after dark without being bothered by CorpSec snitchbots. Well, in a limited area, at least.

dialogues.title: Ava has a contact
lines: I don't have the exact spot, but I will put a marker on your compass. Scan the area around it.
The hacker. He says he has the right contacts.
A hacker. Trustworthy. But also expensive.
Yes. I was told to lead you to him, but you didn't follow my guidance.
I have been researching The Old Network, and I have a possible information source. Kai Galosh.
Not money. He needs some... device. The black box of a sunken ship.

dialogues.title: Return to Palmer
lines: You don't like who is helping you?
I’ve found someone who’ll get you out. Be at the Docks before curfew. Ask for Caleb.
Had to smash the thing outta the sky. You better have good news for me, kid.
Alright, if I get out of this, I'll leave you something in a dropbox in Helix. Your Ava will know where. No offense, but I hope I never have to see you or this place again.
He’s honest. And he’s willing to help.
MetroHub? You think those track rats really gonna come through?
Not one of those mad old sea dogs?
If you’ve double crossed me, I’ll find you, rip your nails out and use them to shred the dermis from your bones. You understand?
Just in it for the money.
Speaking the same language there at least.
This is getting too dangerous. Came within a nanosecond of being spotted by a drone earlier.
I've found someone who'll get you out. Be at the western end of MetroHub right before curfew.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 28
lines: Do you ever wake up with a headache. Caffeine withdrawal. Try to limit your coffee in the evenings.

dialogues.title: Tell Aengus about HuffHuff
lines: Are you still willing to hand over the DNA profiles for the recipe?
The profiles, or I will tell everybody that you can't be trusted.
This recipe could open us up to other districts. It's worth more in my hands than his.
(Lie) It's best when it's blue, if it's turned black it's no good. Blue is best.
Fine, the secret ingredient is HuffHuff. It's a buildup of-
He said something very important about the color.
I think you're forgetting the deal...
If I stopped to pause at every person who looked up to me, I'd still be serving rice noodles. No offense.
It needs to be black. If it's turned blue it will make you very ill.
He really looks up to you.
That's a nonstarter. I could easily just ask Marius myself.
Back so soon. All went swimmingly I assume?
Marius was very forthcoming with his information.
Oh fine here you go. It's meaningless anyway. I've uploaded everything to your assistant. Burn it for all I care.
Fine fine fine! Now leave me to get on with synthesizing this magic.
I know exactly what it is. It's genius. How did I not think of that!

dialogues.title: Mia visits you in your apartment
lines: You make me blush, you know. My cheeks go all warm.
Oh. Yeah... I get that. I mean, we really were only supposed to talk about what I should ask the ghost. Anything else was extra curricular.
Of course! Totally. Hey, so, have you thought about what I should ask the ghost? I have the tumblers set up with the exception of the last few. I'm gettin' antsy!
Hmmm. Yeah, I don't yet. I think I need to think some more. Haha. Thinking about thinking. Don't mind me. I'll only hang out for a little bit then get going. It was good to see you.
Well... let's do more things to each other.
Maybe ask if Nivalis really is all that's out there?
You do things to me too.
I don't. I can think about it.

dialogues.title: Bou's First Run
lines: You got it, one cup of plain old joe coming right up.
We’re a dispatch hub. Coffee delivered to your fingertips. In... in theory that is.
Coffee, right: you want it long, short, tall, multistory, grav-float, underpunched, blast foamed? Help me out here!
Really? Can’t remember the last time someone asked me for… you’re sure? No bio-lumo syrups? No dry bean ice blasts?
Morton, our delivery droid, has gone AWOL and I don’t know how I’m gonna get these orders out and my daily sales targets are already WAY down…
Right, sure. Gotta get those beans in. Here you are. Have a good day.
Just hand them over and I swear, I will give you free coffees for LIFE. Or, well, a couple of days at least.
Just… a coffee. Caffeinated brown stuff.
Wait, what? No, really? Really? Yes! I just need someone to do a delivery run, four coffees, real simple...
If you're so busy, where are all your customers?
I’ll give you the drinks and send the customers’ locations to your HUD.
Ok, we got one extra hot algae infusion, one strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float, one white lithium grease latte, and an octo-shot espresso.
That’s too bad. Can I just get my coffee?
Ha! There are nine hundred and twelve customizations on our menu. In any combination. That’s like way too many possible drinks. And lemme tell you, no one wants “just coffee”.
Barely. Customers who want these have to sign a waiver.
Thanks, feel free to keep any tips and… whatever people say, just don’t take it personally, OK?
Hey! Hi! Howdy, welcome to Coffee PoccoCup, what can I get you today?

dialogues.title: Talk with Calhoun about conditions
lines: Queen of the sharks. *shudder* You better go see her.
Looks like I don't have a choice.
Yeah well, you're gonna have to keep trying, sweetheart. I ain't gonna be able to help ya. Had a visit didn't I.
Someone you don't wanna mess with. Mary-Nyx Curzona. She wants to see you, too.
So, you cast the net and it came up empty, eh?

dialogues.title: Harper - Player Won
lines: At least financially I'm back on track. Here's your Money back.
Well looks like Chess is something else I'm not destined to succeed at. Maybe next time.
Well, thanks for the good sport.
I would have thought you'd be used to losing by now.
What a nasty thing to say.
I'm not sure, you gave me a run for my money there. Better luck next time.
Well, thanks for the good sport. And speaking of money, I'm back on track. Here's yours. With interest.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 18
lines: Time to get up. Another day's waiting for you out there.

dialogues.title: Hide Gan
lines: I looked everywhere, but found nothing.
Nope, I absolutely wouldn't lie to you.
You wouldn't lie to me would you? I know what you floor-levels can be like. Tricky little buggers.
Well, I absolutely do not believe you but nothing to be done. If you see him, tell him it's game over when I find him.
You know, even if I had found him. I wouldn't tell you.
How dare you speak to me in that fashion. Your little noodle hole will be receiving quite the scathing review.

dialogues.title: Better Luck Next Time
lines: Yeah, see, that's why we have an introductory stage. Thanks for trying though. Come back if you wanna give it another shot.

dialogues.title: Need Something that Will Make a Splash
lines: Alright. What side of the law we talkin'?
It's legit... for now. You know the bar owner, Nola Berg?
Any suggestions on where to start?
A raise wouldn't hurt. Just kidding. Though it wouldn't.... But while you think about that, give me a day or so. I'll see what I can scrounge up.
Ooof. She's a tough one. Prides herself on brand recognition. Making a splash with cleverly concocted cocktails.
Oh, ugh, I mean, things are kinda busy here wouldn't yah say?
The side we need to be on if we wanna take on Nola Berg.
You know that bar owner? Nola Berg?
Busy, busy, busy. Climbing that tower to the top, I hope. We'll be sittin' pretty if we keep expanding. You know, and all that other business talk.
There's a moment you see it on a menu and wonder hmmm that might actually taste good.
That's why I hired the best.
I need your help with something.
Why are you always talking about hipsters? Anyway, I need your help with something.
Eh, they ain't my cuppa coffee but plenty of people seem to like them. Weird ingredients sometimes. Think that's her thing.
I might have pissed her off.
This and that. Kinds of things you wouldn't think to put in a glass filled with ice.
We're making waves. Got ourselves some new promos to help get the word out. Pullin' in customers that would make the Corpsters cringe.
You have any dirt on her?
Hey, hey, there boss. What's the good word?
You tell me! What's happening around here?
These cocktails. What's so special about them?
We're hosting everyone from crusty punks to hipsters.
Aye, Captain. Guess I'll man the ship while you wage war.
And this is how we're going to climb closer to the top.
Never mind her brand, what about her drinks?

dialogues.title: Ava recommends funding
lines: I doubt that'll suffice. But okay.
I'll compile a list of people we know. Meanwhile, you can talk to Banor about the staff maybe foregoing their tips for a while.
One more thing... I did some analysis of the boy's condition. I estimate four weeks. That's all the time he has left.
We should attempt to collect money. Smaller sums from a lot of people.

dialogues.title: Talk to Agent Teleshenko
lines: By that logic, if the child lives, they might achieve great things. And generate millions of Lims.
Do you have a family, Agent T?
So tell me, how exactly would a dead child be good for business?
Sarcasm has been known to harm a business. Or kill it altogether.
Not by my predictions. And it's about the principle of the thing.
You. I know what you've been doing and I don't like it.
My domestic situation is of no relevance.
So, I can count on your donation?
Charity is the scourge of ambition. If McKenna had worked harder to achieve he would be able to afford what he needs.
I feel just the same about you.
I have no time for thought experiments. When I return, I expect this whole thing to be forgotten.
If your kid was sick, I would do the same for them.
Don't play stupid. It's all over the Nets.

dialogues.title: Garnet is working too hard
lines: As if I'm applying for a job?
Do you feel as tired as I look?
Oh, before you go, I forgot to say. I got a daughter. A real one! Mila is her name. And she wants to talk to you.
Just... go along with it ok. She's a good kid. She has this idea that I need to find a friend or a partner or a... I dunno.
Look, it's real sweet of her, so just indulge her, ok. I know no one wants me as a partner, and not many want me as a friend either.
Now you're being too hard on yourself.
She's kinda protective, and any time she sees me talk with someone new, she wants to... interview them.
Haha. Thanks for that. It's nice to see a friendly face. I hope your customers been treating you better than mines are treating me.
No need to bribe me. I'll help out.
You still look good to me.
The kid is pushy. So just.... go along with it. If you do, I'll buy you a coffee or two, ok?

dialogues.title: Visit Sky If Shes There
lines: I can go get her for you.
Nah, I bet it was a Synth uprising. Take us all out when we think they're charging batteries or some shit.
If you do anything to her...
How's this for original: suck sea water.
Yeah, when Sky gets back and you fuck off I'll be sure to do that. Feel free to get a head start.
You are relentless. Anyone ever tell you that?
Got an itch? That was quick. What'd yah see at the end? No, wait, let me guess: fire? Wild fires spread from a chemical spill in the Wastes and makes it way toward the city?
See something you like or just staring for fun?
Figures. Tehani had something of mine and I'm just here to grab it back. Sky went to go get it.
Ohhhh, the pretty one likes the complicated one. Call me shicked I didn't see that one coming. You should be a little more original. It might help.
Well I'm doing fine so off yah go.
Listen, I know you think you're like, part of this whole thing since you've been around all of five seconds, but you're not. So maybe, I don't know, find something else to do?
Listen, you smell great and all, but I really don't need or, if we're being honest, want to know that kinda stuff about you. So maybe, I don't know, find something else to do?
I mean the view's not bad.
Yeah, thought I'd come check on you. My new fav-or-ite consumer of concise hallucinatory experiences.

dialogues.title: Only 5 days left
lines: There's only 5 days left to find the music act. She's very persistent.
I received a message from Freya Portlet.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 5
lines: What do you hear when you wake up each morning?
There is a rhythm here, that only the most observant residents of Nivalis dance to.

dialogues.title: Ava's reaction
lines: I… hmm, hmm... I'll see what I can find out.
There's a lot you don't know about me.
Any clues about who she was?
Yes. The way she spoke about the stars...
I didn't realize you were such a dreamer.
I believe she may have been meeting someone here in secret. Perhaps a forbidden love affair, a clandestine tryst…
Well, I managed to excavate some information from her speech.
Oh, yes. KorēChant isn't easy though. It's given me a headache.
I get datalag, it’s more or less the same thing.

dialogues.title: A visitor
lines: Someone wants to talk to you at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Ava suggests it's Miso
lines: Age, criminal career, missing memories... he could be a match!
She still likes to visit the Ramen place in Mountain Town.
Do you think Miso could be Salma's brother?
With a little imagination you can see the similarity. And he mentioned a sister.

dialogues.title: A Visit to Masato
lines: Do you know why we first took residence in the Sewers?
One must find... opportunities... where one must. You should know something about that. I assume you're here because you took the opportunity I so generously gave you?
I see. That's interesting because I didn't send you to talk with Mizzy. I sent you to get Lims from Mizzy.
I'm aware. Tick tock my little restauranteur.
Alexandria is paying our friend a visit. Go ahead and catch up with her. I'll be in touch soon.
Seems to suit you just fine though.
I'm sure you will tell me now.
Because we were afraid of the storms in the sky. So we hid. Built a waterfront oasis meant for our survival. And what did we do?
And let me assume that you gave her such an extension?
Indeed. I take it you're here because you handled your first task to completion?
Don't be sorry, do better. Apologists are pathetic scum.
Abandoned it once we learned how to tame the weather's witches. Shameful.
You live a dangerous life. I expect to see you in three days time with the Lims Mizzy owes me plus ten percent.
I would not have trusted you with such a task should I thought you would have acted otherwise. You are most welcome in this place.
There is no debating with a scorpion. When you are stung you are dead.
And what excuse did she give you? Did the Boards tell her not to pay? Were her trains running too smoothly to get a good wager?
She said she needed three days.

dialogues.title: Banor first meeting
lines: Hey, you set the tables and chairs and chose a menu already! That's a good start.
Right boss. Well, we have a lot to do today. Your hands look soft and clean. You afraid of some hard work?
I'll get you a list. Should be able to get it all from the vendors in the market over there.
I guess I come with the place? I still have a contract, even when the owner changes. Unless you want me gone?
I already took care of that.
We can get to work! Hey, by the way, thanks for giving me my old job back.
Someone's gotta work this place, boss. I only got two hands, two legs and one back.
I knew it! I got a few years left to retirement and I plan to accelerate into it. No slacking off for me!
Oh... errm... no nothing it's fine. It's all probably fine... I should think.
First things first, boss, I don't need you in the kitchen. But we only got enough ingredients for two more meals. Think you could go to the market?
Good morning, boss. I didn't think old Thaddeus would ever persuade anyone to take this place on, considering...
I'm the owner here. You do the hard work.
You don't have to come at me like that, boss. I don't slack off.

dialogues.title: Talk to Safia
lines: You talk to him boss. You're good with people. You can let him down gently.
I've been PRETTY clear... But he is a bit naive.
You need to let him down gently.
I did. Are you being honest with him? I think he is confused.
This is getting in the way of work for both of you.
I hear you boss, but I think he hears what he wants to hear from me. I think someone else needs to tell him.

dialogues.title: Deeala is good at romance after all
lines: Alright, it's a deal. Now let's pick this up later. I'm late for my shift, again, and you look like you've got some work to do.
He's still an asshole, but you bought me some time. He's not even hassling me for rent this month. Yet. So I can save a little and move out soon.
I barely even spoke with him.
For now. What about the future?
Haha! Fuck all that. I just want to get you drunk, rip your ugly clothes off and tie you to my bed posts for the weekend.
But first I need out of my old apartment. And I need this damn LUZ to be over before I start thinking about...
I saw him this morning. He was talking with a Thera-Pay droid about going back to the Stacks to live with his mom while he reappraises his life.
Look, I like you. I do. I don't know if we're gonna hook up, but I'm not... against the idea.
I'll shop for a new outfit.
He's off my back, so I'm left in peace. For now. So I owe you. Thank you. I mean it.
Well... he wasn't cut out for comedy. Obviously. In the long run, you saved him a lot of pain. Though looking at him now... you wouldn't guess it.
Well go take care of your business. When it's all over, and we're both ready to get out of here... I'll be waiting for you.
Hey! What the fuck did you say to Pilk?!
Well, it will need to be a bedposts in a new apartment, when I'm away from Pilk Dane, and we're BOTH out of this damn LUZ.
Romance. Coffee and walks in the park. Holding hands and writing each other poems.
So gimme a little time, ok? And for our first date, I'll take you to Molyphonic. And we'll go from there.

dialogues.title: Rosco 3
lines: Yeah. There was this little stairwell behind an old shoe shop in Lowtown. I mapped it last week—nothing special. Went back today? Gone. Not demolished. No trace. Just… never existed.

Thought of that. But the Carto Carry still shows the data. It insists there should be a stairwell there. But when I try to re-scan, it won’t let me overwrite the old map. Like it’s… arguing with itself.
Owner must have bricked it up?
Because if the city is losing it, we’ve got way bigger problems than my bad memory.
It sounds like you must be losing it.
Get this—I asked a guy who works at the shop if he noticed anything weird. He just stared at me like I was speaking a dead language. Told me there’s never been a stairwell there. Never.
Could it just have been removed by the city?
Never drank in my life. Couldn't afford it.
I really hope so. That's the best case scenario.
I really hope I'm just losing my mind.

dialogues.title: Sage's Serendipity
lines: The MedEd drug? Yeah. Who hasn't? Why you wanna be someone else for a night? Or you looking to learn something specific?
Oh Neon Gods and Plasteel Rails... What are you on right now?
Rad. You're in for a fun night.

Like a specific person? Ehhh, they kinda frown on that. You can pay primo for a chem-tech to cook you up an off-street patch. Then of course you run the risk of the nano-fibers rotting into the first few layers of your skin.
So just the usual nonsense, got it. Well, to play along: whatchya got hot pockets? Figure you're here for a reason or am I losing my touch?
You want it? I'm all set.
Yup, yup! Whatchya got hot pockets? Figure you're here for a reason or am I losing my touch?

Cloud nine spectator high. Some trick-hack from Eastern Res decided to try and cross one of the twins. Got to watch them chase his sorry ass through the station and out the other side. Fool could rrruuunnn.
P-a-r-t-y time. Like it. Just don't fall on a set of tracks when the rail comes through. Watched that happen once. You ever see someone's brain toothpaste outta their own ears?
Well then use what yah got! It's fun to wake up with the memory of a fun life and a few kernels of wisdom tucked in every once and awhile. Like a hangover you finally want to have linger on.
Catchin' a train or just here to chat?
I mean ultimately it's up to you. Whatever you fall asleep thinking about. The last thing on your mind.
Respect. Tonight's going to be wicked and I owe yah one.
Well, thankfully no one calls it the Hub, but other than that it's chill. A permanent place fostering transience.
Eh. What's the worse? This is all a dream? Ha.
Interesting way to look at it.
What are you on right now?
Ohhhhh, you already have some. Cool, cool. You sure you don't want it?
Well you sure seem to be having fun.
What if I want something specific?

dialogues.title: Steal Drugs from RM
lines: You look like you could use a stim too. OK, I won’t be long. Thanks, Takeout.
Sorry friend. It’s been a day. Do you know how many call-outs we had already? Eighteen.
And you sound like you lost half your brain in the Sewers. Wise up, Takeout.
I need some for a doctor friend.
Uhh, I don’t have the strength to haul this thing over to the market and back.
That stuff is the good shit. When a patient has a MedSynge sub, I don't have to lie when I tell them everything's gonna be alright.
Who runs a free clinic by any chance? I told you, don't go there. If I helped every charity quack I wouldn't have a job. It’s about doing what you can, right?
Hey, I don't blame you for trying. See ya, Takeout.
Glad to hear it because it has been a DAY. You know how many call-outs we had already? Eighteen.
Four toxic slime virus infections, three dismemberments, one guy who tried to surf a steam vent on his HOVA board… Oh wait, you were just being polite.
Ha ha. Remind me not to piss you off.
There’s some expensive shit in there, Takeout. If I'm gonna trust you...
Nope. You ever heard of BioX-50?
It's ok, you're on my "Do Not Poison" list.
Sorry, Takeout. Can't take the risk. Nothing personal.
Sure, people sell it. Watered down and cut with CORA-knows what. Why you asking?
Sounds like you need a break.
What I need is a pack of stims. And I’m all out. You got any?
So if I wanted to buy some…?
Do I look like a bootlegger?
Takeout, don’t even go there. MedSynge makes us register every single dose. When a batch goes missing, we have to pay for it personally.
"No reason". Whatever. I gotta go. See ya around, Takeout.
We carry it. Been mugged for it three times this month already. It’s got a street value higher than vintage Joos.
I can watch it while you go buy some.
Have you ever heard of BioX-50?

dialogues.title: Harmony - First Meeting
lines: It sure can! But there is a beauty here too, somewhere between mold and mildew, I've seen it.
Look, I don't want to sound callous here, but this whole serial killer, CorpSec, Unity Zone mess has been great for me. You know, economically.
So it's basically a backpack shop?
Well your optics must be tinted differently my friend. You'll have to tell me where you got them!
You get used to it. No way I could afford static real estate in this city, so it's either this or a lifetime in a Curzona giga-factory. No thank you!
Not really, I like it here.
Hmmm, you're right. I know you're right. God, I'm so selfish aren't I? It's just that... Well times were pretty hard here even before this Aseptic stuff started.
That seems like a pretty messed up way of looking at it.
I like the idea of that.
My Personal Retail Unit! Everything you could possibly need all inside one handy, gyro-stabilized mobile body-mounted mini-mart.
Don’t be fooled by its size, this PRU is packing some pretty hefty deals!
Seems like a high price to pay...
It's just, spending so much time under this much cloud can make it hard to see the silver lining sometimes. Know what I mean?
If you say so. Bye for now.
I guess Nivalis can be tough.
I mean when you put it like that... That is exactly what it is!
I mean, half of my competitors are stuck outside the Zone. I practically have Lowtown to myself!

dialogues.title: Eldridge Exiled
lines: NO. No. I shall just... become a crab and die. That would be preferable to showing my face again. Ohh...
Oh, don't pretend you don't know! It's why I'm stuck in this terrible place!
Business. Such a dirty word. You should see it has done to my Aunt Mary. She wears the same suit, every day! Can you imagine.
I think I know what you're suffering from.
Leave it to me. Who shall I talk to?
How can I care about anything when I am a PARIAH?
You think this place is terrible?
You could? I suppose if you pretended to be a reporter, writing an elegy to my disgrace... yes, it could work...
What did you do? Wear the wrong hat or something?
Well, I'm sure the years will pass quickly.
The truth is... the terrible truth is... I can't remember! Curse Bo Bo and his psychedelic snuff!
The morbs. Beer fear. The post party scaries.
I don't carry anything as grubby as Lims, but I could give you something...
A Nyx-Curzona. We're one of the better branches. I'm thirty-eighth in line to the Chair of the Board. Or I was...
All these questions! How can you expect me to care about anything when I'm a PARIAH?
Just don't say you've seen me like this! In my degradation!
I don't know who you are and I don't care.
Let me guess: you're from the Spire.
I don't care about any of that. I leave business to my Aunt Mary.
Like I said, don't know, don't care.
Let me think, there was me, Bo Bo, Minty, PorridgeDog...
Oh! Exile for Eldridge-Uchuu, exile for a thousand years!
I think you've got a severe case of the morbs.
Lucy the Duchess Lovelace, some kid called Razzy or Razzo, Ziggy on bar... after that I can't remember.
So you might be here for nothing...?
NO. I came to POV Party in the LUZ, but some time during the night I made a breach of etiquette so bad that I ran away here.
See Eldridge... even the unstylish won't speak to you. You deserve it.
You must be one of those offgridders. Otherwise you would have heard. To make such a faux pas as I did... surely the whole of the Nets is talking about it.
So you must have some good business contacts...?
Look, whatever you did, it's probably not that bad.
Mary Nyx Curzona. Don't tell me you haven't heard of her either? Honestly, I'm jealous. It must be so freeing to be poor.
Are you related to Mary Nyx Curzona?
No. Don't speak to me. Leave before you STAIN yourself by standing in my presence.
Curzona make people's lives a misery.
Ugh, my aunt. You know she wears the same suit every day? Can you imagine? That's what business does to a person.
But how will I ever discover what it was? The Comms are down, my butlers are gone... we can't even get the fashion Holos here.
Then it can't be that important, right?
I'll see what I turn up.
There'd be a fee, of course.
Ghastly. The lewd sun, the revolting sand. It's unfathomable that people live like this all year round.
