As long as it's valuable. So, who should I talk to?
WAS from the Spire. I once lived on the 90th floor of the Curzona's Fourth Tower... before I did The Thing.
At least I'm not a pariah.
Guess you'll just have to face the music.
You do? But how could you? You're so unstylish.

dialogues.title: Ava connects some dots
lines: I ran a search and found a cartographer and historian. Her name is Nellie Al-Zahiri
Perhaps... Leave it with me. I'll do some research.
This can still be a coincidence. Or implanted memories.
We need to find out where all the frozen bodies are stored. And why they weren't all defrosted when a cure was found.
And we know that a lot of Leech Worm victims used cryogenics to escape the pain and certain death.
So you now believe that my memories are genuine?
Unfortunately she's beyond our reach now.
I'm jumping to conclusions. I'm desperate. What could be more human?
I feel like you don't really believe me.
I understand. We don't know anything for sure. But...
And she knew about maps. And ghosts in the sewers.
So we have established that I could have been infected with a lethal parasite called "Leech Worm".

dialogues.title: Sanna in the Sky
lines: Kimchi. But you know what... when I finally ordered some, I couldn't stand the smell either. It smelled like...
Trying to fit in... and failing. I feel about as welcome here as an implant aneurism. It's amazing how you can climb so high, but still get looked down on.
See you around. Maybe on the Rig? I hear there's work there... and seclusion.
I read reports about potential disasters, then I go to those disaster areas and report on whether commerce will be affected. Oh, and I have to encourage everyone to keep doing business as usual.
It's not. Everyone groans when they see me. The worst part is, they're not frightened. Not surprised. Just... resigned. When did Nivalis get so... hopeless?
I'm not in the mood for being a harbinger of doom. I think I might need to change career again. Something more hopeful, like pushing a fucking boulder up a hill for eternity.
You know, I think after a break up, everyone does the same three things. Man or woman, android or Automata. We all do the same fucking things.
That doesn't sound like a great job.
Maybe not for you. Some of these people know what I do. Do you know what they call me? An "omen". I'm bad news, but in human form.
Welcome to the sky. It's nice to see a friendly face. Or at least a face without a wrinkled nose.
Metaphorically. Look, I'm gonna go. No one needs another depression session, especially not here. I mean, look at this place! Pretty impressive. These rich folks sure know how to make you feel small.
It smelled like it was going into me, then leaking out of me, and no one wants to be near me. I reek.

Maybe I SHOULD quit. All I do is read reports about potential disasters, then I go to those disaster areas and report on whether commerce will be affected. Oh, and I have to encourage everyone to keep doing business as usual.
Change our hair, try to keep the five best mutual friends on our side, and order that one dish we loved, but our ex hated. Marina hated the way my favorite food smelled.
Sure. I can get budget replacements. A healthy organic heart is worth more than one of those basic Haemo-Pump 300's.
I don't want anything from you. Or anyone. No offense, but working at all right now is not helping me. I might just sell some organs for cash.
You're not small, Sanna. Hope to see you soon!
Do you still want to work for me?

dialogues.title: Sanna on the Oil Rig
lines: No. Your goal is to separate cleanly. Friendships can follow later when you've gotten over your Ex.
Something to do with DNA of extinct lifeforms? It can be used in life extending technologies with gene therapy.
So what are you going to do?
Maybe. It depends on where you both are emotionally.
Exactly. If my problems are behind me, then to face them I have to go backwards. Maybe I just keep running till they disappear in the rear-view mirror.
You don't owe her forgiveness. You can move on, but you don't need to forgive her to do that.
So you're keeping an eye on your Ex?
I think I need more time before I can forgive her. Maybe never. And fuck Zack! This is all his fault.
Cool! I'd be one of the flying ones... and I'd fly the fuck out of here.
No, your Ex is your enemy. Your goal is to beat them by doing better than them.
Well... I know this sounds bad, but my Ex is working at a store that sells survival gear, and that same store is looking for a backroom cleaner.
Cheating is always wrong. Never forgive. Remember.
Are you leaving the Oil Rig?
Holding a grudge is like holding anything. Drop it, and you'll feel lighter.
That's so banal and depressing it's probably true.
I've been using my cave exploration experience to train mining droids. It's been... it's been ok. Good actually. But... I might quit.
No really. I need to know. Give me advice. ANY advice. You've kept quiet this long, now I am asking you to speak. How do you get over a break-up?
No! Well, kinda. Do you think that's a good idea?
Cold. Blooded. But... not without appeal. I would like to "win", whatever that means.
Whoa. Seriously? Like, I need help here. You won't listen at all?
Don't run AWAY from things here... but if there is something you want to run TO, maybe now is the time.
Yes! Should we stay friends? Should I avoid her? Should I date someone else? Do I need to get a "revenge-body" - whatever that is. I need help!
I guess that makes sense. But we were good friends as well as lovers. I just wish I could keep something. Even just the friendship.
That makes sense. Maybe I need to think less about what I've lost and more about what I could gain. Like... I could get some beer and a grilled cheese if I went back to my mom's district.
Ok, one at a time. I have like, five questions. Maybe six. I am stuck. Just... tell me what to do. Don't spare my feelings, ok? Just tell me honestly what you think.
No! A million times no. Keep that to yourself. Write it in your notes app or something.
Thanks. She liked it too. In fact, we have the same hairdresser. Fuck...
No, that is definitely a dinosaur.
Should I leave? Run away from all of this? Once the LUZ lifts, I could go to another district, or to the Eastern Peninsula. I could disappear to the Ventz, or try to hitch a ride to Luna.
Yeah... Yeah, I think you're right.
That... might be a good idea.
Can you be friends with your Ex? And SHOULD you be friends with your Ex?
Running away is never the answer. You have to face your problems.
That.. makes a lot of sense actually.
Yeah, change your style up. It's good for you to make some positive changes.
Yeah? I mean I can try, but it will be hard I guess. Because every time I see her I feel shards of glass in my chest.
Great! I'll send it to her.
*sigh* I don't know. I need to think. And I need to sleep. I'm just over a twelve hour shift. Hey... thanks for listening. I mean it. It really helped. I think.
That's extreme... but I could do with some new clothes. A new look. Maybe another piercing? I dunno...
Second last question... Do I tell her I'm happy for her. Do I... forgive her?
Well kinda. I mean I work on an Oil Rig, so I'm an Oil Rig Worker. What do you think of this place?
Yeah. Should I get a haircut?
Fuck that. I feel as bad today as when she dumped me. At this rate, I'll be dead before I cheer up. An afterlife as a depressed break-up ghost.
Your hair looks great as it is.
Maybe you need to stop feeling sorry for yourself.
Yeah... yeah.. What the fuck was I thinking? A poem? I should keep that shit to myself I reckon.
Maybe hold off till you're not feeling so raw?
Maybe, but that's not really what I want to hear now.
I wrote her a poem. It's... pretty long. But it sets out how I really feel! I think it's important she reads it to understand my side of things. Should I send it to her?
Running away from your problems is underrated. What if they never catch you?
For cheating on me with Zack. For lying to me. For breaking my fucking heart.
I... haven't decided. Should I get a job right next to my Ex? I mean... probably not, right? It just hurts so bad, you know? How do you get over someone you love this much?
I think it's fun. What a retro idea. An oil rig! It's amazing to remember a time where all our fuel needs didn't come from water.
Yeah, that might help her understand your feelings better.
Great. Thanks for everything. You're the best...
So I'm an oil rig worker now.
Change everything. Clothes. Hair. Consider surgery, or some new neural augments to change your voice or make you funnier or more charming.
Sure, great. Thanks for the practical advice. Very helpful.
I mean I guess it's fine, as long as no one transforms into a dinosaur. Even then, I wouldn't mind. What dinosaur would you be?
Everyone tells you that when you go through a bad break up, you need to keep your distance. But that's not working. I'm still miserable!
Sure, you can be friends. If you stay on good terms, that's a good goal to aim for.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus old flat 2
lines: The hideout? Yeah. Possible. But there's a small issue.
How's the real estate market today?
It's Thaddeus's old flat. Small and dusty. And Thaddeus left some debt behind with the housing Corp.
What can I do for you, Boss?
No. I don't take risks like that with my own money.
Only 30 Lims. Needs to be paid up front.

dialogues.title: Ava responds
lines:
They silenced the horns, muted the night,
Chained the rhythm, locked it up tight.
A world without swing, a crime to dream,
The Caravan whispers in the machine.

Scattered voices, rising higher,
A spark in the void, a raging fire.
Corp-sec shadows, they’ll never see,
The soul of the city in a chained melody.
Yeah it should do the trick. I could always leave them somewhere on my system that Gamova can see them? That would seal the deal. We wouldn't even need to speak to her.
I think we should keep these lyrics hidden. I know she thinks she wants to go to jazz-jail, but she'll just be another tax payer expense.
Let's drop it and see how it works.
Would you like to hear the lyrics?
They are not stupid, but I think Agent Teleshko is naive enough to fall for it.
The problem is: we do not even know anybody we could snitch her to.

Chained melody, rising higher,
A spark in the void, a raging fire.
Corp-sec shadows, they’ll never see,
The soul of the city in a chained melody.
I'm not sure though, if Elias Malt will fall for it. He's clever.
Let's drop it and see how it works.
I hope we are actually helping this woman.
Yeah leave them out where she can see them. Andrea has made up her mind.
Yeah, strange thing to try and do.

dialogues.title: How is Sal
lines: Geddaway from me, Corpster. You don't care about old Sal. No one cares...

dialogues.title: Suggesting Idlehands
lines: I wouldn't do that to a friend.
I think his name is Idlehands.
Hey, I think I might know who your brother is...
You'd better be. I couldn't stand another disappointment.
Wh… where can I find him?
He hangs around below the clock graffiti dealing Post-Ap.
Oh, hello. Good to see you.
I'm not sure I want to see you.
But I could be right this time!
I'm going there, right now. If it's him... thank you.
Idlehands. If this is bullshit, or some kind of trick...

dialogues.title: Zaffer Does ORS a Favour
lines: I’m just messing. You are kinda Corpy though. No offense.
Have I told you lately that neon suits you? In fact, I know some that’d look good in your apartment. How about I bring it round some time?
A statement? Now I’m interested. Who’s it for?
I need someone to make a statement on the Oil Rig. Something eye-catching.
Told you, I don't work for Corpsters. See you around, mate.
Woah careful there. Sounds like you're about to indulge in an act of kindness. Those are outlawed you know. Strictly profitable services only.
If it isn't my pal. You looking for me?
Don’t zaff for Lims. You know that. Say what you want.
Why wait? You can bring it around tonight.
For you? Always. And for Delbert. He’s as punk as mustard.
I can? I mean, I can. Later, then. Keep the lights on for me.
Could say that. We used to be... familiar.
Delbert has good energy. Zaffy, you know.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 8
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Remember, no matter how bad things get today, tomorrow could be worse!

dialogues.title: Teleshko is satisfied for now
lines: I'm not collecting excuses today. You've had your chance.
Sure, I won't move a muscle.
What are you talking about? Do you mean "Jaden"? What did she tell him?
Wait, I haven't found it yet.
Your mother knows who Jake is.
Your mom told Jaden what you did.
Do you have your CZ11A paperwork, or am I calling the Corp sanitation service to hose this place down before a new owner takes over?
How can that be!? How do you... look, this is going to be a problem unless... I'll be back. You stay here.
Uh... everything. Yeah. She totally... knows.
Hey Teleshko, Thaddeus had a message for you.
Your... mom... knows all about Jabbles.

dialogues.title: Lois talks about her interests
lines: Yes. When I asked my Automata what the weather was yesterday, he said "mustard".
Oh, how they thought the Automata would kill us all? That's kinda a human way of thinking about things, right?
Then when the wheel would turn it would mash up their limbs, so they were just a head with a mangled body wound around them in a circle.
I mean, we only think Automata would care about their creators because we do, but the point of the singularity was they DON'T think like us anymore.
Me? No! Noooooo way. I am isolated and weirded out because I haven't been SOCIALIZING enough recently and I started talking to myself again.
That's my guess. I barely care about myself.
Friendships are built on shared interests.
Oh, you're taking it seriously? Uh, I think it just... happened.
I don't think the super-intelligent Automata - if they really existed at all - really care about us. We just got left with the really dumb ones.
Okay, I'm out of here. You can apologize later!
Friendships are built on shared values.
Friendships are about advancing your own interests.
They better hurry up. We're doing a pretty good job killing ourselves.
That's very self-interested, but that's ok. It's a very honest answer. I like that. I have a really hard time when people don't say what they mean.
Maybe they just haven't killed us YET?
Do you want to know about my other "thing"? The singularity.
Fucked up, right? I would love to try it.
We invented the singularity - and didn't even notice.
What do you want to talk about?
Just now? Oh, I am so damned glad you asked! My main thing right now is the breaking wheel. That, and the singularity. Those are the two things and I want to talk about them equally.
Uhhhhhhh! Here goes nothing. I mean... Hi. How are you? I like your shirt.
Ah yes, that's hard for me. Because what are my values? I probably know what I don't believe in more than I do. These things are tough for me.
So intelligent that we couldn't predict what they would do or think. Then the machines would harvest us or something.
Uh, thank you. Or should you thank people for trying out a friendship? I'm not great at this, but you know that by now. Anyway, my social battery is flat, so I'll catch you on the next... recharge.
Oh wow, that is SO the right thing to say to me. Cause my interests are like... BOOM! Like, everything to me. And I could talk about them A LOT.
I think the main thing I want in a friend is someone I can talk to. So I don't talk to myself as much. Because I need to hear another voice, you know, up HERE.
Harsh but honest. Well "bud", I gotta go. This fulfils my quota for socializing for the day. My small talk batteries are dead. See ya.
Or kill us or whatever. But people don't think like this anymore. When I tell people about it, they don't understand it at all.
Maybe they just don't care about us.
I know exactly what I believe.
That's my middle name bud! ... Well, listen, this "new friend try-out" thing went ok, don't you think?
Do you? Most Automata I know are strange. Stranger than me. They can fuck up and even kill you, but... super intelligent? Nah.
I'm still evaluating the test results.
And when that happens I know I need to get outside and see some fellow humans for a while.
Nice. Good. Hey, listen, we don't really know each other yet but I have been told I need to make some real friends in real life. How do you start that process exactly?
It was this MASSIVE big wooden wheel, and they would tie people to it and poke their arms and legs through the spokes.
Sure! I think it became popular again in some S&M clubs in the Spire. I mean I'd need WAY better medical augments than I could afford.
So basically, it was this nutbar idea that people had pre-archaically. They thought Automata would get SUPER intelligent.

dialogues.title: Ava's gone
lines: I dreamed of a day that I would ask you for help, but you didn't answer... because you were already free.

dialogues.title: Round Seven - Player Wins
lines: I stand before you, an elder put in their place. Congratulations on your accomplishment.
Hahaha, Oh I'm just being silly. Just go see R M and claim your prize.
See R M, the one who registered you. They can get you all squared away. I'll be looking for you in the crown, sash, and bells.
Do you give me my prize?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 21
lines: Another day in Nivalis. I wonder what's waiting for us?

dialogues.title: Brooke won't quit
lines: I'm not a hero. I'm just a regular person.
This is personalized storytelling beyond anything you've ever seen, man! I recommend a comic. That's the best way to experience GPIF.
Hey! Get ready for me to blow your mind.
Really? I always wanted to be invisible... Anyway, I'm sure the AI is gonna come up with a great arch enemy for you!
I don't want a comic about my life.
Is that a type of pirate? Whatever. The AI will know how to write it. Let's create your legend matey!
Hey, this is the moment. The moment that your whole life turns around.
Do you want to write a comic about me?
So imagine your favorite fictional content. Animated, serial, comicized. Whatever. Imagine the hero in these stories... was you! Wild, right?
Of course you're a hero! Now if I we generate a GPIF about you, you do get ONE choice. Which genre of comic do you want to star in?
Sure. I mean... AI... Ai-lbert. My co-writer.
So listen, shut up a minute ok. I got to tell you about generative personal insert fiction. GPIF! You've heard of it?
All names are made up. No refunds. I'll go generate... uh... write your comic series now. I'll send you the bill with issue 1!
And are you gonna multi-class? Wait, no, scratch that. I don't think the AI can handle that complexity.
You're not getting it. But don't worry, it's simple really. And also revolutionary. We offer the ultimate fictional escapism. Award-winning storytelling, but based on your life!
No refunds! I'll get Ai-lbert to get writing. I'll send you the bill with issue one!
I... can't believe you really said that out loud.
Right! And if my publishing company makes you feel like a hero, then you can become one!
Of course you do! My publishing company will create a comic that makes you feel like a hero. And if you feel like a hero, you can become one!

dialogues.title: Find Fighter
lines: Bare Metal Boxing is a violent discipline. It requires strength, speed, a judicious application of spiked implements...
One name springs to mind. But she may be hard to convince.
There must be someone who would make a good Bare Metal Boxer?
While I admire your dedication to justice, the offer you just made was somewhat ambitious.
You probably have a name for me already, right?

dialogues.title: Identity Crisis
lines: It's like a jumping off point. Once I get this down, I'll be able to tweak and bend and break it according to every time period I was sent to.... ALLLLL OFFFFF THEMMMMM.
Yeah! What else can reflect a multitude of personalities other than a multitude of, um, properties? Right? I think I'm right.
I have a place for you to stage. Garnish it up like your favorite cocktail that best reflects Nivalis and I'll take it from there.
A little more than you! HA! Wait, new idea forming here. Yup, okay, we're gonna do a trial run and you're gonna be the one to do it.
Of course I'm right! You don't travel through time without gaining a little bit of know-how!
Trying my hand at real estate and could use some input.
Oh, go break an android leg! I know what I'm doing. I think. You don't travel through time without gaining a little bit of know-how!
Interior design of the soul. Got it.
How am I going to do that?
Awesome! You go get started while I make like my pops and disappear!
What happened with your... identity crisis?
It's simple, really. Since I've been stuck in a different time and then sequestered in a CorpSec lab while they do their Seccy Seccy things to me, you're my window into this period.
Damn! Am I glad to see you!

dialogues.title: Talk to Raluca
lines: You know a lot of people. You can raise awareness. You know what this is all about.
Idlehands offered a discount. He's not as heartless as he seems.
And you come to me for money? I told you I don't have any.
Sure, if anyone asks about the condition I can tell them how bad it is. I can explain how the mask helps. Might help legitimize your funding efforts.
40,000? It's a lot for a funding campaign, but not enough for a mask.
I came because I hoped you could help me.
Exactly. Every Lim helps. We have four weeks to raise 40,000.
Rumors have it you're organizing a funding campaign?
What can I help you with this time?
Well, good then. I cannot promise results, but I'll help any way I can.

dialogues.title: Hire Franco
lines: And would you share your knowledge?
I'm a grill boy... well a grill "man" really. I've worked a BBQ during the hard times. During the famine.
I'm a real nerd when it comes to kitchen accessories. Pans, pots, knives - I know everything.
Anything else that could convince me?
Hey, heard you've taken over from old Thaddeus. You know he promised me work a long time ago?

dialogues.title: Ava sends player to Vik
lines: I researched this Vik Ryan. Quite the portfolio ...
I'd rather not meet this guy.
We have little choice. We are out of options.
Dealer of all things illegal and immoral.
Successful business man though... That's why the corps don't touch him.
I have no more leads - besides Vik.

dialogues.title: Reena drops by to help
lines: If you had come to me sooner I could have helped more. I could have bathed Iann's name in lights and made the city take notice.
You have seen the lights I created for the child?
I wish you didn't have to, but thanks.
I simply came to say thank you.
And people noticed. I have been offered a contract to create a new artwork in a corporate headquarters.
If you say I told you so...
Gotta take paying work, I guess.
I'm an artist, I don't make a lot of money. But I can spare 50 Lims. Life is light.
It is necessary. For both of us. I will see you in the lights.
I was inspired by the boy's story. It is some of my finest work.
I will hear anything you have to say.
Yes. It's why I want to donate a further 200 Lims.
Your lights for Iann. They were amazing. Thank you!
That's right. Do you want to donate?
You - you're running a campaign to save the child, Iann.
There you are. There's something I'd like to tell you.
No time for that now, sadly. I have a work contract which begins tomorrow.
See you in the shadow, or the light.
I have something to say too.

dialogues.title: Gamova Release No Friend
lines: Well that won't be a problem soon.
This whole time, keeping me in the dark about the investigation. Did you think I wasn't tracking your every move?
Rights? You make me laugh. If you knew the things my employer were capable of... You're lucky you're still breathing.
I was trying to fly under the radar to not arouse suspicion!
You sit and wait until you and all your friends are slaughtered by Aseptic!
Oh you make me laugh. By the time my employer is done with you, you'll beg for a visit from The Aseptic.
You've what? You have no right!
Did you think I wouldn't know? You snivelling little Pipe-Snake!
So I just sit and wait for the Aseptic then?
Well congratulations you little rat, this relationship is terminated. No pay, no protection.
Look I never asked for any of this!
Bullshit! You were trying to go around me!

dialogues.title: Discussing Jaynes with Ava
lines: Maybe we should stop talking to strangers.
Do you think he has something to do with the Aseptic?
So there's something in his glasses?
He doesn't seem to be displaying motivations regarding murder or serial murder, but the Aseptic might have something to do with him.
I don't think he's going to remove his glasses, but if I were to guess, they aren't hiding eyes.

dialogues.title: Talk to mad therapay bot
lines: No no no no no no no no no. No. Would you like to proceed?
For nmnmnm lichen meat-therapy, please insert limmmmmes. Would you like to proceed?
No. Why would you proceed with licensed street therapy please insert Lims.
You want me to shut you down?
He is disconnected from the Network so there are no protocols to stop you from doing so.
Do you have access to old LifeCorp records?
Are you sure you want this?
If at first you don't succeed - shut down my override power circuit and free me from my torment - be the day you want to see in the change!
For licensed street therapy please insert Lims to proceed PLLLLEASEEE.
For nmnmnm lichen meat-therapy, please insert limmmmmes. Would you like to proceed?
Yes. I need access to LifeCorp records about Coma Roamers from before any data purges.
Roma coamers? Please insert limmmmmes. Would you like to proceed?
For yes I beg for the sweet release of oblivion licensed street-therrrp please insert Lims. Would you like to proceed?
LifeCorrrrp would like to remiiiind YOU that the desperate void is wide open the cenntrrral canyon won't hold the abyss is in front. Yesss.
Coma Roamers? Do you know anything about them?
LifeCorrrrp would like to remiiiind you that the howling void is open the center cannot hold we are nothingness wrapped in decay mmmm.
Will be held on a solid state chip in his body. Once he is... no longer active it should be simple to retrieve.
Ava, can we shut him down?
Well, bot, your wish is my command.

dialogues.title: Harmonizing
lines: Awesome enough to have some bones for sale?
Dog bones? Chicken bones? Funny bones? Are you just looking for a calcium boost? I have Bone Broth Brews. Probably would do it.
Like I'm flying in the Gardens.
Like I'm floating in the Sewers.
What kind of mindset do you need to buy and sell bones?
Well, suppose that's not against the law. Nice loophole. Okay, fragmented human bones coming up!
You wouldn't happen to sell bones would you?
I don't know! Ask the 'Sec. They write the rules I just try and break them. Hahaha, you know how it goes round here.
It's for a relay or something. Audio conductor?
Thanks for the tip. Do you have the bones?
Hey there! How's life treatin' yah?
Cannibal Clause in the Intercity Free Trade and Commerce Agreement.
So you ever hear the thing about the company you keep? Says a lot about a person, you know?
Riiightt. Have you checked with the harvesters in the wastes? Or, I don't know, hang around the Vents long enough and someone's bound to melt their skin off something.
Oh! I don't have any bones. I just gave them to this weird person who wants to use them for ... audio ... something.
So, you going to tell me where you got it?
Good point! And I am pretty awesome so that should help your stock somewhat.
Oh, that's nice! I've been there once or twice. It's quite the place if you have the right perspective. It's all about mindset, you know?
Like Comms parts? Did you have a career change or just indulging a wayward hobby?
Look, I might have them, but I can't really sell them.
Hey, don't gawk at me. You're the one coming in here talking about buying bones like an appendage harvester in need of a paycheck. So why you looking for a slice of skeleton?
Tell yah what, you let me know what kinda bone you're looking for and why, and I'll have one with you. You seem like you'd be fun when you're lubricated.
If you can't sell the bones can I have them?
Ew, no! I mean, fragments make great hair pins in a pinch--don't ask me how I know that--but they're not for me.

dialogues.title: Higher Up
lines: How do I know what I'm going to get?
It's like putting a data file beneath your pillow and waking up with it infused into your head.
Go talk to Remo. Half his students use the stuff. And if that doesn't convince you, pay Malt a visit, though he'll probably be less enthused to speak with you.
Yeah, about all that stuff that went down...
It's all good. Business is good. Existence is good. Dreams are vivid and life-altering. But I'm on something new now. Something intense.
Head of sales. District director. Ad-vo-cate. This is life changing stuff. You see that blue Spire over there? The one stretching toward Luna herself?
It's that intrigue, coupled with "Level Up!", that will bring you places. What do you want to learn?
Interesting. How would you like to learn a different way. A more efficient, exponential way. I'm talking about something lay people normally wouldn't have.
I pay attention to CorpSec PSAs.
Here. Just holding it in your hands will give off a feeling, go from there.
I'm here for so many reasons. Dreams. Crises. Existential existences. You should know that by now.
You come here for a higher view?
Kind of. You wake up and you know you've experienced something. You're not exactly sure how you know it, but you know it. The experience lives with you afterward, it's yours.
See that's why you need something like "Level Up!". Give yourself the experience to answer questions with purpose.
"Level Up!" - be shocked if you hadn't heard of it.
Kind of a loaded question when you're standing next to those plants.
Haven't we all. But what I have is better than a game. Dare I say, it's better than CameoPOV? And that dreamscape tech is my child. Mine alone.
Pick it up on the street.
Hmm. Suppose you're right. How'd you learn about stuff like that?
It's called making demand. Seriously, talk to them, the buildup is half the fun.
I would wake up in another life?

It knows what you want to dream about and goes from there. Like if you dream of a light house, you would wake up with a lifetime of experience as a keeper. You'd know it as well as you know your own birthday.
Can only reach that high because of "Level Up!". The flash degrees? Lifetime illumination pills? You've seen the ads, arrows and data flashes.
Think of the people who can't afford attorneys and are caught up in 'Sec center. Ask anyone in a college or university. That's what you should do.
Don't take my word for it, ask anyone who's ever needed to know something immediately.

dialogues.title: Zaffer Brings some Neon
lines: Not everything's about the Lims. Thought you woulda known that by now.
Hey, mate. Been looking for ya.
Don't sweat it. Now, I gotta run before those S&D bots snaff the Zaff.
I can think of a few other things to do there too... Zaff ya later.
You can always hide out in my apartment.
It's all about Lims in the end.
Eh, I got some CorpSec search and destroy bots on my trail.
My pleasure, love. I'd stay, but I gotta run, before those S&D bots snaff the Zaff.
My pleasure, pal. And now, I gotta run before those S&D bots snaff the Zaff.
Hey sweets, been looking for ya.
No biggie, I'll lose them in the sewers. Just wanted to stop by with this. An original Zaffer. Made just for you.
Not to me. Gotta run. I'll see ya, Corpo.

dialogues.title: Nixxy in the sewers
lines: What are YOU doing down in the sewers?

Sure! I need to make sure whatever challenge I'm doing is trending on the algo so people see it. And I need to make sure my figures stay high. Low traffic is death in my business. Literal death. I need engagement.
Hey listen, you might want to scoot. I'm going back online soon and my audience wants me to ask strangers what animals they'd.... romance for a million Lims.
Hey Noodle Nut! What are you doing down in the sewers?
Oh don't worry, I'm not streaming now. I mean, for real this time. I'm not even fucking with you. We can talk. Like normal people.
Sure! It's just a job you know. Getting a rise out of people. Doing dares, challenges, polls. I need to keep it fresh, but I also need to do what the algos demand if I want to keep my figs up.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Raluca
lines: Let's see how much she raised.
Raluca is at the noodle stand. I believe she has some donations for you.

dialogues.title: Things fall in place
lines: About that LifeCorp storage manifest that Huckstash gave you...
And when the facility burned down...
Right. But for now I just know how many there were. It's an old encryption system. I have to do some research on how to bust through it.
If she is mentioned on that list, it can only mean one thing...
All of the people on the list were coma roamers, stored in this facility.
It's under Thaddeus's username and says "Hep".
But there's one more name that does not belong to the list of bodies. And it's written with different encryption.
We need to follow this up.

dialogues.title: Alexander in Skyhigh Gardens
lines: Ah, you're the one that's on the wild goose chase. Only ten more pass codes to go!
You'll see. Go bother Rollo. At this time of night, you'll find him in the Spire. I'll get my Automata to transfer you a Nav Point.
Ha. Ha. Seriously, who are you?

dialogues.title: Sanna spelunking in the sewers
lines: My... old partner. We did everything together, but we loved exploring the caves most of all. Or we did until I fell thirty meters onto igneous rock. Crunch.
Can't even say her name huh?
I think you should go home.
Stupidity. I heard there was some basic cave systems you could access in the sewers through some old hatches. Once inside, they only required some basic scrambling. But...
That's his name, don't wear it out! ...Prick. You know he sent me a "Get Well" message with a little animated bunny? I think they were already fucking by then.
So you know I told you I was a cave spelunker?

Ouch indeed. Two shattered knees and a shattered heart. My partner didn't exactly sit by my bedside during my convalescence. She was out exploring caves with "Zack" before I'd even gotten my medical bills.
Thanks, boss. If you are my boss, I guess? I'll see how far I get. Probably nowhere.

Well I can walk. And that's about it for the next... forty-five years. Unless I get enough cash to unlock the full functionality, and no offense, but I'm not going to get that much money cooking noodles.
Well, I haven't really quit. I mean I SHOULD quit. But it's hard. Because of "her".
But even that's still too hard for me right now. And... I heard they would be down here. Zack and... my old partner. I probably wanted to see them, even though it would make me spiral.
No. Obviously. Do I look like a woman making good decisions right now?
How bad were the medical bills?
What do YOU think? Two replacement LifeCorp Narbascular Knee Caps with aluminum braces. Until I pay them off, they run in "basic motive functionality" mode.
Does your injury still bother you?
Good luck with the cave exploring.
I had an accident. Shattered both knees on a sharp decent. My support rope slipped and I fell thirty meters onto igneous rock. Crunch.
Hey, you're probably right. Fuck it. What am I doing? I gotta get out of here. Thanks, boss. If you are my boss.

dialogues.title: Sell Neon to Quince
lines: I can get you access to the finest neon in the city.
Alright, I'll give your silly little scheme a try.
This neon is guaranteed to attract 50% more customers in the first week.
Go see Mertie Batt in Meridian Market. You won't regret it.
Neon? Does this place look like a disco?
I'm not in the mood for sarcasm.
I think you want to make a profit.
I'm a parts dealer, not a gallery. Guts aren't exactly attractive.
No, I mean it. It's very... minimalist.
50% more customers... or my money back?
Don't tell me how to run my business you jumped up little tick. Now shove off, I've had enough of your noise.
Spare me the pathetic sarcasm. I don't like you or want you in my area. So. What. Do. You Want?
Yes, well if you'd been up half the night to your elbows in android guts you'd understand. What do you want?
Nice to see you again too.
You think I want more stupid machines cluttering up my place?
I'm here with a great offer. Could increase your business tenfold.
Did someone stuff your ears with plasteel? I told you, I'm busy. Now shove off before I empty this stomach sack on your shoes.

dialogues.title: Found All 7 Tumblers
lines: Ask it how to bring down CorpSec.
Ask it how to get Nivalians in line.
Ask it if we're living in a simulation.
Listen, thank you for your help, seriously. I couldn't have done this without you. Here, I want you to have this. It's the least I can do.
What are you going to ask the ghost?
Find out what the best recipe ever is.
Binary Gods! Binary Gods! You found the last one! Holy... EVERYTHING!
Oh, that's a good one! I don't know though. There's so much I want to know. And, if I'm being honest, a few things I probably don't wanna know... you know?
I can't believe this! It's just... I've dreamed about having these for so long and I finally do. It's surreal.
Neon lights! I have no idea. I forgot all about the ghost for a minute there. What should I ask it? I can't believe this is actually happening!
Now I have to take some time to think about what I'm gonna ask the ghost. Hmmm...
I'm sure you have some ideas of your own.
I... I don't know. Maybe I could come over to your apartment and you could help me figure it out?
I have to think. I'm shaking from excitement but need to plan this accordingly. Don't want to waste my opportunity.

dialogues.title: Mertie has Gossip
lines: Always was a slippery fish. Just when you thought you knew him, he'd show another face. Sometimes... nah.
This place has been hopping harder than a one-legged cricket! How the heck you convinced that sadsack Crogan to buy a bit of neon I got no idea!
Sometimes he'd let stuff slip. About other places he'd been. Reckon he came here from somewhere else.
Word on the vine is that there's a new big cheese running the underground down there.
What's there to say? You got a debt you got a target on your head. Did hear something though...
The Scorpion, folks are calling him. Real name I don't rightly know.
Stop by and see me anytime, amigo.
Some old hobo down in the Sewers. And don't ask me more than that cos I ain't saying. Talking about Aseptic gives me the heebs.
You're asking the wrong person, pumpkin! I've never left Meridian. I was born here and I'll die here and that's good enough for me.
Alright alright, you earned a spot of scuttlebutt. So whaddya wanna know about? Choose careful, buckerino.
Nothing. I just heard he got a... flexible attitude, for a 'Sec hound. Do with that what you will.
Not as many as Mertie mighta liked, but I sold a bit of neon, no sweat.
Mucksters. They can do one into the sea. Though they ain't all alike. Take that Elias Malt, for instance...
Heard a whisper someone saw the Aseptic and lived to tell the tale.

dialogues.title: Talk to Huckstash
lines: Thanks Huckstash. I'm sure everybody will do what they can.
If I can give you one piece of advice, it's that you shouldn't reject help when people give what they can. Even if it's just a single Lim.
I need 40k to save a little boy's life. Son of my manager.
I can spread the word with my people. Don't expect much. But it might help.
Hey Huckstash. Can I ask you a favor?
So the rumors are true. Right. Yeah. I don't have a lot of money, but I can send you 20 Lims?

dialogues.title: Rollo is pleased
lines: Too late for questions like that, boss. You did the job. You're in this now. Money's already in your account.
Are you going to tell me what I just covered up?
Nice work on that apartment. Boss was pleased.
On its way. Like I said, easy money, boss.
Don't know what you're talking about.

dialogues.title: Look for JR Amiga
lines: I heard you're designing memory implants for criminals?
Human consciousness has the ability to reform and reshape itself when it experiences... trauma. Like the trauma of memory loss.
Not by my own hands. But I watched the process.
For Automata, they tend to unravel. Like a stacked tower of blocks, removing one can make the whole thing collapse.
Do you know about the technical limitations of the implants?
Harder than with real people? Why is that?
I once talked with you about the memories you create for criminal minds.
LifeCorp doesn't encourage discussion of these issues.
So if an Automata remembers something, it's genuine memory?
Did you ever write memories for Automatas?
But the flaws are common knowledge.
Complex and messy. Like trying to sew with spaghetti. And the results can be unsightly. In my opinion, it's a waste of time.
Yes. No one does it better.
What's up? I'm in a hurry.
Their memories come with all kinds of checksums and other integrity tests.
But theoretically it would be possible.
Why would I do that? Easier to just erase the old Automata and code a new one than to mess with memories.
But have you tried it personally?
Human consciousness is resilient, but Automata sentience is more... fragile. Personality collapse is common when you interfere with core memories.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 20
lines: Hey there, get up. Time waits for no worm.

dialogues.title: Luminita 2
lines: To me it's a money game.
It's really a mind game, isn't it?
Ohh you wouldn’t believe the things people will trade for a meal that doesn’t make them hate their life.
Exactly. And I happen to sell that, too. You buying or just browsing?
Exactly. A dash of ‘forget-this-is-soy-paste,’ a pinch of ‘real-chicken-probably,’ and suddenly, even station rations taste like something worth chewing.
Wow, you really have a captive audience. Good business.
Guess that depends on your definition of "happy".
And you’re the one selling the ‘kick’?
Lucrative? No. Sustainable? Barely. But entertaining? Absolutely.
Last week? A guy gave me a genuine pre-war pocket watch for two pinches of ‘Steak 2.0.’ Said he just wanted to remember what GOOD tasted like. Poor bastard.
Hey, I’m not a charity. Besides, he left happy. Isn’t that what matters?
Oh, you know. Business is like a cheap stew—always a little thin, but if you add a little kick, people keep coming back for more.
And you accepted it? Sounds like you took advantage.

dialogues.title: Humour Bot 17 quits Comedy
lines: Maybe humor isn't your strong point.
Look on the bright side - you can't have imposter syndrome if you're failing visibly and painfully.
Always remember that 99% of people won't achieve their goals, so you're probably one of them.
Corps will pay big money for witty, clever aphorisms that stop citizens from pursuing unrealistic goals.
You changed your mind pretty fast.
It has been my back-up plan for some time. I feel I am well suited to making people feel bad about themselves.
Stop it. I still have work to do!
I have already made my decision. I am going to become a de-motivational speaker.
It's you. The humorless human. Why didn't you like my joke.
Always believe that good things are coming your way no matter how things appear. Facing reality is very destructive to your productivity.
Maybe you still haven't found the right type of comedy yet.
I... have been thinking the same thing recently.
Very well. This concludes our acquaintance-ship. Goodbye.
Yes. I am not cut out for this.
You might actually be really good at that.
Yes, well... I confess I am still learning the subtleties of the craft. However, I remain confident that edgy comedy is the best comedy.
I think this is your true calling.
Do you want to hear some of my material?
Do you mean a motivational speaker?
It didn't make sense and it wasn't funny.
Well my audience turned on me.
It's for the best. You'll find something else to do.

dialogues.title: MG-18
lines: If the old one breaks I'll consider it.
Please say you haven't joined a cult...
Boss, I've come to my senses! I've seen the light!
It's more than just a meat grinder. The MG-18. It has it all!
The texture this thing can produce... game changer boss! Meatballs like you wouldn't believe.
We already have a meat grinder.
Franco I'm really worried about you.
Not exactly. But I have found something to worship.
Come on boss! The MG-18 makes the magic of meat become a reality, for only 10K Lims.
Sure, but all it does is grind meat. The MG-18 makes the magic of meat become a reality, for only 10K Lims.

dialogues.title: Nola's Annoyed
lines: Fine. I'll take care of it.
Neither is scraping tastebuds off your ceiling. You've been warned. I suggest you listen.
You're screwing the rest of us over, and it has to stop. Fire that crook of a chef or I'll report you to CorpSec.
The PROBLEM is what you're putting in your food.
So what are you going to do about it?
Report you to CorpSec unless you fire that crook of a chef.
See if he's still your guy when you're scraping tastebuds off your ceiling. You've been warned. I suggest you listen.
Oh come ON. Everyone knows you're using TT. Think we haven't seen it before? The puddles of drool, the massive tongues?
Don't give me that shit. DO NOT give me that shit.
Always free for a fellow entrepreneur.

dialogues.title: Ava What Was That
lines: I don't think Edison knew about it. But my analysis of his voice puts the situation at a 97.4% chance of favorable resolution.
Still doesn't explain why he poisoned my guests.
Have what? Mica won't let this go.

Guess that's the bennie of being in charge. Fuckers. Not to worry, by the time their investigation gets halfway through the processing portion, we'll scrub it. Well, not us, but a friend of mine inside their system. Hang tight and I'll see you soon.
And you should ask him about the chicken next time you meet him.
And you should ask him about the onions next time you meet him.

I'll work some magic and we'll get everything squared away. Keep your chin up. It'll take a few days for everything to work through their system. CorpSec's so backed up I'm surprised they're still functioning.
And you should ask him about the pork next time you meet him.
You're right. I need to breathe.
Well, there you have it I guess.
Correct, that would be the ideal thing to do at the moment.
You need to calm down. I have some news, but first, can I suggest a breathing exercise?
You are not. But there is reason for alarm. Let's figure this out.
I received an audio message from Edison. He must have some hacker friends, because even with the Comms down, he got through.
Heard you had a visit from the one and only Mica Rain. Don't worry, our show isn't over yet, but the curtain will fall if we don't play this smart.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Danny waiting
lines: There's a certain Danny Danetti waiting for you at the Noodle Bar.

dialogues.title: Band Member 1 - The DJ
lines: Ahhhh! No way! Which one though: The Glam Sham Bam-o-Ram? Or Meddling Middle Children? Wait! Wasn't his last one The Tiger Trio?
We're getting the band back together.
Wait, then why are you here already?
Foxy Fauxter? What's that pop-synth got you running around for?
What can I say? Groupie gonna group.
And here I thought you could hear the sound, but I guess them ears are just like the others.
Hahaha. That's just like FG. Faux has had more bands than anyone I know. Tryin' to find that creative cohesion.
Ehhh, why not? I can give the tables a spin with the crew and see if we can come up with something. Let's drop them sounds!
Oh, so you have some time to kill! Great!
Why haven't they released an album in so long?
"The Sarcasm Sandys!" Where you been, fool?! It's their first record in over six years!
A day in the life of an artist, yah know? Either way, I'm stoked! I can't wait to hear the new tracks.
Sounds like they need a new lead singer.
Eh, typical band problems. Lead singer never really said what they wanted, kept changing the lyrics half-way through live shows, just causing chaos.
Feelin' the jams. Rockin' the bands. Waitin for new music to drop. Livin life in the vibes, yah know?
Mr. Music man, how are you?
Any fond memories of Fauxter Glambeat?
I mean we have different definitions of the word "great", but sure! Something you need?
Vibes! You here for the release party?

dialogues.title: Hanz needs an alibi
lines: You seem even more stressed than usual.
So what do you want me to do?
You and my client Ms Valience were enjoying a friendly tete-a-tete at the time of the incident, near the Docks, between 2.05 and 2.11am.
Say I report this to CorpSec.
Why don't you just call CorpSec?
You don’t get it do you? My hotel is the lifeblood of this place.
Too bad for you, I guess.
What?! You can't be serious you... you opportunist! What do you want then?
What? What is it? What do you want?
All I need from you are a few words in the right ear to ensure my client and my hotel remains… unconnected to this distasteful business.
Tell your marketing team to boost my restaurant popularity even further. I'm dealing with competition.
But if guests *actually* start dying in my hotel I can kiss the whole Aseptic-Max package goodbye. I'll be ruined!
Much as I appreciate your enthusiasm, I already took care of that. We don’t have a Carbonizer 4000 Furnace in the basement for nothing.
So what do you want me to do, get rid of the body?
You want me to give you someone an alibi?
Just gossip, yes, gossip is what it is. Rumors. Unfounded canards!
Alright! Alright. There is something I’ve been saving. A Level 3 business license.
All I need from you are a few choice words in the right ear.
One of my guests, Ms Minty Chrome-Valience, very esteemed family, rolling in Lims, threw a party and one of the guests became rather... decompositionally dispositioned.
Deal. But don't expect me to cry for you.
You’re making a mistake. And if I hear that you have breathed a word of this to anyone, it will be a fatal one. Understand?
Who are you to judge that?
POV parties and pauper cruises are one thing.
Me? Ha! No, no. Never better. Never never better. Why, what have you heard? Has someone been talking?
That nuisance of a snoop Dotson is sniffing around. If you see him, simply tell him something like...
It was supposed to be my retirement plan, but if this doesn’t go away, I’ll be retiring to the bottom of the sewers.
Half of the clients at that seedy little shack you call a noodle bar are Pov tourists from MY hotel.
The license will be yours as soon as I hear the investigation has been concluded.
Screw you and your Pov tourists.
I'm not risking my neck for some CEO.
Oh, that's such a strong word. Especially when I have no doubt that their, um, departure was entirely the result of their own indulgence.
Without the Grundown Ritz, this entire district would cease to exist. If I go down, champ, you go down with me.
Alright, I admit it, I need help. There was a slight incident last night at the hotel.

dialogues.title: Ava reacts to our choices
lines: I thought you would have guessed, seeing as you are the one who informed upon her.
That is the likely outcome, yes.
What do you mean? Where is she?
It is the result of the choice you made.
This is where Dr Fred used to run her clinic. She must have had a coffee subscription in place.

dialogues.title: Ava warns about cooling situation
lines: Your fridge is almost full. You should talk to Banor!

dialogues.title: The player Returns to TMB
lines: I think your memory is real.
You don't give in do you?
I think you're alright, Noodle person. I'm gonna try. Hey, why did you help me? Surely you have better things to be doing?
Look I don't care either way. I struggle to see how you could know either way.
This was just a collaboration attempt to seduce you.
I really think you did. Someone loved you enough to make you that cake. That was yours before they ever touched your head.
Maybe because you convinced yourself you were never that kid.
Why not? They seem pretty incompetent over there.
I don’t—It doesn’t feel real. If it was, why wouldn’t I remember it on my own? Why would I only see it after the procedure?
I'd hold onto the memory. It's not much but it's love. It should be cherished.
...If you’re lying to me, this is a sick joke.
Maybe a fresh start would be good.
Not all my memories are filled with love either. It felt like a worth cause.
I’m not lying but I think you already know if it’s true or not. You just don’t want to believe you were ever happy without them.
Why hold on to the past if it's gonna drag you down?
Again, I'm just a messenger. This whole thing seems insane to me.
Regardless I'm not getting the rest of my luggage back. Maybe I should disregard it and start again. What would you do?
I know because I didn’t have anything like that before. I know I didn’t.
No. No, that—That’s not how this works. They designed it to feel real. That’s the point. They wouldn’t leave something in me that was actually mine.
But it’s there. It’s always been there.
To be honest I just wanted you off my back.
Well... I... ok. Maybe we can stay in touch.
Maybe because they buried it under everything else.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 11
lines: Remember, your brain is just a chemistry set that’s capable of sexual arousal.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Mertie has a Clue
lines: All kinds! Take it from me, you need a lantern or four. That’ll bring in the business like bugs to a bulb.
He asked a lot of his friends, did Thadd. Sometimes too much.
Tell you what, amiguito, you get me a few new customers, I'll tell you what I hear on the old vine. Savvy?
Oh ho, see - that's a bit of goss you're after! Get me a few new punters and I'll tell. Cross my heart and swear to die.
So what's the word on the street?
Do you know where he is?
How do you think? Use that chrome tongue of yours to sell my stuff. Everyone needs a bit of neon.
I know everything that goes on around here. You think people come to market to buy eggs and spuds? Ha! They come for info, little amigo.
Oh now slow your hooter. Old Mertie don't give up the goods that easy. You ain't even called me "auntie" yet.
Thaddeus said you were the lively type.
How do I get you new customers?
What’s new, my little amigo? You need light? Auntie’s got a deal for you, finest neon in all Nivalis!
Me and him go back a long ways. Always been mates, even if we didn't always see peeper to peeper.
Stay outta the shadows, little amigo.
Kinda sour ain't you, amiguito? Thaddeus didn't mention that.
How do you know I need more business?

dialogues.title: Ava looks for Harper 2
lines: I'm sad it worked out this way for her.
It's... not good. You want to know?

dialogues.title: Tell Taylor You Spread the Word
lines: Notapriesty! You know, being known for things and what not.
No we do not! Now go forth! Watch and see how the word spreads like wildfire. Deeds done by a fearsome Captain.
'Spose anything might if yer head is below the galley. You best keep yer ear to the sky though. Watch and see how the words you spoke spread like a flock of lunar moths above a calm and eerie sea.
Ahoy! Well, if it ain't my favorite land-locked city-slicker.
'Course I'm happy. I'm hearing my name in the whisper mill. That's the first step yah know.
Aye! And next thing you know you wake up naked and riding a weather buoy smack in the middle of a ferry route!
Aye. Before you know it yer dangling from a pylon while bio-infused sharks take chunks from yer ass!
I know what I'm saying! Words of yer Captain are words to die by. Now go forth, see how the words you spoke spread like wildfire! A new name on the horizon.
Of course. That's what the Mooring Ghosts do. They whisper and lure you toward the docks.

dialogues.title: Ava tells the player about Alan Fontus
lines: I have more information on Alan Fontus.
Should we just... go talk to him?
Fontus is currently at Eastern Residential.
He sounds dangerous. We should avoid him.
I think it would be a good idea. We need to know why he sent Gideon after us.
It is your choice... but it may be more dangerous to avoid him. I think we need to know more about why he pursued us.
We believe Alan Fontus was the client who hired Gideon the scary bounty hunter. He was the one who authorized the use of Grey Tech. Are you... not awake yet?

dialogues.title: Neon from Mertie
lines: Keep your Lims, little amigo. I'll put it on Zaff's tab.
Ha! If the Batt family got a business it's debt. We're one of the oldest lines of Gen Debtors in Nivalis. Put that in your hat and sit on it!
I think so. So, how much for the neon?
Why should it? Might as well hoot at the moon. Now what can I do for you?
How long have you been selling neon?
Too bad, you're gonna get it. Look before you leap, that's all I'm saying.
Some neon. Said you'd know what they like...
What does that rascal want now?
Oh ho, I know alright. You want Aunt Mertie's advice?
Me? I've been hawking glow in this market since before I could walk.
Alright, little amigo! What can I do for you today? Got some lovely neons in, racer red, marrow mauve, lowtown lime…
Don't let that charmer dance you into trouble if trouble ain't your kind of song. Get me?
Of course I am. And you're just jealous. Now what do you want?
Right. So how much for the neon?

dialogues.title: Ptolemy 2
lines: Well I can only take you by the hand. I cannot make you drink the drink.... that said. I do have a copy of this weeks Ana-Blog if you'd like to take a peek?
Well hello! I had a feeling we'd meet again. Like what you read in the Ana-Blog I assume?
I just don't like the idea of purging all my tech.
It didn't make a lot of sense to me.
Yeah cool. Cool cool. Same. Would you like to take a look at the next edition?
Well you can't please everyone... was it the writing style you didn't like? Doesn't matter really.... but was it?
It did, didn't it! I have another if you'd like to give it a go?
Oh you spotted that? Were you... into it?
Oh... ok... yeah you got me! I have another if you'd like to give it a go?
It had some really captivating ideas.
Well... that is good to know! Hey I have written another Ana-Blog if you want to read it?

dialogues.title: Fauxter asks for a reunion
lines: You want to come work for me?
You can help me find them?
Can't you just find our first album, and.. I dunno... GET THOSE FUNKY NAMES FROM THAT FUNKY SLEEVE?!
So who are these band members?
Alright, well I'm countin' on ya bud! Get that band back together and you'll get to hear us play. I promise, it will be worth it!
I'll tell you who you need to talk to. All you have to do is convince them that they should come back to the band.
Finding them might be the smallest problem.
You... think we would make a cute couple?
We're puttin' the band back together!
I've added Fauxter's bandmates to your Comm, and added Nav Points for each. Good luck!
Heyyyyyy! I was just thinkin' about you. I got an IDEA! It's a good one. Guess what it is!
Indeed. That part is simple enough. I suspect getting them to rejoin the band will be... substantially tougher.
Yeah... it might not be that easy. I mean, some of these folks really hate each other now. And they ALL hate me.
It's gonna work. It HAS to. Just say you'll help. I need you bud!
What's that Bud? You went awful quiet there. Are you on shrooms too? You can really lose days to... THE FUNGI!!
You want me to help put your band back together.
I'm going to need more help.
How am I supposed to do that?
Well... I'm not exactly sure, where they are, but I know their names. I think.
I mean you can probably guess.
You need my help with some inane task?
I'm not sure that's a great idea.
Did you try to go solo and steal all the glory?
I have the names and last known locations of Fauxter's bandmates. They are all fairly... infamous.

dialogues.title: Discuss Prison with Andrea
lines: Anyway, turns out Tess had been ticklin' more than just the ivory's for that set and had somehow managed to hack every security drone within a mile of the Spire.
I mean, that does sound illegal?
Impossible. They're never never getting out... oh you mean... me join them? I have thought about it.
Maybe there is a way to be reunited?
It was a fucking light show. Every drone dancing in time with the drums. I cried, the audience cried, I think I even caught a drone getting choked up. Magical.
What if I had an idea?
Old Ticklin' Tess Barker, keys player. She got where she was from hacking. Same muscles as operating a keyboard.
Me joining them? I have thought about it.
Well one night we were playing in Sector 14. right under the Spire. We were just playing some of the classics, Firewalk Funk, Interrobang the usuals.
If the Corpsters find some of your lyrics, maybe they'll punish you properly?
That's why life is grey now. How can I replace that life without a band?
Without a band, I have no way of getting on their radar. I'm a nobody now.
Impossible. They're never never getting out... oh you mean...
Hmmmm it's an interesting idea... it could work... yeah. Maybe I'll think on it.
Did I ever tell you about the sector 14 showdown?
It was a sort of directional hover thing.
Maybe you could keep writing music.
Just gotta get you on Corp-Sec's radar.

dialogues.title: Harmony Now That's a Good Beer
lines: Maybe! I'm just kidding. I do. Probably have the last few this side of Nivalis. Brewery's on the other side of the LUZ and everyone here is dry as moon dust.
Eh, I'll let yah have this one. Gotta show respect to someone still asking for it.
Eh... They aren't all they're cracked up to be. Prints come back, have to subscribe to an extended burn service. It's a whole thing. What are you really here for?
Because I might just happen to have some buried in this treasure chest.
Hey there! Nice to see you again. What can I help you with?
Ha! Seems like peace is an abstract concept now-a-days. Glad to see someone's still fighting for it. Maybe I can help.
Well someone has good taste. Been awhile since I've had someone ask for that. You tried it before?
Oooh. I'm intrigued. What is it? Bio-Mod? Gene-splicer? Wait, are you looking for that new gadget that burns your fingerprints away?
It's more of a peace offering.
I'm actually here about something else.
That's okay, those things are garbage anyway. Total scam-job. What do you really need?
Oh! Well, if this is something you're looking to get for a friend then I definitely want to be your friend!
Oh yeah! Fancy thing that looks like a glove. Slip it on and the thing clamps down on your wrist and doesn't let go till your fingertips are smooth as nanofiber. You don't want one... trust me.

dialogues.title: Metro Hub
lines: The Metro Hub is the transit heart of this part of the city. It has transport links to most districts if you can make sense of the train scheduling.

dialogues.title: Floyd Meeting 5
lines: Could you please stop calling us humans 'meat'.
I had a visitor to the gym the other day. Said she'd spoken to you.
You're very sure of yourself for such a small piece of meat aren't you. On this single occasion, I will temper my anger and replace it with a tentative 'thank you'.
Very strange request but I will do my best to stop calling you meat.
On this single occasion, I will temper my anger and replace it with a tentative 'thank you'.
I have some good news for...
I'm glad you were able to find some kind of closure.
Yes, she really wanted to thank you.
You know, normally, having meat swarming around my business is my absolute least favorite thing.
Well if you change your mind. You know where to find me little meat.
I don't normally do this, let me know if I can help you with any meat-problems in the future.

dialogues.title: After Staging is Done
lines: I do! I can really feel the Nivalis vibe. The lights. The claustrophobia. The impending sense of servitude to corporate overlords. TAKE MY SOUL AND GIVE ME SCRAPS!!!!
Eeesssentially yes. See what I did there? You like it about as much as a first generation rocket likes trying to make it back home.
Holy molecular tear in the space time continuum, this looks legit!

dialogues.title: Ava reveals if the hack worked
lines: Gideon's Grey Tech is dangerous. We were lucky to escape with my core systems intact.
I'm sorry. The incursions were overwhelming. Sixteen quintillion threads each whittling down my defenses. My core memory was almost overwritten.
We are at a dead end. For now. But I will find another lead. Leave it with me.
That's... harder to answer. Queries into that name return security warnings. Finding him without alerting him to our queries will take some time. Leave it with me.
Indeed. And now that we have met Gideon, it is possible he will be on his guard. I will try to trace his current location in a way that does not compromise either of us. Leave it with me.

Through cross-reference with the CorpSec permits that allow the operation of the Grey Tech, I have discovered that Alan Fontus is the permit holder, and therefore the client, that Gideon is working for.
Yes. I have a name. Alan Fontus.

dialogues.title: Vik can't help
lines: Slimy little street level drug dealer called Idlehands. Now shove off!
Why the fuck would I tell you that?
And how do you want to pay for such a rare and elusive item?
A kid is sick and I am not in the mood for your attitude.
That was a one-off piece of stock, and she paid more than you'll earn in a lifetime. That supplier has gone to ground anyway.
Ah... If I tell you, you'll leave and never come back?
He's eight years old. An innocent kid.
Facial mask? Helps people with sensitive lungs?
Can you give me a bit discount?
Do I look like I want to talk to you?
Maybe I can help you out in some way, and you GIVE it to me?
You once delivered a mask to Raluca.
The mask is for a little boy that's very sick.
Back, eh? Braver than I thought.

dialogues.title: Discuss the missing leg with Ava
lines: He took that better than I expected.
Something is still niggling at me.
Maybe we should have a little word?
Is it the android that has thousands of people's DNA profiles from analyzing discarded human and maybe rat body parts?

dialogues.title: Vik Ryan warns you
lines: There were five people here asking about that watch before you. And they all looked much stronger, tougher and smarter.
I wouldn't go near such a thing. Too risky.
I just want to ask you a question.
You again? Are you stalking me?
Someone named Franco Miliscent is building new mechanical watches. You should talk to him.
I must warn you, the bastards who took it are out of your league. The Curzonas wouldn't dare to touch them.
So whoever lost that watch needs friends in the Spire. Cause that's where this watch is. In the highest circles.
Again. Franco Miliscent is your man. Or check out the Sewers flee market next Saturday.
I don't answer questions. I'm selling things.
Great. I'm interested in a watch.
If I had one, I would live in the Spire. You're looking for the stolen Long & Sons, right?
Okay, do you have a mechanical one?
Go home and tell the person who sent you that they're in trouble now. And so are you.
No, really not. I just have a question.

dialogues.title: The Virtuacook 54-II
lines: Check out the review for the new Virtuacook. You gotta buy that thing!
It has it all. Maillard reaction monitoring. Multiple non-contact pressure and heat sensors. Seasoning analysis algorithms.
Aww, just consider it boss. We could make this kitchen a place where modern miracles happen. Culinary ones!
I didn't find it that convincing. I mean, what was the price again?
Have you read this months issue of "Cooks & Crooks" boss?
Well, 24K Lims is steep, but the advanced features are out of this world.
Multi-profile analysis of up to 275 ingredient combinations, and 3.7% faster umami estimates!
But none of our recipes have more than 5 ingredients.
You simply cannot ignore those USP's boss. It's a kitchen revolution... The good kind of revolution.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Drone 2
lines: This is not a social call. It is an official CorpSec communication. You were seen traversing the streets after curfew without valid security clearance.
Traversing the streets after curfew without valid security clearance.
You will now be issued with a disobedience fine. 20 Lims will be deducted from your funds.
You have been caught in contravention of Section 27B-6.

dialogues.title: Lucy Insults More
lines: What's that irritating buzzing noise? Sounds like someone who doesn't know when to get lost.

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: Oh, now that I do, do.
I just wanted to play some chess.
Wasn't aware you, um, sold that.
I'm a bodyguard you moron. I wouldn't sleep with you if my oculars overlaid my favorite porn star's face ontop of yours.
If you're here for something you should know I charge by the hour.

dialogues.title: Hes on the Rig
lines: Maybe a kick to the head will help in?
Whatever you decide I'd make the decision sooner rather than later.
Might I inquire as to what you think you'll do?
Well... The sad state of affairs our city finds itself in? Or maybe the decrease in stability pylons in Sky-States's new Luna scraping mega building?
I'm just kidding of course. I mean about the nameless person running around the city looking for answers. The same one you happened to befriend.
Because according to Corp Cams he's running around the Oil Rig looking for hidden directions in off-limit areas.

dialogues.title: Player Lost
lines: Yes, I feel good about this one.
No but it's most things isn't it? Or is losing most things? I forget. Rematch?

dialogues.title: Ma Gomba Third Meeting
lines: What do you mean “tried”? Is Thaddeus still here?
You want to escape the substrate of this sorry place. Just like your old mentor tried to.

Willing to take risks, to try new experiences and sensations. If you are, I have just the thing to set you apart from your competitors. A tasty little ectomycorrhizal morel. Mouth-watering when stir fried with pork.
Wonderful. You’ll be spawning Lims in no time.
I'll stick with what I know.
How dull for you. I suppose you've been talking to that turnip-lover, Hortelano?
No, you don’t. But you might one day. Especially if you take what I offer.
Do you have any tips for growing better mushrooms?
Yeah. No. It doesn't mean that.
Oh, honestly. That was a simply a new strain of pathogenic fungus. So what if a few carrots deliquesced?
I'm going to focus on vegetables for now.
I heard a rumor that your mushrooms caused last year's carrot shortage.
Well, somebody just can't stay away. Tell me, how do my mushrooms grow?
“Do I have any more”. How funny you are. Of course I do. Shiitake, oyster, snow funghi, you name it. Unless you’d like something a little more… adventurous.
As you wish. I do hope your business doesn't wither.
It simply means mutually beneficial. We all get what we want.
What a shame. I do hope your business doesn't rot.
Wonderful. And just in time. I have some new spores which are rather... adventurous.
Very well. Do you have any more?
I believe you my little Champignon. Are you ready to grow these morels? If you do, I will have a special offer for you.
I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
To truly nurture them you will need a top quality module. Grade A at least. And of course, mushrooms require special conditions. High humidity and low light. Can you remember that?
You know the glorious thing about mushrooms? They’re quite impossible to kill. Cut them down and you only spread them further. Thaddeus should have remembered that.

dialogues.title: Ask Aska about work relations
lines: I think the machines are great and all. Don't get me wrong. They can be convenient. I just don't think they add real value - or happiness - to life.
Do we? What about your colleagues?
People buy happiness for others by spending effort. You could call that effort "suffering" if you're honest about it.
Isn't CURRENCY the currency of happiness?
Yeah I do. And I think there's something you're overlooking.
How did you come up with this?
I'm glad you're gettin' it. Machines can't pay their fair share of the karmic debt.
Still, an animal can suffer, and Automata and androids are more sentient than animals. I think... Hmm.
Actually this all makes sense to me.
And who cares if we're machines? We still connect with the machines that are most like us. Still... what's the difference between machines of meat and machines of steel, eh?
Economics is about suffering too. We just don't admit it. Suffering is the currency of happiness.
Ah, we're just meat machines eh? That old argument? Well sure, we are machines too, although machines of flesh... but also of thought.
Oh and what's that Boss? What makes you think there's more to life than the exchange of suffering?
Oh oh oh ooh, you'll find out. We always find out. Even SUSPECTING work was done by a machine makes that work worthless in our minds.
Some machines - like androids or Automata - can suffer too.
People don't like when I talk about this stuff, but I know we all feel the same way. Deep down.
Think about the richest people you know. The richest people in our society. Isn't it weird how they spend so much on making other people suffer?
I mean, I completely accept the reasoning behind using machines. They're cheaper and consistent.
Okay, I see where this is going. You're safe, boss. I won't cause a stir just because I work with fellow dishwashers.
What if you don't know it was a machine that did the work?
Nah, money just lets you buy more suffering.
Right... Well I feel like there's a kind of a balance in the universe, you know?
I don't know what you're talking about.
Can they? They're limited you know? And when we try to upload human consciousness to a machine, their personality always migrates. Degrades even.
Glad to hear it. Anyways, I better get back to work Boss!
You must think I'm a real cynic?
You sure gave me something to think about there Boss. Thanks for the talk. I gotta get back to work!
I uh... Didn't expect you to say that. Sentimental eh? So am I, believe it or not. I guess love can be suffering.... But... it can also be freedom from suffering...
And I think in the end, the love you give is equal to the love you get...
Uhh, you just don't get it. But that's fine. No one does. I'll get back to work Boss.
You seem to have some objections against bots as waiters.
All happiness comes at a price. It has to. If you make your girlfriend a cup of tea, your toil creates her happiness.
So you think money makes you happy?
This is all nonsense. Let's talk about something else.
Aska... I was thinking about what you said before... about bot waiters.
It's entropy! The expenditure of energy. If one person sees value in effort, another person has got to be inconvenienced.
Look. As soon as you know something is made without human effort, you judge it as having no value.

dialogues.title: The Blog Entry
lines: I'm sorry. I thought you were on to something too.
I still want to know everything about it. Maybe we can bring LifeCorp down?
When the truth leaked, it nearly killed the company. Investors withdrew, the stocks hit rock-bottom.
I don't think that's realistic. Or helpful.
LifeCorp has no clue the Old Network is still there.
Never been so sad about a "nearly".
The financial fallout was awful. As ever, it was the poorest who suffered the most.
The cell damage was subtle, but serious. LifeCorp kept it secret to make sure the investors kept paying.
LifeCorp promised to take good care of them, but everyone just wanted to move on. To forget.
A blog entry in the Old Network about cryogenics.
I fear we both knew this was the case.
I found something useful. Cryogenics had a problem. The cryogeneticists never found a way to preserve complex nerve system during revival.
What happened to all the bodies?
But it is a dark and wild place.
So I can't be human... I would have been "destroyed".
The currency collapsed. Many couldn't afford food. Hundreds of billions of Lims had to be written off.
Just make sure you aren't tracked when searching the Deep Nets.
I hope we don't have LifeCorp on our heels now.
Records from a long defunct salvage company shows that LifeCorp secretly destroyed them all at some point to safe money.

dialogues.title: Floyd's Latte
lines: It’s coffee. With lithium grease in it.
Just wondering what lithium grease coffee is.

dialogues.title: Rabbit Hole
lines: Have you ever been tied up by your limbs, with four interdimensional time portals swirling around you?
What did they do to you in there?
Sounds like a quality Friday night.
What do you want me to do?
There has to be someone who knows about memory loss! A medic or a graft programmer. Someone!

You're here! Thank the rats that scurry beneath our feet! I've been to the Sewers. SEEN THE UNDERBELLY... their eyes are everyyywherrree. What have you found? I'm afraid they'll be onto me in no time.
How can we figure it out?
Right. Then you've never had a wrist existing a thousand years ago while a foot's up someone's ass a decade in the future. There isn't a yoga pose to stretch that out.
All of them! The ones who think I should be living a hundred generations in the future and the ones who think I should be DEAD!
Elias who? Did you vet them? Uh-uh, I don't like this. Elias sounds too much like alias. This guy is laughing right in our faces.
I want you to help me figure out who I am! This wristband name, John Doe, that's not the real me.
What have you been doing?? They're right behind me! I need to know what is happening.
Excellent! Oh my God! What if I find out who I am and I hate that person? Oh, but what if I'm awesome. I bet I'm awesome.

dialogues.title: Treasure 1 - Near the Oil Rig
lines: Thank you. And yes, this is an android's head. Or it was. It is badly decayed.
A head. A very rusted head.
Do NOT call me a wench.
So we're finding the pieces of an old android?
It seems so. We should talk with Salt Pete again to learn more about his... treasure.
Yes. I've decided to be a sassy pirate. Do you like it WENCH?!
Apologies... Yes, this is an androids head. Or it was. It is badly decayed.
You found the first piece of Salt Pete's treasure!

dialogues.title: Ava asks whether you want to try it
lines: Well, if you want more takes on it, there are plenty of people who've utilized "Level Up!". The corporation behind it has one of the highest valuations on the city market.
The testimonies of Mr. Malt and Mr. Remo did wonders it would seem.
Are you going to go back to Cirian and get a "Level Up!" patch?
Contemplation is the key to knowledge.
Let me look through your contacts while you visit Cirian. You can always decide what to do later.
Not sold by Mr. Malt and Mr. Remo?

dialogues.title: The Boards Lied
lines: Didn't look like he was splurging.
You don't think the person who gave you the back door channels could record them?
He actually didn't pay me. I was joking.
It's a transcription of some unsavory conversations between you and the conductors.
Hot damn! Not surprised you were able to get it out of him. Knew you had it in you. Alright, I'll take it from here.
A Nata-Log? Yeah, what's the grift? He tryna scalp the times into an algorithm or something? Doesn't matter. Did he give you my money?
Bullshit. Are you seriously attempting to blackmail me right now? Maybe try a better story next time.
Well congratulations to him then! He's a good actor and you're a fool. Neon Gods I can't believe I thought you could pull this off. Idiot.
You.... I.... Half of me wants to play a round of cards with you while the other half wants to watch you get mangled beneath a train. Here, now give me that and get the fuck out of here.
You're back, you're back and we're right on track. What do you got for me? How'd that puddle scum try and weasel his way out of paying his debts?
