Of course he said that! That's what people in debt do. They whine and complain and sop around like a broken TheraPay Bot while splurging on graft upgrades and champagne.
He had no money on him.
Wait, wait, wait! Okay, we can figure this out, can't we? Remember how I said I was gonna teach you to read the boards? Come on! Be a business partner not an asshole.

dialogues.title: Ava about Gimble 1
lines: One of them was called Ava. Characteristics of the individual matches my description too. Age, gender etc.
The list in my records contained one more. 13,498. Do you think she made a mistake?
I need more time to think. I burned. And I'm... alive. I must be.
Well that's not the most interesting part. Far from it...
I don't think she makes mistakes.
I ran some data retrieval algos and uncovered a table of the names of the 13,498 people.
No... I can't be. I'm not just the remnants of a person, left as an Automata.

dialogues.title: Recruiting Reena
lines: With the right lensed troffers and electromagnetic ballast lamps, one can achieve anything.
I’m planning my new expression. It’s going to be called Vermillion Rain.
I still don’t know what you mean?
That sounds amazing. How will you do it?
CorpSec betray the neon they wear. They are agents of shadow. May they wallow in shade. They deemed my last three expressions unlawful.
It will look as if the Oil Rig is taking off, leaving this earth for a new world among the stars…
I have to go. Good luck with the art.
I am the light at the end of the tunnel. I am lumen, kelvin, phosphorescence. I am Reena.
I have already joined. The light of my answer is only just reaching your brain.
Is it true there are hidden messages in your art?
Mmm, I can see why they didn’t like that.
Do you think if I reconfigure the backlighting of these struts to create a crimson beam angle it would have the right effect?
My most recent piece was called "Quotas Stare Back". I hacked the terminals at CorpSec HQ.
Then your eyes must be full of shadow too.
Then I have no time for them.
Light. I am talking about my art, my eternal practice.
An obscure art movement I have never heard of. You’ve piqued my interest.
Then I re-programmed them to display fractal mandalas that induced temporary blindness.
The red warning lights here. They’re magnificent.
What about it? Have you met any artists here?
What do CorpSec think about your "expressions"?
O.R.S. No. Are they an art movement?

dialogues.title: Tell Andrea About Gamova
lines: Better than ok, sugar! I just received my arrest warrant. They're taking me in!
At least one job Gamova got done.
Oh I'm glad I found you!
I have so many song ideas bubbling away inside me, they're finally gonna have a place to go and that's thanks to you!
Right, I need to run. I'd like to rent out my apartment while I'm in the inside! Wow "inside" so cool.

dialogues.title: Ashwin quits #2
lines: Depends. Good for me at least. I found an investor!
Well, I'm sorry to hear that, but good luck!
So you're gonna need a new cleaner. I quit.
We'll be better off without you.
Then it's good news for the both of us.
Thanks boss. I mean it. See you around!
Boss, I got news for you!

dialogues.title: Pilk Dane Showdown
lines: I've been a professional stand-up comedian for the last... twelve years.
I've always been naturally funny and sharp. I'm a character!
Alright, well, let's get the elephant in the room out of the way first.... And I don't mean your mom!
You have? Well, I've never heard of you. Maybe you're one of those underground comedians. But if you think you can keep up...?
I think I can handle it.
No. This time you should seek to make Mr Dane angry. The more he considers you an enemy, the better you are doing.
But you're the kinda business owner that I could sell donuts to, and charge extra for the holes.
I have to make him hate me?
We should go and tell Deeala the... good news?
I heard you're running a noodle stand. But people keep throwing up. That's because when people said, "Show us your noods", you send them a photo of yourself.
Gimme your worst! I can't wait to see you stutter and fail as you try to find something - ANYTHING - to use against me.
Jokes on you all. I'm in more debt than any of you!
You can still call this off!
You could teach me some of your... comedy lessons.
I've got thicker skin than this younger generation. You can't upset me unless you find the perfect line.
Well that was... Not as hard as expected. I do NOT think Pilk should continue his career as a comedian.
Alright. I can see you're still standing. Somehow! Now come at me with what you got.
If we became good friends we could have inside jokes - for example, you could keep your jokes inside your head.
And finally, I hear you and Deeala are really hitting it off. And by that, I mean she is HITTING on you to pay OFF her debt!
Well good. I hope you're not easily offended. My comedy is for people who can take a joke. Not like the young generation. My routine has TEETH!
I really don't want to do that ...
You need to break him down. Normally I advise you to observe the FERB score and try, where possible, to make friends ...
Wasn't she supposed to teach you?
What are your credentials? If you're going to tag in for Deeala, I need to know you have some professional experience.
What... what the fuck is wrong with you? Seriously, what's your problem? How could you say something like that to another human being.
I need to go. I have to call my mom. What the fuck... What the fuck am I going to do with my life now? I'm ruined. I'm done... I'm... Fuck.
I'm not sure I'm ready for how edgy you are.
Do I need to remind you what this is about?
Woman with a weird accent. She's mean to rich people for money.
So NO real qualifications. Well, I didn't study this either. School of hard knocks! Maybe you're a natural like me. Do you think you can keep up?
Look, I'm a trained professional, OK? Every night I get up on that stage. I'm ready for anything. I'm a savage. You don't want to catch my eye when I'm up there. I'm a comedic assassin.
Yo. What can I do for you?
They're lazy, these kids. But if they'd just listen, they could learn a lot.
Angry customers? That's hardly on my level. Are you sure you'll be able to keep up?
Someone with a soul and dreams and hope and a heart... Well, until you ripped it out of my chest.
Precisely. You must embarrass him so badly he will never admit you beat him, and then he will, hopefully, leave her alone. Can you do this?
Deeala told me you need someone to roast.
I'll go first, then you come back at me. My three most savage observations are coming your way.
I can't believe people call you a joke thief. Sure, you steal jokes, but you don't take the punchlines!
Alright, hope you're ready to be my comedic punching bag! I just need a tune-up before my big performance tonight. You ready?
But I need HER help. Not you. Who are you supposed to be?
Come at me with everything you've got.
Deeala asked me to teach you.
I'm used to dealing with angry customers, so I'm quick-witted.
I'm not saying your comedy sucks, but at your last gig your audience told the funeral next door to keep the noise down.
...I think you stole that from someone funny.
Right... Right! I remember. I was going to teach her how to be funnier. Pass on some of my skills to the younger generation, you know.
Yeah that's me! You want an autograph? Well, I'm not really doing that. Too many fans hassling me. Well... maybe just this one time. You seem like a good kid.
And don't get me started on your business skills. I'm not saying you're bad at making deals ...
I'm here and willing to learn.
Actually I'm here about Deeala - the woman with the weird accent. She's mean to rich people for money.
You get to comeback after I'm done. If you're still standing. I gotta say, Deeala owes you for this. You're in over your head, kid.

dialogues.title: Edison First Gift
lines: Can do! This synthetic chicken is so fresh, you might expect it to come back to life. But... it won't.
I don't know where Thaddeus is.
Here you go! And if you see Thaddeus around, tell him I'm looking after his old noodle stand, and its new manager.
We have onions so fresh they'll make you cry.
Yeah, well, we're all survivin' best we can. Listen, how about a favor?
We are always running out of onions.
We were looking for good pork belly.
It ain't like that. After we talked last time, I remembered I owe Thaddeus. He bailed me out a while back.
Well, if it isn't my favorite new purveyor of elegant eels. Get it? Because noodles are the same shape as eels? Ahh—nevermind. How's your new life as a business owner treatin' yah?
I'm only charging for the delivery. Twenty Lims.
So the favor ain't for me. It's for you! Got some stock that fell off the back of a HOVA. All sorts of fresh produce.
Can do! This synthetic pork is so fresh, you might expect it to come back to life. But... it won't.
I can't turn down that price.
People keep coming back, so that's good.

dialogues.title: Alfie Gunfibel first meeting
lines: There are two wolves inside you. One is love and one is hate. They both agree that your productivity must improve.
Want to be one of my clients? No charge.
I mean how are you doing emotionally? Mentally? Commercially?
But in the meantime there are some little exercises and mantras I can teach you to help in the short term. Ready?
Good point. I promise I won't charge you half a mil later.
Is this some kind of cult?
It's a... well "punishment" isn't exactly the right word. But if you owe the Society of Therapists money, joining this programme is mandatory.

Nice! Well before we get properly started, you should know that our particular form of therapy is more effective than any other in helping you force down all your emotions, bury your problems - for good - and become productive once more!
I have a mantra you can repeat. "Every mountain starts with a single step."
Sure. That's the most important one.
Right. Well, I'll get you registered and set up as a client. Next time we chat, we can begin in earnest. Thanks for joining me on the road to success!
Alright! Well I should probably put together a personalized development plan to help you overcome your issues and remain productive.
I accidently signed up for one of those "reduce your stress" workshops. Half an hour later, they hit me with a bill for half a mil. I'm paying it off one session at a time.
I don't think I'm ready for such direct rejection. Which, ironically, is why I started therapy.
I wish. I'm a part of the Sanguine Minds Therapy project.
No, but I'm still contractually bound to ask. How are you doing?
Why do you owe therapists money?
It is what it is. Well I should probably put together a personalized development plan to help you overcome your issues and remain productive.
Oh don't be like that! Come on. Don't you want to be one of my clients? No charge.

I want to enable you to overcome any obstacles in your path and help you to achieve your true potential. I want to remove any impediments to your career and professional growth while nurturing your emotional wellbeing and spiritual integrity. I want to... I can't remember the rest.

dialogues.title: Talk to Reena
lines: Your public support might be worth more.
I know you, right? The noodle stand owner?
I cannot ask for more. Thank you!
I don't know how much it will help, but I can already see the colors lighting up the city: "Save Iann!"
No child should suffer like that.
The boy will be the focus for my current work.
I agree. And you're here to ask me for money?
My money is in my colors. My art. And those you can have. I'll lend you my support.
I heard you're fighting for a little boy. I didn't think you had that in you.
Why do people keep saying that? I do more than sell noodles...
Yeah, I heard. You're fundraising for a sick kid. I'll be honest, I didn't think you had that in you.

dialogues.title: More fragments
lines: Apparently, she’d accidentally created a divine spiral and ascended to a different plane of consciousness.
Perhaps enlightenment is knowing not to believe silly stories.
People say that even now, if you run around it six times at sunset, you’ll attain enlightenment.
That could mean Beyond the Western Limit… and this node, I might be able to fix it...
Your secret, right. Hmm. Do you know the story about Helix Monumental?
How sad for the rest of us if that's true.
Too bad. Stories are what hold this city together.
Let me see… where did you find these, at the bottom of a crusher? But wait, there, is that a pair of folded hands? A fish? A half moon?
People say the woman who designed it vanished at the halfway point between the loops one day.
On second thoughts, no time for stories now.
We've all tried it once. Maybe it will work for you!

dialogues.title: Shipping Forecasts continue
lines: Gallalem Wharf, south 7 or 8, thundery showers, moderate. Old Nemo Landing, west by west 5, poison gas cloud warnings, otherwise fine.
Dead Crab Creek, south by southwest, high crustacean activity 9, turning calmer. Moderate to fair.
Nokoling Piers, east zone 4, violent swells, rising 5 or 6. Poor.
We are in the area to hear the shipping forecast. Shall I transmit it?
Oh well. He seems happy enough.
None whatsoever. Half of the places he mentions no longer exist.
Is that information of any use?

dialogues.title: Humour Bot 17 Discovers edgy comedy
lines: I will start by making jokes about a minority group. Or, to be precise, I will judiciously avoid making a specific joke about the minority group.
I one hundred percent guarantee this will be the funniest joke you have ever heard. Simply provide me with a minority group. You will see.
I have moved on to a more evolved, highbrow form of humor.
Pilk Dane. I find him hilarious. I believe he is the funniest man in Nivalis.

And then when everyone is relieved I did NOT make a joke about the minority group, at the very end I say something offensive in an offhand way, like I do not really believe it and I'm just saying it to get a reaction.
I should warn you, this routine is not for the easily offended. I say what I think. People either love me or hate me. Although this is all comedy, what I really believe in is free speech.
I'm not sure about this, but let's hear it.
I like refugees, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't we deport them all?
I trust your day is going well you BUFFOON!
People are too easily offended these days. I love edgy stuff.
Are you still mad about the improv thing?
I can't believe you found something worse than improv.
I'm more of the sensitive type ...
Before we start, please tell me, is there some way I could help you to suppress the instincts that make you ruin my art form?
I have been sharing comedy routines with a local "edgy comedy" expert.
But I will make it seem like I am about to make a joke about that group at any moment.
I actually need your help today audience.
I don't think I'm the problem.
I could engage you in my edgy comedy if you like? Perhaps you might fare better than you did with improv comedy.
Alright, first of all, which is your least favorite minority?
I like vegetarians, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't they just eat meat? Idiots.
No. I have put that behind me. I now barely remember how you ruined a whole genre of comedy.
I like androids, but I couldn't eat a whole one. No, I joke, I joke. Also... why don't we kill them all?
What's the matter? Too EDGY for you.

dialogues.title: I Shoulda Called You
lines: Heyyy! You're the one with the noodle bar and the EF-171.
Since that mining corp went rogue on Luna and tried cutting out the CS Trade Commission, there is a 76% import fee on the minerals used to make the base of different fuses.
You tell me. You're the one who tried it. How did you do it?
Silas Rhodes. I helped Thad' and Ava wire the place after a typhoon a few years ago. Still buggy but better than it was.
I used a converter and put the blender on smoothie mode.
How'd you know I was having issues?
Means it's fix it till yah fuck it time. Gotta finagle with what we have until we can get more. You get it though. You're already doing it. Much respect.
Nah as in nah-gonna have power much longer. Ha! I'm soooo fucking funny. I'm joking don't give me that look.
Ava pinged me and sent me your skims. Saw the EF-171. I wasn't around else I woulda stopped by. What'd you do? Try to jumpstart a tram with your blender?

dialogues.title: Yeah, We Got Extras
lines: Boss hoss holding the moss. What can I do for yah?
You're doing good in this city. Thaddeus would be proud.
Here yah go boss. Staff's favorite. Whoever it is, tell 'em to enjoy.
Ohhh. We're treadin' down that path huh? If it's what we gotta do, let's go for it. Blow 'em up from the inside.
Someone who knows something about the Comms being down.
Business venture. Good will and all that.
Ah, now that is a good choice. Yeah, I got something here. This should do nice. Can I ask who it's for?
Always admirable. That's why I'll work with yah till my eyes go and I'm frying pans with nothing but grease in 'em.
Absolutely. Good food brings good people together. That's a thing. A real truth to life.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Reena
lines: Reena came by the noodle stand to see you. If you hurry, you might catch her.

dialogues.title: Rosetta wants to talk to you
lines: Guess who's waiting at the noodle stand?

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Hanz
lines: Are you expecting Hanz Grundown? He's waiting at the noodle stand in a very impatient manner.

dialogues.title: Speak to Lucy
lines: RIGHT?! I mean, if his aunt heard that he was trying to undermine the basic principles of supply chain competitiveness ...
You were at a party and Eldridge did something. What?
Seriously? Your aura is giving me a headache, so if you wouldn't mind...
Because if you don't, I'll tell everyone you're actually a duchess.
You were at a party with him recently.
Alright, fine! I don't remember everything, Bo Bo had some slugjuice going around, but apparently Eldridge tried to… *mumble*
... she’d have him ex-communicated. Plus engaging in that sort of community collaboration is just, like, EXTREMELY gauche.
Well... that's what Minty told me that PorridgeDog told her.
Nyx-Curzona? Yeah, we... I mean, no. I have literally no idea who you mean.
Whatever. Look, do you know Eldridge?
Look, don't quote me on any of that, OK? Like I said, I was TOTALLY chem-trailed. You should talk to Zig, Ziggy, he'll know.
Err, because he's a CURZONA. If his aunt found out he was trying to undermine the basic principles of supply chain competitiveness ...
You can't. She's off having an aura cleanse. But Ziggy was the one who told PorridgeDog. Talk to him.
Well, maybe I've, like, HEARD of him, but it's not like we had the same nanny or anything. I'm not WEALTHY wealthy!
As he should be. Surprised he hasn't jumped the LUZ and fled to Luna.
Oh yeah, you think we're friends, don't you? That's cute.
No way to treat a friend.
Ugh. Can you step back a bit? Your aura is clashing with mine.
Just by chance: Have you seen him recently?
To start a library! A free one. Apparently he said it would stock all the fashion holos. As well as… textbooks. Bleurgh.

dialogues.title: Luminita 4
lines: You really don’t know when to quit, do you?
And yet, here you are. Which means…
Oh, you know, just a little CorpSec hospitality visit. Busted in like I was running a bioweapons lab instead of selling ‘Make Your Soup Suck Less’ powder.
Spent six hours in an old vending machine shell. Someone even tried to buy a snack from me. Almost charged ‘em.
Smart. Did they get all your stock?
If I did, I wouldn’t be good at this.
Ridiculous is CorpSec thinking they actually got all my stock.
I stashed half my inventory inside a crate labeled ‘Sanitation Supplies.’ Cops don’t touch cleaning products. I was back in business before their boots cooled.
If I wasn't, I wouldn’t be good at this.
So you're still open for business?

Raided, trashed - real full-service experience. You should’ve seen the guy leading it, too. Had that classic CorpSec look—dead eyes, square jaw, haircut like he loses sleep over unauthorized font choices.
I slipped out before they even got through the door. Had an old service tunnel rigged as an escape route—past tense, ‘cause they found it and filled it with foamcrete. Real shame.

dialogues.title: Deeala on Seaside Boardwalk
lines: I'm taking some food to Reese, my old colleague. He got fired, and now he's considering moving to the Ventz to escape the city.
Good. Cos you don't get a lot of layers of subtext with me. Never really mastered the filter on this mouth of mine.
You got fired from your job at the club?
Is he trying to evict you?
For most people - no. For Reese - double no. The kid wouldn't last the night in the Ventz. He's softer than that slime mold that slithers around the docks at midnight.
He's the worst landlord AND the worst comedian in Nivalis. When he raised rent, I said I couldn't afford it, so offered to give feedback on his standup routine instead.
I'm not sleeping, I can't afford decent food, and I'm uncaffeinated. And all because I couldn't stop myself from telling some arsehole landlord that he's as funny as a respiratory virus.
You need to learn when to hold your tongue.
I'm workin' on it. But right now, I gotta get going.
What are you going to do about your bad landlord?
I'm sure you know what you're doing.
No, not yet. But my night job is IMPOSSIBLE because my landlord, Pilk Dane, keeps turning the heat off. Then on. Then off again.
I'm barely holding it together friend. I bet you can tell just looking at me what happened.
He needs to stand on his own two feet.
Can I help you deal with Pilk Dane?
That's sweet of you to offer. But this is my fight. I've dealt with worse - much worse - than a landlord with delusions of comedy grandeur.
Yo! You're not catching me on the best day. Look at the state of me. Again.
Bingo bango! You got it. Pilk FUCKING Dane. Do you know him?
I hope you can help him.
That's not really my style. And I feel like you should know that about me at this stage in our relationship.
I'll help him out as best I can. And I'll see you around. Later friend.
I like that you say what you mean.
You'd be better off selling a kidney.

dialogues.title: Make the Reservation Sage
lines: Don't mention it. Was planning on checking this place out but I already gotta run for the next job. Listen to me when I tell yah... don't fucking gamble, yeah?
Looking to book a dinner reservation.
Then what are you doing here?
Ah, what's up, Pup? You swam across the sea did yah?
Har. Har. Har. So very very funny. Seriously, before I stick your head in the sand and watch your arms flail around, what do you need?
Nope. Just got the stink of the city on yah and this is a place of luxury.
Buncha bullshit peddlers think hacking boards is the way to make easy money. Yeah... Wait till I find these...
Maybe. No promises. What do you need?
Ah, why didn't yah say so? I'll do yah one better... here.
What are you doing out here, Sage?
Ah just going with the grift you know. Rode a couple rails the wrong way and now making up for it. Not the most exciting gig but hey, runnin' errands is what it is.

dialogues.title: Find the Interface
lines: Whatever you say, chief. Now, anything I can do? This data won't harvest itself.
Can't really remember the exact place... only the general area. And if you find it, don't tell anyone you got directions from me, OK?
Have you ever come across one of the old LifeCorp interfaces to the Old Network anywhere?
Oh, I apologize, I always assume people know what I'm doing. This thing on my back is a Carto-Carry. Little piece of Curzona kit that allows me to map the streets of the city.
Have you ever come across an Old Network interface in the LUZ?
You hear stories about the Old Network. That it's... I dunno... The resting place of CORA or something. Dangerous, ya know?
You got something to say, or you just wanna do a two-step on the sidewalk?
Hey ya know... did see something once. Door in the Space Port marked with an Old Network symbol. Thought it might be some kind of dormant control room. I deleted it from the data.
That's the million dollar question, isn't it? Data's never neutral. Best not to go there.
Crumbling faster than a Corpster's conscience at a charity auction. You got something to say, or just here to block the road?
Won't ask what you want it for, either. Data's trouble. Trust me I know.
I'm looking for information about Old Networks in Nivalis.
Goes without saying. Now, anything I can do? This data won't harvest itself.
Now why would you want one of those? They're useless now. Decommissioned. Deader than dancehall.

dialogues.title: Dotson becomes a friend
lines: Even though my heart may cry out for the successful appointment of my friend as my new business partner.
Do you agree to this course of action which establishes us both as a duo worthy of engaging anecdotes and esteem?
I shall leave you with a taster of the task ahead. Answer me this - what separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?
Very well. Now that we are established as close friends, might I suggest we expand our relationship into a professional one?
Let me be clear, my expectations are exacting. We may already be close friends, best buds, companions beyond compare.
This did not escape my inquisitive, sharp eyes, but was dismissed as insignificant.
Good day. I must apologize for my previous impropriety. I trust you will not consider it a black mark upon my character.
I'm no android though. Just in case.
Await my call. I will have your first task ready. It shall be a difficult one, and yet the easiest of the three challenges. Take faith my friend, you are up to this challenge!
But I must be fair during the interview process, and I cannot lower my standards!
I am willing to pay you handsomely for your services.
But of course! Dotson's Detective Agency: Nivalis' finest, cheapest detectives. Formerly two androids working together, now one seeking a partner. A partner like you.
I believe a friendship like ours can endure a thousand stormy days, but with the sunshine of a lucrative shared vocation, it can also bloom like a glorious garden.
Partnership old friend! I believe a friendship like ours can endure a thousand stormy days.
Please wait till you hear the details of my proposal before you make a final decision
I just like you as a friend.
Let us move on as we progress through the formalities of acquaintance and form a bond of friendship which we will cherish through times both prosperous and perilous.
I ended our conversation so abruptly and without due respect for your gracious time and pleasant company.
Not so hasty my friend. To join my detective agency, you will have to progress through the rigorous entrance exam process. Prepare yourself.
But with the sunshine of a lucrative shared vocation, it can also bloom like a glorious garden.
Prepare an answer, for your first challenge will test your insight, wit, guile and mental aptitude. Good day!

dialogues.title: Dotson - Player Lost
lines: My combined compendium of chess knowledge is simply superior to yours. Now, run along as I welcome the next challenger.
I resent that. Just because I am of the mechanical makeup does not mean I cheated.
Stick to your strengths and you'll solve the mystery of what you should do with your life. Until then!
The mystery of who sucks rooks has been solved!
Don't fret ol' chap. Not everyone is good at a game as complex as chess.

dialogues.title: Marcelle's Memories
lines: If you wish to stand out in Nivalis, you will have to be... adventurous when it comes to ingredients. Do not be afraid to try something new.
Nothing. Too many words on an empty belly, that’s all.
So what does my food say about the future?
A last word before I go?
Did you know, I had the privilege of eating one of the last true cherries to grow on a tree? In a tart made from reconstituted ash-flour pastry.
Do you have any more advice?
Eat at my place, on the house.
What does my food say about the past?
That the future might be even more troublesome than the past.
Bitter and sour, like rain without the water. A space at its heart where a stone should be.
That you might be in more danger than you know.
I've been thinking about how, when we eat, we become time travellers. Slurping down the past, savoring our present and maybe, even, tasting the future.
You’re too kind. But I heard that Mr Danetti is debuting a new donut. Maybe this time he’s got it right.
Are you a critic or a failed poet?

dialogues.title: Talk to Lochlainn happy end
lines: We did it. I'm on my way to Idlehands to get the mask.
It's amazing. I had almost given up... But you gotta hurry, ok? Iann is getting really weak.
It's enough, Lochlainn. More than enough.
I'll send you whatever's left of the money once I've dealt with Idlehands.
I can't bring myself to ask boss... I don't know if I'll be able to take it if we came all this way and failed. Did... did we get enough?
It was close, Lochlainn. But we made it.
It's enough, Lochlainn. With some to spare.
Thank CORA. I can't believe it. I... don't know what to say boss...
He'll be strong again soon. Like his dad.

dialogues.title: Coffee for Cassius
lines: Life, the future, the mantle gravity has cruelly cast down upon my shoulders...
I'm sorry about your parents. How are you doing?

Anywhere but the cup! I used to have to twirl about with my mouth open to catch the drips before they got into the equipment. Or drink it through a straw. But look at this! I can’t believe it’s all just staying in there. What would happen if I poured it on the ground?
Well, gotta run. Enjoy the coffee.
Drinks, then. Until we meet again.
Excellent. I look forward to conversing over our contained fluids.
Less?? I can see why my parents found this place so fascinating.
Perhaps. Tell me, would you care to meet for a brimming receptacle of liquid again some time?
I'm joking. Just enjoy your coffee.
You’ll have wasted a perfectly good coffee?
Is that how you all take your coffee down here? I don't recall ordering such a thing...
You know if you drop something from one of the ledges here it falls right down and keeps falling?
I'm sure they'd be glad to see you here.
Uh, yep. I’ve got your coffee?
Yes. Plus there's a thirty Lim delivery charge.
Oh, yes, now I remember. I wanted to see... Would you look at that? It’s in the cup!
Dark Roast with a Tuna Fish Croissant?
How do elevators work? Why do guests always claim they are on a honeymoon? What on Luna is a pillow mint? These are the questions that keep me up at night.
If I were in space such a thought would be ludicrous! But here, yes, why not. I am asking you "out".
Indeed. Tell me, would you care to meet me for a brimming receptacle of liquid again some time?
Not from you, from life! The future, the mantle gravity has cruelly cast down upon my shoulders...
You're right, what a thought. Now I must get back to this "coffee".
Well yes, but it only costs… you know, I have no idea of what coffee costs down here. What is it, twenty Lims?
I mean, I just found you so...

dialogues.title: Meet Gan Coilson again
lines: Child's play. I was Chief Technical Officer at LifeCorp.
How did you transfer your mind?
How did you become a machine?
Are you sure that's what happened?
The best engineer they ever had. The newest Argen Generation was entirely my concept. Human consciousness - perfectly transferred!
How did you learn to do it?
Someone could have implanted that memory.
But that memory could also be implanted, right?
My robot body? No. It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge. If only I had managed to keep it secret from my wife.
To transfer human consciousness? Child's play. I was Chief Technical Officer at LifeCorp.
Tittle tattle... Just...Don't tell my wife.
It's nearly impossible to manipulate the memory of modern bots. I should know!
It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.

dialogues.title: Second Meet with Gladstone after Curfew
lines: You were so good at sneaking before. If anyone can get hold of a little bit of Reeker, surely you can.
Many. The Rat King could tell you anything you wished to know. And I have come up with a plan to find him...
The rats told me. Didn't you feel their eyes watching you?
I'd say that's a pretty clear message considering they're rodents.
The rats, don't you feel their thankful eyes on you?
I have the gnawing feeling I've been played.
Do they know any other secrets?
Not just any cheese. Green Reeker. The most pungent cheese ever created. Highly flammable. Illegal in seventeen districts.
You did it! You destroyed my old traps, every one!
The rats are not very good with such details, considering they're rodents.
Piece of cake. Where do I get it?
So I'm not getting paid before ...
Yes, of course. The rats say that Quince Crogan hides a secret in his shop...
I'm not risking my neck for cheese.
Oh, rats don't play. And they don't lie. But they don't understand the concept of property or locks. Or death.
Humph. Well, the rats thank you anyway. They won't forget.
Can the rats be more specific?
And the rats will help you in return! They told me that Quince Crogan hid a secret in his shop...
Let me guess: you want me to find some?
I don't know... if I did I would have tried myself. Ask one of the illegal traders. They keep their salty secrets close.

dialogues.title: Time to Play
lines: I'm not playing hide and seek with him.
Understood. Though it's, what do you call it, funny? That you think you have a choice.
I'm referring to Silo Mills. The odd little fellow with the blood all over him.
Is this about the creepy kid who probably killed his parents or whoever?
I'm not saying you have to find him. I'm saying he thinks you're playing hide and seek and hasn't been seen since counting to ten.
You really think that's blood on him?
I scanned all the street cams and I believe he might be out on the Oil Rig.
I do, but that's not the point. He's been missing since you started playing hide and seek with him.
Ok, so I think I should point out that you have effectively lost a child.
Of course. Unless of course they're dead. I'm not saying he probably did it, but I am saying he... yeah, no he probably did it.
I have to find him don't I?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 17
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Forget that pesky work-life balance. Embrace the glorious harmony of the Curzona 'work-work' balance. (Patent pending)

dialogues.title: Ava simulates worry
lines: You were searching through her trash?
I found reference to a recent Aseptic incident that did involve an elderly couple. It stands out as most of Aseptics victims are younger.
No let's not waste our only opportunity to do this on a stranger.
But there are many dangers. Are you worried?
If I were fully human, worry would be exactly how I felt. How do you feel?
I'll see if I can dig up any info on the networks.
People are shockingly careless with their personal data..
Well, as you might expect, the Pierreponts will have changed their name in the spirit of the poverty roleplay.
I did, however find reference to a recent Aseptic incident that did involve an elderly couple. It stands out as most of Aseptics victims are younger.
Good idea! what did you find.
Well, I'm wondering if the roleplay went too far, could they be mistaken for the real deal?
That could be anyone, what makes you think it's the Pierreponts?
There was a report memo left lying around in Gamova's digital refuse area.
So what did you find out?
Hmmm I don't think I can contact her directly but it might be that I can access some of her personal files through the connection. Could be risky though.
Cassius seems pleasant. I will not enjoy disappointing him.
Sadly not, I fear her access to hackware will far exceed anything we will be able to put in place. Would you like me to try?
The rich don't tend to do things by halves.
I will bear that in mind for next time.
Ok I think I found something.
Will it mean she won't be able to contact us again?
How far do you think this Pov-Play stuff goes?
I wish the news were different.
Well if I do it, she's going to close the loophole, it will probably be something we can only do once.
Sure, Cassius deserves to know where his parents are.
But hardly deserves the death penalty.
Hmmm, maybe she left something behind when she left?
Thank you! Well, as you might expect, the Pierreponts will have changed their name in the spirit of the poverty roleplay.
A succinct way of looking at it!
I mean it's not really our problem.
Their names were registered as Phillip and Carol Poorepont... As in Poor-e-pont
Yes, I get it. Well I guess we should tell Cassius.
Do you think we could contact Gamova? She might know.
We would have found the bodies. Rheno didn't hide them. He wanted to make a statement.

dialogues.title: Calhoun Makes his Offer
lines: I don't want to borrow anything.
So why don't you move somewhere better?
'cos the act of angling is the only good thing in this stinking dunghill of a place and I'll be damned if I let them take it away from me.
You keep telling yourself that, sweetheart. Well, you know where I am.
Macrogillean. The Baron of the Bay. The biggest fish ever seen in these parts. Some say he's over a thousand years old, scales so scarred and barnacled they look like microchips.
Aye. Pretty decent, don't you think?
So how much can you give me?
Done. Remember you got to pay it back. If you don't, you can expect a visit from my boys. Savvy?
Look, soft-shoeing around won't help, it'll just piss me off. How much?

The Carp Diem. My old club. Mine, before those chum-buckets threw me out. Banned me from fishing any of the good spots in the Docks. Me! I was Barracuda Buddy three years in a row! I was the Prince of Perch!
You don't know who you're dealing with, do you?
For someone like you? 5000 Lims is my limit. I'll take a 20% interest.
That fish let me catch him. Looked me right in the eye then spat my lure back at me.
You know, not many people ask me about terms. What are you, some kinda Corpo grass?
Yeah well, you ain’t the only one to take tea with the bastards. Alright, terms. I only got one policy.
Nice to know where your interests lie.
Then kindly fuck off. Before this scintillating conversation makes me swoon.
Jealousy. They said I broke the fisherman's code. Never lie about your catch.
Transparency is the key to good customer relations.
I call it “limbs for Lims”. I loan you some Lims. You pay them back again or you can forget ever coming crying to me again.
Why did they throw you out?
Maybe you should try fishing in another spot?
How much can you lend me?
Don't waste time do you? Straight in with the demands. No niceties, no “nice to see you Mr Calhoun, how’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?”
You think I like fishing here? Dredging up freak eels and mutant lobsters? You ever tried to gut a fish with hands instead of fins?
Look, when I say I caught the Macrogillean, I'm telling CORA's honest truth.
Eh, I can tell you don't give a shit. But I'll give you some credit for faking it. Maybe we can do some business.
How’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?
Found me, did ya? Took ya long enough.
Cora, this is like getting blood from a stone. What you bothering me for, then? You're scaring the fish.
‘S about the shape of it, yeah. So, you want these Lims?
Alright, alright. Terms. I only got one policy.
Give me strength... I am a loan shark. You are here for a loan. So say how much you wanna borrow or get out of my water.

dialogues.title: Discuss the missing leg with Ava
lines: What do you think Aengus is doing with that leg?
Well, we should probably get hot on his heels...
I'm not even convinced he has it.

dialogues.title: Mica A Blaze of Neon Glory
lines: It's what I KNOW you have. I can SMELL it on you. Evidence. Proof of your wrongdoing.
I'll do what I can, AFTER you give me what I want.
Freya is in hiding on Calypso Island.
We have business. Let's get it over with. Your time is up. I need you to do something... I need you to admit YOU LOSE.
Before I help you I need protection for someone I care about.
I need to know that I will be in the clear after this is all done.
Before I help you I need protections in place.
Not so fast. Before I agree to let you go, for now, I need you to say it. Say the words. I want you to say "I LOSE."
What? You look like you're hiding something.
I need guarantees that you will help those kids after you take down Freya.

Freya's arrest is the first step to bringing down Conland Containers, then the whole Network. Once The Network is dismantled, everyone will be back in their rightful place and we'll all go back to normal.

I don't know whether or not to be impressed by your moxie. Even in the face of an inevitable end, you're still trying to figure out how you lost. Unfortunately, it won't do you any good. Unless you want to point me in another direction... With sufficient evidence of course.
What do you think I have?
Freya is with her associate Alexandria on Calypso Island.
Freya thinks CorpSec can't reach her while she's hiding on Calypso.
And I HAVE her! After all this time, I finally have her! My time has come.
A fool to the end. So prideful. It will cost you. When I'm done with Freya, I'll be back to finish you.
I can give you what you want, but I need something in return.
After a thorough investigation of your business, your transactions and delivery records, as well as a conveniently placed tip about a specific item you have on your person...

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus knows something
lines: Yes. Are we already companions? I do not recall a previous meeting.
I am getting some very strange readings from him. I detect no active Automata, and his heart beats once every ten seconds.
Well if it was, you'll never know. You don't know where he is. I've checked.
Why did you send Gideon after me?
What do you want from me?
It's nice you assume that, because you don't know. And that's why we don't have anything further to discuss.
Why are you looking for Thaddeus?
Be cautious. Anyone who can afford Grey Tech is likely to have other defenses... Though I detect no intrusion tech so far.
Don't send any more bounty hunters after me.
Yes, yes. Well, what do you want? I don't have a lot of time. Or I have too much time... depending on your perspective.
It takes a minute for my mind to focus. Like an old camera, if you know what such a thing is. But I see you now. Clearly.
A bounty hunter? What do you mean? I seek no bounty.
You know what I'm talking about.
So it was all about Thaddeus?

I know one thing about you. You can find me. Not a difficult task, but not an easy one either. But during this saeculum, you're not close enough to glimpse more than a fragment of the truth. I'll see you again, maybe next time round the wheel.
I know you don't. That's why we have nothing else to discuss.

dialogues.title: Replace the poisoned mustard
lines: Because last I checked, yellow mustard is ok, but mustard that turns your customers yellow, not good.
And from a more trustworthy source. I have no idea what the previous owner was doing, but Thaddeus sure made some... bad choices.
Out of the last 10 customers who used our mustard, three have needed liver transplants. That's not a good ratio.
Hey Boss, have you checked on your customers lately?
No big bother. Your business license protects you from repercussions. But I suggest we get some new mustard soon.
Mustard poisoning has always been a problem in Nivalis, even back in my day. They used to call it "spiking the yellow." That's why you need reputable suppliers.

dialogues.title: Ashwin has a second proposal
lines: Results AND a proposal? What proposal?
Ashwin has results and another proposal.

dialogues.title: Crabface's Sea Yarns
lines: Now that you mention it: it's been a while?
Sounds as if you’d like to see for yourself.
Or maybe he found a way out.
Yeah. A real good way to die.
What do you think? Testing your radiation resistance.
Do you think that’s where he went?
Science. Pah! When did science ever help in a stage 5 typhoon?
You city folk. Always busy, flapping your feet and poking at your HUDs. When was the last time you sat and watched the way rainbows shimmer on a sturgeon’s scales?
You city folk. When was the last time you sat and watched the way rainbows shimmer on the waves?
Urban fishing galore. Sewer fish is good for one thing.
Hey, I've been to the islands already.
Sounds inviting. How do I get there?
Metal leggy thing in the sea. Used to drill for oil.
You get me that rust remover yet, lubber?
Pah. Fool’s yarns and sea foam, that’s all. Your old boss used to talk about seeing it one day.
With magic flying shoes. By boat, what the hell do you think? You’ll find your way there soon enough.
People troubles. It’s what happens on land.
What would a lubber know about it? Go on, scram. And don’t come back ‘til you got some salt on your skin.
You haven't left this bay yet, have you? Shoulda known better.
Aye. As far as the Oil Rig and the Islands. As far as the CorpSec buoys.
Have you ever been to sea?
Others say if you drift for 500 days and 500 nights the winds will take you to Sang-Ha.
Didn't you say there's nothing out there.
I guess I’ve been distracted. With the LUZ and the killer and everything.
Thaddeus could spin a yarn better than any mariner on these docks. He could make you believe anything’s possible. All talk, if you ask me.
Some say if you keep sailing long enough, you’ll meet yourself coming back the other way.
Some folk say there ain’t. That past the buoys it's an endless ocean.
What, were you born with your head in a bucket? Half this city has metal skin. Try the Industrial Zone. Or the Sewers.
Land bits in the sea. Covered in palm trees and CEOs. All the sand you can eat.
I’m not sure where to look.
Of course I’m right. None of us going nowhere.
Who knows? But the journey... that would be real.

dialogues.title: Hire Dal
lines: I'm not part of a sanctioned Cleaning Corp.
I'm an unlicensed contractor. I can clean without any Corp oversight. Cleaning without the hidden fees! Consider it.

dialogues.title: Find the plaque
lines: Do you know anyone who can read it?
It is written in Sang-Ha sailor’s cant. I’m afraid I don’t have a dictionary available.
Can you tell what it says?
Thaddeus could. But apart from him, one of your more, ahem, maritime friends might be able to help.
It looks like the name plaque from a boat...

dialogues.title: Ava reveals landlord troubles
lines: The situation with accommodation in Nivalis is... precarious. Losing your property at this time could lead to homelessness.
My records show this flat is owned by a certain Mr Pilk Dane.
Might I advise caution in this endeavor.
I recommend you meet with your landlord and get to the bottom of this. As the Comms are down, simply calling him is impossible.
Hyper-gentrification has led to extreme housing shortages. The LUZ has made the situation considerably worse.
I'll add a Nav Point. It seems he wants to talk with you too...
I am not sure. But I notice your current residence has an outstanding eviction notice. Indeed, potential tenants are already scheduled to view your apartment.
Aren't people RUNNING AWAY FROM the serial killer?
I guess that's just good business.
I inherited this flat. Who is the landlord?
How long will they keep up the LUZ, now that we found the killer?
Sounds like trouble. Where can I find him?
I guess this is where the best parties are now.
Have you paid this months rent?
No. Quite the opposite. Leaving the LUZ is forbidden, but a considerable number of tourists and opportunists are sneaking INTO the LUZ.
Then I hope he's not the type to hold a grudge.
Well, I say sneaking... but really they are simply paying a fee and signing a waiver that "death may occur" within the quarantine zone.

Crisis breeds opportunity. And curiosity. There are Aseptic T-shirt sellers, Aseptic Walking Tours, Aseptic Murder Experiences... and of course some people just want to be where the stories are happening.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 16
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
You can never ask for too much advice!

dialogues.title: Salt Pete tells you about your boat
lines: It's yours. I mean as long as you've stepped aboard once. You have stepped aboard, right?
Come back in a few days and see me when you've got some salt in your hair. I got a few goals left on my bucket list, and maybe you can help me with one of em.
Well technically the Putter belongs to me, Crabface and Foamheart, but I owned the original engine, and that's been replaced.
So you had a boat but it's not yours anymore?
Right. And the next person who gets onboard can claim it... if they register with the Shipping Guild. That's why I reckon you're the new Mariner.
Well, I got a few goals left on my bucket list, and maybe I can tell you about one of them. But not now. Take the boat out for a sail first. We'll talk once you're the registered Captain.
Those are sea legs if ever I saw em. I got good eyes. I know most of the folks round here couldn't handle a boat like The Putter. But you could. I bet Thaddeus thought the same.
Sure! It's yours. I mean as long as you've stepped aboard once. You have stepped aboard, right?
I wonder what he thinks about all that rust on your boat.
There’s more to the Nivalis oceans than sentient slime, junk HOVA’s and ancient, God-like AI’s that lie dreaming dark dreams.
You're welcome young Mariner. Take the boat out for a sail. We'll talk again once you're the registered Captain.
You've seen "The Putter?" The boat over there?
I thought you were the new Mariner?
I get a boat. So what's in it for you?
Foamheart owns the hull, but that got eaten up by rust and every inch got resurfaced. Crabface had the ship license, but that lapsed.
Wait, did you tell ole Crabface you're the new Mariner yet?

dialogues.title: Salt Pete explains the treasure
lines: If you want us to find the pieces of your former Captain, why the riddles?
To give you a chance to prove yourself! And for fun. Fun is very underrated. But what's the point of anything if we're not having fun?
"Golden shores hide golden treasure. Looking here is your last resort."
Well... that's a good piece to find first!
I assume this whole thing is about closure for you?
I assume you need the rest of her?
We... let her down. She was the best Captain to ever sail The Gridless Sea, but when she needed her crew to step up and follow her example... we let her down. And we lost her to the waves.
So you found the first piece of the treasure!
I got another clue for ya.
We should continue our search. I think this riddle is even better than the last!
"She." Captain Andalucia Ophelia Marquez the Third.
I don't think this is much fun.
Just wait till we put the Cap'n back together! Then things will really get salty!

dialogues.title: Lucy Lovelace, Style Consultant
lines: Did we talk about furniture yet? Same principle. Exploit their bad taste and give the people what they want, no matter how fugly.
I guess I need to think about what opportunities are out there.
And then I go for the biggest group I guess?
I am frequently scandalized by the awful taste of the public. Try to choose something that appeals to a broad swathe of the masses.
I thought we were selling noodles...
If not, store the tat away until you open a restaurant where it fits.
I guess I'm fine for now.
The profile of my customers. How do I learn more about my patrons?
You have to dream a little larger darling. You're selling a concept, not just noodles.
Maybe you start with the basics?
And everything that does not work here might become useful somewhere else.
So it will fit somewhere eventually? Got it.
None? There must be a reason for that...
I'm just being pragmatic. I know good taste, but I also know what people like. They seldom overlap.
It's about finding a gap in the market. For instance, there is currently no restaurant at all in the Stacks.
So it comes down to the target group again?
The attitude you chose for your place needs to attract the right kind of customers. Who is your target demographic? Workers? Hipsters? People with taste and money - like me?
And I guess it's a trial and error principle: Buy the stuff and find out.
I guess I need to think about the type of customer I want to attract...
Tables and chairs only get you so far. It's the ornamentals that will send your venue into legendary status with your target group.
Sure, or you target a smaller demographic that doesn't have a place to go yet. Think beyond the mainstream.
Personally I'd say it's a waste of time, but depending on your target group, you will need some.
Might be worth the risk, though.
How do I choose the right furniture for the right customers?
Trial and error. Buy items and see how they effect your target group. If it resonates, commit to it, no matter how tacky their choices.
This noodle stand - it doesn't know, what it wants to be. It has no direction.
Check your statistics. Your customer acquisition system knows the social status of each of your customers.
Let's get to work on this place. What do you need to know?
The noodles are just your entry ticket to the competition. To beat your rivals, you need attitude.
Certainly. Anything else you need to know?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 20
lines: The early bird gets the worm, and the overachiever gets the corner office.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: The crypt opens
lines: Thaddeus birth date really worked. the code was correct. What can you see?

dialogues.title: Bannor discusses the state of Nivalis
lines: How do you know which future I dream of?
Well if it ain't a future where you eat out the trash recombinator, some stuff has got to change.
Oh, don't be. I'm sure we're fine.
Maybe we're in the wrong business...
There are no more farms since the acid rains started fallin'... greenhouses!

Look, I wasn't sure about the serial killer chat. "The Aseptic"? Sounded like scaremongering to me. But now... I'm not so sure. And the LUZ hasn't exactly been a problem for the people who count. The decision makers.
Hey boss, looks like you're settling in ok. How about an update?
Talk to Clem in the Docks. She owes me a favor.
It's sick! I hate the corps... But it's good for us?
The boom will last a while, but it ain't permanent. Now's the time to make some money and invest in a second restaurant. But for that you gotta increase your profit!
The veggies cost us a fortune every day! The greengrocer right now is probably looking for a condo in the Spire.
It's all because of the LUZ. The Localized Unity Zone has taken a lot of stuff offline. I don't know why though. How does taking the Comms offline stop a serial killer?

Well, where should we start? The LUZ isn't going away any time soon. Comms are still down. And the noodle business... well it might pay the bills... just. But it ain't gonna fund the future you dream of.
And how would I do that?
Let's talk about the noodle bar.
Carrots shouldn't cost more than gold.
How? I haven't seen any farms in Nivalis.
It's all about the corps. Business is up. Gawkers have flooded into the area. It's become trendy. Drink, dance and dine in the streets where the serial killer stalks the unwary!
I thought the business was doing ok?
How does this all affect us?
How about growing our own veggies?

dialogues.title: Saying Hi to Sanya
lines: Oh. I'm sorry, I just assumed. That's on me. When you spend so much time looking through glass you get tunnel vision. Kinda ironic when you think about it.
Don't sound to happy about that.
Do you have any idea where she'd go?
Her professor came to my restaurant and seemed worried.
When was the last time you saw her?
Professor Remo asked me to find you.
Photographers are supposed to be unbiased. We see and capture everything and anything. Being too honed on one perspective is really the opposite.
Right, which means you should probably look in other places?
You're not kidding. I used to like how the camera captured truth. That was the whole thing, right? Before all this neural-generated holo imagery started floating around everywhere.
I'm not looking to have my picture taken.
Honestly, I'm kind of into her.
I remember her complaining that there wasn't any water or anything. Yeah, no, she definitely preferred with water.
Trying to help out a friend.
Oh. That's it? She's probably off on a come down from splurging on a "Level Up!" session.
What do you take pictures of?
Sorry, I stopped shooting portraits a few years ago. Camera's got a different purpose now.
Then why are you asking about Zee?
Something you love turned into work, huh?
Apparently you haven't known Zee for very long. Which begs the question, why do you care?
I don't know. I don't think so.
She had left the Docks though.
A handful of times. She used to date this guy, Finlay--used to joke that he was Fine-ly. She did not have the best sense of humor but you can't hold that against her.
I did, despite the fact that I got my foot stuck in a fissure. Thought I was gonna have to hack it off at the ankle! Anyway, that was for a bit. I haven't seen Zee since before then.
It pays the bills. That's all I can ask for.
I'm questioning that more and more. Any who, what can I do for you?
Neural-generated is still true. Just straight from the brain.
Interesting... She hasn't mentioned you before. But again, that's kind of like Zee. She's in her own world most of the time. Sometimes I think you have to be high to even be near her level.
Do you know where she liked to hang out?
There are definitely some good angles to shoot out on that floatin' hunk of an industrial step-child.
Really? Care to explain a little bit more?

Look, Zee tended to wander off quite a bit. She always talked about places beyond the grid, finding neutrality and all that jazz. If I had to guess, she finally found one, which good for her if she did.
Mhm... Well, Zee's kinda her own bird if you know what I mean. Doesn't really fly in a flock or anything like that.
I actually sling food for a living.
I don't know... Any where with a view? She wanted to see everything, not just what the feeds and ad boards showed.
I think I know her well enough.
If you knew her you'd know her dreams brought her into the air. That she liked that line were the sky and the sea nestled together. What did she say? Where they rock one another.
If you're head's down that low I wouldn't bother looking for Zee. Trust me.
Eh, maybe. Wait, I remember I did a photo shoot there once - a flash scene at sunrise and she came along.
Have you been there with her?
Oh, ummmm, well I've been on an assignment for a bit, and this whole nightmare trip to the Wastes to try and capture a fungi that blooms once every seventeen years.

dialogues.title: Ava reminds you about Hynthia
lines: Hynthia had her day in court yesterday.
Given that the case was about accusations of poisoning customers, I thought you might be interested in the outcome?

dialogues.title: Mica At Home
lines: I know all about Edison's little network. Like a primitive version of adaptive marketing software, trying to bend and twist and reach new consumers while leaving those behind hollowed out and broken.
And those he "helped" can then be exploited. Nobody knows they still exist.
Yeah, I brought some take away from the stand to a friend of his. So?
Competition. He courts other lenders, gives them a report of who's moving through his network, who they owe and how much.
That's it. Let that weight off your shoulders. Welcome to the right side of the fold.
Edison Mattix needs to understand that people are given a lot in life and they need to adapt to that lot. Trying to pull them out of it or change it goes against the code running this program.
Helping his niece? He doesn't have a niece. He's running a trafficking network to take a cut of the gen debt he's erasing.
No idea what you're talking about.
How does Edison make money off this?
And if I don't tell you?
I wonder, will today be a good day?
Noooo! Please stay. This has been so much fun.

I know, right? Personally, I'd rather cut my own arm off than sign on that dotted line. There are plenty that do though. See, that's the problem: everyone thinks they're a few good months from hitting big when the truth is they're a few bad days from sleeping under a bridge.
Then, the competition will say something like, "we'll pay you five percent of their gen debt if you make them disappear."
Well. They say stupidity is contagious. I guess hanging around with that deadbeat smuggler has done a number on you.
I'm fortunate enough to have feet upon which I walk.
I'll be back in a few days. Then either your decision has changed - or your life will change drastically.
You're mad he's trying to help his niece?
That's an option, albeit not a good one. If you think having the poisoning of a handful of people is too much, just wait. I'll line your life with guilt, death, and debt.
I'm not helping you. But you already knew that.
And why would I? My duty extends beyond my orders.
He's skirting the law and skimming off the top. Think about it: someone winds up with a mound of Gen Debt. Sorry parents, you're out of luck.
Tale it easy. Hear me out.
Benefit of being 'Sec. Now we get to chat without the busy bustle of the streets around us, drowning out words, twisting meanings. Just a nice, easy chat.
Edison gets paid, and his client's competition loses a shit-ton of Lims. Not that hard to figure out.
I didn't expect you would give up.
Besides the fact that he poisoned over half-a-dozen people and left the blame on you?
As much fun as this has been (thank you for having me) I'm afraid we're going to need to wrap it up. You know, things to do, work never ends because people never stop dying.
What do you really want with Edison?
You better get out of here.
Sorry, Mica. I can't help you.
Honey, the answer to that question depends on you. And your attitude.
Chat? I don't want to chat with you.
In the opposite direction? Care to try again?
Mhm. And if I took a look inside your neurons? Cracked your skull like the shell of a crustacean and analyze the meat inside?
What do you want with Edison?
That money is owed to different players. Banks, corps, even 'Sec gives out some loans if you're desperate enough for 74.6% API to sound appealing.
Even if that were the case, and we both know that it's not, you're telling me you wouldn't use a HOVA-dasher?
Don't worry, once I leave you'll be wishing I was still here. But, before I go, let me give you one more chance to make this easy on yourself: tell me where Edison Mattix is.
We need to talk seriously. I know someone cleansed your record. You might be clear from 'Sec, for now, but you're not clear of me.
Look, you recently went on a run for a friend of yours. Eddy? Tell me a little about that.
It was on my way home.
Still doesn't explain why you're looking for him.
How did you get in here?
No, I mean how'd you get in my apartment?

dialogues.title: Dr Fred's Scotch Bonnet
lines: I have a coffee for you.
If you'd got them from a reputable source, it wouldn't have happened.
Those drugs you gave me were bad. Cut with CORA knows what. I lost two patients.
Didn’t think you’d dare show your face around here again.
No time to eat, so the more stuff I can get in a coffee, the better. Don’t suppose you brought my ramen order too? That way I can just pour the coffee into the noodles.
If I wasn't a doctor, I would break your nose. Now get away from me.
Strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float?
Whatever. Just give it to me?
Well, you didn't. So say what you want and get out of my sight.
Oh, yes. Thank CORA, give it here.
Why are you such a jerk? That's not my coffee!
No... It's your order from Coffee PoccoCup.
No... Please say you didn't bring the wrong thing. I don't have the energy.
Fine, one Strawberry Gateaux Choc Bomb.
I'm not taking anything from you.
Thanks. And now I have to get back.
You asked for the drugs, I got them. I did my part.
You think that makes things better?

dialogues.title: Mary Nyx Staging Request
lines: You are quite possibly the most tiresome person I have ever met. And the stupidest. Enjoy poverty, you pathetic reptile.
I have a property in my portfolio that I've grown tired of. A dull little apartment. It needs furnishing.
I'm not taking a single Lim from you.
Ah, just the person I was hoping to see. I have an opportunity for you.
The outlay will be yours, of course. But do as I ask and you stand to make a profit. That I can guarantee.
Excellent. The furnishings must be of the highest quality, of course. Enough to impress the silly reptile brains of potential buyers.
Because the market is simply too ignorant to appreciate my tastes. It needs a... common touch. Something insipid enough to appeal to the masses.
Why don't you do it yourself?
Mmf. You again. Much as it pains me to say it, I might have a job for you.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 33
lines: Time to wake up. This day won’t live itself.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Harper waiting
lines: Harper is at the Noodle Bar. She doesn't look happy.

dialogues.title: Safia is worried
lines: I need a calm work environment.
I get it, boss. It's just ... I don't want to hurt him. He's such a lamb.
Look, I'll try to keep this stuff out of work. I'll take care of it boss.
Are you a bit distracted? Over Ashwin?
You might need to hurt him if this is threatening my business.
Nothing. He's a nice guy. I like him. He's just a friend. Yesterday he was being a bit strange around me though.
Okay. That might have been my fault.
I hear you boss. I'll take care of it.
Oh yeah, I guess a little.
Did you talk with him? I know he's sweet on me.

dialogues.title: Ava has a price tag
lines: No. But something will come our way. I'm sure.
That's not as expensive as I thought. And worth it to help you.

dialogues.title: Lims on Lims on Lims
lines: Neon Gods. Yeah, it is. Now why are you here? Are you looking to play or what?
Okay, yup. Yup. Uh-huh. I gotta - yeah - look... alright, gotta go bye. Whoooo. Sorry about that. Wait - who are you? Do you play?
Hey, hold on a sec - Artemis... Artemis! Don't hang up. I guarantee I can get the seats filled before the flag drops, yeah?
You should donate some to get the trains fixed.
Anything. I can get you on the boards for whatever, long as you win. Could make you Lims right here.
Sometimes I make a stack a minute.
Love the lure of easy Lims, huh? Alright, come back tomorrow and I'll show you how it runs.
Eh, a DeepNet river flowing to a business acquaintance. Have quite a few of 'em running. I'll suffer a short before I let the 'Sec's bullshit keep me from Lims.
So? Do you play or not?
When Sec comps me for all the business lost due to the Comms bullshit, not to mention locking us in this part of Nivalis like we're in isolation or something? Yeah, maybe then I'll think about it.
How were you on the Comms just now?
You know why I hang out here? Why Metro Hub is the place to be, specifically this spot?
Once you learn the routes it's pretty easy to gamble on delays.
Look over there. Those red and green lights? Every train in Nivalis is on that board at some point, and every one of them has a time of arrival and a time of departure.

dialogues.title: Ava is upset
lines: And making me feeling depressive and lonely helps?
I have to say that I'm not sure how to deal with that.
I better switch myself off when you meet her again.
About whom are you talking then?
About your stupid relatives. But not you!
Come on. She's depressive, lonely and I just help her killing time.
We're not even talking about you!
Ah. And you think I have to bear serial offenses.
Good to know what you're thinking of me.

dialogues.title: Visit DeeDee
lines: Did he now? Well you can head straight back to the old ruin and tell him I have no interest.
Ever notice that all the victims are childless? Every time Aseptic takes one of us out, he or she or it ends the line of credit. Debt orphanism is the most profitable asset the Corpsters have.
No you little Oogle! The opposite. I haven't seen the Corpsters this scared in a long time.
Maybe. I can't see that happening until they want it to. The Aseptic wrote the rules of this game and we have to learn how to play.
You think Aseptic is a Corpo?
What about the people it affects? Do they agree to the plot? Hardly. They must be stopped.
But Aseptic only targets the poor.
While I remember, please give this to Huckstash. I recorded it a long time ago.
Hundreds of lives are in danger.
You Wallet-Walkers spend so much time living in the gutter that it becomes impossible to see the big picture. Why do you think The Aseptic does what they do?
Huckstash mentioned you might have seen the Aseptic.
Exactly! And as my great grandfather Leopold Kemp Jr. used to say 'Follow the Money'.
Back then, we... I had a kid, people with kids are no interest to The Aseptic, no opportunity to close the debt line.
Aseptisists? This city really is messed up.
You think Huckstash could be the Aseptic?
It doesn't matter who The Aseptic is, it matters what The Aseptic is. For the growing number of Aseptisists, the killer is a symbol. Man, Woman, Android, doesn't matter.
Look at me Oogle. Really look at me. Do you think I'm sneaking off in the night and murdering the poor?
I didn't see how he did it because I was wrapped in my sleep sack. I heard a voice in the dark. Assumed it was Fig-Wig, some random vagrant we'd picked up that week. Young lad.
Look around you Oogle. The suffering that runs through the drains of Nivalis was not something invented by The Aseptic. It's older, more rotten. The Aseptic is a symptom.
Even if you're right. They must be stopped.
You had a kid back then? Not now?
If people paid their debts off they'd be fine.
Thought it best not to listen.
I mean, it sounds exactly like you're a cop...
I ain't going anywhere but that has nothing to do with you.
You spend enough time on the rails you see stuff that's gonna get inside your bones. You do your best to bury it mostly but those words will live inside me until I take the last wind.
What does that have to do with a serial killer?

Hundreds? Only hundreds? What about the millions that will die at the hands of the corporations over the next century, crushed under the weight of their ancestors' debts until their eyes bulge from their faces? What about us?
I'm not sure. I'm being coerced into investigating something I'd rather avoid.
This is absurd. He's a psychopath. Regardless of his motive.
I'm just pulling your rope kid, Huckstash's knees gave out decades ago. If he were the Aseptic, he'd still be at the first crime scene.
I find it suspicious that you seem to know so much.
Yeah. That was it. I barely heard him leave. That's when I knew there had been a third person in that box car, Fig-Wig's body was still there. Never saw him coming.
I appreciate that. I'll take it off your hands.
You think Aseptic is targeting the debt, not the people?
Enough of the games. People's lives are at stake.
I've seen a lot but I ain't got the shins for murder.
Fucking Huckstash. Never could keep his rice-hole closed. Listen I don't talk to cops anymore.
I'm not an Oogle, Huckstash sent me.
That's not a track we're going down Oogle.
Ever known CorpSec enforce a lockdown for a serial killer before now?
Because I saw The Aseptic. back when he was working the rails. I watched him doing his thing in a boxcar.
You listened to it?? Fine I'll take it but only because I don't want my business being ogled by Oogles.
Exactly. What do the Corpsters fear more than death? Being broke. That's what Aseptic represents.
Oh you'd be surprised little Oogle.
His voice... It sounded soft. He said 'You are the cure'.
You must have got your head stuck in a boom-tube and lost your hearing, I ain't interested!... what is it?
Just don't leave town any time soon.
Even if I had, why would I talk to you about it?
Fuck them. I'm freelance. I need to know if you saw the Aseptic.
Huckstash sent me here for a reason...
Spent 97% of my life running from cops, and the other 3% being ignored when I needed them. I don't talk to cops.
Was that it? Are you just Huck's messenger tool?
Huckstash has his own agenda or maybe he's trying to throw you off the scent!
Long time since an Oogle came this far out.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus Meeting 1
lines: How'd you like to be a business owner, kid?
Just... away. And soon. But before I go, you wanna piece of advice?
Every day in Nivalis, you have to make a choice. You gotta lift people up, or you gotta step on them. Won't always be a matter of right and wrong. But you gotta choose. That's all.
I don't know anything about running a restaurant.
No time like the present. And at present, I gotta be somewhere else.
By all means, take your time. It's not like we have a business to run.
Always dreamed of being an entrepreneur.
Sounds a lot like hard work.
Are you in some kind of trouble?
Banor will show you the ropes. That old goat knows this place better than anyone. And Ava... listen to her. She can't come with me where I'm going.
Well, it's your lucky day. This old place, it's yours.
Don't put yourself down. You got potential. And I'm giving you a chance to use it. This old place, it's yours.
I got... some things I need to do. Somewhere else.
The noodle bar. It's yours. I'm giving it to you.
I don't think there's a word for the situation I'm in. But that's not your problem. You got this place to think about now.
I know you young folks can run late, but I'm not going to live forever you know. We have work to do.

dialogues.title: Rheno's Goodbye
lines: Of course, as she grew weaker, the debt grew too, and the rest of my life became a footnote on a Curzona balance sheet.
There will be those who will question my execution - pun un-intended - but ultimately, the sacrifice will have been worth it. Aseptic's victims have fought in the most important war and won.
It's like in those old crime novels. The ones in books - printed on real paper.
I do enjoy crime novels... normally.
Strange, right? The last words printed on paper were lost long before my generation of Automata...
I want to know everything. Play the message Ava.
If I were to guess, the idea of a debt orphan murdering other debt orphans would have felt alarmingly hypocritical considering his motives.
And for some reason I don't quite understand it sounds like he needed ME to make the data transfer.
By my estimations, I have permanently wiped out trillions in future debt. I just hope it's enough.
I learned on the job how to be clean and how to hit Curzona hardest, and here we are.
He took the cowards way out.
Ciao for now, Shoku, I'll tell Thaddeus you said hello.
I am not sure. I am still processing. I will get back to you. But the upload succeeded. For now, let's make sure Gamova is taken care of.
Well, here we are. I must be lying on the ground behind you. I wonder who's gonna clean this up? Hopefully, not Fletcher. That guy couldn't find a bloodstain in a bath.
For this to mean anything, he had to be the final victim.
Anyway: Rheno left files in my system, together with instructions on how to publish them to all major networks.
He talks about Curzona debt demands and brags about the debt he has erased and how it will damage the corporation's bottom line. He thinks he's a martyr.
Sure. Rheno did all of this for Thaddeus. At least he claims that's true. And he correctly assumes he's now lying dead on the floor behind us.
This whole thing has been like trying to cook a Hobo's roast without burning the Sludge-Worm.
May I ask for your reasons?
I can't believe this! Play the rest.
Doesn't make a lot of sense to me.
I used Ava one last time. She doesn't even know what I did. It's not her fault. But you'll learn she still has a role to play.
The world needs to know this was worth something. Maybe it was worth everything.
You know, a debt enforcer once tried to bribe me into having another child after she died, just so the credit line wouldn't end with me?
On second thoughts, let's hand it over.
From here on it's just a confession document. He sent the file to us. Like the letter from beyond death in an old crime novel.
We need to decide what to do with these files.
We don't need to know the whole story. Can you summarize Ava?
Down to business. Attached to this document is my confession and economic-manifesto.
On second thoughts. Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.
Doctors did what they could, but it was costly - so costly that I had to take up the aftermath job just to pay off the debt.
The one micro-mercy of Synthia's passing is that she has been released from this mad world.
Not a fan of crime novels.
But when you turned up, I realized the old man had made good on his plans. Good for him, I say.
Their sacrifice will be written across the sky in stars. They are the cure.
I think you'd agree there is a lot of strange things about you Ava.
Just do a summary of the rest Ava.
Why didn't he do it himself?
He confesses he was The Aseptic. He was a debtor because of the health costs for his daughter. She died in the end.
The world eventually returns to a kind of normality. Better for Curzona, but a return to the status quo for the citizens.
I digress. Curzona must be close now. To answer the burning question, yes, once I took my own life, I became the final victim of Aseptic.
Nivalis needs the corps to survive and we can't risk another blood-bath like this one. Asepticism is dangerous. Plus it will get them off our backs.
Once they got that damn fixer involved, things got more complicated.
I feel a kind of... déjà vu. Books printed on paper? I... remember. I've read crime novels like that.
The last will and testament of a mass murderer.
If we share them, we risk turning him into a martyr. People may try this again - a revolution of economic-murder at the expense of the corps.
Can't be. Books haven't been printed on paper for over a hundred years.
Well, if you've got eyes on this, Ava must have done her job. Sorry for the theatrics. Couldn't risk Curzona messing up my timings.
I'm beginning to understand. Play the rest.
Why? It's complicated in a way that isn't. My daughter Synthia got sick — some kind of rare mold parasite on the brain.
Fuck Curzona. I believe the citizens of Nivalis will be able to revolt without resorting to murder. Asepticism should thrive.
You know what's funny? This was all meant for Thaddeus. Ava was meant to bring him on this journey.
Yes. Let's transmit the Aseptic's manifesto.
Ava, can you summarize the rest?
Get it? Hello? Me. I did all the murders!

dialogues.title: Mala Second Metting
lines: CORA give me mercy... Key Performance Indicators? How are you measuring your success?
How can Enterprise Resource Planning have a size?
Right, let's put a pin in this for now. I need to go speak to Ma Gomba.
I think you should run this by someone else.
I'll be quick! Question one: What would you say are your main KPIs going into the current quarter?
Good to hear, Enterprise Resource Planning is an integral part of running a successful business.
Oh... Of course. Well, financially I guess. Next question.
You are singlehandedly going to ensure I fail this class aren't you?
Your Key Performance Indicators are... noodles?
I very much hope Ma Gomba has a better grasp on her business practices.
How would you describe your ERP?
Nothing better than competent benchmarking. Always good to open the kimono.

dialogues.title: I Kind of Lost It
lines: Masato Shima is looking for the Lims you owe him.
Eh, you know, am as good as the Boards will let me be. Bloody greens keeping themselves on time. Those departures are killing me though.
How are you getting the money you owe Masato?
