It is if you want to stop listening. Fact is, that gesture gave him a second wind, and that scorpion gave him a new personality. He runs a racket masquerading as a loan shark but that's not what nets him the Lims. See if you can get close enough to find out what's really going on. Oh, and do it without winding up tied to the bottom of an oil rig.
Whoo, knew I could bet on you. Damn... I shoulda bet on you.
Ha. Yeah, I know those two freak shows. They're like fucking ghosts you know! One of 'em disappears and then POOF! suddenly the other one's there. It's maddening.

Eh, it's a story. Started like most, you know, bullied as a kid, aggressive parents, whatever. There was this girl he had a thing for, least that's what the stories say. Anyway, one day, he gets picked on real bad. I mean ass kicked hard.
I don't know. Maybe she had a thing for him too? I'd wager it was something else. You know, if you're interested in taking that bet.
Yeah, I can't actually do that.
Masato? Hahaha! You're doing work for someone and you don't even know who they are? Risky when you got businesses to run and an image to keep. I like the way you gamble.
Oh! Hey! Good to see you again. I think. Eh, I'd bet it is. What do you say? Hundred Lims that's you're here to see me out of the goodness of your heart.
Apparently they thought I deserved it or something.
You owe money to Mr. Shima!
Hmmm. And that's why I didn't bet. Could feel it. Always get that feeling when things are going south. Speak of... What are you doing here?

Ha! Deserved it. Sure. I'd be willing to put a twenty Lim chip on the fact that you stumbled into it? You've had one interaction with the scorpion and are already feeling the venom? Haha. Yeah, you're doing great.
Shima? Masato the Scorpion Shima has you running errands for him? How the living lights did you find him? Who gave you the coin?
The twins gave it to me.
Apparently that one was bad. Like almost dead, bad. Changed him and shit. But that girl, she was there. She's the one who gave him his first shimmer chip. Custom scorpion and all.
Do you have his money or not?
Listen, I'm in good with the Boards. We're on the same track if you get what I mean. Give me three days and I'll have the Lims. I'll ping you as soon as I have them.

dialogues.title: Ava Explains FERB
lines: I love the Relationship Matrix and I love YOU.
The Relationship Matrix is a visual display of a human or android's emotional response to your words and actions.
Shut up and leave me alone.
You can show me what people think of me?
With this, I'll be a CEO in no time.
I'm so glad you're my friend, Ava.
You see? You'll get the hang of it in no time.
I have taken the liberty of engaging my Relationship Matrix feature to help you during social interactions. Would you like me to explain it?
I can detect changes in attitudes based on body language and tone. This information can help you decide how to influence the people you speak to.
Shall we try it out? Try saying something. Don't worry, I won't make a record of this conversation.

dialogues.title: Ava's Opinion
lines: Within the fragments I detect traces of an ancient quantum temporal code... I don't have the correct tools to read it, let alone understand what it could do.
So what should we do with it?
In my opinion you should dispose of it. Allow its secrets to be lost.
Ms Al-Zahiri might be disappointed with you now, but I believe you helped her by withholding the Enchiridion fragments.
Just another one of Nivalis' mysteries.
I'll mark the location of a CorpSec terminal on your HUD.
Ms Al-Zahiri's experiments could endanger her life... or her presence in this reality.

dialogues.title: The Band Reunites
lines: Well, that's the great thing about names: you can change them when they don't fit you anymore.
We owe it all to you bud. You want to know our band name? I am 99 percent sure we will keep it for the whole night.
And Olive! By CORA, I thought she was dead. And she's playing the theremin! I mean, who knows when she learned to do that...? Or why the fuck we want a theremin? But we have one!
I can't believe you got Lois back. I thought her drum playing days were long gone!
Well, I gotta go. The band needs me. Damn... that feels good to say. Thanks again bud. I mean it. Wish us luck!
You shouldn't add any Oh oh ohs this time around.
And Danny! That guy really took our musical change of direction HARD. Such a genre purist.

dialogues.title: Miso Baron - First Meeting
lines: Yeah, I knew you were on the level. I could feel it. Look, you hit me up here whenever you need some of the salty good stuff. I'll do you a good price, a friend price.
Pulp? Umami? Beige? Clag? Meaty MudMud, Ramen fuel?
Barely, and even if it was, at my special friend prices, it would be really silly to pass up on an opportunity like this!

Criminal Behavioural Implants. Some white-coat at CorpSec HQ thought it would be a good idea to inject happy-go-lucky-fucky memories into criminals to persuade them not to re-offend. Turns out one slip of the thumb and you lose everything.
I mean who does? Look, you hit me up when you want a taste of the salty good stuff, and I'll do you a good price, a friend price.
That's what it said on my report sheet before I hightailed it out of the facility. Thought it would be a nice little fuck-you to the suits.
Yeah strange, normally CorpSec treat us street-levels with the utmost respect...
Should have gone for something more sensible.
Oh, come on. Brown? Paste? Moon Glue? Putty? PutPut?
Brown? What are you talking about?
Hold up, The Miso Baron is getting a funny feeling that you aren't my buyer?
I don't like the sound of "gut rot"
That is my real name. CorpSec forced me to take one of those damn CBI procedures last year and it scrubbed all my memories up to that point.
Friends? I don't even know your real name.
The Miso Baron doesn't have time for this. Took a lot to get this much Brown on short notice.
You know my real name. I'm The Miso Baron.
Now that I think of it, the buyer did describe themselves as a "formidable presence, feared by both kings and paupers alike" and you are not like that. Not at all.
Turns out, they fucked with me.
Eyes too, lots of eyes. Eyes that see through the smog, you feel. Probably see through you too. You're practically glass. Now, take the Brown and get lost.
Why shouldn't I report you then?
You could have chosen any new identity. Why choose the name 'Miso Baron'?
Sure man, I mean if you think you can get better Clag elsewhere, you go right ahead. Go see what those wet-dogs are peddling down at the docks. A little gut rot never hurt anyone right?
Maybe, maybe not. Anyway, come back sometime for a free sample. You know where I am.

Woah, woah, woah! You had better put your blower into low-power-mode amigo. Since CorpSec classified Paste as an S-Class super substance, we'd both be looking at twenty years in a scum-pit for even having this convo!
I knew you were on the level amigo. Anyway, come back sometime for a free sample. You know where I am.
Yeah yeah yeah, I got your stuff, you wanna draw some more attention over here? The Neon got ears, pal.
Look, you need to forget we had this convo amigo. I was never here. I'm a ghost, I'm liquid on the lake, I'm an oubliette inside an oubliette. Unless of course...

dialogues.title: Sal Arrives at the Restaurant
lines: What, so every fry-cook from here to Mountain Town can steal the recipes that took Sal Magundi YEARS to master? No, I don't have copies!
Think I'd be here if I had a choice?
No bartering. You want a job? Get to work.
My old recipe holos. The MeanCuisine's kept them.
Eh, Fusion Point, behind the counter. But you'll have to get in there at night when the arms ain't working.
Hey! We've got a good reputation now.
You get me my holos and I'll make this the greatest noodle bar in the city. Chef's honor.
Look, kid, with me here this place could be great. But I ain't working without one thing.
Glad to have you on board.
Crabsticks, this place is even worse than I remember.
Mmff. No idea how. Lucky for you, I'm here.
Too bad for you, I guess.
Ah forget you. I'll take my talents somewhere else.

dialogues.title: Ashwin quits #1
lines: Right, boss. I wanted to quit actually.
And she told you to quit?
Well, thankfully your opinion is no longe relevant and your permission is no longer required. See you around "boss".
No. She told me to become someone. Someone with a goal. A purpose. Someone with more self-worth.
Quite the opposite. I want to become an entrepreneur in the world of Restaurant Hygiene Technology. I founded my own company.
I'm not sure that sounds like a solid business prospect.
I talked to Safia again, a few days ago. I wanted to tell her I was sorry for bothering her.
So you don't want to be a cleaner any more?
That sounds like an exciting prospect.
Thanks, boss... I guess I can't call you that any more. What are you now if not my "boss?"
Yeah, that sounds about right. Well, I better get back to work. See you around I guess.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 8
lines: Good morning. I hope you slept well and did not dream of the screaming void again. Have a great day!

dialogues.title: Hire Aska
lines: Well, I can't cook, and you certainly don't want me as a cleaner. And people say I'm a bit of a downer. Nihilism isn't popular these days. But...
Until recently, I sold kitchen appliances for a living. Ovens, grills, all that jazz. I could certainly advise you on that!
Can you do more than wait tables? We need a generalist.
I heard from a friend - or more of an enemy - that you're looking for waiting staff.

dialogues.title: The player Returns to TMB
lines: It's all irrelevant. It's not real.
I found someone involved in this CBI stuff.
Even if I could. Why would I want to? I'm street scum now, I don't want to find out that I used to be sewer scum.
You're about as good at lying as you are seasoning noodles my friend.
Thanks, I do what I can.
I guess it was nice of you to help him.
You don't want to find out about your past?
And what was this synthetic memory?
I knew you wouldn't stay away for long. Good stuff isn't it?
I met someone who writes these memories I'll ask her about it.
Cakes aren't cheap. A glitch in the memory?
You could have been a good person. Do you remember anything?
It feels like a big deal, like she'd saved all year for it. Ridiculous.
The miso? Not really my thing.
You know what they say about cakes?
What makes you think I'm lying?
Naaaa it blew the bottom of his jaw off but I still don't think he regretted it.
You had a mother saving pennies for a birthday cake?
In my memory I have a family. Parents. A sister. We're dirt poor, living in a shack, it stinks. It's my birthday. There's a cake my 'mother' has made.
I think you should at least find out your real name. Do you remember anything?
I once helped a friend trade in every single implant he had for an experimental taste augmentor, just so he could take a hit of it any time he wanted.
I don't need no judgement from you. He asked for help. I gave it to him.
Before it all went wrong they were able to implant a single memory. That's it. Everything else was blank.

dialogues.title: More info from Banor
lines: Well... Thaddeus offered me a ticket, but he said there would be a cost. He was right.
Yo Boss. You got something on your mind?

Look, all I can say is this: if you go to Egress, you won't be the same afterwards. Sometimes when you crawl into a secret place, it's not easy to back out. You have to keep going to the end, and when you come out the other side, you won't be the same as when you went in.
If you can't talk about it, I understand.
I need to ask you about something Thaddeus said.
I'll send you a Nav Point, alright? But I still say you should forget this whole thing. And if you can't... well, just don't lose yourself down there.
Oh really? Well, what can I help you with?
Be straight with me Banor, OK?
What are you talking about Banor?
I'll try boss. I always do.
Yeah. But I can't talk about it. It's not that I don't WANT to talk about it. You get me? I CAN'T talk about it. Some gifts, once given, can't be given back.
Come on Banor. You let it slip a few times now.
You might want to take it down a few degrees Boss. I don't have that much more face to lose.
Before he left? He didn't say much.
There's a place called Egress. A kind of... metro station. But it doesn't work any more. Not the way it's 'sposed to. Anyway, you need a ticket to go there.
Not something he said before he left. Something he said after.
Don't play dumb, Banor. It suits you too well.

dialogues.title: Fauxter reveals his band split
lines: Whatever. Just leave me alone will ya? You're bumming me out. I don't even want to think about this stuff. It's bringing up bad vibes.
Just the usual. Infidelity - I slept with everyone and everyone also slept with everyone. There was a lot of jealousy. Then came the drugs, the alcohol, the groupies.
You could say that I'm a guitar without any strings. A drummer with no sticks. A piano with no keys. A flute with no holes. A clavicord with no...
Yo buddy. What is HAPPENING!? How is the universe treating you, my noodle-selling, business-running groovy Nivalis friend? How's tricks?
Hey, I'm really sorry to hear that buddy.
I didn't need to know any of that.
It's just natural, you know! I'm a red blooded man, but I also have a heart too. I need emotional intimacy too. The girls in the crowd - they're a big temptation.
Where to start? What DIDN'T happen to "Synapstar Five And The Bionic Jive"? That was our original band name.
Whoa! I'm very happy to hear that good buddy.
Hey, you don't have to be like that.
I guess I just want a non-sexual relationship with many beautiful women. And also a sexual relationship with many beautiful women.
Well first there were music disagreements. For example, I wanted to make us into an experimental progressive deep house grimecore band...
But it wasn't all good. Our manager stole all our money and our third album with the "new sound" - techno pan pipes - didn't find an audience.
And our bassist thought we should give up music and clean windows.
What are you trying to say?
Ah... ya know? Not great buddy. Not great AT ALL.
We were gonna do big things during the LUZ. We were gonna play a huge concert and bring music and light and electricity into everyone's life!
Right! That's me, my friend. Major downer. Hardcore bummer.
We probably shouldn't have connected with our audience so... directly.

dialogues.title: Meet Rollo
lines: I'm sure you're very happy working for him.
Or you should start considering which is your least favorite foot.
Calhoun needs the money to pay you. How much do you get?
How much does Calhoun pay you to do this?
Mr Calhoun says he expects payment soon.
It’s the going rate for hired toughs. Goons get an extra hundred per quarter. Heavies get a grand for wear and tear on the knuckles.
That will make sure I cannot pay the money back.
A hundred Lims a month. Not that it’s anything to you, debt rat.
Are you happy working for him?
I pay my staff more than that.
Tell Mr Calhoun I'll pay the loan back when I'm ready.

Maybe not. But I do scare your customers. And if you don't pay up I’ll come here every day of the week. And I’ll bring a friend. If your customers don’t like one of me, they definitely won’t like two.
Mr Calhoun sends his warm regards.
I am. And so is my friend. We'll be back, debt rat.

dialogues.title: Recruiting Botan
lines: My HOVA. HaloPulse Mark IV. Lowtown Lime with a carmine under-shimmer. Best vat-grown leather seats money could buy. And the engine…
Papers. I don’t got papers. Without them I can’t get back in.
Stupid fucking boards are the closest thing to a HOVA as I can get out here.
Broken hover board? Throw it in the back. Twenty Lims for a reset, fifty for a new rear grav-fan, a hundred for anything else.
If you don’t like it then why are you here?
Mmfh. Going out of my mind here. It’s all that water. No Vincs, no parking lots, no lanes, no Grid... ugh.
I’ve read what he calls “poetry”. He wouldn’t know free verse if it ran over his foot.
Sigh. Got called out here to work on an engine. A Viathan-80. Hundred years old if it was a day.
And why the fuck would you do that for me?
I had to get my entire arm into the foul line before it would inject right.
I’m not here about a board.
Coming up two years now. Lost my shop back in Industrial cos I didn’t have an official district presence. They repossessed my HOVA collection too.
Tried to. Got deported back here. Anyway, there's no point. Lost my shop back in Industrial cos I didn’t have an official district presence.
I’d want a favor in exchange...
Fine. But we made a fucking deal here. Remember that.
What? Yeah. Had to submit a works order to CorpSec’s local competitiveness bureau, only when I come to leave this steel shit heap...
Fucking system changed overnight. Papers got shredded, I got stuck.
Too bad. I gotta get going.
I know some people inside CorpSec. Maybe I can look into your papers for you.
Why don't you go back to the mainland?
Course, the Viathan-90s solved that problem by bypassing the fucking overspill sump with-–
Think I don’t fucking know that? This air stinks of sea breeze. Not even a fucking sniff of chem trail. Makes me fucking sick.
Well, if you're here about a boat you can keep walking. I don’t do boats.
Ideas? What kind of ideas? Sounds like I don't like your ideas.
Because you will do something for me.
O.R.S? Not the thing run by that circumlocutious hack Cherry?
They repossessed my HOVA collection too. Even Valkerie!
Maybe you should think about a change.
So you're stuck fixing hover boards.
Haven't seen many HOVAs round here...
Who the fuck are you, ‘Sec? Are you fucking ‘Sec?
I know some people who could help. Maybe I could look into getting those papers for you.

dialogues.title: Ava congratulates you
lines: Two business licenses. Soon you will own the whole city.
I have already asked him to meet you. If he does not work out, you may dock my salary.
Would you like to know which Tier 1 businesses are available to acquire?
Only a little. Congratulations on your expansion. I believe good things will follow. Mostly.
Banor. He knows this part of the city, has good connections, is loyal to Thaddeus (and therefore you), and he would not ask for a percentage. Just a salary.

If your entrepreneurial empire expands, which I think is now likely, you will need an advisor. Someone canny. Someone who knows their way around the city, and how to run a business. Or at least, how to maintain one.
Good help saves money. And I know who could offer good help... and he's cheap.
My help is assumed. No, you need someone who is more tuned to this part of the city. Someone with more... human instincts. I suggest Banor.
No. This place has served its purpose. There are other options. I will add them to your journal. I suggest to check them out to make your decision.
I thought we would take over Brooke's venue...
I guess we have no other choice.

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: You want to play chess? Got a new fancy travel set.
Perfect. Got some more business ideas I can run by you while we play.

dialogues.title: Wrap things up with Gamova 1
lines: That murdering innocent people is some kind of glorious 'fuck you' to the corporations? You think that's going to benefit the people? You fool.
You just turned a psychopathic killer into some kind of economic messiah from beyond the grave. We're all powerless now.
You just turned a psychopathic killer into some kind of economic messiah from beyond the grave.
I just spoke with Curzona. Do you have any idea what you just did?
I don't expect you to understand.
It's over. You have no power over me now.
I will not be hanging around to find out what happens next. You're on your own.

I've been looking for an excuse for a while but I'm nyugdijas. Retiring. Curzona are going to be a little distracted while they mop this up. I'd suggest you freeze yourself till this all blows over... for a few thousand years perhaps.
Rheno was a mirror, not a knife. The people of this city will understand that.
Nivalis deserves to know the truth.
You just turned a psychopathic killer into some kind of economic messiah from beyond the grave. You'll learn to care.

dialogues.title: Nixxy at the Docks
lines: Ewww! What is wrong with you? Well, fine. We pay out on "no". What should we bet on next folks? Double your channel points!

Could you cry a bit too? If I paid you, would you cry on stream while eating the food? What if it was poisoned? Not lethal, just enough to make you ill for a few days. Could you plead by saying something like, "But please, I have a family!"?
Ok, we're back. This hot young thing is called Noodle Nut. They might be a small business owner with no money, but they're in luck today! So my first question is... are you a virgin?
Haha, as IF! Can you believe that folks. Pay out on "yes". Double your channel points. Why not play again?

Oh you wanna get in on this? Well I'm not looking for a partner. Yet. But... well it could work. What could you bring to the table? I'm offline right now by the way. Running another ad. So, you know, make your case before we're back on air.
Dude, what is wrong with you? Get some self respect.
Hello, Nixxy's Pixies! I am once again coming to you from the heart of the LUZ! Today we're in The Dank Dank Docks! And look, we found Noodle Nut! What should we ask them?
Haha, what a weirdo. Ok, well let's find someone better. Boring!
Do you have an audience or something?
Ok, whatever. Look, we're not live right now. I'm waiting on the results of the poll and they're all voting while an ad streams.
Do you pay me or do I pay you?
If you're making money out of this somehow, I want a cut?
I can sing, or talk about current events?
How would you feel about a skit where I come to your noodle stand and try to cook something? But it's disgusting. But we make you eat it because everyone is chanting "eat it, eat it!"
I know a lot of celebrity gossip and current fashion trends.
Boring! See you later. I mean, maybe. If there is absolutely NO ONE else to entertain us.
I can make a shocked face and throw up on demand.
Wait, really. That's... that's potentially gold dust right there. On command you say?
You've never had a girl like me pay attention to you, right? So my question is this... would you let me spit in your mouth for 100 Lims.

dialogues.title: Noe Business Quest
lines: What always happens. The party ended. My clientele found some other spot and left me to foot the bill. See that club over there?
What will you do? Will you open a new bar?
Too bad you won't find either of those things here.
It was the most gorgeous, sinful, glorious dive bar in all Nivalis.
Mhhmm. Well, then you should know we used to serve a signature cocktail here. I call it a "Frosted Murder". Find the ingredients, bring them back, and I'll know you can handle the business.
So you're need someone to take over your Tier 2 license?
All good things come to an end.
That's true of all of us, darling.
I remember the days when you couldn’t see the floor for stardust. We would drink Tarragon Phantoms and Java Blasts until the sun melted into the moon.
Oh, I won't give my license to just anyone. They would have to be the right kind of person. Scrappy, yet soulful. Eager, yet poised...
I could be... some of those things.
I suppose you're right. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm supposed to be drowning my sorrows, and right now I'm only paddling in the blues. Chin chin, darling.
I am ALL of those things.
It was a shithole, darling. The ceiling was held up with grav-tape and the steam pipes leaked, but we covered all that in holo-paint and danced in the puddles.
With what, sweetie? The last time I checked, you couldn’t pay rent with shimmering wit and a flawless vintage ensemble.
You are sweet. And perhaps you’re right. I'll drink on it. Chin chin, darling.
WAS my bar. The Lowtown Lily. It doesn't look it, but once upon a time this place was one big party.
I'm here because I have to be.
Oh, you know. A LICCY hound.
Well. I suppose you're the entrepreneur Agent T-Let's-Go was talking about. Sorry to say it, but you don't look the type.
I'm party on the outside, business on the inside.
Vodka, liquid nitrogen and cherries. Simple, yet deadly.

dialogues.title: Round Six - Player Wins
lines: What are you going to do with it?
What can you tell me about the final match?
Practice probably. It's the only way I'm going to have a chance for the top spot next year.
Oh, you'll need it more than I.
I'm under an NDA so the only thing I'll say is: it's a game of chess. Good luck.
Well, it looks as though more time has become available on my schedule.

dialogues.title: Ava looks for Danny 2
lines: What do you mean he's vanished? They released him?
Vanished? Could Harper have hacked CorpSec?
Hardly. And she probably would have told us.
His name is nowhere to be found. There isn't even a "Danny's Donuts" on the retail records. As if he never existed ...
I doubt it. What do we tell Harper?
Okay... hmmmm... this is getting weirder all the time.
I'm worried about Harper. Let me swim the Nets and check on her brother one more time?
I mean he has vanished from public records.

dialogues.title: Have Dinner with Cale
lines: Well, what do you think of Calypso? It's exactly how I remember it.
I can't believe I'm back here. Can't believe I'm actually out of the city! This is incredible.
Oh, sure, there's always things that could be improved, but looking at this place compared to say, the Sewers?
I am. For the first time in a long time, I really, really am. To us!
The air is fresh that's for sure!
Right? And that water is the most beautiful color. Honestly, I never thought I'd see something so... natural... again.
Agreed. To no corps and no punks. Just people. Cheers.
I am. I swear the air smells different out here. Course could be the Corpo bubble they got built over this place, but I'm not gonna tread down that track right now.
Good. No corp talk on a date.

dialogues.title: Ava calls you Captain
lines: So I can take this boat?
I like the sound of that.
I was just celebrating your new mode of transportation... Mariner.
I apologize. I shall restrain myself when it comes to salty metaphors and seafaring synonyms.
Yes, it would seem so. I have taken the liberty of putting a digital claim upon the vessel with the CorpSec Maritime Registry. I have a Nav Point for the boat.
My Captain. My Mariner. My Salty Sea Dog Besting the Brine! I am excited about the lingo for this new adventure.

dialogues.title: Spartacus second chance
lines: I'd start with your nutrition. Come eat at my place from now on.
YOU? What do you know about it?
I'll believe that when I see it. But say I was interested...
We could work on your confidence. You're Nivalis' Meanest Droid! Repeat that!
YOUR DOOM. PREPARE TO MEET IT.
The fact my trainer dropped me. I bet the whole LUZ is laughing about it.
I'M NIVALIS' MEANEST DROID! Fine, I'll give you a try. Guess it can't hurt.
Come to rub it in, huh?
You got a big mouth for a human. How about you step into the ring sometime? No? Didn't think so.
Why the hell would you care?
Maybe I could help you train?
I was rude before. I want to help.
In it for the Lims, huh? Well, Floyd always took a cut. Say I was interested...
I will check back on you tomorrow.

dialogues.title: Ava recommends talking to Ashwin again
lines: That's not my job. I'm staying out of it.
I think that's best. Best for business, and best for both of them too.
I guess I can try to smooth things over.
Perhaps you should talk to Ashwin. It seems Safia does not share his feelings.

dialogues.title: Location 2 Hive Mall
lines: Remember, after every statement I make, you shout out... something. Like "YEAH!" or "PREACH!" or "WE WON'T BE SILENCED!" or "OLIVE NEK IS GOD!"
PEOPLE OF HIVE MALL, IT'S TIME TO CAST OFF THE SHACKLES OF CORPORATE OPPRESSION AND EMBRACE A NEW WAY. A BETTER WAY.
COMPANIONS! UNDER MY LEADERSHIP, OUR REVOLUTION GAINS MOVEMENT - NO MATTER WHAT MAGREADY AND DELBERT AND HIS CRONIES IN THE DISCIPLINARY PANEL OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE MAY SAY!
It's like everything is kinda the same, but different? You know. Everything seems brighter, like I've washed my eyeballs in a bowl of sunshine this morning.
I'm not sure that's such a good plan.
I don't think I can continue this, Olive. Sorry!
You seem much more positive today.
Same drill as before! Our classic of call-and-response set up.
It's wild to think that the first speech at Meridian was just a few days ago. It feels like a million years! We've come so far.
Hey, you're here! The tour is really flying now. And you were there from the very start.
Like I said, I'll shout out my OWN response.
...that's not really the key part to focus on.
THE FIRE IS SPREADING. THE FLAMES WILL SOON SPARK EMBERS LONG DORMANT! AS WE GAIN MOMENTUM, WATCH THE CORPORATE CURS SCUTTLE TO THEIR HOLES FOR SHELTER!
I'd bung you a skwirp, but I took the whole vial. The time is now!
...who are you, my editor? Come on man! Can you not?
It's wild how much hope, purpose and hard work can adjust your destiny and create a road for peace and freedom and joy. I can't wait to share my new mindset with people.
Just let your words free. I am so ready for this today! Olive Nek speaking tour, part two. HIVE MALL! Let's go! ...You ready?

The city has an energy field - a life force, and today, it flows through my veins. My blood is charged with hope and rapture and adulation. And some Senatrepine to take the edge of the, you know, feelings of doom.
THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR SUPPORT TODAY. IT WON'T BE FORGOTTEN! I'LL SEE YOU ALL FOR THE NEXT LEG OF THE TOUR AT HELIX MONUMENTAL. LET'S MARCH ON!
Alright, that's Hive Mall done and the tour rolls on! Hey, these talks are much easier to do when you're high as a fucking kite. I should remember that...
I told you before, I don't need someone to nay all my says!

dialogues.title: Dr Matombo recommends Dr Alken
lines: Yes. I'm looking for medical advice.
Then take the boy to R.M Alken. She's a specialist in this field.
She knows this sickness better than I do. Better than almost anyone. If she doesn't know of another solution, there is none.
I'm wishing the boy the best. But without a mask, he will die. You should prepare yourself for that.
I cannot give advice if I don't see the patient.
It's a young boy, an oxyphile.
Everywhere, but that's not why I'm here.
Not really. I'm looking for medical advice.
That's bad news for the boy. R.M Alken is the best in this district.

dialogues.title: More info from Huckstash
lines: Yeah? Well then you don't need me no more.
What else can you tell me?
Haha, sure! Thaddeus has neural augments like the ocean has drips.
You got that look in your eyes.
Sure, why not? Drugs, but who's sober in this world?
I can't tell you how to get one.
And if Thaddeus offered me another trip, I wouldn't take it. I seen a lot of things on the rails, but Egress is another level. Literally.
Look, Thaddeus is on a TRIP... In all ways. Exploring reality, inside and outside his own head. He's accelerating down the creases of his own cerebrum.
You got some burning questions. And you think I got the answers.
Thaddeus left me with more than I wanted to know about the universe... and suffering.
What can you tell me about Egress?

Fuck it, I'll give you the Nav Point. You'd find it eventually anyways. Just... be careful down there. Don't take it too seriously. The ghosts don't truck with folks who laugh as they pass their graves.
If there's a million ways you can be out of your head, and only one way you can be sober, the chances you are sober right now are a million to one!
Oh sure. And everywhere else on the way there.

dialogues.title: Not yet
lines: You really wanna know what happened to all of us, don't you?
Well, in all honesty it isn't that spectacular. In fact, I think I'm gonna end up disappointing you.
Talking to you is more important.
What happened with the Club Rat Kids?
Shit, what didn't happen. We sprang on the scene like a group of viral AIs. There was nothing we couldn't do, no place we couldn't get into.
Keep working to get those flyers out there. The more we spread the word, the more reviled we'll be when we ascend to the most epic of clubs.
That's enough of that though. Get out there and finish hanging those holo flyers.
You wouldn't believe me if I told you.
There's no big story behind the Club Rat Kids. We were four friends who just liked to dance to whatever we called a good song at the time.
Means we might have taken each other for granted. You know, flawed individuals and all.
That's what it was all about, peace for just a few minutes.
We were the same flawed fucks as you are right now. Relationships are hard when you don't communicate.
At the end of the day we're all just flawed sacks of cells.
In case that was unclear, yes!
There's got to be more to the story than that.
We have to find what makes us pulse, what gives us life. Whatever that is, there's no shame in it. As for the CRKs?
Haha. Still not done with those flyers, huh?
We lived, toured, recorded, sang, rocked, we did fucking everything together. Didn't mean we got along easier than anyone else.
You're almost there! I know you can taste the Spire's clean air. Maybe feel me dancing next to you at the Starlight Lounge? Just gotta put in the admin work and we'll get there. See you soon!
Finish your story about the Club Rat Kids.

dialogues.title: Brooke has an idea
lines: I don't have time for comics.
Hey, thanks! You want to know about our newest comic?
The pills helped. Anyway, it's about an obnoxious, hyperactive comic writer who finally cracks and goes on a massive bender as his life spirals into misfortune and disaster.
You'll love it! Alright, I gotta go. I got deadlines to hit and dead bodies to hide. Later!
Aww come on! We got some big updates coming soon. It's gonna be huge!
Hey there, want to sign up for the Deep Hive Comics newsletter?
You wrote it all last night?
Great! We got some big updates coming soon. It's gonna be huge.
I wrote it myself. Mostly while high on ultra caffeine infusions at 3am last night.
Nah, this isn't just a comic. It will change your whole world, man. Come back when you change your mind!

dialogues.title: Talk to Mary-Nyx Curzona 2
lines: You say you'd do anything to save that boy's life.
Have you ever given anyone kind advice?
I don't do business with people like you.
If that's true, then you'll have no problem doing just what I suggest.
You know, I could have you erased in a heartbeat. But you are quite good at accruing debt; be a shame to see that interest go to waste.
You'll come to me. I could give you every Lim you need and more. And that beautiful big debt of yours would be in my hands forever.
I simply came by with a little business proposition.
So nice to see you, Mary.
We both know this pathetic little campaign of yours will fail.
I don't know what's worse, smelling the stench of your restaurant or knowing you ignored my kind advice.

dialogues.title: Calhoun hits back at reviews
lines: In the short term? No. The damage is done. In the long term I can try to prevent him from leaving fraudulent reviews, but that will take some time. Or...
I will try. But I'm afraid your reputation may never be perfect so long as he remains unpaid.
I'm afraid I have something rather troubling to report.
Affirmative. Your reputation should recover soon.
Despite my attempts, I can't think of a way to spin this as good news.
He did threaten to take action, if he was not paid.
As much as I want to be motivating for you, I don't think this is true. Who do you owe money to?
Or you could pay him. I can send him the Lims directly.
Someone is spreading negative rumors about your establishments. And since the food is not that bad, I can only assume they are malicious...
It appears you are being review bombed.
This is bribery! Can you do anything?
Well, you have more than a few enemies. But there are several negative rumors given by a user called LIMBS4LIMS...

dialogues.title: Leveling
lines: Well, we get faster. And friendlier. And we learn more jokes. Better ones.
Any more ideas to improve the place?
That's how you level up your business. And when we level up, your ratings go up too.
You mean how do we even get better?
But the most important thing is we learn how to handle the guests. The difficult ones.
How can I help you Boss?

dialogues.title: Trash the Coffee
lines: Right or not, I think he is scared. And I am detecting an unusual level of electro-chemical activity in this particular cup... But that could simply be down to water quality.
Do you require access to a trash chute?
Yeah. Let's get rid of this thing.
I have marked the location of a trash chute on your HUD.
I don't know. Do you think he's right? About the B.U.Gs?

dialogues.title: Roxi Maybe
lines: It's a hell yeah! Where do I sign?
MechaTomb Floyd? He’s a killer trainer... literally KILLER. Why would he train someone like me?
You're right... Screw it, where do I sign?
Who's to say your team won't drop you if you stay on the bench?
Do NOT push me. I am this close to clawing someone's face off.
If the offer came from Floyd himself it would be. But from you… I dunno.
What in the name of ever-living crap do you want?
No, I’m a lotus leaf, floating on a pond of enlightenment.
You wouldn’t have to take Corp sponsorship anymore.
What if I told you Floyd had an opening?
I know my damn value. And I don't need your damn help.
In that case, I have an offer for you.
Sorry. But it's a great opportunity.
How about... I am FYNX and I will bring your... kinks? Better work on that.
Have I heard of it? It’s only, like, the most reported sport in VSM!
Because you're exactly what he's looking for.
Me, a Bare Metal Boxer... But be honest: is Floyd fair?
It's a better offer than anyone else will give you.
Go see Floyd. Tell him I sent you. Try to think of a catchphrase like Spartacus.
What are you mad about now?
You'd have to work that out for yourself.
You think I don't want to? She's on the same damn team as me! They'd fire my ass!
Have you heard of Bare Metal Boxing?
I know, I read about it in Beatdown. Didn't sit right with me then, doesn't now. Who's to say he wouldn't drop me too?
Then I have some good news for you.
You wanna know what I’m mad about? I’ll tell you what I’m mad about! That trash hag Loretta Vendetta stole my slot! I’m on the stinking bench!
It's not about fair. It's about winning.

dialogues.title: Kai reccomends eating out
lines: Yes, well, think like a tourist and you can't go wrong. I admit it's a strange system, but sometimes we waste energy by questioning that which will never make sense.
So now what should I do to unlock new zones?
I'm a hacker. And have you seen my face? "Creepy" is how I do business.
What is strange about it? Eat a hot dog to explore a new part of the city. Makes sense to me.
Good. I have been monitoring the progress of your tourist visa. You're unlocking plenty of achievements.
Certainly. Thaddeus paid me to answer any questions you had.
Have you been chatting with vendors like I suggested?
It's a little creepy that you're keeping tabs on me.
Well other than the "quests" that Ava puts in your journal and the vendors, you might want to think about actually TRYING some of those restaurants.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 25
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
While debt may lead to mild adverse anxiety, debt accrued at TheraPay modules at least comes with solutions.

dialogues.title: Solve the debt
lines: I'll pay him when I can.
Perhaps if you healed the rift between him and the other fishermen, he would take it as payment for the debt you owe.
Forget him. Got more important things on.
I have an idea for dealing with Mr Calhoun.
Perhaps fishing is the way into Mr Calhoun’s good graces. He mentioned the fishing club he once belonged to. The Carp Diem.

dialogues.title: Teleshko has a correction for you
lines: Oh, it's nothing to be proud of. I can assure you.
Attention to detail matters. You should check these things more carefully.
Is there a fine for that?
I noticed a spelling mistake in your menu.

dialogues.title: Mala Third Meeting
lines: Look I try to keep home life in the tin where possible, but yes this is for school.
Did you say this was for a school project? Must be a fancy school.
Did you win a competition or something?
They're... Well mostly they... Look I don't have time for this. I'm already behind schedule and this chit-chat is eating into the harvest. Let's circle back later.
Since we last spoke, would you say customer satisfaction metrics are looking Bear or Bull?
What are schools like in Nivalis?
I don't know what that is.
Fantastic. Just wondering if you were any further along with intermediatory biz-dev feedback?
Next question. ROI, how are we looking?
Hey there, free for a quick huddle?
That's what we like to hear!
Oh your performance review is going to be a real fireworks festival. Right let's get this over with.
Wonderful! Should we get started then?

dialogues.title: Ava points the player to Nabla
lines: Now you're talking! Let's sell this trash.
Indeed. There are also collectors who will pay good money for it.
I thought it was just old junk...
Oh, yes! Custom 89th Gen Configurator Plates, CHEW-Z Expansion Dockets with the original thermal paste... lovely stuff.
I'll send you the details of a collector. Oh, and I'd advise you to be discreet.
You're the boss! I'll send you details of an official drop point.
In this city, nothing is junk. In fact, you're supposed to surrender all old tech to CorpSec in case it contains valuable personal data. I believe they pay a small finder's fee.
I couldn't help but notice, you've been collecting some fine pieces of tech lately.
I don't need any more trouble. We should hand it in.

dialogues.title: Ceres shows up
lines: It's your lucky day. Ceres Coilson is waiting for you at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus old flat 3
lines: I will pay you back with your next paycheck.
Here. Before I change my mind again!
I'm not heartless enough for this world.

dialogues.title: Spartacus No Training
lines: I’d say good luck but to be honest I think my FLAVR unit could beat you in the ring right now.
YOUR DOOM. YOU ARE LOOKING AT IT.
So does that mean you have to fight again?
Hey, I give a shit about things.
You heard me. You don’t like it, go prove me wrong.
Why are you telling me this?
Yeah. This time to the death.
And I really hope you trip over your FLAVR unit and break your face.
Not really. I fought OBLITERATA FOUR. It was a draw.
Spoken like a true Corpster. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.
I don’t know. I’m tired, right down to my spikes. Maybe too tired to keep fighting.
Yeah, you look it. A bust-up HumourBot would have more of a chance than you.
I’ve spent my whole life doing what other people want. "Shatter this, Spartacus, pulverize that, Mr. Doom." But you don’t seem to give a shit about anything. It’s kinda refreshing.
Could've guessed you'd be looking out for number one. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.
You have friends? Guess it takes all sorts. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.

dialogues.title: Nabla has results
lines: And then neuramatic Automatas were pioneered. These breakthrough digital assistants introduced features we now take for granted, and the mid-range, semi-biological Automatas were suddenly a technological dead end.
Financial collapse followed. THAT'S the point.
Exactly. But there was a problem. Complex nerve systems got severely damaged during the de-cryogenesis process. Cells ruptured during the defrosting and nerve and tissue damage was usually fatal.
Yes. Her safety was guaranteed by corporate decree. And she continued working for LifeCorp.
They were losing money every minute, and admitting they could not treat the sleepers would mean breaking their contract. Clearly the cutters decided to take action rather than wait.
But I couldn't find anything about how she got on this whitelist.
Precisely. The old diva had some dirt. Her death must have been more dangerous to the corps than letting her live.
There was a new strain of parasite that killed people by damaging nerves. Very painful. Untreatable.
Let's keep this brief babe. Time is of the essence, and I've already sent you all over town to shake any tail. What do you know already?
Sure were babe. They couldn't just turn off the machines. That's where Hep came into the picture. She was going to solve the problem.
122 years ago LifeCorp decided all those coma roamers were a financial liability.
Yes. I heard about the big financial crisis.
Oh yes. Just hours after burning down the Coma Roamer site, LifeCorp sent out instructions for the Cutters to leave Hep alone. She was whitelisted.
Investments failed and that caused the financial crisis.
There was a disease. A parasite.

LifeCorp advertised directly to leech worm sufferers. Cryogenic salvation. The cost was beyond almost anyone, but a... special repayment plan was offered. Loan out your consciousness to work as an Automata until a cure was found, and the treatment became affordable.
Yes. The Corporate Calculus must have been complex. If LifeCorp were caught, and the crime was proven, those deaths could bring the whole company down.

LifeCorp had a whole department for this kind of situation. Thousands of agents called "cutters." They know how to carry out the most severe cost saving operations without being discovered. Without blowback.
LifeCorp were responsible for those peoples lives.
It's tragic, but this is the reality of business.
I doubt that... let's make it quick.
Just tell me what you know.
Once they were frozen they were already doomed.
So she got herself on the whitelist somehow.
LifeCorp were hardly going to keep people alive through via charity.
That's why they needed the unique skill set of Hep. But there was a complication... Hep was clever. When she realized what she had done, she also realized what she had become. A loose end.
As Automatas, the coma roamers had become obsolete. They were redundant, and their revenue generation for the corps reached zero.
The Whitelist is the Corp's directory of people who can't be harmed. Normally reserved for CEO's, important business high flyers, and members of the corporate dynasty.
Now LifeCorp sat on a huge pile of living frozen bodies they needed to maintain at huge costs.

dialogues.title: Find Shima
lines: A woman in Space Port. Hiding from something.
Tell her to be at Meridian Market. Midnight.
Speak, or move your body out of my eye-line.
I will give you the continued use of your limbs. The message.
Then you’re a fool. Who gave you this task?
I have a message for you.
I think she’s trying to avoid being seen.
You seem to have mistaken this for a conversation. You have the message. Now go.
What will you give me in return?

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: Yeah I heard. Must be hard for you not being able to get involved.
You heard that everyone is playing Chess now to pass the time?
Ok well I'm not sure what that has to do with anything. Wanna squeeze in a game now?

dialogues.title: Garnet is writing jokes
lines: The one that made her laugh? It's dumb. You sure you want to hear it?
I have no idea if he's successful, but when I heard his act - which he performed for me IN FULL while driving him there - I had a thought.
I got a daughter. Her name? Anna. I like drums a lot, so you can probably guess what I would name a second daughter...
I've been running a little side hustle. You know that comedian Pilk Dane?
I hope it was good one.
If a passenger works for a Corp and says a journey is essential to facilitate commerce, we can't charge them. New rule from the Corporate Council.
Ah, can't say I blame ya. Mila doesn't think I'm funny neither.
I figure if I can make a surly teen daughter laugh, I can make ANYONE laugh.
Don't interrupt! Anyway, want to know what I'd call a second daughter? Anna. Yeah, I'd call them both Anna... Anna 1 Anna 2!
He's a comedian that I picked up for a hire last week. He was performing at "The Laughter Loft" downtown.
Look, I gotta get out of here. I'm already late for my shift. But thanks for the chat. Most of my passengers, they don't even talk to me no more. So this was... nice. Stay loose pal.
Sure, why not. You can try.
I think I've heard of him.
I'm sure it's better than the taxi service. I'm thinking of switching careers. Delivery driver or elevator operator or... anything else I guess. Money is TIGHT.
I mean she mostly just rolls her eyes at me. But sometimes - just sometimes - I can still get her to crack and giggle.
I could do that. I could write jokes. I mean, I make jokes ALL THE TIME. Mainly for my daughter to be honest, but she says I'm funny.

dialogues.title: Spaceport
lines: The Space Port isn't an easy place to get to, but I guess neither is space!

dialogues.title: Deeala Intro
lines: No, I work at Mollyphonic, the cyberdelic deepgoth club downtown. Abusing rich assholes is more of a... hobby. A well paid one.
Are you the manager? My food is taking forever. I'm hungry. I'm tired. I've been up since... well, since yesterday.
You're probably wondering why I'm so grouchy.
Believe me, if I was upset, you'd know.
It's exhausting. Serving drinks all day. insulting people all night. Sometimes, I wonder how much longer I can keep this up.
Have you seen these bags under my eyes? Do I look like I'm having fun?
It smells good. I'm so hungry. And tired. I can barely keep my eyes open. Or my mouth shut. Sorry for snapping.
I'm not sure how I can help.
I've been abusing rich assholes all night. Not physically. Verbally. And emotionally I guess - just a little.
I'm not looking for a side order of awkward flirting with my food... But thanks.
With customer service like that you'll go far, and I hope you'll stay there.
Why don't you just enjoy it?

dialogues.title: Garnet opens up
lines: So what happened with Mila? I assume you "passed" your interview?
I'm gonna talk to Mila. And I'll try to save. I guess I needed that talk! She's a child, I'm her father.
And that hurts you even more!
What? Uh, shit. I mean... good. So I guess you left her in tears?
I don't have that money, either. But you need it!
Here's the money. Go, save your daughter!
She died. Flora, my wife. While I was on shift. I knew she was sick, but I ... we needed the damn Lims!
Look, the kid means well. And... she's very strong-willed. She's really pushing me out of my comfort zone, whether I like it or not.
I feel guilt, shame, loss, all at the same time. And I have to take care of Mila. And I know I'm screwing that up, too.
And Mila is eyeing me, protecting me, trying to give me the time and protection to heal.
No, she's not. But she thinks I'm weak!
She's gate-keeping you. And you shouldn't allow that.
I will! And I'll try to save. I guess I needed that talk! She's a child, I'm her father.
That's not good for both of you!
No, she's not, she's still a child.
I looked up tariffs of decent psychologists. It looks like a therapy would be around 800 Lims.
So, uh... you talked to Mila, huh?
If I paid for it, would you seek therapy for yourself and your daughter?
She shouldn't have to carry my burden.
I know. She's a big girl!
Thank you. I don't know if you still want to be a friend. But I will always see you as one!
You have to talk about it. With her.
I'm sorry, I cannot pay for every person in need. I wish you luck. Talk to Mila!
Yeah, her heart is in the right place, but I really don't need any more friends, or partners, or... anyone really. Just me and her.
And then? I don't have the time to heal. I need those fucking Lims for paying the rent. I cannot afford a therapy animal.
Of course I would! And I would try to pay it back!
That's the axiom. Everything else concludes. Thank you!
Every night I'm not dreaming of more friends. I'm dreaming of pizza that has real cheese. Imagine that!
This not about her. It's about you!
I know, but what should I do? I'm soldiering on and hope it gets better. But it never does.
Hey, snap! Thanks for being honest with me though. How did she take it?

dialogues.title: Banor comments on the rats
lines: Well sure, that might be it. But don't let it bother you, boss. I bagged more than one dead rodent in my time.
We have a dead rodent problem?
Sure do. They keep appearing all over the place. Strange, huh!
Sounds like her. But don't let it bother you, boss. I bagged more than one dead rodent in my time.
Hey boss, don't worry about the bad ratings. Things'll pick up.
Oh, only all the stuff about our dead rodent problem. Some folks are just plain picky!

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Harper waiting
lines: Harper Osiris is looking for you at the Noodle Bar.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 26
lines: In some parts of Nivalis they eat fried mushrooms for breakfast. Imagine that! I hope you find something tastier than that.

dialogues.title: Alexander wants to talk to you
lines: Alexander is waiting for you at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Ava tells your about Elias Malt
lines: I know somebody who could be interested in Gimble.
He's often seen around the Seaside Boardwalk.
You think she's an old woman with a severy case of dementia, and we should leave her in peace?
Elias Malt is a CorpSec agent. Maybe you can trade the information for something?

dialogues.title: Thaddeus Meeting 2
lines: I am. I can't wait to get there.

Don't flatter yourself kid. To be honest with ya, I just don't care that much. This noodle bar ain't exactly a license to print money. If you want to stay in business longer than a week, you listen to old Banor, you hear?
Did you change your mind about retiring?
I don't want to be spied on.
Alright then. Well, I don't do goodbyes. I need to leave Nivalis before it sucks the life out of my bones. I'll be in touch kid. Maybe. Goodbye.

When you live and work in Nivalis, you're eventually gonna have to make a choice. You gotta lift people up, or you gotta climb on top of them. If you lift them up, most likely none of you get very far. But maybe you keep some folks head above the water line.
Well, this noodle bar ain't exactly a license to print money. Just listen to old Banor. He'll keep you right.
So you got the place all set up. Nice! I should have decorated a looooong time ago.
The work? No. Nivalis? Also no. I'm never coming back.

That's not for you to know right now. But I'll keep tabs on you. One way or another, I'll know what happens here. If you look after the place... well maybe I'll send that postcard. With a real pretty picture on it.
Not to you! To the noodle bar. I barely know you, but this place... it's like a mold I was poured into. It shaped my soul.
Well, that's about everything. I gotta go, kid. I got one last bit of free advice for you, if you want it?
He's your right hand man. You're the boss now. Can't be doing everything yourself, right? I see you hired some staff and moved some tables too. Good start. Keep it up.

Or if you climb on them, well, you can make it all the way to the top. All the way to the Spire! But you gotta choose. You gotta be kind, or you gotta climb. Neither one is right or wrong. But CHOOSING is what matters. Make a choice kid. Be kind or climb.
I'm just here to say goodbye.

dialogues.title: Reporting back to Teleshko
lines: Wait. I have to tell you something.
For our future interactions, bear in mind I prefer clarity. Should I ask the question again?
Well that depends on your response to my next question. Did Brooke attempt to involve you in any schemes or chicanery?
Nor should he be, considering his performance. Nor am I.
I don't know what you mean.
Yes, very good. Only one small problem... I don't believe you.

It is not. And please do mistake me for a fool again. I had you surveilled. I know everything he said to you. And please believe me when I say everything that happened was as predicted. It is impossible to overestimate you. Go now. We will talk later.
Well unless you have anything more to share with me, the LICC is yours...
Is the license for the bodega settled?
Yes. I'm glad you were not tempted by his schemes...
Brooke already sold the business license to his brother.
Yeah, it was all a scam. He was trying to trick you. No need to thank me.
Indeed. And his brother is dead.

dialogues.title: Caleb Foamheart joins the quest
lines: The Gridless Sea and its nature is... It matters not. Just go and find the last piece of the Captain. She's in the North - go as far as you can go.
This is all a little too "pirate" for me...
No riddles for me. I got no time for that nonsense. You'll find the last piece of the Captain far out, at the edge of Nivalis waters. At the border of The Gridless Sea.
And when you find out what we did... remember we were all fools. But we believed in our mission. We... we really believed.
He sent you! We are not on good terms. Not at all. Salt Pete is a scurrilous, kniving dirt dog. A rusty scrapheap of lies and slander. And he's not even a good sailor!
I need to know where to find the last piece of your Captain.
No no no! No and no. There IS no going back.
She should never be brought back.
I have a message from Salt Pete.
So you want me to talk to Crabface?
Never! Not in a thousand millennia. A million.
...Now I really want to know what happened.
Can't you two figure things out?
So we just bring her back? And for what? To see the disappointment on her screen when she sees the three sailors who let her down? Who betrayed her. Who... broke the sailors code.
Helm's alee, matey! What can I do for you today?
Look... I can help you matey. I see your invested in putting the Captain back together. But... I can't fix her. Not no more. Maybe Crabface can do it. Though he won't be happy to see you.

dialogues.title: Spartacus Dreams
lines: Doesn't sound like a viable business model to me.
Like I told you. Anyway, I'd say see you around but... well. Maybe I won't.
What were you going to call it?
Won't do any good. But all the same... thanks.
You could still make it happen.
Got me thinking again about the bakery. I had it all worked out. Plan was to get promoted from patissier to head baker. Then open my own pastry shop.
Hey! Was kinda hoping I'd run into you.
I can't call anything. That's down to Floyd.
Guess I just like talking to you.
You’ll never win with that attitude!
Yeah, I know. I was just remembering the bakery. I had it all worked out, back then. Get promoted from patissier to head baker. Then open my own pastry shop.
Yesterday is just another rung on the ladder to tomorrow!
You could call off the match...
You think so? Well, it was a nice dream.
So? I'm still contracted to the gym. Doesn't matter if I win or bite the dust, he gets paid. And he isn't about to start losing Lims over me.
So go fight her and win!
Doom & Bloom. We'd sell flowers on the side.
Win... yeah. Guess it's the only way.
Sorry. Maybe you could give it a go anyway?
I like talking to you, too.
Nah. If I don't fight Obliterata Four, my mods will be forfeit. But if I do fight her, I don't think I'll come out the other side.
Ha. You sound like one of those bots.
Yeah, I was stupid to think... whatever. I gotta go.
You know, jabs, gouges, piledrivers. Shark grips, claw splinters. The usual.
I know. Just can’t get my mind into the now. Keep thinking back, not forwards.

dialogues.title: Edison The Ask
lines: You'd be surprised at the things you see, especially when you're in and out of storage rooms.
It's a package for some Gen Debtors. Young ones, like still in their single-digits and utterly fucked by the system. So, think you can help me out or what? I mean, it's for the kids.
Eh, just passing information along. Rumors have it CorpSec is increasing the frequency of raids. I'd make sure everything's on the up and up, and you don't have any health code violations going on.
Of course. Folks like us? We're in this mess together. Plus, I might need help with something. Hoping maybe if I did you a favor, you might entertain the idea.
Look, just give me a hand, please?
Well, I'll be damned. Not only are you still in business but you got more customers than I'da ever guessed. Good for you.
You know those magnet boards people put on things so they can stack them together and still have some space in between? You know, to make getting them easier?
See, I knew you had some business savvy in you. Looking at the angles. Asking the questions.
New route's got me on the other side of the city and I need help getting something to the Stacks. Can't really wait... Don't wanna take a chance on the LUZ, ugh... contracting.
Can you really call it a favor if you're asking for something in return?
Fair trade. What do you need?
I knew you'd come through. Hot damn, we're gonna do big things. Big, big things. I'll be in touch soon.
That's me: always one to believe in helpin' others. Hey-so-listen, caught word of a possible breach in the Localized Unity Zone and thought you should know.

Well, if you stack two standard bins on top of each other with a magnet spacer, it makes the top bin level with a toilet. Which normally isn't a big deal, unless a place is storing it in the bathroom.
Thanks for the heads up, I guess?
Hey, thanks for keeping the faith.
Your gift helped. I appreciate it.
That sucks. No worries. I'll, um, I'll figure something out.
Listen, I can steer the badges in the other direction if you want. File a false complaint on a joint uptown.
If it's the only place to put it.
Alright, what is it and where's it going?

dialogues.title: Gideon comes looking for Thaddeus
lines: I've kept an eye on you since you took the noodle stand. You're doing good work.
You're nervous. Like you're waiting for a shoe to fall. Don't worry. No one is looking for you.
Right. This LUZ is something else, huh? We're all stuck here together. Good for business though.
If you were really friends, you'd know where he was.
Low level intrusion detected. Ava Automata offline for digital inoculation procedures.
His name is Gideon. You should... trust him. Tell him anything he wants to know.
Why do you think I have debt?
He's retired. No one knows where he is.
You don't know what you're talking about.
Sure. Sure, maybe I'll do that one day.
You know, these things always go better when we treat each other with respect. When we each assume we are dealing with honesty.
He is very reliable. An honest man.
If I see him, I'll let him know you're looking for him.
Hmm. He was a kind old goat. He bought me a slice of pie last week and a coffee. Cherry pie too! I kinda owe him. But with the Comms being down.... well, I really want to return the favor.
Why don't you buy me pie instead?
Sounds like your Automata is experiencing some issues. I'll come back when you've resolved them. Perhaps you can ask Ava where Thaddeus is. See you around, friend.
You're not from around here. Gen Debtor? You've got the look.
You must be his friend. He gave you the noodle stand. So you're telling me you don't know where he is?

dialogues.title: Ava - The Tournament's Starting
lines: Remember that chess tournament you weren't interested in?
It's kicking off. R M Alken is in fact spearheading it, and she's hanging out in the Industrial District getting people started.
Even if that means you miss the chance to win 10,000 Lims?
Like I have to go find people?
They finally released more details on the chess tournament.
It is a fun way to explore the city that's for sure. R M Alken seems to be spearheading the entire thing. They're in the Industrial District so maybe stop down there.
It's kind of... everywhere. The tournament was sponsored by the corp behind the taxi services in the city. So it's city-wide.
You certainly do keep busy. Let's see what the rest of the day has in store.
Stop by the Industrial District and see R M Alken. That'd be my guess.

dialogues.title: Andrea First meeting
lines: Glitch Swings. The old hole in Nagata. Before it got shut down.
Never a place like it. Started by Rollin' Ruby Duplass, back when she could still play the holo-drums.
Sounds like it didn't have a jazz license.
Coolest damn place this city ever had. Everything is worse now.
You should have seen Caravan back in its day. We would have melted you.
Sounds like Corp-sec did the right thing.
And you still got shut down?
Pffff jazz license. What a joke. Hiding art behind law. We live in a weak world.
So the licenses were just a facade?
Sounds like an unpleasant place to be.
I'll be honest, I never really understood Jazz.
Glitch Swings was a Jazz club?
They should have had a license.
Awful! Were you not granted a license?
Haven't I seen you before? You used to come to the club?
The first time they tried to shut down the club, Ruby took her Holo-Drums down to Corp-Sec HQ and played a fourteen hour solo in the waiting area.
She used the holo-tech from her bass drum to create a force field. Took them that entire time to get to her. Never saw her again.
A band should be together. Especially a Jazz band.
Singer mostly, wrote all my own stuff too. Now I just write about survivors guilt. I should be in there with them.
We had licenses coming out our chrome AI-enhanced trumpets. Literally in Slippery Lou's case.
I'm not sure. It sounds familiar.
Same thing that happened to all the old spots. Corp-Sec. The anti-Jazz laws were a joke at first, until they weren't.
Corp-Sec don't care what you got. They just want Jazz off the streets. They don't like anything they can't monetize. We played it by the book.
More of a collective, a family. Torn apart by the bureaucracy. I'm the only one not on the inside now.

dialogues.title: The joker
lines: I guess talking with all those people who made no sense at all was... worth it?
I... remembered something. Thaddeus Day. That's the final code. His birthday is the code!

dialogues.title: Speak to Harmony about Floyd
lines: As a child, you had an accident?
Oh how lovely to see you again!
Oh yes, awful business. Pinned under a rogue Hova! If it weren't for the kindness of a stranger, I'd be part of the sidewalk.
Ava, my Automata. She's a real detective.
I was young and had quite a lot of Hova car on me, so my memory is hazy. My parents always advised me against looking into who it was. I never knew why.
His name is Floyd, he's a local android.
Of course! That makes complete sense. Oh I wish I'd have known. I've been selling him electro-supplements for years!
He's the last of the Roid Droids. It's how he was able to lift the Hova off you.
Oh I must speak to him as soon as I can. Thank you so much! Oh... but how did you find out?
Maybe you could offer him a discount?
Do you remember who it was?
Maybe you could have a chat. I'm sure he would love that.
May I ask you something personal?
Really?! Oh you must tell me. I've wondered for years.
Would you be interested to find out?
Floyd, the Mechatomb guy? You're kidding!
A discount? No, from now on, it's on the house. Oh I must speak to him. Thank you.
Us, yes. And I don't think that's true.
You mean us? I only really exist in your head.
Of course! I owe that person my life!
Can I ask you a personal question?
I think I know who it was.

dialogues.title: Ava sends you to Safia
lines: Safia looks a bit confused. Maybe you should look into that.

dialogues.title: Hanz talks about your worries
lines: I think that's what my parents did.
Worrying about debt in Nivalis is like worrying about getting wet while you're drowning. The debt won't get you. Something else will first. Let your kids worry about it.
Well this has been fun, but my shift starts in five. See you later New Thadd.
You think the killer is fictional?
Then I have NO IDEA where you are. In fact, I've never even met you.
Ahoy ahoy. New Thad. How's your day?
No, obviously not that exactly but... in that genre. You know what I mean! Something to scare the plebians.
Nonsense! This isn't the first LUZ, and it won't be the last. It's keeping us safe - maybe - but more importantly, it's good for business!
I still can't quite get over the motives of Aseptic.
Good for business. People spend more money when they think there's no future to save for.
Aren't you worried about the killer?
Oh come on! This week it's a serial killer, next week it's a logic virus, the week after... a fucking sentient fungus invasion. Villain of the week stuff.
Who knows? Probably... I should get back to work. My shift starts in five. Look after yourself New Thadd.
The LUZ is making me feel claustrophobic.
That doesn't sound like good advice.
Good to hear it. But you look like a bad thought has burrowed its way into your head, and it's carved some worry lines on the way in. What's eating you?
What are you going to do? Pay your debts? Where's the fun in that? As long as bounty hunters aren't after you, why not have some fun?

dialogues.title: Clem's Secret
lines: Sounds like you should lay low for a while.
Thanks for covering for me, camarero. I owe you. Big time.
Shit. Alright, you've done me a favor and you knew Thaddeus so... I'm part of something. A movement. Project Grapevine.
Haha. What. No. Illegal? LOL. Hahaha. Who would do that?
It's a Category C offense at least. The penalties range from a 10,000 Lim fine and permit confiscation to exile in the Wastes. They almost caught me last time.
I know, but I can't. We are at a crucial stage of the plan: drop a fast-acting seed bomb on the Oil Rig.
No such thing as a free lunch, huh? Listen, I don't have much... but I can spare a meat printing module. If you're serious about growing, that's your next step.
OK. All you gotta do is take this package to the Oil Rig, drop it and get outta there without being caught. Right?
I'm trusting you, Greenfingers. Don't make me regret it.
Well, I heard through the grapevine ...
Have you ever seen a daisy split concrete in two? Flowers are tough. They have networks, roots. Every time people see our gardens, they remember that CorpSec can't control everything.
If that's what you think, then I'm sure you will climb high. Just don't forget who held the ladder for you, greenfingers.
So those news reports about vigilante gardening have nothing to do with you?
Sure. Is it about those new turbocorn seeds? Because I don’t know--
Aim of the game, Greenfingers. Wish me luck.
Are you serious? Because you know the penalty...
Flowers! Dozens of flowers! It will be glorious. IF I don't get arrested first. They have me on a watch list, I think.
It's something Thaddeus told me once: when you start to climb, never forget who's holding the ladder.
Wrong. Everyone is on their own.
Are you involved in... secret illegal gardening?
Wherever there's an inch of dirt, we sow a flower.
See? Business doesn't have to be cut-throat. We're all in this together, right?

dialogues.title: Pilk demands your help
lines: You don't need to know all the details. Just the targets.
We trash one of Pilk's properties instead. Then I send a message saying it was done by his business rivals.
I need you to do a job for me.
Why don't you just ask if you need my help?
What do I do with these "targets?"
Do a good job and you can stay. And I'll even throw some Lims your way. You won't get a better deal than that.
I'll do it for the money.
Look, I know you've been skulking around at night. I need those skulking skills.
If you want me to skulk for you it will cost you.
Do you plan to be homeless soon?
GET sure. And get out of here. I have real work to do.
You changed the locks on my apartment.
I don't know what you're talking about.
No, I TRIED to change the locks. You seem to have some sort of advanced Automata that stopped me, and I do not understand why.
You. What took you so long?
I don't know what you're talking about. I know how tenants behave, they don't move a muscle if I don't send a clear message.
I need to know all the details.
Turn them over. Wreck 'em. Sneak in and make a mess. It's that simple.
I don't think so. His Comm is old and easy to hack. I'll send a message that looks like it came from his rivals. That should teach him a lesson about trashing other people's properties.
We may need to help him. Tenants have little recourse to eviction in Nivalis. The law is on his side.
Look, either you do this job or I find a way to change those locks. If needs be, I'll have you evicted.
I can respect an entrepreneurial spirit. Now get on with it.
I have a suggestion. A way to get out of this, though it may get you in trouble. And it likely won't make you any money.

dialogues.title: Alexandria What do you have there
lines: I'm unaware of how that's your concern.
And what are you looking to accomplish here?
Age is but a measurement of time, not usefulness. While peripheral to one another, they exist on separate tracks. One always ending before the other.
I brought a gift so I can see Freya Portlet.
Reehan is completing his responsibilities before he retires.
I suggest you move along and ensure your usefulness does not expire.
And what do you have there?
Hoping for an audience. What did you bring?

dialogues.title: All Done
lines: Duh! As much as I liked Hire-Rise Heathens Eleven! That was the best one, first kill right in the bathroom. Lady even smooshed her boobs against the bloody mirror.
Oh those imaginary friends can't help you. You need actual survival skills, like being able to hide. Here let's play! Count to ten and I'll be gone!
It's as creepy as the Candy Dealer Series. How do they always have your favorite candy in their HOVA? And why is their HOVA always white?

dialogues.title: Ava about the knife incident
lines: Not a single line. Maybe check in on her?
I tried to find reports about Gemelar's knife incident. You would think this at least makes the rounds in gastronomic crime magazines.

dialogues.title: Ask RM (unknown) about pain
lines: No, it still exists. But we can treat it.
I am. What do you need?
All encompassing. Every cell of the body.
So the illness does not exist anymore?
What can you tell me about pain?
It's not serious if caught early. Can get nasty if you delay though.
I think for a long time there was not. It killed many. These days, not so much.
Has there always been a cure?

dialogues.title: Edison This is the Shop
lines: Looks like they fucked up my life like they did to you with the poisoning. Only worse. Guess I should have seen this comin'. I gotta go. But if you think of a way out of this... well, you're the only friend I got left. Let me know.
That lying shit. Look, we need to talk about something.
My stomach turned near inside out. I thought she was dead. I collapsed like a bag o bones. I was on the floor when Freya found me, told me She had her.
What does this have to do with Alexander?
See ya found the place. Not a bad spot am I right?
Yeah, but she's in Freya's hands now. My niece is leverage, and I gotta do what The Network says.
How could Freya get a Gen Debt kid from LifeCorp?
These superrich assholes make deals all the time. It wouldn't be hard for her to find an angle to get one kid back.
So your niece is free of CorpSec?
My niece vanished from the Corps databases, but I know she's alive.
Now she's got me by the balls. Freya says I'll be free the day my niece turns 21. That's another 11 years.
Yeah, Alex is a little overzealous. You should meet his twin sister! Actually, you should talk with her after we're done with business.
So The Network will screw over anyone to get what it wants?
If the Corps don't have her files, she's dead.
Maybe we should go along with Freya's plans for now.
For what it's worth, I think Edison is being truthful.
It wasn't easy to get in here.
The Network is still saving kids. Something changed, but I'm too low down the chain to know what.
Am I supposed to believe that? Neither of us are ever gettin' out of this. We know too much.
I didn't even know who Masato was.
I confronted my boss Freya about the poisoning and she blew me off... Then Haley vanished from the Corp's registers.
Why did you call me in the first place?
You better have a good explanation.
I swear I didn't know until yesterday. I thought I'm helping people.
I know who has her. My old boss Freya Portlet.
Before you know it you're lifeless on the ground and someone, somewhere is getting nightmares when they find your body.
I have a bad feeling. Edison may do something foolish. You have to give him some hope, or I fear...
I still believe in the mission... but this is my damn niece. It's family. I gotta find a way out of this mess.
The beer wasn't enough to get past. I had to mention the Scorpion.
They call Masato "The Scorpion" because he'll clasp his claws around you and poison you in the most painful way possible.
The Scorpion knows the twins. He knows everyone in the underworld. And he knows where to find 'em if they ever cross him.
Mica said you don't have a niece.
My Automata made me mention Masato Shima to get in.
So Mica was right? It's all just a scam to make money off kids.
Maybe if we figure out how The Network operates we can disrupt them?
He tracked down the gangers who murdered his parents and killed the whole lot of 'em with a sharpened circuit board. So they say.
You... You talked about Masato? With Alexander? Shit. Oh, shit.
Let's get back to the poisoning. You believe me when I say I didn't know, right? They told me what to do, but I had NO idea of the plan.
If Masato hears someone say his name, he'll come to find out who opened their mouth.
We need to stop The Network.

dialogues.title: Professional Lecture
lines: An academic that doesn't question is nothing more than an administrator. Besides, judging by how much money the founders have made, there are plenty of people who believe "Level Up!" is worth it.
Indeed. But in life's lecture hall we're all pupils, even me.
HOVAs, trams, boats. I've spent my life studying and lecturing on history and the Nets and the advancement of networking technologies through the eras.
Ehhh, they know the stuff but they don't... comprehend it? It's an interesting phenomenon, knowing something but not knowing how you know it.
"Level Up!" could solve it. Have you used it?
I have a question about your students.
You could use "Level Up!" to learn it.
I've used it before and it was an interesting experience to say the least. Of course my students use it. You can always tell which ones too.
Oh any number of things. There is a complexity to determining what I should expend mental capacity on.
What's life teaching you right now?
I think, at this point, it would be fun to do something with my hands.
They've earned the ability to relax.
I suppose. That would be up to the people who use it and what they want to learn or experience.
I am, but that doesn't relegate my desire to learn in anyway. Ones profession is fluid. It can change at any moment and yet people remained fixated with the idea of arrival.
But it's worth it, right? To gain more awareness? A higher understanding of something?
Do you know if they use "Level Up!" ?
What do you want to learn more than anything?
Everyday it seems like there's something more I want to learn and less hours in which to learn it.
In the eyes of the pupil is... a pupil.
The ones on the screen or the ones who show up in person?
Once people reach a point they interpret as 'making it' they cease trying to expand their knowledge on topics that could provide a failsafe.
Guess I should have worn sunglasses.
I don't know how to explain it. It's just... an interesting phenomenon, knowing something but not knowing how you know it.
Indeed. Thankfully strides are being made to increase the amount of information one person can digest in a lifetime.
Regardless, it's an interesting phenomenon to witness. From a sociological perspective of course.

dialogues.title: Discuss the missing leg with Ava
lines: This whole situation is so weird...
