I think that theory has legs.
Surely Marius knew he wasn't getting his leg back?
My theory is that Marius isn't telling us something.

dialogues.title: Banor - Level 4 reached
lines: I'd say we turned that ship around, boss!
And how would we do that?
Level 4 is not bad at all. But still a fight for every customer. Too much competition.
You got my drift. Not easy. And it needs investments. But it's worth it: No empty chairs anymore.
Well, if we reached level five, that would change. CorpSec gives venues a real visibility boost.
Just well-paying customers in an all-time packed restaurant.
Four and a half star reviews on average. We need to keep at least 5 staff on the payroll.

dialogues.title: Simple ending
lines: No. He sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.
They say when you hear your name in a dream, you wake up. Is your name Thaddeus?
If you're getting this message, it means the process failed. I guess it was my time. Damn! I feel tired though. I just wanted to clear up some things before I shuffle off stage.
The message origin is clear. It came from Sang Ha. I believe he was there all along.
So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?
I feel like we missed something Ava...
No. But he sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.
I think there was more to this mystery... but we did not solve it.
I'm quite relieved. He's finally gone?

With any luck, you'll never hear this message. And if you do... well, there's one thing you should know. If you've ever felt like you're different from everyone else - like you're unique - you are. More than you can ever know, you are.

You thought Ava was spying on you, and that wasn't the whole truth. All this time, I was watching you through the eyes of your friends. If you were just a smidge more curious, I'd have more to tell you. As it stands, best we keep it simple.

dialogues.title: Mila Calcifer Interviews you
lines: My father, Mr Gospodin, needs support, kindness and encouragement. His mood has been very low since he lost his... Since he experienced a bereavement.
This interview is for you to learn about us as much as it is for us to learn about you.
Yes indeed. You have done quite well.
Let me just calculate your score so far. Perhaps you can tell from the sound of my voice that I am pleased with your choices up to this point.
I pay for my half. He can figure out the rest.
You're chickening out? Then you're not for my father.
You're a funny young woman. I really like you! Your father will be happy.
Excellent question. I'm glad to hear you are engaging in this process pro-actively and asking for more information.
Yes indeed. We have many candidates to get through, and several rounds of evaluations and questionnaires, so let's keep moving.
Some of these questions will make you interrogate your deepest beliefs and values.
He needs your love, not your protection!
You are out with Mr Gospodin and some of his friends. One of them, "Janice", makes a joke about his threadbare sweater and low income.
Well friendship is also an option. You can become pals. Buds. Besties! Please, trust the process and talk with my father at your earliest possible convenience.
... Please note that although there are no wrong answers this is nonetheless the wrong answer.
I'm not sure I want that.
I... really thought you might do better. Well... thank you for your time. I guess I'll go see if Danny still wants to do the interview. Or... *sigh* Lucy.
You're as brave as it gets. But this here doesn't help him!
Yes, he is. But he's already wounded.
I will ask a series of questions to build up a social, interpersonal, emotional and romantic profile of who you are as a person. Please answer truthfully at all times.
He is eating spaghetti. He has sauce on his chin. Not a small amount. Half a meatball is stuck on there. Do you tell him?
While this "tough love" approach may work for some people, I'm afraid this is a little TOO tough for me. And for Mr Gospodin.
I would play it cool... but later I would confront Janice in private and make it clear that if she ever hurt Garnet again, I would feed her into a sustenance recombinator.
I'm afraid you haven't quite met the required grade to continue on to the next stage of the interview.
You defused an awkward situation and secured a second date. Good work!
I pay for us, but ask him to transfer the Lims as soon as he gets home
Good day, welcome to the interview. Please take a seat.
Time for your third question, and the last for today. I hope you're finding this process rewarding.
I'm still not sure about this.
Mr Gospodin - my father - currently has an opening available for the role of friend, partner, lover, smooch-buddy, acquaintance, bestie and/or sister-or-brother-from-another-mother.
What a threatening and direct approach. You will note that the tone of my voice there was not one of disappointment or disapproval.
I'll pay. It's only spaghetti. And he can pay for the next one.
Then what should I do? This world is gonna eat him alive!
She implies Mr Gospodin is lazy. Though he laughs this off, you can tell it upsets him, but Janice, with her stupid smirk, is somehow his best friend. How do you deal with this situation?
Oh... really? You want to opt out? Neither me nor Mr Gospodin will contact you about this opportunity - or anything else - again.
I'll talk to him. Without your permission!
Well done! I am pleased to announce you are through to the next round. Good work.
Janice is Garnet's friend, not mine. It's not my place to get involved, and making a scene might cause more embarrassment.
That seems sensible, but I'm afraid you missed out on an opportunity to secure a second date with a high value companion.
That is an option if you meet our advanced recruitment criteria. Can I just check, at this time, are you interested in ANY of these positions?
Yes, challenging bullies in such a direct way and making them justify their words is effective and I approve.
I will be in contact. Meanwhile, please seek out Mr Gospodin. My research suggests more interactions can foster more intimate relationships.
Is that the end of the quiz?
He'll find someone else. Don't spoil it again!
Yes, this is about my father.
And this process may make you reevaluate your ethics, how you deal with others, and even your fundamental understanding of who you are as a person.
I would very clearly ask her to repeat the joke and explain why it is funny. Bullies don't like it when you ask them to justify themselves.
So... clean him up a bit?
Just don't lock him away like you did from me!
Get out! You had your chance!
Okay, it was funny in the beginning, but the joke is getting old.
Please don't delay. We have a lot of candidates to get through. This is a very popular position we're recruiting for today.
However, he also needs someone who is honest and clear with him, and will help him through clear communication, and positive feedback.
Only one more question - for this round anyway. Let's push through.

Hmm, a "hands off" approach might not be the best in this situation. I'm noting your answer, but please notice the change in my demeanor, the position of my eyebrows, and the way I am typing in an agitated manner.
In a way, yes. But this is more important than a job.

Yes, precisely. Now your meal together is coming to an end. Mr Gospodin reveals he has left his wallet at home, and his Comm is broken - again - because every time I tell him he needs a new one, he says "But I don't like how heavy the new Comms are..."
Are you sure you want to stop now, or do you want to learn more?
To offset any inconvenience, at the end you will be given a cookie.
I get it, you want to protect him from whatever.
Please save your own questions for the end. Now, here is your first scenario task... You are eating dinner with Mr Gospodin.
Listen, Mila. You're a great daughter to your father.

dialogues.title: Gan Coilson has a hint
lines: I'm like a red wine stain on a carpet - never really go away.
Be quick. I have only covered 20% of my daily vacuum quota.
Yes. I need help with something.
That obviously changed all the time.
When you were CTO at LifeCorp, what was the keycode for your network technicians to access The Old Network service rooms?
Those technicians were just too stupid to memorize a more complex pass phrase.

dialogues.title: Marcelle Leaves a good or OK review
lines: "The food tastes like a rainy Tuesday afternoon on a tropical island. Familiar yet heady, warm as the owner's smile."
"The food tastes like a rainy Tuesday afternoon: hum-drum yet soothing with just a hint of the owner's spicy personality peeking through."
Mr DeNuite has written a review of your business in his column "Kind of a Big Dill". Would you like to hear it?
From reading Mr DeNuite's previous columns, it could certainly be a lot worse.
It's fair. Do you want to hear?
Perhaps. Mr DeNuite's column is very popular. I can read you some of the comments--
I'll pass on the comments, thanks.

dialogues.title: Talk with Curzona about conditions
lines: Now run along. Mommy has interest to calculate. Hahahaha.
Here you are, right on time.
I do. And I'm transferring the balance... now. There. That was easy, wasn't it? Almost painless.

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Sixth Meeting
lines: You don't trust him with finding a sponsor?
I hope he does this time.
I love him. I really do, but in a pinch, he doesn't always come through.
Yeah I'd stay away from the Miso thing.
I still can't believe Danny is trying to get my identity changed. Are you sure about that?
I love him. I really do. But he doesn't always come through...
They let him get about ten meters past the threshold. Then the air blinked. like someone flicked off reality and he was just... gone. Not even a stain left behind.
And not a word from my brother. I can't stop thinking about him. What if he needs me?
I hope he does this time.
I'm sure he'll find the funds.

News? Yeah. I’m the proud new owner of four rejections, two interviews that ghosted me, and a courtesy call from a temp agency that wanted me to hand out Miso-paste samples on a street corner. At least I think it was an agency... He had a weird voice.
You're writing job applications? Are you mad? Shouldn't you be on the run?
Disturbing’s the baseline here, friend. If you’re not disturbed by that, you’re probably disturbed in a different way.
Still skulking around like me then?
Meh. Maybe I should take it. Seems fitting, right? At least then I’m helping someone leave The LUZ, even if it’s just a body.
Yeah. You just have to trust him.
I heard they even welded some of the transit gates shut.
Ok... Well they let him get about ten meters past the threshold. Then the air blinked. like someone flicked off reality and he was just... gone. Not even a stain left behind.
I just hope Danny finds the money for the identity change.
Yeah, right. Leave. We’re all happy little citizens of the Localized Unity Zone now. No one in, no one out. Mandatory solidarity. "Enforced by us, enjoyed by you!" What a joke.
One guy offered me a job threading biomesh into funeral suits. Said it was "close enough" to silicon weaving. Pays in city credits I can’t even spend outside the LUZ. I told him I’d think about it.
Can't say I'm much of a skulker.
You sure? The way you're dragging your feet feels sort of skulky. Skulkular.
I don't really want to know.
Classic CorpSec, they didn't even weld them properly. One of the clamps snapped last week. Some kid tried to slip through. You know what happened?
As my mother used to say, "Taste the paste, and it clings to your waist!" I'm not really sure what that means to be honest.

dialogues.title: Tell Freya You Found an Act
lines: You have to be yourself or you'll never survive. Didn't anyone ever tell you that?
So now you'll stop being a major pain in the ass to everyone?
So, to the Spire we go?
Yeah, to the Spire we go. You got a spark I guess. Now we just gotta see if it ignites.
Yeah, and myself is a better person.
We'll see. Let's start with handling the influx of new customers this is gonna bring you. See if you still have the energy for more after that.
I'm impressed. And I don't say that often. Or ever. If the act you found is half as good as these people think, well...
No, I believe I did. Which is why I called you. Did you think I'd put you up to this if I thought you'd fail? With my name on it? Please.

dialogues.title: Nixxy On the Street
lines: Filming? No. Why would you say that?
Ok. Ok nice! They liked that. Maybe you can be a recurring character.
Hello, Nixxy's Pixies! I am once again coming to you from Meridian Market where I'm about to try... Uhh... Can I help you?
Don't worry folks, there will be NO downtime today, so leave your comments and vote in our daily poll.
No, wait! The poll results are in and I'm supposed to talk to you. So... who are you?
I have no idea what you're talking about.
Don't be mad. Frowning doesn't help this whole situation. And by "situation", I mean your face.
You sounded like you were talking to... an invisible cameraman.
Well I'm Nixxy. One moment. I should say... WHAT? Sure, I'll tell them... I think you're the ugliest person I've met this week.
You seem to be busy, so I'll...
Stick around please. We might need you again.
Tell me who you are first.
I'll leave you to your... fans.

dialogues.title: Ava has some info on Thaddeus
lines: I know what you are going to ask. I do not know how Thaddeus knew you were in trouble. Nor do I know how we managed to dissuade Agent Teleshko.
Interesting. I can only guess what that means.
Are you both keeping tabs on me?
Why is there anything? Is it a valid question to ask? When it comes to reality, WHY is it? Or... is there no "why?"
I have no means to pass messages to Thaddeus.

Is there always a "why"? Almost always. Why does the rain fall? Clouds form from water. Why does the wind blow? Air pressure and... such. Why am I rambling? I do not have enough data to talk clearly. Why is there something? ...There is no why. The question is invalid.
Are you communicating with him in secret?
He means, "Why there is something instead of nothing?"
I think we all have to figure that out for ourselves.
He said he was looking for answers to "the only thing without a WHY". Does that make sense to you?
...He did tell me one thing. Before he left he said he was looking for "answers."

dialogues.title: Lois says hey
lines: I just realized you're the first real person I've talked to this week. And, don't take this the wrong way, but that is really fucking depressing.
Yesterday I spent eight hours working on an in-game cosmetic item for WarZoner: Conquest Champions of the Battleground.
Golden armor for your war camel. It costs five million Lims.
Sounds depressing, right? Believe me, it's nothing compared to the shit the corps make me work on in my day job.
It gets worse. If you don't buy the golden camel armor then your camel gets killed in a cut scene and there's an unskippable three hour death animation.
It's the worst. I hate almost everything I make.
Some kind of monkey from mythology.
Didn't know the corps make games.
Unsociable hours. I'm a game developer.
Wow. Well, I should get back to work...
Then you get a message asking if you want to buy camel armor so your next camel won't die.
Me too. Thanks for the "human contact".
The Lightness of a Shattered Heart? Darkness And Despair Quest? Crimson Freeways Across My Wrists? The Void of Desolation? Super Bunny Block Jumper 3?
I should get back to work...
I'm not the best gamer, but try me!
In my free time I can make some indie stuff. In fact, that's all I really care about. You might have played some of my games.
Hey, heard you're going to take on the noodle stand. Thanks for keeping the place open.

dialogues.title: Samuel Jaynes First meeting
lines: Over millennia, we have convinced ourselves that our brains are one, belonging entirely to ourselves, but if we learn to listen, we will learn to hear.
It is as if life evolved to a certain point and then in ourselves turned at a right angle and simply exploded in another direction.
Which direction were we going before?
Take a moment with me now.... Allow your breathing to sync with the city... Allow written language to seep from your skin and feel that weight as it becomes a part of the world around you...
Now open your mind in all directions... Reach out... Reach out... Reach out... Can you hear them?
Have you ever wondered where our consciousness comes from?
Care to hear the voice of the true Gods?
Ugh... then, perhaps you are more ready than most to share your path. Return to me when you'd like to explore your insides more comprehensively.
How do we hear these voices?
I'm not sure I need to hear MORE voices...
I believe that our path through life is a collaboration with those who know us best and that if we are willing to listen, we are joined on our journey, not forced along it.
Locating the true voice can take time. Return to me when you'd like to explore your insides more comprehensively.
Given time, I believe we can all reunite with our bicameral selves. From there, the voices will return.
You speak only of mortal voices. Even those made digital and synthetic pale in the shadow of the True Gods.
The voices of those so ancient and internal that we have all but tuned out their frequency. When we recover our bicameral mind, we recover words of our makers.
Well, it is my belief that one half of our brain 'does', because the other half 'tells', and the voice that does the telling belongs not to us, but to the true gods.
Ok, that didn't answer my question.
The True Gods! The gods only revealed to us when we return to our true bicameral mind.
I expect it does to ears attached to a non-bicameral mind.

dialogues.title: Return to Clem
lines: I'll take your word for it.
Just... remember to help others out, yeah? Same way I helped you.
Ha, he’s kinda salty when he’s working. Which is, you know, all the time. But he’s a sweetheart really. Or at least a umami-heart.
Hey, thanks SO much for filling in with the delivery. Appreciate it. Sal treat you OK?
It's like a furry HOVA with stilts instead of landing pads. With a cellulose input port at the front.
Listen, you want another job? I gotta go to the Spire for a few days, and I hate saying no to my customers...
Are you in some kind of trouble?
Claro, no problem. Well, you know where I am. But if I'm ever gone for more than a few days and you can't find me...
I've got more important things to do right now.
Ugh, some CEO wants me to grow an overnight flower meadow for his daughter's birthday. They got drone-bees, holoflies, a pony, the works. Sick, huh?
Forget it, it's not your problem. See you.
Me? I'm just a gardener. But it'd be nice to know some people still care, despite everything.
Claro. It's the same deal as before. See what the client wants, grow it, send it. Easy as peas. I'll transfer their details to your HUD.
I'll see what I can do.

dialogues.title: An Altar of Ones and Zeros
lines: The Scripture of Ones and Zeros is NOT hokum. It's a beautiful translation of our world. My flat just isn't the right place. It's too... plain.
Hence the truth seeking aspect of the ordeal.
I can help you spruce it up.
Yeah? You'd turn my place into an altar for the Binary God?
Don't have a place to do it.
The Church of the Binary God has allowed for the inter-personal-space study project to commence! IPSSP whooo!
It's a coding framework that allows for the user to participate in truth seeking through a self-guided data run they can do at home.
Lotta hokum to be bringing into your house.
That's a lot of big words.
Ones and zeros and an atrium to study them in.
Pleeeasssseee! This is my way to self-discovery! I just need help, you know, discovering it.
I have a flat, thank you. Just not one that's of the caliber this needs. It's too... plain.
It would be, but there's a problem. At least for me anyway.

dialogues.title: Banor wants to restore peace
lines: Hey, boss. This photography lady, Malloy, is causing trouble.
If you hear people talking about this, tell them to stop.
We need to sort this out.
She is saying fame is calling Roberta and "obstacles" are in the way.
Thanks for letting me know. I will talk with Malloy.
She's walking around here, talking to staff, asking them about Roberta. It's causing a ruckus.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Huckstash
lines: Mr Huckstash is waiting for you at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Narc
lines: If you’re what’s outside it, then I’m pretty happy where I am.
You think you're the only one? Silly, silly bunny.
These "free" doctors are wolves in white coats. Sharks bloodying the clear waters of commerce.
Time is money. What information do you have?
Citizen. Tired of life at the bottom of the barrel yet?
Such dedication is to be applauded. And rewarded. Name your carrot, bun bun.
I thought it was my duty to tell you.
The target's name is Dr Fred Matombo. She runs an illegal free clinic in the Sewers.
Touché, bunny. If your information proves correct, you’ll have your Lims. I suggest you use them wisely.
I actually have a new target for you.
Ambition suits you. Well? Who is this miscreant?
Seems that bunny has discovered the art of the deal. You'll get your carrot... if I like what I hear.
Not so fast. I’ll want a carrot in return.
Bunny. Do you have a tasty carrot for me?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 11
lines: Good morning. If at first you don’t succeed, try LifeHype, the newest cognitive enhancer to revive ambition. This has been your daily motivational message, sponsored by LifeHype.

dialogues.title: Hire a cleaner
lines: I suggest you hire a cleaner. Quickly. And don't read any more reviews till you do. They stink.
Don't have the capacity right now boss. Already using three arms when I only got two. I'd appreciate the help.
However you'd like to proceed! Either way, this place needs cleaning up. Maybe you could take a look or if we can afford it, maybe hire a cleaner?
Yeah we should keep an eye on these.
Engaging with your customers and other residents of the city will often result in opportunities to develop new menu ideas.
Either way, this place needs cleaning up. Maybe you could take a look or if we can afford it, maybe hire a cleaner?
Yeah, I mean who cares what people think. I should ignore them too.
If you're lacking a little spice in your life, you could always take a look at our review scores.
It was never a problem for Thaddeus, he never read them. Could explain a few things.
I can evaluate likely staff performance levels with a level grading - one to five. Five being the best, obviously. Try to recruit higher level staff, especially in more important positions.
Maybe you need to take more pride in your work.
In my experience, happy staff who are paid well and are not overworked offer better customer service. A varied menu also helps. Be on the look out for inspiration when it comes to menu options.
How do we get good food reviews?
The most recent review features this choice quote: "Visiting the noodle stall is like having the juice from the bottom of the trash can pneumatically pumped into your sinuses."

dialogues.title: Thaddeus old flat 1
lines: If they would hide someone from the authorities then they wouldn't be reliable.
You gotta listen better, Boss. I didn't say I don't know somebody. Ask me again tomorrow.
I need to help someone find a place to lie low. Who would be a reliable landlord?

dialogues.title: Agent Teleshko wants info
lines: Business must show no mercy. He IS helping other businesses.
I applaud the spirit if not the sentiment. You continue to meet my expectations.
That sounds a bit aggressive. I'm not sure if he is doing anything wrong.
Yes indeed, the amateur vandal. It would be easy enough to catch them in the act. They could be re-educated right now if we wanted to take them in.
First, let us discuss Dotson. The robotic detective is pulling at threads best left undisturbed. His agency is about to unravel. Several of his investigations must be put to an end.
Clever bunny. You're smarter than you look.
I'll see what I can do.
Please provide your reports on the suspects.
Well, I knew that! Though it is good to get confirmation. Good enough I suppose for a beginner informant.
I haven't made up my mind about Zaffer, so just continue to keep your eye on them. Now run along bunny.
Well, THAT'S disappointing. I expected more from you.
Your friend is far too chummy with his business rivals. Rivalry should not be friendly. It should be fierce. Competitive. It should seek the destruction of all enemies. So what did you find out?
I am playing the long game with that one. We hope they might lead us to bigger fish.
Very well. Dotson is not the most important target, but I hope you have a better response for the others.

That is not an information you need to know. But his agency threatens to stir a sleeping giant in the crime world of Nivalis. One even CorpSec does not confront. Also... he does not have a permit for the parking outside his office.
Well, that's not a great result, informant.
I could seek your destruction. And I'm not telling you anything about Danny.

dialogues.title: Complete Sal's Order
lines: I sent everything you asked for Chef.
No time to chat. I got an eighteen course tasting menu to serve, two POV Parties to cater and the Plumber's Union Annual Luncheon due in - *FIVE DUCK SOUFFLES!* - any minute.
Today? Crispy roach in a lemon dressing with - *DUCKS TO THE PASS* - candied bean sprouts. Here’s your money, kid. I gotta get back to the arms. Tell Clem I said 'Hi'.
Yeah and where’d you go for the seeds, Sang-Ha? Never mind, quality could be better but I'll make it work. Can't make cabbage surprise without the cabbage.
Where’d you go for the seeds, Sang-Ha? Took you so long I almost gave up. Lucky for you I can't make cabbage surprise without the cabbage.

dialogues.title: Rigs
lines: You need to talk to their employer - find out what caused them to reach the useful life limit on their contract.
Damn, you found one of the good ones. Where you get it? You kill a synth and pull it off their chest? Nah, that's not your style. Stole it, didn't ya?
They aren't exactly alive, though "dead" is too strong a word.
You don't. Unless you got an AI interface grafted into your skull, and I ain't talkin' bout your little Automata there either.
I didn't kill anyone for it.
What's to say? Whatever synth lost this was either running or was already caught. My bet's on the latter.
Do you know anything about it, or not?
There's more to them than that.
Actually wondering if you can help me.
Cause and effect. Action and reaction. Just waiting for you to spark the convo, Cosmo.

Do you know anything about this pin?
(show Anchor Pin)
Reached the end of his shelf life, you know? No more firmware for the fun loving captain.
Like that's my aim in life, Cosmo.
Thank me with deeds, not with words.
I thought that was obvious by now.
So what DO I do then?
Uh huh. You heard them say, "no good deed goes unpunished?" You wanna return that pin you gotta figure out where the next A.A.A. meeting is.
Sure. You keep telling yourself that and I'll say Finlay didn't use the water cooler to store gasoline.
No, I'm just here because I'm bored.
So, you're back. And you got something on your mind. More fun to be had? Got a fire you need lit? Maybe under someone's ass?
What are you going to say?
You wanna help your friend or whoever this synth is to you?
Yeah. Synths are just anatomically correct computers with a bit of adaptive AI and cosmetic surgery thrown in.
Not gonna say yes and not gonna say no.
Now why was that so hard?
True, but I want to return this to them.
Just as well. Oil burns and we got a slick-sea's worth right now. So if no fires, then whatchya doing out here?
It's getting only harder from here if you really want to do this.
Can you tell me anything about the Android Anchor Association?
So tell me how to find one.

dialogues.title: Ma Gomba is angry
lines: I... don't know what you mean.
Don't play the fool with me, you rotten little maggot. I know what you did. And since you are so fond of trash, perhaps that's what will happen to your business. Now, get out of my sight.
When I trust a person with my wares, I do not expect to be let down.

dialogues.title: Hire Roberta
lines: Fringle by name Fringle by nature, know what I mean?
I'm not sure where you heard that.
Sure, I could use the help.
Hey, little birdy told me you might be on a bit of a hiring spree...
Waitress, I'm a waitress. A damn good one. Let me know if you need any help.
Yeah yeah yeah, well, don't worry about that. Look, there's a lot of time wasters in the LUZ. Always changing their minds. Unpredictable. Not like me.

dialogues.title: Talk to Alexander
lines: Stacks Fever they called it. Tore through the place like wildfire. Killed thousands.
Well, this is my business. Should I direct you to the right department...?
We have never interacted in a non-business environment.
Yeah. So, we try to give back where we can. Got 50 Lims for that kid you're trying to save.
Sure. Alexandra sends her greetings. And... I hope the kid makes it.
When we were younger than him, my sis and I got sick.
So you do have a moral code.
Our parents didn't have insurance. Couldn't buy a Lim. But a free clinic doc waived the fee. Saved our lives.
Alright, alright. I didn't come here to waste time. I wanted to talk about the kid.
Eh, it ain't much, I know. But we owe it.
Yeah. See, I know what he's going through.

dialogues.title: Hanz Needs Help
lines: Good. I will transmit the rough location to your HUD. Now, please, move out of my way. I must find a plumber…
No need for the attitude. Get that necklace and there’ll be a reward in it for you. Understand?
I have eight personal requests to fulfill, an exploding bidet and a Nets-star who won’t stop redecorating my hotel rooms.
You know, smell the waves, get a shot of themselves with a Dock-dweller, kiss a carp, that kind of thing.
Sounds like it’s going to be my job soon...
Then I’ll be reporting you for a wanton disregard of financial opportunity. Good DAY!
New Thadd. You have a fishing stick, yes?
Don’t get funny with me. I do not have time for faffery. Will you do me a favor using that fishing stick of yours or not?
I was trying to offer you an opportunity. You should take some time to think about why you keep making the wrong choices.
Yes, well it turns out they were less than careful and lost an item of jewelry.
No time for “might”. One of my esteemed guests, can’t say who (don’t ask) went on a little pauper's cruise yesterday.
It's a priceless heirloom. Grandma stole it fair and square, yada yada. They want it back and my job is to make that happen.
Will you do me a favor using that fishing stick of yours or not?

dialogues.title: Milo goes out of business
lines: Considering everything that's fair play, isn't it?
Nola Berg didn't agree to be your partner?
This is where our fate diverges my friend.
I am considering faking my death. I assume you don't need to take such severe steps?
No. And then she destroyed me. Nola Berg bought up the debt contracts for my seismology equipment.
Seismology has never let me down, so I'll never let seismology down.
You're not alone. Seismology is only for the toughest!
I'm not cut out for business. That's what happened.
She then raised the interest payments. Obviously.
And to you, my former business partner. Take care!
In geological terms, this generational debt stretches down to the core of the planet.
Well that's my plan. If I can escape the Debt Corps, I can keep working on my seismology.
I don't mind CorpSec at the moment. It's Nola Berg that ripped me apart!
It's not seismology per se. It's all the financial bullshit that comes with it.
It really means a lot to you, huh?

dialogues.title: Ava recommends talking to Pilk
lines: It's best if I stay out of all this.
I think you should warn Pilk.

dialogues.title: Ask Huckstash about the Old Network
lines: Could it still be the same consciousness?
Are you sure it wasn't the same old Automata?
Thaddeus's Automata? She was always around.
Rings no bells. But Gunger keeps talking about some book fair.
Did Thaddeus talk about books much?
Have you ever heard Thaddeus mentioning anything about cryogenics?
Hmmm.... I once heard Fontus talk about it with Thaddeus. Maybe you ask him.
Nothing's ever clear with Thaddeus. I dunno if you can upgrade an Automata like that though. I'm no LifeCorp technician.
Ask Gunger. That's not my world.
They'll say an old network never existed. And arrest you for saying otherwise.
The printed ones. On real paper. Ava remembers them.
Nothing's ever clear with Thaddeus. But she would be very outdated by now.
This is way beyond a noodle stand owner.
A book fair? That would be illegal.
Did Thaddeus mention something named "The Old Network"? Ava told me about it.
Nah, don't think so. She was always newest generation I reckon. Thaddeus just named each new Automata "Ava."
How well do you know Ava?
CorpSec. They don't want you talkin' about it.
The Old Network? Listen, I wouldn't look into that. Not even with your Automata.

dialogues.title: Activation Code Sent
lines: It actually doesn't do anything. Next time consider where you're buying something from.
You received the activation code from Nola Berg. Would you like it?
Well, I could tell you what it says or you could read it for yourself.

dialogues.title: Ava is frustrated
lines: The guy definitely knew a thing or two about bots.
I wish he was still working there.
I don't like to criticize, but this was not your finest moment.
What do you make of all of that?
I'm sorry, but could Coilson really have been LifeCorp's CTO? Isn't that unlikely?
We shouldn't have picked him up.
If Coilson was a LifeCorp CTO, then LifeCorp knows about him and his human condition.
Do you think he could have interfered with my memory?
I'll try to access LifeCorp's data about his time as CTO.
Don't think so. Where's the motive?
We need definite proof. Where could I get it?
He was just an old engineer, and his widow is overrating his former capabilities.
Could be. Mad scientists love weird experiments.

dialogues.title: Why Did You Burn Me
lines: I asked, nay I commanded you with a set of simple instructions: spread the word of my deeds!
And ye made up those?! They be like bad reviews for the food you serve!
Aye, but why'd yah spread that slanderous filth?
What the blasted squall have ye been doing?!
Aye! And it takes so much work to correct the ill informed. Unnecessary work that now falls on me! Be gone with ye!
I can see that! Me eyes read the article those people penned. Now I must work harder than ever to clear my name of such dirty water.
Everyone saw the blasted article! That be the problem. Aarrgh. So much unnecessary work to do now. Be gone with ye!
You didn't give me any examples so I made them up.
Bored?! You tarnish a reputation, a glowing reputation because yer bored? Be gone with ye!

dialogues.title: Idly sitting on your hands
lines: Are you doing something CorpSec wouldn't approve of?
What exactly do you expect me to say? You're blabbing around while Sec's got eyes and ears in every light post and data jack!
Convince me to give you a loan.
I'm seriously just looking for something to trip on.
Sell me some Post-Apocalypse and I'm gone.
So... are you Idlehands or not?
Like someone who's lost someone. Someone name Tehani?
Hahaha, whooooo! We got a live one here! Everyone come running round and see the--I'm just fucking with you now shut your mouth, k?
Not something you should be asking, okay? I know you didn't know her. You know how? Because I would have known you. No one was closer to her than me. Now get lost!
Alright, I get it. Need Momma M or Sister S to dance with? Some of those clubs can be extra preeetttyyy with a new set of eyes.
You have no idea what you're talking about. And it would probably be a good idea to stop doing it. In case you were wondering. Now get the fuck out of here!
You're sure? That's really what you're looking for?
Because you're a stand-up, er, drug dealer?
I don't have a hundred Lims.
We ain't close enough to talk about who I'm missing and who I'm not. So unless you got business here, suggesting you turn back and be on your way.
I would like some drugs that make me hallucinate the end of the world.
I just want to check in on the person who lost Tehani.
Who knows? Could get hit by a HOVA on the way out of here. Get walking and let's see.
You're looking for some what? Say it again and say who gave you this location or I'm scramming with my hands in my pockets.
Hundred Lims and I'll toss yah a dropper. Not sure what strand it is. Maybe flood? Haven't seen one of those in a nanosecond.
Have a blast. If you survive the end, come back for more.
Infuriating. That's what you are. In-fure-re-ate-ing. What are you exactly looking for? And make it quick, yeah? Like, get it onnnnnn.
If I had to guess? You.
I, ugh, have to sit through a sermon at the Church of the Binary God?
I'm told they go by Idlehands.
Is this the same batch you gave Tehani?
Um, hey, are you... can I help you with something or are you just, like, you know, wandering 'round here looking weird and shit?
Short, scrawny, kinda gangly. End of his rope kinda guy.
Riiiiggghttt... And what would this, ugh, Idlehands, look like?
Is there a reason I wouldn't?
Ha. This view is shit. Why you really here?
Tehani? Doesn't ring a bell, like, sooooo don't know what to tell yah.
Hmph. And who do you, ugh, imagine is gonna get you these said drugs?
I'm looking for someone called Idlehands who can give something to get high with.
Ha! Yeah, yeah, alright. One time, that's it.
Consider it like a free sample? Just a taste to get me back for more.

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris First Meeting
lines: Does Kikuchi know? Is he in on it?

I guess it makes no difference if I tell you now. One night a few weeks ago, I was working late, revising my transistor theory, when the terminal I was working at started to glitch, and Hickabits of data started uploading themselves to the internal drive.
Why is your teacher trying to tie up loose ends?
You know nothing about me. Not that I'm even remotely important considering.
Sounds like you messed up a big opportunity.
Look I shouldn't be talking about this. If you do work for him, don't play with me. I just ask you don't make it painful? Maybe you could throw me over an edge? Might even be fun, in a way?
You misunderstand. This is not about Kikuchi's finances. Some very powerful people have been using these chips to formulate untraceable tax schemes!
The documents made no sense initially, but I eventually realized that they were a series of financial maps, trails of seemingly random transactions. Tax avoidance.
Please let me know if you find any!
Wow, it sounds like you are really deep into something.
Very few can. It’s why I was so excited to be at the academy. Did you know only five students are chosen every year? You can’t even apply, they FIND you.
I really hoped not, but when I brought it up I was expelled from the school without warning.
It's probably too dangerous to go into. I don't know how far Kikuchi's network reaches.
Kikuchi is avoiding Tax? The world needs to know!
I lay low I guess. Sadly, the ability to operate microno-tools to within atom-width accuracy isn't a massively applicable skill in this city.
That's very kind. And it might be true, but it's unimportant now considering...
You're one of HIS people I assume? Just make it quick.
Kaito Kikuchi? The Master silicon chip weaver? I was his student until recently.
I'll keep an eye out for any work.
Tax avoidance? Doesn't sound like a big deal in a school of five students.
I didn’t know people could ‘weave’ silicon chips.
It depends on how much Kikuchi is eager to tie up loose ends, I guess.

dialogues.title: Cirian Finding the Notary
lines: Spreading their dreams from the confines of sleep to their every day lives. Their imaginations giving them complacency. False hopes. Such a shame.
Then, by all accounts, Edison and I would be even and you'd be out 15,000 Lims. Pretty cut and dry.
There's so many things we can do in this world. Let me open the windows so you can have a look.
Did he now? On your fading code you swear?
Will I see the Notary through one of those windows?
As Edison is one to have people do. And, based on the fact that he's got you here seeking out the Notary, he's looking for some ID cards. The other set of debt orphans I assume?
Yes, well, with the amount of money he owes me I'm not surprised he sent you in his stead. It's like your his automata. I'm curious... How does that fact make you feel?
I wouldn't be here if he didn't.
Hmmm. For a second it seemed like the day was about to get interesting.
I suppose you'd know if you had. Though I'm not sure what's worse: having no dreams at all or having so many you become an addict.
What if I wanted to live like the Notary?
What if, rather than false promises, they are glimpses of what you deserve?
If I see you around here again, I'll paralyze your augments and push you into the nearest vent. If Edison Mattix is truly your friend, you'd be wise to tell him the same.
15,000 Lims? What if I paid them?
Dreams are nothing but false promises.

I would never say such a thing about the greatest gift we've been given. The ability to look into the lives we think we want. The ones we think we deserve. I can show you the existence you dream about.
This is the third class he's taken on a field trip. It's 5,000 Lims per class.
How much does he owe you?
I help him with a few things here and there.
I don't have time for this. I'm looking for the Notary.
Interesting. Now that you know where to find me you should make sure to come back.
We have a mutual friend in common. Edison Mattix.
A welcome reprieve indeed. A glimpse into the kind of life or world the dreamer wants to live in. More and more people are getting smarter to the fact that they can have a sliver of that existence.

Let me introduce CameoPOV Media. CPM if you like. You tell me who you admire, whose life you want to live, and I build you an authentic dream-state. One you can rent and live in whenever you close your eyes.
Did I what? Dream last night?
Well now, no one can live like the Notary. But she can build you something more tangible. May I ask how you heard of her?
Look, do you have the ID cards or not?
Ah, yes, Edison. How do you know him?
Are you saying dreams are bad?
How do you know his name?

I suppose that is why you're here. Well, here they are. Tell Edison, if he wants more, he'll need to pay me what I'm owed. Our business ties are severed until then. Let him try and find his niece without my help.
Edison sent me. Said you ran out on a job.
Dreaming's the best thing about the day.

dialogues.title: Ask Fred about pain
lines: No. I need information about pain.
My Automata. She remembers pain like this.
It is. Early patients suffered immeasurably.
All encompassing. Every cell of the body.
It's not much to go on, but it sounds like a Leech Worm. A parasite. I have heard the symptoms described as such.
It's treatable, but unmedicated it's lethal.
Who is suffering this type of pain?
Has there always been a cure?
You'll have to be more specific.
How would an Automata remember pain? Well, anyway...
Treatments take time to develop, patent, sell... But I'm no medical historian.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus strange message 3
lines: Analysis of his vocal patterns indicates significantly less emotional range. He seems... calmer.

So this trip... you might wonder why I'm doing it. I mean, we already know that if we go back far enough, we can see what it was like BEFORE me. And AFTER me... well, I now know that my influence fades. But never disappears.
Could he be a bit less vague?
I agree. It's clear he knows more.
That's the end of the message. Did you pick up on what he said at the end?
I can't determine the origin of the message, nor its age.
All of this temporal sling-shotting sure does make your head spin. And your stomach heave. I could go for a bowl of noodles to settle my gut right now. Ask Banor to prepare some for me.
Not really. That was who he was. Or is.
I have a message from Thaddeus, but... it says this is his last.
Banor. Maybe we should talk to him again?

I'm rattled kid. Buffeted back and forward through time, bouncing off the big bang and smacking against the long darkness, only to come all the way back. Had to send this message via a singularity just past Hades Five.

dialogues.title: Humour Bot 17 Improv Technique
lines:
Even though this slack-jawed fool was very hard to please

I tried to make a funny song, to make them slap their knees

The song includes lemons, ginger, a little shot of gin

All the options that they chose when I asked them to join in
Why are you finding this so hard?
I believe this experiment with improv has been a failure. This form of comedy should stay dead. I will leave now. No refunds.
Yes... Your... CUSTOMIZED improv song is now ready. Would you like to hear it?
Comedic interpretation of a word or situation.
I don't know what to do!
Maybe I need to warm up the audience first. *Ahem* IS ANYONE IN TONIGHT FROM MIDTOWN?!
Alright. One more. Please select a food.

The improv is now over, the crowd is not yet happy

But I confess, I'm also grumpy, cross and a bit snappy

This routine did not work, this crowd is out of luck

If they don't like my comedy then they can get to-
Do not doubt me human. I shall have you in stitches.
You are a very bad improv audience member.
Please select the second improv element. Think more carefully, and hurry. I need a meal. Provide an option with utmost priority. Proceed!
So do I just wait or...?
I am pleased to announce I have discovered a new form of comedy. From antiquity!

Standing in Nivalis, this meatsack said to me

You do the jokes, so come and make me smile and laugh for free?

I'm a poor old robot, I had to have a think

Then I had an idea - I'll make a song about what I like to drink!
I will prove the validity of this comedic art-form which was once the height of cultural expression.
It's fine! I'll make it work. I'm a professional.
You can do this Humour Bot 17!
Comedians worked on their material for literally minutes!
...ERROR CODE 17 - CATASTROPHIC SYSTEM CRASH. USER INPUT NOT SAVED. ABORT/RETRY/FAIL?
I'm thinking! What kind of prompt do you want?
Warm up routine: complete. Stage two begin. Please provide me with a prompt. Perhaps a favorite dish?

dialogues.title: Teleshko Has Another Lead
lines: Because they did not increase capital through commerce.
Hmm. There is a bar in Lowtown that has been on the decline for some time. I believe the owner could be persuaded to give up a Tier 2 license.
Business is life. And now that you possess a Tier 1 License to Increase Capital through Commerce, it is time to start planning your next move.
I'm only doing this LICCY business because I have no choice.
Do not call it "LICCY Business". It is a License to Increase Capital through Commerce. And now that you possess a Grade 1, it is time to think about your next move.
But I'm happy where I am.
You have the details. The next time I see you, I hope you will have moved up in the world.
Your feelings do not apply to this matter. Do I need to remind you of the obligatory nature of the LICC?
I am pleased to see that my judgement of your enterprising character was correct.

dialogues.title: Banor has Concerns about TT
lines: What do you think we should do?
Boss, I don't wanna speak outta turn...
I don't like it, boss. Thaddeus's noodles mighta been trash, but they were honest trash.
Yeah... thing is, I think Sal's been putting something extra in the food.
Sounds like people love what we're doing.
No way. Business is good. Forget about it.
I think we should flush it, boss. Before someone finds out.
You're right. Get rid of it.
It's just... customers been acting a little odd lately. Caught one trying to eat a ramen bowl. Another one's been sneaking in at night to lick the tables.
Customers been acting a little odd lately. Caught one trying to eat a ramen bowl. Another one's been sneaking in at night to lick the tables.
I've seen him, boss. Found his stash too.

dialogues.title: Harmony Player Lost
lines: Well, you can't win them all. You put up a good fight. In a way.

dialogues.title: Where is the Gridless Sea
lines: Salt Pete has been trying to contact you again through... unorthodox means.
I think I got it. Let's go.
Sometimes when I tell you I am the most intelligent, sophisticated assistant that has ever existed, I think you don't believe me.
Well, there's many ways to measure such claims, but most metrics would align with my conclusions.
That you don't believe me? Only you would know.
I guess he is telling us where to go with the boat.
Yes. He says: "Spare the rod and spoil the secret. The oil is rigged in your favor. Cast your gaze down, the pelagic depths hold the first prize."
Oh, and he left an old fishing rod for you.
So what did Salt Pete say?
How did you pick up morse code?
He has sent you the first "clue"?
I believe he wants you to go fishing near the oil rig.
You are pretty smart I guess.
I believe they call it "Morse Code". I took the liberty of translating for you.
He is. Have you deciphered his clue?
Indeed. And not a very good one. How thrilling!

dialogues.title: Vibes
lines: Real music comes from real life. Shared experiences and common emotions. Only way to harness that vibe is to live in it.

Gotta hear the music. Feel the vibe the airwaves are putting out. Last I heard it, the time I realized yeah, this is where I need to be, was in the Port. Those ships coming in from Luna. The raw power of everything around me, people on the move. Maybe it'll have the same effect on you too.
If the airwaves were kinder, and the scene a little brighter, we'd be flying higher, flying higher.
Mr. Anthony Geraci himself. The number one synth accordo to grace the airwaves.

Well, the secret is what he teaches through his music. See, the thing is, once you find the vibe that works for you, the rhythm your life flows to, everything else just exists. Once that happens it's, well it's golden.
Listen, everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.
Life is what you put into it. Luckily, the currency of that ideology is perspective.
Fair. What's fair is fair and what's not is, well, just something to figure out.
That's just too damn bad... Wait... It's too damn bad, that this world is so sad, so rushed... just to gush... over nothing but mad, mad ol' mush...
How do I put bad into it?
There are no drugs. Everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.
Me? I'm on nothing but the high of life. People might say otherwise but that's it. Just riding the vibes 'til I die.
Lil' ole me? Though I'm not so little I 'spose. Haha, just an extra layer of warmth come the rainy times. But me? I'm the one, the only, Flippin' Finn Amano!
Everyone's always got somewhere to be, somewhere they're always rushing off to. Gotta chill my people. Chill and enjoy the music.
Should I know who you are?
Hey, hey, why you moving so fast?
Because I have somewhere to be.
I want whatever drugs you're on.
How do I put good into it?

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Raluca
lines: Hey there. Raluca is at the noodle stand and would like to speak to you.

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Seventh Meeting
lines: You had a chance to help before.
It's too much for me at the moment.
Three hundred Lims for a new life?
Three Hundred Lims for a new life.
Especially for an unemployed silicon weaver.
Maybe you can ask around for help.
Danny told me you don't want to pay.
I knew it. I knew he was gone. I felt it. I just... I didn't know he helped me out in the end.
Yes. He... he sacrificed himself for you.
You're right. I should save my Lims.
I need to find Three Hundred Lims for my records to be scrubbed clean and a fresh start.
I appreciate it. I've been through a lot. I guess we all have. But this will really help. I probably won't be able to pay you back for a while, so... thank you.
I want to help. Here you go. (-300 Lims)
Sure. Makes sense. Why would you?
Well... it's been an experience. See you around. Maybe.
Out of reach for an unemployed silicon weaver though.
Not that much for a new life.

dialogues.title: I Lost the File on that One
lines: Do you recall anything about the Happy Hour Friends?
They drove a tram through a wall and into the ocean. Do you understand the kind of paperwork an incident like that comes with? I missed my daughter's graduation because of those assholes.
I'm looking for information on time travel.
Why are you acting like that?
So they didn't actually discover time travel?
No. And why would they? This timeline has exponentially worked in their favor.
Okay, okay! I'm looking for information about the Happy Hour Friends.
Of course they didn't discover time travel. They were a group of misfits on their twelfth beers attempting to do complex math. What do you think?
Believe me, the pleasure is far from mine.
Need I remind you that my job involves arresting individuals?
Confidential. And you've lost a minute based on the stupidity of that question.
Has 'Sec or any of the corps been working on time travel?
In fact it was. Now, if we're done here, you've more than used up your allotted five minutes.
The HHF were a nihilistic group HOVA-bent on opening time rifts across the city. They pitched their idea, got funding from a Corpster, and then you know what they did?
You're mad because they made you do your job?
How do you know of the Happy Hour Friends?

dialogues.title: Cale Comes to the Noodle Stand
lines: I know. I'm the one who said it. Only because I've been told it over and over again. If you have any ideas on how to use it for my benefit, I'm all ears.
Surviving is, well, the only thing we can do. Some say it's insufficient but when it's the only thing you can manage what are you supposed to do?
I can be here when I can, but I got a business to run.
You're so funny! I really liked the hybrid strawberry and synthetic chamomile I tried the other day. Hey, that reminds me, I saw the health inspector skulking around the other day. Better watch out.
You make it easy. I mean your food does. Shit. Ah, don't mind me. I'll swing by the stand soon.
Thanks. I'll swing by for lunch or something real soon. Get that menu in shape for me.
Yeah. No worries. I get it.
Oh—shit—really? I'm sorry. I didn't mean to... Well, I hope I'll see you round lunch time!
That's kind of the point, right?
I am what I am. I'll be good when I get some grub in me. Looking forward to what Banor and the crew cook up today.
Really? When have they ever done anything to help us?
You and me both, my friend. You and me both.
I know. My poor mother. And not only that, but due to a technicality they refused to pay us for participating in the clinical trial.
That's a load of moldy mushrooms.
Always love to hear that. You're too kind.
You do have one of those faces.
Yeah! I know, I have one of those faces and you probably see hundreds of them every day with how good the food Banor and them sling is.

They enrolled her in that clinical trial. Promised—fucking promised—there would be no charge if the trial failed. And guess what? It failed. My mother never left that hospital, but the invoices sure as hell did.
Sorry, that was over the top. I gotta rein it in sometimes. I know. Stupid.
Could smuggle drugs or something. Blend into the crowd.
Ha! That would be the day. I don't need to help the drug lords pad the Corp's bottom line. No thank you.
Eh, I'm sure I'll figure something out. Until then, least there's good food being served. Catch you later for lunch or something. Try not to forget my name again... Sorry, that was dumb. Ignore me.
If only we could get the corps to actually help us.
I believe you. You wouldn't lie to me, one of your favorite customers. You just have a lot going on and probably could use a break, you know?
If it isn't my favorite noodle master. How are you my friend?
For sure. I mean, they couldn't be coming for Thaddeus's place. There's no way something would be going on there. You all do the best work. Better than the corps!
No, but I bet you're going to.
Oh, well, this is awkward. I'm Cale. I've been coming to the stand for a while now.
Who are we gonna get to help? MedSynge? That Corp is a plague on this city. I told you what they did to me right? What they did to my family?
No, I remember you. I swear. Long day.
For sure. Now, here I am: sans family, aside from Meo, my little kittie friend, and well, you I guess. I mean I'd consider us friends, right?

dialogues.title: Hail Mary
lines: Is it outside your competence as a bot in general?
I have been helpful. You are satisfied with this interaction! This is an unusual sensation. Is it... pride?
Do you know of any bots with a human consciousness transfer?
LifeCorp wants an accurate background report on all my earnings.
I'm not sure I'm allowed to talk about it as an active, practicing Thera-Pay psychotherapist.
In Nivalis? It is barely even interesting, never mind unusual.
Well ... then we're looking for a human cleaning robot in Meridian Market. Thank you... I think.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
That's outside my remit as a Thera-Pay bot.
Oh, right. Then it's okay, I guess.
No, I do not know anyone personally. But there are rumors of a cleaner bot. A vacuum cleaner, to be precise. And he was once human.

dialogues.title: Ava Rundown
lines: So she never met the person she wanted to run away with?
Fled from torture - killed by a Vinculum Ascender.
It sounds as though she was on her way to meet them when the accident occurred. Whoever it was, they must have been heartbroken.

dialogues.title: Was that a Ghost
lines: Is there anything else about her?
You already know her. The post was written by Ms Al-Zahiri, the historian.
The post was written by a historian named Ms Al-Zahiri.
Yes, it's called "Green Reeker". Its smell is so strong, it causes auditory and visual hallucinations.
Did the apparition seem malevolent at all?
No. But the post writer wants to hear from anyone else who may have seen the ghost.
A post that references an encounter with an emanation on this very spot. A specter called "the Lost Lady".
I haven't eaten any cheese. You really didn't hear anything?
I'm afraid you must be hallucinating. Did you eat any of that illegal cheese people are talking about?
No, I was JUST talking to her. You didn't hear it?
If you mean Green Reeker, then no, I haven't eaten any.
I just ran a search and I am coming across some Nets chatter about incorporeal emanations in this area...
I'm not sure what you're referring to.
You could put it that way. I have found a post on an account called "The Nivalis Nocturne".
I don’t know. It sounded garbled. Like code.
I heard your attempts to interrogate thin air...
Then I suggest you avoid this place in future. I am picking up some unusual trace electro magnetic fluctuations…
The person who was just here... she vanished.
It references seeing one such emanation on this very spot. A specter called "The Lost Lady".
Where can I find this person?
We need an exorcist, not a historian.
Entirely possible. What did this apparition say?
We had better go and talk to her.
No, I just don't like ghosts.

dialogues.title: Idlehands hands get busy
lines: Didn't work. He was down there too long. Bad noises man. A real bad scene.
Yeah, that's how I found you.
No one gets me, and that is fine. If people did, they'd know I ain't the worst here. Not by a long shot.
I know you, right? Never forget a face.
Doesn't sound like my kind of scene.
I'm not a customer. Vik sent me.
I didn't expect you to actually help.
Your help in saving a little boy.
Listen, I know what I am, but no one else does. Not really.
Didn't have nobody worrying about me when I was eight... but maybe that was the problem, ya know?
Once knew a kid who drowned. He was my friend. Bud Mallignagi. I remember them trying to pump the water out his lungs at the dock.
Eight years old. Good family, and he's running out of time.
He's suffering. An oxyphile without a mask.
I did source one. Once. Extremely expensive, very little demand down here.
Oh what?! Some kid is sick and someone put you on ME?!
Yeah, hard to find any one person who can afford the full 40k. You're gonna have to pool your resources. What's it called - crowdfund. Now get outta here, and come back with the cash.
I ain't asking for you to change your opinion bout me or say thank you. But dead kids... bad scene.
Right... But 40,000 is still way too much.
Maybe... Takes a few days, but it's possible. But as I said: expensive. Way beyond you.
I'm not completely heartless, ya know...? I can do it for 40,000. That's me selling at cost, and taking on a lot of risk without an extra charge.
Hehe. Good joke. I appreciate the humor. Now really, what do you want?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 30
lines: Why do they say "rise and shine"? People don't shine. Unless they are all sweaty. Yuk.

dialogues.title: Nixxi at Seaside Boardwalk
lines: People have to do all sorts to survive this city.
You'll pay, just like everyone else.
Hey. So the votes are in...
Thanks. Hey, I bet you're glad you didn't let me spit in your mouth now.

It's not that complicated. Most streaming is just an elaborate series of pranks and audience in-jokes. Basically, my career, my fans, my platform - everything about my success, was an elaborate prank by another, bigger streamer.
Yes, that's right. Did you know too?
Catchy huh. Literally no idea what I'm going to do now. Suggestions?
Well you're less fun now than when we had an audience! See you around Noodle Nut.
Well they voted to send me to the Ventz... and I refused to go. When the relocation company came for me, they revealed it was all a scam. They filmed my reaction.
I'm retired. No more streaming for me.
Apparently, they gained their highest audience ever while their fans watched me "react to exile." That's the name of their channel by the way.
The relocation company was a scam?
I see you're not living in the Spire.
What did your audience choose for your fate?
I see you're not living in the Ventz.
Nice. I'll be back then - without an audience next time. See you around Noodle Nut.
You're kinda funny. When I figure out what the fuck I'm doing with my life, I'll come back here and try some of your food. For free?
A holiday sounds great. I mean I have no money, so the best I could manage as regards a destination is... the Ventz.

dialogues.title: Interview Ma Gomba
lines: Danetti… too sweet for my tastes. But a vigorous energy to him I admire. He’ll go far. If he heeds my advice.
I gave him a few… hints. A sprinkle of lion’s mane here, a dash of psilocybin there, the customers will come running.
So believe me when I say, a donut is never just a donut. I would suggest you find who did this, and quickly. If not, the results could be messy.
Well, if it isn’t my least favorite stinkhorn. Still stunting everyone’s growth with your acidic principles?
And I have a few thoughts on why you are still shedding bacteria in my general vicinity.
That is a concern. He and I have been working on something new together. I’d hate to see it fall into the wrong hands.
My favorite puffball. Always a pleasure.

Do you know how Curzona’s Third Branch fell? Someone adulterated the biscuit supply with a powerful cocktail of flavor enhancers, appetite inhibitors and mood boosters. The entire board ate themselves to death.

dialogues.title: Lucy is thawing
lines: I don't think she came in.
Look, no one likes a time waster. This is exactly the kind of thing that made us enemies. We're enemies now.
I don't have time for this.
Friends make time for each other.
I can't talk to you when you're like this. I'll see you later.
Hey, did you sort my friends out with free food? Sophie Saltlick told me she had to pay for her own Ramen.
There's no need to be so dramatic.

dialogues.title: Meeting Dr Fred
lines: And I just have fifteen patients who can’t speak let alone make conversation, so…
I scratch your back, you scratch mine.
Unless you’re about to stop breathing or processing, please could you come back tomorrow?
Thanks to LifeCorp, this is as close to a "proper" clinic as it's possible to get in Nivalis.
Won’t lie, it’s a nightmare. Ransomware viruses, data rot, black-market augs gone septic, dermis-eating parasites…
Yeah, well... fatal infections don't exactly obey the law. Speaking of which, I really have to go. If you get that Bio-X you know where to find me.
Mmmhmm. If you'll excuse me, I have real work to do.
I'd heard from a few people that you're on the wrong side of the corps. Which is the right side for me. There is something you could do...
Why don't you work in a proper clinic?
Just trying to make this city a better place.
Most EMaTs carry it. Some vendors if a MedSynge shipment gets jacked. I haven’t had time to go searching.
Is there anything I can do?
I'd rather not. You don't know where they've been.
I’m sorry, it’s just... I forgot, how people interact outside of all of this. I can take thirty seconds. Need to breathe anyway.
Thanks. And be careful. LifeCorp don't exactly play.
Thanks for the offer, but I've heard about the kind of people you do business with. Can't take the risk. Sorry.
Is there anything I can do?
I'm a doctor. Period. I trained because I wanted to help people, not to up-sell them LifeCorp premiums.
If people don't have a LifeCorp subscription that's their problem.
I'll see what I can do.
Have you heard of BioX-50? It’s a proprietary antibiotic produced by MedSynge, but they don’t allow non-subscribers access. I'm desperate for some.
I don’t know, are you a bio-synth phlebotomist specializing in intravenous shielding repair?

dialogues.title: Ava Needs Network Interface
lines: This is a proprietary LifeCorp interface that's lost to time. The chip has old encryption, but it's still encryption.
Where do we find an interface?
It's just some old data chip. Surely you can read it?
So how do we access the records on the chip?
We finally have the information and we can't read it?!
A cursory scan of the chip suggests the data is mostly intact. And old. It has not been purged.
That might be more difficult than I hoped. I know the data is there, but reading it is tricky. The chip is only compatible with a special Old Network interface.
I thought Galosh gave you Old Network access?
Data purges happen after corporate scandals. The Coma Roamers were wiped from all data repositories that LifeCorp could find.
So far we have done well asking for help when we need it. We should reach out to someone who knows not just technology... but the streets.
Truthfully? I'm not sure if there are any left. Especially not in the LUZ. Maybe out in some half-deserted settlement on the outskirts. But here in the heart of the city...

dialogues.title: Salt Pete says it's time for Caleb
lines: Please, just tell Caleb... the Captain is almost rebuilt, and... Tell him it's time we put the past behind us. Then he'll tell you where to find the last piece.
Ahoy! You found the second piece of the Cap'n. Now there's just one thing left to do.
What really happened between you and your friends?
No. We need to... speak to Caleb. The old dog.
This is all none of my business anyway.

dialogues.title: Questions
lines: Whoa! Sorry, what happened to Zee?
I'm sorry, but I have too much going on right now. I'm sure she'll turn up.
Well, that is most unfortunate, but I suppose it's understandable. Missing people are nothing new. If you happen to see her in your travels, please let me know.
I'm wondering if you might recognize this person? Her name is Zee Burke. Does she look familiar at all?
Same reason you or anyone else would ask a question, to learn information. My name is Kasey Remo. I'm a professor at Central Canyon University and I'm hoping you could assist me with something.
Yeah, I know her. She's... What happened?
I'm afraid I don't know. She seems to have... disappeared.
Though she spent her time at the docks, Zee lived in Eastern Residential. She had a friend there, a photographer named Sanya Predex. Maybe you could speak with her?

Ah, now see, that makes sense. Her first paper was about the Docks. It was elegant. Well beyond her years. It's what first caused me to take notice of her work. There was something there. A gift to academia.
What do you mean she disappeared?
Oh, Zee! Actually, I do remember her. She was at the Docks.
Of course, of course. But, see, the thing is though, the last time she came to my lecture, she had one of your take away containers.
What are you going to do?
I'm afraid she hasn't been to a lecture for some time. In fact, no one's seen her for over a week.
I'm not really sure what you want me to do.
Your generosity with your time is beyond appreciated.
Missing courses doesn't sound so strange for students.
She was. And I hope she will be again.
Yeah, yeah, old man. What happened to Zee?
If you're actually insinuating that I had an inappropriate relationship with one of my students, you can choke on the very food you cook.
I have to attend a conference on the implications of fully augmenting the human brain, I'm supposed to be the keynote speaker but I don't know if I have it in me.
What the fuck is Ethical Hacking?
Seeing you, I now realize that we have already met.
Unfortunately. Given the circumstances, it isn't really that nice of an occasion I'm afraid.
I'm afraid she hasn't been to a lecture for some time. In fact, no one's seen her here for over a week. With the news of this serial killer, I'm more than a little concerned.
I'll see what I can find out about Zee.
I don't. I see a lot of people everyday.
I would love nothing more than to go into the fascinating world of ethical hacking, however I'm afraid I'm on a mission. Help me find Zee and I'll teach you things that history forgot.
She does. I saw her at the Docks.
What kind of professor are you?
I teach in the history department of the Central Canyon Technical Institute. Ethical hacking and Grid Pathways through the ages.
Correct. Especially for Zee. But something was off with her the weeks before she vanished this time. She was ... distracted.
Um, excuse me. You're the owner of this stand, correct?
I am. What can I get for you?
Ah, that's great, thank you. I am a professor over at Central Canyon. Professor Kasey Remo.

dialogues.title: Getting on the boat
lines: Take the wheel and be bold. This boat sails itself! Almost.
How do I... pilot... drive... SAIL this boat?
Skip. Skipper. Admiral. Commander. Captain... Cap'ain. There's so many options.
Sail. Though the wind that splits the waves for us is generated by directional electromagnetic waves broadcast from The Grid. But such details can wait. Let's cast off!

dialogues.title: Rollo has a job for you
lines: Yeah. "Decorating". I know someone that needs that doing... Quietly.
Your old boss... sounds like they're in trouble.
I've had enough of cleaning up crime scenes to be honest.
My old boss needs someone to fix a place up pronto. Make it look normal.
Yeah, you know. A totally "normal" apartment. Definitely not the kind of place to run an extended narcotics operation from.
Extra-legal. Easy money though, for the right pair of hands...
Heard on the wire you're good with... furniture.
I knew it. You got that look. Like a hungry badger.
Hey boss. You looking for... something extra?
Yeah. Quickly. Without being seen by security.
No thanks. I've got bigger fish to fry.
Who said anything about a crime scene? It's "redecorating". Quickly. Without being seen by security.
Nah. These investigations never find anything.
That snitchy little shit surveillance drone knows my face.
Not surprised. I'm kind of a big deal.
Keep your voice down. You want that ferret Teleshko to hear?
Yeah, well, thanks for wasting my time.
Boss'll make it worth your while, "boss."
Right. So what do you want?
So I just need to... re-decorate an apartment?

dialogues.title: I Think I Found Something
lines: I'll go with the Flask Fizz.
Figure you only got time to make one and make it right. Which way you leaning?
I think these two will give you an edge. One is called Green Essence, the other is named Flask Fizz.
Where can I find the ingredients?
Let's go with the Green Essence.
Gnarly. Give me the top two you found.
Hey, boss. So about those cocktail recipes.
Thanks, Boss. Got 'em from an old copy of the Anarchist's Encyclopedia of Mixology.
The ingredients aren't anything unusual, the combination makes these cocktails special.
That's insane. I want to beat Nola not kill her.
Let's put the drink on the menu and see what it stirs up.
Cuz it was banned way, way back. Couple kids made a cocktail and added too much turpentine. You know, gotta pour just the right amount.
Well, It's just, I did some research on what could, you know, really stick it to the old 'Berg.

dialogues.title: Ava researches Leech Worm
lines: For almost 100 years after it was first diagnosed, there was no treatment.
The symptoms match my memories of extreme, non-localized pain. After months of physical decay, there was a 98% mortality rate.
And now it's easily treated... Yes, I guess it's possible.
What did we need that for again?
To think I could have been a victim ...
It may have been the cause of my memories of pain. The parasite first appeared 230 years ago. It mainly infected people weakened by radiation.
The few survivors lapsed into catatonia and required lifelong care.
For almost 100 years after it was first diagnosed, there was no treatment. This could be a solid lead... Maybe I suffered from this?
I found some information about the Leech Worm parasite.

dialogues.title: Skyhigh Gardens
lines: Gardens in the sky. Wow. I've never seen them. I really wish I could be you right now.

dialogues.title: Floyd Meeting 4
lines: Yes, but not physically. My identity vanished.
It might offer you some closure.
Such meat-logic. I'm hardly hard to find.
With me? Never, for I am merely a machine, built to serve and save the meat. Why would they waste their time.
Well, I hope you find some peace.
It might offer you some purpose.
I'd love to see the world through your silly little meat-eyes. Through my finely tuned third generation Curzona SEE-14B optics, all I see is rot.
Have you stayed in touch with the person you saved?
You're right, rotting in the septic tank would probably have been easier.
You saved someones life, It's the day you became a hero!
Absolutely not. What would be the point?
You said it's the day you vanished again.
Maybe they weren't worth saving then.
Always a challenging day, anniversary of the crash, the day I came out of hiding.
It's the day I became a citizen. A citizen of this place.
I think that's a small price to pay for saving a life.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Banor
lines: Banor is waiting to have a word. I think he has the staff collection for Lochlainn.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 11
lines: I'm still trying to piece it together. Maybe we should look around?
What happened here Ava? That's Rheno right?

dialogues.title: A Message in Notes
lines: Ahh! You're the best. I knew you'd find them. Keep your ear to the waves my friend. I'll see you at the next show.
Actually, I'd like to hang onto it for a bit. See his work and all.
Bossin'. This is rad. Like the best song I've ever heard.
Of course. Thanks for helping me find the vibes.
Yeah, but it's what's in the song that matters. It's the intro bit, and the music notes here end right when the lyrics start.
Oh yeah! Okay, let me look. Alright, if we find the painting... here we go... yup! Here are the notes. Okay, let me look at the jukebox again.
How can you hear that when you're only looking?
What do you think it is?
Makes sense. I'm glad you found the vibes my friend. Make sure to keep your ear to the waves.
Well, let's see. If we take these... then add them here... and play this... OH! I know this. It's the start to his song Woman in Red and Rain.
Any ideas what they mean? The notes.
You did! That's wicked. Can I take a look?
If the Original AG was anything, he was appreciative of what he had. Something we all could do a bit more of. Hey, do you... um, do you mind if I hang onto this? Maybe look through it some more?
It's clues to his own song?
What kind of question is that? If you can read the notes, you can hear them. Can you hear the word "tree" when you read the letters?
I saw here there, from my lanai. Looking at me like life was a lie. But in her beauty and her eyes I saw, that this is all perfect afterall.
Speaking of music. Any idea what the notes mean?
Well, well, well, you're back... to bother someone. Just kidding! Though that feels like a catchy tune. Musta heard it somewhere.

dialogues.title: Leech worms and cryogenics Old Network
lines: I ran a search about the Leech Worm in the Old Network.
Is this going to be gross?
The evidence is starting to stack up.
One legacy LifeCorp record attributed over 90% of cryogenic treatments to this parasite.
Leech Worm infection was a very common factor in cryogenics.
A chain of clues, but still no proof.

dialogues.title: Locate the Terminal
lines: LifeCorp employees could access the Old Network. They would have security access - a key. If there is any old LifeCorp data left in the Old Network, we need that key.
Run some background searches. We can't be defeated by a locked door.
No. We haven't come across one of them yet.
Network Technicians would be our best bet. They would have access.
Having the entry code would probably help.
This must be the door Rosco was talking about.

dialogues.title: Rollo in the Spire
lines: Help my memories: Since when do I owe you money?
I'm a serious businessman. I'm strongarming people, not lying to them.
Hey, I have expenses to cover. For example, I had to make sure you weren't followed. Surveillance is pricey.
You're not, by the way. See? It's totally worth it!
A certain hacker involved me in a wild goose chase. Sending you running all over the city.
I love it, when debtors finally appear to pay their debt.
I'm sorry to hear that. But you only have this one chance. I'll be gone tomorrow. Lose the 1000 Lims you've already paid - or pay another 100. The choice is yours!
And what guarantee do I have that you're telling me the truth?
100 Lims. Special discount price, for my close friends.
You can meet Nabla in the Stacks. Tomorrow.
Technically it's not really a debt, but a... fee. You owe me my fee.

dialogues.title: Lending an Ear
lines: Oh, I can wait if you want a few minutes.
Ugh. Just tell me what you're doing here so we can move on.
That's why my ears were ringing.
And you trust he didn't give Tehani a bad batch?
But he loved my sister and he's the closest thing I have to her now that she's gone.
Something tells me you'd like that a little too much. Besides, having some company in front of this place isn't the worst thing I've ever experienced.
Yeah, I guess all I have left to do is go inside. Thanks for everything. Hopefully I'll see you around.
Idlehands was at your spot. Wanted to make sure you were okay.
What'd you find out about the batch?
I haven't actually gone inside yet.
Listen, he might be a little, ugh, squirrely and whatnot, but he's not a bad dude. You know, aside from dealing illegal substances and all that.
Hahaha, man, you really can't quit with this concerned friend thing can you?
You took it without knowing if the batch was bad?!
So that's why you haven't talked to Magz in awhile.
It's a major character flaw I know. I get taken advantage of quite a bit.
Hmph. Sounds like Tehani. That kid was friendly to everyone. I tried to see her through a hit of Post-Ap but just nuclear bombs and burning buildings.
