Fuckin' honesty, yeah? Tehani was my kid sister. She was my best friend. My confidant. It shoulda been me who took that batch, not her.
Took a Post-Ap trip a little while ago... never thought an alien invasion would make me shit myself.
About Tehani? No, I haven't. About you? Consistently.
Ha. You really like this good person act, huh? Regardless, what I meant was, I've yet to go inside at all.
Pffft. How stupid do you think I am? Idlehands let me borrow a chem-set to test it. Probably was hanging around because it wanted it back. I actually think I'm gonna keep it.

dialogues.title: Holocropolis
lines: We have many empty resting places. You wish to upload a dead human relative?
Tell him so he can apologize.
Please return when you have the funds. Thank for you visiting Lowtown Holocropolis.
Normally there would be a charge of 100 Lims. But I will waive that! For you! Please proceed.
It is you. You are welcome to the Lowtown Holocropolis.
I need a favor. A plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.
I need a plaque to lay someone's memory to rest.
I am allowed to say that I am well! My logic relay is efficiently logical!
There is a charge of 100 Lims. Do you wish to proceed?
No. It was his order that caused her death.
There. I have encoded her name onto the plaque and uploaded her memory. Now, she can rest.
It is you! You are welcome to the Lowtown Holocropolis! I am so pleased to see you! Here is a tissue! I need a tissue!
Should we tell Samuel, so he can turn this place into a place of worship?
I don't have that right now.

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus First Meeting
lines: Age is just a number. Some measure it in years, some in generations. Personally I measure it in mitochondrial mutations. Hey you knew Thaddeus right?
Ahhhh that's right! Thaddeus is still alive, in his own way. But aren't we all?
That's something I'm not sure either you, nor the rest of the world is ready to hear yet. And I'm certainly not sure if I'm ready to tell.
Perhaps there is hope for you yet... we'll see.
Generations? You must be older than you look.
It's nice to see a young person like yourself keeping the art of 'walking up to strangers' alive.
That might be the question! The only one worth asking.
Can you just get to the point?
You must be older than you look.
It shouldn't be but I've seen it happen less and less with every generation.
When the day comes that the people of this city are ready to fight God, perhaps they might be trusted with the tools to do so.
I can't wait to get the God-fighting tools that you don't currently trust me with.
I didn't know that was an art.
I apologize, the moon is young to me.
Your impatience illustrates my exact point about readiness.
When will we be ready to learn what you're talking about?
That sounds like a lot of responsibility.

dialogues.title: Speak with Nellie Al-Zahiri
lines: No, not yet. But I heard you are a historian.
I can't resist a history discussion!
Certainly. That's why it's so fascinating!
LifeCorp have never declassified their records from that time, even with high level Corp clearance.
We don't even know why people were frozen?
Not as much as I would like to. Corporate cryogenics has long been shrouded in secrecy. Classified stuff.
Indeed. And a good one. So what do you want?
Records from that period are sparse because of the Erasera... But we know it was a bad time for just about everyone.
Well I'm still a bit angry about the fragments you didn't hand over... disappointed rather. But...
What do you know about cryogenics in Nivalis?
I'm sorry. Even the names of those involved in the project are hard to find.
The seventh epoch financial crisis seems to have affected the cryogenics industry.

dialogues.title: Banor ask the player about Egress
lines: I'm your boss Banor. Tell me.
Just an old man's ramblings. Pay me no mind.
Look, you're my boss and you can fire me, but there was stuff about Thaddeus that... well he has to tell you himself. You can't hear it from me.

There are two questions people got about Thaddeus: "Where is he?", and “Why did he leave?” It might only be possible to answer one of those questions, so you better decide which one means more to you.
It ain't my place, boss. If I say more I could be boiling some toads, you know?
Hey boss, you got that ticket to Egress all sorted out now?
Oh... right. Uh... Don't worry about it. I just thought maybe you already knew about... never mind boss.
I don't know more than anyone else. But sometimes, even though he's gone, it feels like he left to look out for us. And sometimes, it feels like he didn't go anywhere - he went everywhere.
No, you were going to say something. Tell me.

dialogues.title: Ava makes fun
lines: So we are looking for a sentient vacuum cleaner in Meridian Market.
Not the most absurd thing I ever did.

dialogues.title: Deeala at the docks
lines: You can listen to me bitch. I mean we could talk another time maybe.
I need to ask you something. Is my eyeliner symmetrical? Don't fuck about. Just yes or no please.
This morning it was so cold my latte became a frappe. I had to bail and do my make-up on the DuoRail.
I need the cash this month. Every day I miss rent, my landlord turns the heat down ten degrees in my apartment.
The ticket robot asked me if I "was going through something right now."
Right, well fuck you very much. I'm kidding. Kinda. I'll see you around. Maybe.
You need the tips that bad?
Fuck, right, there you are. Fuck! Where were you?
Okay, well, I'm really fucking busy, but I'll see what I do. I'm gonna be late, I gotta go. Later.
Good. I'm supposed to start my shift in fifteen minutes at Mollyphonic and there's some dumb tech bro who tips an insane amount when I look presentable.
Fuck. I'm supposed to start my shift in fifteen minutes at Mollyphonic and there's some dumb tech bro who tips an insane amount when I look presentable.
You need the tips that bad?
Right. I like that. You're right. Why should you listen to me bitch and moan? Unless... I'm willing to listen to you bitch and moan back?

dialogues.title: Freya Welcome to Paradise
lines: We're on vacation darling. You should try to relax. Unclench those shoulders. But go ahead. I'll hear you out. But first, did you bring me something lovely? A gift?
You made it. Welcome to Calypso Island. I hope you find your time here restful.
I'm here to free Edison's niece.
Yes... Yes, perhaps someone like you can help. But Mica has protections. Defenses. How can YOU circumvent her security?
You have no evidence, and only a vague understanding of the reality of what's happening. And no understanding of the danger you are in, apparently.
Legendary is a bit of a stretch.
Conland Containers and The Network are exploiting these kids.
Do you have something to say to me?
It's nice to finally meet you.
It's a tool that, when used correctly, can make problems go away. We have a little side business to... Well why give all this away to you? I know who you are you know?
I will lure her here where she's exposed.
Even a minnow can tip the scales.
Serious accusations against a company I am only tangentially involved with. And I have never heard of a "Network."
Almost certainly a bluff. But a bold one. Let's skip past this and get to your offer. What can you give me?
I know what you really are.
You've got guts, I'll give you that. More than Edison. Alright. Let's see where this goes. Bring Mica here. Then I'll give you what you want.
Of course you can. If you didn't have something to offer me, I wouldn't be letting you stand here in front of me.
Have you heard of a seasoning called Shimmer Sage?
In my business it's best to assume everyone knows everything. But never reveal anything, even if you think everyone might already know.
Oooohhh. I do like the thrill of a good accident. People pushed to their limits, scrambling to try and find a fix, a way out.
How about a piece of bone from an accident on the Oil Rig?
You think I am not ALREADY helping Edison? Protecting Edison? And his family? What are you saying?
If I'm crazy enough to do all this, what else could I do if you betrayed me?
It's just like when I bought my first resort and it almost went tits up. Wild times. Really speaks to a person's character if they make it through. Alright... I'll give you two minutes.
I have the records of Edison's niece, and I know they were erased.
I bet we could find traces of the tainted Shimmer Sage in your warehouses.
That's what we're doing here. When the business is over, I'll ask you to leave.
Where did you get this?? I thought Finn dove off the deep end and drowned.
You're telling me that legendary DJ Finn Amano is friends with... you?

That's a better idea than you could know. I control the environment here. I can expose her and cut her off from her protections. And I suppose I have nothing to lose... but how do you know YOU can trust ME?
Tell me who she is and why she would be of interest?
And who knows who YOU are? And, more importantly, who knows you're here? And would miss you?
It wasn't easy to see you.
How about the sheet music for an unreleased Finn Amano track?
Come on, you know she's your enemy.
You're part of The Network and the one behind all of these schemes.
Edison is a witness to everything that happened, and he is in hiding already.
I'll bring you Mica, then you let Edison and his niece go.
If she's as dangerous as you say, and so am I, what do YOU think you can bring to the table. No offence, but you're a... minnow.
This dance is a waste of time.
I have evidence - the traces of Shimmer Sage, the erased records, Edison as a witness.
You're persistent. Like a new Dolly track that worms its way into your head and won't get out. You have a minute left.

dialogues.title: Nabla helps - maybe
lines: Did you try the Old Network?
There is nothing we can retrieve. We all tried. The hackers love a challenge, so a few years back they all tried to gather info on one of Nivalis oldest, most secretive citizens. No one succeeded.
Exactly. I need all your bedtime stories about Hep.
In the bedtime stories my mother told me. A legend.
Too dangerous babe. And if there was important information we needed, safer to just ask her. She's still around. Just.
Are you looking for a hacker?
Nabla can help you... for the right amount.
I need to know everything about her. The good and bad.
Can you babe? Out of your league I think. And maybe even mine. Serious encryption. Lots of data obliteration. Scorched earth data secrecy.
Unless... Leave it with Nabla. More research is required. But if it IS possible... it won't be cheap.

dialogues.title: Party Time
lines: Ahhhh, well, that's a long story. She used to show up at these events I had. But she'd always come at the end, right? Stay for a few minutes maybe a half hour tops, then dip out with someone. Dudes. Chicks. Android. Didn't matter, whatever clung to her.
You're back! How'd it go? Did you secure the stuff? Can we have the party?
RM said I'm ignoring her. R! M! said THAT. Yet she had NO problem ignoring the fact that what lies she spread caused so much bullshit for so many people?
Yeah. Gods and Lights, those parties were the fuckin' best.
You.... That's just.... I mean.... There's people in this world and then there's good people.
Seriously? Wow. I was NOT expecting that. I mean, it's the right thing to do after she spread all those rumors around. Maybe she's taking stock in her actions.

Well, you see, there's just something about birthdays, you know? It's a day when normal people, people like you and me and the ones we serve with our drinks and our food and our blood, sweat, and tears--sometimes literally--get to sit back and reap the rewards of our labor! Of our very EXISTENCE!
You earned it. I'll let you know when the party is, really get our business talk going. I got some luscious ideas for your libations.
Oh, yeah! Word is bond and mine is as strong as those nanofiber cuffs the 'Sec's got. Here yah go.
How do you two know each other?
So what'd she wail yah for the bag? I told her I'd cover the cost by getting her VIP to this shimmer fest but she wasn't having it. Despite the fact that we're gettin' an ice luge with ACTUAL ice.
Why is this party SO important?
FIVE HUNDRED! For the love of every neon light in this glass and concrete cell block! Ugh. Whatever. I need this party to be the redux. The 'Welcome Back'.

dialogues.title: Ava Message Received
lines: He's trying to save her himself.
Being a GPS beats being an answering machine.
You have a new message from Edison. If they ever re-enable the Comms, I can simply connect you rather than operating as a woefully over-qualified answering machine.
He's in over his head. Edison doesn't know about our plan to give Mica to Freya. We should get there fast before he does something stupid.
Got a lead. Look, I know it's short notice, but can you meet me at Odin's Pub? It's a block down from Conland. I'm close to finding my niece... I can feel it. I can't trust anyone else with this.
I'll assume you want me to play it.
Can you point me toward Odin's Pub?
It suits you. Possible new job when I upgrade?

dialogues.title: Lynnphora Offer to Help
lines: So maybe the greenhouses where they grow the synthetic meats might be most appropriate?
I'm worried you're gonna keep going in circles.
Oh I'm so sorry, I didn't mean for free or anything. I can pay you some Lims.
No, I'll do this for free.
No, but really this time, I need to be rid of this urn, It's so hard to carry shopping with this damn thing.
Oh really? What a fantastic being you are.
Well, I was thinking the other day about how much he liked beef cubes. I tried them a few times but they were never really my thing. He never shut up about them.
I can't help you if you won't help yourself.
Are there any other details about Eugene that might inform your choice?
No you're right. It's my own fault.
Well since we started talking I have been thinking maybe it's time to let someone else make a call. Would you possibly take him? Eugene I mean.
Ok ok ok, I know this looks bad but I'm just really struggling to make this work. I'm sorry.
Welcome to my silly life. I struggle to make a decision about which coffee to order so I fear we'll both be in urns before this is over. Maybe it's time.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Agent Teleshko second visit
lines: Agent Teleshko is at the noodle bar. He looks a little... uncomfortable.

dialogues.title: Cecil Grimes Health Inspection
lines: Once an infraction's been noted, it's as good as logged. You'll barely notice the dock coming out of next month's return. Now, anyways, for why I'm really here...
Sounds like the peak of middle management.
I don't know a Cecil Grimes.

At this point? The inquiry's over. You can lodge a complaint with the head office but, I promise you, it will go unanswered. Feel free to pay the messaging fee though. My next holiday in the Spire ain't gonna pay for itself.
Well, considering you've got plates filthier than the bottom of my HOVA? Yes, I'd say there's always more. We'll add a 73C infraction for that one. Anything else?
It's not like clandestine language or anything. You've got a barely running shop here. And that's before I get involved.
Wait, whoa, can we slow down here?
You the owner of this... establishment? And I am applying the absolute barest definition of the word.
My colleague. Mica deals with the most serious offenders. So, uh... good luck!
Somehow, some way, I'm sure I'll recover. The important thing is that I'm an Assistant Sub-Deputy Hygiene Inspector at CorpSec's Bureau of Sanitation.

Those grease stains you have on the counter? That's a 14FC. Over there? That jar of unidentified matter? That's an infraction of Code 92B. I don't think I need to tell you they get pricier as the number rises.
I am. Can I help you?
I'm Cecil Grimes and boy do we need to have some words.
All that said, I'd like to introduce you to my friend Mica, she is waiting for you downstairs. I'd say it's been a pleasure but, you know... it hasn't.

dialogues.title: Ava announces Elaine Malloy
lines: And she wants to speak to you at the noodle stand.
The current chef of the year?
Does the name Elaine Malloy mean anything to you?
She's a famous photographer. Well, famous in the Spire.

dialogues.title: Clancy meeting 2
lines: You didn't ask! I mean if this has left you wanting more, I can get you signed up to the next package?
Well that's what we do here! I assume I can sign you up for the next lesson?
You didn't mention any terms and conditions!
Eager. As we always say here, early bird catches the good leads.
What, that was it? This is a scam!
How about this. We do another little taster free of charge?
I'll be honest, people don't normally drop out of the course this early. Really is a sign of weakness. But if you're sure?
Well there you are. Look at you. Ready to hit the big-time. Gotta respect that.
I'm here for your first lesson.
One hundred Lims plus a ten Lim admin fee.
Such an honor to be riding with you on this journey! Meet me again tomorrow.
That was it... the early bird thing.
Now now now, no need for the big talk. It's all there in the terms and conditions.

dialogues.title: Harper's Brother 1 help
lines: I heard you talked to Harper?
The less you know, the better for you both.
Just think Danny. CorpSec will follow you day and night to get to Harper.
I get it. I do... but this is my family.
Trust me, it's better this way. It will keep her safe from CorpSec.
I have no clue what you're talking about.
Are you kidding me? My sister. Where is she?
Can you give me her address?
You have my help, but you have to do things my way now.
No, I can't. It's to protect you both.
I'm her brother and she needs my help. Can you just tell me where she is? I haven't heard a word for three days.
My sister. She's in trouble. Do you know where she is?
Maybe talk to Banor. Tell him I sent you.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 4 - no
lines: No I thought we should keep that to ourselves.
I hate it when she does that. Did you mention the Crusty Punks.
Probably for the best. Perhaps we should go speak with this McFellow guy? I think the Metro Hub would be a good place to look.

dialogues.title: Crabface completes the expedition
lines: We sailed together so long. We were a family, but we three have all lived so long... Arguments and broken promises go back over the horizon of my memory.
I threw some old debris in the sea in case anyone - like you - ever try to dredge her up again.
I can't believe you listened to those two old rust buckets.
Cos I told them it was against the Captain's wishes, which is true. The Captain always said "If the seas take me, don't try to take me back."
Well I ain't giving you the full story - it's too depressin'. You should tell Salt Pete to tell you why we was all fighin' and why we were out on the seas in the first place.

No... But a hundred years later, on the anniversary of the accident, I told the others I did find her body. I told them I found her, and I had already scattered her remains in the ocean. They asked where, and I told them.

The three of us mutinied. I ain't proud to admit it. In the middle of a storm, the Captain went overboard. We were sailing North. Far North. Looking for The Gridless Sea. She fell, but we were squabbling when she needed us.
Why did you lie to them?

I... felt guilty I guess. It was me that started the argument. It was me that should have been looking out for the Captain when the mast hit her. I wanted to give them some peace. Even told them she could be repaired one day...
You should talk to each other.
Because I did it. I told Caleb and Salt Pete that I would put the Captain to rest. Scatter her remains to the four corners of the Gridless sea.

Dredging up the past was never gonna do us any good. But at least we can bury the lies as well as the Captain now. Tell Salt Pete...I didn't mean to hurt him. And if you see Caleb, give him a message, ok? Tell him.... Stormy's Gone.
And after all these years you still don't talk to one another?
I'm putting your Captain back together.
You were just trying to protect them I guess.
You got a look in your eye, landlubber. A look I don't like.

It was the Captain who kept us together. Unravelling the mysteries of The Gridless Sea was exciting, but we lost sense of ourselves out there. When she went overboard... it was a good time to go our separate ways and find ourselves again.
THAT ain't the Captain. That's trash.
Yeah. I guess I got a lot of explainin' to do. I always knew this day would come...
No. Salt Pete and Caleb can't count. I can't believe you listened to those two old rust buckets.
So the Captain is lost? And Crabface lied about finding her and burying her at sea. That's not very "pirate" of him. I guess we should tell Salt Pete...
You shouldn't have lied to them.
Captain Andalucia Ophelia Marquez the Fourth...
Well, I got bad news for ya. For all of ya.
Aye. To my shame... Aye. But you can tell them now. I tried to keep the secrets. Bury the truth below the waves, but the truth always gets washed up on shore eventually.
It's trash. These are pieces of scrap metal. Shaped like the Captain, sure enough. But they are NOT the Captain.
How can you tell after all this time?

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 12
lines: Old Network? Hm ... Are you sure you remember that right?
Let's hope it can't be traced.
Maybe? What else have you got?
I remember something... I can't put my finger on it ...
There was something very old. A network of ancient AI's... chaotic and untamed, even... primordial.
She told me to ask if the term "Old Network" meant anything to you.
I'm much older than we think. I'm a coma roamer.
Just like with the cryogenics that Gamova mentioned.
See! How could you remember paper books or an old network!
Rheno left a file showing her path into my system. I can shut her out now.
You said something was strange when you transmitted the files?
I believe the ancient AI took the files and spread them to avoid my tracing algorithms.
Nothing else. Wait... that's it! The Old Network! The books printed on paper! The Long Freeze!
In your own time Ava. This is a lot to take on.
Crime novels right? What do they have to do with the old network?
Excellent work. Love a good pun.
Your generation of Automata is too recent to remember all of this.
I... need to process this. Go into my memories and swim in the stream of my dreams... Can we talk about this tomorrow? I need time.
My generation of Automata was prototyped 22 years ago.
I get it. Are you sure she's gone?
She's gone. Gamova. "Game Over." Should I explain the joke further?
That ancient network took the files. I had no control. Seconds later they appeared on conventional networks.
I... remember them! I have experienced all of these things.

dialogues.title: Seaside Boardwalk
lines: Seaside Boardwalk offers budget shopping space, budget housing but premium views!

dialogues.title: Return to Cassius
lines: Alas I fear they've gone native. They've succumbed to the allure of the poor. I knew the lifestyle would be too exciting for them.
Well, they may have been at the whole business thing for a long time, maybe they're entitled to their retirement...
We think they took the roleplay too far and were mistaken for real poor people.
Oh my all this gravity is making my brain taste weird. What would you do?
Oh no. They haven't gone native have they? They've succumbed to the allure of the poor. I knew the lifestyle would be too exciting for them!
I'd take over the business. A lot of money to be made in hospitality.
I'm not sure... how to process... what do I do?
Your destiny clearly lies in the stars.

Well thank you for your help. You have been both useful and kind. If you ever need a room at Pierrepont establishment, you tell them you know old Cassius and... you'll still have to pay, but they'll know how connected you were for a time. Goodbye.
I'm afraid we have grave news.
...Yes. That's the bad news. They have no interest in returning to their past lives.
It sounds like they deserve it.
There were two victims, a couple with the name of Poorepont.
We weren't able to dig up anything new.
I have a lot to think about. I discovered Thera-pay bots this morning, perhaps I will find the answers there.
Ahhh my friend, have you any news? My parents are yet to make contact.
Those were their Aliases. Always told them that they're frivolous...
That's up to you. Will you take over the family empire or return to space?
No I'm afraid it's worse than that. They were killed by The Aseptic.

dialogues.title: Meet Hep Gimble
lines: You know... I can't exactly recall.
You don't remember why you're here?
I don't know. But their scent sticks to everything. Not even sterilizer gets rid of it. I sometimes smell it in the middle of the night.
You know... I'm not quite certain. Maybe I even read them.
I thought I’d be a paper pusher, but I was always athletic. I shouldn't have been surprised that the Corp promoted me to wetwork.
What do you do with the old books?
Yeah, I came here to see them.
That’s good. It’s one of the nicest jobs in the city. I wish I’d known keeping plants tidy was a job when I was young.
I sometimes pick some of the flowers and press their blossoms between the pages of old books.
Oh, well I was never allowed to keep any of my memories, dear.
"CorpSec". I think I worked for them, once.
Who did you say you were, dear?

Yes, when we went to find a target. There were always so many things to wash afterwards. I don’t remember the missions but I do remember the washing. Hands, uniform, tools... all that sterile spray would sting my skin something rotten.
The flowers. The plants. They’re quite lovely.
LOOK at these flowers. This is the only place they’ll grow outside the Spire. How lucky we are to see them.
I’m tired now, dear. Don’t you have watering to see to?
It was an order. Part of the training. When we were told to forget, we forgot. I got quite good at it. Forgot every single one of my missions.
My parents said CorpSec was a safe choice. I thought I’d be a paper pusher, but I was always athletic. I shouldn't have been surprised that the Corp promoted me to wetwork.
Some of them aren't real, you know, but the gardeners do such a nice job keeping the leaves freshly painted.
I'm a gardener. I just started.
Why did you need to sterilize anything?
Sounds like your conscience getting the better of you.

dialogues.title: Ava introduces sea exploration
lines: It means something exciting. Trust me.
And despite the risks - CorpSec, Neo Gorgons, sentient slime colonies - it remains a lucrative opportunity - for those fortunate enough to own a boat.
I recommend you use this boat to reach inaccessible areas, explore the sea-level city superstructure and find good fishing grounds. Beware the waves and bad weather. And let's go plunder some booty!

Indeed. Sailing in Nivalis is a popular way to explore less... accessible locales. CorpSec look down on the practice, but with no real way to enforce a ban, they rely on spot checks and random fees and fines to gather income from those who sail the seas.
So, where shall we go Skip?
Perhaps it would be best if I introduced you to the world of sailing in Nivalis? Would you like more, or fewer pirate metaphors?
My records are conflicted on this term. "Pirates" were either sailers with a penchant for raiding and pillaging, or hackers who illicitly copied and shared software.
Tell me more about sailing in Nivalis.

dialogues.title: Seriously
lines: Which was nothing. Not that I am judging you. Inaction is often the best course of action.
Maybe you should have paid the money.
I did what I had to.
Are you afraid to tell Harper that you refused to pay the 300 Lims?

dialogues.title: Botan - Player Wins
lines: You're like a recall that gets lost in the feeds and ends up killing someone when you cause their HOVA to blow up.
Don't do that. It's not as fun when you're a good sport.

dialogues.title: You Have a Caller
lines: ....No. It was a play on words. You have an audio log from Cale Wyer. Would you like me to play it?
It appears you have a gentleman caller.
Oh! Awesome. Let's hear his idea.
Bummer. Thought things were getting back to normal. I'm good right now.
Yeah, I kinda changed my mind on that.
I know it's been a little bit, but if you're still up for a date I have an idea. Meet me in Sky High Gardens, your Automata knows where.
And listen, no worries if you changed your mind. I wouldn't blame yah. Hope to maybe see you soon.
I believe it's about a date he planned.

dialogues.title: Nixxi at The Spire
lines: Retiring. Soon, I get to live my life based on my own choices instead of what my audience votes for me to do. Which is less fun... obviously.
The Spire! And what a perfect place for my penultimate stream.
Look at us. Who would have guessed we'd make it all the way here.
It's fifty-fifty. I like those odds.
You'll be losing out on a lot of money.
You shouldn't let strangers tell you what to do with your life.
Sounds like it's worth the gamble.
It's a commercial break right now so I can be honest cos I'm offline. It's the right time for a move. I just need to complete one last task, but I'm not sure my audience will go for it.
I'm glad you'll soon be free.
Why does your audience get to decide your fate?
I thought there were three options?
The audience will spend all their channel points and their vote is the one I have to go with.
Why do you have to do what they say?

Because their channel points make up my salary. If all of them chip in, they can pay for my life here. But if they decide it's funnier to send me to the Ventz, their channel points will pay for a relocation company to send me there.
I thought you were free of your audience.
They'll either send me to the Ventz or keep me here in the Spire. No one wants to watch me work for a delivery company.
Not exactly. I won't stream anymore, but I'll be featured in a follow up Nets series about my life in luxury. Or poverty. So wish me luck!
I thought after they voted you didn't have an audience any more?
They get to decide what I do when I quit streaming. They have three options: delivery driver, exile to the Ventz, or retirement in luxury here, in the Spire.

dialogues.title: Learn about Staff Shifts
lines: And what does lower worker satisfaction actually mean?
Lower productivity, if it sinks too low. In that case a pay rise can help. It's a game of balance.
Shifts work as you'd expect, longer shifts, better productivity but the trade-off is lower worker satisfaction. Capitalism 101!
Will my staff ever just quit?
Might be a good time to talk shifts.
If they are unhappy for too long, yes, they could. Only one way to find out.

dialogues.title: Milo hired a criminal
lines: Yes, well, it was clear to everyone in that lowlife bar that I was out of my depth.
I think a "mufflin" is a euphemism for a body part.
I am not sure what a "Mufflin" is, but I am sure it's not a term of endearment.
I will attempt to partner with Nola Berg. It is my only remaining option. My finances are almost depleted. My business accounts are drained.
You have to admit he got a point!
Well it was a BAD idea.
Wasn't that obvious in the first place?
Thank you. Next time I see you, I shall report back on my success.
Maybe that's not a good idea, either?
You told me I should send a criminal to threaten Nola Berg.
I got mugged and someone stole my glasses.
I'm sorry, but I don't listen to you anymore!
Then he called me childish names while I protested.
What will you say to her?
I will tell her about my business acumen and encourage her to invest in me.
The man who mugged me - his name was "Razzor" I believe, told me I deserved neither money nor vision.
I went to Lowtown and asked around for a criminal to help me.

dialogues.title: Speak to Cassius
lines: Then I shall have my people contact him.
Is it about water? Because I have to be honest, the concept of drainspin is still troubling me...
I quite understand. Did you wish to ask me something?
I will certainly do so. Connections are everything.
Spend time in each other’s company.
Are you asking if I want to hang out?
I like to repay my debts where I can. You have someone in mind, I presume?
Are you asking me for a date?
Probably not, but you’d be doing me a favor if you hired one.
As would I! So, ah... did you want to ask me something?
So different to Luna… I had no idea. Do you know of someone?
It’s about your hotel. In the Spire. Do you need a hygiene inspector?
Ah! I’m so pleased to see you. I have another question…
Yes. All the best hotels have one.
Oh. I don’t know. Do I?
Tell them to mention my name.
My father always said favors are for the weak. But I suppose he isn't here. You have a candidate in mind?
Yes, I know a guy. Cecil Grimes. He’s… very diligent.
It is good to help those who are reliant on Lims, isn’t it?
Would you care to, ahem, peruse a hydrophobic carpet catalogue with me? I could bring it round to your apartment tonight.
It's... no, never mind. Is there something I can do for you?
What an interesting person you are. Now, if you'll excuse me, hotel business calls.
What a fascinating person you are. I will look forward to "hanging out" together...
Oh! Haha, yes. That makes a lot more sense. Yes. I am asking if you would like to "hang out".

dialogues.title: Check the Dropbox
lines: It would seem that both of you trusted the wrong person.
She said she'd leave something for me!
If she died, it isn't my fault...
She said she would leave something for you if she got out of this alive...

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus Third Meeting
lines: Give or take. I did lose track in the one hundred and sixties but we find our way back don't we? My research has been putting the train in front of the track as it were.
Well, destiny is a fluid concept, and one you must not lean on, it lest you fall to your death.
Your oversimplification of an over complication is clunky, but by and large, you are bang on.
You're two hundred and thirty years old?
Have you ever come across a bad slime mold?
How could I possibly help you make that choice?
Once again, the words you spoke when last we met have grown like a slime mold within me.
What an amazing feat! You should make your research public.
So you can make people immortal, and you don't know what to do with that?
Yes, of course. You and I have some important choices to make. One man's eternal life could be a society's impending death.
Well, I'm not quite sure what we are talking about but you seem to know your stuff so I'll take that into consideration. Goodbye for now.
Help? Have you ever seen slime mold? Horrible stuff.
Another perfect allegory for life... nearly as good as the plumbing one!
I think this research would be terrible in the wrong hands. You should destroy it.
My research is complete. Now we must decide what to do with it.
My life's work has the power to change the way the wind blows. One man's eternal life, could be a society's eternal death.
The plumbing of destiny has returned you here.
I suspect you already have. In my two hundred and thirty years on this world, I have learned a lot about people. You are a person and people make choices every day.

dialogues.title: Danny Second Meeting
lines: It's just... no, never mind. I, uh... I gotta go.
Hey, so did you know old Thaddeus Carminus well?

dialogues.title: Mala Fifth Metting
lines: Ok, well leave me to get on with my street-education then.
Yes, it's a lot, but thanks for even thinking about it.
What?? But it's a thousand Lims. Are you toying with me?
Ok, well, I'll get on with my street-education then.
No, I was thinking, maybe I should pay your tuition.
On second thoughts. It is a lot.
In case you're hungry, drop by my noodle stand. It's on the house.
I can't... It's just... Thank you.
You haven't been telling people my secret have you?
No, I was actually thinking of paying your school tuition, but I just cannot afford it.
Thank you! That means a lot!

dialogues.title: Gamova Call 3
lines: You have been selected via advanced risk algorithms—
Fuck! Damn! ... I mean ... Your contribution to the case has been filed. Await further instruction.

You listen up. I'm under a Sky-bridge of pressure here. I don't have time to deal with your... another Aseptic adjacent environment has been identified. My employer has deemed it necessary that this be investigated.
I need to inform you. I require full transparency at all times. Failure to hand over key information would result in catastrophe for you. What did you learn?
We found an audio log. It mentioned the Crusty Punks?
Now you listen to me. Do not under any circumstances approach the Crusty Punks. This is above your security clearance.
Another Aseptic adjacent environment has been identified. My employer has deemed it necessary that this be investigated.
If you want me to keep doing this, I'm going to need more access.

dialogues.title: Ask Banor about Ava
lines: Or maybe ask Huckstash, Gunger or Alan Fontus? They've all been around Thaddeus for a while.
But she seems to remember pain.
I'm no specialist on Automatas or their faults. Maybe take her to a specialist?
How well do you know Ava?
Thaddeus must have upgraded her a lot over the years. She's never seemed to become obsolete.
Ava? I know her as long as I knew Thaddeus. She was his Automata for a long time.
Thaddeus found ways to get around rules. He could manipulate anyone and anything.
He never needed to replace her?

dialogues.title: Harmony Third Meeting
lines: I'm just not sure if penning a prolific serial killer into one of the most densely populated areas of Nivalis is good for the residents?
Yeah, seems like a bad idea to me.
I mean eventually I'll have to I guess, but it doesn't seem fair for all my customers.
I'm sure CorpSec knows what they're doing.
I'm sure there are good people who work for CorpSec, there has to be right?
Used to be, but it's getting harder and harder to bring stock into the zone. Prices are hugely over-inflated.
Now that the Aseptic seems to be finished, why do we still have the LUZ?
Probably to maintain Corp control a little longer.
Just seems like Aseptic is working in overdrive these days. I don't think the LUZ is working.

dialogues.title: Side Job Sage Hullen
lines: No way. Hand it over, babe.
Nice try, pooch. Here's twenty. You're lucky to get it.
Good doggy. Now go play fetch somewhere else.
Can't believe that neon-dweeb suckered you into doing their dirty work. Hand it over.
Look, I haven't had my morning stims so whatever trouble yah got in those pockets just keep it there, ok?
I'm just looking for someone called Sage.
Should I rather deliver it to CorpSec?
UGH. Alright, how much did it cost?
You're looking AT someone called Sage. Gonna do anything about it?
If you rubberneck at me any harder your head'll fall off.
Can't believe that neon-dweeb suckered another idiot into doing their dirty work. Hand it over.
No can do. I've got to give you this package from Nabla.
Yeah: give you this package from Nabla.
Nothing to do with you, babe.
Nice to see you again too.
Cute. Here's twenty. Go buy yourself a guide on how to flirt.

dialogues.title: Olive dreams big
lines: Relax. I'd probably fuck it up. Or chicken out. Wouldn't be the first time! Anyway, don't look at me like that. I'm fine now. And on the stone cold. I'm in the cold light of day, and somehow, I'm ok with it. I'm doing ok.
Look, I'm happy. That's what I'm trying to say. I've left the Movement and I'm happy about it. Our speaking tour was a success. In a way. I made it.
You should never attempt to work in marketing!
Ok? I'm flying bay-bee! We're out on our own now. You and me. We did it! They don't need us less than we don't need them.
You happened, you glorious fucking asshole. I love you. Fuck you. Let's go!
Well, they fuck-ing did it, didn't they? They fucking threw me out of the movement.
Sure. I'm a lot of things! But... maybe that's fine, you know. And maybe I can keep being a lot of things if I sober up... a bit. Ease off on the Joos, booze, uppers, downers, siders.
Ciders. You know? The apple drink.
Retire from life, yeah. Take so much Joos I don't feel ANYTHING any more, then jump off something high. Or into something toxic. Whichever would be more dramatic.
I don't know if it helps you to know this, but... you helped me. So thanks. Now, I gotta go. I think retirement calls for a celebration. And a drink!
Yeah. Maybe all I needed was... a friend.
You know... Take so much Joos I don't feel ANYTHING any more, then jump off something high. Or into something toxic. Whichever would be more dramatic.
I know what I am. A drunk. A drug addict. An attention whore. A dangerously charismatic lunatic. A provocateur. An iconoclast.
Of soda! Or tea... or that unflavored stuff that's supposed to be good for you.
I made it. This tour was... a finale. An encore. After this, no more tours. No more speeches. No more Olive.
They need a slogan for water?
Water! That's the one. Damn, they need to come up with some better branding for that. And a better name. They need a slogan too.
Me too. See you later Friendo!
Sure! It has no slogans, no nicknames... We should be "Chugging the clear" "Supping the wets."

Look, I'm not as scribbly as I seem. I know the speeches are all for show. No one listens. No one cares. Or ALMOST no one. Sometimes, you only need one person. If one person hears you scream into the void, it's not a void any more. They're an audience, and it's a show.

dialogues.title: Meeting Clancy
lines: Straight to the point. I actually respect that. I think you're ready. Let's say we get you signed up?
Well look, this is starting to feel more like fate than anything else. Let's say we get you signed up?
I knew I'd come to the right person. So sharp. Yes, I'm an educator. And what started as a symposium is now an entire school. Those who can, teach.
Hey kid I'm so damn glad I found you! I'm just scooting through town on some business and something came across my desk that screams your name!
Just the taster session? Seventy-two weeks Covers all the basic stuff but leaves plenty of room for the intermediate course!
Oh... ok... great. Wow, yeah brilliant, I mean, we should maybe work on your haggling skills first off but, welcome aboard the Pantermino International Sales School!
Well that's kind, but... enough about me. Let's talk about you! Let's talk about how seriously you take this business craft of yours!
Playing hard to get, business 101. And dating am I right? No but seriously:

Now now, I do NOT believe that. Look, we go back a long way so I'm gonna offer you something I don't offer to the riff raff. One fifty, you'll make that back tenfold under my tutorship. That's the Pantermino Guarantee.
And oh boy do I know how to 'can'. Forty years selling everything from fishing rods to Hova mods. You name it I've sold it.
Wooooweeeee I'm not sure how much I can teach you! I'm kidding - you have a lot to learn. Ok listen up, you need to keep this to yourself but maybe I can go a little lower. One Fifty.
I work in the restaurant sector.
Now now, I'm not trying to kiss on the first date. Funny you mention business though, as business is my business if you catch my drift? Of course you do.

Well my my my, I wonder what could have happened. I mean it says in my records here that you're incredibly interested in growing your business and... let me see here... ahhh yes, becoming a titan of industry!
Look. You know where to find me.
I guess you must have expressed some interest in the Pantermino International Sales Symposium. Did you know Symposium is an ancient name for Drinking Party? I always loved that.
Welcome aboard the Pantermino International Sales School. Maybe I'll come up with an acronym at some point. I'll be in touch with information soon!
Free! I mean... look maybe just sign up for free. I'd really like it if you did. ...Please.
I can tell you're a business person. It's in the eyes. I can always tell, you know?! A real gift my mother used to say. What do you do?
I didn't express interest in anything like that.
I'd be happy to take a small deposit of... look you're a friend now so let's say two hundred and fifty Lims?

dialogues.title: Meet Marius
lines: Well, if it isn’t the rookie with overblown ambition. We’ve met, haven’t we? You were looking for recipes.
I just want to focus on my own business.
You do you, I do me.
I assume you've been keeping an eye on the rankings.
You must have a forgettable face.
I remember when I was down where you are. Early days stuff. You might be able to claw some back.
You're gonna need to start sweating the small details if you want to grow in this business.
It's coming back to me now. You're a food man.
Fighting talk eh? I assume you've been keeping an eye on the rankings?
Food man. I like it. I assume you've been keeping an eye on the rankings?
You’ve got the look. Like you’re starting to believe your own pitch. Dangerous thing in this city.
Yet here you are. Clinging to the charts like mold on a soy stick.

dialogues.title: Find the Student
lines: Ohhhhh. I see. The university probably has a copy somewhere. Once an artist is deceased, SecTalent enacts an intellectual easement and assumes ownership.
Sorry. My head's always in the lens, you know? When you've been taking pictures as long as I have it becomes impossible to separate.
Preach. But, hey, least I'm getting some good shots of it all burning down... Sad how true that is.
Glad I never went to college. Lims well saved.
Everyone's in debt in this city.
Depends. In art circles you're an outlaw. Some people love that you buck the norms. Others couldn't care less. Corpsters hate it because of the lost revenue.
You're definitely new to this whole area aren't you. If you know someone in Sec they might be able to help you. The University might, but who knows where it is or who has access.
Have you heard of the AG?
... clearly. Look, I gotta run. Good luck finding AG's compendium!
Student, actually. One day this will be my official job but I gotta work myself out of the hole first.
That sucks. What about the family? No royalties?
How far are you from having one?
Do most artists not want one?
Educational institutions should have more funding.
Oh, hey. Fancy seeing you around here. Hoping I'll snap a shot just as you're doing something epic?
Can I get a copy from SecTalent?
If playing the Corpsters' game means success then do it.
Sure. As long as you get a good enough price for it who needs a soul anyway? What has you asking about compendiums?

Well, it's kinda tricky, you know? Most want them because it's your life's work. But it's also a way to track you. There's artists out there who have work that aren't in compendiums or just purely don't have them.
Oh no, not yet. That's more for when your work gets monetized. Pretty much the only purpose of them is so SecTalent can log what you're doing and how much you're making.
If only. Figuratively of course. Though literally would make for some risque photo ops... Anyway, what has you asking about compendiums?
You make quite the frame standing with that in the background.
The AG? Mr. Anthony himself? Of course. Most have. His legacy is palpable among the community. He was a loss, that's for sure.
Who at the University would have it?
Central Canyon Tech. Since their art funding was slashed I do their marketing stuff pro bono and they let me use their labs whenever. It's kind of a nice setup actually.

dialogues.title: Raluca paid a lot of money (Raluca unknown)
lines: Don't worry. I just want to know where you got it.
Not really. Father's working for me.
Yeah. What is it to you? I don't want any hassle.
And how much you paid for it, if that's ok...

Who knows how Ryan got it? Probably pulled it off a body. Best not to know. But you should ask him. He's a black market trader, but you'll have to find him yourself. He's elusive. That's all I got for ya.
It's too pricey if you just like the look. This isn't a fashion thing.
I can imagine. You're an oxyphile, right?
One counts as charity for a sick kid.
I know someone. A child. He's an oxyphile like you and needs a mask.
So where did I get it? That's all you need to know?
It worked its way through the hands of the underground traders. Vik Ryan trafficked it down from the Spire for a 100 grand.
Rather expensive, for someone living in Lowtown.
I assume you don't pay them Spire-level wages?
Sure is. What exactly do you want?
The mask was used black-market ware. Still wiped out my inheritance.

dialogues.title: Marius discusses his leg B
lines: No look, I only have one real leg...
Look at me... notice anything strange? Anything off to you limb-wise? have a look in the leg area?
Well the thing is, there's a rumor he's using it for some sick... I don't know but I've heard he's using it for something.
Everyone's tough until they wake up inside a deep fat fryer. That tends to make people go very crispy very quickly.
What do you think he did with it?
Well... that's very kind... but I'm trying to make a point out of it. What do you think happened to it?
Ok ok ok fine. Maybe instead we could work something else out?
See this as an investment into your future. Lims for Limbs.
Can I get a refund on the other payments?
Oh one more thing. Remember what I said about Aengus Prince?
Well I'll be honest, I didn't expect to see you again.
If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.
I think you're just making this stuff up to extort me.
Wait, who's that walking towards you? "Oh my, it's the guy who's leg I stole all those years ago! I'd better split!"
So he'll leg it when you approach him?
Ok, two moves ahead I see. Well you'd better hope it's enough.
Firstly, poor choice of words. Secondly I have no idea as I've never tried but that's what I'd do! Look, do it for me and I'll give you free protection for life!
Shall we say a square 95 Lims?
Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.
You remember a few moments ago, I was talking about my leg and Aengus Prince?
The point, Little Berry Mouse, is if you keep scraping the glaze as closely as you are, you're gonna lose your own limbs soon enough.
What did he do with it?
Well no, I lent it to him and he never gave it back.
You think I lost it behind the sofa? Left it in the back of a taxi? Fuck no, this was Aengus Prince.
Look I don't really know what your point is here.
Well the life expectancy of someone not paying protection is days in this town.
I just wondered if you'd mind speaking to him for me? See if you can find out where he might be keeping it?
Aengus is the best in the business, it was a peace offering in exchange for tutorship. I heard he was on the lookout for bits of body and I offered mine.
I didn't want to make a point out of it.
Picture the scene: You're minding your own business, all is well.
What did he do with it?
I'm many things, but I ain't a liar.

dialogues.title: Ava - Unlock Some Recipies
lines: I cannot. Most creative tasks are still left to individuals as a way to, um, ensure their lives have meaning.
You can tell when I'm feeling inspired?
Then I better get to work.
And I have a lot of it?
According to "Hacking the Human Condition so You Can Hack Said Humans - Fourth Edition", dopamine is a neurotransmitter made in your brain. Hey, look at that, something does happen up there.
Well, your dopamine levels are curiously odd. I wonder if...
... Yes, I can tell when you're feeling inspired. Make sure you utilize that for your business.
Advanced Biometric Pulse Surveys notify me of variations in certain levels within your composition.
Isn't that something you or Banor could do?
Talk to Banor again, he might require some assistance.
Get creative! You have a slew of ingredients available to you. Some of them are even edible! Use your inspiration to edit recipes so that we can offer something special at the Noodle Bar.
Increased levels tend to lend themselves to feelings of creativity or... dare I say... inspiration? That's something you should put to good use.

dialogues.title: Ceres gives more context
lines: So you just wanted to warn me?
You see Gan, my husband, should not live on.
You must listen to me if you value your comfortable life here in Nivalis.
And I am not the only one who feels like this.
Yes. But you must not say this to anyone. Surely you realize how sensitive this information could be?
I don't like where this is going.
There was more to Gan than you may know. He was an odd man, and a secretive one. Seemingly small of intellectual stature and wisdom but that was a facade.
I realize I may have been a little harsh and dismissive last time...
I can't say lest you too become a target. But no one should know his current fate. Understand?
These people would kill as many innocent souls as they needed to if they thought their secrets were threatened.
I confess now he's back I feel better. But I hope no one else learns his fate.
For your own safety, don't tell anybody that you ever heard the name Gan Coilson.
Is it connected with him having been CTO at LifeCorp?

dialogues.title: Level Down from 5 to 3
lines: Alright... We probably need to do something about that.
Hey, wow. Ok. Wow. That's not good. Our rating for the noodle stand dropped from five to three!
We need to get the business back on track.

dialogues.title: Go to Crogan's Apartment
lines: Well I hope you aren't looking for the someone who lived here. He's toast.
I don't really have a choice.

Whatever vigilante shit you’ve got going on, I hope you’re serious about catching this guy I got into a lot of dice-debt and I'm worried I'm going to be high on his list. Such a sick fucking MO. Targeting the poorest.
Is what it is. Here take this. Looks like some kind of weird data cache. Label says "McFellow Transport Hub". Found it in the poor fucks jacket.
Well it would be if CorpSec weren't so incompetent.
Look, I probably shouldn't have trusted you last time either. Just go back to running noodle stands. Why get in over your head?
You must have a good reputation.
Whatever you say kid. Here take this. Looks like some kind of weird data cache. Label says "McFellow Transport Hub". Found it in the poor fuck's jacket.
Yeah seems like your job is a waste of time.
Yeah agreed, death to the Corpsters.
I'm sorry about your gambling debt.
You betcha! Stunning work as per. No idea why they keep calling me out to these ones. Place was cleaner than a Corpsters alibi during a data breach.
Here take this. Looks like some kind of weird data cache. Label says "McFellow Transport Hub". Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 13
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Do not allow your happiness to rely on your economic position… please insert Lims to continue.

dialogues.title: Finlay is angry
lines: Stay the fuck away from me, I mean it.
Fucking sold out Delbert to Curzona. I was here when they took him. He was the best of us, man.
Sorry won't bring him back. Just, stay the fuck away from me.
Get the fuck away from me, corpo snitch worm.

dialogues.title: Ava gets the nav point to Egress
lines: Unclear. Perhaps Huckstash? Or Banor. You should investigate soon.
I have a Nav Point. The description is one word.

dialogues.title: Ava announces Pilk
lines: Pilk Dane. I don't think it's about your tenancy.
Your landlord is at the noodle stand waiting for you.
He still thinks you have a doppelganger who insulted him and made him quit comedy.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Camera 3
lines: Hmm. A criminal fine of 60 Lims has been deducted from your account.
I was wondering when you'd call.
It has been noted. Nevertheless, a criminal fine of 60 Lims has been deducted from your account.
You are attempting to bribe me.
Anything I can do to make this go away?
You have been engaging in criminal activity. Again.
This is not a laughing matter. You were seen...

dialogues.title: Lois and the Aseptic
lines: Not yet, but I'm working on it.
Yeah. It was kinda covered up by CorpSec. Gordon is a Corpster Hacker in his spare time and he told me about it.
Coffee? You're a strange one, and that's something, coming from me.
I'm not sure Luna is great either.
Hey. Funny seeing you here. What brings you to the old port?
Maybe there's more to life than games?
I'd rather do something in the real world.
I think I know what the pattern is.
I dunno. My job, my family, my life... Something.
Sentient slime mold. It slithers up from the slump at midnight. Well, that's the rumor anyway.
I'm not really into guns either.
There are a lot of rumors.
Haha, then our first trip to the moon will have to wait I guess. *Sigh* I just like to watch the shuttles take off. The ozone smell makes me think of...
So do you know anything about The Aseptic?

I mean an Automata probably needs a robotic frame to do it, but even then... I remember that rogue traffic Automata last month that killed like two hundred people just by flashing the wrong color at the wrong time.
It's a little worrying, but I think I will be fine.
I'm not into guns, but shooting people in games is fun.
I don't give it a second's thought.
Course. But do I believe this one?
No, of course not. Unless you have a few million Lims in your back pocket?
Well anything that can keep my mind off these morbid serial killer stories is good. We should play some co-op games some time. You in?
Anywhere but here seems good right now. I need something to change...
Things will get better. You just have to wait it out.
You did? I thought it was kinda covered up by CorpSec. Gordon is a Corpster Hacker in his spare time and he told me about it.
Is that what YOU'RE doing? I dunno... Maybe it's just that time of the year, you know?
What do you think he wants? Or she? Or them? Could be anyone, you know. All sorts of people can be serial killers. Even androids and Automata.
I could ask you the same thing.
You know, when there's no big games coming out because all the season passes have started over again. I probably just need something new to play.
I'm pretty anxious about it. But then, I'm pretty anxious about MOST things. Have you heard of that sentient slime mold that appears at the docks?
Things will only get better if you take control of your own life.
Yeah, something like that. You gotta dream of something better than this, right? And the easiest way to do that, is to dream that somewhere else IS better than this.
I was making polite conversation bud. I just wanted to know if you needed any help or something?
Sure. Why not? Sounds cool, in a terrifying kind of way. Anyway, want to hop in a shuttle with me? Luna sounds nice?
There's a pattern for sure, but I don't know what it is yet.
Come on Lois. You can tell me.
Alright. Well, I'm gonna let you get back to... whatever you are really doing. I'm gonna watch like three more launches, then I should go home and finish those bug reports.
Maybe I should get into shooters? I'm just not that excited about guns though...
Right. Not... thinking about fleeing the planet to escape this mad serial killer?
Haha, good one. Maybe I should get into shooters? I'm just not that excited about guns though...
The thought had crossed my mind.
Well, I get the feeling this killer has a plan. I mean, I know that's not much of a secret, but I feel like there is a pattern there, you know? We just can't see it yet.
I like all sorts of games, but I don't like shooting much.

dialogues.title: At the Hideout
lines: This is the area where Silo was last seen. We should look for clues.

dialogues.title: Dotson - Player Won
lines: Thou has thwarted me. I... I have malfunctioned.
Perception defines good. And ours differs at this moment. Nevertheless, I wish you luck in the next match. Use the clues your opponent gives you and crush them!
Yup. Now you can go short circuit yourself.
How rude!!! You must work for my rival: the detestable agency that has cracked too many of my cases. I must go!

dialogues.title: Nabla Buys Old Tech
lines: Forty, yeah? See you next time, babe.
Can you do a little more?
Thirty, yeah? See you next time, babe.
Got something good for me, babe?

dialogues.title: Ask Rosetta for Help with Records
lines: Perhaps. People tell them all sorts of secrets. Coma Roamers and LifeCorp secrets... they just might know something, and they never stop talking. They have no filter.
Coma-roamers? There are no records here about that programme! No such programme ever existed. You shouldn't even ask for it.
Can I just look at some old LifeCorp records?
CORA no! What a question! If it was allowed, I would be aghast right now. Aghast! If you do not have an expired human relative to visit, you should NOT be here!
Does the Holocropolis store any... frozen bodies?
All sensitive data, but those old buckets have been around a long time, and they hold more secrets than people realize. You'll need to find an old one.
But instead I will recommend you see a TheraPay bot. Old frozen bodies... Coma Roamers...
Hello again! I am so happy to see you!
Well, could I look at Lifecorp Records over 150 years old? Or do you have any.... frozen, stored bodies?
You are welcome! Here is a tissue!
I'm looking for any records about coma-roamers in the Holocropolis.
You are not allowed to look for records!
No. Holograms only last 99 years here. After that we delete them to make space on our servers. And we don't store biological material. No bodies!
You! You are not allowed to be here!
Could I just check your records?
If I was allowed to, I would tell you to go jump in the sea!
In all honestly, we rarely get visitors for holograms that are older than 10 years.
If I was allowed, to I would tell you to leave now!
No. And I think I know what you need, but I don't have it. Perhaps I can point you in the right direction though... Some of the boys might have a long memory.
The TheraPay boys! Those old buckets have been around a long time, and they hold more secrets than people realize. You'll need to find an old one.
I'm looking for records about coma-roamers in the Holocropolis.
And even if they can't help you with your bizarre requests, they can help you talk though your obvious mental and emotional issues.

dialogues.title: Coffee for Marcelle
lines: I wouldn't sully my palette with something so lurid.
And so it was. Did you expect me to lie to my readers? Head Tomatoes is a respected column.
Well, if it isn't my old friend.
You do, hmm? Then what is it?
Thank you for the review. It helped business. I think.
Oh, you can be assured I will.
Indeed! My own invention. The warmth of the milk brings out the piquancy in the cheese, whilst the coolness of the ice refreshes the palate beautifully.
No, you have enough Lims to bribe your way to success I’m sure. What is it that you want?
Once again you show what little imagination you have. Good day.
Ough, far too harsh on the stomach!
You earned it. All I want is to share such genuine feeling with the world.

dialogues.title: Thank You
lines: On second thought, I can't leave my businesses.
First mate! A ship needs a few things: sails, a rudder, and a captain. And a captain, one worth his salt, needs a dependable first mate.
I can't leave till they open the ports again.
I'm actually not really into sailing.
What a glorious piece of writing that was! I'm having streamers reach out to me. Streamers! Before this, the only kinda streamers I knew of were ones we threw overboard after looting a booze cruise.
Well, I shall leave you with this because I'm an admirable Captain who sticks to his word. Until next time ye landlubber!
Ahhhh! Life on the Gridless Sea. One devoid of material gains... besides TREASURE! The reward for back-breaking-skin-callousing-hard work.
My future first mate! What fortunes have you come to bring me now?
Oh, well, that's a doldrum conundrum I'd say. The sea ain't for everyone, that's sure as the tides.
On second thought, I can't leave my lover.
Aye! Now, what do you say? Leave the land for a life at sea? Join me crew?

dialogues.title: Calhoun at the book fair
lines: What a surprise to see you here.
I recommend you haggle with these people. They don't expect you to pay full price.
What, am I not allowed to enjoy an odd illegal activity from time to time!?
I'm not buying. Not from you. Goodbye.
This is neither the right place nor time to ask me for money.
Are you here for books or for money?

dialogues.title: Ava comments
lines: I think so. Let's keep an eye on him.

dialogues.title: Salt Pete and the Truth
lines: I got all the pieces, but Crabface said the real Captain was lost. It was junk.
Out on one of those voyages, I saw something that changed my view of not just The Gridless Sea, but all of Nivalis.

We was bickering as usual. Captain was trying to get us to pull together in the middle of a storm. But we was all obsessed. Looking for The Gridless Sea. She went in the drink, and we all blamed each other. And ourselves.

Ah, don't fret. I suspected as much. Old Crabface can barely catch a virus, far less dredge up a lost sea captain. I suspected he was trying to give us some peace of mind. He's a rusty old bastard, but I get it.
Ah, that's a secret that best dies with me. I wish I didn't learn the truth. If I hadn't been so obsessed with The Gridless Sea, maybe I'd still have a Captain... and good friends.
We all dream of something like that.

Aye. I never said they was the brightest sparks in the sea, you know? They had some mad theory - that The Gridless Sea is infinite, and the world is made up of little boxes or something? They talked some real nonsense during those long ocean voyages.
Hey Mariner, you don't look too cheery. And I don't see the Captain.
He did, did he? And the Captain?
That's what we was all arguing about. Caleb thought it was a way out of Nivalis, to a better place. A current that swept you out to a new land. A better place for all of us.
The Captain and Karel both believed the same thing. That The Gridless Sea goes on forever. That we could sail over the horizon and keep going forever - cos this world is flat.

dialogues.title: Teleshko wrap up
lines: I, ahem, this tangent is an unproductive use of time. I suggest you concentrate on finding new LICCYs.
Now, it is up to you to find businesses that will increase capital through commerce. Approach the owners, do what you must. Choose carefully.
Maximize your existing venues. Do what you must to obtain another license. Locate available venues. Choose carefully. I'll be watching.
It's rare that someone proves me wrong. The sensation is not entirely unpleasant.
Yes. An unfortunate waft of charity about you. Never mind, if you continue to increase capital through commerce it will subside.
You see - despite appearances, general odor and reputation - seem to have grasped the concept of LICCs.

dialogues.title: Salt Pete talks about the treasure
lines: HOVA's are linked to The Grid. Sure, they can fly off Grid, but they can't draw power, and with the lack of clean water down here, they got no fuel. And of course CorpSec are likely to fine ya if you're down here.
Fancier? Look, The Putter might not win any prizes for her looks, but she's designed with arcane tech so advanced, no one alive really knows how it works any more. She's a technological marvel.
I don't know what to do with it.
Yes, if you want to call it that. I'll be in touch. Away with ya.

Finding Lost Tech on unreachable shores, dredging the depths for ancient CPU cores, smuggling goods into the sub-Spire warrens, finding the very rarest fishing grounds - the limit is your imagination!
Now as regards what you can do with her...

Haha, absolutely not. She's not sellable. Contaminated, rotten, and registered with the Sailing Guild as a protected relic. No, you can't sell her. But that's not to say she won't lead you to a fortune.
The ocean swells with promise and adventure young Mariner! Only the lucky few are destined to heed the call. A pelagic wonder world awaits.
Hey, you didn't sink. I'm not surprised about that at all. What did you think of the boat?
And I got something a little spicier for ya. I mentioned I had a task in mind... Well me and my EX shipmates lost some... cargo. I'm going to need your help finding it.
A boat gets you places other transport can't go in Nivalis.

That's just the start of it. Ferro fibrous balance cores to keep her stable, micro-detergent cores in the rudder to resist acidic bacterial colonies, two-way myomers in the mast to survive storms up to intensity level 8. She's not a sailboat, she's a battleship.
But what can I DO with it?
I was being poetic. But I reckon when Nivalis finally topples into the sea, she'll be all that's left.

The Putter draws power from The Firmament - an archaic energy field that predates The Grid. She also automatically processes Grade 8 water to for a backup uranium power cell. That's water so dirty you can slice it.

We'll make a sailor of yea yet! Indeed. HOVA's are linked to The Grid. Sure, they can fly off Grid, but they can't draw power, and with the lack of clean water down here, they got no fuel. And of course CorpSec are likely to fine ya if you're down here.
I'll send some information to your Automata. Just let me find the old map.
Well.. I do have a task in mind. Something that could benefit BOTH of us greatly. But first... what did you think of The Putter?
You might wonder why such transport exists in a city with HOVA's, Vinculum Ascenders and supersonic locomotives.

dialogues.title: Complex ending
lines: I hope we learn the truth.

Those memories were no longer inside me, but they were close by, close enough to touch. And that kept me going... far longer than it should have. I always treated my friends well, as I hope I did with you too.
So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?
No. He sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.
No. But he sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.
They won't be affected by Thaddeus's death, but... they won't lose the memories either. And they won't be able to reveal any of his secrets, even now.
I'm quite relieved. He's finally gone?
They say when you hear your name in a dream, you wake up. Is your name Thaddeus?
The message origin is clear. It came from Sang-Ha. I believe he was there all along.
Do you think he treated you well?
If you're getting this message, it means the process failed. I guess it was my time. Damn, I feel tired though. I just wanted to clear up some things before I shuffle off stage.

You might have put two and two together by now, and came out with infinity. Turns out, that answer is correct. I'm more than one person, more than a few. I passed memories - pieces of myself - on to Banor, Huckstash, Gunger and more.

You uncovered more about my true nature than anyone else has for a thousand years. In any other epoch, I would have had you killed to protect those secrets. Now though, all I want is to scream them out loud for the world to hear.
Just one more thing kid. I.... No. No, you don't need to know all that. Nivalis is a wild ride. I hope you enjoy your trip. See you on the next turning. You know... at one time, I was everywhere...

None of them could tell you the truth, because my influence prevented it. Part of the condition of taking my memories, and a part of my personality, is that they cannot reveal the truth, even if they wanted to.

dialogues.title: Banor further revelations
lines: The other city? What was he doing there?
He sent me a message. Said I could trust you. Somewhat. There ain't much I can tell you, but what I know I'm happy to share.
Well boss, looks like Thaddeus might really be going through with it. That's what you're coming to talk to me about, right?
In his head? All around the universe. In reality? Probably Sang Ha. Everything he needed was there.
I can't say any more. But it doesn't matter. He's going to tell you himself soon. one way or another, the experiment is almost over. Good luck boss.

Looking for the other Doctor. Or part of himself that can still remember the other Doctor. Thaddeus's mind is failing. Filling. Now Egress has broken down, he needs another transmitter, and a fresh consciousness to fill with memories.
He tried to keep his mind working by trimming it down, but eventually the process stopped working. He went to Sang Ha to find help.

dialogues.title: Tell Eldridge the Truth
lines: Well, it took a while, but I discovered the truth.
My... how can you be so cruel to me in my suffering? Knowing I have no choice? Fine! You leech! You vampire! Just help me!
EVERYONE is not Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona! Everyone is not the laughing stock of the Spire! That's it, I'm finished, I'm going to lay down and DIE.
Well, I don't care for the way you're stating it. Tell me now and tell me extra quickly: was there anything else?
Trust me, you need to know.
It's you. You've returned to witness my suffering. Tell me, what is the world saying about the tragedy of Eldridge Uchuu?
You're lucky your aunt doesn't know...
That's right. Who is anyone to question my taste? I'm a Curzona!
No... take it back, tell me that you're lying...
Don't tell me, I can't bear to hear it!
Oh then tell me if you must! Nothing can be worse than the torment of exile!
I knew it! The bacon burps were a sign! Oh, how could I have done such a thing?
A kid called Razlo got it on camera and is going to use it to blackmail you.
You think so? You don't think it was horribly passe?
Ha ha! Not charge. You are funny. But tell me honestly: was there anything else?
I couldn't... I didn't... but now you mention it, I do remember feeling a strange desire to share things with the less fortunate. Damn Bo Bo's snuff!
Looks like it. You promised a reward for the info?
I don't think libraries are meant to charge money...
Ohh, my life is over. I'm finished. How can I bear it? I'm going to lay down here and DIE.
Yes... it could be a way to make money from my vast fashion holo collection!
HOW can it get worse? What did I do, wear red? Make a pun? Join a grassroots community action campaign?
That Razlo is a greedy upstart. A snake. He'll want something, trust me.
If you like it, that's what matters.
Nice to do business with you!
It really is the height of bad taste.
I can't. It's the awful truth.
THAT is a first edition of Pomp & Frippery! More than you deserve! Now leave me drown my sorrows in beautiful degradation. I never want to see you again!
You tried to start a library.
It's only a big deal if you make it one.
Ohh. Please, was there anything else?
How can you be so cruel? Here, take this fashion holo and get out of my pitiful sight!
I dunno, it sounds quite good.
Razlo... Razlo... the little snitch who failed Attitudinizing? How dare he! Oh if Aunt Mary sees those pictures I'll be excommunicated... you MUST get them for me!
I can see it now, The Eldridge Uchuu Education Centre.
Tell me. Was there anything else?
I want your apartment in the Spire.
You don't understand anything! Tell me no one captured it?
I think it's a good idea.
You forgot to turn your sweat inhibitor on.

dialogues.title: We sabotaged Pilk's property
lines: Hey, you didn't trash those apartments yet did you?
Phew, good that I didn't do it yet.
Good. Right, good, thank CORA. It's just... I got some enemies, and they warned me that if I go after them, they'll ALL come after me. Big time.
So just... hold off alright. And keep your head down. I gotta think about my career plans. This has really made me doubt the wisdom of land... lording.
Ava, what message did you send to him?
Maybe a little... But at least he's off our back.
No. That needs more time for planning!
Huh? Oh, I... am gonna leave you to do your own thing for a while. Just keep outta my hair, okay? Now I gotta go. I can't be seen around this part of town right now.
I said the rival landlords had joined forces and arranged to trash his properties, and next time they saw him, they'd redecorate the walls with his blood.

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: See that's exactly it, nobody knows. I have asked scores of people and nobody ever thought to ask! I have a theory though.
I think the black and white squares on the board represent the binary zeros and ones that make it up. I wonder if Chess was the very first computer program.
I thought some bored droid invented it.
And you don't know the name I choose. Let's keep it that way.
I'd never really thought about it.
You saved my life and I owe you. I haven't forgotten.
Do you think it could ever work in the physical world?
I'll try. Did you know we have no idea where the game of Chess comes from?

dialogues.title: Learn about Restaurant Managers
lines: You can add one more worker and new recipes.
And I have the time off?
How about more free time for you?
You can now hire a manager. They take care of everyday matters: grocery shopping and keeping the staff motivated.
Congrats! Your venue reached the third level.
Not quite. You are still responsible for larger purchases such as equipment and furniture!

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 27
lines: I like to watch you sleep... Only joking! That would be creepy.

dialogues.title: Tell Huckstash about Hep
lines: She's just an old woman who doesn't remember anything.
Knew you'd do the right thing, kid.
Agent Gimble was the most bloodthirsty erasure technician ever lived. Killed thousands. So. Where is she?
Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?
I have all the information I need.
My informant looked like he wanted you to kill her.
She was the most bloodthirsty erasure technician ever lived. Killed thousands. You're damn right she should answer. So. Where is she?
Hmm. Just when I think I got you figured.
I might. I might also hope you'd just fucking tell me.
I have some information you want.
He said you might pay good money to know where she is...
Don’t listen to me, kid. I've been on the Joos. It's the LUZ, its getting to me. Like my skin’s too tight for my bones.
I’m the ferryman. Cross my palm with Lims and I’ll take you to the other side.
If this is the underworld, then what are you?
I will warn her to not tell naive kids about her past.
You just do what Thaddeus' tells you?
Fucking oogle. You've got no idea what you're talking about. Get out of here.
You little worm. You've got no idea who you're talking to. Get out of my sight.
She's still needed. Ask Thaddeus about it - if he lets you. His words were always "She's still needed."
A lost city. The one we can’t go back to.
I got answers. Maybe not the ones you want…
Where the fuck did you get that name?
So. You found your way back to the underworld.
I think you should leave her alone. Let it go.
Elias said she killed people. She should answer for that.

dialogues.title: Congratulations
lines: Well I'll be lying on a gurney with my legs hacked off. Did NOT see that one coming. Congratulations and good luck.
Oh! The next player will ping your Automata once I or whoever registers your win. Just note you might experience an advertisement or two but hey, when do you not, right? Good luck!

dialogues.title: Razlo's Deal
lines: So, you're back. Took you longer than I thought. Are you always so slow?
Just some files of academic interest.
I told you before. They come at a cost.
Then it seems Mr Nyx-Curzona belongs to me. We're going to be such good friends over the years. I can tell.
It seems to be full of long academic papers on data sub-layers… but it's possible they are a smokescreen for something else.
Take them, and thank Eldridge for me. I simply couldn't have done this without him.
How much? I'm sure Eldridge will pay.
Ava, do you know what he’s talking about?
I’ve made my offer. I suggest you take it. The server is called Hybris1.
Yes... I have it. Shall I transmit it to Razlo?
Calm down, I performed a few non-invasive scans, that's all. Would I be right in thinking she has access to the Old Network?
She’s sending it to you now.
I need the ID code for a particular server there. If your Ava can get it for me, then I'll give you the photos.
Give me the photos of Eldridge.
OK, can you get the code?
I changed my mind. I'm not giving you anything.
Now now, that's no way to do business.
