But you can get the code?
Oh, this is too good. You have no idea what you've given me, do you? And all for a few silly photos.
No. There is so much data there… without knowing what I was looking for, it might take months. Even years.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 23
lines: Good morning, I *yawn*. I'm sorry. I was up all night defragging my memory units.

dialogues.title: City Tour
lines: Look out for landing HOVA taxis and a nearby short wave transmitter beacon on your compass.
The LUZ prevents anyone without significant justification from entering or leaving this city district.
However, many thrill seekers and entrepreneurs have flooded into the area too. Hopefully it keeps the killer penned in with us!
As you know, there is a serial killer - the Aseptic - still on the loose. So the Localized Unity Zone was officially acknowledged by CorpSec at 5am today.
This is Lowtown. It's not normally this busy, but the Localized Unity Zone, "The LUZ" is currently in effect.
I was passed information to help me act as your companion. I shall give you a brief tour. Don't worry, it will be fun!

dialogues.title: Reena at the Club
lines: It might be daylight but if I close my eyes I can still see the neon.
Happens to the best of us.
I'm more of a night person.
Morning is the spotlight of existence.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Drone 3
lines: This is not a laughing matter. You were seen...
Is there anything I can do to make this go away?
You are attempting to bribe me.
I was wondering when you'd call.
Hmm. A disobedience fine of 30 Lims has been deducted from your account.
It has been noted. Nevertheless, a disobedience fine of 30 Lims has been deducted from your account.
You have been engaging in criminal activity.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 4
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
When life hands you lemons, make sure you have the correct citrus permits. Unlicensed fruit ownership destroys lives.

dialogues.title: Last fragments
lines: But he was excited. He asked to come and speak to me about it but hasn't yet. Whatever it is might still be in his shop.
*sigh* Maybe you’re right. Maybe I have been staring at this thing too long. It gets into your brain. Like a parasite or something.
Well, I heard that before he died, he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.
Anyway, I heard that he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.
Me? Of course, I’m just an academic. What kind of trouble could I get into?
Well, I heard that he found something in the guts of a droid he was disassembling for parts. Something the person had swallowed.
I don’t know exactly! Haha! It’s so difficult, and my pictorial Nivali was never very good… but so far I've got a series of images:
This could be it, this could be what I need. Look, there: that’s a skull isn't it? A mind? A face? And the circle. A mirror! CORA-be-thanked...
I can worry about myself, thanks. So will you give me the fragments? I know you have it.
Look. I’m fine. I know what I’m doing. So do you have the fragments or not?
So why haven't you looked for it?
Old man uses crane to fish?
... you'll still be an unknown historian!
Did you find any more fragments? Have you brought them?
I don’t know. But whatever it was, he was excited. He asked to come and speak to me about it, but was killed before he could. Whatever it is might still be in his shop.
What? Why are you lying to me? You want them for yourself!
You’re right. I should get some sleep. Thanks, I guess.
I'd throw it in the sea.
You're worse than CorpSec. Next time you want answers, go find someone else. We're done.
I think you should take a break from this for a while...
Throw it in the...?! This is a priceless artefact! The key to another world! I thought you understood.
Old man, two parallel lines and a long-necked bird, like a heron or an egret? And a fish? I think?
Nope, no idea what that means.
This thing has power over you...
I can’t take a break! Not now. Don’t you understand? If I translate even a fraction of the Enchiridion...
He's a technician, has a shop in Industrial.
Because it’s all I can offer in payment. Finding these pieces… I can’t express what it means. Thank you. I hope you find what you’re looking for.
I understand that it's something you shouldn't be messing with.
Because if someone swallowed it, they wanted to hide it. Which means it's probably illegal. I have enough problems with CorpSec as it is.
A cognitive test for dementia: Man, heron, fish ...
Fine. You know Quince Crogan, the Gut Broker?
You know I've deciphered some of the Enchiridion’s instructions?
I’m fine, I’m fine, I just haven’t slept. Every time I close my eyes I see the patterns.
Fine, fine. You know the Gut Broker, Crogan? The one who was murdered?
No, I’ll be able to access the most powerful repository of knowledge about the city that’s ever existed!
No. I think you're getting too obsessed.
"Wisdom is the path to… fish? Old man loves birds?" I don’t know but I’m close, I can feel it. And if you have any more…

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 3
lines: I have a plan though. I still have a friend in the Crusty Punks. Could be a way to get off-grid for a bit, ride suicide one last time before I take the last wind. Just gotta hope old Huckstash isn't as mad as they say.
I'm so sorry, no results I'm afraid.
This audio-log could be promising, would you like me to patch it through?
I'm very glad to hear that! In light of this, I have taken the liberty of searching for the phrase 'Crusty Punk' Would you like the information?

I've been doing this a long time now. The mountain just seems to get taller. With all this Aseptic stuff happening, I just feel like I'm going to be high up on his list. Some people are saying he's only going after debt-orphans and you don't get much more debt-orphaned than me.
Anyway, my love, maybe I'll catch you when they lift the Unity Zone restrictions, but maybe I wont.
This feels sad. Would you like me to give you space?

After sifting through some... Questionable sexual content... I found reference to a now defunct rail gang called the Crusty Punks in a blog from someone called McFellow. Seems to be some kind of rail transport expert.
Could you sum this up in a sentence.
It's quite sad really. The victim was about to run away with some kind of group called the Crusty Punks. Mentioned someone there called Huckstash.

dialogues.title: Miso Player Lost
lines: I mean, I'd wish you better luck next time but I think it's pretty unlikely you'll be coming back for any more of that humiliation. Stick to the cooking kid.

dialogues.title: Ava reacts to the Train Timetable
lines: I cannot detect Ms Al-Zahiri's digital presence anywhere in the LUZ. Logically it follows that she must be outside the LUZ.
Antique? Nellie's not that old, is she?
Perhaps. Perhaps not. Since she took the fragments with her, I don't suppose we'll ever know.
I did it! I deciphered enough of the Enchiridion's code to get it working again.
I guess that's a question she would have to answer.
This is an antique voice recording. I believe it is from Ms Al-Zahiri. Shall I play it?
Once I hit this button I... don't know what will happen. But I have to try. I have to see what's on the other side. Wish me lu--

dialogues.title: Talk to Raluca 3
lines: As it is, I managed to collect a little for the boy. 200 Lims. It won't go far, but you should take it.
You haven't come to see me about the campaign. Don't you think that's weird?
Yeah, and if I'd had more time I could have used my experience with this awful thing to help you.
Yes? Sorry, did I do something?
So you do remember my name.

dialogues.title: Sister Sister Sister
lines: Ah, well, as much as I like money that would be an issue for our commerce division.
Hmmm, favors, defined as free labor. I think I'll choose to decline.
So what's it going to take?
Division of Commerce and Monetary Gain. You'll have to talk to them.
Human resources serves many functions. Which can I assist you with?
I need you to reopen the Oil Rig shipping routes.
You came to me with a request, I'm directing you to the appropriate people who can give you a response. That's business.
Your brother said he worked in maintenance.
It's not? Hmm, I tend to think it is here at Sea2Sea.
I don't know who that is.
You'll have to speak to our commerce division. It's an issue for them to contend with.
Ah, just speak with my brother. He's the head of that division.
Your brother told me to talk to you.
Fine. Where do I find them?
Did he? I'll make sure to follow-up with him. Anything else?
I can't imagine this being true. We are not rude. We have clear processes. And if you don't follow them, we'll cut you out of our business.

dialogues.title: Salma is done
lines: And I told you that I couldn't take it again. But you didn't listen. So I’m done listening to you.
I have nothing to say to you.

dialogues.title: Kenzy at the Club
lines: I love this song!!! Come on!
Ahhh! And I love you! Like more than I love this bass line. And I love this bass line a lot. Come on! Let's dance babe!
Yeah, yeah, yeah, just shut up and dance! We're here and alive and living by the pulse of this music!! I fucking love you for it!

dialogues.title: Ava comments
lines: Writing the instruction now... there. All you need to do is insert the chip into the terminal. Good luck.
Do I really have a choice?
Well, it seems to me you have an interesting choice before you.
You would do that for me?
She doesn't seem to be the word keeping type. Drop Dagmar's rating.
Raising her rating might help you in the long run, but we have no guarantee she'll keep her word.
Boost Dagmar's rating. We're in this to win.
Dropping Dagmar's hygiene rating would surely give you the edge over her. But it risks her taking revenge.
I could rig the chip with instructions to boost Dagmar's score, as she requested. Or I could rig it to drop her score significantly.
I have the location for the CorpSec Terminal Dagmar mentioned. And...

dialogues.title: Ava is stuck
lines: I have an update. Gan Coilson's records at LifeCorp are ranked level 8 confidentiality. It will take me a while to access them.
Can we find someone else to help?
Thaddeus would occasionally unlock my advanced data intrusion subroutines. He's gone, but Banor might know about them.
Their security is outdated but still comprehensive.

dialogues.title: Meet Bonaventure and discuss his life
lines: Not going so well at the moment?
Sounds like he lied to you.
Sounds like you're still liking this place?
I know. Every year I tell myself it will be the last. Every morning I say "just another day". I’ve said it 10957 times.
No. I can see that. But Lims can't buy love. Remember that.
I have a boat. I'll go and look for you.
He had a tracker in his arm, said his bosses would set it off if he didn’t go back. But he swore he’d return. He'd buy a boat he'd been saving for, the Annabel Lee.
Oh, I am. I love commerce. Live and breathe it, gotta chase those Lims right?
We met one night among the neon-shine of the Docks and I fell for him faster than an anchor thrown into the deep.
If his ship went down in a storm, there might be a trace of it still. Under the waves.
I’m doing my best. Truth be told, I never thought I'd be here this long. It was supposed to be a temporary arrangement.
He said it would take him two years to make it there and back. Then we would leave to sail the world together.
Two weeks we had. The two brightest weeks of my life. But then he had to make the return voyage.
Do you know how to reach Sang-Ha? Even if I did find some relay, he might be anywhere by now. But there’s one thing I've been meaning to try...
I don't have time to hang around discussing romance.
You sure you're enthusiastic about the business?
Some days I hope so. Because then he might still be alive out there somewhere.
I told myself he’d know better than to sail into it. But…
Doesn't make it less hurtful for those in the story.
Doesn’t look like you’re catching very many.
Around the time he was supposed to return, there was a storm. One of the worst Nivalis has ever seen.
I'm long past luck, friend. But thank you all the same.
Sounds like something happened to him.
But I’ve never been able to look. Barely able to set foot on the Docks, to be honest. Reminds me of him too much.
No one's worth waiting that long for.
Thank you. All I have to give is my business license, but you'd be welcome to that.
Thirty years ago I fell in love with a man from across the sea. A merchant sailing in from Sang-Ha.
Well, what can I do for you?
Heard that kind of story a thousand times ...
I keep it running if that’s what you mean. Fill the fridge, set out the chairs, keep the lights on, make sure no one floods the joint.
Sorry, I really don't have time for this.
How long have you been here?
Couldn't you try to contact him?
So, I took on the license for this place. And I've been waiting ever since.
Afraid I can't help. But good luck to you.
He still tried to get to you?
Yes. Somewhere in the ocean around the Rigs. That’s where the storm hit hardest. If I knew for certain he was never coming I might be able to leave.
Doesn't it take forever to get to Sang-Ha?

dialogues.title: You Got One
lines: Well now, how is it out there amongst the waves? Have you caught any fish yet or will you be forced to starve?
Where should I fish for them?
Ah, who really knows what is going on with the Localized Unity Zone. On the one hand, I feel more unified... unified against CorpSec. Ha!
Well.. CorpSec unified against us. Like they have an extra pair of eyes on this part of town.
Now, IF I told you that, how would you prove your skills? Finding them is only half the challenge. Good luck!
You must meet the quota. Find the fish. Catch the fish. Put the fish in the market.
What do you think about the LUZ?
Can you be a bit more SPECIFIC?
Ok, I tell you what- a market order just came through last night for a pair of burbot, stickleback, and 3 pike... Catch them, bring them back, and we will get you into that market.
Many ways, but the quickest? Get yourself into the underground fish market.
Perhaps something small and achievable so you don't wander into turbulent waters haunted by only the mooring ghosts.
Sail the Gridless Sea and stand on the land's edge. Learn the waters, know the waters, and bring the fish from them.
Right... How do I get in?
And how do I make money fishing?
Ah, it appears you do. Congratulations! You are on your way to being the greatest fisherman in the LUZ.
Of course. Be sure to let me know if you wanna make some extra Lims with that skill of yours.
The underground fish market is a thing and a thing does what a thing does and is what a thing is.

dialogues.title: Ava talks about Teleshko's demands
lines: Let me search my records. Perhaps there are digital ownership receipts for your establishments. I will get back to you.
We should try to find that document. Agent Teleshko is not lying. He has the authority to close your business.

dialogues.title: Clem Questions
lines: No, they... were caught in a Big Chill. I only survived because I was making a delivery up here. If it wasn't for Thaddeus, I would have starved.
Unless you want to make a profit.
How do I upgrade my greenhouse?
Not everything is about profit, hotshot. But come back and talk to me again some time. I might have something for you.
Do you know where he went?
He gave me my first packet of onion seeds. Carminus Reds. The same ones I gave you.
Yeah, humidity, temperature and light. You can set them via the module in the greenhouse. Different crops have different needs, but your settings apply to the whole place.
De nada. Come back and talk to me again some time. I might have something for you.
Hey! How are your first onions?
I've been doing it my whole life. My family were algae farmers in the Ventz. Once you can grow crustgrass at negative five in a steam geyser, you can grow most things.
Ha, you sound like a street racer with a HOVA. You can buy new modules for different crops. Or upgrade the ones you have for faster growing and better yields. But that costs Lims.
No. But he'd be glad to know you're looking after things. Anyway, come back and talk to me again some time. I might have something for you.
There are hardware vendors all over the LUZ, and a few right here in the Docks. But why rush? No harm in growing slow.
You know a lot about gardening.
Sure feels nice to harvest your own.
They'll take a little while to grow. You should try to stop by the greenhouse every day to plant and harvest crops. And check the parameters.

dialogues.title: Saban talks life goals
lines: What keeps you going? We make a choice every single day, without thinking about it for even a moment, that we will continue with all of this. What's your reason?
I don't know why I keep going.
That's great for you. This place has never felt like my home. Not for a single moment.
It was a nice talk, but I want to explore the coves. There's a nice walk near the sewage outlets. I'll see you later.
Spoken like a true Corpster. I'm happy for you. And your opportunities.
I love to explore this city! What a place. When you wonder around with nowhere in particular to go, you really could be fooled into thinking this is a good place to live.

Of course. Privacy is important. Nowhere feels as lonely, or beautiful, as the Docks. You really get a unique view of this city from here. Looking up at the belly of the beast. Almost seems like a good place to live.
It's good we aren't close. You shouldn't lie to your friends.
Hello there. Funny seeing you in the docks. The salty smell of the water really brings you back to reality. What brings you down here?
You'll figure it out. Or you won't. Hey, either way, it will be OK, you know? In the end it will all be fine. Totally fine.
Hey chin up. There's plenty to do in this place before we're all finished. Nivalis may be burning, but we can dance in the flames before they burn us all.
I do everything I'm supposed to. I work. I spend time with them. I kiss my wife and I read my kid stories at bedtime. I listen to them talk about their day.
There's a lot of opportunity here.

dialogues.title: Samuel Starts Leaking
lines:
Here we are again... 

*giggle*
FIRE... FIRE... IT'S ALL FIRE.
*laugh*
He seems to be malfunctioning. His FERB score is going haywire.
This is why they're shutting down the old network I guess.
Let's leave him. They may be bad voices, but they're his bad voices.

*Argh*

Hold on... wait... I'm... where am I?
Perhaps you're beginning to hear the voices...
Seems like some of the old AIs are leaking.
It's all rather simple binary. I could sever it?!
Did they say anything about serial murder?
Nothing. I must have misheard you.
I think you are having some kind of malfunction.
Today the voices are more distant. They arrive on the wind and leave on the breeze.
Are you hearing this from the voices?
Thing is, he seems pretty attached to the voices, its become his religion. If I block it, it might kill them for good.
We can't allow him to keep walking the streets like this, he could be dangerous. Sever the connection.
Yes... voices... so many voices... I was one of them.
I was... there were voices... so many voices... I was one of them.
Oh thank the gods... I went to some back street eye doctor my friend recommended. I've been in a half dream since.
Right... I must go. I had a pet lizard. He's probably long dead by now.
*Argh* I beg your pardon? What was what?

Many people find me slightly strange- 

*ugh* 
KILL TIME 
KILL TIME 
KILL TIME... 
*giggle*
You'll know this when you hear them, but sometimes when they speak, the voices comfort me in the way only a mother could. - *ugh* DROWN THE WEAK IN PIGS BLOOD! *laugh*
The thing you just said about the fire?

*Argh*

THE FIRE SHALL BURN THE EDGES AND THE MIDDLE. THE FOUNDATIONS WILL CRUMBLE.

*laugh*
No... god no... that would have at least been interesting. It was all just... train schedules, advertisements and recipes.
Ok I'm picking up a strange signal being fed into some of his implants.
You think he might miss the voices?

You look like you've seen a ghost - *ugh* 

THE STREETS WILL BECOME YOU. *laugh*

dialogues.title: Harper's Brother 2 nohelp
lines: I need a beer. I can't face this sober...
I'm not. I need a drink. My sister... What am I gonna do without her? Damn...
By CorpSec. She was acting really paranoid. Talked about some high level tax evasion stuff. I should have listened to her. I just dismissed it all. Didn't understand a word.
Wanted to be special. And she was. More special than any Danetti has ever been... Damn. What am I gonna do?
Called herself Harper. Harper Osiris. We had different fathers, but the same mom. She never did like being a Danetti, so she took her dad's name.

dialogues.title: Gunger knows the streets
lines: I'm not that connected. I just talk a bit. And listen more. What do you want to know?
My friend Petar is currently producing hats with "I survived the Aseptic" printed on them. For after the murderer is found.
More unity, right? Anyway, I gotta go. My friend Marv needs some help at his stall selling knock off performance enhancing augments. See ya later!
My friend Petar is already selling hats with "I survived the Aseptic" printed on them.
Do you think the Comms will come back online?
I think it's all pretty funny. When you're one of a small group at risk of being stabbed every day, it's kinda nice when that group increases to include everyone.
"News from the street?" What am I, "The Daily Hobo?"
What do you know about the killer?
What do you think about the LUZ?
Street vendors sell maps showing the locations of all the killings. The trendiest cocktail on Seaside Boardwalk right now is "The A-sip-tic". What color do you think it is?
No. You hear about neural augment logic viruses, skin-stealing androids, radioactive cola drinks and, yes, serial killers.
Exactly! They're all as real as freezing to death on the streets or getting trampled during a rent stampede, but far less likely to happen. And far more, (forgive the word), "glamorous".
You have no idea. You know what's dangerous in Nivalis? HOVA accidents. You hear a lot of chatter about HOVA accidents?
"The Spectrum Strangler." "The Ripper." "Doctor Defenestrater". I guess the idea of a great serial killer name is out the window.
I dunno. I don't even know why they're OFFLINE. I mean we can still access The Nets. We just can't call anyone. Apparently it's related to the Localized Unity Zone.
All because of this serial killer. You can't deny it, a serial killer on the streets really gets the blood pumping. Sometimes literally.
What else do you have to do but gossip?
The Aseptic? I mean, that's a pretty weak name for a serial killer if you ask me. I miss some of the classics.
Are you worried about the serial killer rumors?
I look relaxed do I? I don't feel very relaxed. But you people—and by "you people" I mean everyone—you don't understand risk.
The Localized Unity Zone. Call it by the proper name. Can't you see all this unity all around us?
BLOOD red. The cocktail umbrella has a little knife at the end so you can stabby stab the heart-shaped boba floating on top.
We're all in danger. All the time. From a serial killer though? Nah.

dialogues.title: Player Lost
lines: Haha, I have never played chess before in my liiife! You must be really bad, friend. Or I must be a golden god...
You mean, I... won? Like, really won?

dialogues.title: Deeala asked to help Pilk Dane
lines: Damn... If you think that's for the best. I can try. I guess I'll... let you know how it goes. CORA knows how I'm gonna pull this off... Wish me luck.
Lessons learned Deeala. Trust NO ONE. Well... fuck you very much. See you around! Or hopefully not...
Ok, so Pilk is insecure. Fantastically, tragically insecure. So put him on his back foot. Don't spend too much time on defense.
He's a comedian. You think I can beat him in a roast?
Good for you. You'll do great. Good luck!
His defining trait is fragility. Remember this. He really DOES think he's funny. He thinks he's the only one brave enough to say what he thinks out loud.
And he's a creepy weirdo. Confront him with that, and he'll crumble.
Look, I'm only friends with people who can keep up with me. You're sharp and funny. You can do this!
Love your confidence honey. I'm not sure I feel that way about you... But you ARE sweet. Sometimes... Let's see how you do with Pilk, then we'll talk.
I'm not kidding. I want the money.
I'm still not sure. I think it's better you try to roast him.
You really fucked this up, you know? I'll deal with my landlord myself. I.. thought I was falling for you. Deep down, I'm still such a sucker for losers.
Damn, good for you! I wasn't sure you had it in you. Look, I can give you some advice. If you want it. I know how to beat him in a roast.
You've got my head spinning here. What the fuck do you want? Really?
I mean what's the alternative? I teach HIM how to roast people? It's very likely I piss him off so bad he throws me out on the street.
And he's not funny at all. Confront him with that, and he'll crumble.
Sure thing Darlin'. That seems fair.
I'd like to help, but are you sure this is a good idea?
No wait. I changed my mind. Forget I said that.
Wait, really? You're telling me you strung me along this far and now you want... what? Money? You've got to be fucking kidding me!
Yes! Exactly. He somehow thinks he's an everyman, and at the same time, a comic genius! To beat him, you have to show him that he's neither.
I don't think I need advice.

dialogues.title: Ashwin has a third proposal
lines: He never seems to run out of ideas.
We can give him another chance.
Another proposal by Ashwin... He is looking for you.

dialogues.title: Mala Fourth Metting
lines: I'm normal thank you very much! Look around you, this place is built on business. I'm the most normal person in this conversation.
Yes I would! Not all adults are dismissive of children.
I wanted to learn without begging. You'd never have spoken to a grubby looking street-urchin.
Can I ask you some questions this time?
Why do you think? I'm not going to go down the same path as my parents. I will not be another wasted statistic at the bottom of a Thera-pay bot's internal memory. I have to do more.
Well their best wasn't good enough. Dad joined a train gang and mom slowly went mad on whatever Ma Gomba produce she could get her hands on.
Why are you never in school?
I'm... it's the school... I have... Can we please get back to the interview questions?
I'd need at least a thousand Lims to get started.
Put you into an interview situation, could be good practice.
What do you mean? The money for school? Really? Oh my...
So why all this? I don't understand.
What? I mean? ... Fine! I'm not in a traditional school. Is that what you wanted to hear?
Get to what? I'm in a rush.
Why do you want to work in business?
Look around, how else could someone succeed here?
Look it's fine, just tell me the truth.
What do you mean? I am in school.
It's ok if you're not in school Mala, most kids can't afford school in this district...
You've been lying this entire time you little street rat!
I can't... It's just... Thank you.
Yeah. Look, I can just keep doing this, I'll work it out eventually. Thank you for your help anyway.
I'm hearing positive word on the Syntheti-grape vine that your business is on the up and up. Surprising.
I already did a short-course on interview technique when I was six, guess it can't hurt to brush up on it.
Fine, if you're not going to be transparent I'm leaving...
There are plenty of happy people who don't own businesses.
Enough with the gum flapping, we should get to it.
Fine! Look my parents never had the wherewithal to plan further than their own noses with regards to me and education.
Why do you have no interest in being a normal kid?
So why all this business stuff?
I'm sure they tried their best.
So here I am. Wandering the streets, trying to scrape together an education from the bottom of people's shoes.
You can pay me back when you become a titan of industry.
Indeed. Dad joined a train gang and mom slowly went mad on whatever Ma Gomba produce she could get her hands on.
Well regardless, this is where I am. Wandering the streets, trying to scrape together an education from the bottom of people's shoes.
If you knew how much father paid for my schooling, you'd realize how important this is.

dialogues.title: Ashwin plays tough
lines: Oh, wow! I didn't think so...
Good. Make sure it stays that way.
Are you perhaps distracted? By someone special?
It's not like that boss. I don't have time for romance.
You don't seem to have your mind on your work.
I don't care... as long as you do your job.

dialogues.title: Ava reports on Harper
lines: Do you remember Harper Osiris? The silicon weaving woman?
She was found dead at the docks. Another murder.
Yeah, the strange lady. What about her?

dialogues.title: Round Five - Player Loses
lines: At least your better at slinging food than you are at playing chess. I'll light a billboard for you.
Shoulda, shoulda, but you woulda, woulda, LOST! Sorry, darlin, not your time. I'll see yah round though. Look for me.

dialogues.title: Spartacus Training
lines: Were you serious about being my coach? Cos I'm down to fight OBLITERATA FOUR. She smashed her last four opponents into plasteel.
Counter with the bone saw... right... I can do this...
You are NOT going to lose. You are NOT going to let me down. Because you are...?
I WILL CRUSH THEIR HEADS LIKE CANS. I WILL BRING THEIR DOOM.
That's why I'm here. You can take her!
Watch out for her lead hook, counter with the bone saw.

dialogues.title: Hanz Grundown first meeting
lines: Your business is four hundred and seventy-five metres away. You're in my sphere of influence. That means I can... influence your bottom line.
You're the new Thaddeus, right? I'm the Night Manager of the Grundown Ritz. Grundown. Hanz to my friends.
Sometimes they want to slum it downtown with some greasy noodles, a green soda and some poverty safari.
Are you sure your guests are also mine?
Anything within five hundred meters of the Grundown Ritz is still my responsibility, at least as far as those guests are concerned.
Look, the Grundown Ritz is a fine hotel. Too nice for this area, but that's hyper-gentrification for you.
I have to keep some very wealthy and important people very happy.
Right. Thaddeus would offer a discount to some of our more prestigious guests.
I think I get your point.
Hey, you there! I need your help.
My guests have varied tastes. Sometimes they wonder out in this direction instead of heading to the casinos and clubs in Midtown.
What's this got to do with me?
One week your street is paved with diamonds, the next it's a river of shit. Or vice versa. That's just Nivalis.

dialogues.title: Ava thinks you should find Safia
lines: I suggest you try to find this Safia in Hive Mall. Find out if you can help Ashwin somehow.
I don't think so. Let the two sort it out between them.

dialogues.title: Learn the truth about Ava
lines: I'm not sure I like Mr McFellow.
Would you consider him above murder?
Yes, we should follow this line of inquiry and see where it leads us.
I get a bad feeling about him.
He's definitely mad, but doesn't look like a murderer.
Definitely not. But if he killed this Crogan, why would he leave that data cache?

dialogues.title: Ava tells you Vik is there
lines: He wouldn't say. But he's not the sort of person you want to keep waiting.
Mr Vik Ryan is waiting for you at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Ask Kai Galosh about the Old Network
lines: I feel... different. Like another part of my brain just woke up.
But... now it feels like I really have one.
And believe me, you don't want to change their mind.
Wait! You knew that all along?
He also told me that when you came to me, I should tell you about secure access throughout the city. But you didn't come to me, yet.
We talked about data networks a lot. He respected my security expertise.
Thaddeus left a hidden data stream port in Ava. One that even she didn't know about. He told me that one day someone would ask about it.
I opened the secret port in Ava's system. She now has access to everything else you need to know.
You don't have a real brain.
Yet you found the black box.
It was a patchwork of super computers, grey terminals and trash... but it worked. Too well. Oversight was impossible.
Before the sprawl of The Nets as we know them, there was once a free macro-network.
And why did you want the Black Box?
When The Nets expanded and conglomerated, the Old Network was deprecated.
Give me a moment to process.
Without the corps it must have been dangerous anarchy.
And if I hadn't brought it?
Well, I heard you were a good fisherman, so I seized the opportunity.
I wouldn't call it anarchy. But there were places that were hidden from corp supervision.
I would have told you anyway. Eventually. I promised Thaddeus, but I couldn't miss an opportunity for a LITTLE extortion.
But tread lightly in the Old Network. It doesn't like strangers.
A naive take on the situation. But yes, it was dangerous.
Controlled by no one. No Corp oversight. Pure user-driven data.
That was my part of the bargain.
You really want to know? Asking about the Old Network is dangerous enough.

dialogues.title: Pilk has a tiny complaint
lines: Drilling holes in the floor and walls and ceiling?
No. But it happens to me all the time. Seems like I'm having a doppelganger.
Great to see me? You're trying to evict me!
Just don't send me any more eviction notices.
Of course you haven't. Oh, and do you need anything else from me? I'm going to the store. Sugar? New tabs for the air filters?
And hey, just remember, while I'm clearing up your rating on our system, no parties, no drilling holes and no destroying appliances. Alright bud?
If yes I don't remember them.
Well... let me check with my Automata... Yes, here it is! Your tenancy relationship index rating has dropped by six points in the last week.
No worries friend. Hey, have you been having loud parties?
I haven't done any of those things.
We need to talk about my tenancy.
Hey, you let me know if I can do anything else to help, alright? Old Pilk is your man.
Hey, then you should be fine! It must all be some sort of misunderstanding. Don't worry about it at all.
No recollection of any of those things.
Don't think so. Would have to look to make sure.
Sure. Like I said, it must be some sort of mistake. Don't worry. Let old Pilk take care of it.
You need to take care of that. There's a real asshole running around, looking just like you! You might get hurt! So what's up?
We need to talk about my tenancy.

dialogues.title: Lois complains about her boss
lines: I am! And... it's not you I'm mad at. Maybe we aren't close enough for me to vent at you like this?
No! And I don't care how good looking everyone says he is.
No. Not like my boss. He is just terrible.
I think he has a cynical view of relationships.
So I'm working on this looter shooter thing. You know the deal. "Epic guns, double your damage output, triple your fun with bonus Slayer Mode Coins!"
Sexuality is weird. It just happens. But friendship is special - and it's a choice. Friendship is work.
It doesn't mean I am making a plan to STEAL your dinner! And I won't take it by force either.
Don't just keep saying "I see." Give me your opinion. What do you think?
Well first off, I don't believe it at all. But... in this case, I think Gordon kinda DOES want to sleep with me.
You're a what? A "gamer"? What a weird thing to call yourself. I like donuts. Does that make me a donuter?
It's true, Men never stop thinking about sex.
Hey, do you ever want to just take up drinking. Or drugs?
Oh, I was just fooling around! I don't really rate or order my friends. I'm not weird. Or... well, I'm not weird in that particular way.
No! Not at all. And I told my boss. I said we were just friends. Gordon is a fucking GREAT game designer. I love working with the dude!
Only if you make it your whole personality.
No. He said men and women can't be real friends. He said - and listen to this bullshit - "Men want to sleep with their female friends, so real friendship is impossible between the genders."
I... do. Thanks. So you wanna know what this fucking guy asked me to do today? You won't believe this.
You don't play many games, do you?
I get his point, but not all people are alike.
So is your boss right after all?
Hey, I gotta go and finish this milestone for this dumb game, but thanks for listening to my rant. As always! See ya around bud.
Well, I think friendships are way more important than pretty much anything else. And Gordon is a good friend. I mean I only have like three... but he is in the top two!
He told me I couldn't sit next to our junior survival horror-game designer, Gordon, because there is too much sexual chemistry between us... Between me.... And Gordon.
If a friend wants to sleep with me, and they can't, WHO CARES?! They can still be a friend. I mean, I can look at your dinner and think "I want to eat that".
Do you want to talk about this?
No. Because most of my male friends DON'T want to sleep with me. But - here's the crucial thing - if they did... who cares?
Apologies! I should rephrase. Someone should invent a BOSS that's a good person.
Well I love games. And I hate them. Just like everything in life I guess. They are great and terrible and everything in between. Just like people.
Your boss is talking nonsense. Gender and sexuality has nothing to do with friendship.
Could you recommend some? What do you take to forget how much you hate your life?
Games are a waste of time.
Yes. Someone should invent a man that's a good person.

dialogues.title: Talk to Lochlainn sad end
lines: I'm so sorry, Lochlainn. I'll send you whatever we collected. I hope it can help you all, in some way.
Weak. He won't make it more than another few days.
I already heard. We didn't make enough, did we?
Thanks for your effort, boss. You tried. We all... tried.

dialogues.title: Ava's decision
lines: We don't know if that body is still viable.
I would love that. Good luck Ava!
I understand that you did what you had to.
With Clem, you turned metal and concrete into flowers.
I don't think it's my fate to die today. If Thaddeus built the road that led us here, I believe he built something for us at the end of it too.
Nivalis is a city of dreams. In mine, we are together.
You'll be fine without me. I promise.
I know. But I trust Thaddeus. And I trust you.
I've been watching you for a long time now. Watching the choices you make, and the way this city has shaped you into the person you have become.
My mind, yes. My brain still works, and the Cryogenic technology that broadcasts and digitizes my thoughts is functional. The system allows me to be your Automata, but...
When you cut my connection to the Network, I'll accept the connection, and my mind will be uploaded to the new body.
With Clem, you reported illegal activities to the authorities and crushed rebellions before they could bloom.
Will I ever speak to you again?
You have given me hope. Hope that whatever lies ahead for me, this world is where I belong.
And they certainly couldn't control what was in YOURS.
I can hear him in my head now... There is another body. I don't know what it is like, and I don't know where it is. But Thaddeus says I can go to it. I can LIVE.
I'll be waiting for you, Ava.
I don't think so. You'll be fine without me though. I promise.
Well, good luck Ava. I hope you find your peace.
We don't know where it is?
Peace? I don't want you to go.
I'm not sure I want to live in a world where corporations, money and capital can change someone's heart the way they've changed yours.
I'm not judging you. But your actions show the kind of person you have become.
With The Crusty Punks and Gamova, you obeyed the Corps when they asked for your help.
I am still deciding. A new life... somewhere? Do I just trust Thaddeus and his plan? Did he really have this in mind all along? A way to give me my life back?
Yes. Preserved, but lifeless. We found... me. But my body is a shell. It's the least life a body can have without being dead.
This human body has been preserved for a long time... and preserved well. But it was never intended to be woken. This isn't a place to care for the sick. It is a tomb.
I see now. Thaddeus had a plan for me. He left me with an offer. I must make a choice.
I will find you. And I will thank you, in person... And then... I'll probably try to kiss you.

When you cut my connection to the Network, I'll delete the last link to my physical form. I will reject the connection to the new body Thaddeus had waiting for me. I'll be lost in the Nets... In that endless sea of night. And I'll find peace.
I know. I understand all your choices - I was there. I was with you. But I don't think I want to return to THIS world.
Perhaps... not. New subroutines are being unlocked as we speak. I am being made aware of another option.
I know this is real. There IS a body waiting for me, if I want it. The decision is not whether I trust Thaddeus... it is whether I want to come back and live a life in Nivalis.
With Mica, you resisted when people tried to scare you.
I thought I knew how this world worked, but you showed me that even if CorpSec makes the rules, they can't control what's in people's hearts.
If there is a way back to you, I will find it. And when I find you, I'm giving you the biggest, squeeziest hug of your life.
Will I ever see you again?

dialogues.title: Agent Teleshko asks you to snitch
lines: A fellow vendor called Daniel Danetti, a graffiti "artist" called Zaffer, and a faulty android who calls himself "Dotson".
What do you need to know?
You should take some time to think about your decision. Next time we speak, you'll have some information from me. I know you're smarter than you look.

Well, further down the line, maybe things get easier for your business. Quick permits. Invasive advertising opportunities. Mandatory custom. There's a lot of ways CorpSec can make your business thrive.
Good. I'll return soon. Remember, gain their trust. Act like you're one of them. But the fact that you're hearing me out... it means you're not like them. You're like me.
I don't have to tell you anything.
There are three citizens I need to ask you about. Suffice it to say, I have plenty of reason to question this trios' motives.
You better watch yourself citizen. I'm going to ask you some questions, and what you say will have a big effect on your future. For example, whether you have one.
I need some information. I'm going to ask you some questions. You'll answer truthfully. Is that clear?
Please gather info on them. You are now a source. Learn what you can, then report to me.

dialogues.title: Ill Read it to You
lines: No customers behind the counter. What do you need the light for?
Gonna have to do better than that.
Ok, so first it's 'you' need to look at something, and then it becomes 'Sage' is looking for one.
So look in the parts of the city with little light and a lot of waste. You've been given the invite, they'll show you the door when they see you coming.
Do you know where I can get one?
I'm not giving it to you.
Kinda hard when there's a curfew.
Then why'd you ask what kind I wanted?
Means don't look for the snake if you're trying to find a scorpion.
Sage Hullen's looking for one. Just doing her a favor.
If Sage really sent you here, I don't need to explain why. Give it to me and I'll manage it for you.
(show coin) I need to look at this under it.
Alright, scorpion shimmer chip. This is a quality day.
Yeah, well, Sage still owes me for that romp through the Canyon. She is a wild good time though.
What? Then why say you were sold out?
Just need to look at something.
There's a writing on the underside of the coin. 'Focus on the snake, miss the scorpion. Blink too quick, drown in waste.'
Sage Hullen's looking for one. Just doing her a favor.
Do you happen to have a UV light?
Genuine UVs are antiques due to the quartz tubing. Good luck finding another one.
Said I have one. It's not for sale.
Fine by me. Feel free to get fucked by the door on your way out.
Scorpions are nocturnal. They like the dark. You'll probably find who, or what, you're looking for in an absence of light.

dialogues.title: Old Network knows secret book stores
lines: Are you ready for a night time excursion?
I swam the Old Network. There's still some activity on there. I found some interesting discussions. There's a secret book fair coming up tonight!
Alright, if it will help you.
Yes! Secret book lovers sharing secret books. Paper ones. We might find some more clues about my memories. Surely we should check it out.
I like the sound of that.
I kinda wanna see these secret books. Let's go.

dialogues.title: We sabotaged a Rival's property
lines: Hey, you kept up your end of the bargain. You trashed those places real good.
See you around. Oh, and I won't hassle you no more about the apartment. You earned my trust.
Well, here's your reward you ruthless bastard. You know, you remind me of me.

dialogues.title: Coffee for Teleshko
lines: A favor. It’s when you do something to help someone else out because you can.
Favors are in direct violation of this sector’s Profitability Enhancement Directives.
A Butterscotch Mocha with Ketchup Cream?
Caffeine is the fuel that drives the engine of commerce.
You think I would order something so inefficient?
Charge a fee for your deliveries from now on, or face a fine.
Quite. And I thank you for delivering mine. These penalty fees don't issue themselves. Good day.
One Extra Extra Tall Grande Latte.
Did you simply come here to insult me?
Here's your Dark Roast Tuna Combo.
Sounds like somebody needs their coffee!
Correct. I am glad to see you taking on a new line of work. If only more citizens had your zeal for business.
I am busy, citizen. And in no mood for idle chat.
An accurate if irritating observation. Well? Do you intend to impede my progress all day?
No, I'm here to deliver your coffee.
Actually, I’m doing it as a favor.

dialogues.title: Dr Alken wants to talk to you
lines: R.M Alken is at the noodle stand and wishes to speak to you.
Perhaps she wants to donate. It would be best to hurry, she rarely stays in one place for long.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 18
lines: All I can see is the infinite sea of suffering.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Salt Pete Speaks
lines: Tsk, you'll never understand the ways of the sea. Just like Calhoun.
A favor, you say? Dangerous things. But this old sea dog’s ears are like shells, whisper in my skull and all you’ll hear are the waves. Ha!
Actually, I have a favor to ask you.
Belay yourself this way and have a chat with me, matey!
So where is he, eh? Can’t see his boots on the dock.
It's not about belief, young lubber. It's about respect. We should ALL have gone to fish for the Baron that day.
He swears he caught it. Why don't you believe him?
But Calhoun wanted the glory for himself. So he took the boat and stole my best rod and then came back with some crusty tale.
Never! He baked his clam with us the day he lied about the Macrogillean! He broke the code! He shot his gull!
He broke the fisherman’s code. We banished him from the wharf forever.
He'd like to join back the club.
Aye. But it's a secret club. Who told you?
He'd like to fish here again.
Only one way to be un-banished. And it's something that old cove would never do.
Sounds like he was just more ambitious.
You're a member of the Carp Diem, right?
The sewers? Pah, all he’ll catch down there are mutant jellies. No way to live.

dialogues.title: Ava suggests some research
lines: If a cheaper alternative to this mask exists, we have to find it.
Yeah, we need to help somehow.
I'll do some research and get back to you.

dialogues.title: Well Hey There
lines: Darlin, if I wasn't already sweaty from dancin' you'd make me blush. You're quite the catch yourself.
How long have you been a visual artist?
Well hey there, darlin, you come to dance?
If I could dance half as good as them I'd upload it too.
Well, the invite's there if you change your mind!
Since I was a tot and my folks got me a plug-pin light up game. I'd make shapes with colored pegs and leave them on while I slept. They were beautiful.
Do you have any projects coming up?
You just gotta feel the music, darlin. Let the lights shine on you like blazing suns and faded moons. I did a piece like that once. One of my favorite displays.
Why not? They have some pretty chill beach clubs there. Could work on those moves of yours. Think about it, yeah? Ah! I love this song. Time to talk less and dance more!
Oh, it was beautiful. The client was kind of a cockroach. Hard to believe they had much of a soul, but they wanted a celestial display that spanned a day/night cycle and I was happy to deliver.
I'm not really much of a dancer.
Bet it pales to your beauty.
I'd be embarrassed for people to see that.
You want me to come with you?
That's the spirit! What's your go-to move? I'm a fan of fibbing with my hips, you know, like this. Boom-boom-botta. Boom-boom-botta.
Ah, not like the free love groups I used to swing with. But Delbs got his hands full trying to light fires across the city so I'm spending my time here. You should join me!
A few things in the works. I gotta run out to Calypso in a few days to meet with a client. Hey! You should join me!
That's the spirit! Ahh! I love this song. Time to talk less and dance more!
Oh it's not that hard. Have you seen some of the vids people upload to the feeds? Squirming around their bedrooms in swanky clothes?

dialogues.title: Level Down from 5 to 4
lines: Our prestige is slipping. The noodle bar has been downgraded from rating five to four.
You need to keep an eye on things. It won't run itself.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 10
lines: That sounds like custom programming. The majority of CorpSec arrests are made using artificial intelligence risk algorithms.
That's quite high. Why haven't you said anything?
If I guessed the killer, would you be able to tell me if I'm right?
It may be possible for me to bypass the network somehow...
What?! Our lives are in danger.
She knows who the Aseptic is.
We shouldn't go together. I'm going to try and give Curzona the runaround - see if I can buy us some time. I'll meet you there. Be quick.
I don't have time to explain this but, Ava, do you know who the Aseptic is?
Every time I tried to mention it, something inside the network blocked my communication. I assumed it was a failsafe of some kind.
There are things I cannot say, even if I want to say them.
That was strange, I went offline again. Is that Gamova?
I was right! ...Can you tell me if I was right?
Nope. Can't say. This is frustrating.
You could have told me earlier.
Somebody didn't trust the authorities, right?
I'd say my confidence rating is 95%.
I am not sure... But we can try!
Exactly. As far as I know CorpSec only require a 13% certainty before making an arrest.
I thought we were through with her.
The network is preventing me from providing a name.
Hmmm... I was able to track the suspect using a network of TheraPay bots that they interacted with regularly. This gave me an approximate route to their location.
According to Ava, she is unable to make accusations without the network blocking her.
All she could give me was an address. You should have it now.
I have updated your map. I believe the trail of street-therapy leads to an apartment deep within the Sewers.
Come on, Ava! What about a location?

dialogues.title: Mertie Batt Crime Scene
lines: You know what Shoku, I think you might be right. It might be time to rince the mop.
If it takes the fight to the corps, maybe some good can come from it.
Nothing. This guy's working cleaner than an Erasure Tech.
She was everyone's aunt. Least it felt that way, sometimes. Meridian Market's gonna be dark without her.
Yeah. Just like she didn't deserve to live in debt her whole life.
But there's something about this guy. I mean you can't call it beautiful but I mean look at it... Look at me getting all emotional.
The smell, it just becomes a part of you eventually.
Knock yourself out. I gotta take a break anyway. This is killing me today.
I'm not sure. This one really got to me. Do you think he's right? This Aseptic lad. Some people think he's doing the right thing but I'm not sure.
Have you found any clues this time? Anything?
What's the worst part of it?
It sounds like you need a break.
If there's one thing this job has taught me, it's how to clean up after myself. I think it's time I apply that to something useful. Hey, maybe I'll see you around. Thanks for the words.
I gotta take a break, this is killing me today. Look around all you want. She ain't going nowhere.
You'd prefer it to be someone else?
Whatever. I gotta take a break, this is killing me today. Look around all you want. She ain't going nowhere.
Must be nice to be so sure about who deserves to die. Now, if you'll excuse me...
I've seen it all doing this job. Maulings so bad you don't know what's what anymore. "Oh is this Rooster Soup or is it a bit of ex-person".
There's never an excuse for murder.

dialogues.title: Ava faces Gideons Grey Tech
lines: The weather is really bad recently.
After that, my father, the inventor of the... crash-resistant space shuttle seat, was lost in the... big incident of '08.
It's going down. My business, bounty hunting, even the green mold!
Why do I feel like you have not stumbled upon me, but have FOUND me?
Perfect! That's helping, but the intrusion is weakening my defenses. Please keep him talking for a moment more.
My mentor was involved in the great system melt down.
Indeed... Well I have work to do, though maybe I can revisit my question from before? About Thaddeus?
How long have you worked as a bounty hunter?

Good. Pseudo-naivety lets him question your intentions. But you aren't generating new data for him to query! The root level attack on my core systems is intensifying. I will try to run the trace before I am hacked.
And his son told him he should retire to Luna instead.
Uh, I actually have to go. I'll talk to you later.
I guess I AM feeling a lot of stress.
Was talking about The Docks. Though his old friend said he should stay.
Have you ever been to the wastes? I hear some bounty hunters go there.
I have to discuss an important matter.
I wonder if Thaddeus got away before the LUZ stopped him.
None of it really affects my business. I have plenty of work here.
Warning! I have detected a system intrusion. Gideon's Grey Tech has attempted a breach. My defensive subsystems are holding... for now.
Before this job, my corporate background was in aggressive take-overs with Curzona.
I advise against the course. Do not arouse his suspicion. You are playing your hand too early.
The intrusion is weakening my defenses. Keep him talking for a moment more. This will be close.
Maybe. Jumping at shadows? What do you want to talk about?
Undecipherable garbage. Perfect! The root level attack on my core systems is lagging. I will try to run the trace.
My old employer needed me to track down the man.
Green mold, a lunatic bounty hunter, my joint running out of wares: wouldn't you be confused?
Do you recommend it as a career?
I hear the LUZ is good for business. What do you think about that?
You hired a bounty hunter.... Interesting. I would not think you possessed the means.
No, keep him talking. Don't start to wrap up. I am holding off the intrusions for now. I will try to run the trace.
I think the LUZ is making me a little crazy.
People are disappearing. Serial killers are on the loose. The Comms are down. Crazy, huh?
That's no good. Throw lots of topics at him. And use specifics. We need his Grey Tech to run checks on what we say.
When I hired a bounty hunter I sent them out into the wastes.
I haven't completed the trace. We failed. But I am in danger. We must leave. Now!
He had stolen a precious data drive.
The Aseptic might have paid this bounty hunter to confuse the situation!
Do you think I would make a good bounty hunter? How would I get started?
That's no good. You need something more specific. You need to make him query data and check what you're saying. Tease him.
Is your head clear friend? You seem to have a lot on your mind.
Yes, I once hired a bounty hunter.
We did it! I have a trace on the owner of the Grey Tech. But I am in danger. We must leave. Now!
He used Grey Tech to confuse his target's Automata.
Yes, throw lots of topics at him, but you need more specifics! We need his Grey Tech to run checks on what we say.
What I am trying to say is...
Yes! This is raising more questions than it asks.
You're probably want me to get to the point soon, right?
And there's a shortage of ingredients so I'm worried my customers will be disappointed.
How do you feel about the state of The Docks? Is it getting worse?
And the sentient mold. Did you hear that it's moving in from the sea every night?
I guess I'm just worried about that ransomware attack.
I hired a bounty hunter once. To track my previous partner, before he lost all that money in the... accident.
No, this is not good. Too vague, and you are asking him for info. You have to reveal information, not seek it.
That's it! Tease him with information. We need his Grey Tech distracted. I don't detect any system intrusions. Yet.
Trapped in a LUZ. Serial killers are getting caught.
There's a bounty on the guy who caused it. He was seen in this area recently.

dialogues.title: You Hear it When You Sleep Dont You
lines: Those ships coming in from Luna. The raw power of everything around me. Maybe it'll have the same effect on you too.
Gotta hear the music. Feel the vibe the airwaves are putting out. Last I heard it, the time I realized yeah, this is where I need to be, was in the Port.
Listen, everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.
Forgot my knives at the restaurant.
Mr. Anthony Geraci himself. The number one synth accordo to grace the airwaves.
Do you want to assist? To find the vibes and ride the waves with me?
Look who's wandered back to the hustle and bustle and rustle of the struggle. Oh, that's a good one.
Sometimes the rhymes work sometimes they don't.
Words are words, beats are heartbeats. The pulse. The life. The very blood of the vibes. Cut me open and you'll see.

Well, the secret is what he teaches through his music. See, the thing is, once you find the vibe that works for you, the rhythm your life flows by, everything else just exists. Once that happens it's, well it's golden.
I want to bleed like that.
Ahh, so here we are. Listen, if you listen - get it? No? Ah, it's subliminal verses trying to depict the worse... ening - ah, that one needs some massaging.

dialogues.title: Elaine Malloy shows up
lines: Elaine Malloy is waiting for you at the noodle stand.
I'm not in the mood to have my photo taken.
She says it's about Iann. I would hurry, she can be a bit... prickly.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 12
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Dr Matombo wants to talk to you
lines: Dr Matombo is at the noodle stand.
Perhaps she has a medical opinion, or wishes to donate. She's a busy woman, you should try not to keep her waiting.
Do you know what she wants?

dialogues.title: Decisons Decisions
lines: Are you just throwing random words together?
Are you really that happy right now?
I talked to Cirian about the drugs, Kai.
What is that? Is it a new version of the In Dreams tech? Let me tell you, I haven't felt this blissful in ages.
Can't you see it?! Waves of happiness as lush trees give way to scantily clad beach goers enjoying the lustful lounging of their desires.
Thank you, my friend! And, CUT! That's a wrap for today.
Well, then this next dose will make you even happier.
That's good, Kai. I'm happy for you.
Reality?! You don't think this is reality? A glowing city of glitz, glam, and gobsmacked citizens weaving through the confines of their lives? What could be more reality than that?

Cirian! What a sponsor! They're the type of person you want on your side when the advert gods decide to pull out of your system. Haha, pull out. Sorry! Sorry, everyone! That was inappropriate. Can we take it again from the top?
Are you here to comment on the current situation unfolding here on Calypso Island?
Kai, we're in Eastern Residential, buddy.
I'm here to help bring you back to reality.
My ratings are up and the sky's the limit! Well, the Spire's the limit due to the vertical ascent restrictions but you get what I mean.
Throwing words together? Yes. Random words? No. That's what an announcer does, they string syllables into sentences and convey information to the viewers and readers and streamers like you.
Of course we are! We couldn't actually be on Calypso Island, not with what's going on there?
She gave me this to give to you.

dialogues.title: Lucy was not finished speaking
lines: I mean, I'm going to keep coming. I live real close. And, you know, I want to support small, failing businesses and help them find their way. I'm all about that. I just shouldn't have to pay as much as the regular customers.
Maybe we can give you a discount.
I'll make some calls. This place is going to become much cooler VERY soon. You owe me for this!
Right! Well, that's a good start. Maybe I can get the rest of my band mates to come by. They will need a discount too, but they'll make your place SO MUCH cooler. There's too many ugly people here.
You don't sound like a loyal customer.
I've come here three times now. CORA knows why. I guess I just like shitty food and bad attitudes.
I'll remember this. You've made an enemy here today. An enemy for life.
I'll see what I can do.
Hey, can you have a word with your staff? I need a loyal customer discount.

dialogues.title: Sell Neon to Harmony
lines: What do I need with neon?
I guess it is kinda functional-looking.
You know Mertie, down in the market?
Thinking of getting into the business? Here's some advice: don't. I'd have to kill you. Like, literally. My license says so.
So what's this all about? Like I said, kinda busy.
Wow, you really are desperate to sell some neon, huh? Alright, I'll go see Mertie. Maybe we can do some kinda deal. Now, I REALLY have to go. Radiation sickness waits for no woman!
Can't stop, just heard about a radiation leak over in Industrial. These stem cell power boost bars are gonna fly off the shelves!
Your PRU's boring. Think how eye-catching it could be with a bit of glow.
Real quick, I've got a question about your PRU...
Hahaha, you wouldn't stand a chance. I'd strangle you in your sleep. So anyway, what's this about? Kinda busy here.
A bit of blue neon would really bring out the color of your eyes.
I can get you an exclusive deal with her. Some top-quality Spire-grade neon tubes for Lowtown prices.
Well, sure, that's what being a Personal Retail Unit vendor is all about!
It could help you stand out in the dark.
Yeah, the dark when so many are out buying things. After curfew. Great pitch, buddy.
Sounds like you've got an eye business.

dialogues.title: Bring Banor on board
lines: I guessed you'd come talk to me about this at some point.
Ava suggested you could help me with running multiple businesses.
Gimme a day to look over the paperwork. I'm guessing Ava sent that over to my Comm already.

I'll do the boring stuff. Keep tabs on the stock, staff and markets, point you in the right direction, offer advice... How you run the business is up to you. But I'll make sure you have all the information you need. Let's get to work!
In a manner of speaking. Sometimes it's like I can think like Old Thad. Like I have his voice in my head. And he told me this would happen.
An old friend said you'd be a big deal in Nivalis. You'd end up owning much more than a noodle stand, and you'd need help.
Keep an eye on every business you run. And you only got two, boss.
Promised the Old Man I would. Not the one in my head, the real one. I got you, boss.

dialogues.title: Fun With Finlay
lines: Holy unmoored tentacle beast I did! Thanks for letting me know.
Do you know where Zee is?
She knows the risks. That's the good thing about free will: you get to make your own decisions.
Oh so you're the new friend, got it. Well you can't be that good of a friend or you'd know she wouldn't want to be found right now. She's on one of her little 'resets'.
Zee? Why are you asking about Zee?
What if something happens to her?
5... 4... 3... aannnddd we're good. Ok, thanks for that.
Missing? You a new friend of Zee's or what? If you can't find her it's not that she's missing. She's on one of her little 'resets'. She don't wanna be found.
Hey look can you take this.
She takes off to the mountains, says they give her the best view to watch the sky kiss the sea. She does it every so often, just drops off and disappears. She'll be back.
I have to or I'd forget and I can't forget because if I forget then it's all just forgotten! You know?
Hold on--let's go--wait, just act normal.

dialogues.title: Ava involves RM Alken
lines: So we have a lead on a mask for Lochlainn's child... Vik Ryan of all people.
Yes... I recommend seeing R.M Alken first. We can check the diagnosis.
And it still costs a fortune.

dialogues.title: Ghost in the Gardens
lines: If it means we can be together, I'll find the strength to go through with it. I don’t care about the consequences.
I'll see you on the other side. One last thing...
It's happening, the thing we feared. They're going to cleanse me, TC. And soon. They've scheduled the procedure.
I know it’s likely a death sentence, but what can I do? They watch us day and night. I was barely able to get away.
Thank the stars. I thought you wouldn’t come.
I thought about what you carved in this rock. “YT & TC”. Us. I know what I have to do.

dialogues.title: Tabloid Trash
lines: Sounds like a very Roxi thing to do.
What?! No, not like actual shit. What's wrong with you?
Track down the bastards who ran the broadcast, tie 'em up, rip their noses off and feed 'em to each other one by one.
What if I did it for you?
Well I invite you to leave it at anytime. I gotta work on getting this done.
CorpSec loves sales, no matter what is sold.
What's got you more pissed than usual?
'course! Some people pay for vials of sweat for who knows what reason. A worn jersey is nothing in comparison but it still fetches a pretty high price.
He better has. Or he's yours.
Binary Gods, you living in the Wastes or just sucking Vent fumes? It's a scanner bot fuckers use to syphon pheromones and shit from your body.
Fine, fine, but the opportunity is out there... maybe. Find Kai Reston, the announcer-turned-reporter-turned-completely-washed-up-scumbag!!! And get him to cut the SimBot shit, okay?
I happen to have some cajun spice.
Get the damn jersey back before they can push it. If anyone's making money off my sweat it's me.
What's got you more pissed than usual?
Huh. Alright. You wanna get your hands dirty? Do a good job and maybe we can get you on a Hover team. Put those muscles to good use.
If I'm feeling generous I'll sprinkle some cajun seasoning on 'em first.
Yeah and my hands about to smack your mouth.
The big deal is people take SimBot scans and infuse them into clothing and other stuff. Sell it under the pretense an athlete or rock star wore it.
I had that interview right? Don't remember if I told yah but it was with a punk from VSM and due to the Comms being down had to meet him in person.
What are you going to do?
They took a SimBot scan. Hidden little bug in the prep room. You know what that means? How bad that is?
How are you going to get it back?
Whatever. Not important. I can't believe they actually did this. I should have known they were a slimy scum suck of a grrrrrrr.
You're the one who said it!
Surprised you're surprised. Some people pay for vials of sweat for who knows what reason. A worn jersey is nothing in comparison but it still fetches a pretty high price.
Well then keep walking. Unless you wanna source my next ink job.
He mentioned an interview with a zero-g player headed to Luna so probably the Spaceport. Though knowing him, he probably scammed his way on a transport by now.

dialogues.title: Speak to Razlo
lines: Mr Nyx-Curzona did indeed commit a faux pas. A very serious one. I even have photographic evidence of it.
I just like taking photos of parties. The precious memories. I make sure to save copies.
Every credit token has two sides. Once you know how to be seen, you know how to be unseen. I find the latter… more useful.
Oh, I promise I won’t use the images for a good while yet. Some things are better left to age. Say hello to Eldridge for me.
Not here to chat, I just have a question.
So were you unseen at this party Eldridge was at?
The road to corporate domination is paved with bad ties and formulaic manoeuvres. I've chosen a more interesting path.
Are you looking for me? How things change. For the better, in my case. Not sure about yours...
Did you see Eldridge at a party recently?
I wouldn't say that's your forte.
It came out beautifully on camera. You should have seen his face when I told him.
If Eldridge was photographed with sweat-marked garments… well. He would do a lot to make those images go away.
You see? Already the information is worth something. And I didn’t even need to wait twenty years.
So you don't regret failing those exams?
Right in front of everyone! It came out beautifully on camera. You should have seen his face when I told him.
No. He forgot to turn on his sweat gland inhibitor. He perspired all night!
Posture. Stature. Bearing. Being from the Spire is all about making yourself seen.
He tried to start a library, right?
I see you don’t understand. Perspiration is considered a crime against both poise and fashion.
So you saw what Eldridge did...?
I didn’t go to get cartwheeled on bubblesnuff. I went there to watch. To gather... insurance.
I don't enjoy being patronized. What do you want?
Oh yes, Mr Nyx-Curzona, thirty-eighth in line to the board. We had the same Attitudinizing tutor. A lot of good it did him.
So you're going to blackmail him?
And I have a schedule to keep. What do you want?

dialogues.title: Only Eyes is Gone
lines: Nope, got better things to do.
We are in the area to hear Mr Only Eyes's broadcast. Shall I see if I can reach him?
Maybe we will meet him again.
Hello? Only Eyes, are you there?
The channel is dead. It seems that Only Eyes is no longer here.
Happy to hear that he moved on.

dialogues.title: Banor is Worried
lines: I'll try, boss, but they’re scaring the customers. Ain’t good for business. You're gonna have to pay that guy back eventually.
Hey boss, I don’t mean to speak outta turn, but you been borrowing money?
Well... it's just that we've had some heavies hanging around the place. Look like bargain basement erasure techs. Said they work for some guy called Calhoun?

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Danny waiting
lines: Danny is at the Noodle bar. He seems anxious.

dialogues.title: Ceres remembers her husband
lines: That was his job. He was Chief Technical Officer at LifeCorp. Worked on it for a lifetime.
I need more information about your late husband.
Just a question: How did Gan get into the vacuum cleaner?
He really was. Always trying to eternalize human memories and minds. That's what he called it. "Eternalization."
So, is it possible to manipulate an Automata's memories?
Not so eternal for him, right?
He should have remembered to stay home.
How would I know? I hated his job!
Can you do me a favor?

dialogues.title: Tell Cale about the Reservation
lines: Well now that's a bit unexpected. What's the occasion?
Well, the thought means a lot. What's the plan then?
I thought we could make new memories there.
I... I don't know what to say. Thank you. As nervous as I am to go back there, I can't wait. It's going to be such a good time.
This... this is for a restaurant on Calypso Island.
See you in a couple days.
I had an idea for another date.
Hey you. Thanks for making my day a little better.

dialogues.title: Hynthia recipe customization
lines: And I will do my best to honor your culinary... visions.
You know. Customize! Tinker, get creative. Who knows, you might even figure out something that works. Miracles do happen. Occasionally.
Yeah I'll do my best to honor your culinary... visions.
Hey... uh. You don't have to be scared of me, you know?
I'm always nice. And that poison trial thing starts next week, so I could really do with some character witnesses. You know, just in case.
I know I can be intimidating, but if you want to change the recipes, you should just go ahead and do it. Have fun!

dialogues.title: Cecil Stops by with a Fine
lines: Remind me, are you the one in charge of this... location?
Or I'm having a talk with my CorpSec contact regarding your license.
What’s not fair is being stuck as a lowly inspector, poking around dives like yours, when I could be sweeping for nanoparticles in the Spire.
Say what you want or get out.
Not my dream. My calling. And I’ll be calling on you again soon. Good day.
This place honestly looks like the contents of a city dumpster have been emptied here.
I want to inspect every crevice of this germ-ridden enterprise. And then I want to purge it from existence!
Your dream is to inspect the Spire?
“Work” is putting it generously. Do you clean the floors or simply squirm around on them?
Perhaps not to you. But to the Bureau of Sanitation it is positively crawling with Lims, I mean, lice.
And you're proud of this cess pit? This heap of ordure? This muck palace?
Unhygienic! It’s positively polluted! There! Is that a grease spot over one inch diameter? Let me get my measuring device…
Are you implying that this place is unhygienic?
But I’ll settle for issuing a Category D fine of, let’s see, fifty Lims.

dialogues.title: Ava loses her mind at Egress
lines: Digital ghosts. These are the uploads that failed.
We're all pluviophiles here. You can't make a rainbow without a little filter attached to the camera that convinces most people that it's raining.
It's not the end of the world. But it might be the end of HIS world. Also... it IS the end of the world.
Alright, let's get out of here.
Very well, but there is little here that we can learn. Without some form of "ticket", we can go no further. I advise you to be quick.
There's a place you can go if you close your eyes. Do you see it? It's called... Nivalis.
But I want to look around.
What do you expect to find here? It's the same, but all the familiar faces are replaced. Or... remixed. A part of his daydream on your computer screen, but he's older. And there's four of him now.
I'm... sorry. I'm recompiling my source code to overwrite the corrupted functions. My core personality is mostly intact.
There are old algorithms that live here. Powerful ones. They are sleeping, but their dreams are... turbulent. We should leave.
I fail to understand in the first place. What uploads?

dialogues.title: Ava says Pilk has a job
lines: Do not panic. I have deployed data protection measures to postpone the changes. But you should talk with your landlord Pilk Dane as soon as possible.
The electronic locks in your apartment are being changed.

dialogues.title: Kai visits the noodle stand
lines: I most certainly have... NOT! I was going to. I was right there, ready to fluff the pillows and crawl under my sheets when BAM! My brain exploded in front of our studio audience.

First, we see the city gleam, like it wants to say something, tell us a secret, whisper in our ear--AANNNNDDD cut feed to the HOVAs racing toward Meridian Market and the people walking the street beneath the blurry shadows. This is the living, breathing, city of Nivalis.
SimBot scan?! Nah, I'm done with that nonsense. Got me an announcing gig. No more chasing celebs for soundbites. Now people get to hear my voice.... BOOMING through stadiums and speakers.
This is the part where you say something. Don't be shy, the audience wants to hear.
Kai, you're not at work. There is no audience.
If you're here to SimBot scan our food you can scram.
Noodle crew, noodle crew, every light is shining on the noodle crew. So, what's in the crew's brew for the six o'clock news?
Well! Whose fault is that? I'll tell yah whose... mine! And he's off! Off to work ol' chum. Ciao, ciao, ciao!

dialogues.title: Edison What Happened
lines: Then I guess that's where I'm going. Least I could pull off my part of the deal. You... just.... unbelievable. I'll be back.
I'm asking, right here in front of you, help me. I have to know what happened to my niece Haley.
Nothing more than dropping those cards off at the class room.
You... you paid Cirian what I owed them?
Flash cams caught her in the neighborhood, about seventy-five yards from the hideout. That woman is death in their minds.
Alright, so! Thankfully the orphans are good for now. A-O-K. What about on your end? Did you find the Notary?
Did you get the ID cards? Tell me you got the ID cards...
Yeah, yeah, I know. I have to and I will once I figure this all out. Thanks for getting the cards. Here's what I got for yah.
I'm aware. Alright. Okay... We got this. It's okay. Where did you find Cirian?
Place in the Stacks. You can just put em in the drop-box out front. Those kids aren't gonna open the door for someone they don't know. Not with Mica Rain casually walking around.
Cirian mentioned you owe her money.

Hot as a bowl of mango-spiced grub! You actually did it. Not that I doubted you. Well, okay, I doubted you a little but hey, this world's full of doubt. Know you doubted whether or not I could get that fine lifted.
You wanna make some more? It's not much, still replenishing stocks after I had to pay a few people off. Greedy sons of motherboards.
Like one's inhibition as soon as they step foot in Club Oralange. Lotta people get tongue-tied in that place if yah know what I mean.
Fine. What do I have to do?
I don't know what to say. Honestly. This... this is too much and you are too good'a person. Can't tell you the last time I hung around with genuinely good people.
It's okay. I'll see you on the next run through.
Huh. Did she now? And here I thought we were still abiding by friendly confidentiality. Well then.
Cirian was not happy to see me.
Bastard-corpster-greed-filled-mother-ahhh! Seriously? One thing. We agreed you could handle one. Very. Simple. Thing!
She won't be able to mention it anymore.

dialogues.title: Safia's closure not hired
lines: You were a good boss. You take care of your people.
We're friends. Good ones. He's grown up a lot.
Well, I better get going. See you around.
Ashwin just sent me a message saying that he bought you out.
Ashwin just sent me a message saying that he sent you the last payment.
He did. He's doing his own thing now.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 2
lines: Rise and shine. A new day is waiting. You should check in at the Noodle Bar to see what needs to be done.

dialogues.title: Find Rice Walket
lines: So... I take it you don't have Mizzy's Lims?
I setup a voice network for an entrepreneur. I had no idea what she was doing with it.
Right on. Here, take this. It's a bootleg Nata-Log. The chat is transcribed alongside the route data. Even the idiots at CorpSec should be able to see this corruption.
CorpSec is really going to care about some board reading?
It is, but not one of mine.
Yeah, so did you listen to the story I just told you? This is what Mizzy does. Don't fall for it. Work with me to bury this fucker.
I could sell it to Mizzy.
I don't have time for this.
Get it to 'Sec. They'll take the info from it and make their move.
