Gambling on the boards! Then people like Mizzy would have to find another way to swindle hard workin' folks like you and me.
Did. Until 'Sec shut 'em down and blamed 'technical difficulties'. HA! It's technically difficult to keep all her lies straight.
And then she wrangled you in with promises on how to read the boards, yeah? Told you to come back a few days later and she'd show you?
Why would people be looking for you?
Ah, yah finally found me. Knew this was bound to happen.
She said you got a delay bet wrong and skipped out on paying.
Mizzy was using those channels when I met them though.
Seas below... Mizzy can look for the broad side of a HOVA while standing on an active railway.
You're gonna turn it over to them?

Regardless... I didn't realize what she was doing until I lost that bet. The delay was perfectly timed and then all of a sudden it was off. I couldn't believe it. Fucking heart sank faster than a decommissioned satellite.
Look, let's just get the gab over with and figure out what's about to happen.
Listen, I owe Mizzy a thousand Lims. I know that. But that shit owes me so much more than that. She cost me my job. My livelihood. My PASSION. She cost me the blasted Comms!
I mean... It was both of you.
When I found out, I swiped what Lims I could from Mizzy and booked it. I knew she'd send someone after me eventually but I didn't care.

CorpSec discovered the back channels I had open for Mizzy to talk directly to the conductors. She won't say it, but that was the acid on the body of the Comms. Final thing 'Sec needed to shut 'em down.
Because technically I'm involved. Sure I could use this to try and convince them to clear my case, but that still leaves me hanging on the backdoor channel charges. Potential charges.
Let me guess... Mizzy told you she'd help you learn the boards, make some Lims, and pad those pockets, right?
Ha! As if she has the money to buy you off. Come on, don't get wishy-washy on me.
So you helped Mizzy fix her bets?
Ha. Grifters gonna grift. That's Mizzy's whole schtick. Lures you in with the promise of easy Lims and the allure of that board and its glowing letters and numbers. Should be illegal.
What do I do with it?
Fair. It isn't the supplier's responsibility what the buyer does.
Right! Then here's a reason to sway to my side: Mizzy ain't gonna teach yah anything. She's gonna bring you into the fold and bleed yah dry. What do you say?
No, but you are. Be on the right side of history here. Let's screw the ones who screw people like us.
Okay... humor me then. Why are you attempting to wrangle up Mizzy's debts? She got something on you or are you just bored?

You're really here on behalf of that Crusty Punk-wannabe-gambling-dipshit? She screwed me over worse than a bootleg relay installed in a headset. You ever see someone with a Comms scar on the side of their face? Mizzy left one on my brain.
I had a bot transcribe the backdoor channel's I connected and now have an entire text log of Mizzy and the conductor. CorpSec would be pretty interested in what they talked about.
A 200-1 payout. I lost it all and she ordered de-oiled oysters from her beloved little shop.
Should be as hands off as possible. I'd use the Drop Box Terminal down in the Industrial District.
Funny. Mizzy should stop gambling and become a writer cuz that's better than half the shit you see on the Nets.
Can you get to the point, please?
Sorry, Comms speak. It's ingrained despite the fact that she's lost me so many Lims.
Do you have her money or not?
That was only the first part. Then they talked about doing it again. And again. They were gonna pad their accounts and sift the Lims through their false businesses.
But she didn't get the other channels, the ones I had hidden and bootlegged across different waves.
Mizzy's looking for the money you owe her.
I'm assuming you met Mizzy in a cafe in Metro Hub, right? Little corner chair like she's some slick gangster with a favorite seat that always belongs to them?

dialogues.title: Gan talks about suckin'
lines: Well if that's the case, she can grieve properly now I'm gone again. Now, If you'll excuse me, there's a really grimy bit of rat paste over there I've had my eye on for quite some time... that's it, come here you sassy minx.
Technicalities don’t matter when someone’s yelling at you about the Hetherington's Country Club gala ball. It felt real enough.
Ohhhh boy I feel things. I can feel all sorts. Sadness, joy, the familiar vibration as you suck a dead termite up your pipe hole. Vrrrrrrr.
Difficult is polite. Living with her was like arguing with a hailstorm.
If you're just a persona construct, I guess she isn't technically your actual wife?
It sucks... get it? Look, it’s not glamorous, but it beats being screamed at for "forgetting to feel." And hey, floors don’t argue back.
Thanks again for the assist friend.
Do you enjoy being a vacuum cleaner?

dialogues.title: We know all 3 candidates
lines: Let's tell Salma right away. I'm very curious what she thinks.
They are a match with at least 2 out of 3 criteria. Age, criminal career, missing memories. Who do you think could be her brother?
I think we do know 3 potential candidates for Salma's brother.
John Doe, Idlehands and the Miso Baron. You've met them all.
Would you like a fallback option or are you sure?

dialogues.title: Sanderson is pleased
lines: That's all you care about, huh?
Yeah. It's what I figured. Who ever heard of a security droid artist? Stupid. Anyway, here's your money. I'll see ya around.
Yep, Rollo was right about you. And I thought the boss was bad. Fine then, here's your cash.
Even a security droid with a ruptured cranial plate from too many headbutts?
Especially a security droid with a ruptured cranial plate from too many headbutts.
All artists deserve to get paid.
Nice work on that redecorating, chief. Boss's husband was thrilled. Loved the walls.
It's a calling. You wouldn't understand.
Thank you, you don't know what this means... maybe I'll go and buy... a sketchbook.
Just takes a bit of an artistic touch.
See that's what I told the boss you were: an artist. *sigh* Must be nice.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Terminal
lines: Thank you, CECIL GRIMES. Your data request will be processed.

dialogues.title: Go Get Recipes
lines: From other restaurants. See if you can persuade them to give up their secrets. Won't be easy though.
Nice work on the ingredients, boss. This'll get us through the day alright. Not sure about any other days though...
Well, if this place is gonna have a future we're gonna need to offer more than one dish.
Thaddeus had his own way of doing things, you know? But if we're gonna survive, we need recipes and we need them now.
Where do I get new recipes?

dialogues.title: Enough of Cecil
lines: I assume you find Mr Grimes' visits tedious?
Were you FLIRTING with Mr Grimes?
He is costing your business rather a lot of money.
Good idea. He's currently at the Seaside Boardwalk.
Coming from you, I will take that as a compliment.
How can we get rid of him?
There are several ways. But the two easiest he told us himself: get him demoted or promoted.
Is there a way to stop him fining us?
Ava, you are an evil genius.
Then it is quite simple. We ask a hacker to falsify his quotas.
I believe he would take a job in the Spire. Perhaps if we speak to someone with a business concern there?

dialogues.title: Spartacus Bakes
lines: Hey, thanks. Look, I gotta go, but come by soon, ok?
Oh hey, it's you! I mean, hey, how's it going?
I got some great news. I was talking to that donut guy, Danetti, and he thinks we can do business together.
You're going to start a shop?
Just letting you know the risks.
Oh, I know them. I'll see ya.
It's a winner. Just like you.
Yeah! I do the baking, he does the frying... dude's got some weird ideas but damn if it doesn't sound like a plan.
I was talking to that donut guy, Danetti, and he thinks we can do business together.
I'll take that as a compliment.
Screw CorpSec. You know how close I came to losing this dream. I'm not gonna let them stop me now.
I am Spartacus and I have got some news for you.
Ha! You know I like you... but not that much.
Good job I like you too then.
We're gonna call the place "Doomnetti's". What do you think?
Ha! You might be smart but you cannot do names.
Heh. Look, I gotta go, but come by soon, ok?
Not bad, I guess. I'll think about it.
All the better for seeing you.

dialogues.title: Rosco 4
lines: Oh, you know. Just another twelve hours of walking in circles, logging streets that won’t stay put, feeding data into a machine that doesn’t care. Real fulfilling work.
Yeah. Makes you wonder—when I finally do get free, will there even be a city left to leave? Or will it have all just… rearranged itself into the sea.
How much time have you worked off so far?
Ha pay. Well it doesn't exist so who cares?
Could be. But when I tried to cross-check it with Curzona’s records, guess what? Nothing. No mention. No history. Just a big blank space where data should be.
Apparently not. Because it doesn’t exist.
I found something. An old lift shaft, wedged between two towers, rusted and forgotten. But when I scanned it, the Carto Carry lit up, pulling schematics I’d never seen: ‘The Cradle Phase 1.’
What I can’t do is stop. Curzona doesn’t pay me to ask questions, they pay me to walk, scan, and shut up. And by “pay,” I mean “slowly shave time off my sentence.”
You're looking well! How's it going?
You look like hell. Rough day?
Sounds like it's above your pay-grade.
Exactly. And here’s the fun part—when I went back an hour later? Whole damn thing was gone. Just a wall where the shaft used to be.
And it’s not just this. It’s the alleys that move, the stairwells that vanish, the buildings that shift ten meters to the left overnight.
I’m starting to think mapping this city is like trying to bottle fog. The second I get it down, it changes.
Rings a bell. Is it a place?
Besides my own patience wearing down to a thread? Yeah. Ever heard of the Cradle?
Twenty Five years. Out of forever.

dialogues.title: Brother Brother
lines: Can't be shipping if you're lipping.
Anyway, What can I help you with? We are very busy here at Sea2Sea. Your leading resource in shipping solutions.
Ohhhhh, I see. If he's been speaking with us that would be through our department of human resources. They handle all communication mitigation.
Then you're acquainted. I'd say it was a pleasure but, you know, it wasn't.
I need you to resume shipments to the Oil Rig.
She told me to talk to you.
Indeed. I'm a versatile asset to many organizations throughout this great city. Commerce connections... you should know that.
Your sister said to talk to you.
How much influence do you have on the Sea2Sea policies?
That would actually be a question for our human resources department. They handle all communication mitigation.
Talk to my sister. She's overseeing that department.
He said he's been talking to you about the shipping routes.
Oh, I'm afraid I can't do that. Thank you for your inquiry though.
You've got to be kidding me.
Working. Clearly not the same as you.
What is it going to take to get you to?
Well then it's your lucky day. What can I do for you?
Did she? Interesting. Maybe I should speak with her.
I don't know who that is.

dialogues.title: Speak to Ziggy
lines: Your loss, chief. I'd offer you a hit to commiserate but I just slugged the last of my stash.
I don't want to con people.
Yo chief, chief, I got a great idea for a side hustle. Wanna hear?
Fucking A! Tell ya, the more you con Spireites, the more they love it.
Yeah! She tried to aura surf and ended up on the floor. Hit it off with some FLAVR unit down there. Didn't even know FLAVRs could flirt.
Yeah. Pretty hysterical guy! I remember!
Like I said, I tapped out. Came up smiling two days later in Helix Monu with a new tattoo. Good times!
Were you at a party with Eldridge Nyx-Curzona recently?
Gonna be a BIG hit. And I'd offer you a big hit to celebrate but I just slugged the last of my stash.
Load of Spire kids. Someone called PorridgeDog...?
I dunno, it's a haze... this trust fund chick called Minnie... Monty...
Oh man. Was I? Remind me...
Enabled him to make a library?
Sounds like fun. Thanks for the recipe.
Pog to the Og Dog! The Oatymealmeister! Brekky Bowl Bad Boy! Ha ha, yeah now I remember.
Don't forget to put that little money maker on the menu!
I dunno. I powered out after that. There was this weird kid there though. Taking photos. Wore a bowtie. Total vibe slayer.
And what, they got their pocket money doing charity work? Fuck 'em! They'll still have a good time. Guaranteed.
OK get this: aura cocktails. We serve up an empty glass, puff around some smoke and BAM. Spire kids will drop Lims like they're going outta fashion. Well?
Ha, what didn't happen! PoggyDog took some of Bo Bo's freaky stuff and entered the Lowtown Mayoral race.
You change your mind about those cocktails, you know where to find me.
That's him. What did he do?
He... ahem... he ordered a... ham daiquiri.
So that's why he exiled himself?
I dunno, I feel kinda bad talking about it man. I kinda enabled him, but it's what he wanted.
Rizzo or something, Rasmus... no Razlo. That's it.
I shoulda told him no, but what was I gonna do? The man asked! Bartender's oath, you know?

dialogues.title: Fourth Meeting with Salma
lines: I’m glad to see you too.
You’re like the rest, only eyes for the Spire. But I don’t care what’s up there. Everything I ever loved was here. I won’t give up on it.
When I wear shoes, no one can tell. If the BHSPD knew, they never would have hired me. Speaking of which, I have to go.
I can tell you’ve never been in real trouble.
To have a roof over my head, a place to sleep, food, safety… there were times in the past I thought I'd never see the sky again. So no, I don’t find it dull.
Thanks. I have to go now. Work calls.
You ever heard of "Lims for Limbs?" I was lucky. They only took my toes.
It’s so nice to have a conversation that isn't about ducts. Or broth.
Do you know why he went missing?
Then I borrowed instead, from as many loan sharks as I could find. And when I couldn’t pay it back… well.
He had a temper. But he was funny. A sweet kid underneath it all.
My parents were killed in a shuttle accident when I was twenty. Seth was only 15.
Spent every last Lim of our parents' savings searching for him. Hired a private investigator, bribed CorpSec...
If you want, I can help look for your brother...
I'm sorry I was rude before. It was nice to have a conversation that isn’t about ducts. Or broth.
I was so scared of that. I spent every last Lim of our parents' savings bribing LifeCorp to perform searches on unidentified corpses…
I didn’t stop, not even when the money was gone.
Sorry, I didn’t mean to offend you.
No. There was a man at Steam Bones who I thought could have been him but it was just my imagination, playing tricks.
So how did you get into trouble?
Hello again. I was hoping I would see you.
Yes. I've ordered so much Ramen over the years I could do it in my sleep.
It isn’t. There are more pipes than anyone can count in this city, and almost all of them have ducts, and almost half are those ducts are broken… you get the picture.
Oh, I work for the Bureau of Health and Sanitation, in the Pipes Division. Specializing in Ducts.
I see you’ve heard of Calhoun. He’s actually not as bad as people say. He only took my toes.
I have been in more than you might think.
I tried to look after him, but he fell in with a bad crowd. We argued one night, he stormed out and that was the last time I ever saw I him.
Is there anything else you remember about him?

dialogues.title: There's Bonaventure
lines: Someone called Bonavenure is waiting for you at the noodle stand.
Did they say what they wanted?
The old man waiting since 30 years for his love to return?
He's wants to speak to you. He's at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Salt Pete confirms
lines: Sang-Ha cant? Been years since anyone asked me that. I'll be rustier than Crabface, but I can read a little.
Aha! Come to haul on my keel line, eh?
I know someone who was waiting for that ship to return.
Do you know anyone who can read Sang-Ha sailor slang?
Hmm, this belonged to a clipper sailing out of Sangport. Can tell by the markings. As for the name… umm… Caramel Bee? Annabel Free?
That’s it! Thought you couldn’t read this?
This name plaque. What does it say?
Nah, close ... Annabel Lee, that's it.
I can’t. I know someone who was waiting for that ship to come in.
Well, go on, squawk away, don’t have all tide to stand here and talk.
Aye, aye. There are folk who’ll always be waiting. That’s the life of the sea.
Can you read Sang-Ha sailor slang?
Come to flap at my jib? Rattle my kedge?

dialogues.title: Deeala at Mountain Town
lines: But you're a good sport. And good fun. We could be friends, you know? If... that was something you wanted.
I am enraptured by the dark, throbbing bass and the ambient, eternal wail of the synths as I sway to the dark rhythms of my blackened heart.
None of that sounds appealing at all. I cannot overstate how much I do not want to be involved in any of what you just described.
Think sexy. Think transgressive. What have you always dreamed of wearing? If you knew no one would judge you, what would your ultimate outfit be?
Sweet. Well, I gotta go, but I'll see you around. I'm pretty busy, what with the two jobs and my, you know, whole... vibe. But we'll catch up soon!
Look, I'll level with ya. You seem alright. But I don't think you're gonna fit it at my club, or with... me. I think I'd rather we were just friends.
Right.... Oh! I remember now. I was looking at my Comm and just walking around on autopilot. But this is the right district. I am looking for Reese.
Casual sneakers, a t-shirt, jeans and a sporty watch?
A lot of mascara and black chrome and fishnets and hairspray on the dance floor, if you know what I mean. Does that appeal to you?
I am the darkness. My black heart beats with the rhythm of distorted industrial synthesizers, and I worship at the altar of endless night.
An outfit of lace and leather with lots of buckles?
Hey, it's you! Good to see you. Wait, now I've forgotten what I was doing...
You're trying a bit too hard... but I respect the enthusiasm. It's kinda adorable that you're going this hard.
I get it. Friends it is.
Never the wrong time to learn.
I mean it's not really my scene, but maybe I could explore it with the right person?
At the club? The same. Mollyphonic has benefitted from the LUZ. Our patrons appreciate a bit of murder and morbid intrigue. They embrace the darkness.
Ah, well Mollyphonic ain't for everyone. I confess, sometimes I get kinda tired of the screaming and the... darkness. I'm partial to some jazz - when I'm in the mood, and in good company.
Is that everything? How'd I do?
That's the spirit. CORA loves those who try.
Right, so I guess we do... friend stuff. Chat and bitch about our jobs and stuff like that?
Besides your clothes? Make-up. Attitude. Maybe you could have a good darkwave moniker - you know, a cool new name. Oh, and can you actually dance?
Fair play to ya, that's honest I suppose. You can always just kinda... sway. That's what most people do anyway. Not a lot of spinning or two-step at Mollyphonic.
Maybe a shirt with a band name on it?
I mean are you into darkwave gothic synthcore with a side order of chunky platform boots, latex and black lipstick. Or are you, you know... normal. Vanilla.
Look, I'll admit, I was teasing you a little. You probably don't really want to go to Mollyphonic. You probably can't even get in anyway.
Well... I'll keep it in mind. Oh, wait. Fuck fuck fuck! Reese starts his shift in 15 minutes. I have to find him. Sorry to run. Catch ya later!
But we'd need to do something about your clothes. And... well there's a lot we'd need to work on.
You're a wee ray of sunshine, ain't ya! You're either not even TRYING to impress me, or you know flattery and compliments don't work on me.
Alright, we got a plan for dancing, but what are you going to wear?
I must say, I can't picture you in that right now, but I'm sure you could pull it off. You'd fit right in darlin'.
You're trying. I can see that. It's a good start.
I dunno... You're not really my type. But who is? Let's just... see how this goes, ok?
Great! Cool! See you around. Or, you know, probably not... Love ya!
Hey, if you really are up for going to Mollyphonic some time, I could probably get you past the bouncers. Maybe even get you in for free!
What else do I need to do?
Do I really need new clothes just to get into the club?
Furry boots with a ten inch platform!
A mohawk and skull face paint?
Sure darlin'. That's good enough for me I guess.
Looking for the right person to broaden your horizons, huh? I like it.
And one of those backpacks that's shaped like a coffin.
That's not gonna cut it darlin'. You don't have to dress like a diehard cybergoth but you can't dress like a dickhead.
Well... maybe if I hear about any jazz concerts I'll hook you up. There's a place called the Blue Chui. Maybe once the LUZ clears...
And a chain with some... skulls?
And not the kind of friends that hang out a lot. Or at all. Or talk, or laugh or who go for coffee. Just like... well wishers. In that I wish you no particular harm.
He's the bartender at Mollyphonic and my boss Del is going to fire him if he's late for one more shift.
I'm not really looking for more friends right now.

dialogues.title: Talk to Rosetta
lines: I have come to visit! Which I can do! Thanks to my new logic relay!
I would like to give someone else another chance at life!
I didn't think you had any money.
Well, thank you. It's very welcome.
Not many people think to do it, but! Some do! Over the centuries it adds up.
I thought you couldn't leave the Holocropolis?
Hello! Welcome to your noodle stand!
I am allowed to receive tips!
I would like to give you 500 Lims!

dialogues.title: The ballad of Hepzibah Gimble 2
lines: Whatever you're getting upset about, I'm sure it's not worth the time or energy. Why don't you get to the point dear?

It was a shaky equilibrium, but it held. I had the information to destroy LifeCorp and Thaddeus. He held my fate in his hands as well. Bound by secrecy. I'm sure we all had safeguards too. For example, if anything ever happened to me, I have friends who would leak Thaddeus' info to LifeCorp.
She deserves to know, and be free.
Did Thaddeus have anything to do with burning the Coma Roamers to death?
We were in the perfect double-bind. He protected me, and I didn't kill him. Or Ava.
He made changes to her memories to protect her. He didn't erase the memories, he held and protected them. If Ava knew she was the last of her kind, she could put all three of us at risk.
I admit, I've enjoyed leaving you little breadcrumb hints along the way.
What does all this have to do with Thaddeus?
Ava. Your ticket to get on the white list.
Thaddeus had a personal connection with his Automata and wanted to retain her, and I knew he had the resources to keep her safe and secret.

But as long as Ava was alive, and under our auspices, her existence was evidence of LifeCorp's crime. The final coma roamer, an old friend for Thaddeus, and an insurance policy for me - Ava is many things to many people.
And Thaddeus was in on it?
If I find the body, what happens to you?
All the information was on the Deep Nets. You knew Ava could find it.
Not really. Ava was his Automata. Which was lucky. I needed a capable mind to understand the challenge.
Letting me know you had books printed on paper was a giveaway.
I knew you would be back.
I have little to hide. Why would I need to? I've been around a long time dear.
Are you gonna kill me now too Hepzibah?

Thaddeus is gone, so one corner of our little triangle of accountability is already lost. I don't know if you will find her, and if you do, I'm not sure I much care what happens to any of us afterwards dear.

And Thaddeus was one of the few people with either the skills or resources - I suspect the latter - to manipulate an Automata's memories. He seems to have even found a way to update Ava too, improving her performance and expanding her abilities.
You set me on this track deliberately.
Thaddeus is not behind everything. He didn't help, but he didn't stop me either. He just wanted something for himself.
You used Ava to protect yourself from LifeCorp killing you.
Part of our deal was that I didn't know where Thaddeus took her. I just made sure it was possible for his people to remove her frozen body before the fire.
I'm very old. As they say in this great city, this is the party at the end of the world. The final fire is burning out, and all we can do now is dance in the light of the final flames. Goodbye.
Do you know where Ava's body is located?
She kept me safe for 122 long years.

dialogues.title: Money from Razlo
lines: I couldn't possibly say. But I wouldn't eat any of the free donuts in the Curzona offices for a while.
So, you're back. Didn't think it would take you long to come sniffing around for your money.
Here, like I promised. This was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
That's commerce. Feel free to give up your share if your scruples are too much for you.
Ha, like I thought. On the inside, you're just as venal as everyone else. Here. Enjoy your reward.
CORA, you're pathetic. And down 200 Lims. Too bad for you.
Right. Where 's my money? I bet you sold the recipe.
I did. To an enterprising buyer with big plans.

dialogues.title: Get the first song lyrics off Andrea
lines: I don't like you making assumptions about me.
You want me to plant it?
Which is why I'm absolutely going to do it.
That pretty much sums me up.
I know I'm asking a lot, but if you could cast this to the wrong wind going in the right direction, I'd really appreciate it.
You look like the kinda' cat who knows people. Good and bad.
I think we need a little bit more of that in this city.
Oh boy you know I did.
Think it will be enough to get Corp-Sec's attention?
I've been thinking about what you said. About getting myself sent to jail.
It's risky in so many ways.
I'll see what I can do.
If they get a whiff I'm trying to get sent to jazz-jail they'll send me somewhere else. Then I'm double fucked.
The more I think about it, the more crazy I think it is. Getting sent to prison to jam with my band is insane.
Here's where I need your help. I'm never going to be able to get it in front of the right people without looking suspicious.
It's not cool sugar plumb, it's jazz.

dialogues.title: Meet Zaffer
lines: Uh huh. I have to go.
I like the sound of that.
Did you see the new Lapin? He did a burner right across the Canyon Central L, painted the whole thing, doors to floors. It was beautiful.
THE Lapin, Byal Lapin, the greatest artpunk this city has ever seen!
Don't think so. What does it look like?
What kind of "art" are we talking about?
Me? I'm Zaffer. You seen my art?
Save the Lapin, screw the corps!
Tragic. You better get some of my art in your eyeballs, mate.
Mostly work with signs these days. Neon-hacking, pixel-twisting... You see a board that’s been messed with, you know it’s been zaffed.
The Lapin does more than graffiti. The Lapin IS graffiti. He's everywhere, he's everything, he's a giant cosmic hand giving the corps the finger. You get what I'm saying?

dialogues.title: Ava remembers Gan
lines: Well... that path is no longer available.
Would his wife, Ceres, be an option? She still has his construct.
I have an idea about getting a code for that locked door.
Right, and I think he owes me a favor.
The sentient vacuum. Makes sense. I will have a chat with him.
Gan Coilson was CTO at LifeCorp. He might know how to get access.

dialogues.title: We try to hire Lucy 2
lines: So you know a lot about decor?
Indeed. And you need my help. Desperately. Your business looks as shabby as you do.
Are you here about the style consultant thing again?
Very well. You're lucky to get me for such a scandalously low rate. I'll see you tomorrow and we can discuss further.
Maybe... for 50 Lims you can help me.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Harper waiting
lines: Harper is at the Noodle Bar. She's really becoming a regular.

dialogues.title: Do you think its the same batch
lines: I'm honestly not sure how I feel about that.
Did you now? Least he's still doing business. Maybe this means the supply lines are back to normal.
What are you talking about take a minute to think?! Hand over the stuff so I can figure out if it's the same batch.
... I don't know who the fuck you think you are but... alright. Two days. I'll see you in two days.
If what is what? We're trying to figure out if the bad batch came from Idlehands and his suppliers.
Yeah, sure, let's party. Hand it over and we'll figure out if it's the same batch or not.
If we figure out where it came from we can... well... just let's find out who's peddling this stuff then focus on what to do with them.
Well, that's... That's gonna be something you'll need to work out. Did you manage to get anything from Idlehands?
I also got a batch from Idlehands.
I managed to score Post-Ap from Idlehands.
What do you mean am I sure I want to know? Why the fuck wouldn't I want to know?
I can't believe I'm holding this stuff again. I gotta get it to my guy. Give me two days. I'll talk to you then.
Yes, but know that won't bring her back. Trust me. Give me two days.
I have a friend who can figure out if it's the same batch or not. Let me see?
Just take a minute to think.
Are you sure you want to know?
Huh. Didn't actually expect to see you come back.
You... you went to the Holocropolis?
What if you mean something to me?
Did you manage to grab anything from Idlehands?
I got a batch from Idlehands.
Oh, I'm sure you're just as thrilled to see me. How went your little venture?
Well, part of me is touched. The other wants to rip your lungs out for acting like she meant something to you.

dialogues.title: Gladstone wants to talk to you
lines: None that I saw. But he looks a bit twitchy. You might want to get there sooner rather than later.
Mr Gladstone is at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Ava has more clues
lines: They set out to “cleanse” their followers' brains through aggressive surgeries. Many didn’t survive.
Indeed. The Forsworn splintered from the main faith and held an anti-tech position.
So she was trying to run away from the Forsworn?
Quite. The Sect was disbanded by the Bicameral Council after just a few years of operation.
It’s possible. The Bicameral archives are off limits to civilians, but Brother Jaynes may be able to share knowledge.
It means of two halves. Those who follow the Bicameral Mentality believe in keeping half of their brain empty so they can hear the voice of the true gods.
YT & TC. I’ll perform a search on any matching death records from the era. But it will take some time.
She was sacrificed on the altar of madness.
By searching the term "code-cleanse" I found an obscure order of the Church of Bicameral Mentality called “the Forsworn”.
What was she so scared of?
They were claiming that the voice of God could not be heard through digital interference.
How does that play into our ghost story?
It’s possible. The Bicameral archives are off limits to civilians, but there’s a monk in Mountain Town who may be able to share knowledge.
They splintered from the main faith and held an anti-tech position.

dialogues.title: Silas is hungry
lines: Get outta my way so I can keep working.
Prolly some punks tryna fuck with the network. Idiots think destruction equals activation. They don't understand how this all works.
Anything I can do to help?
You know what? I actually could use something. Been sluggin overtime and haven't had a chance to eat in hours. Pick me up something. I'll give you a few Lims for it.
At this point I'm too hungry to think about it. Any chance you could do me a solid and pick some grub up or something? I'll give yah the Lims for it.
Anything. Just no mushrooms. It's not the taste. It's the consistency.
Hmm. Don't mind if I do. Thanks. Just no mushrooms. It's not the taste, it's the consistency.
It's called a hint. Can't take it? I'm a contractor for DataSynth's Comm's division. Trying to install these relays to boost signal across the city.
You moving? Oh I don't know, maybe let me finish my work? Finish my job. Complete my contract. Get paid.
Gonna need yah to move, k? Got something a little bigger than fuses going on.
You sure you don't need anything?
Keep the Lims. I own a place.
Didn't hear it from me... Inside job.
Have you been getting pings from anyone other than your Automata? They've been down for a scalding hot second. You seemed smarter when you were dealing with the lights.

dialogues.title: Ashwin talking success (and quits)
lines: Second option: you get 2000 Lims every 7 days for the next 15 weeks. That's more money, but stretched out for a longer time.
We're there boss! The new chemicals work. All tests passed. We are 100% microorganism free for at least 24 hours after treatment.
I'll take the lifelong free service plus 1000 Lims for 15 weeks.
I already advised my bank. The first payment should be in your account.
Yeah! Without you and Safia that never would have happened!
And on top of that you get 1000 Lims every seven days for 15 weeks. What do you think?
Sure! And the good news is spreading fast. I already have enough orders to pay back my Curzona debt.
I will deliver the aerosol and teach your cleaners how to use it. And the first payment should already be in your bank account.
Right. Safia. It all began with her.
Ashwin. Any success with these C.E.I.s?
So now you're going to market?
Or third: you get a lifelong free service with my aerosol for all of your restaurants. That should improve your cleaners performance by 100%.
I have three options. First, I could give you 20K Lims right now.
Please tell me there's no more new cleaning technology we need to buy.
I'm also sorry to inform you that I have to quit as your cleaner. My new company takes all my attention!
I'll take the 2,000 Lims for 15 weeks.
As you wish, boss. The money's in your account!
Anyway, boss. We need to talk about me paying you back.
Our new range of cleaning products - paired with aggressive nanobots - are eliminating bacteria more effectively than any of our rivals.

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Third Meeting
lines: I'm sure you make the right decision.
Me too! But if I don't, I don't!
Probably only a matter of time if you don't stay in your hideout.
That is not the kind of negativity I need right now. And I told you, most people die at home!
It's like all the things I was worried about are in a bed, cuddled under a blanket... In a different city.
Reduced anxiety and altered consciousness does sound tempting.
Danny Danetti? Okay. But I might not trust him with the address if I have doubts he can deal with CorpSec.
Well, either way, I hope you stay safe!
See! Saying something like that would normally make my stomach knot up with stress, but instead I feel even more relaxed.
If you're in danger, maybe you should be worried.
You should keep a low profile.
I met him. But I'm not sure I'd tell him the address. That's dangerous knowledge.
Well, they haven't tracked me down yet!
Look I know you're right but Ma Gomba gifted me some strange mushrooms and since I've been eating them, things have been... Lighter.
I think a little anxiety is good when running a business.
Anyway, I gotta go. If Danny Danetti asks for me: that's okay. He's my brother. You can level with him. As for everybody else - you don't know me.
And don't answer the door unless.
Look I'm sure she'd hook you up if you asked her.

dialogues.title: Humour Bot 17 encore
lines: So tell me a joke then.
There's also friendship, love... other stuff.
There's more to life than jokes.
You learn how to make people laugh real fast when it's the only thing that stops them hurting you.
Please ignore my musings humanoid. My humor chip was not engaged.
Of course I am right. Mirth is the only way we can continue to exist in the absurdity of this world. We must find the mirth.
You have not yet processed payment for my previous jokes. Therefore, mirth is not available for you. Good day.
Indeed. My humor chip is the only thing that keeps me from deactivating myself. If we cannot laugh, what can we do?
Inconsequential. Additionally, you still owe me payment for my previous jokes.

dialogues.title: Alexandria  Player Won
lines: The LUZ isn't going anywhere. We have plenty of time to meet again.
Whatever you have to tell yourself.
Even a broken clock is right twice a day.
Yup, and it's time for you to go.

dialogues.title: Help Rosetta
lines: Are you trying to make me feel guilty?
Forty-two percent of her components are no longer functional.
That was sad. Her records indicate that LifeCorp haven't granted her a break in over twenty-six years.
Just some empathy from one AI to another. I apologize ...
Yes. It shouldn't be too hard to source one from a specialist parts broker. We should act quickly though. Rosetta may not have much time left.

dialogues.title: Oh This View Was for Me
lines: Thank you. This has been... this is good conversation to relax my mind with.
Oh, you found me. This view was one of my favorites.
I would prefer that actually. Solitary in our solidarity.
At any given time there are a number of people looking for a number of things. Some of them other people.
So you keep it in the past?
This is one of the better views in Nivalis, wouldn't you say?
Yeah, that's what I figured you'd say. If you don't mind I have some time to kill and I'd like to do it by myself.
That's me! And I love it but sometimes I need some me time, you know?
Exactly. Because at that period of time it was in fact the best view.
I get that. It's been real.
Thank you. Remember to stop and enjoy the view every once and awhile.
Maybe we could just stand here and enjoy it for a few?

Because if you look at things in the past tense it means you've appreciated them. If I were to say, this is my favorite view, it would leave it open to the possibility of being disappointed when something else surpasses it.
No, it's ok. If anyone were to find me I'm glad it's you.

dialogues.title: Player finds Enchiridion fragment
lines: Oh, I have to get this under a microscope…
Some say he’s actually a shapeshifting droid who can take human form...
All that work for a fishing rumor?
What? Oh yes, I did promise, didn't I? Alright, have you heard the story of the Macrogillean?
Well, I know plenty of fishermen who would kill for that rumor. Or... maybe not "kill." Lightly maim.
There’s more where that came from.
Some say he’s an ancient carp who devoured his CEO owner and fled to the Sewers. Others say he’s a mutant trout, the product of bio-corp experimentation.
I'll keep that in mind, thanks.
Hey, did you find any fragments yet?
Fascinating. Looks like junk. But this scratch here, it might be the symbol for “up” and this one, some kind of numeral…?
Who knows? But an old fisherman once told me a secret: that the Macrogillean can only be caught in the waters off the islands after dark.
Right! Well, legend has it that the Macrogillean is the largest fish ever seen in Nivalis waters.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 9
lines: Life is about giving 100% (Not applicable when donating organs or blood)
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Brother Why
lines: I'm not seeing anybody else talking to me right now.
Wait, when did you convene and vote?
I can't believe you already did it.
It's actually Commerce and Monetary Gain. You'd do best to get it correct.
Process is everything here at Sea2Sea.
Why were you wasting my time?!
Your sister told me you're Commerce and Monetization.
I want to know why you and your sister are messing with me.
I was told to speak with you.
You've been asking the wrong people to get things done. You can't go to HR to negotiate trade agreements. And now you are being rude.
Actually, it was just a few minutes ago.
Doing what? You came up to me.
Easy. You've been asking the wrong people to get things done. You can't go to HR to negotiate trade agreements.
And you can't bother maintenance with ocean navigation.
I thought you worked in Maintenance?
If you have complaints or feedback I'd invite you to speak with our customer care team.
Simple enough. Our Commerce and Monetary Gain committee voted 3-1 to reestablish the flow of goods. The first ships should be headed out.
Are you stupid? You know exactly what I mean.
I just need you to reopen the shipping routes to the Oil Rig.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 6
lines: I guess you're right. Let's find Huckstash.
Indeed. I have been speaking to an Automata who was a replacement for another digital assistant. That assistant was fried when a mystery woman hacked their network-bond. Made a real mess.
So you could be in danger too?
I've been doing some deeper research regarding the name Gamova. I assume it's some kind of pseudonym, but it has been cropping up more and more on the network.
I really don't trust her. I think we should try and speak to Huckstash.
While I appreciate your concern, I feel we must prioritize the safety of fully organic lifeforms... Like you.
We're in this together. Let's find Huckstash.

dialogues.title: Meet Mia Jay
lines: Yeah, those are in poor taste.
No shit. At least what I'm looking for serves an actual purpose. I just gotta get all of them in order to amplify that purpose. Ahhh, I'm almost there! Almost.

Just because we're in the Sewers doesn't mean you have to live in the gutter. Though I'm not opposed to directness. Just, in the middle of something. Only got seven left of these tumblers then I get my question.
A handful of people have. Though one was an android so not sure if that counts. Probably does. I mean, they're just like us. Hopes and dreams and all. I just need seven more and I'll have them.
Right?! No one's ever seen it though, so you gotta wonder where the stories come from, you know? But that's half the fun! Finding out if there's truth to the myth.
Nothing! That's the thing. Well, I guess I've been a little focused on the k20 collection. But I'm almost there! Finding all of them has to come first. If you lose focus then it's all over.

I can't tell you that! If I tell you then I won't get an answer. Wait... is that just for wishes? Nevermind. Honestly, I don't know. I have things I want to know, but mainly I just want to see the ghost too.

Oh, shit, well I'm just blundering up all the bits today. You're from the Wastes aren't you? I really didn't know. You look great. Groomed, the whole thing. I'm Mia. Mia Jay. I'm trying to complete my k20 Tumbler collection.
Probably, knowing me. I mean, everyone needs friends you know? Sadly, I owe lots of people a ping pretty soon. But that's on me and that's ok.

Um, well, I'd have to dig them up. And honestly, while I believe you wanna help me, there is still a chance you're just another collector and you're playing me. Tell you what... if you find one and bring it to me then I'll dig up some clues for the others, yeah?
There's still places that take longer than a minute for a grub drop?

Oh! Haha, nice one! You're funny. Are you sure you're willing to help? I've been at this forever and I'm still missing these seven. Though I really think there's one over there. Really. I just haven't confirmed... Yet.
I couldn't ask you to do that. It's a lot. Also, I don't know if that really counts, you know? Like, I should be able to find them all myself if I want to be the best collector.
Sweet! Let me know if you find any!
What if I help you find them?
Oh... Well, that makes sense. Thanks for the offer though.
Seems like a lot for some mugs.
Nothing? Hmm. I guess I've been doing this too long. I'm almost there though. Only seven left to go then I get my question.
Oh, you're not—sorry. I ordered a pizza like... 5 minutes ago? I mean really? Thought you were finally my food.
Oh, see that building over there? The office window glowy place? I'm pretty sure they have the xlb style k20 on their counter.
You're not from the Wastes and you don't know what k20s are? But hey, who am I to judge? k20 made 123 styles of their tumblers. Beautiful drink ware with shimmering eyes on the side.

Sweet! Alright, well, I have seven left. Let me know if you find any of them. Some people have them, others are supposedly lost in the world somewhere. But there's clues and all this other shit out there, though I think that's all just noise.
Wait! Hold on. Lemmie just... Ok, maybe you could help.
I figured. Oh well. I'm sure it will be here soon... I think. I don't know. I can't leave this spot right now so it doesn't matter. Wait, who are you? What are you doing here?
Right?! You'd think they'd invest in new runs. Anyway. Wait, who are you? What are you doing here?
What are you going to ask it?

xlb-k20 Tumbler? You know? The k20 drink ware line? They're great. Will keep iced fusions cold for weeks, and hot ones scalding for days. Blessed be the caffeine circuitry. I'm almost there though. Only seven left to go then I get my question.
They're not just some mugs. They're k20s! The primo drink ware and liquid transport container.

No weirder than half the other trends passed through the Nets. Scald bucket challenge? One legged boot lickers? Those retro plush toys of extinct animals? Like, cool, we can now have stuffed toys of things that should be alive, yay!
Awe, that's sweet. You're kinda cool. And kinda cute too. Just wanted to put that out there. Even so, I need to focus on my collection right now. Maybe when I finally have them all we can hang out!
If only they weren't so hard to find or, you know, they made more than one or two of the limited edition styles. Damn bastards knew what they were doing that's for sure.

Well, rumor has it if you can place all 123 in a circle the eyes will blink and the ghost appears. You get one question. ANY question, and the universe gives you an answer. The ghost is the messenger.

dialogues.title: Stacks
lines: Be careful in The Stacks, it's mostly run by the gangs here. The residents seem to like it that way too.

dialogues.title: Thanks from Bou
lines: Can’t blame you. We do make the best. Anyway, I've got good news.
Yeah well, he’s back out making deliveries. Good news for you, huh? No more annoying coffee girl talking your ear off. Ha.
I'd like that. Nice to know there's more to me than coffee making skills! Speaking of, want one for the road?
His dance machine got stuck on “continuous” mode. He was voguing for eight days straight before the power ran down.
Because someday soon I'm gonna walk away from the milk frother and step onto one of these trains. See what the coffee tastes like on the other side of the departures board.
From someone else. Here's one for the road. I'll be seeing you... maybe.
That's a shame. I enjoyed it.

You know it's funny, I see some people every day of their lives. I know their names, their allergies, their schedules but you're the only one who has ever actually stopped to talk. It made me remember something.
Morton, our delivery droid is back. So I won't be asking you for any more favors.
Can I get that coffee now?
Well, if it isn’t my favorite coffee slinger. Can’t thank you enough for stepping in like that. Really.
I'm just in it for the free coffee.
That I'm a person. That I should exist outside of this booth.
Thanks for visiting PoccoCoffeeCup. We - I - hope to see you again soon.
But where will I get my coffee?!
I'll still come back and see you.
Why does it sound like you're saying goodbye?
I hope so. Anyway, here's one for the road. I'll be seeing you... maybe.
I did too. Gonna miss our chats, you know?
Did you put anything in the Black Ultra Grande coffee?
Yeah, no more annoying coffee girl talking your ear off. Ha.
What? No! Why would you ask that?

dialogues.title: A rat's ass!
lines: Jewelry, bits of tech, lost trinkets, spare parts... the sewers are full of expensive things, if you know where to look.
So I have asked them to help!
My rats told me that you've been collecting. A little here, a little there. They like it.
The, err, rats want to donate?
Yes, you! I've been hearing whispers that you're trying to save the McKenna boy's life.
Because more humans means more rats. They want us to be one family.
We have decided to dedicate a day's findings to the boy. It comes to 324 Lims!
And I know where to look. The rats take care of me. Like I take care of them.
That's actually really good. Thank you, Gladstone.
Ah, my friend, there you are!
Just remember to thank the rats!
Their claws aren't built for Lims. But they see things, nice things, and they tell me where to find them.

dialogues.title: Boardwalk Ady first meeting
lines: I have more good jokes! I will share them if you join me for fishing.
A fishing pole of course! Just find some water and cast. Let the fish do all the work.
This is a joke, yes? Like the story of the underwater boat made of fruit.
You are wondering why we would be catching such fish? To use it as bait to catch something better! Just like life. We must take misfortune and remake it into fortune.
For eating? They are not! Indeed, a single bite will likely leave you writhing in agony for three hours.
Just find a spot and cast a line. Or take a boat and get some real fishing done. But why swim before you can paddle?
Come back and see me when you've caught something. Then we can REALLY talk fish, eh?
I happen to have an extra. It's old and a bit rusty but... better than using your hands!
Indeed! This spot is the best I've found all month. The lampet eels are biting!
Could I get rich selling fish?
Where do I get a fishing rod?
Hello my friend! Won't you join me?
Well, even if you don't like my jokes, you are welcome to join me for some fishing.
I already have a fishing rod.

dialogues.title: Speak to Dotson
lines: And where did this perambulation occur?
With you! How confounding. What were you doing?
Because she would have been seen by Nets reporters if she had left the hotel.
Just talking. We went for a walk.
Because Hanz Grundown tried to bribe me to be her alibi.
There you are, my fellow sleuthhound, my gumshoe pal! We have a case! A most confounding case!
Indeed… and what time was this?
Gadzooks, then she could indeed have been at the scene during the event in question! Thank you my friend, I will find her and resume my investigation forthwith!
There has been a possible fatality at the Grundown Ritz! So far there are only rumors.
Then the mystery remains unsolved… dear me. Dear dear me.
That a guest of Ms Minty Chrome-Valience was found deceased last night in a most COMPROMISING manner!
A bold deduction! How do you know?
Gadzooks, then you are her alibi my dear friend!
But now that Dotson is on the job you can rest assured that the mystery will be swiftly solved.
Gadzooks, you're right! Thank you my friend, I will find her and resume my investigation forthwith!
Much as I admire your digestive tract, I will need more to go on, in this case.
If you are indeed her alibi, then all of my deductive processes have been incorrect. I thought my sleuthing powers were second to none... this is terrible. I must go and reflect on my failings.
Gadzooks! So she WAS at the hotel! I will conclude my investigation forthwith!
But it is puzzling. I have interviewed Ms Valience and she insists that she was nowhere near the scene.
That’s right. She was with me.

dialogues.title: First Meeting JR Amiga
lines: and then getting dumped by your agent for being too "verbally offensive", all while your father has cut you off the credit cards. How does that sound morally?
No that stuff is illegal. What are you working on?
The only thing that will be selling out is my debut novel "Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity."
You could have written a comedy!
Remind me, what is a CBI?
They've had some positive results... Sure, a few people have had neural meltdowns, a few didn't make it off the table.
Oh, this? I'm working on… It's fiction.
I just hope my novel: 'Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity.' finally gets published. It could be worse. I could be working in a ramen stand or something.

Criminal Behavioral Implants? They're pretty new. Some neuroscientists noticed most criminals had pretty crummy childhoods, so they started implanting them with happy memories to see if they could change them from the ground up.
Yes… Well no… I'm writing CBI's while I'm between agents. Just putting potatoes on the table.
That's... look... I'm just really busy here. This isn't noodle cooking, formative childhood experiences don't write themselves.
Sounds like it could have moral implications.
Do you have any of that underground digitally-enhanced neuro-coffee at your place? I've not slept in three days.
So you're not really a writer then.
I have no idea, but the way I see it, if I'm doing my job well, they won't care.
Like you'd know. Can't imagine running a noodle stand requires much reading.
What happens to the real memories?
Moral implications? Try getting cheated out of the advance of your first novel because it was deemed too "politically offensive".

dialogues.title: Spartacus Shares
lines: So you were out of a job?
Not if you sulk like a loser. Get out there and get mean!
Sure. Thanks for listening. It was... kinda nice to remember the good times for a while.
Not unless a couple hundred Lims fall out the sky. Look, I gotta get going. But thanks for listening, it was... kinda nice to remember the good times for a while.
Isn’t there another way you could pay it back?
Promise you won’t rat me out? Blow my brand?
You know why. I can’t quit. I owe the gym for all my mods.
Nothing. Just thinking about the match with OB4. Watched some of her old fights. She’s brutal. Rip-the-capacitor-out-your-chest-and relocate-it-to-your-tertiary-outlet brutal. I can’t beat that.
Bare Metal was your calling then?
Eh. That's Bare Metal for you.
Some nights, when there's no one around, I’ll walk past restaurant kitchens just so I can smell the ovens. Wonder what it would be like to step back through the door.
How did you get into Bare Metal Boxing anyway?
Look, I'm too busy to chat right now.
I know. Guess it’s a habit. You mind if I call you that, anyway?
I didn’t. There was this outbreak, some freak toxic fungus that killed all the wheat. Bakery went bust.
Alright. Truth is, I used to be a baker. Working with dough, kneading, proofing. Takes some strength.
Yeah. No one was hiring. I was down to my last Lims when I walked past the MechaTomb and met Floyd. He reckoned I could make it in Bare Metal. So... here I am.

dialogues.title: Talk to Mary-Nyx Curzona
lines: You. I've been meaning to have a little chat.
I'm just trying to help a kid.
Always talking when you should be listening. You think that kid has it bad? We can make your life far worse. And shorter.
Don't see that it's any of your business.
If not, there will be consequences.
I would rather strangle the boy myself.
A decision that might cost you. Sleep on it.
Every time I think you can't get more pathetic, you manage to surprise me.
Just in case I wasn't clear: charity is counter-productive and will not be tolerated. The campaign stops.
I'm not giving up the campaign.
Everything is my business. Debt most of all.
Why don't you surprise me by donating?
I heard a rather distressing rumor that you're trying to undermine the generational debt of the McKennas. We advise against it.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 7
lines: The greatest glory in living lies not in never failing, but in never trying in the first place, because then you can avoid failure altogether.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Quince or Vik
lines: He is based in Industrial. Your HUD has been updated with the information.
He's dead. I've found another vendor who may be able to help. I'll update your HUD with his details.
Ordinarily, I would recommend a visit to Quince Crogan, the gut-broker, to acquire parts, but...
His name is Quince Crogan, aka the Gut-Broker.

dialogues.title: Ava comments on Safia
lines: I don't have the time for this Ava.
Yeah. Out of his league. What should we tell Ashwin?
I think if he lost this job he would really spiral. We should help him if we can.
You need to talk to Ashwin. He needs a new perspective. A new purpose.
She's a thoughtful, attractive woman. I can see why Ashwin fell in love with her.
We can offer him some support. Get him back on track.
I agree. The young man needs help.
I think Safia is right. He needs a hand on his shoulder.

dialogues.title: Mila Calcifer continues the Interview
lines: The noise a single dad makes who has not quite come to terms with the sudden death of his wife six years ago.
His wife... my mother... was a very special person. An exemplary woman. My dad might need you to... go slow.
No one can fix him Mila. He needs to grieve.
Really? I'm... excited to see where this development leads. I understand. You have one more task to complete for your final assessment.
I like Garnet but just as a friend.
So you chatted with my dad again huh?

Mr Gospodin - my father - often cooks me dinner after a long shift driving his taxi cab. When he comes home, and when I am asleep, I often hear noises from the adjoining room. Our apartment has terrible soundproofing.

I hope so. Really... I mean it. It will take dad a long time to come around. He's pretty fragile. But... I think one day we'll split a pizza with you. If you wanted that. And then... I guess see how you feel about him.
I don't know how to fix him Mila. But we can both try our best.
He cries every night. How would you rectify this situation and fix him?
Always one up your sleeves, kid?

Well I am pleased to say you have made the final shortlist of candidates. You have an excellent chance of being Mr Gospodin's friend and/or romantic partner. Can I confirm this is still what you want?
I understand. Then you have one more task to complete for your final assessment.
I'm not sure I wanna know ...
It just takes time Mila. Be there for him.
I like Garnet and I'd like to see where things go romantically.
Oh, and if you see him, tell him I left him some pizza for after his shift. The good kind.
There is just one additional fact I must make you aware of.
Will you hurt him? And will you leave us?
Mr Gospodin, though feeling much better of late, has gone through a... rough patch. As such, he may not be ready for an intimate relationship right now. Not for a while.
Oh, you know. Just single-dad noises.
Very good. Then I am pleased to say that I can now offer you the position of Mr Garnet Gospodin's newest social contact with upgrade potential to romantic partner. Best of luck in this new position.
I won't hurt either of you. And I'll be there as long as you both want me around.
Please save your own questions for the end. I have more questions of my own. Important ones.
Are you kidding? No! Of course not. But it does have capers.
That is... a most satisfactory answer. Yes, very good.
I won't hurt him. And I'm not going anywhere.

dialogues.title: McFellow in Metro Hub
lines: That remains to be seen. They are sneaky you know?
I was told to give you a name and a place. That's all.
Nobody knows. Only THEY know who THEY are.
Not that I know of. All quiet.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Huckstash
lines: Not sure why. But I'll go see him.
Of course he is. Alright, I'll see him.
Huckstash is waiting for you at the noodle stand. I get the impression he is displeased.

dialogues.title: Gemelar wants umbrellas
lines: When it rains, half the customers stay away because our tables are getting wet.
How will talking to ME help the performance of my staff?
Let's try to keep it respectful.
Fine. I'll look into the umbrellas. You get on with your work.
I've been meaning to talk to you.
We have this wild new invention. "Umbrellas" bucko. They're really great.
You have a point, but please stop calling me "Bucko."
Waiters are waiting empty tables during the rain. Chef's have nothing to cook. The cleaners are mopping up puddles.
I'll listen to you and you do the same?
I'm used to a relaxed vibe. I'll try to keep it a bit more... profesh.
You want me to buy umbrellas?

dialogues.title: Gunger hates people correcting him
lines: I think there's SOMETHING out there.
Well, that's not much imagination friend. Or maybe it is. Sometimes it's easier to imagine the end of the universe than an end to... all this.
And those little beams of light, thin as a pencil because the trees are so dense. Imagine such a thing!
I... do have a lot on my mind.
Good for you. Good for you.

I reckon those wastes are a lot less lifeless than the corps tell us. I mean, I don't think it's all green grass and cherry pie, but there's got to be more than radioactive sand and giant rats, right?
Anywhere. Pick a direction and go there. That's how my feet work. You think you'll ever get out of here?
Damn. I thought someone younger like you would be more... hopeful. You know, I'd love to head out into the wastes one day.
That's what they call it, right? But who says that it's really "wasted"? I mean, you look around here. Doesn't this feel like a wasteland to you?
Hello chief. You ok? You look like you have a lot on your mind.
You're making fun of me? Watch out...
Yeah? Well the main thing ringing in my old brain right now is this Unity Zone. I have a wanderlust, and this lust is going unfulfilled.
What would you want that something to be?
I see wasted people from time to time.
But if there was, what would you want to see?
Foaming ocean waves and a boat to sail them. What a wonder that would be.
The enthusiasm of youth. Love it. Let's hope so. I'd love to head out into the wastes one day.
I think there's nothing out there.

dialogues.title: Campaign report week 3
lines: Reena's Nets profile says she is unavailable at present. So perhaps focus on Clancy.
Thanks to Mr Pantermino we collected 5661 Lims this week. Plus a few extra directly.
By bringing Clancy and Reena on board we collected a huge 11,322 Lims this week, plus direct donations.
Reena's lights helped to bring in 3774 Lims this week, plus the individual donations. We need more reach: Mr Pantermino could help.
Indeed. I'll send the balance to your HUD.
We're getting there. I've sent the current balance to your HUD.
I think his help will be critical. I've sent the current balance to your HUD.
We need to move fast, Iann doesn't have much longer. I'll send the current balance to your HUD.
The campaign needs more reach. Clancy and Reena could both help with that. Without them we collected only 1887 Lims.
We're entering the final stretch now. I've added a few more people to the list. Check it out.
The results are in for the third week of the funding campaign. Are you interested?

dialogues.title: What'd She Say
lines: How does people dealing with things they're handed go against scripture? If anything, the ones and zeros help us process what's happening.
No... but the Binary God determines... Processing is part of the code that's programmed into each and every one of us.

I... I need to get back to the church. Thank you for checking on my friend. I hope you find whatever it is you're looking for. Even more so, I hope you're more understanding of those who already have.
While I know there are gray areas in the world, I also know it's the ones and zeros that code order out of madness. That truth is enough for me to move forward.
Doesn't that go against your scripture?
And yet life provides us with endless ways to grieve.
How people process is gray. There isn't a right thing to do.
I asked you to check on a friend and you do this?
Listen, thank you for checking on her. I... appreciate the gesture, but I think I'll take it from here.
I don't think grieving a dead sibling exactly equates to crazy. People process loss differently.
You were supposed to check and comfort not check and insult! I have three snarky holo memes about 'the company I keep'.

dialogues.title: Sal wants you to trash a joint
lines: I would, kid. I would. Thing is, as good as I am, there are always gonna be folks who'll be jealous of old Sal...
Then you ain't got what it takes to be a restauranteur. Ah too bad, kid. We coulda done great things together.
Ha, you know, you got the makings of a great restauranteur.
Other folks play dirty, so can we. If someone were to mess with Fusion's kitchen, we'd have a chance to rise to the top.
Crabsticks. I'm impressed. You got the makings of a fine restauranteur, kid.

dialogues.title: Gunger talks murder
lines: BAM! Take them out too. While wearing overalls to protect me from the... mess.
No, I really don't like this subject.
That's... a really terrible idea. I mean why would they eat it? And if they did, why would they swim? And you don't drown because of a tummy ache. Are you even taking this seriously?
Aw no, it's not like that. I don't got no enemies. Not really. It's just an interesting thought exercise.
In their apartment, late at night.
Knock on their door. Taser them when they answer. While they're incapacitated, an injection between the toes where no one will see the puncture wound. Put them back in bed.
Who are you going to murder?
Electrocution. Run an electric current into the water.
You're an elevator engineer now are you? I dunno. I'm not sold.
So I've been thinking about the perfect murder.
My android sidekick will wait for them under the water. Then the android grabs them and pulls them down and holds them under.
Hide a weapon in the toilet stall the day before. Walk into the restaurant, go to the restroom, grab the pistol, come out and shoot him point blank while he eats. BAM!
How would you trap them? And if they're already trapped in the pool, wouldn't they just drown eventually?
It's not bad, but... It's too easy to get rumbled. Most restaurants will spot a fake waiter.
I don't know if you understand how elevators work my friend, but when you cut the cord, the elevator doesn't go down. It stays in place. Or goes up. The counterweight you see...
Alright, say you're gonna off someone and you want to make sure you never get caught. How do you do it? Let's go step-by-step.
I'm not sure it's healthy to be obsessed with murder.
Instead of breaking in I could poison their delivery food....
I'd observe the targets patterns. Listen to the pulse of the city. Strike when it's quiet and no one is around. Silencer on the gun to reduce noise and reduce muzzle velocity for less mess.
Holo-point to the back of the skull. BAM!
Drowning. I would drown them in the swimming pool.
I'd clone their door key so I could get in and hide.
Swap the pool water with acid.
You're an engineer now are you? And how do you get into the apartment next door? That's just pushing the problem one door over! You're not taking this seriously...
Right! So first off... who do you want to kill. No! Don't tell me. Just think of the victim. Hold them in your mind. Did you think of someone?
Cook them a really big meal, then when they swim they'll get a stomach ache and drown.

That's... bold. But it feels like you're not even trying to create the perfect murder. The loudest perhaps. Witnesses, a murder weapon, blood splatter... it seems pretty terrible as a plan, I have to say.
I like it! Quiet. No witnesses. Easy to get the jump on them. Now onto the method. How will you do it?
Keep it simple. Poison their food.
I'll tell you. Another time. For now, I gotta go. But I enjoyed the chat. Thanks for indulging me. And don't go killing anyone for real.
Public space, but lots of possibilities! I'm interested in why you chose there. What's your method?
That's an interesting choice. I like it! Now onto the method. How will you do it?
I like your spirit! I feel I have a pretty good set up for a perfect murder. A murder that you could never be caught for committing.
Aww come on. Just for fun.
Chilling. I like it. Good work. You creepy motherfucker.
Well that's smarter than sourcing a swimming pool full of acid. But you'd still need a lot of chemicals, you'd need to break in, and I'm still unsure of the lethality. It needs work.
Simple. Effective. But loud. And messy. Blood splatter all over you. People would hear. What happens when you step out the lift if someone sees you?
I'd go in through the apartment next door and use the air vent system to sneak in.
I'd only be in their apartment for a minute then I'd be long gone. I'd hack the locks so there was no damage.
That's very clever. Not perfect but... I think it's simple and you can make a quick getaway. Gonna be hard to catch you. Nice plan.
Exactly! And when they get to the deserted rooftop and open the door, I put the gun to their forehead and pull the trigger.
I'll dress as a waiter. Intercept their order at the pass and bring them the poisoned food.

Sure, if they HAVE a neural augment that will work. Maybe. But you have to hire a hacker, so there's an accomplice. And hacks are expensive to buy, and even the pricey ones can be traced... as a murder plan, it's got some holes.

You're an elevator technician now are you? I guess you could learn how to do it. And it's unique, I'll give you that. It allows for privacy. Sneaky. I don't think anyone has tried it before. I... like it.
I have some connections. And the cameras wouldn't see much.
Not that I know, but they might have erased my memories.
Well you sound confident enough. Which is weird. But I still don't buy it. There's plenty of more subtle methods.
I'd engage the pool cover and the acid would make sure they die more quickly.
I'd hit them over the head, knock them unconscious, then push them into the pool.
Easier to intercept, and it's easy to pay off a delivery driver, or impersonate them. It's not a bad plan...
I could trap them in the pool THEN add the acid.

... Hard to get caught... Easy delivery... You're nice and close... Easy escape... It's good. It's very good. You still need to source the poison. There's a murder weapon. And security cameras in the elevators.
Neural virus. Hack their neural augments and simply deactivate their consciousness.
And here's the deal: if you can convince me you could get away with murder, I'll tell you how I'd do it. And my murder method... well I know it works.
Aww come on. Everyone has thought about it. Be honest.
That's a bit too up-close-and-personal. And what do you hit them with? That's a murder weapon. And maybe they fight back. It's... not great.
Ok. Now, where do you off them? We need a location. Where can you get at someone without being spotted or identified? And remember, you need to catch them off-guard. Vulnerable.
Aren't you afraid people are going to think you're the serial killer?
Poison. Right. But you're in a restaurant. How are you getting to their food? Sneaking in the kitchen? And what if someone else eats it? High risk...
I could get add chemicals to lower the pH of the water.
Sneak up on them while they're sleeping. Pillow on their head then pull the trigger.

That's suspiciously close to how the professionals do it. You still have a murder weapon, and need to procure a taser and poison, leaving a paper trail. But otherwise, that's a solid plan. Say, you aren't ex-military are you?
All well and good, but those purchases of protective gear would leave a paper trail. And electricity is still dangerous. And unpredictable. Your method is good... but not perfect.
A public place. But you get a moment of privacy, and you can get close. I like it! Now onto the method. How will you do it?

Well... that's horrible. I like it. But that might not kill them outright. Even a strong acid - I think your method of murder must be more lethal. And where would you get that much acid? And transport it in secret? I dunno... the more I think about it, the less I like it.
Cut the elevator cord while they're inside. They plummet.
That solves the mess problem. But you still have to dispose of the overalls. There's a murder weapon... I dunno. It's pretty weak overall.
Well... it's grisly, I'll give you that. You don't have to get too close, and it might even look like an accident. Some logistical issues - getting the acid and all that. But not bad!
I'm obsessed. OBSESSED! Can't get enough. Me and Marv talk about it all day long.
Ah yes! It would seem like an accident. But how would you drown them?
Connections, eh? And a poison needle is pretty easy to conceal. You've put some thought into this one. I like it.
That takes some expertise. You're putting yourself in danger breaking in, and the method is not foolproof. I don't like it.

Hey... that's pretty clever. Even if the electricity doesn't kill them outright, it will paralyze their muscles and they'll drown. Risky though... Electricity. Easy for that to backfire and shock you instead. And a pool full of water... very risky.

Well that cuts down on mess, and minimizes noise. It's up close and personal though, and there's a murder weapon to dispose of. And how do you break in? I dunno. It's simple, which I like, but there's clear drawbacks.
Indirect, and not too messy. But prone to error. You can't guarantee they'll take the poison. And you still need to SOURCE the poison. And break in. There are clear drawbacks.
The Aseptic is sloppy. I got some ideas on how to do a better job. Want to share yours?
Brush past them and jab them with a poison needle.
I'd get my android conspirator to set up the electrical charge.
Sneak in and poison their food. Nerve agent in their coffee or cereal.
You're a hacker now? Or you're going to recruit one? Too many leads going back to you. Accomplices, traceable hacks. I don't like it.
Aerosol bottle of poison. I knock over their glass "by mistake" and spray while they are distracted.

That... could work. It would look like an accident, it's very effective, with no witnesses and no murder weapons. But... you'd have a co-conspirator. That's not a perfect murder. There's still a possibility you'd be caught. It's not foolproof.

dialogues.title: Marius discusses his leg A
lines: Also while I have you. Remember what I said about Aengus Prince?
Can I get a refund on the other payments?
Remember before when I mentioned Aengus Prince?
Look I don't really know what your point is here.
Ok, a little less with the leg stuff buddy. Look get my leg back and I'll give you protection for life, free of charge. Gratis.
You think I misplaced it? Left it on the train? Fuck no! This was Aengus Prince's work.
I was a fool! I looked up to Aengus. He's one of the greats, I offered my leg as a sort of fleshy olive branch. I just wanted him to take me under his wing.
So he'll leg it when you approach him?
I'm trying to make a point out of it. How do you think I got like this?
You're welcome. All part of the service.
Lims for Limbs baby. It's an investment.
Can't do kid. Firstly, seeing him still makes me weak at the knees.... knee. He really is a very good chef.
Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.
Oh it's all just so simple for you isn't it?
Ok fine what if we worked something else out?
The point is, this stuff is bigger than us. You have people out here collecting human limbs for some reason. You need to watch your back.
If the leaderboards are so dangerous, how have you survived so long?
If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.
How dare you. I'm very athletic usually.
What did he do with it?
You seem to be doing ok?
I didn't want to make a point out of it.
What did he do with it?
You'll notice your knees are still attached.
Well he could still have my leg. Could you check in with him for me?
Yeah after I lent it him.
Survived? Look at my legs. Do I look like I'm surviving?
Secondly, I'm worried he'll just run away if he sees me and my ego wouldn't take it.
Well there is a rumor that he's collecting human flesh for something.

dialogues.title: Meeting Salma
lines: Sometimes I feel like I'm just supposed to talk to everyone.
I disagree. I don't know anyone and see no reason to change that.
Just trying to make friends in the LUZ.
I don't mean to be rude but... why are you asking? You don't know me, and I'm sure I don't know you.
I keep my head down. Just try to stay out of trouble. Like CorpSec says.
I... Excuse me, I have to go.
Oh. I see. Well, I don’t know anyone so I can't help you.

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus Told to Destroy
lines: You said you had cured aging.
No... we were talking about your research last time.
I can see how that would sway you.
Well I thought I'd misplaced it at first, but remembered eventually a man in a suit came to my lab and asked me for it.
And you GAVE it to him?
I remember you. You replaced my third hip didn't you?
Well, look. It is what it is, until it isn't and it isn't an 'is' anymore. I'm considering taking up one of my side hobbies.
The Corps will have it now.
I was good at biology in school. Maybe I could find a cure for aging?
Immortality. Maybe you should also look into memory loss.
Can I help you find it?
Oh, I see! Yeah, that. I remember. A stranger told me to destroy it so I did... well I tried to.
It was a very nice suit.
Well it's really rather hard to destroy a thing that's no longer there?

dialogues.title: Find Safia in Hive Mall
lines: Now he's a heart-sick animal. Feeling sorry for himself. Avoiding me, then finding excuses to be around me through mutual friends.
He's still young, you know. He'll get over this. Maybe he'll be a good man, maybe not. Right now, he doesn't need romance. He needs a friend. Or failing that, a friendly boss.
I'm his boss, and when I asked him about his poor performance, your name came up.
I've dated guys like that before. It never works out.
He's not in love with me, he's in love with the idea of being in love.
I don't want to get him into any trouble.
So what do you suggest I do about this?
And he still thinks he has a chance?
Do you know some Ashwin Chopra?
Maybe you need to be clearer with him.
He's not gonna listen to me. Anything I say just gets twisted up in his head. He needs a sane voice. A detached voice. A voice like yours.

dialogues.title: Clem Intro
lines: Onions. With those, all you need is seed, a grow module and time.

OK, if you know what you are doing, head on up the hill and check out Thaddeus's old greenhouse. You can take over the rent. Have a go at planting your first crop of onions with these seeds. Seriously, there's nothing better.
Plenty of vendors around the place. Try over by the water. These seeds should get you started.
Good choice. Onions are easy-going. All you need is some seed, a grow module and time.
Well, glad to have you here. So you don't need any help to get started?
I might need a little help.
Straight in at the deep end, eh? Listen, mushrooms are... fussy. Try something easier.
Hey! Welcome to the Greenhouses. Are you new?
Woah, slow down hot shot. Can't fly before you can crawl. You need to learn the basics first.
My pleasure. Head on up the hill and check out Thaddeus's old greenhouse. You can take over the rent. Have a go at planting and harvesting your first crop. Seriously, there's nothing better.
Then welcome to the wonderful world of crops. We'll have you harvesting your own food in no time. What would you like to grow first?
You're here for Thaddeus's place, right?
He said someone would be by. He also said you don't know one end of a spade from another. That true?
Yeah, inside the greenhouse. There are different modules for different kinds of crops. You can upgrade them as you go... but that's a little advanced for now. These seeds should get you started.

dialogues.title: Round Seven - Player Loses
lines: Because you're keeping on such a good face for someone who looks like they're going to cry.
Wow, a good sport. I'm impressed.
Oh, my, oh may. How are you feeling? That was quite the loss, and so close to the end too. I bet that's... just devastating.
Never happens. And I was lying. I don't care.
