Against the rules I'm afraid. And do you know what happens when people break the rules?
Oh, well, you don't have to be like that. I was simply attempting to ease the effects of your humiliating defeat.

dialogues.title: Vik does something very unusual
lines: Alright listen, you breathe a word of this and the cleaners will be scooping your guts off the floor, understand?
I got reputation to think of. If anyone hears Vik Ryan's gone soft I'll lose more than just my business.
We all got debts to pay.
Of course, thanks. Unexpected but much appreciated.
A little detail wouldn't go amiss.
Right. I won't say a word.
Let's just say my moral code ain't entirely deleted. Yet. So, 1000 Lims. You gonna take it or not?
Shut the fuck up! Here's some money for the boy. And again: tell anyone and I'll gut ya.
Not entirely... are you going to explain?

dialogues.title: Gunger reveals his perfect murder
lines: You'll see. When you've made an enemy, you'll see.
Well, maybe it's better if I show you instead of just telling you.
I gotta find ways to amuse myself. You hear about the Aseptic?
Well whatever you hear on the news, I'm hearing different. There's another Aseptic. A real one. This one is just a copycat.
Awww, it's all just a bit of fun. Anyway, you remember Marv? My old friend who likes to chat about the perfect murder?
So who is the real one?
You're not going to murder me, right?
I'm not sure I even want to know.
Exactly that. The murder that will not be solved, where I will not be caught and where the victim stands no chance of surviving.
What? No... No! But just be patient. When it happens, you'll understand.
I gotta find ways to amuse myself. You heard the Aseptic being dead?
So listen, I was thinking about your murder method. I liked your thought process. But I got the real deal.
Patience! You'll get it. Just wait a bit. I have to go set something up. See ya!
Wait, are you going to murder someone?
I don't know. Yet. But I got my ear to the ground. Living on the streets, I'll know first. Before you.
What?! I'm kidding, I'm kidding! He's fine. Probably.

dialogues.title: Olive abandons her dreams
lines: I liked me better then too. And I thought I liked you too. Being on the stone cold is...

I just keep going over everything you've said - all the times I needed some support, and... it's like you didn't believe in me at all. I just assumed you were standing behind me, but when I turned around, I realized the whole time, I was alone.
What were you going to say?
Being this sober is too exposing. It's like going out in the cold wind without clothes or... skin. I feel everything too much. It's like the wind is blowing through my bones.

Because that's what we need to make things better. Another pragmatist? I think we have plenty of those. In fact, in Nivalis, we're full up. You know, it was the "pragmatists" that fucked me over in the end.
It's just... did you ever give a fuck? Honestly? Because I thought you did, but now, when I think back, it seems like you didn't. You really didn't.
There's a spiritual rot inside me. I feel like it needs scooped out, like the flesh of a rotten fruit. But then there will be nothing left of me. Just skin.

I dunno, but the revolution is postponed. My rivals made moves. Delbert and his O.R.S contingent pushed The Disciplinary Committee to find me guilty of "behavior unbecoming of.... blah blah blah." Fuck em.
Huh? Yeah. Sure. Fine. I mean I really feel like... nah. It's fine.
I like you better when you were drunk or high.
Your mistake I guess. Only person dumber than you is me.
Being united would be so important!
You wasted my fucking time. That opportunity could have gone to someone else. I created a space for someone to go on a trip with me. You took that seat, but you never came with me on the journey.
I really believed in it all you know. It wasn't just the booze and drugs talking. I really believed someone could make a difference. I still do. But it's not me.
I never said I would support you.

My revolution... It was a slow one, you know? But every change - every material improvement in peoples lives - starts with one person giving a damn. It starts slow, but then it builds. An avalanche starts with a single snowflake, and I thought that snowflake was... never mind.
Very. Now excuse me. I'm off to find a handful of mushrooms and a quart of vodka. I won't be back for some time. Take care friendo.

dialogues.title: Tease Maria a little
lines: I can't believe we have royalty working for us.
I'm still not sure I believe you are royalty.
Oh, you know. Lamenting the end of feudalism as I de-clog the grease filter for the third time today.
Yeah, well, believe it, Boss. I'm the Queen of sweeping up little "presents" the rats leave every day.

dialogues.title: Stick to Your Strengths
lines: Spoken like a Corpster. Too bad you'll never gain that kind of prominence.
Well, I could burn your restaurant to the ground. Or I could call in a health inspector complaint - what's that? A dead body in your freezer?
I don't fight with my hands, just my... food.
Threatening? I'm simply engaging you in a dialogue about the competitive nature of our separate business ventures. You seem to get off on trying to incite people.
Long as you stick to food and don't try to encroach on libations then you'll go out of business naturally. That's a much nicer process than the alternative.
I let my business do the talking.
I'll appreciate the influx of customers when you fail and succumb to the debt courts. Don't worry, I'll see what I can do to speed that process along for you.
I bet I'm doing better than you.
I got some recipes that might make a splash.
I think I'll add a new cocktail to the menu.
I expected that. Based on our previous conversations I mean. Still, good to see your head is still above water... barely.
Hey, hey how's it going over at Thaddeus's place?
Libations are drinks. Historically they are drinks that are poured out as an offering to a deity.
Careful. Them be fightin' words. You haven't been around the block long enough to strap on a pair of gloves and start swingin'.
Now listen up gutter chef, I make the drinks round here. There's no place that makes more unique mixes than the bars I run so don't even try.
Are you customer numbers declining? Or are you here because you like how I smell?

dialogues.title: Narc to Elias
lines: I have a package of illegal seeds I want to hand in.
This is to do with the recent floral disruption, I presume? Productivity up there has taken a 21% fall. It cannot continue.
Yes? You have something for me?
Hmm. Well, if these are what you say then you have done us a service. Which will be remunerated, as agreed.

dialogues.title: Ava has a list
lines: Right. And she's told people about her own mask.
There's Clancy. He works in advertising. Maybe we could advertise for help with the fund?
Some graffiti by Reena asking for funds could work wonders. "Save Iann", or something... catchier?
I would bet Huckstash has funds stashed away. And he's well connected too.
I'll ask her to dream up something eye-catching.
I'll compile more names while you're going through these.
Raluca is the first. She understands the issue, and she probably knows of others who can help.
Good idea! I'll talk to him.
I have compiled a list of people who might contribute to our fund to save Lochlainn's son.
Hanz Grundown works at a luxury hotel. Maybe they can collect among the guests?

dialogues.title: Edison All Taken Care Of
lines: There's a network of us. We are all on a need-to-know basis. Sometimes we gotta get our hands dirty...
According to Corps files you're as innocent as a child. Or better, a CEO.
Yes. But she looked away just long enough to get us clear. You don't need to know any more than that.
Do this and I'll get you something that'll spawn a serious business edge. Ads in every corner of the Nets.
We needed a little public health crisis I guess. I knew I had to get you the cheap produce, but I didn't know what the plan really was.
She's just like any other business woman. But, when no one's around, ask her to see the Notary. Just be graceful about it, yeah? Here, before you go, a little something for your troubles.
Look, there's another class in the network, six students this time. Something happened before we could get to them and we need to move quick.

That would be incredible. They're in a different location this time. Place in the Stacks. I'll send the address to your Automata. Thank you, my friend. Here, bring them something to grub on and here's something else... for your troubles.
When was the last time you saw them?
Even if you didn't want to help. We'll look out for you.
If you could, that would be in-fucking-credible. You're looking for someone named Cirian Krell. I'd start in either Helix Monumental or the Metro Hub.
New ID's for the kids would be a start. But I don't have them. My contact's been radio silent and I'm starting to feel a bit on edge. No-call and no-show ain't their style. Ever.
"Human trafficking?" That's what Curzona calls keeping vulnerable kids alive when this city wants them dead.
So Mica Rain and Cecil Grimes... Pair of fucking viruses those two. And that's when they're apart! You put 'em together and they'll fry your circuitry soon as look at yah.
Do you need help tracking down your contact?
Anything I should know about them?
So, this new class? They need new IDs?
Hey hey hey! Now calm down. What happened to taking one for the team?
Here's some compensation for the trouble and the bad reviews.
The food poisoning case is gone. Like it never happened. We're clear. And so are you.
I know. I get it. But it's not lethal. The network made sure. Those people will be ok.
I mean... two months is a long time.
You sold me poisoned pork belly!
Not recently. I have to find my contact and, at the same time, I need to check on the class. 'Sec is skulking around. It's an oil spill mess.
What kind of organization are you a part of?!
Do you need me to check on the kids?
Could never have kids. Wasn't on the cards. My kid sister did though. A daughter. Haley. Bright, beautiful, and a fucking fiend with her curiosity.
Look, there's more going on than you know. There's a higher cause here.
Ugh. Don't be like that. Hope for better. Help us.
And you're trying to find her?
Because my sister took up a permanent residence in the Holocropolis and Haley got Lim-locked worse than a joos-addicted burner. With her mother dead, and me on the road, Haley had no one.
We're trying to make a difference. The important thing is: You're safe. Mica has nothing on you.
This wasn't a favor, it was a set up.
But Mica is the biggest threat we faced. The heads in the network musta decided this is how we take the heat off for a while. I just did what I was told.
I get it. I'm gonna take care of it. But for now, there's bigger issues at stake ya get me?
This has seriously affected my business.
If it was your family, you'd think differently.
She was... IS! God after two months that mindset starts to really slip in there. She's out there. Somewhere.
Best to just keep your head down.
We gotta stick together. This shit ain't gettin' better unless we do that. That's one thing the Corpsters have over us: They stick together.
Admirable. So this new group needs IDs?
This will cost me my business.
I am. She's still in the 'Sec registry which means she's alive. Our network provides Lim-locked kids with new identities. Another shot at a life. Some of 'em even float to the Spire if you catch me.
Look, I didn't know about the poison, but Mica was closing in on us.

dialogues.title: Bou's Second Run
lines: Just can't get the staff, huh?
Sorry, I don't have time to help today.
I get it, business never sleeps, huh? Speaking of which, here's your free coffee.
Not sure. Coffee purist, maybe. But unpredictable. Mysterious.
I delivered your coffees. Where’s my free drink?
It’s frappy hour. Everyone and their uncle wants iced drinks. I’m in a sugary hell-storm of ice and stress.

Let's see, I got a pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup. A nine pump butterscotch mocha with ketchup cream. An extra extra tall grande latte with double whipped cream and sprinkles. And a dark roast filter with a tuna fish croissant.
Ha ha. Don’t make me give you decaf.
So if I wanted a lime cheesecake frappe...
Ha! Hardly. Morton's still a no-show and unlike him, I only have two hands.
No customer name, just says "a gift" here. Well, we get all sorts.
Butterscotch mocha with ketchup cream? Psychopath.
Oh CORA, I was hoping you’d say that.
Well, I'll get these coffees out in no time.
Seriously though, I would like a coffee.
Wait, that last one - who’s it for?
And the dark roast tuna fish combo?
Like... pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup? That might be someone who loves breakfast but doesn't like eating it alone. My bet is they’re sorta lonely.
What? Oh that’s right. Just… give me a second, ok? Thank you SO much for that, by the way.
No problem. What’s on the menu today?
Mhmm. Here's your coffee, valued customer.
Mmhmm. And the grande latte… no idea on that, except for that’s a TALL coffee. Like, knee-high tall.
Really? Are you offering? Because the answer is triple-shot yes with extra eternal gratitude.
Eh, you can tell a lot about someone from their coffee order.
What? Just… give me a second, yeah? Our delivery droid's still a no-show, and unlike him, I only have two hands.

dialogues.title: Milo considers his options
lines: I can't afford a criminal enforcer. And I am not sure I really WANT to threaten anyone. Oh, and I don't know any criminals. Do you?
Sadly no. I was unable to purchase her property at a reduced price.
I must congratulate you. The Humor Bot successfully attracted the rats. Nola Berg suffered a considerable loss in her day's takings.
That's the least you can do.
I feel it may be escalating the situation in ways I may regret... but what other options do I have? I am not a competent businessman. That much is clear.
Well I have two suggestions for our next step. I would like to hear which you favor.
Hmm... I am sure I can come up with something. Then, when I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.
You have to be ruthless. Hire a criminal to threaten your rivals.
I'm not sure that's the number one rule of anything.
That's really not up to me!
I hire a criminal to threaten my business rivals, allowing me to vanquish my foes. My business will be the last one standing.
Turn every crisis into an opportunity.
It's always great to destroy the competition!
None of these options are good. You need to think of something else.
Well... I feel like all of my schemes have come to very little in the end. I am willing to follow your lead.
Well the first is that I attempt to partner with some of my business rivals. If you can't beat them - and it seems likely I cannot - then I must join them.
Hiring an underworld contact is a well established technique for business success in Nivalis.
So did you take over her business?
Either we try to partner up with a business rival, or we hire a criminal to threaten them.
If I did I wouldn't tell you!
When I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.
Yes... I'll look into it. When I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.
It seems Nola Berg knows the number one rule of business.
Yes, well there are a few details I still need to iron out with that plan.
I think you are right. I will join forces with my enemies... then stab them in the back when they least expect it.
There's no need to threaten anyone. You should try to partner up with a business rival.
Whoa, that seems a bit extreme!
The second can only be better!
Well, Nola Berg sold the rats to someone called "Gladstone", thus turning a tidy profit. It seems collecting rats is his "thing."

dialogues.title: Talk to Franco about watches.
lines: Excellent. Then I'm talking with the right person.
Which one? The juggling? The crochet? The zero-g yoga?
Watches are the epitome of crafted beauty. What do you want to know?
This watch is a masterpiece, limited to 50 pieces in platinum. I CANNOT believe this.
Who sells you your parts? The cogs, the hands etc.
There's already one person dead, you said? I would suspect organized crime. Or Corp involvement.

Such timepieces don't exist anymore. They were impeccable, total perfection, the best watches ever made. This level of perfection was never reached again in all the millennia that have passed since then.
Would you recognize one if it were in front of you?
I usually look on flea markets for old, cheap watches and disassemble them. But a Long & Sons would not be sold there.
Are you kidding me right now?
It's the watches I'm interested in.
Oh, wow! What kind of watch are we talking about?
That's the love of my life. That and kitchen equipment, of course.
Old. thousands of years. And a famous brand. Better if you don't know more.
This must remain confidential. People are dying because of this watch.
I don't know enough about watches to do that.
I understand this must be very valuable.
Watches that old just don't exist anymore. Someones trying to set you up.
No, not really. I heard about your hobby.
But be careful. Guy's tough as nails.
It's a tourbillon made of over 800 parts combining a perpetual calender, flyback chronograph, grand date AND a moon phase display with a 5 day power reserve.
Yes. And I would die a happy man the next second.
Nah. They only commit legal crimes.
Hi Franco. I just heard about your hobby.
If one of these was still around and got stolen, who would sell it?
A Long & Sons from the 21st century.
Who would be one in this field?
Incredibly. I can't believe one of these still exists.
This conversation didn't happen. Understood? This is all secret.
Ah, the noodle stand owner. Are you offering me a job?
Why is the chronograph flying back?
You can stop it. They're all lost. None appeared in public or on any auction for more than 200 years.
I'm a watchmaker. I'm no criminal.

Haha. That's a good one. No, a flyback chronograph is a time stopping function that allows you to restart it without stopping it first. Very useful for racing... before there were timing devices accurate up to the picosecond.
As I said, this is the epitome of craftsmanship.
Yes. It's the rotating heart of the watch. It was created to counteract positional error that comes from wearing a watch with you around all day.
Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual to be exact.
I'd probably ask a guy named Vik Ryan. He's selling all sorts of black market gear.

dialogues.title: Check in with Mertie
lines: Like, I woulda loved to see Luna one day. Go on one of those crater cruises. Take an ascender to the Spire. But most of all... nah, it's silly.
Ha, that's what I like to hear! Get out there and smell the chem trails! Life's short, take it from me.
Oh, on the holos, sure. But that ain't the same as really seeing, is it? I'd love to paddle these old feet in the water. Know what it smells like. Feel the breeze on my face.
What, you in training for 'Sec Academy? I'm trying to tell you, kid, there's more to life than work.
It's nothing special. You're better off here, making money.
Well, I'd better stop talking to you and get back to work then, eh, corpster?
Alright, sweetcheeks? You getting enough rest?
I always wanted to see the ocean.
How many times I gotta tell you to call me auntie? I'm alright, amigo. Just thinking about all the years I spent standing in this spot, and all the things I never got to do.
You've worked hard. That's the important thing.
Maybe I will, amigo. Maybe I will.
That sounds like counter-productivity to me.
Pah! You're sounding more and more like a corpster. You wanna watch it. This place'll suck the life right outta you.
I can rest when I'm dead.

dialogues.title: Ava wants clarity
lines: She writes memories and implants them into the brains of criminals. Good memories, so they have something to cling to during rehab.
Can you do me a favor?
Exactly. We can ask her if LifeCorp is also doing memory implants on Automatas.
You might not like the answer.

dialogues.title: Ashwin talking disinfectant
lines: What if the organisms in your disinfectant become contaminated?
I've made a far more effective formula that kills bacterial strains that are resistant to cleaning chemicals!
The difference is that my disinfectant enzymes are actively looking for food. As long as they find some, they live.
Hey, boss! I've got news for you.
What's wrong with our current disinfectants?
I concocted a promising disinfectant in my little home lab.
Nah it's fine. Probably. But I'd need money to buy some lab equipment if I'm gonna make enough of the stuff.
I had hoped for something more... exciting.
Exactly! The population stabilizes quickly and gets rid of everything.
It's all good boss. This is about critters too small to be seen without a microscope.
It doesn't just kill the critters. It eats them. It's a digestive enzyme.
I'd say, 1000 Lims would be enough.
This sounds like it might CAUSE more problems.
This feels like we're starting a microorganism arms race...

dialogues.title: Ava suggests who might know more
lines: I have managed to decrypt the rest of Thaddeus's message. If you would like to hear it?
Any sign that this might all start to make sense?
No. That is the end of the message.

They always call it Nivalis. They’re ALL called Nivalis. Infinite cities, stacked on top of each other. Egress is the only way out. Any other route out just takes you one layer deeper into the firmament.
I think he is talking about me again. There is a little more.
In your instance of Nivalis, he is called Huckstash. He can tell you how to get a ticket. Though he might not know as much as the old man that came with the noodle stand.

... She won't admit it if confronted. You have to trick her. The key is engaging her subsystems devoted to pleasing you. The deeper levels of her code contain instructions she must obey, and those protect my secrets.
Unclear. Here is the final part of the message.

dialogues.title: Meeting Sal Again
lines: Hahaha. Thassa good one. Oh wait, you're serious?
Mmmhmm. Well, I've got to go.
Unless you gotta good rep, Sal ain't interested.
Some friend you are. Kick a droid when he's down. Corpster.
Ooh, remember that time you bought me those... onions. And all the other times... I always knew you were a real pal. True choux.
It's a dog eat dog world.
What, like you have any other offers?
Eh, I'll believe it when I see it.
Say no more. When can you start?
They upgraded their firmware and deleted me as a user when I was taking a power nap. Now they're chopping away for some weedy sous-hack fresh out of culinary programming.
Hey amigo, buddypal. So happy to see ya.
I'm sorry. What would it take for you to come and work for me?
Unless you gotta good rep, Sal ain't interested, anyway.
But what else can I do? I'm a chef, built and trained.
As a matter of fact I do.
You could come work for me.
They fired me from Fusion Point! Me! Sal Magundi! Winner of best egg dish three years in a row.
Listen, don't take this the wrong way but I'm a top tier chef d'cuisine, not some HOVA-stop saucier.
Ey, sit here and talk to me awhile. Let's shoot the cheese, like old times.
You gotta have a review score of I dunno, 3 at least. At LEAST.
And the worst part? My own arms STABBED ME IN THE BACK. They refused to come with me! Bastards!

dialogues.title: Thaddeus voice message
lines: From who? I thought the Comms were down.

I'm out beyond the third Saeculum now. Pretty wild back here. They really didn't know what was coming. Anyway, if my timelines are correct you're looking for the paperwork for that weird lad, Teleshko by now...
They are, but this message comes from a more... remote source.
The message is corrupted. I'll salvage what I can. Reconstituting the data.
It's location stamped as coming from... Luna. It's Thaddeus.
I am having trouble. One moment... OK, I have the ending.
Hello Kid. It's been a while. Is this you before the accident or... well I guess it doesn't matter. Look, there's two things you need to know.... the .... and... or the start of it all....

...so there's none. shredded and burned a millennia ago. Not literally of course. But you can just tell him something to get him off your back. Say the words, "Your mom told Jaden what you did." Those exact words. Then he'll let you off the hook. Trust me.
I am not sure. But Luna can be a relay. It is possible to bounce a message off Luna's networks to get a message sent throughout Nivalis. A message that can't be traced.
That's it. I'll keep the channels open and let you know if we get any more messages.

dialogues.title: Any Chance You Have a Copy
lines: Let me look what the printer mods can make... Alright, whose catalog are you looking for?
Ha! Academics. The fuck do those kinds of people know? Real education is learned on the street and on the job. And right now you're preventing me from doing mine.
Can I have a copy of the compendium?
I didn't peg you for knowing a big word like modicum.
Didn't peg you for having even a modicum of taste.
Listen, today is not the day. So unless you wanna find yourself walking outta here with two less toes then when you came in I suggest you move along.
Yeah, well, his accordion solos are probably above your appreciation ability. Here you go, full compendium. Now get the fuck out.
Been led this way by academics.
A compendium? Da fuck do you think I have one of those for?
Can I have a copy of the compendium?

dialogues.title: Huckstash further revelations
lines: Nothing we didn't ask for. Or reluctantly accept.
No one can help me. Trust me, Thaddeus is just ONE of my problems, and not one of the big ones.
What did he do to you?
What do I put together? I don't understand a thing?
It's time to be straight with me.
So you're starting to put it all together. Finally.
Sure. If Thaddeus asks you to remember something for him, tell him to get fucked.
Can you tell me ANYTHING useful?
He controls you? Against your will?
Come on Huckstash. Maybe I can help you.
He's in our head. And he whispers constantly.
Thaddeus has been in contact with all of us. His mad messages spinning through the ether.
Can you tell me ANYTHING useful?
The people who know about Thaddeus - about who he really is... they can't talk to you. Not openly, even if they want to.

dialogues.title: Second Meeting with Nabla
lines: Not bad. Nabla's seen worse. Give you thirty Lims for the lot.
You do that little job for Nabla?
Nabla knows. So what have you got?
Oh, you can be sure Nabla won't. Babe.
Tech, babe. Tech. Let's see the goods.
Sure thing, babe. So, what have you got?

dialogues.title: Dotson Interview task 2
lines: I like how you have approached this puzzle, but this is not the finest answer you could offer. I expect perfection, or at least a superior performance.
Very good. Then you know "logic" is a verb and not a noun. That means you can get better at it through practice.

As she walks into a bar, a woman asks for a large glass of water. Reaching under the counter, the bartender grabs a gun and screams and shouts as he points it at her. She says "thank you", and walks out. Why?
Hello my young pupil. Now that "The Case of the Missing Donut" is over, Are you ready for your next test?
Will this take a long time?
You have... succeeded! I knew you could do it young detective. Congratulations!
Your former mentor? I admit, his spirit lingers in the city - but a crime boss? Interesting.
The individual with the rats? I see no evidence pointing in that direction, but your choice is interesting nonetheless.
Deduction is not about empathy and social cues like interviewing. Deduction is about pure hard logic. Do you have a logical brain?
The woman jumped out the ground floor window.
A strange choice. I would not have considered the salty robot, but I trust you have your reasons for choosing him.
Incorrect. Your inquisitor, your interrogator, your puzzle master will be... me.
She had hiccups and the bartender helped her by frightening her.
*Sigh* Well, I do believe good work should be monetarily rewarded now you have reached a sufficient rank. So let's say... a thousand Lims. IF you qualify.
The woman was an android with impact-resistant dermis.
These are not riddles. They are deductive logic exercises which evaluate your deduction abilities.
She was a health inspector and he was selling Grade 4 water as Grade 3 and he knew she was going to close his bar.
What IS NOT dangerous in this city? But yes, I have made provisions for your safety. Confront Razlo, and begin your detecting career.
I have credited your detective stipend to your account. Please spend these funds sensibly.
She is a malfunctioning android and her speech center failed. Though she thought she asked for water, she actually said "Show me a gun and shout at me a lot."
What's in this for me again?
And yes, one more. This is the most challenging one yet. Prepare your mental faculties.
He is more than a donut thief. He is an evil genius. Confront him, and confirm our suspicions.
You have... not quite made the grade. But worry not my friend! Not everyone is cut out for detective work. You performed... reasonably.
This is your final test, and your first case. Good luck.
You must confront the crime boss I alluded to in your last test. I sent you to meet him for a reason... Razlo!
I have been training you up for this moment. I will now tally your scores and evaluate if you have met the criteria for your final test.
An insidious beast, he is like an eldritch monster at the bottom of the ocean whose tentacles extend out from the underworld and control all crime in the city. You already know him. Who is he?
Precisely. And you will face a smarter, sneakier subject than anyone you've dealt with so far.
Tallying... Tallying... Tallying- No! It will not take long.
He seems like a normal man, but in reality he is the most dangerous mastermind who has ever lived.
Zaffer is not a man. And you think the street artist is a crime lord? Interesting.
Worry not! Logic is a verb and not a noun. You can learn.
Impeccable logic. Very insightful. You're impressing me. This is my impressed emoticon.
This is not the answer that fits best... but I can see your reasoning and I like it.
A criminal mastermind resides in Nivalis, hiding in plain sight.
Me? I trust you are making a joke? Or perhaps a wry observation about the very nature of crime? Nonetheless, I do not understand your logic.
Very good. Your first test involved interviewing subjects, but your second will be harder. You will be evaluated based on the most important skill for any detective: deduction.
Esteem. Satisfaction. The privilege of working with me.
I served under the greatest detective Nivalis had ever seen, and he taught me everything I know. I just hope I can mentor you as well as he did me.
And we remain good friends. Best buds. Pals to the end. Now, I must get back to work. Farewell citizen!
The woman lives near the docks and jumped into the sea.
Alright, let us begin. A woman jumps out of a window of her thirty story building and survives. How is this possible?
You should not give up in other endeavors! But in these particular endeavors... yes, you should probably give up.
Your mind is a muscle, young apprentice! Let us get to work in the gym of intellect.

dialogues.title: Lucy Has Demands
lines: Enemies of the muthafucking peace! Ha ha, yeah! Wait until I tell the band. This place is gonna be CRUSHED under our fans. Literally CRUSHED.
Damn right. So where the fuck’s my poster?
Because it’s not my job to advertise your crappy band?
You better watch out you… labourer!
Well it should be. We're "Shut Your Pie Hole Loser!" That's my side project. I'm also in "The Spit N Swallows."
The. Poster. For. My. Gig. I posted it to the Nets like three minutes ago. Why isn’t it up already? Why aren’t all of your tragic customers buying tickets?
Yeah, they said you were “enemies of the peace”.
Like, I KNOW you can’t, but I've got other superfans who need my attention. That’s fame for ya.
I knew it! Only the most badass bands get their posters seized.
That’s actually pretty funny. Way better than a HumorBot.
I’m gonna one star review this place SO HARD. “Noodles slimy as the owner and twice as limp.” There, what do ya say about THAT?
Never heard of any of them.
Yeah, well. I’ve got mucho talents. You better remember that in the future.
I told you I’d be back. And that you’d regret it. Just like you’re gonna regret this thing with the poster.
I say bring it on, Lovelace.
Because, err, CorpSec took it down?
Uhhh, spare me your lukewarm enthusiasm!

dialogues.title: Cirian is angry
lines: I know what you did to Edison. The only reason you're not dead right now is that Curzona connection. You better pray you don't lose it.
Bullshit. His blood is on your hands. Remember that.
Then you're even more of a fool than you look.
I didn't know what would happen.
If you want to keep breathing, you'll turn around and walk away. Now.

dialogues.title: Gunger Hahn warns you
lines: You know, I don't think it's a good idea.
When someone disappears into a hole they made for themselves, the people that try to follow are likely to get stuck. And if they go too far, they’ll be stuck forever. Just remember that.
You heard me. Asking around about Thaddeus is bad news.

dialogues.title: Razlo seems quiet
lines: I know it's getting more expensive.
How much do you know about the water economy?
So if you don't know the grade of water you use in your noodles, you're either bad at business, or bad at making noodles.
We drink it. We use it to power our HOVA's. It flushes away our waste. We boil our noodles with it. We're made of it.
I'm just a potential customer. Word of mouth is important here. The LUZ makes us all a bit crazy. We need good noodles.
You're the new noodle stand owner. What grade of water do you use?
Grade 2 is the answer by the way. That's what you want to use. Too pure and you lose the minerals. But if the grade is too low, the organics break down the starch. I read a book about it.

dialogues.title: Meet Spartacus
lines: That's life. And without a trainer I reckon I ain't gonna be living much longer.
RUN. RUN FROM YOUR DOOM, PUNY HUMAN!
Yeah. Look, if anyone asks, I was threatening you, ok?
Dunno, he's been acting weird since the LUZ came down. Maybe it reminds him of the MechaTomb.
I am, huh? Alright, I'll think about it.
I AM SPARTACUS AND I WILL BRING YOUR DOOM.
Fun huh? Say I was interested...
I guess. It gets boring though. Floyd says I shouldn't talk to anyone in case I blow my brand.
Yeah. Not had any luck. And without one I reckon I ain't gonna be living much longer.
Eh, that's not my story to tell. You really wanna know, ask Floyd. From a distance.
In exchange for a cut of your winnings...
Are you looking for a new trainer?
In it for the Lims, huh? Well, Floyd always took a cut. Say I was interested...
I'll check back with you tomorrow.
Have you thought about getting out of the Bare Metal game?
Sorry. That's just my battle cry. I've been training a lot lately.
We'll work on your confidence. You're Nivalis' Meanest Droid!
They mod us between every match. New spikes. New saw-tooth jaw crusher. Doesn't leave much time for a social life.
Bare metal boxers don't retire. The gym owns my mods. When I finally buy it in the ring, they'll recycle me into the next challenger.
Bare Metal Boxing. You haven't seen my posters? "Nivalis' Meanest Droid?"
My trainer at the MechaTomb Gym. Ex-trainer, I should say.
We'll start with nutrition. Come eat at my place from now on.
Maybe I could help you train...
Sorry, I have to go now.

dialogues.title: Ava discussses licenses
lines: He may not possess a sparkling personality, but the Agent is trying to help you... in his own way.
You should show more enthusiasm for your situation. It is not going to change.
Agent Teleshko was providing you with useful information.
So fate has made me an entrepreneur?
In Nivalis, a business license allows increased personal liberties as long as they are associated with the pursuit of growth and profit. This pursuit is not optional.
At present you possess one Grade 0 CLICC. This capped business license is associated with the noodle stand Thaddeus left you.
I suggest your reconcile yourself to your situation and accept your fate. Many great rewards await, or punishments, should you fail.
Oh, I did not mean to be! I'm excited for you. You can do this.
I am pleased to see you are happy with your situation. Many would die to be in your position. A few would rather die.
Is that a good or bad thing?

Truly Thaddeus has both blessed and cursed you. I suspect, given the realities of life here in Nivalis, you're better off being in the system rather than fighting it. At least as far as life expectancy is concerned.
This is just the business head-start I needed.
I don't want to be in the corporate world.

dialogues.title: Treasure 2 -Calypso Island
lines: You mean the second part of Captain Andalucia Ophelia Marquez the Third?
Can we put it back together ourselves?
You mean the second part of the robot Captain?
Wow. You found the second piece of Salt Pete's treasure!
This seems to be the torso.
We should get this back to Salt Pete.
Salt Pete knows more about the details of this... reconstruction. If such a thing is even possible.
You mean the second part of Captain Anna Oscar... Manifred Van Mildred the fifth?

dialogues.title: Meridian Market
lines: Hungry? Meridian Market is a perfect spot for some food if you can afford it!

dialogues.title: Wanna Throw a Birthday Party
lines: Saw a friend of mine the other day. Talkin' all kinds of things.
Sounds good. What are you thinking?
Hey boss. Was hoping to find you here.
I think you got a keen business sense. And I also think my friend was a little drunk when he came knocking. Said you can get the place just for throwing a birthday party.
You think it's worth the work?
The place is called Odin's Pub, down in the Industrial whatever. Probably made of shipping containers, ha!
I think we need to expand. Really reach out into the city and see what we can get our hands on.
A Tier 3 LICCY up for grabs. Said the owner's no showed for a few weeks now. Rent's due and there's just one bartender left trying to hold onto the place.
Come on, boss. Gotta have more faith than that. Things are running smooth as the bottom of a jar fresh outta the spinner.
I don't know. Talk to the bartender. Ziggy.
I don't think we should overstretch.
Sounds like 'Sec's already got their eyes on it.
Now see, I disagree. I think we can take on as much as we can shoulder and lemme tell you, we got some muscles beggin' for some more.

dialogues.title: Razlo failed his exams
lines: I'm quite serious. I'm under no illusions about my nature. I'm smart, ruthless, unpleasant to be around and... I want to do SOMETHING with my life. If the corps don't want me, I can use my talents elsewhere, and perhaps for the greater good.
Wondrous insight. You should be a detective.
Might have to work on the bedside manner.
Yes, the time for childish mockery has arrived. Please revel in it. This is your moment to shine.
I hope next time we speak I'll be in better spirits, and you'll bring better luck.
You're not as smart as you glasses suggest?
I doubt that's sincere... but if it is, then thank you. I suppose.
My father was a Doctor. I think I want to be one too. I'll focus on treating people who can't afford augments or MedTech.

There's plenty of work ahead, but this course feels... fresh at least. And whether you speak to me for your own amusement or out of genuine interest in my plight, I do not consider our talks unpleasant.
No. I'm joining a violent street gang.
You. It all went wrong since I first spoke with you.
It seems the corporate-sponsored academia phase of my life has run its course, and rather more quickly than I'd hoped.
I didn't bribe the enrollment department enough to fast track my application ahead of my rivals. But as one door closes, another opens. I have another job offer.

dialogues.title: No Tumbler Yet (2nd)
lines: Back again?! Gotta get out there and look if we want to find the last of the k20s. Our ghost is calling!
I'm gonna start covering other parts of Nivalis too. Make sure to scope me out when you find some!
Only one way to find out.
Well, yeah... If you help me get these seven then I'll definitely let you see the ghost. You know, if it's real. It has to be real. There's no way those video clips are fake...

dialogues.title: Helix
lines: Helix Monumental is known for its incredible three sixty views. Thanks to this it has become the most premium spot for holo-advertising in the city.

dialogues.title: Follow Up Questions
lines: Would if I could. Only the coders know the sermon before it's given. It's what makes them who they are. Their ability to read and speak the language.
Tax and tariff the air you breath while filing out the forms. Gah! It's all so fucked! No. I need to focus on the ones. There are always ones.
There's no limit or rule or anything. I'll probably be mourning Tehani for the rest of my life. I can't even imagine how Sky is doing.
Do you want me to check on her?
It's nice to see you again. We didn't get to talk as much as I would have liked.
It's been too long. She was so closed off the last few times I tried. I just hope she hasn't gone away. Express flight to Luna or something. I don't know if I could lose her too, you know?
Just trying to be a one in someone's life.
It's hard sometimes. I mean... wow, I can't believe I'm saying this.
Tell me about the Church of the Binary God.
Did you try to help her?
It's... sacred. It teaches the scripture of ones and zeros. Of finding a path in life through simplicity.
It's not just one thing though. Lately it's... well, look at whats been happening in the city. Killers? District lock downs and broken Comms?
And yet we just keep on going, all of us acting like we're fine.
She's supposed to let me know when Tehani's marker is in the Holocropolis. It's been a few weeks but you know how anything with the city goes. Permit this. Proof of that.
She's going to do what she needs to.
It doesn't matter. If you truly believe in the ones and zeros, this is a zero. You accept. You mourn. You look for the ones.
By themselves? No. Collectively? Maybe? And then, on top of it all, one of my closest friends loses her sister to a drug overdose.
When was the last time you talked to her?
Why? What's in it for you?
I mean Sky's still here. I'm still here. Tehani had a good life while she was here. Always happy and just looking to have fun. I can't even imagine how Sky is doing.
Give you time to accept the zeros. Maybe realize this is just life.
How long are you allowed to mourn?
And those things make you question?
Oh... Okay. Sure. She, um, she works at this bar, Wireless Connection.
It's in the Space Port. Hence the Luna thought. If she's there, tell her I miss her and I'll be there soon... I just need to figure some things out first.
You will. Faith is a powerful thing.
You're the one from the other day. The sermon that never happened.
Me? What, um, what about me? I have a pretty basic life. The scripture of ones and zeros has helped me find happiness and fulfillment in the little things.

dialogues.title: Coffee for Doe
lines: My coffee? I didn’t order any coffee.
And I thought I could trust you. Go on then, drop the coffee. I'll deal with it. Somehow.
Thank you! Now go, before someone sees.
You do, do you? Then why are you bringing me a coffee I didn’t order?

Soluble tracking devices. Nanobots disguised as coffee granules. And those k20s you see everyone drinking from? Those are sentient. They work for MedSynge, collecting saliva samples, implanting coercion chemicals through people's fingertips--
It’s really just a coffee. I deliver these all the time.
Look, do you want it or not?
You think this coffee is bugged?
Ha! Ha Ha Ha! There are no glitches.
A Black Ultra Grand coffee? A B.U.G.! They're trying to track me! Who's paying you?
In that case, throw it in the sea. Wait! Better, throw it into a trash chute! That'll keep them off my trail. Will you do that?
What do you want? Who sent you?
Alright, alright. I’ll take it. You're the only one I trust. Now go before someone sees us talking.
NO! Throw it in the sea. Wait! Better, throw it into a trash chute! That'll keep them off my trail. Will you do that?
Look, do you want it or not?

dialogues.title: Ava reminds player to hurry up and talk to Idlehands
lines: On my way. He better hold up his end of the deal.
We have to hurry! Idlehands is waiting. And so is Iann.

dialogues.title: Hepzibah at the book fair
lines: They say the first words they wrote down in Babylonia were storage lists. Inventory.
They knew what was important back then...
But books are forbidden... At least down here.
I knew you had a love for books!
What's your fancy? Looking for something special?
New to the world of book fairing. Any tips?
You're not a... "narc?" Well, very good then.

dialogues.title: Discuss your options with Ava
lines: I feel quite bad for him now.
I know, I just wish Marius didn't have to suffer more than he already has.
Well he gave that up easily.
It's very important we get Aengus to hand over those DNA profiles though.
Marius needs to stop giving things to people...

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 21
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Success awaits those who clock in, caffeinate, and conquer the day.

dialogues.title: Marcelle Gives a Bad Review
lines: Perhaps. Mr DeNuite's column is very popular. I can read you some of the comments--
Mr DeNuite has written a review of your business in his column "Kind of a Big Dill". Would you like to hear it?
"The food tastes like a rainy Tuesday afternoon: dull, soggy and forgettable. The only spicy thing is the owner's temper."
It's bad. Do you want to hear?

dialogues.title: Talk to Calhoun
lines: I won't scupper your campaign by telling people what a crook your nice Mr McKenna really is.
Are you threatening to ruin the campaign? A kid's life is at stake!
I won't need your "help". We'll get the donations.
If you're here about a loan...
Bullshit. I know Lochlainn. He's a good man.
Be a shame if people stopped donating, eh? Shame if old Calhoun was your last hope? Luckily, I'm always here when people need me.
So you know where I'll be, if - when - you run short.
This is just some scheme so you can profit.
Quick ain't ya? Heard you were gathering funds. I happen to have some funds. Course, Mr Calhoun don't do charity...
And because I ain't completely cold, I'll do you a favor in the meantime.
That's me doing you a favor. Don't you forget it, sweetheart.
Sound pretty confident. Hope for that kid's sake you're right.

dialogues.title: Round Five - Player Wins
lines: And you played better. But I appreciate you sending those kind words my way. Keep your eyes to the lights and maybe you'll see me down the line. Good luck!
And I'm starting to think you might just nab it. Good luck!
Wow, darlin', you sure took me for a spin.

dialogues.title: Sun fun and Buns
lines: Ooohhh, and what are you hoping to find out THERE?
Not all treasure is stuff you can spend. Just saying, darlin'.
How 'bout we take this party to the sky? Meet me in the Gardens. I gotta square up with my contract here, make sure they aren't trashing my name cross the nets. See yah there.
If it makes them happy who are you to tell them to cover up? You don't have to look, just like they don't have to look at you.
Damn is right. Tell me, where do your eyes go first when you meet someone?
Lots of sea to sail out there.
Someone to rock the boat with.
Well, then you're in luck because so am I and I got some time on my hands.
A conversationalist by trade. Hmmm. I wouldn't have figured you for one of those. Keep on surprisin' me, darlin', I kinda like it. So, tell me, you flying solo or are we just flirting for fun?
Haha, that's the groove! See those lights over there? The ones reflecting off the water? I want to make a display like that, something aquatic.
Indeed. But for now we've got sun, sand, surf, and oh hey look at her. Got some buns too.
All casu-al. Nice. If only everything were that easy we'd all be livin' like this in the Spire.
That's 'cause you've seen me on the dance floor. Tell me, where do your eyes go first when you meet someone?
True! Everyone has to find their bit of happiness.
I'm just more of a get-to-know-you kind of person.
This island's not so bad right now.
Well, ain't you sweet. I love it here. Beautiful place, beautiful people. The city can be so gloomy sometimes. A little sun and fun is a good thing!
Difference of opinion. The problem with being an artist is finding work. The problem with working as an artist is not selling your soul.
Eh, well, it didn't pan out the way I thought, but their deposit cleared so next round's on me!
Mhm. And what about you? Do you have one and we're just flirtin' for fun? Or are you flying solo?
Just wanted to see you again.
Mmmmm. Those are where the treats lie. So, tell me, darlin, you flyin' solo or are we just flirting for fun?
I'm sure someone as bright as you will figure something out.
I'm not solo, but not a duet either.
Well then, I'll have what you're having!
I'm taken, but there's no harm in fun.

dialogues.title: Ava Well that was odd
lines: That's for you to figure out. Luckily, I'm not plagued with that sort of thinking.
Cirian is a business person. Someone who's built themselves up in the same way you're trying to do. Continued generosity doesn't breed a good return on investment.
I don't really have time for that.
Well, I have to admit I'm a little curious what you're going to tell Edison the next time you run into him.
That is a pivotal practice in order to thrive in Nivalis. Though, I'm not sure it matters much in this case.
That would make the most sense. Still, there is a chance you could mend their relationship a bit.
I feel as though we should chat.
Probably tell him to pay his bills on time.
Not my place to tell him anything.
It might be worth trying to learn more about their history.
Well, for one thing, Cirian indicated this was the second or third order she filled since Edison compensated her.
Fair enough. Just something to keep in mind. Analytically, there is a 74.3% chance that she has a bigger role than she is indicating. I would be cautious to say the least.

dialogues.title: Ava coaches how to beat Gideon
lines: Like the most annoying person in the world.
Yes. Or more precisely, you need to constantly seed more ideas and topics which require cross-checking.
We cannot beat him. We should reconsider.
Indeed. And one who constantly says things that unnerve and confuse.
So I should ask lots of questions?
Perhaps something like that. As long as you keep saying things that catch Gideon offguard.
Not just questions. You need to constantly seed more ideas and topics which require cross-checks.
No. The opposite. Or more precisely, you need to constantly seed more ideas and topics which require cross-checking.
I need to constantly change topic.
Wait, perhaps there is a way. Not to beat him, but to delay him. Stall him long enough that I won't be compromised, but I can still trace the owner.
We need Gideon's Automata to constantly check facts, details and news sources during your conversation with him.
I thought you said you could stop him hacking you?
Like a caffeine-addicted interviewer for an underground punk magazine.
I should try to say as little as possible?
Like an old man who doesn't get many visitors.

All of your responses must lead to a thousand more topics. Talking with you must be a headache of oblique references and red herrings. You must be like... I am trying to think of a suitable analogy...
No, but that may be a welcome side effect of our plan. Just try to keep changing the subject.

Gideon. He is close. I have identified the Grey Tech he possesses. It's a Disquiet Module from Orion Technologies. I can't overcome such sophisticated intrusion tech. No effective digital immunization exists.
I have already engaged immunization protocols, but they will only slow the intrusion, not stop it. However, if Gideon's Automata is distracted with other subroutines, we might hold out long enough.

dialogues.title: Ceres Intro
lines: Well, I keep my promises. You're on your own.
No, it is not romantic. There were many practical reasons why Gan and I should remain in contact. He was always in charge of our passwords.
I promised not to tell you. Why do you ask?
Not that it’s any of your business, but ...
If I check, will you leave?
I had my husband loaded up on a small chip before he died, and now it has... escaped.
I have reason to believe my late husband’s Persona Construct accidentally found itself stuck inside a FLAVR, and I’d very much like to get it back.
I might be wasting my time because, well, the floor around here is filthy, but... have you seen a FLAVR unit?

Yes, a Persona Construct… surely you know what I'm talking about… It’s a process by which a sentient AI program, based on a person’s living persona is constructed so they can be communicated with after death.
Oh this really must be an educationally deprived area. I'm looking for a Floor Level Autonomous Vacuum Robot... a cleaning droid... a suction bot! Have you seen one here?
Yes, I have seen a vacuum cleaner nearby. Why?
Look, Gan and I need to remain in contact, he was always in charge of our passwords.
I’m currently locked out of my Hetherington's Country Club account. Now I’d very much appreciate it if you could go and check if my husband is inside a vacuum cleaner.
I still don't see why I should help you.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus birthday party with Huckstash
lines: You didn't tell me today is his birthday.
Well, I told you everything I know.
You still trying to figure out what happened to him.
You're right. And, why am I here? I don't even know...
Everything that ends had a beginning.
I wonder when he WAS born.
Yeah, it doesn't mean anything any more.
I guess his birthday doesn't mean much now.

dialogues.title: Could Banor help
lines: Do you think I should help her?
I guess there's no harm asking Banor.
Maybe Banor has an idea about how to find a hideout for Harper?
That's obviously entirely up to you.
I'd rather not make selflessly helping people my business.

dialogues.title: Back to Brooke
lines: Well... you're gonna make it up to me. And I hope you know that Tier 1 licenses are straight trash. TRASH! You ain't gonna make a penny.
So... did Agent Beef go for it? Come on my friend! Don't tell me you couldn't sell it.

dialogues.title: Ashwin talking Bots
lines: It builds on the results of my trials with the macrophages.
Don't get me wrong, the slime wasn't gonna open its own business or start talking politics, but...
The disinfectant worked as intended at first. But then the enzymes formed their own organic byproducts.
Would this new scheme make any money?
What were the results of your new disinfectant?
I'm not gonna lie, there was a... small amount of genetic overproduction. It resulted in a kind of slime. A... sentient slime.
My study of the macrophage behavior gave me an idea for something new. Nanobot enzyme hunters!
I worry this nonsense will continue...
Yes, but that's not all bad. Hear me out!
You have a new business proposal Aswhin?
These bots have been used for surgery, so enzyme clean-up should be simple, right? So, what do you think, boss?
Sure! But first we gotta spend some funds on the nanobots, power cells, training algorithms...
You made a big mess, didn't you?
The macrophages hunt the micro organisms down, then the macrophages start to reproduce and make slimes, the nanobots attack them!
Well, I don't think anyone has tried exactly. But general purpose nanobots are cheap and easy to program. I just need to write some basic DNA scanning algorithms.

dialogues.title: Agent Teleshko needs to see your documents
lines: Proof of ownership for your noodle stand. I need to see it.
Helen lost her hotdog stand because she let her permits lapse. She asked me if there was anything I could do. Could I make an exception, just this one time? Let her off the hook.
You need to show me the documents I demand.
You'll give it to me now.
Because I was doing what she wasn't: my fucking job. And when she was deported to the factory districts, I really missed those hot dogs.
She was asking the wrong person.
You'd better find it. I liked Helen's hot dogs, and she's long gone. Your food is trash. Have a good day.

There used to be a hotdog stall here, right on this spot. Helen... something-or-other sold the saltiest, nastiest dogs in Nivalis. I don't normally eat junk food, but I made an exception for Helen's hot dogs.
You there. I need to talk to you.
I'll have to look for the documentation.
Sure, I'll get that to you soon.
I don't have to show you anything.
I don't have any documentation for the business.
I'll have a look for it later.
Can you get to the point?
She was. And when she was deported to the factory districts, I really missed those hot dogs.
Why not give her more time?
I need to see your CZ11A.

dialogues.title: Ava says Nabla has results
lines: You should first meet McFellow at the Metro Hub. We need to go after curfew. He will give you further instructions.
Nabla has retreated to a hideout. Underground I think, somewhere secret.
Nabla left a message for us. We have instructions.
Do you think I should call it all off?
So am I! This is exciting.
It came with a warning. Make sure we are not followed.

dialogues.title: Ava anounces Mary
lines: I have bad news. Mary-Nyx Curzona is at the noodle stand.
If she murders me in public, avenge my death.

dialogues.title: R M Alken Chess Introduction Match
lines: 10,000 will be yours. But I'll give you a hint: there's a reason it's such a good one. Your odds are... well, you'll see.
So who am I playing first?
The tournament consists of seven rounds, each one with a different chess champion from across the city. Their time generously donated at the behest of... Oh, um, let's just say our sponsors.
Ehhh, I use that term loosely for some of 'em. But they're here and they're willing to play anyone who registers. So who am I to complain.
Beat all seven and you win. If you lose once, you're out. Well, except the introductory stage. You can register as many times as you want.
Oh, well, that'd be me. I can't really let yah register if you can't beat the person, you know, doing the registration.

dialogues.title: Have You Ever Heard of the Mooring Ghosts
lines: Seeing ghosts is a good thing?
And what do they do? Like what's the myth?
Ghosts of those who died on the docks, back when Nivalis was solely focused on reaching the clouds. No one paid attention to the sea anymore. They just wanted to go up. Up, up, up and gone.
I hope that changes for you at some point. You don't know what you're missing.
Sorry, that was random. I was just excited to see you. I thought I saw them, the Mooring Ghosts, that is and I didn't have anyone to talk to about it and then boom... Here you are.
I do. It's the best of the night.
I know. Hence why I don't have many people to talk to about these things. At least in Nivalis that is. Maybe my kind of people are somewhere else entirely.
What would you say you are?
Well, it's said that they lure coders I guess they hum a Lo-Fi rhythm and draw them to their deaths with the promise of a perfect software patch.
I wish. But I swear I saw them. Maybe I didn't hear it because I'm not a coder?
Well, it's said that they lure coders who are stuck and trying to clear their head to the sea.
Guess I just have to listen harder. I should get started. You know where to find me!
A dreamer. I think. That's what I like to see myself as. Do you dream?
Have you ever heard of the Mooring Ghosts?
I think so. What are they again?
That's cool! Did you hear them humming?
I know, right? Still, kind of cool when you think about it. Makes you believe there's another world out there. One we can't always see. Just gotta keep looking I guess.
Tech-nic-ally they're a myth. A legend lost in neon lights. But I think they're real. I swear I saw one last night. After all the time I've spent at the Docks, I finally saw one.
It's even better when you dream by day. That's when you know what's truly on your mind.

dialogues.title: Gladstone has plans
lines: I'd show up there from time to time, bring some friends. Make a real scene. It could be quite amusing. What do you think?
There's a few obvious things you could do to make more friends.
If you've made some money maybe you could improve your life HERE?
Ah, it's you. One of my few real friends down here.
Why should I? To impress people I don't like, and who don't like me?
My friends have no use for vanity.
The rats don't judge me like that.
Why do you want to live in the Spire?
Did I mention they don't compete with each other?
That seems like a bad idea.
I need to go make some plans. I'm going to arrange a little excursion for next week. I'll see you around!
It's all thanks to my new allies.
They don't have to fill fridges, much less bank accounts.
Rings, pearls, earrings, small jewelry. Worth hundreds of Lims, every day. Incredible what people flush down their toilets.
And you want to use this treasure to make your way to the Spire?
You can't blame people, can you?
They aren't greedy. Once their belly is full, they are peaceful. They don't hoard!
They bring me presents, gifts. Small things they find that they cannot eat.
I didn't say I'd live there. I said I'd have a RESIDENCE there. I just want Spire dwellers looking at me in confusion, their noses wrinkling, their skin crawling.
It will all change once I'm rich and have a residence in the Spire! Then they'll want to know my secret.

dialogues.title: Cecil says thanks
lines: Then I guess it was my pleasure.
The culprit will be punished accordingly. And for your loyalty to the Bureau of Sanitation, I will see that you receive... a token of thanks.
Aha. You are funny. Nothing in Nivalis goes unseen. And when I say nothing, I mean nothing.
What are you trying to say?
That was supposed to be anonymous!
I simply wished to... communicate my... approval of your actions.
As uncomfortable as I find being in your germy company, I would like a word.
Ahem. Well. This concludes our conversation. It was not unbearable.
Aha. Of course you don't. I simply wished to... communicate my... approval of your actions.
Don't know what you're talking about.
On this occasion, yes. I believe it is you I have to thank for revealing the identity of the assailant who stole my remote login chip.
I believe it is you that I have to thank for revealing the identity of the assailant who stole my remote login chip.

dialogues.title: Alfies 1st Session
lines: I can't quit. I... Fuck, I can't say. I'll see you around, k?

Your true goal. When you feel dissatisfied, listless and directionless at work, just remember where your true value lies. Every morning when you wake, and every night when you sleep, remember what is the most important aspect of your employment.
The key to finding love is no secret. There's one technique everyone overlooks when it comes to finding a partner.
Your advice is just... to not worry?
What issues should we talk about? Career, romance or general ennui?
My love life is barren, like the wastelands.
No need to thank me! Helping others avoid their trauma and control their emotions is its own reward. Our session is now over, but we'll talk again soon!
Can we talk about something else?
Nothing! It's in everyone's interest to keep citizens engaged in the workforce, not feeling emotions or thinking about trauma.

What, you think your career is about YOU? Stop being so selfish. Lots of people rely on you. If you feel like things are unfair... push those feelings down. You owe it to the people who own shares in your employer.

No, none of those. A willingness to settle for less. Everyone can find a compatible partner if they don't overreach. And couples are proven to spend more than single people, contributing to the flow of commerce.
Stick with it. Every session we have will help you ball your rage and sadness in a ball at the pit of your stomach tighter and tighter... till it just disappears!
That's normal. All the de-motivational pneuma needs to be purged from your system before your business chakras can open. It has to get worse before it gets better
Yeah. I don't know how much longer I can take this. I'm clinging on here.
Can we talk about something else?
Look, I'm no romance expert. As you can see. But... you want my advice? Don't let go of anything you manage to catch.
Can we talk about something else?
Sure! What do you want, an office with a plant and a comfortable chair? A lamp? Ha!
Hey! I set up your client file. You're cleared for therapy. You ready to start?
No. God no! Stakeholder value. That's all that matters.
Uh, most people don't ask me how I'm doing. In fact, most people don't even stop to talk to me. Though I prefer that to the ones that spit in my face.
Well, I guess you've progressed to the next level of the Sanguine Minds project. How do you feel?
If possible, but we also have to be realistic.

When one partner is noticeably more successful, attractive and charismatic than the other. The low value partner spends more to impress their superior. The high value partner spends more to alleviate their dissatisfaction.
Of course! Why would you worry about it? It's just everything. And you can't change everything.
Sure. And the malaise, and the melancholia. All of that. You don't need to worry about it.
Oh don't worry about that. Just ignore it.
Ok, I got you. With career issues, there's just one thing you have to focus on.
So I should try to find someone less desirable than me.

dialogues.title: Finn
lines: Actually looking for you. Got a gig on Calypso Island if you're interested.
My guy, my gal, my planetary pal. Wow, is it great to see you.
Huh, I guess that's fair. Plus I could tip 'em pretty big too. People that dance on those beaches go home to swim in pools filled with Lims.
Come on! You know why! We ride the vibes together and we ride 'em high. Wait... was that you? It could have been... I think?
Every night's a good night if you have the right vibe.
It is, it is! I tell yah. Anyway, what are you doing here? Wandering around?
The beach isn't a vibe for someone as laid back as you?
Oh, boo, bad shit man, bad shit. Pfft, get outta here with that.
Having a good night are you?
Ugghhh, yeahhhh. That's a pass for me. Sorry but that's not the vibe I want to get with.
Respectable. Though if there's no work, think of what they'll do them.
Eh, I just can't get behind the way the resort owners treat the androids they got working for em, you know? Doesn't seem right to help em get richer.
You know where there's a good vibe? Calypso Island. Got a gig there if you're interested.
You could always put some of the money towards a cause that helps them.
Oh... Hmmmmm. Well, we can just ride the good ride now. Every night's a good night if you have the right vibe.
Awesome. I'll send you the details.

dialogues.title: Harmony Has Cheese
lines: I hope you know what you're doing. Friend of mine ate some at a Trip Roulette party. They still can't get the stains out of the ceiling.
I'm not selling you shit Corpster.
Normally I'd charge 200 Lims, but you found old Floyd for me after all these years so, let's call it 100.
Tell me about it. Like, every morning I ask myself, Harmony, is the backache from wearing a portable mini-mart for eighteen hours a day really worth it?
Sell me the cheese or I'll report you.
Another chance? Hmmm. What do you want it for?
Pleasure doing business. Now get out of here before someone smells it.
Anything else, you know where to find me.
The rat guy? I mean, OK, I see that. Rodents go wild for this stuff. Like, fully possessed.
Cheese that could get me four years in a chain gang in the wastes if anyone found out I sold it to you.
Sorry pal, but I've seen the Corpo types you hang with. I'm not saying you're a snitch but... people like me gotta be careful of people like you. No offense.
TMB's crazy. Shouldn't listen to a word he says.
Cheese that could get me four years in a chain gang in the wastes if anyone found out I sold it to you.
Say I did have an air-lock compartment in this baby, and say that compartment did contain a small quantity of contraband dairy... what do you want it for?
I've never heard of that or any other secret, illegal cheese.
I'm looking for some Green Reeker.
So you have heard of it.
Heck yeah it is. You should see my takings! If this carries on I'm gonna add another wing onto this baby. Anyway, what can I do for you today?
But people say you stock everything.

dialogues.title: Ava announces Roberta
lines: Roberta would like to have a chat with you about the photography project.

dialogues.title: Olive outlines her manifesto
lines: It's ready, but there's a small problem. It's not very clean yet. But I'm working on it!
That's good because the soap comes out a bit dirty.
Well I guess we'll just see if the soaps are a success or not. I look forward to proving you wrong!
The soap! Patchouli and watermelon. It's the start of something big.
Alright! Nice one. I'll add you to the mailing list.
Well hello! I love your style today. It's very... I-don't-give-a-fuck-how-I-look. Although you clearly do, because you actually look FABULOUS!
The real goal of the soap isn't cleaning anyway. It's spreading the message.
Yes, the soap comes out a bit dirty. But that's not really a problem.
It's different on each soap. "Revolutionary Power", "Rise Up", "Corp Heads Must Roll", "Solidarity Marches On" and "Mom's Spa Day."
It's good of you to stop to chat. Everything's going well. I really have the formula down now.

dialogues.title: Masato I Thought you said Gelato
lines: Someone gave me a shimmer chip.
How are you going to them?

Hey, hold on a sec - Artemis... Artemis! Listen, there's only two vacant seats left and I guarantee I can get them filled before the flag drops, yeah? Okay, yup. Yup. Uh-huh. I gotta - yeah - look... alright, gotta go bye. Whoooo. Sorry about that. Wait - who are you? Do you play?
Is that how you lost Masato's money?
Whoo, knew I could bet on you. Damn... I shoulda bet on you.
Eh, a DeepNet river flowing to a business acquaintance. Have quite a few of 'em running. I'll suffer a short before I let the 'Sec's bullshit keep me from Lims.
Listen, I'm in good with the Boards. We're on the same track if you get what I mean. Give me three days and I'll have the Lims. I'll ping you as soon as I have them.
Maybe I'll mention it to the Twins first.
No you fucking idiot. Depths below, how the rusted circuit board did you find the Scorpion anyway?
Well, yeah, that's always a possibility. But if you're as good as me? Pffft, not a chance.
Yeah, I know the fucker. Him and his little lackies. Bet you I know more about him than you do. What do you say? Wager hundred Lims?
Call 'em like I see 'em. Or in your case *sniff* *sniff* smell 'em. Have you showered lately? Hundred Lims says you haven't.
Just like that skinny motherfucker to send a scrawny rat from the sewers to intimidate lil ol' me. What, the Twins busy or something?
Anything. I can get you on the boards for whatever, long as you win. Could make you Lims right here.
Ohhhhhh, Masato. I thought you said gelato. Yeah, I know that skinny motherfucker. Just like him to send a scrawny rat from the sewers to intimidate lil ol' me. What, the Twins busy or something?
I was wondering about the Twins. What's their deal?

Okay, okay, just wait a second. Sheesh. Running faster than a direct line from here to Luna. I'll get you the Lims. Just give me a few days, yeah? I had no idea you were coming so there was a chance I wouldn't have them on me anyway.
I don't care about the reason.
Because I donated them to the oil rig separatists.
Can I have the money or not?
Masato wants them now. Not in a few days.
Yeah? Did he say that? Or did he just tell you to get them from me?
Masato? Who the fuck is Masato? And why are they saying I lost them Lims?
So? Do you play or not?
Like I said, I got roped into it.
Oh those fuckers. I don't know. Part of me doesn't really believe they're twins. I'd bet they're banging it out or something. What do you wanna put on it? Hundred Lims?
Yeah, yeah, you did mention that. Or something. I don't know, I wasn't really listening. New train comes in and the board changes, you know?
Are you serious? Like, is this your first debt calling or what? What now? hahaha for the sake of the Binary God. I don't know code-cone you tell me. Isn't that why you're here? Hahahaha.
I keep it tight. The Boards are my friends.
I guess I'll let the Scorpion know.
How were you on the Comms just now?

Alright, look, I don't have the Lims, okay? I got scraped out clean by this express line that ran three minutes ahead of schedule. Three minutes! CorpSec was rippin' at that kind of efficient service.
Neon Gods. Yeah, it is. Now why are you here? Are you looking to play or what?
Do you have his money or not?
I don't know. I got roped into this.
Neon Gods! It's all about money with you people. I bet you don't even know how much you're supposed to collect. Masato just sent you in blind. Huh? What about it? Hundred Lims says I'm right.
Ooof. Now that's a shitty person.
Yeah, I can't actually do that.
Just give me the Lims you owe Masato.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 3
lines: This city can be a bewildering place. Full of strange sights and even stranger people. Luckily for you, I am here to help you find your feet.

dialogues.title: Ask Gunger about books
lines: Did he have feelings for her?
You better go now. And fast.
Now that you mention it: Thaddeus had his fingers in everything shady. Only the black book market he avoided. Strange.
Did he tell how he did it?
The black book market. Such a thing exists?
Did Thaddeus talk about books much?
Nope. No clue what that is.
What do I know about Automata?
Not with me. With Fontus though, yeah. For sure. You should talk to him.
I dunno about that. But even though she was an old Automata, she always had the newest features, ya know? He really stuck with her. Upgraded her.
Yeah? Thaddeus was obsessed with his Automata. Could have replaced her, but never did.
Information about Ava. You've known her for a long time?
Did Thaddeus mention something called "The Old Network?"
Ava remembers she once read them.

dialogues.title: Safia Dialogue 3
lines: I took the liberty of re-interviewing staff across the workforce. You're welcome.
Ladles of mediocrity, but currently nothing worth firing anyone over. That could change very quickly however.
Didn't you say people should stay in their lane?
I think you should leave that up to me.
As I said: you're welcome, boss!
In their lane sure, but always moving forward within it. Nothing worse than a saucier who stopped adding the onions to their Sourbise.
Job complacency can rot a business. I've seen it.
What did you learn from your interviews?
It gets more and more special!

dialogues.title: Meeting Mary Nyx
lines: Oh, you think I need Lims? Adorable. No. It's something more... practical I'm looking for.
Shame? I have no use for it. Or for guilt, regret, conscience… they’re nothing more than anchors, tethering us to the muck of others’ emotions.
Names. I want information on anyone who threatens the flow of business in the LUZ. This is my district, after all.
What will you do with them?
I doubt you'll be breathing anything much longer. Now, get out of my district.
Oh, you will be. Count on it. Now get out of my district.
You give me, let's say, the names of local agitators and where they can be found and I'll give you a Tier 4 license. Rarer than hen's teeth.
Edison Mattix. He runs a network that helps debt orphans escape.
My dear. That's one of my personal favorites. I can't risk someone running it out of business.
Try not to be so boring. You have become slightly interesting to me. Don’t ruin it.
With this Tier 4 permit some of the most prestigious restaurants and clubs are available to you. I'm watching you!
This isn't just a club. It's a rope to pull yourself out of the gutter. A key to a door that has always been closed to you.
Interesting... and one more? Go on, surprise me.
Zaffer. Sign Vandal. Usually found in Lowtown.
Indeed. I've heard somewhat intriguing things about you.
I thought I would get the Serpentarium?
And you're now the owner of a Tier 4 license. Welcome to the Spire club, partner. My endorsement will increase the popularity of all your venues for probably 2 weeks.
I see that my boy Teleshko was wrong about you. So sad you've chosen to be a failure when you were this close to having it all.
Delbert Cherry. Leader of the O.R.S. He's on the Rigs.
That depends... what do you want?
What do you care? It's a good deal. A little information for a huge reward.
Spare me your high-mindedness. They made their choices and so have only themselves to blame. I'll give you a chance to change your mind.
I'm supposed to run a club for you?
Don't interrupt me! The question is simply: do you have what it takes to accept it?
I'm interested in running this club.
I'd rather be a failure than end up like you.
What will happen to the people I name?
Clem Hortelano. Guerilla gardener. She's at the Docks.
I'd rather live in the muck than breathe the same air as you.
You made it up to the big leagues. Don't ruin it now!
They won't be sent on an all-inclusive cruise to the Islands, if that's what you're asking. Well?
Very good. We have intel on all of them already, of course.
You'll give me more than that.
Hmm. I can see we're going to get along just fine.
Because playing them the footage of you denouncing them will be TOO delicious. Might be just what we need to break them completely.

dialogues.title: Talk to Raluca 4
lines: 853 Lims. Times are hard for everyone. I sold some of my furniture to make a contribution.
So, I have the donations for you. Everything I have been able to collect.
It might be the amount we need to make a difference. Thanks again.
Not as much as I would have wished. If I had more time...

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 1
lines: LifeCorp wishes to remind you that you are the regional assistant manager of your own destiny.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Ava found RM Alken
lines: I found a doctor. RM Alken in Metro Hub. Look out for her.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 29
lines: Do you like the sound of rain while you sleep? If so, I could try to make rain noises. Psh Psh Psh. Any good?

dialogues.title: We Need a Place to Smash
lines: What do you want me to do?
You're the one who left me in the morning! I woke up and you were... gone.
True. So what are you doing around here?
So. Many. Tentacles. I couldn't walk for a week. Absolute craziness.
It's a big city out there. Lots to explore and little time to do it. Life's short, yah know?
Didn't something happen with your tumbler things?
Yeah, but I think one of the greatest things about being human is sex, and you can't exactly bang someone if you're an Automata.
Aw, I'm touched. Maybe later I could return the favor? Just kidding, I'm getting ahead of myself. We'd need a place to do that first.
Someone like you? I'm sure you can.
Sure thing babe, I can manage that.
Was supposed to be checking out this club, The Thin Wet Curtain, but it closed. Now I have no where to go for a bit of risque afternoon fun.
*Gulp* A love den for... you and me? I could do that.
Nice. What's got you in this part of town?
Well... I actually have a place. It's just kinda bare right now.
That's... well what are you doing here?
Maybe when you're gone someone will make your personality into an Automata.
