That sounds good. I can help.
Well hey-hey. Remember me? Didn't think I'd see you again.
Let's build a love den. Something that oozes sultry sexuality. Reds and purples and neon lights. A place where someone could walk around in dressed or undressed and no one would bat an eye.
Like me during bathing suit season.
I was thinking the same--oh, you're talking about the place aren't you? Yeah, that works too.
Took the words right out of my mouth.

dialogues.title: Mountain Town
lines: This is Mountain Town. Worth taking a look at if nothing else. Known for its 'creative' architecture. Not sure how much of it is up to code.

dialogues.title: Hire Safia
lines: Well I am hiring at the moment, come work for me!
I'm a lifer. Wait staff only. No hopes for anything more. Just looking to be the best I can be.
I hear you're looking for staff? I might be able to clear out my schedule if you need help?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 26
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Congratulations on completing Therapy! Enjoy being fixed!

dialogues.title: Calhoun's Deal
lines: Apologize. To Salt Pete and the boys. That’s it.
Then enjoy your mutant eels, I guess.
You better be telling the truth, sweetheart. Fine. Consider our contract terminated.
You got a helluva nerve coming here. Either that or you taken a dislike to one or more of your limbs.
And what if I don’t wanna go back?
This way we both get what we want.
The only proposition you can make is which one of your legs I saw off first.
All you need to do is... apologize.
I have a proposition for you.
Alright wait. You got a deal. Get me back on that wharf and I’ll forget I ever saw you.
Impossible. I was banished by those chum buckets.
I spoke to Salt Pete. He’s willing to let you back in the club. If…
I just informed them of their options.
Erase my debt and I'll tell you.
What if I can get your old fishing spot back?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 31
lines: Morning. You should open some windows. It doesn't smell very fresh in here. Did you eat beans yesterday?

dialogues.title: Looking for Something
lines: Yup. That's for sure. Maybe you should try to score some Post-Ap. Be a lamb and let us know if the batch is still bad.
I did. Said he didn't know but was looking into it... under the radar like.
That feeling of survival is more than worth it. Seeing it all go down and making it through? That's the end. That's all that matters right there: surviving.
Post-Ap? Seriously? It's an eye drop hallucinogen, you know? Makes you see the end of the world and feel like you survived Armageddon. Each trip is different. Fire. Floods. Nukes.
Do you know who's poisoning it?
Huh, figured you sucked. Least I was right about that. Don't worry about my dead sister by the way. I'm sure her ghost can figure it out.
I'm sorry but just who the fuck are you? How did you know Tehani?
Who would be stupid enough to do that?
Looks like it shook you too.
Yeah, well, Post-Apocalypse has gone bad, and the supply of LV426 is non-existent. So don't bother.
In the end, you're just another marker and a name in the Holocropolis. Anything else you want or can I get back to work?
Magz asked me to check on you.
When we were kids Tehani would always try to trail along. One time--get this--she got busted for a false retinal scan at this club downtown. I didn't see it happen, was already inside.
Cuz when I ordered my next drink she was the one who brought it to me! They made her work the whole night for trying to get in underage.
You still didn't tell me who you are or why you're here talking to me.
Good, because otherwise the Post-Apocalypse has gone bad, and the supply of LV426 is non-existent. So don't bother.
I'm not looking for a drink.
Mountains last I knew. Trying to approach a new lab or something. I don't know. I searched his place, I'll admit it.
I met Magz. He asked me to check on you.
If you're looking for Wireless Connection, the club is over there. Otherwise I'd suggest Brunelle's down the street.
Whatever. What I'm really here for ...
Magz? I swear that kid. He used to hang around Tehani. Her death shook him.
Never used to be. But lately?
Have dozens more. Would be writing new ones if she had stayed away from this batch. Had just taken a break and decided enough was enough for now. At least the Holocropolis is nice.
People die. It sucks but you move on.
I don't. Normally she gets them from Idlehands. She'd been dating him for years and I don't really wanna believe it was him. They were good together.
She'd only get her stuff from him. Trusted source and all. Wanna make yourself useful? Buy some off of him and let's see.
Yeah, alright, fine. I'll do it.
An asynchronous bar and dance club. A moment in time. Poof. And then it's gone.
If only it were that simple.
Other than a few holocordings I could have gone my entire life without seeing? Nothing.

The batch is bad. So was the last one. Someone's fucking with it, adding something that makes it so intense, so euphoric to survive the end, nothing else compares. Nothing. And when you can't have that feeling all the time?

dialogues.title: Ava explains Nightmode
lines: Why did you say "almost" everyone is at home?
Between the security cameras and the drones, CorpSec has eyes at night. There's places you can hide though.
Nivalis gets so quiet at night. The curfew has almost everyone at home.
Shelters that have popped up across the city. If you find yourself on their radar, you can duck in one of those if you can't make it back to your apartment.
Easier to buy and sell illegal items. Opportunity to get creative and 'visit' rival businesses, maybe leaving with a few things in hand.
This is only temporary. Return to your apartment before curfew and you can sleep in your own bed.
Why would anyone want to be out after curfew?
Some people only come out at night. They'd have you believing their skin will burn if it meets the sun.
What happens if you get caught?
Well, not everyone plays by the rules. Being out at night is restricted but not deadly. Unless...
If you don't make it home before curfew, a local shelter will be provided for you. You are currently in it.
If I had to guess I'd assume serial killers move better at night. Though CorpSec has implemented quite a few safeguards to keep the populace contained--I mean safe.

dialogues.title: Nixxi on Calypso Island
lines: Maybe we can just be friends first?
You don't? But... that kinda makes me want you to want me to date you. Do you get it?
Hi. What would you rate me on a scale of one to ten?
I like you, do you want to date?
Well... I guess we're alone now....
That doesn't sound like a great deal for me.
Oh, we haven't done that in weeks... But it might work... Let's give it a try.
My viewership is plummeting. What in CORA's name did you do? I've never seen a decline in numbers like this. How are you so bad at this!? I hardly have any viewers left!
You've tanked my numbers, you've wasted my time, and you've weirded me out. I need to get out of here. See you around.
I'm glad your audience listens to me because you don't.
Hey, quick! My engagement is dropping. Calypso Island is a big fucking dud for the algo. The pixxies liked you last time. Kinda! Come on stream with me!
Me or a million Lims. You have to choose. Come on!
Give me your best pickup line, and if I like it, I'll go on a date with you.
Don't think about it too hard. I'll throw in ten percent of the streaming revenue - about a 1000 Lims - if you just go along with it.
Eww. No. You just get to sit next to me while the Pixxies tell me what to eat.
I don't want to go on a date with you.
What do you want me to say?
Yes! That's it. Get angry. Or... flirty?
You're like a neural hack. You're in my head, I can't stop thinking about you, and you're gonna get me in a lot of trouble.
Well this was good for my numbers. Overall. So have some cash, and I'll see you around.
Just give me your best pick up line. If it raises my engagement numbers, you win.
Quick! Don't pick anything in the middle. That doesn't traffic well. Zero or ten, or say something random.
Has CorpSec covered you in parking tickets? Cos you got "fine" written all over you.
You're prettier than the rainbows over nuclear substation 12 when it's leaking uranium ions.
Nice! I mean horrible, but my numbers went up so... good job.

dialogues.title: Ava Explains the Item Finder
lines:
Oh I already downloaded the application. It should be done installing right about... now. Give it a whirl. 

PRESS [C] TO ACTIVATE
Well it can be sorta glitchy with the people aspect. Sometimes it gets things wrong. At least from what I can tell.
It might be hard for you to believe but there are a finite amount of thoughts in your head. I don't sleep. That's a lot of time to spend with them.
You have no idea what I'm talking about do you?
Some of them. It tries to identify usefulness, comparative interests, ways the person could be a positive influence on your life.
Well, with the Comms being down, there's a lot of unused processing power just hanging around in Grafts and Automatas.
I don't know what that is.
I figured, but preamble is great. It highlights things in your environment that have a high probability of being useful.
Exactly. Useful things and all that. Sometimes people too.
I found something in the Nets that might interest you.
You were just surfing the Nets for fun?
Apparently, a tech collective found a way to repurpose and use it as a commodifier.
Seems kind of shallow or manipulative.

dialogues.title: You Did It
lines: You sure? This could be a chance for you to ride up to the top with us.
Call 'em like I see 'em. Yet you proved me wrong so here we are. Wish I had a pack of glow sticks for yah.
There's nothing wrong with the status quo.
Not gonna lie I had my doubts but here you are like a smooth base line.
I'll take you anywhere you want to go.
Ha. I’m sure. And now you’re here to whisk me away from this life of crawling through clubs and plop me into one of mediocrity, right?
If you're always searching then you're never truly happy.
Nice!!! We're gettin' back to the big leagues! Spire here we come! Then, who knows? Onto Luna!
What do we need to do?
We'll have to do that sometime. There's absolutely nothing like a sweaty grind sesh under neon lights and pulsing speakers.
If it gets under your skin, sure.
Because you're celebrating. You're allowed to do that.
I'd love to dance with you.

Oh, well, good. So... now we test the waters. Tease a collab and climb back into Starlight Lounge. If you could help get us in there it would guarantee we rightfully reclaim our spot on the dance floor.
Well I got your Lims right here. Willing to pay double if you can do something else for me.
Wouldn't that be fun to do with someone?
I'm glad I could disappoint you.
I'll add your lack of confidence to my fee.
Oh yeah? You like being a disappointment?
All about the payment, huh? Not sure why I thought any different.
We zaff something! I need you to talk to Zaffer, see if that graffiti genius can work something up. Something big.
Hmm except there is. If the status quo happened to be so great we'd never advance! There would be no new tunes or vibes or places to go!
That was cheesy but I appreciate the effort. I'll give yah a pass since you're cute. You like to dance at all?
I gotta get back to my own thing.
I'm sure you've got a plan.
Holy shit you did it! WE did it! This is going to be epic.
These places like a flashy show. A bass drop they can market. Something that vibrates Lims into their tils. We show 'em the Club Rat Kids are back in a banger way and we'll be set.
What else do we need to do?

dialogues.title: Dagmar gives you one more chance
lines: It's a one-time login. I've been saving it for an emergency. And this is a fucking emergency.
Not if success looks like you.
Why haven't you used it already?
I want my business back in the black! Now! And since it was YOUR fault, you're going to help me.
Why can't you do it yourself?
A hygiene inspector's remote access chip. I had that cretin Cecil Grimes mugged a few months ago. Cost me a bomb.
I don't want to hear it!
Look at my stats! Look at them! A 21% decline overnight! Why is this happening to lovely me?
Change my hygiene rating to excellent. and drop everyone else's score while you're at it. That should bring the customers crawling back.
I've got an ace up my sleeve. Didn't want to use it but since you fucked up my dealings I'm gonna have to.
You got some nerve showing your face here, slimefish. I told you to convince that asshole critic, not piss him off!
What do you want this time?
How dare you, after all I've done? Get out of my sight. If I ever see you again, I'll spoon out your eyes and fry them with bacon.
And you think it's worth it?
I don't like where this is going!
I don't think it's worth it!
Use it to access a CorpSec terminal.
Because it's illegal, jackass. And because I have you to do it for me. Because you want to succeed. Don't you?
Good. Do this and we'll be partners, you and I. All the way to the top.
Bullshit. Did you see what he said about me? "The floors are as clean as the owner's conscience, and the dishes have one flavor: no."
It'll give you access to the hygiene system via a CorpSec terminal.
I can think of a few reasons...

dialogues.title: It's Miso!
lines: You've done more than help. You've given me back my little brother. Even if he doesn't remember me.
I know. But it doesn’t matter. We’ve found each other now. We’ll make new memories.
Seth. I couldn't believe it. I would have walked right past, but what you said made me look and then under that hood, under all those scars, I saw him. My Seth.
No. Not yet. Well, he says he remembers something, an image of his birthday and the cake I made him, but he might just be saying that to make me feel better.
I’m just glad I could help.
There you are! I don’t know how I’m ever going to thank you. How WE can ever thank you.
I think the CBI implant wiped everything.
I’ll never be able to repay you. But you must come for dinner with us sometime. It’s the least I can do. We’ll go for ramen!

dialogues.title: Dotson opens his case file
lines: You can try the android maintenance cafe at the end of the promenade.
Sorry, most places here only sell human food.
Then I shall bid you good day... for now.
Do you sell grade 3 lubrication fluid?
I am looking for a friend of mine. He goes by the name... wait. His agents? They may be listening. I must flee!
You don't hear the word "utmost" very often these days.
My secret mission is... wait! I was almost tricked into revealing my mission of utmost importance.
I must confess... my question was a ruse. A subterfuge. An intentional misdirection.
Perhaps if you might answer my enquiries I can reveal more information to you.

dialogues.title: Ava interferes
lines: Could be. Mad scientists love weird experiments.
He's just an old engineer overrating his former capabilities.
Don't think so. Where's the motive?
Seems like a strong hint your memory is genuine.
Could Coilson really have been LifeCorp's CTO?
We need definite proof. Where could I get it?
Do you think he could have interfered with my memory?
I'll try to access LifeCorp's data about his time as CTO.
What do you make of all of that?
The guy definitely knows a thing or two about bots.
If Coilson was a LifeCorp CTO, then LifeCorp knows about him and his human condition.
You wouldn't give up so easily, would you?
What more evidence do you need?
I wish he could say more.

dialogues.title: Ava A Round of Annoyingly Helpful Advice
lines: I did what I had to do.
So... that interaction with Edison was a little awkward, huh?
No. I need to focus on the business.
So, that package Edison left you. The one you agreed to bring to the Gen Debtors?
More like, how about some discretion if you go through with this. Just an idea.
I don't really care about the kids.
Never too late to change your mind. Unless they're dead, then it would be too late.
Of course it's a lockdown. That was the original name, but CorpSec found that lockdown didn't go over well when they focus-grouped it.
Well, I just wanted to serve you the gentle reminder that we are in fact currently under lockdown so perhaps this isn't the smartest idea?
And what if his little errand could help with the business?
We should focus on the business.
Yes, and while my understanding of morality tells me you should honor that, the analytical part of my programming wants me to tell you that this is a bit risky. I would recommend discretion.
There is that, yes. I'm not specifically saying don't. I just want to express caution and a bit of discretion.
Edison's a friend and I let him down.
Then why do you feel bad?
If you'd like to help him, I can ping him for you. Just let me know.
I knew it! The LUZ is a lockdown.
I'm not going to let it get there.

dialogues.title: You Found Something
lines: Vik Ryan probably has one if I had to guess. Talk to him. Tell him I'm looking for one and he won't break your fingers when you reach for it.
Little critter with claws and a pointy tail?
Where can I get a UV light?
Been a hacker a long time. Learned how to notice irregularities, no matter how small. And I haven't seen a shimmer chip in some time.
It's a shimmer coin. You never seen one? Where the blood-slicked tram tracks did you come from? They have raised images on one side, a trick of the nanolights on its surface.
How'd you know I have something?
Mmmhm. Florescent chemicals in their skin or something. Shine a black light on them and they glow baby blue neon.
Hey, so... what um, what happens to be in that pocket of yours? And don't lie to me. We're past the point of lying.
How much do you know about scorpions?

dialogues.title: Tell Andrea About Malt
lines: The guy seems to sit on it ... wait. Elias Malt? You didn't say Elias Malt!
He probably will protect me from any further investigation. Great choice, thanks!
Fuck yeah. Our biggest fan before the jazz war. Even dated him a few times. Sheesh ...
I dropped them by a CorpSec agent named Elias Malt.
You have any luck with those lyrics honey?
Sorry I kept you out of jail!

dialogues.title: Hire a waiter
lines: Hey Boss, these old bones ain't what they used to be. Especially these leg bones. Know what I mean?
I think I understand what you're trying to say.
A good manager chooses the right man for the right job. You don't ask the one-armed chef to mash the tatters. You don't ask the one-eyed baker to measure the flour.
Quicker. Younger. Whatever. As long as their legs work. Hire a waiter, boss. As soon as you can.
We need a waiter. I can do plenty, but there's one thing I can't do. Every night, I dream I can fly just by wriggling my toes just right, but every morning, I wake up so sore I can barely walk, boss.
You have two arms and two eyes.

dialogues.title: Lynnphora Adams - Final Round
lines: Oh, oh, oh, ever so sorry to bother you but I think you're my next contestant. Are you ready for this silly old chess stuff? No worries if not! You can always forfeit.
I am! If online gaming over the last few decades has taught me anything, it's that crushing people's souls and spirits can be quite enjoyable!

dialogues.title: Ashwin talking inhibitors
lines: Did you get your nanobots working?
It's a lot of money, Ashwin.
I'll have to take your word for it.
I'm not sure about this Ashwin...
Your schemes are making things worse, not better.
We're moving in the right direction boss. Overall...
Spare me the details. How much?
How do we get rid of the new bacterial colonies?
Cyclins are expressed by the cell to regulate cytokinesis. We just need to engineer some and they will take care of the remaining mess.
They were highly effective at reducing the macrophages and eliminating the... slime build up.
I hear you have another proposal?
So do you have a plan for cleaning up this mess?
I think 7000 Lims should be enough.
Think of all the money you can save on cleaning.
Alright boss. I'll prepare my lab equipment so that when I get funds, I'm ready to go!
The problem is the nanobots blast the macrophages into tiny pieces. And those pieces can combine and grow into a new and more dangerous microorganism colony.
I have to think about this.
Cyclin Expression Inhibitors are more complicated than nanobots. Harder to engineer and propagate.
I know boss, I know! But we're getting closer to eliminating the bacteria! We just accidentally made a few (far more dangerous) bacterial colonies along the way.

dialogues.title: Ghost Again
lines: You came. I wondered if I’d ever see you again.
I know, and it has to be soon. The order are holding a code cleanse and if they pick me...
Do you remember the night we met? The night the Irisian Fall lit up the skies and turned the water into a sea of stars?
I never thought you’d feel the same way. It's why I'm here. I'd risk anything to spend just another minute beside you.
I snuck away from the chapter house and wanted to dive into that light. But when I looked down into the water, I saw you.
I don't think we should be listening...
I don’t think she can hear us. I believe she's reliving a conversation that already happened.
Can you hear me at all?
Sadly not much of a future.
She's kinda cute. Still: Let's leave!
And when you looked at me and smiled, I knew you were my future. No matter what.
I’ve been thinking about you too. I can’t concentrate on anything else. I don’t listen during orations... all I can do is think about what you said.
I'll try to get away. Meet me in the gardens, by the stone. In four nights time. I’m trusting you, my love.

dialogues.title: Fauxter
lines: Of course you don't. You let me borrow it.
There's no boat?!?! How are we rocking yachts without the yachts? That'd be like trying to melt their faces in the shade!
Send me the deets and I'll bring the beats. YAOW!
What kinda boat doesn't have a HOVA-pad? Are we playing on the back of a paddle pontoon?
How about you come play them on Calypso Island?
Woah. Call me Captain of the Yacht Rock Club. What boat we jamming on? Wait, does it have a HOVA-pad? I totally wanna parachute from the HOVA to the deck baybee! Talk about an entrance!
Hey, since you said you recorded new tracks...
Do you have a bigger boat?
Sounds familiar. I don't know, I don't know, I've partied way too hard on too many beaches to remember if I woke up on this one...
Nah, I gotta get there. I gave my WORD! And if I don't have a word how am I gonna write songs? You need words to write songs. That's music science baybee!
Yeah! These things are PURE GOLD BAYBEE! Jacqueline Queue guessed on one of them. You know what that collab sounds like? Liquid grooves my friend. LIQUID grooves!
Hey! I have your mixer for you. Put together a couple solid tracks with it.
No, it's on land. A resort owned by Freya Portlet.
I thought you did. Maybe it wasn't you BAYBEEEEEE! I am getting MIXED UP about the mixer.... Yaow! I guess never mind then...
I let you borrow my mixer?
Not... well... Once these new tracks hit I will! And now you got me late to the mastering session. Jac's gonna skin me.

dialogues.title: Razlo talks survival in Nivalis
lines: I soak my underwear in coffee to let my body absorb the caffeine.
You work long hours. I've seen you. What do you recommend for keeping my focus when I get too tired to study anymore?
I can see why HoloHype needs lesbian robot poems?
I should leave you to study.
I have a corporate scholarship with HoloHype Advertising. They're looking to up the "book smarts" of their sales force. Their term, not mine.
Prosaic. But my studies won't wait for my circadian rhythms to stabilize.
I have two main areas of interest, and both have final exams coming in less than twenty-four hours. Corporate guerrilla tactics and sapphic poetry for androids.
I don't believe in polluting my body. Don't get me wrong, I'm no Analogue or Tech-Skep, but once you take that first step into nudging the mind with technology, the brain learns to love the crutch.
My exam is oral, invigilated by a rusty old android called Professor Koboday. Before you go, do you want to know one thing he told me corporate warfare and android erotica have in common?
Every Corp is at war with its rivals.
Questions leave a vacuum that answers want to fill, but bad answers are worse than no answers. My anatomy tutor told me that. Not word-for-word, but I agree with her sentiment.
Make sure you have all the right tools for the job before you get down to business.
I can see why HoloHype needs corporate guerilla warriors?
Uh... Actually I don't get it.
Nor am I a corporate guerilla, but I am, nonetheless, a student of both.

dialogues.title: Fix Rosetta
lines: I'm not allowed to react appropriately.
Thank you... I'm allowed to say. Thank you.
I found you a logic relay.
You... were not allowed to do such a thing for me. I am not allowed to cry. You are allowed to cry. Here is a tissue!
I am not allowed to say how happy I am to see you!
You... are not allowed to be back!
I'm not allowed to tell you I found you a logic relay.

dialogues.title: Danny is judging you
lines: What if I don't want to?
We're a kinda... well what ever name I give ya for a bunch of businesses that work together will get me exiled if I say it out loud. But us businesses... we're friends basically.
If I wasn't so worried about you screwing us all over, I might be impressed. Look... no one is irredeemable. You can turn it around.
You're helpful, kind, community-minded, and you're willing to compromise on your own goals to raise up your neighbors.
In this district we all help each other out. Obviously that don't make us popular with CorpSec.
And you want me to do ... what?
I think they are actually tryin' to arrest me if they can get enough evidence...
We considered how much you helped others. How much you tow the line for the corps, and how much you stand up to them.
We all write our own stories pal. You're might have a good ending, fuck, it might end up being some tragedy.
I mean you're not perfect, and you still make the odd questionable choice, but we recognise all you've done to help this district during a hard time.
We don't want nuthin'. It's more we.... came to a conclusion about you. And I'm here to tell you how we judged you.
It's good news pal! You ain't always kind or friendly, but when the chips are down, you've chosen to help others over obeying corporate rule.
This is going to be interesting.
You're helpful, kind, community-minded, and you're willing to compromise on your own goals to raise up your neighbors.
But if you keep goin' how you're goin' the very least people are gonna say about you is that you tried your best to help folk. And they won't forget that. I won't forget that.
Point is, at this stage in your career, your a cutthroat corporate bastard. You should think about whether that's what you want to be.
We all write our stories pal. You just gotta decide if this is how you want to be known, and remembered. And if not, you gotta write yourself a new ending.
And most important of all, were you climbing on top of us to get to the top, or helping lift us all up?
It's good news pal! At almost every turn, you've chosen to help others over obeying corporate rule.
You're competitive, ruthless, uncompromising, and willing to destroy any obstacle - or anyone - in your path.
So, uh, me and some other business owners have been kinda... keeping an eye on ya.
It ain't good pal. At almost every turn, you've chosen to follow the corporate path.
Would you help me with it?

dialogues.title: The CH 17-V896-SL
lines: This seasons best new extraction hood! 3500 watts, fractal modulator extraction elements, and eighteen independent rotors.
But it's breaking the extraction limits boss! How can you be so unimpressed?
At maximum load it produced only 50 decibels of noise!
It's a leader in its class.
I wasn't impressed with it to be honest.
The price tag can't hold us back from embracing the future!
3500 watts, fractal modulator extraction elements, and eighteen independent rotors, and you DON'T KNOW?!
Our old hoods are working fine.
Hey boss, tell me you already know about the V16 Hoodtron Extreme Edition? The CH 17-V896-SL?

dialogues.title: Second Meeting with Salma
lines: I'm curious, that's all. You seem lonely.
If you or your bosses want something, just get it over with and tell me, please.
Are you in some kind of trouble?
Oh. Well, there's nothing to know so…. sorry, I guess. Goodbye.
You're not...? I'm sorry, it's just you were asking questions. And talking to me. That doesn't usually happen for a good reason.
It's just… the questions. You keep asking them. And talking to me. I don't understand why.
No, it's nothing. Sorry again. Goodbye.
I don't want anything. I’m sorry.

dialogues.title: Did Alfie escape Sanguine Minds
lines: Sadly, no. Why did you have to be so fucking stable? You live in Nivalis. NIVALIS! Even the people who are happy have lost touch with reality. Obviously.
Please. We don't use that word. The term is "mentally damaged beyond repair" by the therapy you received.
Yeah. The bane of my life.
Whatever man. I'm stuck with this fucking therapy job forever I guess.
Hey, so the results are in...
I'm free. I'm finally free. The Sanguine Minds Project voided my contract. I've been told to deny all knowledge of their existence. I'm out!
That's what we were shooting for.
Did I act crazy enough to get you off the programme.
Hey, I like that! What kind of Alfie should I be? Give me a new name. Something catchy, that screams "Fresh start".
Yes! You're nuttier than a fruit loaf. A nutty one. I know that's not a socially acceptable way to say you're fucking mental, but... you know what you are.
Har. Har. Fuck you very much.
You really are, you glorious, mad bastard.
I used to advise small business start-ups. Game companies, zine publishing, hyper pop star training camps. My name is mud now... unless I change it.
Hey, I like it! Thanks. I mean it. When my new business takes off, I won't forget this.
Sometimes you change so much your old name doesn't fit you any more.
And how does that make you feel?

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 1
lines: I’m not sure it’s wise for us to become involved with this situation. It is most likely very dangerous.
Even my deep-scans are coming up empty. In short, I have no idea.
Any way we can block her?
Oh you're back. Who was that?

dialogues.title: Only 1 day left
lines: Thanks for being a pain in my butt.
There's only 1 day left to find a music act for her. She is very influential and easily offended. We shouldn't make her an enemy.
Didn't you forget to do something for Freya?

dialogues.title: Talk to Clancy 4
lines: I own the noodle stand in Meridian market.
Oh, it's you is it? Only just coming to me now as a last resort?
So just... take this 5000 Lims and don't tell anyone you spoke to me. I don't want to be associated with this debacle.
Which is all I would be able to conjure for that poor kid.
Well, forget about asking for my help now. Clancy Pantermino doesn't do shoddy rush jobs.
Three weeks you've been campaigning. Do you know how many eyeballs we could have reached in that time? How many wallets?

dialogues.title: Band Member 4 - The Drummer
lines: Trust FAUXTER?! I wouldn't trust him as far as I could throw my drum kit. But... dammit, if I don't miss playing music with people... even if those people are that FUCKING band again...
Well, anything I can help you with?
Maybe? But I didn't feel it. And I certainly didn't feel like I was "accepted" when I was on stage in front of seven fans, and five were booing.
Dammit... Alright. But just because it's you. And you seem decent... in a "pushy-but-pleasant" kind of way.

That's what Fauxter used to call me. How did he put it? "The woman with no emotions, but GREAT rhythm. Please welcome to the stage the most robotic musician in Nivalis - including the robots. Here is THE DRUM MACHINE SIX THOUSAND!"
You really know how to tug on the ole heartstrings. Didn't take you for being so... I dunno, spiritual about it.

Fine! I'll do it. But I don't want to hear anything more about Fauxter. I'm there cos I need an excuse to play drums. That's it. Now I gotta go. My old kit is in storage and I gotta hire a lifter droid to clear it out for me!
It took me a long time to figure out I don't really fit in anywhere. And that's fine. I mean, if I DO fit in anywhere, it's with other people like me who don't really fit in either.
But... I do miss the drums. I loved to play. The rhythms really helped settle my mind when my brain had "the zoomies."
Yeah, well, ole Fauxter was never the best with PEOPLE. Or things, or places. He's basically the most incompetent, upsetting person I've ever met. Good front man for a band though.
I dunno though... How can I be sure Fauxter won't fuck it all up again? Say I agree to play drums - just a few gigs for fun - what would I get out of it?
We're putting the band back together.
So you won't rejoin the band?
But I didn't really care about any of those things. I was just trying to find a place where people accepted me.
Look, playing drums in a failing funk-punk band was never exactly my scene, but in my early twenties, I was doing a lot of things that weren't really... me. You know?
And, well, I'm working on a game with rhythm action elements. Maybe drumming again would help? You know? As research.
You just have to trust him. He really wants to make it work this time.
You just have to trust me. It will be worthwhile.
Trust your instincts. You want to play drums again. No matter who you play with, the MUSIC is what's important.
Fauxter asked me to talk to you.
The band? So they need the old drum machine six thousand, huh?
So I tried things. Before I started developing games, I was into baking, handicrafts, cutting-edge sneakers, murderball, knitting, nuclear isotopes...
Heya! You got some frown lines going on there. It's' frown-town on your brow. What's with all the frowning? You ok?

dialogues.title: My Friend, How'd You Find Me
lines: I don't think it's that easy.
Your kindness will be everlasting, even if I will not. I hope we meet again, my friend.
I didn't know androids could be unemployed.
Free will is nothing more than the ability to make a choice.
I am at a state in my existence that can be considered the last stretch of the race.
What happened? What did they do to you?
Indeed. Might I ask how you knew where to look for me?
We can't, hence my calculated decision to leave.
This... I left in such a hurry I thought it was gone. Thank you. From the bottom of my synthetic heart, thank you.
What? Of course not. I left on my own volition. Although it is safe to assume my former employer did not agree with my timing.
Of course I remember you my friend. I hope things are well. I trust you were able to obtain the access to Freya that you required?
Volition? Do you have free will?
From a business perspective that makes sense.
Why did you need to leave?
Your concern is both admirable and appreciated, my friend. But alas, this is my lot in life. I have served my purpose for the extent I was meant to.
I may be an artificial intelligence, but my primary function is to take in knowledge and make decisions based on that knowledge.

In a different time they might have. But due to increased automation and cheap imported parts from the Vents it is actually more economically efficient to purchase a newer model then it is to upgrade the internal components of an older one.
Indeed. But on the scale of things that are, how you say, so fucked, it is but a blip. Might I ask how you knew where to look for me?
Unfortunately it's not what they did to me but what they would do to me if I remained.
Preparing. I had to gather somethings and meet several acquaintances.
Oh, wow. I'm surprised to see you here. While there's always a probability of such an encounter you have to admit this one feels a tad... serendipitous.
Maybe not, but it's less hurtful to be a little bit cynical about myself.
I'm afraid my systems are no longer compatible with the latest firmware upgrades rendering me inoperable or, at the very least, inefficient in my employment.
I found this on the beach. (give Anchor Pin)

dialogues.title: Kenzs Lost Her Glow sticks
lines: What do you want me to say to him?
Whoa! Hold your Hovas. These clubs are the pulse of the city. Their beats? Those songs give us life.
I don't know. Ever since he went off the deep end he's been skulking around staring at puddles. He's probably in the canyon somewhere.
Then what do you need me to do?
Wow. Alright. There's a bonus track I didn't expect to hear.
Maybe you can get me into one of the clubs in the Spire?
Used to? What happened to him?
Haha. Be the least you could do if you stole my sticks. What you lookin' for in return.

I bet you took 'em. Yeah. I'll throw Lims on the fact that you stole 'em to try and get into the show at DXncYrs. No way you're getting in dressed like... that. So, you figure fuck it, let's get me some accessories.
I can't believe those are still a thing.
Uh-huh. And my blood is made of black lights. If you know him, talk to him! This is how we start the promo circuit.
Holy blown speaker! I don't know. Just get him to come see me or at least record a tune. I'll start getting the word out about him making a come back. We time this right, it'll be Spire-worthy.
I didn't take your party favors.
What are you going to do?
You? You know Finn Amano? The DJ? How?
So let's figure out how to shut 'em down!
Whatever. It's fine. I definitely lost 'em though. Will have to scour for another pack before I hit the party. This LUZ man. So hard to get contraband shit you know? Friggin' CorpSec.
Promos have run their course and I got people bad mouthin' a show I put together because two of the DJs bailed last minute. Something about a holo-short that sucked them into the nets or something.
Lean into your curious nature and help me find someone. A DJ, goes by the name Finn Amano. He used to have the synthiest, trippiest, most - umph. His songs massaged the sweats from your pores.
No offense, but I kinda figured.

I don't know. Everyone thinks he ate some bad fungi and got stuck in wonderland. All I know is that he started rambling about the original AG and stopped recording tracks. He still makes 'em, but won't put any out in the waves.
Can I help you bring it back?
You got some anger in you.
Yeah, something about the way the lights reflected or something. I don't know. I had my headphones in.
That's a lot of .... not-hing. Get it?
So let's get something to melt their bodies too!
Ah, there it is! Like the bass drop boom! Alright, help me get my reputation back to where I can get into the Spire, and I'll bring you into whatever club you want.
Blast if I know. Haven't heard from em' since.
Yeah, I've met him. Seemed cool.
Bummer. Good luck getting it back!
You haven't seen a pack of glow sticks have you?
That's the jam! What we need is a good hit. Something that vibes with a lot of people, hitting their very souls.
Yeah... You know: little plastic tubes that you crack and shake and they glow bright colors. Hence the name: glow sticks. Like the ones I'm wearing?
Nothing yet. Trying to network but things haven't been as good as they used to.
The biggest thing is getting something to promote. All the joints on club corner have event calendars that will literally melt your face off.
I am not on anything. I'm also not not on anything. It's a double not. Not like the double knot I'm gonna leave your trachea in if you took my glow sticks.
I don't know. Reputation is everything in this circuit and those fools sent mine to the bottom of the grimy-ass sea.
You would be too if your career was tanking.

dialogues.title: Lucy Has a Proposition
lines: I want some top tier acknowledgements.
I don't want anything from you. Or to do with you.
Uh, obviously. Starting tomorrow. And... thanks, peasant.
Are you in some kind of trouble?
Ya, I know. Just don't start crying or anything like last time.
Yeah. We're all in this together, right?
I KNOW, right? It's an unbelievable offer. So what do you say?
What's not to get? I'm offering to like, acknowledge you in public.
I know, you're intimidated by me. But don't be. It's a great deal. I'll agree to verbally acknowledge you, to a limit of five words per interaction. Facial expressions cost extra.
No, YOU'RE on your own in the stupid... stinky... loner place. You... slimecrab. Fuck you!
So, you'll help me? I mean, you'll act now and grab this dazzling offer?
UGH. Whatever. Look, so far it seems like you've kept your mouth shut about my... little secret... so I've decided to offer you an exclusive deal.
It's a great deal. I'll agree to verbally acknowledge you, to a limit of five words per interaction. Facial expressions cost extra.
So... what's in it for me?
I never... I mean, sure, whatever peasant. This is gonna do you some big favors.
So, here's the deal. For a small, one-off payment I'll give you access to my acknowledgement for a whole month. How does that sound?
Fuck no! You're on your own.
Hahahaha, trouble? Why would a fabulous opportunity like this seem like trouble?
Welcome to the real world, sis.
Urgh, you are such a Lowtowner. Fine, 50. But don't tell CorpSec.
I... I got fired this morning. And CorpSec took my only Lims as a Re-Employment Encouragement Fee, so... I'm... broke. I have nothing.
You get to be cool by proxy. Don't expect me to actually, like, converse with you though. I'm trying to keep my aura clean.
You want me to pay you to be nice to me?
This one-time offer can be yours for just... 100 Lims?
UGH. Whatever. I'm about to offer you an exclusive deal. Do you know how lucky you are?
Hey Laborer. We need to parlay.
I'm here to offer you an exclusive deal. Do you know how lucky you are?

dialogues.title: Ava comments on Dagmar's betrayal
lines: No. Simply making an observation. As always.
It would appear that Dagmar has, how shall I put this, dropped you in the shit.
I am uncertain why. She made no secret of her devious nature. I would recommend avoiding her in future.

dialogues.title: Visit Huckstash 1
lines: I'll give you her details but I cannot stress enough, you are an Oogle, If you've never hopped a train before, this will be dangerous. There is a high chance you will not walk away from this. I don't have time to train you and neither will my crew.
Ok, you're looking for a woman that goes by the name DeeDee Thumb-it. Formidable force of nature. She saw Aseptic kill a man. With her own optics.
Hmmmm. Wouldn't trust you as far as I could throw a billy-coupling but that does sound like the kind of thing she'd do.
I wondered when one of you would be knocking on this door.
Sure anything I can do to help.
Funny and ugly. I've hit the jackpot.
Kid, I live on the railways. I know lots of things. We all do down here. None of it is any interest to you lot, so we just keep to ourselves.
I don't work for her, I'm being coerced.
Yeah that's her name. Mean, rude, patronizing. Like every other Corpster out there. Which is why I'm done talking to you.

Firstly, only a hobo can say hobo. Secondly, yes. Of course he did. If you wanted to target debt orphans where else would you look first? I'd figure there are more debt orphans riding the rails than rats.
I'd say, at least Thirty NATA-logs ago. Two standard years maybe.
Probably best that I don't know. So if I give you my contact, you'll give me the NATA-Log?
Don't patronise me. Just tell me where to find them.
You speak pretty fluent cop don't you? Look, I never saw him, never had no reason to. That said, I do know someone who saw him first hand.
Anything else you can tell me? Got a description?
Well shit, ain't you the little runaway freight train that could! You should hit the brakes before you get derailed. This is a path even a hobo shouldn't walk.

You know what slack-tension is? You know what riding suicide means? You know how to catch out on a meridian sidewinder carrying sixteen terra-tonnes of sand-blasted foundation slate? No, I didn't think so. You want to walk the tracks, you gotta prove you know your highline from your clove-hitch.
I got your details from McFellow.

Not more of this. I already told that Corpster hack what I know. Which is diddle-drip. I ain't seen anything, my guys haven't seen anything and if I was Aseptic? I'd certainly be too busy slicing throats to be down here all day. Get lost.
I have enough to do without running your errands.
Told you that kid was the real deal. So if I give you my contact, you'll give me the NATA-Log?
I'm following a line of investigation regarding The Aseptic.
Oh, of course you are, now that Pavement-Pacers are being killed in droves. Who gave a fuck when we were the target?
I'm interested in the Aseptic case.
I appreciate the warning but this is important.

Hahaha, oh kid, who's going to investigate a bunch of hobos being offed? Sure, we reported it but if there is one thing you can rely on the Corpsters for, it's turning off their optics to anyone who doesn't own stock-options.
I mean... I guess you could... One more thing. If you're heading in that direction, could you give DeeDee a message from me. I have it right here. We have some... History.
I met a blind monk once who said "There is nothing that isn't important" That includes the safety of my crew. I can't be giving out details left and right to every street-Oogle I meet.
What about in exchange for this month's NATA-log?
This is why I don't talk to Oogles. Pavement-Pacers, Concrete-Cowboys, Briefcase-Bandits all walking the streets doing whatever the corps tell you.
I mean, I can see why they didn't investigate.
Look, I really meant what I said about her being formidable. Plus, the last time we saw each other... Look never mind. Please give it to her.
McFellow? The Frother? Never met a person more romantic for the tracks, and I'm a lifelong hobo.
Can I just take public transport?
Nothing worse than an Oogle who don't know they're an Oogle. Leave me alone.
Yeah, a basher. Someone who gets a hard-on for the train network. Useful person to know as a hobo actually. Nerds like McFellow are pretty wired in.
You really are not full of surprises.

dialogues.title: Second Meeting with Noe
lines: Sweet, simple, effective at loosening Lims. The main ingredients are gin, strawberries, ginger and chili.
You’ll always get that from me, darling. Too many people sugarcoat their words in this city, so you don’t taste the betrayal.
Frankly? It's like a Spire debutante caught in the rain: insipid and tasteless.
Sounds like you learned that the hard way?
Could I add one of your cocktail recipes to the menu?
The LUZ will love it. The ingredients are vodka, brandy, HOVA fuel, liquid nitrogen and lime.
Not really. I see you're better suited to the cut-throat world of business than I was. But I do miss the drinks. We had the best menu in Lowtown, new cocktails every week.
No harm in learning to strut before you fly. I’ll give you a recipe for one of the Lily classics. The Strawberry Stinger.
Then how can I improve things around here?
What do you think of my menu?
Of course you do. I’ll transmit the ingredients list to your Automata. Have one on me, won't you?
Hard lessons are the most valuable lessons, darling!
A little. I'm glad you're keeping her spirit alive. What I do miss are the drinks. We had the best menu in Lowtown, new cocktails every week.
I like the sound of that.
Why would I take advice from someone who failed?
A regular Icarus. Watch out for those wings. Perhaps you can handle one of the old Lily specials. It’s called an Ultra 64.
Would you call yourself a cocktail connoisseur? Or an enthusiastic amateur? Some of my recipes can be a little tricky to make.
Well, you can do something about your menu for a start. Where’s the spice? The glamour? The cocktails so strong that when you fall off your chair it takes three days to land?
Come talk to me darling. Ever since I retired I'm in terrible danger of becoming maudlin and it does nothing for my complexion.
Are you still thinking about your bar?

dialogues.title: Ava explains Vending machines
lines: Assuredly! The influx of visitors and the travel restrictions from the LUZ has increased the demand for cheap, low quality food and drink. There is a gap in the market. A vending machine-shaped gap!
I see you have discovered the exciting world of vending machines. Another lucrative business venture!
Vending machines are a cheap and easy way to accrue passive income. Passive income is a form of leeching money from others with minimal work! You just need money to begin with.
Vending machines are the past. But also the future! Your future.
I've already activated your vending machine license extension! When the time comes you will be able to buy, place and manage vending machines in suitable locations.
A vending machine license is expensive, but we have one! Inherited from our Thaddeus business portfolio. That's why you can already begin your vending adventure. Exciting!
This is really going to make us money?
So, how do we do this?
We don't HAVE money to begin with.

dialogues.title: Saban in the sewers
lines: Thanks. I'm enjoying the solitude. Though I have a question for you first, if you have the time?
The moment is all that matters. What you think and feel and the choices you make.
Do you really believe that? That people can learn lessons and we don't make the same mistakes? Humanity can't stop making the same mistakes! Neither can I!
If you knew something terrible would happen to everyone, but you couldn't change it, and you couldn't prove it, what would you do? How would you act?
All good. See you later, stranger.
We need a bright future to look forward to. Hope is what matters.
But you know the outcome of the choices. And the terrible thing will still happen. Still...that's an interesting answer. I'll need to think about that.
Hey, we're just a couple of rats down in the sewers now, right? What brings you down here little rat friend?
I'm good. I'm actually enjoying the solitude. But I wanted to pose you a question... if you have the time?
Can you guess why I'm down here?

If each moment is neither the future nor the past, but a slice between the two so thin it doesn't exist, does the past and future matter? If the past is a story that's already been told, and the future doesn't exist yet, is the moment all that matters?
You don't get it at all. But that's OK. I'll see you around. I need to be alone for a while.
Drinking to feel better. Thinking I can reason my way out of depression. Responding to emotional breakdowns with logical arguments.
I need some time. We can talk later. Hey, have a great day, OK?

I'm trying to make a quick buck. The LUZ has stopped a lot of the more... esoteric items making it into Meridian. One of them is a fungus Ma Gomba sells. She thinks she harvested it all, but I know a spot where it blooms.
Memories are what matter. Lessons from the past help us avoid the disasters of the future.

dialogues.title: Ava I've Pinged Him
lines: I received a message from Edison.
Should probably look at changing the locks. Just saying.

Noodle Master! Knew you'd come through. You're doing the right thing. I know you know it. Ask yourself where you'd be had someone not done the same for you. Well, not exactly the same, but close enough.
Thanks again, friend. I'll be in touch.

I left the package at your place. Not your shop, your place. Couldn't trust it out in the open. Should probably change your locks when you get a chance. The Super used the cheapest ones on the market.
Guess I better pick this thing up.

dialogues.title: Only Eyes Confession Show
lines: Next up we have a message from user Berald94, long-time listener first time 'fesser, who says Ivan, I am having an affair with my own hologram.
First, we have a message from Bruze who says: help, I lied about loving garlic on a first date. Now we're married and my wife just got a garlic gland installed for our anniversary.
Ave, sinners, get ready to hear the darkest, dankest, dirtiest of secrets because you're listening to Ivan Iker McGuire and this is... Only Ears.
I can't stop crying. Oh Bruze, time to come clean, or better yet, get your scent receptors removed and say nothing. Problem solved.
Ave, sinners, get ready to hear the darkest, dankest, dirtiest of secrets because you are about to enter... McGuire's Fess Hole.
He thinks he's being targeted by vandals but I can't help myself. Am I weird? Haha, not compared to some of the freaks out there, V!
Well sinners that's all we got time for this week. Tune in again soon for truth, absolution or straight up harsh judgement with me, Ivan McGuire. Thank you and goodnight.
Lastly we've got a message from V who says, Ivan, I have a fetish that involves sitting on cakes. I am dating a baker purely for access to freshly iced sponges.
It started out of curiosity but now I want me to leave my wife for me. Haha, good luck with that one, Berald.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 6
lines: Yeah, information like that could be useful to the case.
Huckstash's audio-log isn't encrypted. We could listen to it if you'd like?
I can't really take back what was said last time. It wasn't me really. Anyway, I know you have retired, technically, but if you'd like to take a last trip. Well you know to where to look for me.
Deeandra, look I know it's been quite a few NATA-Logs since we last spoke. Too many. I took some time drifting the East Meridian, picked up a few guys along the way. They all asked about you.
Sounds like they really do have history.
See, thing is, I'm getting older, I assume you are too. I've just been thinking a lot about, you know, catching the last wind as it were.
I'm bad at ending these things so I'm... Just... going to say... Ok bye... How do you sto-
Hopefully this DeeDee character is less formidable than he says.

dialogues.title: Marius offers protection
lines: You know how putting meat in a freeze bag can keep it safe from dust-rot? I can be that bag for you. I could keep you safe. Let me be your bag.
Great! I really wish this wasn't how things worked but here we are. Sad. So Sad... Fifty Lims should cover it for a few days.
Protection money? It feels like a scam.
Good to see you're still standing. You're taking this whole thing quite seriously. It's time for us to talk about survival.
And to think, I was actually growing to like you. See you in the morgue amigo.
The carrousel, the maelstrom, the ring road of death... the catering cartel.
The way I see this working, you offer me a modest stipend, a few Lims say every week.
And I keep the wolf from your back, the bear from the door, the bosses from your kneecaps.
I'm only offering this to you because you seem like you need it, I'd hate to see that pretty little face get washed up in the docks.
I've seen my fair share of business warfare. I think it's time we work out how to keep you safe.
Protection money? It sounds like a fair deal.

dialogues.title: Mala Spinx - Round Six
lines: I have some free schedule space if you're ready for a game? I'm told you're the next one up.
Time is money kid. If not now, we can circle back when you have more bandwidth? Though there might be a winner by then. It'd be a shame if it were somebody else.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 5
lines: This device seems to be addressed to McFellow. I wonder if it's the same McFellow who wrote a blog about the Crusty Punks?

dialogues.title: Ava offers the alternative view
lines: You're saying we should narc on Clem?!
Information on illegal activities has a value, especially to CorpSec.
Let's grow flowers on the Oil Rig.

While Ms Hortelano’s dedication to gardening is admirable, it is certainly against the law. Section 9 of the CorpSec Metro Ordinances specifically prohibits “unlawful cultivation of organic productivity enhancement areas”.
We... could do that. So long as you are aware that information on illegal activities also has a value, especially to CorpSec.
Flowers not fines! We're re-wilding the streets, baby!
It's your choice. What would you like to do?

dialogues.title: Palmer is Hiding
lines: Listen, I don’t want much. And I can’t promise shit. But you help me, I might help you, ‘k?
Doesn’t exist. You’re on your own.
Yeah, but the good kind of trouble. The kind with a reward at the end.
If I take the message, what then?
No. I’m just allergic to floodlights and cameras. They bring me out in a rash.
Well fuck you very much. Enjoy your day, supergrass.
Having some... transport issues right now. My ride got nixxed which means I’m kinda stuck here.
I hate to do this when we’ve only just met but I need a favor and you look like the charitable type.
What does a narc look like?
Why not take the train? Or a cab?
I’d wait until dark, but then there’s the curfew and I’d rather not get my ass fried by some enforcement drone.
And you’re not undercover for the OrbFuzz?
Shima as in the crime boss?
Eh, aren’t we all a bit criminal from time to time?
Better dressed. I take it you’re not ‘Sec?
Would I tell you if I was?
HA! You're clearly not Orbital Force - those space cop bastards have no sense of humor.
Orbital Force. Astro Watch. Space Cops.
Let's just say I’m manifesting a covert outlook.
Hey wait, don’t go, you’re the first person I’ve seen who doesn’t look like a narc.
Then you can come back here and tell me what he says. And bring some food. I’m so hungry these rats are starting to look like furry kebabs.
Look, right now I don’t like the streets and the streets don’t like me.
Like to know who I’m talking to. So what d’you do?
And I live in the Spire.
You got that on a LifeCorp tea towel at home? Listen, I don’t want much. And I can’t promise shit. But you help me, I might help you, ‘k?
All you gotta do is go find a guy called Shima. Masato Shima. And tell him “Palms down”. You got that?
Well, BOSS it’s nice to meet you. And ...

dialogues.title: Fourth meeting with Noe
lines: I didn't know we were doing insults. 800.
But what about all of the good memories? Won’t you lose those too?
What if I had a bar in need of a cocktail consultant…
Yes, but what’s the point when there’s only me to remember? If I can’t live in the past, I might call it a night.
I'm sure you'll make a fine, decent waiter.
You'll make a fine bar owner, I just know it. And as for me... I've finally decided what to do with myself.
I guess you know what’s best.
A consultant. I could do that. But I'd charge a fee... say, 1000 Lims?
It's one final party. One glorious all-night extravaganza, and then I’ll go and get myself re-set. Wipe away all the sadness and start again.
Well… you already have two of my cocktails on the menu. It would be a shame to leave the poor things without their friends. Oh, to the wastes with it, I accept!
Good, you’re here. Did you find the ingredients for my cocktails?
Work for me as a cocktail consultant. It sounds as if you can help me make things a success.
Thank you for reviving my recipes, darling. Have one on me, won't you?
And it is not as if I am swimming in a sea of interesting and dignified job offers.
Then "no" is my final answer. I think I'll move on after all. This conversation is drab.
I look forward to doing business.
That’s sweet of you. But even a bon vivant needs Lims. There’s only so many pairs of Derclouds I can sell.
I'm tired, and I've been a drag - pun intended - on the corps long enough. My second life will be easier for both of us.

dialogues.title: Humor Bot attracts the rats
lines: Are you here because of that seismologist and his schemes?
You can't tell me what to do. I am a Humor Bot. I am here for the laughs, not for attracting rats.
Oh I see. You just reject anything I say.
Well I told him the same thing I'll tell you...
Promise me to spare Nola's apartment!
Greetings. Are you here for a humor appointment?
No, you don't! Try and manipulate or coerce me and you will fail. I am too strong-willed. Too independent. A free thinker.
Are you the Humor Bot that attracts rats?
Well I am not in the mood today.
You must NOT go into Nola Berg's property and lure the rats to ruin her business.
I forbid you from visiting Nola Berg's business.
But you've been programmed to do it.
I refuse to wait. I simply will not do so.
Alright.... So will you go and lure the rats in?
No I am not. I am a Humor Bot. I have my own opinions. I follow my own rules.
No. I will not do it.
Nice try. But you are not my master and you cannot stop me from going into Nola Berg's property.
Milo told me you would be like this.

dialogues.title: Ava looks for Danny 3
lines: His trail ends at The Docks. Far from Harper's flat.
I keep trying to find out what happened to Danny...
It's possible. Perhaps they questioned him...
And when they realized he was giving them a run around, they arrested him?
We should warn her that CorpSec may have eliminated him.
We may never know what happened to him. But they may have eliminated him if they didn't get any information.
What do you think he was looking for?
If they really questioned Danny, they would have their hands on Harper by now. Unless he kept his mouth shut...
Pretty clever! He was trying to lure CorpSec away from her.
Maybe he offered himself as bait. We told him he was being observed.
If it went down that way, he was pretty brave.

dialogues.title: Question About a Client
lines: I mean have you seen him? Looks like he came out of a test tube stored in the Vents.
And what makes you think I can tell you about Kai Reston? Client confidentiality and all.
Would I be dreaming about you?
3,000 Lims says I'll sign a confidentiality agreement to keep it between us.
3,500 and you get to be a decent person.
Why do they have to be alive ?
I'm actually not here to talk about me.
Kai's studio had three sponsors. Two pulled out which left the burden of keeping them afloat until the Comms returned and others bought in on my shoulders.
Because according to the rules you can't license dreams from a ghost. The transfer between planes was ruled trauma inducing.
Bliss. Happiness. Reality. These are just perceptions. What's real for one is false to another and who are we to be the arbiters of that? If you want to pull him out of his dreams, give him this.
My, you are an impatient little fuck.
I can't determine if I like you or not. Lims first.
Just... can we keep going here?
Before you leave, heed this: life is short and life is difficult, why not let others live out their dreams if it makes them happy?
What does that have to do with you?
On the contrary, I gave him more. CameoPOV has a new product line launching next quarter and I saw an opportunity to penetrate the market.
Do you even have a pillow? Or are you one of those unfortunates who sleep with their arms folded beneath their head?
They receive a small licensing fee and move about their day. Don't worry, it's totally anonymous. The person only knows some of their data is being used.
Kai wanted a sample. Seems like he unlocked his inner most personality. Whether that's rooted in reality or not...
Ha! Look at what the skies dropped on me today. To what do I owe the pleasure? And I'm on the fence on whether or not that's the right word to describe seeing you.
Uh-huh. Never mind it lets children experience the past. Watch their elders and learn from their mistakes.
Yes, because I accept my flaws. I don't attempt to flaunt them.
We at CameoPOV prefer to call it a state of personal discovery and contentment.
Then I rent you a cameo chip for you to integrate with your Automata at night and when you sleep, whooosh off to their life you go.
We call it ID - In Dreams. Because in dreams we channel our id, the primitive, unconscious parts of our personalities.
Interesting. Four and you have a deal.
Come on.. what's better than a truly great dream? You're itching for one. There's nothing more spiritual, more powerful than a truly great dream.
CameoPOV Media. CPM for short. You pick your person and you live a day in their life. Doesn't matter who it is. All they have to do is be alive right now.
Interesting. You wouldn't live in a glass house would you?
It is a surprising turn to this otherwise bland day, I'll give you that.

Better than an illusion: it's a dream. There's nothing more spiritual, more powerful than a truly great dream. Will change your life, you know. Once you wake up, you'll see the world different. So pick someone who you idolize because they might slip into your subconscious.
Aren't you the one wearing a mask?
Can we put our history aside for a minute?
Hmmm. Wouldn't expect that insight to come from you.
At night. Or during the day for that matter. Whenever it is that you close your eyes and drift away from Nivalis, do you see anything? Feel anything?
I can give you the best dreams you've ever had. If you're interested.
Because if his studio has shuttered then you lose exposure to thousands of Nivali.
Hi Cirian. Not exactly a loving welcome. Kind of curt. Is that what you've dreamed of saying to me all this time?
Is that what you did for Kai Reston?
How do we get him out?
Ohhh, you seem to be on a mission. Trying to escape reality maybe? Find yourself a dream POV you want to experience the next time your head hits the pillow?
Kai has what most don't. Drive. Determination. And a voice, not to mention a face, fit for the airwaves.
Will change your life, you know. Once you wake up, you'll see the world different. So pick someone who you idolize because they might slip into your subconscious.
Simple: Pick your person could be a celebrity, politician, that sexy someone you want but can't get with...

dialogues.title: Ava tracks Gideon
lines: Gideon. I know where he is.
Yes, that's what I was thinking. Thanks for paying attention.
Just remember who is the human and who is the Automata.
To figure out who hired him?
He's a bounty hunter, but there's more to him. He has access to high level Grey Tech. I think if we talk to him again, I can track it back to an owner.
No. He's looking for Thaddeus. Are you properly awake today?
I'll pay attention to what you say.

Please listen to me properly. I once served an old man who didn't pay attention to my advice. All our interactions were by text on his Comm. He skipped past everything I said, thinking there would be no repercussions.
It's not possible for me to forget that.
To figure out who he's looking for?
As will I. I can do nothing less.
Using the resources I have at my disposal, I believe Gideon is at the docks. We should go as soon as you are ready.
He died. I detected an irregular heart beat an hour before the heart attack. If he hadn't skipped past my dialogue, I would never have become Thaddeus's Automata.

dialogues.title: Sanna sounds you out for a job
lines: Why are you so desperate for this?
Look, I'm smart. Not the smartest, but you know, decent. And I work hard. I mean as hard as anyone else in this job. Maybe harder, cos I'm desperate.
I need to know more first.
So why should I hire you?
I'll be fine. But now I'm broke. I'm lost. I need... something. This job won't change much, but it will give me a new start.
I have some amazing experience that makes me the perfect candidate for the job. I mean I was a cave spelunker. Diving into old ruined domes beneath the city superstructure and finding lost techs!
Have you done this work before?
Hey! Uh, sorry to interrupt you. I was just thinking... nah. Never mind.
What else do you want to know?
Soon! Let me just wrap up some things. I'll come by early next week... boss. Can I call you boss? Whatever. We can work it out. Thank you!
I guess so. I mean, not really. I should be honest, right? It's not my dream job or anything.
You're right. You're not good at first impressions.
Think about it. If you need me, I'll be here. I... don't have anywhere else to go.
Hospitality? No. No way. I was a cave spelunker. Diving into old ruined domes beneath the city superstructure and finding lost techs.
There's something you're not telling me.
I am! That has to count for something right?
I'm saying all the wrong things. Let me tell you about myself.
You really think this is a good job for you?
Ugh, fine, I need the help anyway.
I wouldn't normally do this. I'm not good at interviews or making a good first impression, really.
A job. I need to work.
It was a breakup. A... really bad one. Apocalyptic. One where, like... the other person is sewn into the threads of everything in your life and when they're torn out, they take most of you with them.
It's just I saw where you work. Pretty cool!
Sanna. Sanna Sinamon. Nice to meet you.

dialogues.title: No success with Quince
lines: An accurate description. I'm sorry, I should have checked Mr Crogan's records more carefully.
No. Too busy. Rosetta will have to find someone else to help her.
Alright. I'll send you the details of another vendor. I believe there is one on Seaside Boardwalk.
Maybe not. But we still need that part... shall I search for another supplier?

dialogues.title: Third Meeting with Salma
lines: A bit like me. But it’s been so many years. I might have sat down next to him at a counter and ordered Tsukemen Ramen and never known.
He vanished, as if the city just swallowed him up.
If I see him, where could he meet you?
My brother liked it really. Eating it always reminds me of him.
It’s taken a lot just to get this far. I think I know what I’m doing. Goodbye.
I’ve changed too. And this city has a way of making people forget.
Maybe. But it's all I've got.
Maybe it's you who is looking for me?
That’s true. I think I’ve been to every Ramen place a dozen times.
What did he look like? Maybe I’ll see him.
I don’t know. This city just swallowed him up.
But he loved Ramen, so I eat it as much as I can. In case one day I look over the bowl and see him sitting there.
Well, not many places to go thanks to the LUZ.
There's a Ramen stand in Mountain Town. There's a good chance to meet me there.
No, surely not. No offense meant.
Thanks. It’s been nice to talk.

dialogues.title: Marcelle Gives Feedback
lines: I think he has made up his mind, and we should see some reviews appearing soon, maybe tomorrow. Fingers crossed.
I’m afraid I can’t stop to talk, I’ve just heard about the most fascinating hypogeal milk bar.
Wait. Is my food getting better?
Your metaphors are more mixed than Danetti's donuts.
I'm not sure what to make of all this Ava.
If the bowl is the page, then your food is a novel.
I don't think he likes me... or the Noodle Bar.
I'm surprised you can taste anything with a tongue that bitter. Good day.
I didn’t say it was a good one. Still, don’t be disheartened. We need pulp just as much as literary genius. Now, please excuse me…

dialogues.title: Zaffer Zaffs
lines: Sweet. Course, I’m gonna need some neon. I’m all out. Traded my good shit for tools to create my last masterpiece.
Let's just say I know what I like, and I like what I see.
Is there anything else you want?
Well, old Banor ain't bad for his age, but he’s not really my type.
And you just came by to look?
Thanks, but no. I can’t afford to get into trouble.
What can I do for you today?
Ha ha, mate. If you gotta ask, you ain’t punk enough for the ‘Stash. Zaff ya later.
Have you ever heard of the Crusty Punks?
I came by to glom your place. And not a moment too soon. Look at it, colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.
Ha, mellow out, mate. Said I could zaff your gaff. The offer still stands.
I think I know what I like too.
Nothing today, officer. Zaff ya later.
Came by to glom your place. And not a moment too soon. Look at it, colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.
This is Nivalis, mate. Trouble’s gonna get you whether you do what they say or not.
Lemme put it this way: if the Lapin is the demi god of artpunks, then Huckstash is like, the king of freighthoppers. One of the greatest of all time.
Look who it is, my favorite Corpster.
One of them, yeah. If the Lapin is the demi god of artpunks, then Huckstash is like, the king of freighthoppers.
Never far from a train. Crusties got steel in the blood. Zaff ya later.
I would have said pay a visit to my Aunt Mertie but...
Look who it is, finest noodle tout in the LUZ.
So what do you do differently?
Chronic. Why don’t you just change your sign to say “‘Sec Only”?
Could’ve fooled me. Look at this place. Colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.
Huckstash’s crew. He’s a radical old goat. In both senses of the words, know what I mean?
Go see my Aunt Mertie in the market. Mention my name. She knows what I like.
Bit of neon-twisting here, dash of screw-you-CorpSec there. Trust me, it’ll be grand.
Thanks. She was one of the best of us, you know? Can you find Neon Tubes for me? Hive Mall could be a good place to start.

dialogues.title: Meeting Magz
lines: Nova was set to preach today. A throwback to the first scripts, when the Church of the Binary God was nothing more than a weekly meeting at a LAN cafe.
"Peace is coded in absolutes." I have to go, but come see me down at the Seaside Boardwalk Market in a few days. We can look at the ones and zeros.
It's actually very simple. Scripture tells us that life is a series of ones and zeros. You either wake up (one) or you don't (zero).
It's the bedrock of life, like down to the very core of it all. Simple ones and zeros. Yes and no. Dead or alive. We've just complicated everything to a point where it's almost unrecognizable.
You either have a good day (one) or a bad day (zero). If you can find the ones then you're doing alright.
Are they though? Really? I gotta go, but maybe you could come see me at the Seaside Boardwalk Market in a few days. I'd be interested to talk about the gray.
Too bad. Unfortunately it's not going to happen. The church's coder cancelled last minute.
And if I wake up inside a dream?
Agreed. We need to simplify everything.
The Church of the Binary God? The coders behind the Scripture of Ones and Zeros.
Did you come here for the sermon?
Woah. I'm not looking for a cult.
Ummm, we're not exactly a fan of the C-word. That sort of closed mindedness is what has us existing in this mess.

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus revelations
lines: So he did it? So what? He got what he wanted... what we all wanted, but at what cost?
The formula. He figured out how to overcome personality degradation, but only by splitting himself up into a thousand pieces.

Don't be obtuse! To prolong his span of course. But to preserve the diamond, he shattered his heart into a thousand shards. A million. And the pieces pierced every one of us. He cleaved his sins onto the souls of others.

I won't acknowledge his glory while languishing in my own failure. If you want to know more, seek out those who carry a piece of him. His victory is pyric, his future opaque. I hope he suffers eternally.
You should stick your head in an ion vent... I can't believe the old bastard beat me.
You should try to calm down.
Still doesn't make a lot of sense.
He won't tell us anything useful.

dialogues.title: Talk to Ceres instead
lines: Sometimes. It wasn't as secret as you might think. A bunch of tech nerds having a big tech party every day in his department.
Did Gan ever talk about his work at LifeCorp?
He set the code to automatically change every day.
And his technicians always forgot the current key.
If he did, and I tell you, will you leave me in peace? At least for a while?
The last time, I promise. If you can tell me what I need to know.
He once sent me there to pick up some work files he forgot. The key code obviously changed all the time...
Did Gan ever mention a key code for accessing service rooms for The Old Network?

dialogues.title: Gamova Call 5
lines: Have you been keeping your mouth shut?
This is someone I believe you are familiar with. I'd get over there immediately.
While this abhorrent breach of practice is suboptimal, I appreciate your honesty. Please see that you keep me informed going forward.
I have news... There is another Aseptic crime scene I need you to visit.
Of course, I want nothing to do with this.
Good to hear. I have news, grave news... there is another Aseptic crime scene I need you to visit.
Look, I should be honest. I continued the investigation without you.

dialogues.title: Franco is a bit dissappointed
lines: You don't seem to realize the kind of business we run.
Well, I can't contain my love of kitchen gadgets... But I'll try to rein it in a little, boss. I'm still gonna keep reading Kitchen Ninjas Monthly though.
I have to think about expenditure carefully.
I keep my ear to the ground, ya know? Try to keep up to date on the kitchen tech.
But isn't it your business to know?
I find the very best equipment, and you're NEVER interested!
We can work our way up to it! You gotta be ambitious.
Boss I need to talk. I gotta ask you something.
I want to lift people up, not run away to the Spire.
We're in the food business. These are for preparing food!
So the stuff I tell you about is too pricey?
And you want to know why?

dialogues.title: Hepzibah has a book
lines: Maybe you think about this again. I would not recommend aggravating her.
Her book. I wonder if it was a real book. With pages.
And such books are outlawed outside the Spire, even if used as a flower press. She lives in the Gardens, though.
Perhaps... But we might need more evidence pushing us in this direction before we risk exploration.
She owns books to press flowers.
I was just thinking about Hepzibah Gimble...
Do you think we should follow up on this?

dialogues.title: SimBot Shenanigans
lines: Why would you be so ... generous?
Awww, that's so cute, and I care, really I do. Except I don't. At all. Ohhhh, what do we have for them Delilah? Nothing. We have nothing for you.
Got another one logged for the feeds. Talk about a good day!
Managed to get a sound bite before she left! This is gonna be huge! Can't wait to see the bruise it leaves on In-Step. Those bastards have had such a run lately!
You think you know about the SimBot.
Nothing, thought I saw someone. Anyway, gotta go! Lots to do.
Right?! Even a bit of blood on it. I tell yah, nothing like a good game of Hover Derby to watch people beat the bloody bits from each other.
If you're not following her, where's your ticket to?
Why is her livelihood more important than mine? Look, buy the jersey or don't, that's where we're at.
Authentic jersey used in her match against the Booming Snowbirds. Can practically smell her on it. Was a brutal match. She knocked out this one defender, took the gray helmet clean off his head.
The Hover Derby brute? What about her? Ohh! You're a fan? Boy let me tell you, I got something you're gonna love.
Look, something like this? I could easily get 700 Lims for. Eeeaaasssyyyy. But for you? Let's say 500.
Oh neon lights are you from the CasterTech's union? Didn't Sec disband you guys for illegally working to increase pay to subminimal wages?
In the flesh. Well, momentarily. I got a transport ticket with my name on it. What do you need?
I'm a fan and you're scamming her.
Actually, I need to talk to you about Roxi Fynx.
Maybe so, but at least I'll be able to afford some food!
You're a true fan if you tracked me down for it. So from one to the next, I want you to have it. You know, in exchange for Lims.
And you sucked up to her?
You're a grifter and you should be ashamed.
You've never heard of her? She's only the number one zero-g gymnast in Nivalis. Her inverted hover-bar routine qualified her for the Luna championship.
Neither am I. I want to eat next week and with the Comms down and our ad rev next to nothing, I need this. Okay?
Umm, no? Hahaha. Seriously? Buy it if you want it. Oh, and the price jumped. 1,000 Lims and it's yours.
Interview of course. Just wrapped chatting with Alayna Nicole.
My ticket? Oh, nowhere really. I'm just headed to--hey, what's that over there? Is that Cotton Scares the horror clown?
A smart business decision? Look, I got bills to pay like everyone else. Think I want 'Sec to come in and throw me to the wastes? Or worse, The Vents?
No. I do. And I need you to scrap the scan.
Fine. Here. Now give me the damn jersey.
She's a friend and you're scamming her.
