Pleasure doing business with you. Hey, if you're bored later, check out channel 37454. I'll be on the feeds at nine.

dialogues.title: Find Steven McFellow
lines: Over the years the city has seen many gangs come and go. Normally it's young vagrants looking to live a life on the tracks. Jumping on freight trains hoping to find themselves. When these groups organize they become gangs, and it doesn't take long for them to find each other.
Why are train schedules so valuable?
I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.
I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

You should tread carefully around Huckstash. Some say he is the mad veteran of a far-away war. Others say his whole family was killed by Roid-droids. All sound like pretty good reasons one might want to go on a deranged killing spree...
You know a lot about the train network.
Great! Not sure his exact address but he's in the stacks, goes by the name Quince Crogan. You should be able to find him easily. Follow the smell.

Once every four weeks, TRACKS spits out the deciphered schedule called a NATA-Log for the next month and, if you know the right people, they might be able to get their hands on said data before it becomes public knowledge.
Great! Not sure his exact address but he's in the stacks, goes by the name Quince Crogan. You should be able to find him easily. Follow the smell.
And you accused me of being a NATA-head!

I know you. Running the old Thaddeus joint right? Nice little spot, serviced by the East and West meridian train lines. I'm also hearing rumors of plans for a new station a few minutes walk from you. A nice spot indeed.
Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?
I guess you're just going to have to trust me.
Don't you all? How do I know you aren't some NATA-head looking to pawn off schedule-data for Lims?
Hold on. How did you even find me?
Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?
Yeah a NATA-head. Someone who takes NATA data and uses it to game the system.
It looks like I need to hide the blog better.
This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?
Do you know the name Huckstash?
He sounds like a positive lead. Know where I can find him?

Wow... Ok. I'll try and sum this up in a way you might understand. The entire rail system in Nivalis is run by two very diametrically opposed AIs. The Nivalis Autonomous Transport Authority or NATA is an ancient and mad scheduling system that is as old as the city's more crumbled foundations. Built on the old network which will be getting shut down soon.
Never mind. Back to the Crusty Punks. Remember what I said about information being its own currency?

The Train Route and Control Knowledge System or TRACKS. This more modern AI which is build on the modern network deciphers the mad ramblings of NATA into a schedule that humans like me can understand.
I don't have time for this, I'm trying to find the Aseptic.

Thing is, you can do a lot with the NATA-log. You're a business owner, imagine knowing information regarding peak mid-week footfall thanks to rail disruption. Or something more sinister, like planning a heist or even a murder. Wouldn't surprise me if old Aseptic worked the rails at some stage.
A bribe? People's lives are in danger here!
It's classified. Know where I can find him?
I have some questions about the railway.
Pays to keep an ear to the tracks. Good to know who's eating lunch with who and how they got there. Information is its own currency.
I'm happy to offer a bribe.
It sounds like you're stalking me.
Huckstash keeps under the radar. Always has done. News on the sleepers was that he worked alone until he took over one of the railway gangs.

If you wanna track down old Huckstash and his gang, you're gonna need a copy of the NATA-Log. I'd normally have it by now but my contact is a no-show. Go find it, and I'll show you how to find the old steel-dog.
The Aseptic. Nasty business. According to the NATA-Log he seems to favor the Proxima line. 42% of Aseptic murders happen on that rail-line alone. Although, correlation is not causation right?
You know, I might have to. not because you look trustworthy, but because Thaddeus thinks you are. That's enough for me. I swear on the NATA-log though, if you double cross me...

Huckstash, Huckstash. Haven't heard that name in many cycles. Used to roll with a rail gang. Ran it in some capacity I think. Can't have been the Invisigoths after what happened... Must be with the Crusty Punks. Yeah that sounds right. You like him for the Aseptic?
'Bribe' is such a clunky word. Look you need something, I need something. The thing I need will lead you to the thing you need.

dialogues.title: First chat with Dal
lines: Right. Well, officially no. I have no license. But that keeps the price down, right?
Ok, you can stop winking at me and get back to work.
Alright, less talk, more work. I get it.
I know right. I dated one a long time ago. Weird guy. Smelled like bleach.
Sure thing boss. I'll get back to scrubbin'!
Ah, you know. Pick up trash, clean floors, empty rotten food outta storage, keep the hygiene inspectors off your back.
Uh huh. So what exactly do you do?
Thanks again for the hire, boss.

dialogues.title: Hire Lochlainn
lines: I think you have something. A little potential maybe. Missing a good manager?
You know I came and ate at your place.
Lochlainn McKenna. Pleasure to meet you. Trained at the culinary school on Luna. Specialize in organization and supply management.
Sounds like I could really use you. You're hired!

dialogues.title: Saban asks for the weather
lines: It's the little acts of rebellion that get you through the day.
How do you get anything done?
Why don't you just check your Automata?
It's kinda peaceful to unplug for a while. You know? And it's not illegal. Just... very impractical.
Yeah, so you gotta strike up a conversation with a friendly stranger.
Hey there, do you know the PH of the rain today? I missed the update on the Nets this morning. I'm so forgetful - like an android with a faulty memory chip.
I mean I have one. I just go out without it sometimes.
You need to lighten up. What's the worst that can happen?
Well if the weather is clear, I better get home. I saw your food place. I should check it out.
Yeah, you don't know important stuff like the rain PH.
Acts of rebellion aren't a good idea in Nivalis.
I guess no one is melting in the rain right now, so I'm probably safe.
I can see the appeal of being off the grid.

dialogues.title: Ptolemy 3
lines: Want? Oh, sweet thing, it’s not about what I want—it’s about what you need. And what you need… is a good, old-fashioned, analogue experience.
It's all in the Ana-Blog. Give it a look
Behold! The latest edition of my Ana-Blog! Hot off the...well, technically lukewarm off my fingertips. Handwritten, untraceable, and absolutely dripping with substance.
Look, I know you mean 'cult' in a bad way, but what if you also look at it in a good way?
The only thing I'm scared of is your use of language.
I'm not sure how to do that.
Here, take a look. I think you might find something you're looking for.
I'm not an idiot, I know that nobody reads this stuff yet, but you were there from day one. You're as invested in this as I am.
But no, here you stand, real, physical, and, dare I say, aching for a little organic stimulation.
You have a real way with words.
So you're still working on the Ana-blog?
I like how they feel in my mouth.
I mean something like that I guess.
Ah-ha! I knew it. A deep, primal fear, etched into your very soul. You stare at these little ink-stained curves and lines, and somewhere inside, a tiny voice whispers… What if they change me?
Ohhh, I see how it is. You're afraid. Afraid of feeling something real. Afraid that these little squiggles of ink might touch you in a way your sterile little data feeds never could.
Look, I know I come on a little strong sometimes. it's just passion. I know this Tech-Skep stuff is a little mad. It's not just about the message it's about the community.

Oh, don’t be coy. You know exactly what I mean. Sweat, effort, the unmistakable musk of a mind working without a neural uplink. It’s raw. It’s real. And it’s just waiting to be touched. Go on, touch it.
Ah-ha! There you are, my little screen-addicted cherub. I was starting to think you’d succumbed the digital void.

dialogues.title: Ava tells you that you need more storage
lines: That is NOT an option. We need to add more cabinets or shelves for our ingredients.
Hey, storage is almost full. Banor says we're gonna have to start stacking boxes in his old HOVA soon.

dialogues.title: Ava Lockdown 1
lines: There has been an incident at the Noodle Bar. A CorpSec officer is waiting for you there to question you.
Your venue is under lockdown until CorpSec reviews the matter. You should head there quickly to reopen as soon as possible.

dialogues.title: Rollo and S Visit
lines: How did you come to be working for Calhoun?
How many people are you intimidating right now?
It's true that I suffer from brow-strain. The doctor said I should relax my face more.
I am not paid to discuss eggs.
There is no contest between egg forms.
Seems like you're underpaid to me.
I must tell Rollo about this!
Have you considered other career options?
You are in a desert walking along in the sand when all of sudden you look down ...
Which do you prefer, poached eggs or scrambled?
It can’t be easy, pounding the streets, threatening people, looking menacing all day.
As are you. With your debt.
As far as I know, he only cares for two things: money and fishing.
There must be some way to win him over.
Some days I can't even find the energy to crush a soda can in a menacing fashion.
We used to work at CorpSec HQ. Until we were fired when the 9 series was introduced. Mr Calhoun gave us a break and-- damn! Stop this distraction technique.
I am not paid to discuss tortoises.
We are brothers. Standard Security 8-Series models. Stop attempting to distract me.
He needs dermis treatment on his knuckles from all the beatings but Mr Calhoun won’t let him wear the moisturizing gloves on duty.
Security? You mean like, doormen? Bouncers? Chuckers-Out? Stand in one place and look menacing, rather than tramping all over the city?
He's never getting that money back.
Calhoun doesn’t sound like a very good employer.
Mr Calhoun sends his Regards. With a capital R. Not warm regards. Just “Regards”. You know what that means?
You mean like the bailiff business? There aren’t many openings. The battering ram bots keep close ranks.
It means he is planning which of your limbs to remove first.
He gave us a chance when no one else would.
Your attempt to alter the topic is painfully obvious.

dialogues.title: Take Ma Gomba's Mushroom Order
lines: Working for me should be payment enough. Perhaps I'll give you something more. It will depend on the quality of your fungi.
A job’s a job. I’ll do it.

Indeed. I’m holding a soiree for some associates. We have a little wager going. I wish to show them the difference in quality between my mushrooms and those grown by… let’s say an enthusiastic amateur.
In order to bloom, symbiosis is necessary, if distasteful. And “Clem” has the best substrate in the city.
Excellent. I want some Kings. 5 units should do it. That's simple enough even for you, button.
Let me guess, you have a mushroom order?
Forget it. I'm not going to grow things just so you can trash them.
I suppose I do. Such a tiresome individual. All mud and ethics. No... adaptability.
You want me to grow mushrooms just so you can judge them?
Take the job, or leave it. It means little to me.
Well, this is a surprise. I was expecting that bad tempered trug-lugger.
That's no way to do business.
You are a quick one, aren't you?
Ah, my little Agaricus. How nice. I was expecting the bad tempered trug-lugger.
If you don’t like Clem, why do business?

dialogues.title: Zaffer Stops By
lines: Some things are worth waiting for.
Since when did you care about that?
They got to ya, did they? That's the saddest fucking thing I've ever heard. You and me could've been magic.
Well, look what the cat dragged in. Thought you'd keep me waiting all night.
Since I have a business to run.
I've got to think about my reputation.
Yeah, that's what I love about you.
You don't need to ask, mate. I'm already out.
Reckon you're right. So, you don't care if anyone sees you... associating... with a known artpunk?
Here to see you, mate. Why, worried someone will see you... associating... with a wanted artpunk?

dialogues.title: Saban at the Oil Rig
lines: Saban are you going to do something you'll regret?
I ain't hiding anything. Not from you anyway. I got plans to end it all. I've had enough. I've made my peace. See no reason to stick around...
Fall off the edge of the sea. Maybe you fall to a better place, and the only thing keeping us here is a belief there's nowhere less awful.
It's play the game, or cash out.
You can talk to me Saban.
Saban are you able to keep yourself safe?
Well, I've made a decision recently, and since then, I find nothing really gets me down anymore.
Believe it or not, you're the first person to say that to me. Most people think I'm pretty happy.
I won't be around to regret it.
Set a timer. Go ahead. Maybe... 15 minutes. Set a timer, and when it goes off, see if you're still thinking about me.
It will be more of ... well, I've asked the LifeCorp personal android replacement service to make some improvements on my existing personality.
But none of it makes me feel anything. They sold me on a life, and when I got it, I didn't want it. I want a refund, but you don't get those on your life.
Are you even listening to me?
What will you tell your wife?
Oh yeah, don't worry. I got it all figured out. I've almost saved enough money for an android replacement. That's why I'm in such a good mood now!
Anyway, I'll see ya around. You take care of yourself.
You really need to cheer up a bit.
Safe? What kind of "safe"? Safe in body, or soul?
Sure. Most people in Nivalis are in some kind of pain. Just look at you. Are you okay friend? Honestly. Can you say that you are happy? Can you say that you are free of pain?
There's lots of things to see in this city. Lots to do. People who care about you.
You're replacing yourself with an android?!

I feel like the sea goes on forever. But maybe it doesn't, you know? I've heard people say there's an edge. Been reading some pretty wild theories recently. What if you get to the end and you just... fall off?
That's life. Nothing you can do about it?
Yeah, pretty clear. She thinks it's an upgrade too, I guess. She's not wrong. When I realized she agreed with my plan to be replaced... well it made everything real easy.
These views are something else, huh?
If I'm honest, I feel pretty numb too.
Sure, sure. Don't you worry about it. After all, what is it to you? You're just another person who will forget about me in five minutes.
Yes. I feel nothing at all.
Is it? I don't know. I feel like I'm just trying to distract myself. Waste my own time. And now I'm wasting yours.
You have plenty to live for.
Ah, she knows. She found the receipt from LifeCorp's dispatch message?
You've seen the view from the docks in the morning when the steam from the Vents catches in the low pressure zone? Stunning. I love that view. I might go check it out.
I know she saw it - I can see it's marked as read. But she didn't say nothing.
You don't have to go through with this.
You need to cheer up buddy.
It's not very convincing, but it's good enough. My wife isn't overly fond of me, and my kids are too young to notice the difference.
Oh, I don't know... I have all the things you're SUPPOSED to want. A decent job, a home, money for decent food, a wife and family.

Sure. I've been pretty checked-out for a while now. You know, struggle to get out of bed... can't concentrate. This new Saban - technically - doesn't' even need to sleep! Though it will, just so no one feels too weird about it.
I feel happiness AND pain. That's life.
I sense you have a plan?
Okay? I feel better than okay friend.

dialogues.title: Change of Heart
lines: What will happen to you, if I don't?
I'm sorry. I really can't help.
Here to taunt me with it? Wave it around with those fleshy human arms of yours like some kinda sadistic squid?
And there won't be shit I can do about it cos my jaw will have seized shut.
You ever watched a ship go to rust? First thing that goes is the hull. My guts'll rust through and my innards'll fall out.
Ya mind? You're blocking my view of a fascinating oil slick.
Wassa matter, too much for that land-belly of yours? Get outta here, will you?
What are ya, a TheraPay Bot? I know what I need. So stump it up, or don't bother coming back.
I don't think rust remover is the solution to your problems.
Ok, I get it. Here. take it.
Never thought a Lowtown lubber would be the one to get me free of this place. I’m grateful, kid. Good luck. Go... catch yourself a future.
Last thing to go will be the optics. First the lens, then the adhesion layer...
I might miss that mouth of yours.

dialogues.title: Ma Gomba 2nd Try
lines: Oh my dear, no. I want your customers to be the pigs.
Why wouldn't you be? They can stop a heart, enchant a mind, even bring down a city with the right encouragement. Plus, they're simply delicious on toast. Now, have you reconsidered my offer?
One biotrophic broth coming right up!
Why would I be afraid of mushrooms?
You want me to be a guinea pig for an experimental mushroom?
Very wise. You might as well be afraid of the air you breathe. Have you reconsidered my offer?
I will. And so will you, since the spores are already in your lungs. Have a nice day.
I'm surprised to see you getting so close. I had you down as a mycophobe.
I'm glad to hear it. Symbiosis is the key to success. I will send you a free sample. Use it in your kitchen. I will watch and take note of the results.
Just a little biotrophic enoki I've been working on. Scrumptious in ramen.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 5
lines: What you think, you become, unless of course, you're thinking about becoming rich, then you should reevaluate.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Second Meeting Delbert
lines: Your social conscience. Here to visit us Rigowners, share your steam-filled dreams?
Check out Botan Noss, Reena Coda, Sanya Predex and if nothing works, try Finlay Basin.
I wanted to know more about O.R.S.
It's a hard core. Like a dinosaur crushing oil into diamonds.
Maybe I want to get to know you better.
If you wanna know more, you have to become a member. So are you in, or are you all the way out?
Rig. You steel-shanked wave defier, carry us on your back to freedom with fire!
I only share my poetry with people I trust. You want me to trust you? Prove it.
Back to ease your soco, Cosmo?
Alright. But if you're serious, you gotta prove it.
The second rule of O.R.S: all members must contribute a line of verse to Pipeline, our weekly zine.
How many members are there at the moment?
Too bad, Cosmo. Coulda used someone like you.
All members must participate in activities to further the O.R.S. cause.
I’m not sure that’s how that works…
Well, open up your knowledge box, cos here it comes. The Corps might control the water, but we are oil, and O.R.S is the spark that will ignite the inferno of freedom.
I don't have time for this.
We're planning an intervention. CEOs want to blow this place, send us down to the bottom of the ocean. But we won't go without a fight.
There's a list of candidates. But be careful. Some might be corpsters. Underground agents.
Fulfil the three rules of O.R.S. First rule: every new member must recruit at least two further members.
No loss. Enjoy the view from the Spire, Cosmo.
Right. Well, I guess I'll go look for some new members.
On second thoughts, maybe this isn't for me.

dialogues.title: Ava Questioning Motives
lines: I don't want you to detect when I'm lying.
I'll let you know which issues I want to discuss.
I don't believe so. Hard as it may be to believe, Edison seems to be honorable. A rarity in Nivalis.
Alright... What do you know about that guy Edison?
The delivery from Mr. Mattix has arrived.
I detect a tone in your voice which indicates skepticism. Automata are designed to know when they are not hearing the truth. And my sources suggest it would benefit you to talk through this issue.
What do you know about him?
I understand. However, this is not a feature of my programming I can disregard. High stress can lead to health issues, and I detect Edison's words made you anxious.
I don't detect any obvious ulterior motives. He has a good reputation, and a lot of people who call him a reliable friend.
So his gift isn't a trap?
I understand. However, this is not a level of my cognition which I can disable. High stress can lead to health issues, and I detect Edison's words made you anxious.

dialogues.title: Meet Gladstone after the quest
lines: Not exactly a loudmouth. Not human. They've got time.
They don't do that. Unlike humans.
Not a lot of tourists around right now, in the LUZ.
You heard me, man. No killing rats anymore. Had my Damascus moment.
Oh, I do. Or I will. Just founded a start-up, showing tourists the underbelly of the city, the places where our little furry overlords dwell.
You did. But you gotta make a living, too!
I told you I converted, right? I can't kill rats anymore. Not gonna tell you who does. I've seen the light.
I had to learn they don't like that.
Not my companions. We don't compare.
Not me. You're too late. That ship has sailed. And the rats aren't leaving it.
They're gonna rule once their plot is complete. So I gotta show them respect!
But you bow to their king?
I thought maybe you would like to have a regular job with a fixed income.
I remember you calling them your furry little angels.
You will! I might even offer you a license to open up a noodle stand down there!
One electric cable at a time, I get it.
I need five portions of rat meat a day, delivered fresh and without intermediaries.
How are your little companions doing?
Out of respect, not fear. And in order to better understand him, to be honest.
Maybe you can't tell from the outside, but I'm not a nine-to-five kind of guy.
They're not like us. They are not going to eat us.
Too bad. I need a rat meat specialist!
Didn't I tell you I converted? Not killing rats anymore. I've seen the light.
That's temporary. As soon as the city opens up again, my business will explode!
Have you ever seen rats congregating, packing, and attacking as one?

dialogues.title: Ava has a plan
lines: Indeed. In this situation, I would suggest that "strike first" might be an appropriate response.
Judging by your past interactions, and a basic analysis of her personality type, there is a 42% likelihood of brutal vengeance.
Nah. Let her do her worst.
She mentioned that she had Cecil Grimes the hygiene inspector mugged to gain access to his remote chip. Perhaps he would be interested in that information.
Forget it. I'm not a snitch.
I can submit an anonymous tip-off via the Nets, if you wish?
Are you concerned by Dagmar's threats?

dialogues.title: We need 3 dishes on the menu
lines: How is a humble food critic meant to critique when he has nothing to go on? How am I to evaluate your skill when you only offer so little?
Hmph. I will return in a few mealtimes. I suggest you offer your customers more choice.
Far be it from me to discourage you. I shall return in a few mealtimes. Perhaps by then you will offer your customers more choice.
This is the way forward. I shall return in a few mealtimes to see how you are doing.
So... how do I do that?
We might only have one dish, but it's good.
An aroma of alteration. An odor of originality. Sadly, I haven't found it.
What? We have a lot of options on the menu.
He does have a point. If we want more customers, we will need to add more dishes to the menu. My research suggests diners expect a minimum of five.
Don't mind me, I'm just here sniffing around.
Click on the monitor at the venue. You can make changes to the menu there.

dialogues.title: Confront Aengus about the DNA
lines: I might reconsider my position given the right... compensation.
This is just about your ego.
He was just excited to meet you I think.
Firstly I do not lose things. Secondly, this DNA had been cast out to the winds already? Anyone with half a brain could do the same work I've done.
You mentioned that you store quite a lot of DNA information. That seems pretty unsafe, what if you lost it?
If the man failed to read the fine-print on his own leg deal that's not my problem.
I think you underplayed how final the deal really was.
I think he just needed the closure.
Humans are funny that way. What can I help you with?
Ahh I see you are back. I hope that Marius fellow took the news well.
You don't think I've tried! For some reason it always misses the mark. He must be approaching it from a completely new angle. I want that angle.
Can't you just make your own?
I have heard word that he's experimenting with a new kind of brisket glaze and people are going crazy for it... I want it.
Let me try and put this in human terms. Would you burn one of your own paintings? Would you crush a childhood swimming trophy? Why should I delete my achievements?
Because in the wrong hands, your 'trophies' pose an unprecedented security risk!
Well after our little conversation, I did a little digging around the feet... foot... of Marius Mitchell. Seems like he's been climbing the ranks rather quickly.
You'll destroy the records of thousands of DNA Profiles if I get you the recipe for a brisket glaze?

dialogues.title: Ashwin gets a sponsor
lines: Oh... Oh right. Well, that's pretty clear cut then. Guess I'll just be alone forever!
She says there's no chance you two will ever get together.
What things used to make you happy?
Wow. I mean... maybe I just need to prove myself to her, you know? She already thinks that I'm a nice guy!
Really? Well, I guess I could look at the old business plan documents again... Would you really be interested?
If it sounded promising I might even invest in your hygiene business.
Well I thought I had been in love before Safia, but I hadn't. She is different. The feeling is different.
I know that. I know that you're right! But right now I can't help it. I can't think about anything else. It's like all the things that used to make me happy seem pointless.
She thinks you are too young and naive.
Well... my concept for the Restaurant Hygiene Technology company. I had this idea that my new start-up company would finally solve the issue of hygiene in Nivalis.
If you have some proposals, let me know.
I'm in love boss. Haven't you ever been in love?
Maybe. But I mainly want you working again.
Right!? A problem as old as gastronomy itself! And I was going to solve it.
This is a terrible idea Ashwin. I think it's better we part ways.
I would like to hear more.
Well, it was. But right now it's Safia.
Sure. This could actually really help out the business.
Of what? You firing me? Damn... I actually didn't see that coming...
I get it, but she doesn't feel the same.
So no more distractions at work?
No Ashwin, you need to get over her.
She thinks you're a nice guy and she respects you, but doesn't want more than friendship.
I have, and I didn't let it get in the way of doing my job.

dialogues.title: Harper - Player Lost
lines: Well, thanks for the good sport. And since financially I'm back on track: Here's your money. With interest.
Well as I'm feeling awake now, fancy a rematch?
Whoa, I mean not to wallow in your bad fortune, but it feels good to be good at something again!
You were just lucky. I didn't sleep well last night.

dialogues.title: Eldridge Triumphant
lines: How horrible. But I am ETERNALLY in your debt. The word of Eldridge is always good and I promised a reward. There.
Drown my sorrows, I suppose. With a... damn it all, with a ham daiquiri! I will WALLOW in beautiful degradation! Eldridge is dead, long live Eldridge!
I don't know. The shame... how can I face my peers? My adoring public? My butler?
Too bad. Still, perhaps with some careful outfit planning and the right lighting, I can make a grand return after all.
Ha ha! Typical Minty! You know, perhaps with some careful outfit planning and the right lighting, I can make a grand return after all.
And I will drown my sorrows with, damn it all, with a ham daiquiri! I will WALLOW in beautiful degradation! Eldridge is dead, long live Eldridge!
Oh yes, I have a few. Can't quite remember how many. Anyway, it's the least I can do.
This is Tier 4 business permit from one of my old businesses, valid even for places in the Spire.
Minty had a fling with a FLAVR unit.
THAT is a first edition of POMP & FRIPPERY. Worth a lot of Lims to the right person. But of course, you wouldn't know that.
I gave Razlo something he wanted.
At least you didn't run for mayor like PorridgeDog.
I promised you a reward didn't I? Here: take this fashion zine. It has been my most treasured possession in this dismal place.
You GOT them? Praise gold and all that's branded. How?
Maybe it's time to go back?
Then perhaps I'll see you in the Spire. It's Bo Bo's birthday soon. Maybe we'll have a party...
Looks like it's your lucky day.
TELL me you're here to put an end to my suffering. I simply can't take another day of this place. The sea hurts my eyes. Even the sand mocks me.
How can you think of such a thing? Fine, take this. It's all I can offer.
Then it's all over for me. The end of Eldridge. I must live out my years as an eternal pariah, chained to that horrid Razlo.
Afraid so. Now about my reward...?
Really, it's the least I can do.
He DIDN'T! Poggy for Mayor? Ha ha! How sordid. I feel better already. Did anything else occur?

dialogues.title: Talk to Dr Matombo
lines: Why surprising? Do you think everyone's an asshole?
Keep going. I hate losing any patient, but a boy as young as this...
Spoken like a true Corpster. The only reason I do this job is because I care. If I didn't, I could be earning six figures in some Spire cosmetic clinic.
Aren't you meant to have some professional distance?
We look after each other down here. Despite what CorpSec orders.
Feels like the right thing to do.
Good, I don't have very long.
Between us we managed 943 Lims. I'm about to send it to your funding account.
Right. So take the money and bank it, yes?
Yes, RM and I had a bit of a whip-round while on our rounds.
No, I mean... I know your patients don't have much.

dialogues.title: Rust Remover for Crabface
lines: Yeah. Try putting bait on the right end of the rod.
I just came to say hi.
Soon as I can move I'm going out. On. It ain’t rust remover in that tin. It’s the far horizon. So you... gonna give it to me?
Oh, take up tap dancing. It’s always been a dream of mine, to pitter patter across a stage.
I'll tell ya: none of your goddam business. So you gonna give it to me?
‘Cos they’re a bunch of lazy bums, that’s why. So you gonna give it to me?
I’m not. But I have a question first.
Why didn't your friends get this for you?
You’re a bit too rusty to pull my leg. Or even yours.
Well, look what the catfish dragged in. Lemme guess, no rust remover yet.
We got a smart one. You really wanna know?
Never trust a lubber. You're all the same. Get outta my goddam sight.
So what you doing here? Run out of rust flakes at that bar of yours?
Out. On. It ain’t rust remover in that tin. It’s the far horizon. So you... gonna give it to me?
Do you have any fishing tips?
What will you do, once you can move from this dock?
They think I’ll... go away. Once I can move.
Never thought a Lowtown lubber would be the one to get me free of this place. I’m grateful, kid. Good luck. Go... catch yourself a future.
Sorry, I don't think I can.

dialogues.title: Buy the Mask from Idlehands
lines: Right... Will you give them the mask?
Now... A rising tide raises all ships and all that. I'm off to reinvest my profits at the bar. And the economy chugs on! Cheers my friend. See ya around.
Yeah. I guess we both are. Me more than you. But thanks anyway.
Gives you hope. Gives me hope. I think we did good here. Everything worked out!
If ya hadn't hit the target, I still would have given the boy the mask, and taken whatever you had. But what can I say? You're a top-rate fundraiser!
Right... Will you give me the mask now?
Nah. This is a triumph for hope, spirit, charity... and all that STUFF. But also business! People gave a damn, and I cleared my stock. Everyone wins.
I'm sorry about your girl. Tehani!
I heard about your campaign. Great stuff! Had my fingers crossed the WHOLE time.
You played us all, you asshole!
I held on to it. That's good business ya see. You could learn a thing or two from me. For example, you're learning a pretty big lesson right now.
We sent you the funds. You have them, right?
Sure. Ya see back when I got Raluca's mask two years ago, I actually got a spare mask. Had it the whole time.
The boy already got it! My runner dropped it off at their house. It's a Nivalis miracle! If you see the kid, tell him I said "Hi".

dialogues.title: Marcelle's Back for More
lines: So do I, but that requires Lims.
What would it cost for a good word in one of your reviews?
And if you gave me a good review...

True. But what you do is more important than money. You are one of this city’s beating hearts. You have a responsibility to keep the blood flowing as best you can, even when people try to bleed you dry.
I thought I tasted a background tang of greed. Be careful how much you use. It sticks in the throat.
If you want to attract customers, you must be bold, daring, but most of all kind. That’s why people came here when Thaddeus was in charge. They felt at home.
I’m glad you like it. Especially since you're a critic.
How do I make people feel at home?
I don’t think you understand. You are one of this city’s beating hearts. You have a responsibility to keep the blood flowing as best you can, even when people try to bleed you dry.
Make sure you have a broth on the menu. We all need comfort from time to time.
Food is about giving, not accumulating. All I want is for people to eat and be happy.
Guilty as charged. But please, don’t treat me any differently. I am here to eat, like everyone.
But you could help my business.
I must congratulate you on sourcing this rat meat. Fresh, toothsome, juicy as the latest Nets gossip and twice as spicy.

dialogues.title: Mia leaves a voice note
lines: Mia snuck out early after indicating she had things she needed to do. She left you a note if you'd like it.

Hey there. Good morning. I wish you could see the smile on my face right now. You look pretty cute right now too. Restful. I need to do a few things and then figure out what I'm gonna do with the k20s. Such a good problem to have, and one I wouldn't be navigating if it weren't for you. Thank you. Talk soon!
Lovely woman. Do you need anything else at the moment?

dialogues.title: Lynnphora says goodbye
lines: Oh, hi! So what did you decide to do?
I threw the ashes into the wind up in Skyhigh Gardens.
I threw the ashes into the endless waves of the sea.
I'm just not good with making decisions. They're all wrong. So thank you for your help!
In a way, yes. We're both at peace now. Thank you, with all my heart.
Thank you. He would have loved this. But I simply couldn't do it.
(lie) I let him run free in the winds by the seaside. He'll hunt seagulls.
He's resting now and so should you, in a different way.
Oh that sounds just wonderful. You have been a real friend.

dialogues.title: CorpSec Warning 1
lines: It is not creepy. It is factually accurate. You were seen on the streets. We have the evidence.
I know what you did last night.
Consider this an official warning. Next time, the consequences will be severe.
I was at home. In bed!
You were seen on the streets. We have evidence.
What are you going to do about it?

dialogues.title: No Tumbler Yet
lines: Who really knows? Fact remain that the k20s are my goal. I'm gonna start scoping out other parts of Nivalis. Make sure to find me if you stumble on a tumble...er. That was lame.
I know! It's the lifestyle of a die-hard, you know? Our fascinations always come first.
Actually wanted to ask you something.
The hearts of my exes... Ha. Just kidding. Nope, just the tumblers for me. People say I'm wasting my time looking.
That's too funny. I'm gonna start scoping out other parts of Nivalis. Make sure to find me if you stumble on a tumble...er. That was lame.
Oh... Well.. There really isn't anyone around to care. You know, in that way.
Well... Then get to it! What are you waiting for? Other people are looking as we speak.
Whooo-eee. I have no idea. I don't think anyone's ever actually asked. They mostly just say I shouldn't be wasting my time looking for 'em.
Does your partner care that you're constantly out looking for these?
Hey! You're back already. How many did you find?
Maybe you just haven't found the right companion.
Ok... I mean we should be looking for k20s but I guess we can take a break. What's on your mind?

Because it's fun? Something to do while I wait for this twinkling city to sink into the sea. Hey! When that finally happens I could probably build a raft outta all my tumblers. Captain of the HMS K20!
What made you start looking for these?

dialogues.title: Ava explains the Curfew
lines: Hey, it's almost time for curfew.
The Aseptic is known for striking at night. Fewer people in the streets, fewer bodies.
So the killer only murders people on the street?
Either way, it gives you a chance to work out today's finances and how much of your debt you would like to pay off.
The debt from Thaddeus's Noodle Bar. When you took on the restaurant the debt came with it. Free of charge!
Why would I pay off more?
Thanks to the serial killer, there's currently a nighttime curfew in the LUZ.
Well, if there was a killer on the loose targeting people with large debt responsibilities, I'd want that debt gone as quickly as possible.
Hey, tomorrow is a new day with new opportunities and at this rate you'll have that debt paid off in... well, at some point!
Some of CorpSec's punishments can be quite imaginative.
Oh gosh no, 87% of the killings have happened indoors. Probably because that's where most people are.
The good news is, you can choose to spend a larger percentage of today's profits paying off the interest. 5% 10% or even 15%!
What happens if I break curfew?

dialogues.title: Talk to Agent Teleshko 2
lines: My P.I.S.S. My Personal Interface for Social Standards. It informs me that I should donate 50 Lims to this campaign of yours to maintain my credit score.
I have neither time nor patience for sarcasm. Like I said, I consulted my P.I.S.S...
I'll take whatever you and your P.I.S.S. can give.
Hmph. Well, this concludes our interaction.
Do you have a medical problem?
Good you're here. I have consulted my P.I.S.S. and have come to a conclusion.

dialogues.title: Alexandria An Offering
lines: I've did my job by giving it to you. Scram!
Edison said to talk to you.

dialogues.title: Met Finn
lines: Listen, The Club Rat Kids were a family. Scrawny, misfits amped up on so many uppers they hummed like a synthesizer. What went down kinda broke 'em. I don't think they've really talked since.
The Club Rat Kids. They were the best viral marketers in the biz. They knew everyone. Didn't matter what club you were at, somehow one of em was always there.
If there's two A sides? Sure!
Tell Kenzy if she gets her rep back I'll wander over and we can pitch an event tent. See if we can scurry our way back up to the top.
You don't say... Kenzy's gonna try and get the Club Rat Kids crawling up the Spire again. Ridin' the thermals all the way to fresh air and clear skies.
Glow sticks Kenzy? Kenzy Voan? You know her?
Really now? I'm hoping it's for something good. Nah, I know it is. You got that vibe about you. Feel it pulsing like a mel-o-dyyyyy.
Nothing big, I guess. Do you know a Kenzy?
In a different time, singing a different tune. Yeah, we all played together. Danced on glass floors while data streamed below through tubes of neon light.
How do you measure reputation in the first place?
How do you change your reputation?
She said it was a reputation thing.
Kenzy Voan wants to collab on something.
Ohhhh, she wants to collab with me! I thought you meant someone else and you were here to try and recruit me to help you stop her.
That's her. She wants a collab.
I'll see what I can do.
What the fuck are you talking about?
Whatever sounds I can weave into the airwaves.
Yeah, the reputation of the Club Rat Kids. They were the team to beat a few months ago. Promos at every club. Events every single night. Kenz was even in talks for a sponsorship deal with Liq-Hr.
You were a Club Rat Kid?
Finn Amano mannnn. The late. The Great. The Spinner himself.
My friend. What can I do for you?
Ehhhhhhh. It's not my song to sing. If you help her get back into the scene, pull the Club Rats out from under the house, maybe she'll tell yah.
Still vibin? What's got yah going round the tables?
So what's she trying to do?

See the club scene in the upper levels operates on reputation. The more you have the more you know. The more you know the more you promote. You hit a level and people want you in their clubs just to say it happened.
Welllllll, that's the thing. It's like... It's like a fly on the wall of your skull, something pulsing to the beat of your soul. Yeah, that's good. That's the one.
Depends on what side of the record is spinnin'. You playin' the B-sides too?

dialogues.title: Elaine Malloy First Meeting
lines: Well if you start to feel dizzy, don't faint towards me.
You're right, this is a lot to take in.
I wouldn't pay to be photographed.
Well let me give you a second for it to sink in, for some, the prospect of me taking their photo can be a shock to the system.
Credit? I'm not sure what that means exactly. I can look into the idea of some kind of payment. What currency do you people like down here? Lims is it? We could make something work.
I bet it takes great photos.
Oh this old chestnut. When will people learn that photography is about the moment. Not about the angle.
What makes your photographs so much better than everyone else's?
Sadly not. Could have been anyone, the photography business is cutthroat. Toughest business out there.
How about my one to one training under the tutorship of G.G. O'Brien, the greatest photographer to ever have lived. Before me of course.
Oh you really are too much! Your arrogance is actually fascinating to me. No really, I'm actually more interested in you now if anything.
Maybe I don't want you to take my photo.
Well in this instance, that would be very foolish of you.
Tell you what. I have a spare ASScap you can borrow.
Rain and Strauss just commissioned me to put together my next book. Staying Local - A Visual History of the Unity Zone.
Did they ever find the culprit?
Tragic HOVA accident. Apparently somebody cut off the feed to the air brake and well... let's just say it's hard to take photographs without a working pelvis. A real tragedy.
Why would you give one to me?

This part of town truly is fascinating, almost completely culturally cut off from society. Well, just to make you, aware, most people would beg me to take their portrait, even pay vast amounts to have me photograph them.
Wow you have a really unique look! It's a sort of, hmmm, homeless-chic with an air of misplaced hope. Ever been in a train gang?
Possible. But not important. But his look was... unique.
Great. This could be great for me... and us. I can look into the idea of some kind of payment. What currency do you people like down here? Lims is it? We could make something work.
Ambient Spacial Snapshot ... capture. A new way to take pictures. Take a snapshot of an entire environment and choose your angle later. Ultimate control.
History is history and we're gonna make it. Together. You take that camera, get me some snaps in each of the districts, and maybe just maybe, you'll get featured.
And you take all the credit?
What a ridiculous question. How about more cover-photos for Vanguard magazine than any other living photographer?
History of the Unity Zone? It's only a few days old.
I once photographed a hobo leader called Hipflask or Hackdash or something. Deep, sunken eyes that told stories. Made a lot of Lims off that portrait!
People take great photos, well some people. No the ASSCap is just a tool like any other.
Sorry are your optics working? You can see me right? You know who I am.
Sorry what is going on here?

dialogues.title: Give Elaine a hint
lines: She understands. It's not for her.
Some of your staff want to take Roberta's place.
I don't want you disturbing my staff.
What? She has star potential. She is wasting her life here.
I feel like you're not accustomed to hearing "no."
Hi! Are you ready to give me some good news?
You're causing unrest among my staff.
Hmmm... I will check them out. Thank you. And please tell Roberta that the door is always open for her.
She needs to understand this! And so do you!
I am not happy. But I respect your clarity on this.
I only want Roberta. And... I suppose I can't have her. My search for the new face of my campaign must begin again from scratch.
Please don't disturb ANY of my staff.
I'm not. You're right. Very astute.
Alexander and Alexandria. Bouncers. They are twins. Lots of star quality.
Would you like to hear a suggestion?
I need to talk with her. Set up a meeting. Just the two of us.
She doesn't want to talk to you.
Could you take one of them?

dialogues.title: Luminita 3
lines: Oh yeah. Just got a fresh batch of ‘Genuine Smokehouse BBQ’ in. Perfect for making protein bricks taste like someone actually cared.
Mm. Side effects include mild euphoria, an irrational sense of nostalgia, and—if you use too much—brief but intense longing for a father figure.
Preferably not a full-blown existential crisis.
Hey, he said it was the best meal he ever had. Besides, isn’t that what food is supposed to do? Make you FEEL something?
You're not even on my shortlist of possible customers.
I think I'll stick to the old fashioned seasonings.
Yeah, weird one. Had a guy start sobbing into his food tray. Kept saying he could hear his dad flipping burgers in the backyard.
So much for putting it on my menu.
I need to have a chat with my chef.
Then maybe stick to the mild stuff. I’ve got a vanilla extract that just makes you 10% more optimistic. No baggage, guaranteed

dialogues.title: Only Eyes First Transmission
lines: Nivalis Bay, south by south west 3, 16 miles, 1120, rising slowly. Good.
I'm not sure. It sounds like some kind of antique shipping report. But as far as I know they haven't been broadcast for centuries...
East NeoFog, south by south east 5, 20 miles, 1450, rising more slowly. Fine.
No, the signal is too weak. But I can try to find a rough location. Perhaps if we are closer I can transmit to the same frequency. I'll update your HUD.

dialogues.title: Ava sends player to Dr Matombo
Location 3 Helix Monumental
lines: I will remind you if you do.

Alright, look, I got an idea. I don't have the prize with me right now, but if you come back and find me in a few days, we can grab a drink, reminisce about the old days, and I'll hook you up with your prize, OK?
Is this really the end of the tour?
Come on! Is that correction really necessary?
...That was only a few days ago.
Just one more time my friend. Once more we will hammer our point home, and put up a sign for all who follow us. This is the final!

SOON MY SPEECHES WILL FALL SILENT, BUT YOUR VOICES WILL FILL THE VOID. MY TOUR, THOUGH INSPIRING, EXCITING AND OUTRAGEOUSLY ENTERTAINING, CANNOT GO ON FOR EVER. MY SINGLE VOICE WILL BE REPLACED WITH A CHORUS.

It's like we were kids playing in the twilight, and now a new day dawns on this city, and we wake with the bright morning light of change. Hey, do you want to take some uppers now or later? I already took all mine.
COMPANIONS! AS OUR STRUGGLE NEARS ITS END, REMEMBER, THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE THE DAWN.
Are we doing the shouting thing again?
THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR SUPPORT THROUGH THIS WHOLE TOUR. I DON'T KNOW WHAT'S IN STORE FOR ME NEXT... BUT I DO KNOW YOUR FATE. THE FATE OF ALL NIVALI. FREEDOM. EMANCIPATION. HOPE!
I can barely remember those early days back at Hive Mall and Meridian Market. Everything seemed so small back then. So... impossible. But just look at us now.
Awww, friendo! I can't stand to see a bud free wheel on the stone cold. We gotta hook you up with some mind juice soon!
I guess so bucko. It's been a long road, but you know what? We walked it! Every step of the way, you were by my side. I won't forget that.
WE SHOULD ALL BE PAID MORE!

Alright, it's the dawning of the night, and we need to raise a new type of light. A neon sign driven into the heart of Nivalis like a stake, that beats with the heart of the people. And it glows in the darkness baby! It glows...
You gotta lighten up friendo. I'm not saying you're square, but if we checked your corners, we'd find four right angles.
PEOPLE OF HELIX MONUMENTAL, IT'S TIME TO FINALLY ACKNOWLEDGE THE TRUTH WE ALL KNOW IN OUR HEARTS. THIS CORPORATE DICTATORSHIP MUST END!
Hey, you might just win the prize after all! Three appearances in a row.
There's still no people here Olive.
ACTUALLY THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE TOTAL DARKNESS!
We've really started something, you know. The fire is kindled. We just have to stoke the flames.
Me and you. We're the ones that count. You've been here since the start. I won't forget that. Not ever! Thank you.
Great. Until then... I gotta catch some Z's. I haven't slept in a week.

dialogues.title: Talk to RM Alken
lines: Now you sound like a Corpster. You gonna take this cash or not?
Yep. Had a little whip-round while on my rounds. Get it?
Not everyone down here is as heartless as you seem to think.
Aren't you supposed to have a bit of professional distance?
Please keep going. I hate losing any patient, but this one...
Doing good feels kinda good, right?
You get it. Kids have it hard enough these days.
My patients can't give much. But I'm gonna send 943 Lims to your funding account.

dialogues.title: Band Member 3 - The Guitarist
lines: CORA, no. Worse than that. Much worse.
We're putting the band back together.
The worst thing you can imagine.
Did he sleep with your partner?
Well, out with it. We're a couple of business owners with work to do. Can't be yapping all day long!
You were right to leave. This is unforgivable.
Did he take too many drugs?
No. You don't get it. He wanted to make us into an... indie rock band.
...Fine! I do miss the rest of the band. But he better keep us on track from now on. ANYTHING but indie rock.
Did he take too FEW drugs.
I'm sure he's over that phase.
He tried to change our bands genre.
Fauxter really screwed me over. I mean it. That guy is bad news.
No. No way. Nuh-uh. Not a chance.
I thought you changed genre all the time?
I mean if he PROMISES to make sure we won't play anymore songs that go "Oh OH oh OH OH," I might consider it.
Hey bud. You look like you're on a mission. Can I help ya with anything?
Go on. Imagine it. Whatever you can think of, this is worse. Why don't you try and guess what he did?
Fauxter needs you to come back and play guitar in his band.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 3
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
Just keep telling yourself everything will be fine, even if it won't.

dialogues.title: Ma Gomba wants Poison
lines: Wonderful. Here are the spores. When it's grown, come and see me for payment. That's all.
Then consider our acquaintance terminated. I have no time for parasites.
It's quite simple. I need you to grow a mushroom for me. A special kind. Not for eating. I'll pay you 300 Lims.
Whatever it is, I'm going to pass.
Haven't I always had your best interests at heart?
If I hadn't, you would know about it.
To impress me. I have a favor to ask. A little quid pro quo.
Say no more. I'll grow it.
Why would I be interested in helping you even more?
I have a favor to ask. A little quid pro quo.
There you are. I was hoping you'd stop by.

dialogues.title: Secret Location Olive is lost
lines: Hey! It's you. Thank CORA, someone I recognize. Hey I have a question... where the fuck am I?

Look, I'll level with you, right now I don't know if we're friends, enemies, or if it's you... mom? I don't even know if you're real. But whoever you are, I'm gonna get my head clear and I'll see you on the next leg of the speaking tour.
Alright. Well depending on your potential corporeality, I'll see you back in the city - or on my next trip!

That's real kind of you, potentially-real-person, but I'll be just fine when I get back to the stone cold. I'm drying out fine, but sometimes the wets get deep into your cerebellum and it takes a while, you know?
No one comes to see you talk anyway.
Are you sure you don't need any help finding your way back?
Shrooms man! I know exactly how you feel.
Hey hey hey! Come on now. You know how it works. The words find their way into the... fertile soil. They pollinate!
This is what I get for eating all those expired mushrooms.
I'm having a trip so bad I think I'm in the sewers, so yeah, mushrooms can expire.
Who would come to see me speak in the sewers! No one, that's who.
Really? Listen, I'm hallucinating a lot right now. I might be imagining things, but it sounded like you said I was in the sewers.
I have no idea what you're talking about.
Could this be part of your speaking tour?

dialogues.title: Talk to Ava about the Cradle
lines: Bad enough to have it removed from Nivalis' history entirely.
Unknown. All associated records have been expunged.
Searching… No active records found under that name. However, I have located fragmented data from seventy-one years ago. A project labeled “Cradle.”
Deeper retrieval initiated… I have something. Partial data fragments, buried in an obsolete server cluster.
Clones. The data is heavily corrupted, but I’ve reconstructed enough to determine that high-ranking members of Curzona were conducting experimental cloning.
The Cradle some kind of facility—specifically, a nursery.
I can attempt deeper retrieval, but if this was a targeted wipe, results are unlikely.
Would you like me to search the Cradle on the networks?
But considering the extent of this cover-up… perhaps you should ask a different question.
Unclear. The project was abruptly terminated decades ago. All records purged. The facility itself appears to be... no longer present in the city.
Who? Where? About what? And why?
That is an excellent question. Shall we find out?
More thorough than deletion. The data wasn’t just removed—it was deliberately erased from multiple archives. Someone wanted it gone.
What did they nurse there that they wanted to erase?
Curzona executives. It appears they were creating… successors. Copies of themselves, grown from infancy, presumably to be trained into leadership roles.
Understood. However, please be advised—searching for erased data often attracts attention.
No blueprints, no decommission reports, no structural remnants. It was there… and then it wasn’t.
It must have been a horrific place.

dialogues.title: Luminita Sells TT
lines: Right, listen. If I could help you, and I'm not saying I can, it would be a big ask... hypothetically.
No need for any of that. Can I help you?
I didn't move closer to you. I'm just looking for a specific taste-related contraband.
Look the only taste-related contraband here is your breath... just step back a little.
Yeah well speaking of passing, that's how I'd describe the poor bastards tongue as it exited out the back of his skull.
He said you could maybe acquire something a little 'off-the-books'?
Me too... so yeah, if you need some of this stuff, you'd better really need it and you'd better not use too much.
I don't owe you toffee so if you really do need a hook up, I'd hit the breaks, stand back a bit and listen to what I have to say.
I account for the fact I can taste your breath pal. Just take a little shuffle back there.
You heard about the trout thing down at the docks?
Did he now? Has a way with words that guy. Think it's the mustache.
Kind of wish I'd seen that.
How'd it get out the lab?
The new compound on the street is called 'Tongue Twister' potent underground shit. The kind of thing that only gets out the lab if it escapes.
Oh yeah. Just stay there. Can I help you?
This is for Sal right? He has potential as a regular. I'll give you the first Crunch free but worth remembering, they never found that guy's tongue.
Again, getting a little close to me there... yeah it's Curzona fairy dust for sure.
Ok firstly, stop moving closer to me. It's creepy. Secondly, I have no idea what you or Mustache Molly over there are talking about. I'm an accountant.
I really don't have time for this.
Again, my apologies. I'm looking for a specific taste related contraband.
Ok back up a bit, little bit close there buddy.
Same way your breath did I assume. Just back off a bit. You heard about the trout thing down at the docks?
Yeah gnarly. Kind of wish I'd been there... so yeah, if you need some of this stuff, you'd better really need it and you'd better not use too much.
So I'm gonna need to know that, hypothetically, you're able to handle what I give you.
Can you help me or not?

dialogues.title: Have You Ever Heard of Efficiency
lines: How'd you know I was a debt orphan?
Exciting times! Now go take on more work so we can help you manage it. Remember, you're only as good as your best month of sales.

Administrative Specialist Interface. This little pumped up program handles all the background items that you and your automata are trying to juggle. Average return on investment for these bad boys is almost 36%.
Sounds a little too Corpo for my blood.
Bingo. Let me introduce you to the one and only Digital Declutterers.
That's right! We get the mess out of your interfaces so you can show your actual face to your customers. For a business like yours, I'd recommend our Level 3 ASI.
Hey there, you work at that noodle shop down the way, yeah?
Of course! That's what I do. Now let me ask you why I ate at your stand the other day and still haven't gotten a follow-up survey or feedback questionnaire with a discount code for my next order.
Are you interested to check out the greenhouses? Grow some new ingredients?
Relax, relax. I'm just fracking with you. But you gotta reel me in with a follow-up loop that sets you apart from the shop 'round the corner.
I knew it! We've met briefly before, nice to get your attention for a minute.
Suit yourself. Could be downloading those Lims like crazy though. You know where to find me when you have an actual intelligent thought.
Well, if you want to rent the space just head on down to the Docks and check out what they have available. Gotta secure the house before you can fill it with little ones you know?
You're all set on getting out of debt and increasing your net worth? Really? Digital Declutterers can do so much for you.
Everything's a gimmick... Gim-making-those-Lims! Or you will anyway. If you implement a killer follow-up loop that sets you apart from oh, say, the shop, 'round the corner.
Is it really 'a little too Corpo' to pull yourself outta debt so you don't have to keep looking over your shoulder for the thugs who will drag you to the Orphanage?
Yeah, well, alright, what do I need to do?
Just let me get a quick retinal scan... Perfect. You are going to love this. I'll start getting the program tailored to your shop and send you an activation code when it's all set.
Let me guess: you sell them?

Because I was in the same place a few years ago. Sad, tired, grubby...That's why I formed Digital Declutterers. Now I'm trying to break those barriers for those who are next in line. Hint, hint — that'd be you.
Well, when you serve mediocre food you got to have a gimmick, right?
Yup! You can have dirt and seeds and dreams but unless you grow actual ingredients, you'll be serving the same bland stuff over and over.

dialogues.title: Hynthia wants to level up
lines: Double the processing power, double the profit. Plus I love working side by side with a fellow chef... So they can see just how much better I am.
You had better get on with it then.
Hey, so you know how I only started working here because I was desperate and no one else would hire me after the "poisoning" thing?
I know, it's hard to imagine how my speed and the quality of my dishes could be improved. But they CAN. They really can.
Right. About that. Why haven't you invested in multiple appliances?
Great! Now that I've been here a while, I think this place might maybe, possibly, just conceivably have a glimmer of potential.
All because of me course. Steel sharpens steel and all that. And I'll be even better once I level up my skills.
That's right. Look at you learning.

dialogues.title: Ashwin is giddy
lines: Ashwin wants to talk to you again.

dialogues.title: Meeting Nabla
lines: I heard you bought old tech...
Babe. You NEVER ask what's in the package.
No deal. I don't want to get involved in whatever this scheme is.
Eh... dying and failing in business is.
Don’t ask how Nabla knows. You’ll just embarrass yourself.
Nabla needs a package delivered to Sage Hullen. You can find her hanging round Metro Hub.
I'm gonna turn it into a success.
Here you go, babe. Come back when the job's done.
Either way, you're gonna have to prove yourself. Give a little, get a little.
Sure. We all believe that. What are you here for?
Then Nabla doesn't want to get involved with you. Later, BABE.
Nabla does a lot of things. Course Nabla doesn't buy from just anyone. You might be a Corpo grass for all Nabla knows.
Are you Nabla, by any chance?
Babe… we’re all Nabla. But you, you're Thaddeus's pet project. Took on a bar with a debt record longer than a budget trip to Luna.

dialogues.title: Ava discusses the crash
lines: Remember that prickly photographer we met, Elaine Malloy? She was a suspect. It never went anywhere.
I was interested and did a little digging around Floyd and the crash.
Well the crash itself was interesting because the person driving the Hova was a famous photographer. Gemo O'Brien.
It gets stranger, our mobile retail friend Harmony, she was the person pinned under the car. She's who Floyd saved.
It sometimes feels like we live in a simulation.
Well, famously Gemo lost her pelvis in the impact but it was always regarded as suspicious. The air breaks in the vehicle had been tampered with.
What would I do without you, Ava?

dialogues.title: It's 1234
lines: I updated the passphrase in the chip. If you insert it into the terminal, the interface should be able to read it.

dialogues.title: Pray with Me
lines: Yup, big ol' Zero set up just for you.
Well, I thank you for your work. If you have the time, there is always a spot for you among the congregation.
If you ever find the time, there is always a spot for you among the congregation.
Good thing I have heathens for friends.
Har. Har. Very funny. To create a Zero where there should be a place to code is blasphemous.
You are ready to find the Ones.

dialogues.title: Ava points out options
lines: She's just trying to help people.
Not necessarily. It's simple my job to make sure you are aware of your options.
Well, it's a dog eat dog world, Ava.
Do you think there'd be something in it for me if I reported her?
Indeed. However, such information could have value to the authorities.
You want me to narc on Dr Fred?
I'll let Agent Teleshko know you are looking for him.
Under CorpSec legislation, what Dr Fred is doing is technically illegal.
I feel obliged to say something...
So, such information could have value to the authorities.

dialogues.title: Ava has found Raluca
lines: A woman called Raluca owns an oxyphile mask. She is mostly seen in Lowtown. This could be what Lochlainn needs to help his son.

dialogues.title: Return with Cocktail ingredients
lines: I'm glad to hear it. Well, so long to a life behind the bar. There. The license is yours.
You have conviction. I suppose I can respect that. Well, so long to a life behind the bar. There. The license is yours.
Maybe I'll stick around to see. Good luck!
No. I run my establishments my way.
Someone call the Sec, there's been a murder. Of my EXPECTATIONS. I never thought you'd do it, darling.
Happy to keep a tradition alive.
Will you put Frosted Murders on your menu?
I'll make my fortune with this.
So, will you sign the license over to me?

dialogues.title: Ava looks for Danny 1
lines: I've been monitoring CorpSec feeds. They apprehended Danny.
Breaking curfew? That was pretty careless.
Sounds like they wanted an excuse to nab him.
That kind of offense is normally a fine. Sounds like a pretext?
That is where it gets really strange. They took him in at 9:30 in the evening.
CorpSec nabbed him in a raid. He's been in a detention center for hours.
Wait... did he lead CorpSec directly to Harper?
Maybe they want to lure Harper out of hiding?
The justification was pretty weak. Breaking curfew.

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus Told to Publish
lines: I don't know what you mean by research?
Obviously I thought I had misplaced the damn thing but then I remembered another half forgotten dream about a man in a suit who came and asked for it.
Nope. I just have one of those faces. What happened with your research? publish it?
The aging stuff, you said you cured it?
Well it's impossible to submit something you no longer have?
I was good at biology in school. Maybe I could find a cure for aging?
How could you be so foolish, it will be in the hands of the corps now, they'll keep it for themselves!
Immortality. Maybe loss of memory would have been more urgent to research.
It's all a bit foggy but I do remember something. An ugly stranger told me to publish it so I did... well I tried to.
It was a very lovely suit.
And you gave it to him?
Are you hear about my dream recordings?
You lost it?! How could you be so foolish old man!
Well, look. It is what it is, until it isn't and it isn't an 'is' anymore. Time for a side hobby I think.
I can see how that would sway you.

dialogues.title: New Game
lines: I don't know. I was finger painting with them and ran out of paint so I used something else... I think I got some on my clothes.
You need to go now, Silo.
.... Alright, scram. Go watch a movie.
Binary Gods, kid! You scared me.
Ok, I found you. Now go home.
Hehe. I'm good at that. It's an art, you know? My parents told me I should learn to draw but that was boring.
Awww. Come on. One more round and then I'll go home. I promise.
I have the best hiding spot in mind. Catch me if you can!!!

dialogues.title: Clancy Meeting 3
lines: Hey kid, can you help me with something?
Exactly. But it feels like there is, doesn't it?
Little birdy came to me last night and placed something very special on my desk.
Have to? Do you have to? No, it's only the greatest opportunity to come across my desk in years. Of course you don't have to.
Now you're getting it amigo. You're very welcome.
Look here, in my hands can you see it?
And just like that, you've learned the most fundamental lesson in sales.
The hand may be empty but the mind is always full. It's a very powerful tool. People see what they want to see.
It's high-level stuff kid. Careful with it.

dialogues.title: We try to hire Lucy
lines: I have a little experience with aesthetics. Ambiance. Decor. And I have noticed that your noodle stand could be described as "shabby chic"... minus the "chic."
So you want to help me by...?
How very short-sighted of you. Your loss obviously.
I could be your style consultant. A measly 100 Lims would be the cost... daily of course.
Deal! Let's meet here again tomorrow.
Oh hey, fellow acquaintance. I am greeting you in a friendly manner. You are welcome!

dialogues.title: Gan doesn't consider himself a vacuum cleaner
lines: And it would have a better dust filter than this one, too.
No problem, but I want to ask you something!
You've got some special qualities I need!
You can raise it to 1000 Lims per hour. The answer remains the same!
You're not great at reading people, are you? The answer is no.
So, will you take the job?
Ah, you think just because I look like a vacuum cleaner ...
... because I look like a vacuum cleaner, that makes me a vacuum cleaner?
I am much more! I am a being! I was a highly qualified engineer in my lifetime.
Well, you are a vacuum cleaner!
Well, if you ever run into hard times, you know where to find me!
I could construct a vacuum cleaner from the items in your trash over a lunch-break!
I need a cleaner bot in my restaurant.
Now that you put it like that ...
That's not what I came for.
Hello. Thank you for respecting my privacy, and keeping my fate secret from my wife.

dialogues.title: Ava suggests who knows more
lines: Everyone has brushed me off so far.
I feel they may respond differently now, especially if you tell them you know where he is.
Thaddeus found a way to keep them quiet.
I suggest you revisit those who knew Thaddeus well... or those who might know more about his true nature.
Perhaps as Thaddeus nears the end of his journey, those who know him best will share more information with us.

dialogues.title: Sanna has a new career
lines: That's the next best thing to spelunking?
Look, I won't bother you with the details of my broken fucking heart, but I needed to find work, FAST, and preferably something where I wouldn't have to serve my ex and her... new boyfriend noodles.
And that's why you're here. I see.
Exactly. So I got a new gig. Something that gets me out and about a bit more, and pays... ok. Considering.
That's what I wanted to tell you. I actually... found something else. Another job - a good one. I think.
Hey, I didn't know you came out this far. Hive Mall huh! It's not as fancy as it used to be.
It's hard to keep track of all the sad stories.

I'm never exploring a cave again - not unless I can afford a new spine and some upgraded kneecaps. So I'm doing the next best thing. I'm going to all the most dangerous parts of the city as a corporate risk assessor.

Yup. Officially... absolutely everything is ok here. But if you don't have a good reason to be here, I recommend you conclude any important business transactions... and if you feel the ground rumble under your feet, run.
Nice to know I made an impression. What's the point of misery if it's not even memorable?
Sarcasm. This is the worst job in the world. I go to dangerous locations and write reports on how to minimize damage to commerce.
Imagine that. Me asking if Marina wants, I dunno, an espresso. Meanwhile I'm...
Remember I told you about my... break up?
I'm contractually obligated to tell you it's not. And to recommend you go about your business as usual. In fact, that's the main part of this job. Telling people everything is ok.
I cannot give you a lot of hope.
You still want to work for me?
Look, I know no one wants to know all the boring details of my break up.
Hope to see you again, Sanna.
I meant to come talk to you. About the job...
Alright, I'm gonna get back to work. My next posting is the Oil Rig - which is not in any kind of danger of capsizing. It's also where me and Marina had our first kiss. Fuck my life I guess?
Phew! I'm glad everything is ok.
Sure. And hey... thanks for the chat. It... wasn't nothing.

dialogues.title: Discuss your options with Ava
lines: I'd rather not think about it.
Are you able to delete it?
He did indeed upload all the DNA data to me.
I wonder if any of you is in here? DNA gets everywhere.

dialogues.title: Tell Andrea About None
lines: You're just like all the rest. Well I hope you find happiness in your life before you croak, it's clearly eluded you up to this point.
Any luck with those lyrics honey?
Well I appreciate that, sugar. Guess I'll find someone else somewhere. Thanks for giving me the idea though.
It's a waste of CorpSec time and money. They have enough to deal with.
I care. I just don't want to see you arrested for such a small thing.
Well that's the most un-Jazz thing I ever heard. I had a feeling you were gonna bottle it. Never mind I guess, I'll find someone who cares
I don't think I want to be responsible for getting you sent to Jazz-Jail.

dialogues.title: Dr Fred Thanks
lines: No, trying to do the right thing never is.
This is... thank you. So much. You've saved lives today.
But I am asking. There are lives at stake. If you've screwed me over...
You don't seem very pleased to see me.
Then maybe you don’t need to. Good luck out there.
Someone I trust. It wasn't easy.
You know why I like the sewers? Because down here, so far from the Spire, people remember what it is to be human.
Wait, you got them? How? Where from?
I’m not sure I am. I was tired before. I shouldn't have asked you to risk anything for me.

dialogues.title: Ava scans the urn
lines: Could be a dog, or a man.
No, not really. Unless you find dogs weird.
Just thought it would be worth taking a look in case there was something weird in there.
She did say that Eugene liked running on the beach...
Oh my ... she told us the entire time, right?
Let's scatter them. It's the right thing to do.
Don't worry, I scanned the urn.
We don't have time for this, dispose of them, she'll never know.
Well Lynnphora is correct, the urn is full to the brim with ashes but those ashes belong to a canine. One of the smaller breeds. A Dachshund perhaps?
What would you like to do? We could scatter them anyway, he clearly meant a lot to her. Or I can dispose of them for you?
Creepy thing to do... is there?
In this context, I might do. How much dog?

dialogues.title: Gunger futher revelations
lines: From Thaddeus? Nah. He won't force anything onto you. But if you take him up on his offer, remember one thing: after you fuck with your brain once, it's fucked forever. You can't un-stir the coffee.
Good choice. Remember that when Thaddeus makes you the same offer he made me... I'm so fucking tired...
Can't tell you. Wish I could. Thaddeus had a secret he didn't want to share, but I really don't feel like keeping his secrets anymore.
So it's all coming to an end huh? The Thaddeus's experiment is almost over.

He asked me to hold onto something, and I can't tell you what it is. But I can tell you I don't want it anymore. You see for you, it might be like Thaddeus is gone, but for me... it's like I can't ever get rid of him.
Nah. If his experiment fails, I'm stuck holding onto something that loses all meaning. If it succeeds, Thaddeus sticks around and my burden remains.
He gave me a gift I can't give back.
That's impossible. I really want to spill it out, but ...

dialogues.title: Rendezvous
lines: Oh, for one, my cousin Jay - hey! I see what you tried to do there. Not gonna pull one over on me! Haha.
I like the gardens. I feel like this is the most natural place in Nivalis, yah know? Only other place would be the islands.
Before the debt came tumbling down, I used to dream about this place on Calypso Island. Have you ever been?
You do? Can't blame 'em. Where's their favorite spot? Unless it's a secret, though I can keep a secret you know.
Oh! Hey! You made it. Quite the spot, right?
She liked the Docks. Said she loved the way the neon rode the waves.
Ah, nothing beats the water. Before the debt came tumbling down, I used to dream about this place on Calypso Island. Have you ever been?
Ah, people always think that until they're the only ones still hanging around.
I'd rather be an asshole than struggle.
Ah, I guess it could be worse. You know?
...I had a friend that liked views like this.

I've only been once, when I was young. We took a family trip to celebrate my older sister's certification. Hmph, that was such a great trip. There for a full three days. Neither of us had been out of the main city 'side from a boat trip.
Oh? What kind of secrets are you keeping?
You do? Can't blame her. Where's her favorite spot? Unless it's a secret, though I can keep a secret you know.
I have a friend, she likes views like this.
Pretty sucky if you ask me.
Too much family time for me.
It's a little high don't yah think?
There are the struggles. Though this was fun. We'll have to do it again some time.
If you don't sell your soul, sure. Look at those flashing ad boards and shit though... Most would sell their very skin to see their face on one of those.
She likes the Docks. Said she loves the way the neon rode the waves.
Yeah, think about it. Assets are the things you have that have value, right? The word literally starts with ass.
So true. That's why Corpo CEOs are the biggest assholes around!

Ah, I'd like to blame it on a lack of Lims. But, truth be told, don't think I can. Afraid if I do, the new memory will replace the old one and I really don't want that to happen. I miss those relationships and would hate to have the memory masked, you know?
Had to try. Do you have other spots you like?
Yeah, guess you bring it out of me. This was fun. Have to do it again some time.
Yeah, I guess it is. You'd probably be better off near the water. Nothing beats it.
No one to talk to. Only one still left around is my sister and she's still on Luna. Never came back when Mom was sick. Never helped with the debt or assets - ha, that's such a funny word.
I like the HOVAs racing by.
Like the things that you think have value actually make you an asshole!

Oh that was the first of many things. She got a certification in grafting, then she got one that made her an expert in ocular tattooing, and I don't know what else. I stopped paying attention after she left for Luna, some intense training camp on the nuances of granite harvesting.
Right? Pure be-a-utes. Only thing that beats them are the boats wavering on the sea. Nothing beats the water.
Cale! Is that a bit of optimism?!

dialogues.title: Ava says ask the TheraPay bots
lines: Since everything remains anonymous, people confide all sorts of private information to them.
Thaddeus? I have no idea. But the TheraPay bots are old, and widely used.
I ran a search and found a reference to a Version 1.0 TheraPay bot that has been offline for almost seventy years. Its memory may have escaped any data purges.
If anybody ever talked about Coma Roamers with them, they would have retained the data.
You haven't spoken with one, yet? You're missing out on all the fun...
They offer advice and emotional support... for Lims. Like a discount therapy session. Somewhat...
TheraPay bots! That might actually work!
Rosetta's suggestion is actually a good one. We need to talk to TheraPay bots.
You think Thaddeus talked with a TheraPay bot?
It seems like a long shot Ava...
It IS a long shot. But what have we got to lose?
I'll update your HUD with its location.

dialogues.title: Danny needs money
lines: I'm not a bank or a loan shark.
I met someone who can change her identity and fully override her public record and documentation. Iris transplant and all.

Please think about it. My businesses are all deep in debt - I already owe everyone I know AND more than a few sharks... I would need the cash by tomorrow. If you can, send the money via Banor. He knows where to find me.
And that's exactly where you can help.
I found a solution for my sister. But I need your help.
She doesn't have it. I don't have it. This whole situation has put me in debt. I promise... you'll get it back some day. Once my business gets back on its feet.
Look, I have a friend who would do it heavy discounted for me... But it still costs 300 Lims.
300 Lims? You have your own business but you can't afford that much?

dialogues.title: Band Member 5 - The Theraminist
lines: Can I ask one quick question though?
