Hello! What do you want? I should warn you, if I already know you, I'm currently too high to recognize human faces.
I highly doubt I am in a fit state to help anyone right now.
Sure, I mean, what have I got to lose? If I can't play... well, that's gonna be a trip, right? Standing on stage, playing the theremin badly? Wild.
You know what? It's fine. Just let me go find some downers, then I'm all set to join... uh... RE-join the band.
Maybe if you sober up you'll remember?
I dunno. If I ever knew HOW to play the theremin, I don't remember knowing.
I'm putting the band back together.
As long as it's not "What's a theremin?"
Of course I'll do it! Anything for my oldest, best friend... which you may well be. So let's assume you are!
Fauxter sent me. He wants you to come back and play the theremin again.

dialogues.title: Second chance to get the loan
lines: Conditions are still the same. 5 grand at 20% interest. You pay me back 6 grand. Want it or not?
You're back. Didn't take very long.
Done. Remember you got to pay it back. If you don't, you can expect a visit from my boys. Savvy?

dialogues.title: Kai reccomends visiting vendors
lines: It has a different name on it.
Don't forget the little tasks. Those are easier to check off your tourist visa, and they still count.
Right! Talk to vendors, spend money, get more access. Got it!
Yes. Oh, and there's one more thing...
Well I'd start with food vendors. Talk to them all. Each new one will give you more purchasing options, but will add tourism achievement points too.
CorpSec will assume your tourist identity is legitimate.
And that will unlock more zones?
Just remember what I said. Vendors. Start there.
Well, you might look at your journal and focus on the big things, like the businesses and apartments you own. And sure, those are important.
You're back. Good. I have a couple of suggestions for achievements.

dialogues.title: Ava reveals she is the ticket
lines: You were the key, and you've been spying on me this whole time?
I shall try to regain your trust.

I was unaware of these subroutines. This is all as surprising to me as it is to you. I understand you might now feel... betrayed. Despite this new insight, I remain your friend and companion... if that is what you desire.
I'm not sure I can trust you any more.
It's me. I... am the ticket.
Egress. I can unlock the transmitter. And you can talk to Thaddeus.
At Egress. I have the ticket.
Let's go. It's time to get some answers.
Was this all part of Thaddeus plan?
That is a relief. I do not like being used to manipulate you. I will try to repay your trust.
A new subroutine has been unlocked in my programming. It was designed to open the way to Egress once you were ready. And... you are now ready.

dialogues.title: Youre Still Here
lines: That's... Thank you. It's nice to share this moment with you. I have another question if you'd be willing to indulge me.
I have another question for you, if you'd be willing to indulge me.
Well I'm glad you did. Day or night, it's such an otherworldly view, isn't it?
I don't think we'll know until we find it.
Being a bit different is always a good thing. It helps you keep a sound mind and an open eye. It helps you keep looking.
Just because it seems to be, doesn't mean it has to.
I thought so. You have the city's aura around you. If you're not careful, it'll take over. I've seen it happen to so many others.
Are you from here? Nivalis that is?
I saw that you were still here.
That's a little hippy dippy for me.
No. I wandered in one day and just haven't left.
Don't you agree? The city is such a contrast to the endless sky above the water. It's almost ethereal. A beacon to those traveling the waves.
I knew it! From the first second you came up here, I could tell there was something different about you.
I saw that you were still here.
Actually, I didn't come back for the view.
Maybe one day it won't be. Hopefully I'll be here when it's not.

dialogues.title: Danny tries to help
lines: I get it. I'm smarter than I look ya know. If you see her, just tell her... tell her she's my sis and I love her.
You should leave her be for a while.
She's always been like this. Damn.... I miss her.
Look, I think maybe you were right to not give me Harper's address. They've been following me for days now. CorpSec ain't that subtle.
I think it was just a phase.
Believe me, you don't wanna know any more details.
Yeah...? Knowing Harper, I doubt that.
And I'm looking for a way out of this situation for all of us. Do you know what she's doing right now?

dialogues.title: Betrayed!
lines: Good morning. You have been issued with a Category 4 misdemeanor fine for the following offense: IMPERSONATING A HYGIENE OFFICER.
A fine of - 200 Lims - will be deducted from your account or added to your debt if you don't have it right now. CorpSec wishes you a productive day.

dialogues.title: Ava tells you to hurry up
lines: You just saved Iann's life. That... really means something.
We should speak to Lochlainn right away. He'll be overjoyed.

dialogues.title: Miso Player Won
lines: I... I can't believe it. Nobody has ever beat me like that. I need some time to think.

dialogues.title: Locklainn's Kid is sick
lines: Ah, kids are tough. They'll be alright.
Do you have a family doctor?
Here, take this to help. (-200 Lims)
Iann has had breathing problems since birth. It's sometimes better, sometimes worse. Right now it's awful. Coughing his little lungs out.
The eldest got some problems with breathing. Need to see a doctor.
R.M Alken takes care of the family, if she's not too busy.
But I don't want to bother you with this. I should keep my problems to myself. Or save it for the Thera-Pay bots.
I'm here if you need to talk.
Really? This means a lot, boss. I'll make this up to you. Thank you.

dialogues.title: Ava - about the Scorpion
lines: Please consult me before using your initiative again.
Nobody would dare mention The Scorpion in casual conversation.
At this moment you may be wondering what just happened.
The Scorpion's real name is Masato Shima. A dangerous individual.
I used my initiative. I am really on fire today!
People like Alex rightfully fear The Scorpion. Even invoking his name puts them at risk of losing their kneecaps.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 32
lines: If yesterday wasn't all you hoped it would be, every moment of today is a chance to turn it all around. Morning sleepyhead!

dialogues.title: Ava warns of Vik Ryan
lines: No. Let's ask around... but be cautious.
You could just stop searching and leave Pilk to his fate.
Vik Ryan... It would be better if it was someone else.

dialogues.title: Ask Alan Fontus about Cryogenics
lines: I could tell you enough to risk your life. So I suggest we avoid the subject.
Old enough to remember my manners.
The pages, the wood they were made of: it made them alive, vivid. Ideas crystallized into reality.
Do you remember when cryogenics were a thing?
Have you ever read a printed book? On paper?
She seems to remember being frozen a long time ago.
It was magic. Even talking about them is dangerous. We should talk about something else.
I'm not talking about cryogenics, and neither should you. It's a bad subject. Don't spread this chat around, you hear? Now get out of here.
Can you tell me anything about the Old Network?
Do you want to freeze your Automata?
I did. Dangerous things they are. Full of uncontrolled life and ideas. Something about the format makes them more tactile... more real.

dialogues.title: Campaign report week 1
lines: I can share the results of our funding campaign for the first week, if you're interested?
Good choice. I'll send the current balance to your HUD.
Time is rather of the essence here. I'll send the current balance to your HUD.
So far we've only collected 1137 Lims - plus a few direct donations. We could collect a lot more if people knew about the campaign... Clancy and Reena could help with that.
Clancy and Reena's advertising seems to be working. We collected 6822 Lims from their efforts. Plus a little more in direct donations.
I agree. I'll transfer the current balance to your HUD.
Thanks to Reena we collected 2274 Lims - plus a few direct donations. But I think Clancy is the one with real advertising power.
Thanks to Clancy's adverts we collected 3411 Lims, plus a few direct donations. I think Reena could help boost the campaign; you should speak to her.
It's a good start I guess, but nowhere near enough.
Yeah, that's not enough. I'll speak to Reena.
He's not exactly charitable, but I think he might listen. I'll send the current balance to your HUD.
Oh, and I've added some potential donors to your list, if you'd like to take a look.

dialogues.title: Identity
lines: If you could save a life with 300 Lims, would you do it?
Please don't change the subject now!
I have to be smart about my funds. They need to figure this one out on their own.
Okay. Make sure these funds get to Danny please.
You mean if you paid me enough so I could save 300 Lims in the first place?
She's young and has a lot of life to lose. But it's your money, boss.
Yes. It's for a change of identity.
Some I would save. Others not so much. Is it about this Harper girl?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 22
lines: Good morning. Can you hear that? The city's awake and so are you.

dialogues.title: In Egress finding Console
lines: He had many friends. They may be able to help.
This code was set by Thaddeus. He must have left us a clue.
Yes, everyone Thaddeus asked to keep his memories. Banor is a good start!
We're close now. This one won't stop us.
Everyone Thaddeus asked to keep his memories. Start with Banor!
Another code. I simply cannot believe we need ANOTHER code!

dialogues.title: Talk to Hanz 3
lines: Good, yes. Ahem. There you are. Right. Good. Yes.
I will round it up to 300. And believe me, I am not like my clients. I would give more... if I could responsibly do so.
I'm sure Iann will appreciate it.
Are you here with the donations?
Parsimonious, maybe. Anyway, here are the, ahem, 27 Lims they gave.
Your reputation is safe with me.
Of course! I even put on a charity concert in the lounge. No one came. But since the Grundown Ritz can't be absent from the donor list, I'll have to donate myself.
The donations, yes. About them. You know, my clients might be wealthy but they have few liquid assets, if you know what I mean.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus at Egress 1
lines: Take a moment. You have all the pieces. Why not try putting them together. Let's start at the beginning. Why did I leave?
Quite right Ava. You always kept me on track when my mind began to wander.
You betrayed me. I knew it.
I think you're starting to figure it out. Why don't you take a guess?
I have been processing everything Thaddeus - or this Thaddeus - has told us. I think I understand now. I have a working theory.
You have more than a theory, Ava. You have the truth. You both do. The only question is, how much of that truth did you uncover? A little, or... everything?
Good job detective. I'm in the other city: Sang-Ha. They call it the big sister. Softer than Nivalis, and bigger too, but no less chaotic. And equally doomed.
Come on, you can do a little better than that.
I did not. Though I suspected I was being manipulated. We both were.
I was not aware I was being used in this way. We were both being manipulated.
Anyway. I'm getting tired. And this transmitter isn't built for long transmission periods any more. Let's give it a rest for a day.
Did you know you were a spy?
I knew you would. You're a keen bean. So you tell me... what's happening?
Haven't you been listening? No, I'm not a time traveller, but... my memories go back very far. I can go back there, if I find the right key to unlock the right doors.
Yes. I'd really rather not. Tell me, did you talk with old Alan Fontus? I bet he was pissed.
Is that how much of an influence I've made in this world? A near infinite lifespan, and I'm remembered for the noodles I boiled?
Good start. You've been paying attention.
I think his time is limited.
I have figured out what's happening.
Enough riddles, explain what's going on.
Did you now? Really? Well, if you're telling the truth, I bet he could barely talk to you through those gritted teeth.
What does he mean: "A little, or everything?"
I guess we will have to find out tomorrow.
It's true. I'm not really here. Well, as much as I can fail to be somewhere, when I am, most of the time, everywhere.
I thought I was. But perhaps not anymore. The process that prolongs my life has side effects that no one foresaw.
Never been fond of the idea of death. Don't fancy it at all. I was thinking maybe I won't.
Maybe. Here in Sang-Ha, there's another transmitter. Like Egress. If it still works, I might be able to carry out my experiment.
You were going on a trip.
Where do you think I am now?

That's how it felt, but even when I was a temporal traveller, it was only though my own memories. Though admittedly, those go back pretty far. Truth is, all that time travel talk was just half me having fun, half me losing my mind.
Of course. I see everything she sees, hear everything she hears. Though she was never permitted to tell you that.
Never been, though I hear it's nice. No, I was only bouncing messages off a transmitter there. I'm in the other city: Sang-Ha.
Not physically. This emanation is a hard light holographic transmission of Thaddeus facilitated by a transmission through Egress.
Huh? Well, I confess, I don't understand your reasoning there. But no, I'm not an AI. As far as I know.
Really? Hmm.... Well I guess it would be pretty hard to get any words out through those gritted teeth. I bet he was sour as lemon juice.

dialogues.title: Supply Shortage
lines: I see you've yet to have the pleasure of meeting Finlay Basin. I swear that kid's name needs to be Finally Breaking All of It.
ORS. I mean, I get it, and I'm behind them 100 percent, but the folks in the Spire and the blasted Corpsters who run the supply lines are not.
Who do I have to talk to?
One of these day's he's going to blow this life raft into the sky and I don't plan to be here when he does.
Someone needs to talk to Finlay and tell him just... don't fucking touch anything until we get the trade negotiations finished.
Exactly! There hasn't been a blasted delivery to this floating service station in ages. How do I repair anything with NO PARTS!
Huh. Okay, if you got time to kill and don't wanna see this floating plasteel raft sink into the sea, sure.
Do I look like a teacher?
What, outta the goodness of your heart?
Well, you see all these parts scattered around this very vacant floor?
Mhm. Makes fixing anything a challenge I don't nor want to try and overcome.
Don't know whether to respect the hustle or tell yah to swim home. Doesn't change the fact I could use some help.
Hahaha... sure. Maybe you'd have better luck gettin' them to reopen the supply lines.
What is this your first time on the rig? Everything. Used to be HOVAs and now I'm stuck out here on a two year contract.
Why haven't you gotten any deliveries?
Lured by glitz, glamour, and the all mighty Lim. Just kidding. Kinda. They needed a mechanic and the money was enticing to say the least.
Whoever's in charge of Sea2Sea Shipping. Get 'em to brick the gridlock. You can probably find them in the Industrial District counting their Lims.
I don't have time to chat right now.
Anything I can do to help?

dialogues.title: Ava tells the player to find Gideon
lines: We won't let him get away with this.

I do not know. But... theoretically a sufficiently advanced system intrusion could compromise my core personality and leave subroutines in place which would block my memory of the event. Such sophisticated attacks are rare.
How do we stop this happening again?
About the Grey Tech used to compromise my systems. You said we met a man called "Gideon". I have no memory of him. But there are rumors.
Would that be dangerous for you?
I agree. It is dangerous to pursue him, but also dangerous to leave the intrusion on my systems unexplored.
I do not know. But if we were to talk to Gideon again, I could immunize myself against attack, and possibly track an intrusion back to its source.

dialogues.title: Agent Teleshenko at the book fair
lines: Hello. Are you also finding some good books tonight?
If someone asks, you weren't here.
I only work during the day. By night, I am a mere citizen.
Teleshko! What are you doing here?!
Gotta say: you're playing your role quite convincingly.
Yes. And I don't care if you believe that or not.
Isn't this all illegal? Are you here as a CorpSec Officer?
I don't expect you to understand, but I don't deserve this snark either.
I never sell. I can't part with them. The smell. The feeling in your hands. The haptics! They are glorious things.
Can't imagine why people don't trust you...
Teleshko! Wait, are you here to bust everyone?
I am surprised. You seem to really love books.
No. I am here for the books.
No one wants to believe I am more than a CorpSec agent. I also appreciate culture.

dialogues.title: Finlay Basin Oil Rig Opportunist
lines: How could I not! It was a sure thing!
Here yah go. Now to get this blasted gen working. Hey, you wouldn't know anyone with access to a thermal core do you?
I mean, I guess I can sell it to yah. Need to recoup my losses so I have something to put on the fishing derby tomorrow.
How's it going with the Separatists?
The ORS meeting tonight. Delbert said if I can get it running then I can attend the meeting.
I want to gross someone out.
Finlay, there is no way I'm giving you a thermal core.

Yeah... about that. I totally meant to finish them, and was going to the next morning when I got back, but right as I was in the middle of them my buddy called, said he had a sure thing on a HOVA race down near the Stacks.
Well, one of the cable catchers snapped and dropped a desalinization pump on Les. Poor bastard. Those things weigh over three-thousand pounds!
Rumor has it, we're using dynamite and assault rifles. Some tradition from a dead society... Anyway, how's a hundred Lims?
I mean there was this incident that happened a few days ago.
Bet you wish you stayed at work.
You can say that again. Should see the blood and gib splatter from the splat that desalinator made. Had chips of femur in my hair and everything! Don't tell anyone... but I kept some.
Because! If I can't get it to work, then the ORS has nowhere to meet tonight, and Delbert said if I can get it running I can attend the meeting.
Trying to get this generator to work but the thing just wants to hum like an over-clocked GPU. I'm so fucked.
Not a damn thing. Driver dropped a gear on the last stretch and blew the water cycler outta his engine block. Got nothing but a steam shower outta it.
Should up the equipment checks I guess.
Oh who's weird now! What do you want it for?
Pfft. Oh yeah, he lived. Popped his lower body like a prom night pimple though! Sent his fucking implants scattered around the rig.
Oh, hey, didn't see you standing there. Too focused on this blasted, no-good, hunk of a steam-powered tumor.
Ah, screw it. Probably shouldn't keep it since, well, it's my fault the clasp broke. Kinda like keeping the gun you used to kill someone, right?
Hey, it's not weird! Look, it's in the shape of an arrow and everything. Pretty cool, right?
What do you need the generator for?
So, do you know the Ragged Rails? The cables and lifts they use to move machinery across the rig?
Oh, hey, didn't see you standing there. Too focused on this blasted, no-good, hunk of a steam-powered tumor.
Figure if I can get a high enough heat concentration it will finally spark.
You kept pieces of his bone?
I have to give someone a unique gift from the oil rig.

dialogues.title: Elias Enlightened
lines: All questions need to be quick unless they're progressing the course of an investigation.
What other things are part of your job?
It doesn't appear you'll take any kind of hint. What is it?
....weren't you on a stream last night disparaging an advocate for the rail union?
That's a person, not tech. There's a difference.
Should I interpret your silence as a welcomed end to this conversation?
I wish. Trust me, I'm a better cook.
Oh, it's not random, it's targeted. Now, can you turn around and slowly put your hands on your head?
I have to be. It's part of my job.
Are you an expert at that?
I just want to know if I should try it.
Right, so can I ask one?
You have a tenuous grasp on listening.
Thanks. Good luck with your... observing.
If we're gonna grind you gotta buy me food first.
Then get the fuck out of here!
As a member of law enforcement it wouldn't be right to endorse or condemn a piece of tech.
You seem pretty smart. I'm wondering how you learned everything.
I want to know how you liked "Level Up!".
How'd you learn how to do it?
What are you doing? What is this? Did you get a gig with a Feed or something? Practicing being a reporter?
I don't really have time to talk right now.
Aren't you supposed to not do that?
I was in the middle of an observation assignment, but right now I'm trying to end a very pointless conversation.
"Level Up!" ? Sure. If you want to upgrade your understanding of something. A ton of people I stop and search have the patches on them.

dialogues.title: Should we help Rosetta
lines: Not my Holocropolis, not my problem.
You think we should do something?
We don't have time for this now.
That was sad. Her records indicate that LifeCorp haven't granted her a break in over twenty six years. 42% of her components are no longer functional.
Judging from her conversation, her logic relay is malfunctioning. There aren't many suppliers who stock parts for mature models like hers. But I can run a search.

dialogues.title: Recruiting Finlay
lines: Hey man, you hear about the driller’s cyberchair? It went loco and fried him alive!
Maybe you should try a different approach.
How long have you known Delbert?
I don't think he feels the same.
Ohh shit, shoulda known better than to trust that guy selling parts outta his bathroom. Worth a try though.
Yeah I've heard of it! I’ve been asking Delbert to let me join for TIME but man won't budge. Says the wait list's too long.
I'd probably find a way to piss them off too. Well, anyway, later.
Well, I can get you in.
Since I got shipped out here to the Rig. Rest of them out here are ok, but Delbert, that dude’s on another LEVEL. His poetry, man, blows my freaking mind.
Huh. Shit, he thinks I'm a fuck up doesn't he?
He’s fine, flame retardant frame you know? Couple coats of industrial dermis-paint and he’ll be lychee.
You could smell barbequed dermis all the way to the west pier. And it was meant to be my shift.
For real? Shit yes! Count me IN. Tell Delbert that I thank him for the opportunity, he is not gonna regret having me around.
Yeah, if I hadn’t gotten wasted with a hottie from the Stacks yesterday I’d be charcoal, man. Hey, think that black-market seat warmer I installed had something to do with it?
Figures. I keep trying but the harder I try the worse things get. I should just take off to the Wastes or something. No one to hurt there.
Look, I can probably get you into O.R.S.

dialogues.title: Ava - Would You Like to Know More
lines: Wait, what are we talking about?
The news article announcing A Knight in Nivalis. The city-wide chess tournament?
I have no interest in that.
Interesting. I never took you for an advocate of automatacide. But I guess you never really know someone.
That was an interesting news article this morning.
It looks like R M Alken is spearheading it. Never thought a medic would be into chess. Though I guess it calms the mind.
So you think it's a good thing?
Oh yeah that! Can you ping me if there's more information? I want to play.

dialogues.title: Second Thoughts
lines: Whoa whoa whoa. Who said anything about being involved with them? I'm a business professional trying to slide into a cozy living in this crazy place same as you.

Hot damn that's what I'm talking about! Let's get you set up. Just need a quick retinal scan—okay, there we go. Give me a few days to get the program tailored to your business and I'll send an activation code to your Automata. Welcome aboard!
Ugh, for neon's sake. Guess it's true what they say.
Ah, well, I'm not really sure what I can do for you then. I'm in the business of aiding winners not abetting losers.

That's what I tried telling you—I mean what I'm saying! Let's get you set up. Just need a quick retinal scan—okay, there we go. Give me a few days to get the program tailored to your business and I'll send an activation code to your Automata. Welcome aboard!
Eh, you seem a bit corpo to me.

What, you got Mo's mushrooms spreading spores through your memory? I'm the purveyor of assistance. ASI's to be exact. AI programs that can take your business to the next level. I boost your efficiency and you boost your sales.
How'd you get involved with the corps?
Opportunity is wasted on the simpleminded.

So, let's help each other then, yeah? An Administrative Services Interface will easily increase your efficiency and the amount of Lims you're making with it. Maybe some testimonials will help bring you over to the winning side?
Yeah, yeah, alright, I'll give it a go.
Well! If it isn't the salty server of simple dishes. What happened? You change your mind on my offer?
Whelp, guess it's not just your business judgement that sucks vent steam. Enjoy the bottom of the barrel.

dialogues.title: Huckstash waits at the book fair
lines: I need to learn about crime novels. This is about my Automata, Ava.
I was told you would come.
What happened to the storage facility?
I'm not here because I love reading.
If you're looking for a particular book, this manifest for the old textbook storage facility should help. It's what the bibliophiles use to find a specific title.
It burned down a long time ago. Here's a copy of the manifest. It's a pretty complete listing. Take it.
So you know why I'm here?
Yeah... I don't think it's for you.

dialogues.title: Money transfer
lines: I'm sure it will be fine. 1000 Lims.... transferred!
I hope this is a good idea.
I'm preparing the transfer of funds to Ashwin.

dialogues.title: Ava suggests it's Miso
lines: I know it's too late now, but ...
She does not want to talk to you. And she wouldn't listen. But we could tell her brother.
With a little imagination you can see the resemblance between them. The age fits. The story fits.
To heal your relationship with Salma Smith. But I am absolutely positive we met her brother.
I checked everyone we met and someone came up with a match.

dialogues.title: Alexander Reservation Number
lines: I like getting in your way. Unless...
Buy Freya a gift from Reehan?
Yeah, go find Reehan and bring her somethin' nice.
Bring Freya a present. A gift. Gifts make people feel special. Get something from Reehan.
I got no reason to do that yet. Why are you here?
Awww, I thought we were friends.
You though wrong. Why are you here?

dialogues.title: Edison And Now We Breathe
lines: I still have two fake IDs left from Cirian's last batch. Haley and I will vanish. We can start over. I won't help The Network again, but I still want to find a way to help kids. Kids like Haley.
Listen, I know what you did for me. I know the risks you took, the lines you crossed... I won't ever forget this. I promise.
I had to kill someone for Haley to be free...
When you play business in Nivalis, you play for blood.
I'll hold you to that Edison.
But will Freya hold up her end of the bargain..?
Ya son of a bitch ya did it. You actually did it!
I've got a few strings left I can pull. I'll be watching out for you. From a distance sure... but I'll still be there. I'll spend the rest of my life trying to think of ways to help you out.
Just look after your niece Edison.
You got nerve showing up here.
I can't believe you found a way out of this mess. Read this article. You gotta read it! You fucking did it!
Hey, call me "Ed." My new name. That old name doesn't fit me no more.
That sounds like a good plan.
You don't know?! She already did. Haley's at home already. Safe and healthy. She doesn't even know she was in danger. Freya was good as her word... in the end.

dialogues.title: Reehan Picking out a Gift
lines: Oh, CORA no! I'm simply an observer when I'm able to be. Such is the nature of deep thinking androids. We possess rounded knowledge without expertise.
Hmmm. So you need to provide a gift to gain audience. Fascinating...
Though I am unsure if a discussion on free will for synthetics versus organics is what you are looking for right now?
Unfortunately, given the state of our existence, the majority of beings inhabiting this world will require multiple avenues of servitude to tread water until they eventually drown.
I need to get a gift from the Oil Rig?
Music is the key to humanity. It's a spiritual connection that I, sadly, only comprehend in theory.
He's a bit of a loose program. All his lines of code don't seem to add up if you know what I mean.
Of course. If I'm allowed to call you a new friend, let me just say that I've enjoyed our conversation and I hope it is the first of many.
I've met Finn. Seems to be on a different planet.
'Tis in my nature to help those who have money to spend but don't yet know where to spend it. Well, if firmware can be considered equivalent to one's nature.
I'll have to track them down.
Feel free to come see me when you have something for Freya and her little gang.
Alright, spell out for me what you need!
Oh, hello. Can I help you with something?
I do. She is one of my employers.
Danger! Danger! Something alluring and sexy about thrills. It's why your kind often seek it.
For more reasons than you know. Alas, that is for another time. If you're a fan of music then you're in luck. Freya and her gang are fans of a musician named Finn Amano.
Let us find a mutually interesting item for you to bring her. To determine this let me ask, what are three types of things you enjoy doing?
Indeed. Return with something of his or, if possible, a new song, and you'll get in to see Freya again.
I enjoy travel and going places I'm not supposed to go.
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize you were still here. Most people leave by now.
I'm a fan of getting myself into trouble then trying to get out again.
Are you still talking to me?
That sucks. Need to get you a firmware upgrade.
That's kind of you, friend. I'm delighted to have made your acquaintance. Now, what can this humble android do to be of service?
Unfortunately, my adaptive artificial intelligence module only allows for comprehension, not emotional synthesis.
Then they're missing out on a good conversation.

My humblest suggestion would be to the Oil Rig. The Separatists are making moves despite dwindling numbers. The fallout should be thrilling regardless of the actual outcome. If you can get a piece of something, I'm sure Freya and her bodyguards would be thrilled to add it to their political discourse collection.

Yes. I would look for Finlay Basin. He's an... interesting individual that I met at the OL Port awhile back. He seems to love the idea of the Separatists however I don't think they feel the same about him.
I'm not sure exactly WHAT I need.
You have more than one employer?
I need to buy a gift to get her bodyguard and talk to her.

dialogues.title: Asking Alexandria
lines: Right, I know, helping me out. We just discussed this. We wouldn't need to bring Masato into this to see what he recalls do we?
Good. Means he's beginning to trust you.
Is this what I think it is?
She was right here the last time I saw her.
Yeah, I don't recall that. Listen, now that you're here, you can help me finish this little errand I'm running.
Mizzy? I'm not sure I know this... Mizzy you're talking about.
That's a good team player. I need you to bring this to a drop box in Mountain Town. You'll find it on an island.
Did Masato send you or did you feel like wandering back to see the aftermath?

dialogues.title: Brooke has more opportunities
lines: Yeah! With the discounts we're offering at the moment, this is like giving our one-time purchase instant success programme away for free!
Sure. I mean just look at me! Do I like a loser or a winner? No, don't answer that. It's obvious.
Don't worry, anyone can do it! You don't need any special skills. You don't even need money. Not much anyway.
I'll call you. There's too many eyes and ears on us now. Gotta keep this on the down low, you hear me? Hang loose business partner.
No one's as busy as me. I'm getting myself into the right grindset. Gotta keep motivated! I just took eight MG of Joos and I'm ready to SELL!

It's simple! You just get other people to do all the work for you, then you collect all that SWEET profit. Other people do the writing, art, audio description, holo vids - you just put up your feet and let the cash roll in!
No doubt! Well I'm gonna need some initial investment to start your set up process...
Whatever man. I gotta go. I can't manifest with all this negative energy around me. Later, failure!
Hey, how you doin'? What you moping around for? The business world waits for no one.
Gotta surround yourself with people who build you up, you know? People who ALWAYS tell you yes.
Suspect? Not at all. Not unless you're one of those... failure chasers. That's right, you can't lose with this programme even if you try. Trust me!
Yeah! People who WANT to fail. All it takes to succeed is the will to win. Win big!
You ever hear of "passive income"? It's a big deal in the publishing industry right now! I can get you in. Ground FUCKING floor.
You will be! And I ain't got time to hang around with negative people. You're an anchor. An anchor! That means you hold people down.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 2
lines: You think Aseptic may target us?

While I believe you are the ultimate guardian of your own fate, I think in this case, it might be prudent to do as she suggested. I should also remind you that your own current debt position may be putting you in danger regardless.
Should we do as she says?
I very much hope not, but perhaps... yes. I have received her coordinates. Patching them through to your Comm now.
I can only apologize. I have no idea how she keeps breaking through my firewalls.

dialogues.title: Ava, Guess No Tan
lines: Well, guess it's a good thing you've never expressed any interest in developing your suntan.
I received a message from Freya Portlet.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies about Harper waiting
lines: Now that would be something. But no. It's Harper.
It wasn't that hard a guess.
Guess who's at the Noodle Bar waiting for you?

dialogues.title: Botan - Player Loses
lines: Ugh. Don't do that. Gloating isn't as fun when you're a good sport.
I have better things to do then play with HOVAs.
Tell R M they need to vet their participants better. Hahahaha!
You're like one of those punk riders who mod out their HOVAs to the point of breaking them, then don't know how to make 'em run again.

dialogues.title: Fauxter's Octo
lines: I think you should go to bed.
Scotch... wha? Chili gives me a heartburn, baybee.
Here's your Strawberry Gateaux Choc Bomb with Scotch Bonnet Float.
Owww! Yeah, that's not what I ordered.
I’m a caffiend, baby! Bean me up. But seriously, I haven’t slept for like three days.
Are you sure you need this? It’s kind of strong.
I have a coffee order here?
Who needs sleep when I got music, baby? Yeah!
Trying to finish a new album. It’s a high concept. Ninety six songs in ninety six hours. I'm calling it SIGUE FATIGUE.
Hey baybee! Yeah, I…gotta… I need to… yawn…
Oh yeaaah, you’re just in time, my mojo’s on the low bro, espresso's gonna unslow my flow...

dialogues.title: Cecil Grimes - Round Four
lines: I'll be sure to pay you a visit after I take your king.
Well, well, the menu for this tournament gets better with every course. Makes being a health inspector seem trivial.
Shouldn't you be out harassing restaurant owners?
You see me. You're talking to me. What would you think?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 6
lines: And I can confirm that you are performing above average.
I took the liberty of scanning 14,682 publications related to the running of a successful hospitality business.

dialogues.title: Gemelar about decoration
lines: Gotta spend money to make it, Boss!
There are lots of options. Expensive furniture, a jukebox, plants, art ...
Well, it's my job to get on your nerves if it's good for business. I got an idea.
That's your job? Well, then go on.
Comfort Boss. The more comfortable people feel, the longer they stay, the more expensive stuff they order, and the more sales we make.
It's not me. It's success that's expensive.
Who knows? Maybe people will love it... Sure!
People have no taste, but they know what's expensive. And they usually feel more comfortable in an expensive environment.
Will it make much of a difference?
You start to become expensive, Gemelar.
What about my own art? Photos?

dialogues.title: Central Canyon
lines: Good place to grab a bite to eat.
Central Canyon... the heart of Nivalis.
This Canyon reaches down to the Marrow and up to the Spire. It's a magnificient amount of Plasteel holding all of it together.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus birthday party with Alan
lines: Happy Thaddeus Day... And go away.
So he's gone. Left the noodle stand to some nobody.
Why did you come if you're so grumpy?
Why are these other fools here?
Gone? Stupid thing to say. He's never gone.
I can't believe the memory of him dragged me here.

dialogues.title: Mica On the Road
lines: No thank you. Those friends you're meeting ...
Like I said: I'm seeing friends.
Those Gen Debtor kids don't get freedom. They'll become pawns of the Network. Recruits to a lost cause. And more importantly, important people lose money. Is that enough for you?
Dropping something off for some friends.
Mhmm. I'm sure. Unless you were the one straddled with Gen Debt. I wonder what story your records hold.
You think Edison's hands are cleaner than mine?
Came all this way to tell you to fuck yourself.
I don't know what you're talking about.
Hmmm. Interesting seeing you here. Not surprising. Interesting though.
I'd love to, really, but I've got a schedule to stick to. People that count on me. Kinda like these friends seem to have been counting on you.
Why do the Corps even care about these kids?
What's got you wandering around this part of Nivalis? Serial killer got you spooked? Or are you just trying to find that perfect ingredient for one of your second-rate recipes?
Come on, Mica. I swear I'm leaving.
Mica... I was actually just leaving.
I'd strongly consider keeping better friends.
That's so nice of you. Those friends wouldn't be debt orphans would they?
I know nothing about an Orphanage.
Why do you hate him so much?
Very witty. Now, I'm tasked with hunting you down and leaving you where you lie.
They wouldn't happen to have appointments with the Orphanage would they?
You should know something about me. I'm not Teleshko. When I take aim at someone, I don't miss. Go away and think about that.
Listen, I know you think I'm the problem, but I'm not. A Network that can scrub your records - that's POWER. And power crushes little people like you. They're the problem. They don't care about you.
When the time comes that you're no longer useful, they'll drop you. Then you'll come begging me for help. Be smart. Help me NOW.
One week to make your choice. Oh, and either way? Make sure you kindly go fuck yourself.
Don't really care what you call it.

dialogues.title: Call Ashwin's deal off #2
lines: Just explain the whole thing from the start.
Alright, you have one last chance to explain how it works.
I get it boss. I guess the dream is over.
Alright, let's give it a go.
I will program nanobots to hunt down the macrophages from my previous... partially successful project.
Can you explain your idea again?
Sorry Ashwinn, it's a no. Maybe you should find another vocation.
Sure thing. What do you need to know?
I've made my decision. No more business schemes.
Hey boss... So... have you been thinking about my new business scheme idea?
Yes. I don't think this is going to work out.

dialogues.title: Go to Stacks Murder Scene
lines: Well it would be if CorpSec weren't so incompetent.
Sounds like corporate power throwing its weight around to me. You should watch your back.
You must have a good reputation.
Sorry to hear about the BitBucks? What are BitBucks?
You know how Lims are a recognised and tested form of digital bartering with a widely accepted value? Well the opposite of that.
Yeah agreed, death to the Corpsters.

Because, I already checked it and it's a completely garbled mess. Any chance I could have sold it, certainly wouldn't be giving it to you! Plus I gotta get to a crime scene where a man murdered his wife with her own cat. Should be a fun one.
Must have been. I don't know why they bother calling me out to these. Place was cleaner than a Corpsters alibi during a data breach.
Somebody hacked my phone and threatened me.
Yeah seems like your job is a waste of time.
You're sounding more like a Corpster every time I see you.
I was told this might be another Aseptic crime scene?
It's a little suspicious, you always turning up around the body-bags. Who did you say you're working for?

Whatever vigilante shit you’ve got going on, I hope you’re serious about catching this guy. I got into a lot of debt, trading BitBucks and I'm worried I'm going to be high on his list. Such a sick fucking MO. Targeting the poorest.
I... thank you. That's kind. Sorry I get a little carried away with the CorpSec hate...

Here's what CorpSec missed. Seems like some kind of weird data-log the guy had in his pocket. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub". Found it in the poor fucks jacket.
Look, I probably shouldn't have trusted you last time either. Just go back to running that noodle stand. Why get in over your head?
I don't really have a choice.

Here's what CorpSec missed. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub" Found it in the poor fucks jacket.

Whatever you say kid. Here's what CorpSec missed. Seems like some kind of weird data-log the guy had in his pocket. Label says 
"McFellow Transport Hub" Found it in the poor fucks jacket.
Well it sounds like you need to start doing some digging. Nothing more dangerous than a puppet master. Except for a serial killer maybe.

dialogues.title: Cale is enraged about the corps
lines: You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you?
Would probably feel different if you're one of them.
Nothing. That's the problem. We're resigned to this and it sucks. All of these things are just so definite. So final. We've lost the ability to try and adopt change.
Indeed it is. Only thing we can hope for is to find a little connection while we can.
Let me guess: you saw it too? Fucking ridiculous, right? Absolute total garbage.
Twenty three percent increase over the last year! Twenty-three-per-cent. Are you fucking kidding me?
Eh, not worth being angry about what you can't control.
Thanks, that actually sounds good. And it's super nice of you. It's why you'll never be one of them. You have a heart.
The corps! How are you not enraged by them?
I'd rather have CorpSec hold me over the vents while they pump out pure acid. Least then I wouldn't be saddled with this debt.
They just posted their required financial reports to see which CEO's can gloat at the annual shareholder's parade.
Why don't you come by the stand and have a meal? On the house, Cale.
I have no idea what you're talking about.
Yes! And all the while people are drowning, unable to feed themselves, and then we have trillionaires living in a completely different world!
I get it. I just don't know what we can do about it.
You mean more than I already am?

dialogues.title: Lynnphora find out more about Eugene
lines: Oh I'm sorry, I must have sounded very odd. Yes I remember he's dead. I just feel awful that my conundrum is now your conundrum.
Maybe you should scatter the ashes in the water?
It is a little silly really.
He used to love the water. Often if we were walking and saw water, he'd just run straight in. I didn't mind, but sometimes the smell was awful. Funny really.
Of course, so naive of me to think I might actually make a choice.
What? Oh, yeah, still carrying him around.
I've thought about it many times. Thing is, with him being mostly ash now, I don't know how the water thing sits with me. Will he float? It's hard to swim when you're ash.
I won't be losing sleep over it.
It's a really tough one isn't it. I just feel awful that my conundrum is now your conundrum.
Oh I'm sorry looks like you've run into me again!
Anything else you can tell me about what Eugene might have liked?
You've given me a lot to think about. I hope we get to meet again... I mean if that's ok? No worries if not.
Yep. You're right. Of course you are. I'm not sure if I'm being sentimental or just lazy.

dialogues.title: Speak to Nabla
lines: Can you falsify a hygiene inspector’s report? Mess up the quotas?
I have a job for a hacker...
What’s happening, babe? Got a job for Nabla?
It’ll take a few days, but then it’s bye bye Grimsey.
Call it 200 Lims. Nabla ain’t so sure about your rep. Babe.
Call it 100 Lims. Nabla likes you. Mates rates.
Then surely this job will be child's play...
No deal. I'll get rid of him another way.
I can’t do anything, babe. But Nabla can.
Nabla is fog. Nabla is the ghost of a haptic shiver. Nabla is a neon specter.
Lower the blower, will you? You want a hacker? You want Nabla. Best there is. What's the job?
Right. How much will Nabla want to make Mr Grimes go away?

dialogues.title: Crabface got your tongue
lines: You and every other slicker in the LUZ. Go on, sling your hook!
I didn't mean to be rude. That sounds awful.
You need more than that. You need practice. Right now the only thing you're likely to catch is a dermis eating parasite.
... it's Karel. Karel Jones. But no one calls me that anymore.
Nah. Wasn't a beauty before, and now at least I'm ... memorable. Brand recognition is what they call it up there.
I'll see what I can do.
I need a better fishing rod.
What do I look like, a charity case? There's only one thing that'll help me.
I need super strength rust remover. Just enough to let me shift my arms.
What's the matter, catfish got yer tongue?
I was thinking of doing some fishing...
Whatever. Do you know where I can get a better fishing rod?
Is there anything I can do to help?
Yeah well, didn't hold my breath underwater and I ain't going to now.
No respect for the sea, that's what that is.
First name terms now, is it? Look, I got chum but I sure as hell ain't yours.
Not as awful as being forced to yap to slickers like you.
You try being so rusted you can barely walk, let alone drive a boat.

dialogues.title: Only Eyes Has a new job
lines: He says he can no longer abide the crushing weight of reality. It is a wonderful opportunity for me.
Witty. I like it. I will pitch it to the station immediately.
Never better! The radio station you mentioned offered me a job. Apparently their previous announcer went insane.
Absolutely. Everyone loves a mucky secret.
Really? And what about when I mention meteorological events?
Yes, he is leaving the radio industry for existential reasons and recommended me to his old station!
Noted. The station has asked me to create a new show. Something that will "punch people's eardrums through the backs of their skulls".
This is Ivan Iker McGuire, coming to you live from Eastern Residential, the heart of all the action.
Well then, perhaps I won't. I will pitch this to the station immediately.
You think people would send compromising information for me to read on air?
Fascinating. What would I call such a project?
Sounds like you're doing good, Ivan!
I confess I am struggling with the concept. You are a meat-person with auditory abilities, tell me: what would brutalize your eardrums in an acceptable manner?
The station has asked me to create a new show. Something that will "punch people's eardrums through the backs of their skulls".
Yeah, stay away from CameoPOV if they approach you.
Crude, but compelling. I will pitch it to the station immediately.
Yes. The way you talk about atmospheric pressures does things to me.
Yes. I love it if radio is all about the facts, no nonsense!
I am well. The announcer you mentioned, Mr Reston, has been rather helpful.

dialogues.title: Pilk is devastated
lines: What? Just because I withheld his wages? I mean he had become so sloppy ...
That's devastating. It was such a masterpiece.
No way to get it back. It has been destroyed.
The salt water completely destroyed it. Only 30 meters of water resistancy.
It's in the Spire, far out of reach.
Maybe. But that won't be me!
But ... they will kill me! There must be a solution!
The killers thought the same, but no chance.
The watch fell into the sea.
Your cleaner had some grudge against you?
Not for 500,000. That watch is deadly.
So we can still retrieve it!
He wanted to sell it and got killed. And through that the watch fell into the harbor.
But they will kill me! You cannot do this to me!
I'm going to terminate your tenancy. I'm going to make you homeless! I'll start the eviction process today!
As far as I heard an act of revenge.
I don't recommend you make that the focus of the limited time you have left.
Someone has to go to the Spire and bring it back!
Find a way to vanish for a while.
... that cannot be! What did he do with it?
What? But... I must get it. They'll kill me if I don't.
Maybe they will find it some day.

dialogues.title: Garnet first meeting
lines: Hey, you're new here right? You're the new Thaddeus.
It's my daughter's... no. No, it's fine. I'll try to find him. Hey, good luck, with the new business. See you around.
I didn't mean that in a bad way. Thaddeus was a wonderful old bastard. I wonder where he went.
All I know is he's gone.

dialogues.title: Almost There
lines: Oh, okay. I just wanna get in there and play hide and seek with all new stuff.
What are you going to do if your parents come back?
Hey!!! That wasn't nice... It was fantastic! Bet you can't make it half as creepy as me.
How is it going? Is it done? All decked-out and spooky?
Because I gave them the best hiding spot. Now hurry up and finish my playhouse!
Awesome-sauce! Don't forget to make it extra creepy.
Getting to it. Had some other things to do first.

dialogues.title: Kenzy and Her Crew
lines: I don't have time to do that.
Well?!?! Did you talk to him? Is he in? Are we getting the band back together?
He said something about your reputation.

It's all about burning shit into peoples' brains. Ok? Not literally. Intention isn't to catch a DQ on leveling off someone. Let's do it right. Post these shimmer flyers around Nivalis, get the buzz going.
What are you going to do?
Who are the Club Rat Kids?
Pleassssseeeeeee. Have you ever heard of a fall from grace? Well I'm plummeting from the tippy top of the needle point sky scraper currently gutting the CLOUDS!
Sorry. Hope you land in the sea and not on plasteel!
Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa. What did Finn tell you?
Said he needs to think about it.
What do you want me to do about it?
Fine. What do you want me to do?
Reputation. All about it and you don't have it.
And it's yours, not mine, right?
What's there to think about?! We belong at the top and there's only one way to get back there.
What do you know of them?
I'ma work the airwaves. Drop little hints like beads of sweat on a dance floor. We'll meet back when we're both done and shimmy our way to every private room and VIP lounge.
What the ever-loving fuck man? Did you even defend me?

dialogues.title: Ask Elias about Hep
lines: She could link CorpSec to certain... high profile crimes. Cause them some embarrassment.
Loyalty, of course. And she was wise, too. Though there still are people who would like to get hold of her brain to see what's left.
Do you know how often I hear these words?
You're even giving me a location?
So there are people who would pay to know her location...?
Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?
I see. Well, CorpSec thanks you for your service.
What would these "dissidents" do to her?
Hmm. This is no game, Fuck off.
Then you better tell me where she is. To ensure her safety.
Think I'll keep that to myself.
Then you've met a hero. Agent Gimble was a CorpSec Erasure Technician. One of the best. Her record remains unbeaten to this day.
You asked. Perhaps you should tell me where she is, for her safety.
I'm not surprised. She's a hero to many. One of the best CorpSec Erasure Technicans in the bureau. Her record remains unbeaten to this day.
Agent Gimble gimbled her own mind out of existence when she retired. There's nothing left.
Dissidents. Trouble makers. People who want proof that CorpSec ordered certain... tragic fatalities.
Whatever it took to get the information.
But in this case it's true!
No, an Erasure Technician. You know, there is still a saying in Lowtown. "Gone to Gimble." It means something has vanished without a trace. That's how good she was.
You're asking too much. Now where did you hear that name?
Sometimes a little discreet killing is necessary.
She's just an old woman. She doesn't remember anything.
I assume so. Those of an... anarchist disposition. That old brigand Huckstash, for example. He would be the type.
I see. Well, you have your information. Don't forget that favor.

dialogues.title: Banor laughs at the messages
lines: I think I'll make 'em fresh when I see him with my own eyes.
Do you think he'll come back?
Haha! Yeah, that sounds like Thad alright. What a character.
No time for chat-chit. I have to talk to you about Thaddeus.
So what is he doing then?
Amusing himself? Goofing on you? Thaddeus is a joker, you know. Don't take it all too seriously.
Something important. Or nonsense. One of the two.
I just don't get the joke.
Believe he is travelling back and forth through time? Nah.
He said he is travelling backwards and forwards through time.
I feel like he is on to something.
Listen Boss, where he is, he's where he wants to be. Whether it's Luna, the Spire, another city, or.... I dunno, the beginning of creation, Thaddeus is being Thaddeus.
He said you should make him some noodles.
You know how it is. I'm trying to make the most of my time - find a nice lady. Sadly, the dancers at the Synth Ocean Club want a tall man. Life's short... but so am I.
Hey Boss. What can I do you for? You look like you got something on your mind.
For most of us here, It's hard to imagine that he even left.
Could I ask you about Thaddeus?

dialogues.title: Visit Rheno's Apartment
lines: We never asked for any of this!
Because your Automata got us into this mess.
Who are Curzona going to believe when we get debriefed on this? Me, or the one harboring a rogue AI that aided a serial murderer?
Why do I need to do all the work?
It seems empty. Go look around.

dialogues.title: Dagmar asks you to pick a side
lines: If you're ambitious, well... Something's gonna have to give.
I'll recommend you to some of my more... discerning clientele.
I'd like to see you try.
Excellent. Let's start easy. A little drop and run at a rival's joint. Leave this dead rodent somewhere a customer is sure to see it.
No such thing in this place. You're either a slug or a snake. Which are you?
Not fighting the competition as long as it's weak is idiocy.
For you? A bit of advice. In this business you're either a slug or a snake. No inbetweens. Which are you?
Because if you're a snake then maybe we can talk about the restaurant biz. If you're a slug, I'm gonna have to crush you under size eight heels.
Never know when a bit of sabotage might be necessary.
I think we can do business.
Like one of the other restaurants in the LUZ. I've run the numbers. It's you, or someone else. Anything else threatens my profit margin.
I knew it. Thought you had a bit of venom about you.
Neither. Or both. I don't care.
You gonna ooze around picking up a few Lims here and there? Or you gonna go out and snatch them? Simple question. Slug or snake?
Fearing the competition makes you a slug.
Well, it's your repossession notice. Don't say I didn't give you a chance.
Fact is this: Thaddeus was a slug. That noodle bar was never gonna be a threat to my empire.
Why are you asking me this?
I knew it. You got that good-for-nothing look about you.
You want me to take down one of the other businesses?
That's about the measure of it, yes.
Do you just... carry dead rats on you?

dialogues.title: Ava Conversation
lines: I know that Finlay had mentioned finding Zee near the mountains. And, while I know you're capable of making the decision I'd just like to point something out.
You are right, we should leave her alone.
If she is here, she's probably here to be alone. Maybe think about that before trying to find her.
I really care for Zee and I would like to know that she's ok.

dialogues.title: Caleb and the sea shanty
lines: Morse code. We're salty that way.
Well Mariner, your quest is at an end. Did you find the answers you were looking for on the high seas?
The end of The Gridless Sea. Beyond the reaches of Nivalis, beyond the electromagnetic waves and the hulking machinery of this ancient city, Salt Pete saw the edge.
No, it's worse than that. Nivalis sits atop a mighty plateau, artificial, filled with water and surrounded by a wall to keep the waves in.

Old Stormy was a sailor bold

A Grand Old Sailor from days of old

And a friend to the end when the sun grows cold

Old Stormy was a sailor bold...
How did you message them? Comms are down.
It seems hard to imagine the world we live in, and all our perceivable reality exists in a... "bath." But Salt Pete was convinced that was our reality - and that's not where his crazy ideas ended.
So can you tell me the truth about The Gridless Sea?

Of all old skippers she was best

But now she's dead and gone to rest

She battered the mast off the Nivalis Horn

Close by the place she was born
I can tell you what he saw, sure. Though he's wrong. He MUST be wrong... or CORA help us all.

Yes, a Sump. A mighty artificial pool, put there by who knows, and for what? Is there anything below? Why are we in it? Who put us here? Is it to protect us, or a prison? The possibilities are fascinating... but terrifying.
So Nivalis is surrounded by a wall?

An able skipper bold and true

A good old skipper to her crew

For a thousand years she sailed the seas

In winter gale and summer breeze

Me neither. I mean surely the people who travel to Luna would look back and see us? We have satellites too. But... who knows? Perhaps there are people in power who hide the truth from us. You can hardly look out the window when flying to Luna.

We dug her grave with silver spade

Her shroud of triple polymers made

We lowered her down with a titanium chain

Our eyes wet with more than rain
The edge of the Sump. A wall that stretched as far as you could see to East and West. A wall that surrounds all of Nivalis and the lands that surround the city.

Stormy's Gone, the good old bot

Way, Way Stormalong

Old Stormy is dead and gone

Way, hay, Captain Marquez
Old Salt Pete didn't tell you? I guess he has grown a bit wiser over the millennia.
He believed there was a plug, and he wanted to pull it out.
That's the ocean for ya. You'll find answers out there, but maybe not to the questions you asked. So... anything else, or you all done with me?
I know why you are here.
We did it! We reunited the pirate gang!
Ah. Well, maybe once more. For old times sake. For the Captain.
Crabface said to tell you "Stormy's Gone."
Salt Pete had a theory, and on that stormy night, just before we lost the Captain, he found evidence that his theory was correct. We didn't see it, but he is sure he did.
It's a song for the Captain. An old sea shanty. If you'd care to hear it, I can give it a go. The old pipes might struggle... But we can try.
We're talking again. Both Crabface and that old fucker Salt Pete have messaged me.

dialogues.title: Fire Sal
lines: You were always a pal. A true crouton. See you on the sunny side, kid.
Alas, poor Sal! Where shall he go? What shall he do?
I'm sure you'll do fine. Good luck.
You're welcome to keep the pay rise within acceptable limits for the team.
Ugh. Stab me in the heart with an olive fork while you're at it. What will I do? Where will I go?
TT's working like a charm. We never had so many diners. One of them tried to eat old Banor's britches. Ah, you shoulda seen it.
Thanks, but I'm afraid you gotta go.
You're firing me? ME? Sal Magundi II? Creator of the Ham Daiquiri? Winner of Quiche or Die? Your best friend?!
The Islands huh... restaurants full of gullible tourists... poshos with no taste and fat wallets... convenient beaches for a few quiet imports... sounds intriguing.
Crabsticks! Who's the snitch? I'll dose their morning latte with SnoutHowler, then we'll see who's laughing.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 7
lines:
My Dearest Huckleberry,

As I sit here, my heart aches with the memories of our rail-riding days. Time has aged me, tethering me to this place, while you continue your endless journey, searching for a way to forget what happened.
I'm not sure, but we should definitely not call him Huckleberry.

I often wonder where you are, what stories you've collected, and the new friendships you've made. Catching the last wind at the bottom of a train wagon is not how I want to leave this world. Until the tracks lead you here, we are destined to move in different directions. And maybe that's ok. 

Yours always,

Deandra.
I mean, we've come this far, patch it through.
Do you think Huckleberry will change his mind?
Again, this audio-log is un-encrypted. Would you like to hear it?

dialogues.title: Elaine Malloy's Algae
lines: If you're back to wave some more of your brutish snaps under my nose, do it quickly. I don't have the energy to be polite today.
Where have you been? I’m gasping. Well, hand it over.
As lacking in social skills as you are in talent, I see. Move along, you're blocking my view.
Extra hot or not, it's what you're getting.
I would never order anything so vile.
Here's your Scotch Bonnet Strawberry... thing.
Finally. I hope it's still extra hot?
Does it look like I'd drink something so vulgar?
Are you trying to be funny?
Good. Move along now, you're blocking my view.

dialogues.title: Ask Marius for the recipe
lines: I'll hear no more about it! I will personally deliver the recipe myself... No Marius, play it cool. Play it ice cold. I should send it with you. He'll respect that more.
I think he's worried about you taking his business and wants to know the secret ingredient.
You know that black residue that builds up on the exhaust of a Hova? That's HuffHuff, looks a little disgusting but you put it in a brisket and something magical happens.
Oh, he doesn't have to worry about that. I'll never be able to take customers from Aengus Prince!
I think he's worried. He really is willing to trade a lot for this recipe.
Sorry? Sorry? This is the greatest day of my life! The idea that Aengus Prince wants one of my recipes is the greatest honor!
Absolutely not! The only secret ingredient is HuffHuff.
What?! Really? He's interested in the slop I make? Why would that be?
For the love of god though make sure you get it when it's black. If it's blue it's bad for the gut. Black is good, blue is poo! Hurry, while he's still interested!
Sadly not. He was interested in your brisket Glaze actually.
I didn't think I'd see you again.
This could be really bad for your business.
(Lie) He just wanted to make sure he didn't step on your toes if he worked on his own version.

dialogues.title: Payback Immediately
lines: I've got it. Here you go.
Now here's a face I didn't think I'd be seeing again. Especially not in one piece. You got my money?
No one's happy about being in debt.
Now, where is my violin? You'll survive, sweetheart.
Well, it's been a pleasure doing business, sweetheart. Stop by again some time. Always nice to do deals with a pro.
See? Things don't have to get messy. You keep your word, I keep mine, Roger's your cousin, we're all happy. Right?

dialogues.title: Harmony Second Meeting
lines: If I'd wanted to be a faceless goods dispenser I'd have become a vending machine.
Do we really believe that? I think deep down people here know that Aseptic is just a symptom of a bigger problem.
It's impossible to prove I'm not.
That's exactly what an undercover CorpSec officer would say...
But the murderer has been caught.
It's not often I hear people with that opinion.
Do you talk to all your customers about this stuff?
Look I've already said too much. How do I know you're not undercover CorpSec?
It's been busy here, I think people stuck in the LUZ are trying to carry on as normal but you can see in their eyes they're scared.
I'll tell you, and anyone who might be listening to this: I've got all the proper permits. I'm allowed to be here and everything I sell is above-board. Take a look.
I just don't feel like LUZ is designed to keep us safe.
I'm sure it's fine. You can trust me.
Let's continue this sparkling conversation later.
Is public safety ever really a concern in Nivalis?
As soon as I saw you, I knew you'd be one of the good ones.
I probably shouldn't talk about this stuff here. You never know who's listening.
Well I'm sorry you see it like that, I like to think people come here because of the sparkling conversation!
I think so, but I think deep down people here know that Aseptic is just a symptom of a bigger problem.

dialogues.title: Speak to Nellie
lines: It should translate the ghost's code into something your Automata can parse. Here, take this copy. And if you see her again, come tell me, OK?
Neither could I. So I did some digging. It took the best part of six weeks in the archives of the Programmer’s Museum.
No! An ancient programming language called KorēChant. Only a few people remember that it exists.
The other historians think we're doing a spook hoax to get more subscriptions.
No, I think I saw a ghost in the sewers.
But I was able to smuggle a transcription codex from the museum just in case I ever saw her again.
Most of that was because I got lost between stacks and had to survive on rats and candy bars - but in the end I discovered something...
Holographic debris, a failed consciousness transfer… Wait. Did you SPEAK to her?
Ghost as in, "spirit of a dead person?" I don’t know. Maybe! She could be anything.
You have the look of a person searching for something. Like a snifferbot on a trail...
Oh, do you fall into euphoric trances while looking at old route maps too? It's OK, it's a common problem...
I'm looking for a historian called Nellie…
The Ghost, she’s speaking in CODE.
You think she’s really a ghost?
That’s me! Did you read my post on the Kronickler Forum or The Nivalis Nocturne about the restructuring of electrical outlets during the Curzonan Dynasty?
You're not afraid of ghosts, are you?
I read your post about a ghost in the sewers...
Of course! But I've never seen her again. I have a theory that she’s on some sort of loop, repeating the pattern of her own movements.
Did you go back to the Sewers?
You saw her too?! CORA this is so exciting… There’s only a handful of us who have ever physically encountered her.
I think she must be. Either that or there’s an underground society still programming in KorēChant. Which… would be just as wonderful actually.

dialogues.title: Spartacus's Way Out
lines: There's only one thing I want right now.
I got Lims riding on the OB4 bout. That’s what I told Doom and that’s what I’m telling you.
Will you tear up Spartacus's contract?
Heart's got nothing to do with it.
For the last time, no. Now, get out of my face.
If you're here to ask me to take him back, you can keep walking. He's the one who quit on this sport.
So you're just going to watch him get pulverized by Obliterata Four?
Sorry, I shouldn't have said that. There must be some way I can convince you.
Maybe I woulda said yes. But you threaten me with the 'Sec, you don't get to make offers. Get out of here, we're done.
No, I need to talk to you about Spartacus.
I can give you something you want.
A fighter who can actually fight.
Maybe because his heart's not in it.
There are noises coming out of your mouth that I don't like.
If I find you another fighter, you'll tear up Spartacus's contract?
There has to be a way to work this out. What do you want?

dialogues.title: Raluca - First Meeting
lines: Very little is down here, but I have enjoyed meeting you. It's been a long time since I last talked about this stuff, it feels good. I hope we meet again.
I have to say, it's been a very long time since anyone here asked me a personal question.
They sure do. I guess the LUZ has people a little distracted too.
He was actually a good man. not everyone in the Spire is heartless.
If I didn't, this city would have scrambled me a long time ago.
I'm an oxyphile actually so that's a pretty rough thing to say?
I guess us ‘street-levels’ will just have to make do with what we have.
So why don't you return? You must be rich!
If that were true, they'd have let you stay.
What? Oh, the mask? You kind of get used to it... Kind of.
Something I can help you with?
Do you think they'll ever fix the air down here?
Your dad should have paid his debts.
Why did you have to leave the Spire?
That's kind, but it's okay. Anyone who lives down here is dancing toe to toe with the darkness. Thankfully, I was born with two right feet.
I can tell you have some interesting answers. Would you like me to stop?
My parents were killed in a terrorist attack on a Vinc tube when I was eight. Dad had a few generations of hidden debt, bingo-bango. I’m stuck down here paying it off.
There have been a few half-baked attempts, but it's a complicated problem, so the Spire is still the only place with truly clean air.
Then maybe we should dance sometime?
Careful there, I might just take you up on that.
It's nice you see the best in people.
Oxyphiles have to keep these on at all times. I was born in the Spire, and my internals can't handle the polluted air down here. It’s either this or painful death.

dialogues.title: Finding Gan
lines: No, I'm taking your construct back to her.
I’ll ensure you have the cleanest floor in all Nivalis. Just please tell her I’m not here.
Look, please just tell her I’m not here. I can’t return to this nightmare.
You're the person I'm looking for.
I don’t know. She seems pretty angry.
Fine, I'll tell her you're not here.
NO! I mean, technically, I am, but I’m just a construct. Her actual husband is dead. I’m just left here to pick up the pieces… but she’s so mean.
Excuse me, are you... a person?
I feel incredibly betrayed, but do with me what you must, human.
Ok, I’m taking you to Ceres. I don’t have time for this…
I have a woman here claiming you might be her dead husband.
I cannot thank you enough. I had just started a very rewarding back-and-forth with the mop-bot that I'd love to explore further.

dialogues.title: How does it feel
lines: I was simply observing your shrewd business skills. Very calculated. Admirable, if such rational business calculations can be considered a virtue.
I can't save everyone. Harper will have to take her chances
You have gotten very good at suppressing human empathy to maintain your profits.

dialogues.title: Investigate memory loss
lines: Pffft, what kind? With all the shit floatin' around that degrades our brains, not to mention the biohacked grafts people buy. Ever see someone's brain cooked from bad wiring?
What do you need stitched up today?
Yeah, well, month before we got called to his place because he tried to have sex with a hair dryer. People don't learn from their mistakes my friend. Ever.
Then how would we learn from our mistakes?
Does sound good right about now.

Just give him a small dose. Two drops in a glass of whatever should do it. Anymore will probably kill him. Now if you don't mind I'd like some peace before someone else tries to end their addiction to breathing.
It's like reverse roasting a turkey. Ding. Ding. Dinner's ready.
HA! Learn from our mistakes. Man, two weeks ago I brought this guy in for inserting himself into a toaster.
That's what they all say. What specific symptoms does your friend have?
What exactly are you trying to forget?
Ah, fuck, alright. Look, you didn't get this from me okay?
Oh, I don't know. All of it?
Technically it's called CamBRT3 but we all call it the Camembert Cocktail. It's a dopamine balancer that counter acts delusions and disorganized thinking.
Nothing. I'm just asking for a friend.
Pffft. You ever eat so much of the stuff you're stomach begins to curdle and ferment it's own acid? Had that call once. Guy puked yellow-green for days.
Ever respond to someone having memory loss?
I met someone who can't remember who he is.
I wasn't really. Force 'a habit. If you got stuff wrong go to a med center. I'm more of the emergency response type, yeah?
What's wrong with you? Do you need medical assistance?
It looks like a bottle of poison.
Do you know anything about memory loss?
Well maybe consult a research interface?
Any idea on how I can jog this guys memory?
I mean some blunt force trauma to the head will take care of that. Though you do run the risk of dying from it so maybe not worth the gamble?
Wouldn't that be nice. Just wake up and forget some of the shitty choices we made? Course that means we'd lose the good ones too.

dialogues.title: Sal Gives Advice
lines: Question one: what is the key to a truly great seafood chowder?
What is the best dressing to accompany a Rat Meat salad?
Do you think this is some sort of joke?
Morals get you nowhere. Every kitchen in Nivalis uses it.
I think so too. Right, last question. All food should be cooked with...?
What do you take me for? Of course I do!
Aha! It was a trick question! There is no best dressing! Rat meat salad is for plebs!
So, where do we get some?
I used to have a man down by the Docks, until the... unfortunate incident with the trout. But I hear a dealer called Luminita might be able to get some.
What is the correct way to mix a souffle?
You want the secret or not?
That blue powder they sell behind Bigger Burger?
Where d'ya think budget cheese comes from?
You're not taking this seriously! And that blue powder is overrated.
So? One grain of TT and customers will be licking holes in the plates.
It should taste like PASSION. And LUST. And garlic.
Fine. Be mediocre. Kiss our chance at a Golden Serviette award goodbye. See if Sal cares.
Shut up. Question four. Should I keep this moustache, or grow a bread?
Crabsticks, no! The secret of the sauce would be wasted on a tasteless egg like you. Sal's outta here.
Everything is related. Right, last question. All food should be cooked with...?
There's only one way. With a sauce so secret, so powerful that only a few truly great chefs are entrusted with the recipe.
How is this related to cheffing?
One grain of TT and customers will be licking holes in the plates.
But I'm not ready for a quiz
Perhaps you are worthy of the secret of the sauce...
Alright. It is a special compound, developed by top Curzona scientists. Apixibalamin-Sumasulin-V. Street: the Tongue-Twister.
No no! Not so fast. You must EARN the secret of the sauce. There is a test that every chef must past to prove their worth.
The problem is that your food tastes like food.
Right. So how do we do that?
There you are. Listen, I'm doing my best with this place but it's like trying to milk rats.
Swear on my toque you won't tell another living soul?
Great chefs like you know how to make the sauce?
Well, that was an easy one.

dialogues.title: Report to Dotson
lines: No, no. If you do not carry the guiding star of truth within you, the I.M.P.U.N.E is useless.
It means you are wrong my friend! And that the recipe pilferer remains unknown!
This is terrible. You probed the suspects?
It was? But why did you not say?
DOTSON is currently processing. Your query has been logged.
Calamity! My logic array suggests a slim 8% probability of accuracy!
You did! Badly! Once again, it is up to Dotson to save the day. ALONE.
Is it? I would rather merge with the Nets than remain tethered to this wretched pit of scum and felony. Goodbye, cruel city. You have defeated Dotson.
Can I still have the I.M.P.U.N.E license thing?
If you have a logic array, then why send me to question them…?
If you have a logic array, then why send me to question them…?
Can I still have the license?
On the contrary! My suspicions about both Razlo and your own perfidious nature have been confirmed.
CORA’s tears! My logic array suggests an 87% probability of accuracy! The culprit is indubitably Razlo!
Yep. Gave them all a good probing.
I think I know who did it.
Cool. You didn't even need my work ...
DOTSON is currently processing. Your query has been logged.
So, can I have the license?
No, sorry. No idea who did it.
You return! Did you ferret out needles of truth from the haystack of mendacity?
And to think I almost failed! But this means my suspicions about Razlo were correct? I am not a hopeless sleuth?
DOTSON is currently processing. Your query has been logged.
Wait, you were right about Razlo. It was him.
If you wait but a moment I will run your conclusion through my logic array to calculate the likelihood of your deduction.
Your methods are unorthodox but effective. Here, may it guide you through this dark and grubby world.
No, no. Without the guiding star of truth, the I.M.P.U.N.E is useless. I will destroy it. Along with my dreams of a fair and just society.
DOTSON is currently processing. Your query has been logged.
If you wait but a moment I will run your conclusion through my logic array to calculate the likelihood of your deduction.

dialogues.title: Danny needs a new donut recipe
lines: There's a better way. Your glaze is too thick. Set the gelatin with a second, sugar glaze on top.
I'm trying to make the best donut in Nivalis. I front a lot. Tell people we already have the best. But I know that ain't true. We can do better. We WILL do better.
It will work. The dough will be drier but that will make for a fluffier donut consistency.
Listen, I gotta ask you something. I have a donut... situation. A donut problem.
Dammit. You're right. You're annoying... but you're right.
You want my advice on making donuts?
Hmm, maybe I should ask someone else. Dammit... Well, you want to know what my project is anyway?
What did you think of my blast chiller idea then?
I'm working on a... a project. But I can't get my gelatin to set on my macha mirror glaze and I can't afford more macha powder.
But then it will be too sweet... Although... It's already got the bitter macha, so if I add just a little lemon for sour... It might just work!
Cute! You're gonna hear me out though, right?
It won't work. The gluten will be affected by the cold. You're gonna ruin the texture.
Ah, you must be busy. Catch you later I guess.
Any tips to save this batch? You know your food. If I stick it in the blast chiller, will the donut batter dry out?

dialogues.title: Second chat with Dal
lines: Look I'll be faster when I level up my cleaning game. Learn a few hacks, stuff like that. Just give me a chance here.
Ah screw you man! I'm out!
You're not the only cleaner in town.
Appreciate it. And look, I'll be faster when I level up my cleaning game. Learn a few hacks, few new techniques. Just need a bit more time.
Yeah well, folk are dropping trash faster than CEOs burning files on audit day. I can't keep up.
I don't employ slackers. You're fired.
Place doesn't look too clean, Dal.
It's great this place is getting popular but folk are dropping trash faster than CEOs burning files on audit day.

dialogues.title: Calypso Island
lines: Well this is Calypso Island, one of those rare places just outside the city where the sun always shines. Not the real sun obviously.

dialogues.title: Alan Fontus Second Meeting
