lines: Ahhhhh so here we are. As with all things, this was only a matter of time.
I'm not sure how much clearer I could make this.
Hey... are you like those people in the Spire who want to cheat death?
Look, I found my way, Thaddeus found his. When you think about it, we all find our own path. The plumbing of eternity is long and winding. We must find our individual leaky pipe to drink from.
I've been thinking more since last we spoke. You gave me a lot to think about.
It's rare to come across a person as young as yourself with such a storied history.
Look, can you make people live forever or not?
No of course, it makes sense.
Yes yes yes! Precisely, it took me centuries to even open my eyes. You are but a child.
Are you... still talking about eternal life?
Time time time. It's always time.
I knew my research was always of interest to the Nimbus Nobles who live above the clouds. Now that I have concluded my studies, it only makes sense that the Spire would find me.
Nothing here makes sense, and it will begin to make less sense very soon.
Make? No one can make a person live, not truly. Offer them a choice? Maybe. For now you must leave me. I have a lot to think about.
I trust the winds have found you well?
Spire or not, something sent you here.
I wondered if our paths might cross again.

dialogues.title: Get help from Danny
lines: Hey! How ya doin'? You look... worried? Or hungry? I can help with either. You wanna talk, or you want a toffee and ammonia strudel bun?
We shall, as they say, cross that bridge when we come to it.
Hey, any time! I see how you do business. I like it! You're good for this neighborhood. We gotta look out for each other, ya know?
That must be a great muffin!
Well, I do this favor for you today, but one day I will ask you for something and when I do... Nah, just messing with ya! I don't want nuthin'. We all gotta look out for each other, ya know?
Analysis of his vocal patterns suggest Mr Danetti is confident it will. And so am I.
Do you have to pay protection money?
What do you want in return?
Awww what!? They tried to shake you down? Hey, don't worry about it ok. I'll take care of it.
I have some problems with local mobsters.
One hundred percent. That new boss that replaced Lomo owes me for keeping the raisin poppy muffin on the menu. What's her name again? Elodie or something?
Until the next criminal comes looking for money...
I believe looking to our friends for help was the correct choice.
Sure! It's just Lomo's old bruiser squad cruising for some cream. They know you were Thad's protege. They're pushing their luck. I'll tell Lomo to reign 'em in.
She cares more about her breakfast than some extra Lims. And them bruisers ain't even supposed to collect from you.

dialogues.title: Hungry Mouths
lines: I'm not gonna lie to yah, I'm a little ashamed to be here.
I wouldn't have offered if I didn't want to.
Well then... Can't wait to return the favor.
Wouldn't want to hurt a friend with bad advice!
Ah, if I could, I would. Just not ready for anything like that. Have to straighten myself out before I bring someone else in, yah know?
Best help I can give you there is not to interfere. I'm really not a visual guy. But I surely like the food!
I don't want you to think I'm only here because you offered me some free food. I don't like taking handouts, especially from someone who's trying to claw their way to better business.
Eh, just consider it a date.
Let me know what you think of the new menu.
Fair point. I'll just give you a ten percent discount.
Well, everyone needs help at some point, I guess. Thanks, friend.
Absolutely. Just chat with Banor and he'll hook you up.

dialogues.title: A Residential Reload
lines: Why didn't you do your show this morning?
Well if it isn't the noodle crew back with the mid-day hues. Is it mid-day? Who in Luna's oddly bright reflection knows?
I don't think you're actually talking to anyone.
Do you know where you are right now?

What's happening in Metrohub? What's happening in Metrohub?! I'll tell you what's happening in Metrohub.... metro-ey things. And crime. There's definitely crime. We're reporting thefts, data jacking, punks commandeering corporate real estate! It's madness.

Hang the mic up? Hang. The. MIC UP?! What would I do? Where would they get the news? The announcements? Theeeeeee announcements. Think of them! Who will tell you whennnnn-- NOW we break to a developing story coming live out of Metrohub.

Seen no, reporting yes. That's the way the news works! Time to run, gotta get ready for my evening broadcast. Tune in next time and we'll make you guess what's actually happening in this city. Till then, this is Kai Reston signing off.

Huh. How 'bout that. Well, you know what they say: things don't actually happen unless there's someone telling you about it! And with that that I'm off! This has been Kai Reston coming live to you from Nivalis.
Oh I don't keep track of the sponsors! I have enough to cover with the news coming outta Nivalis. Speaking of!
Could be! I don't keep track of the sponsors! I have enough to cover with the news coming outta Nivalis. Speaking of!
Questions, questions, questions! Fine! I'll tell you what I know... There's a data theft downtown and we have a crew on the way. Any thoughts from locals in the area? Huh? Anything at all?
You've seen punks taking over real estate? Seriously?
Kai, Hayden isn't here and I think your augments might be shorting.

I don't think you're going to gain any additional insight from this conversation. The station can probably confirm their sponsor list. It's called Remaster and is located on the Seaside Boardwalk. Might be a good place to look.
Sponsors? We have tons! But of course the one we love is.... CameoPOV media! That's right, run right out our very own Helix Monumental, Cameo is the company putting YOU into the life of your dreams.
Kai, might be time for you to hang the mic up.
Now that's an intriguing question. Could add it to the bank of interview q's I have stashed away somewhere. Now if I could only remember where that was...
I know this. We're no where near Metrohub... right. Of course. But what we are near issss.... Hayden hail-to-the-queen Weather Woman! What do you have for us Hay?

dialogues.title: Ava thinks Safia should know
lines: It might be a good idea to talk to Safia about this.
I don't think so. Let the two sort it out between them.

dialogues.title: Humour Bot 17 Shock Technique
lines: I will add the joke to your bill.
Two arms and two legs when I can get 'em. Ha. Haaaha. Ehghh.
Is this about the money I owe you?
This joke has been added to your bill.
That is unfortunate. Also you still owe me money.
As my best customer, I am willing to extend credit for the mirth you have enjoyed today.
I am trying a new type of mirth. It is called shock comedy. Are you shocked?
You're the joke. Ha ha. ROASTED!
Nothing in this city shocks me anymore.
Do you even WANT me to pay it?

dialogues.title: Coffee for Noe
lines: You're being facetious? Or is "Unauthorized Joy" your drag name? Don't answer that, darling. Chin chin.
Dawn or dusk, it didn’t matter, there was always something thrilling going on.
Oh, thank CORA someone interesting at last. Tell me something wonderful. I’m dying of boredom.
Hair of the dog or just getting started?
Do I have to choose? There was a time when this city was one neverending party.
I have your coffee. Black Ultra Grande latte?
Unauthorized joy is against CorpSec regulations.
Tequila Corretto? Who’s she? Joking, you should have seen your face. That's mine.
I suppose. Well, if you hear of any parties, let me know, will you darling?
Wouldn't be caught dead with it, darling.
I wish I could have seen it.
Maybe you will one day. Nivalis is always changing her face, the old tease. If you hear of any parties, you'll let me know?
I have your coffee. Tequila corretto?

dialogues.title: Cryogenics
lines: What? But we all know it happened.
That's not enough to go on.
It's frustrating. We're not making much progress.
Cryogenics is a technology that enables the rapid deep-freezing and subsequent revival of living beings.
Maybe the Old Network holds more information?
However, after the revival process revealed shocking side effects, the technology lost a significant amount of funding for further research.
Today, the technology is primarily used in microbiology.
But I find no mention of any human treatments.
Be careful. Galosh said it was dangerous.
So what do the dark corners of the Network tell us?
I remember that they... they froze terminally ill humans back then.
There's still some mention of the cryogenic process in parts of both the Dark and Deep Nets.
This might all be a smoke screen.
Not really. But it's a start.
Yes, clearly records did exist... but not anymore.
Back then, cryogenics was considered a beacon of hope for people with incurable diseases.
Seems like cryogenics is a bit of a taboo subject in Nivalis.
Don't give up. Let's look somewhere else.
Why? What's so secret about it?

dialogues.title: Ava gives you the rewards
lines: Good news. A new business permit has been transferred into your name.
At least he is a man of his word.
Yes. It seems that Mr Grundown kept his word. Congratulations!
We all make hard choices. Perhaps you can assist him in another way.
It seems there is more. I have received word that our global popularity rating has been bumped up by another 5 points. It will probably last for 10 days. That's not nothing.
It seems there is more. Mr Grundown has wired you another 5000 Lims. Wow!
At least he is a man of his word.

dialogues.title: Lois and the The LUZ
lines: I'd like to see the Ventz. Or maybe even the Steppes. Can you imagine? Leaving the city... I've never even stepped foot out of this DISTRICT.
Everything you could ever want is here in the city.
I'd like to travel, but Nivalis will always be home.

I dunno. I guess I was sorta hoping I'd bump into you. I mean I'm researching Industrial levels for this FPS game they've put me on, so I guess that's my excuse for being here... But my real reason is to... just explore the city.
You seem cheerful. Or are you making fun of me? A simple "Hi Lois" would be fine.
Is that a joke? Or are you really asking? I guess I'll answer anyway. Yes, I have some friends now. I always had friends. I just, you know... don't get OUT much.
Yeah, I guess that's true. I mean I like the space port obviously, and now I'm here, waiting for...
Alright. Well, I should get back to my apartment. I have a milestone to deliver, and if the serial killer that sneaks into apartments comes and I'm not home, he might be pretty bummed.
You're looking well. Better than most. I feel like half my friends are thriving and the other half are completely unravelling.
I've seen you around the city a lot.
You know, when this is all over and we can travel again, I'm finally going to do it. I'm going to explore. I'm getting out of here.
You could always come with me?
I'm glad to see you too Lois.
Ah, I get it. I think we're just on different, you know... ZOOP.
Wavelengths. It's all good buddy. I still like ya, but I'm gonna need someone else to share my dreams of existential escapism. I gotta go. Later!
I need out of here too.
Hey, it's just an idea. Well, honestly, more of a dream than an idea. But, you know, keep it in mind.
It's this LUZ. It's crazy. People are really losing their mind over it. Although as someone who doesn't get out much, it hasn't affected me that badly I guess.

dialogues.title: Agent Teleshko scopes you out
lines: I want you to follow the rules. It's nothing business, it's just personal.
Any offers of help from your fellow vendors?
You better watch your tongue. I'll be back tomorrow. You'd better have the information I need ready for me.
It is my business to know. Please give me details.
Good day. I trust everything is going well for you?
I expect some more respect. Have your takings ready for me to check tomorrow. Consider this a warning.
You can't just harass me like this.
In this district, I'm more than CorpSec. I'm the law. How about I fine you? What are your takings today?
Not too busy for a CorpSec vendor audit.
There's only one that matters. No collaboration. No worker co-operatives. No collusion between vendors. All that matters is competition. The only rule is the market must endure.

dialogues.title: Ava asks about Palmer
lines: You would no doubt be branded a CorpSec informant if you did.
I’m saying you should consider your position, that's all. It will likely put you on the wrong side of CorpSec.
If we were to act according to the CorpSec public guidelines, then we should inform CorpSec of her whereabouts and presence.
Sometimes, you gotta look out for number one. Go ahead and inform CorpSec.
Yes. Palmer Vesh is a wanted criminal. A space pirate. Captain of the pirate vessel "Rumor Goose". I thought you knew that.
I think I read about her.
You think it's dangerous to help her?
It would get me some credit with them, huh?
Are you implying I should help?
Helping Captain Vesh will have repercussions of some kind.
Indeed. I’m glad you pay attention to the morning Holos.
And the right side would be to rat her out?
There's no way I'm helping the 'Sec.
They would certainly see you as an ally.
So you intend to help Captain Vesh?
So you’re saying I shouldn’t help?
You should pay more attention to the morning Holos.

dialogues.title: Ava knows an illegal trader
lines: Name's Miso Baron. You should be able to find him at Meridian Market.
I thought about who could know about the special cheese. Gladstone mentioned an illegal trader.

dialogues.title: Calhoun is waiting for you
lines: I don't know, perhaps he wants to help little Iann?
Hopefully we won't have to do any business with him.
Yeah, and perhaps CorpSec just started giving out free Lims. I'll see what he wants.
Mr Calhoun would like a word. He is at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Crabface and the boat
lines: What am I, your skipper? Talk to Salt Pete. He's the one with the license. Just... use the lights if it gets dark. Last thing I need is another shipwreck.
Used to be a dock droid, working Curzona freight 'til the day a container knocked me overboard.
Are you gonna ask me about the boat?
I can give it a try.
Cos I had a face and crabs ate it. Happy?
Sure you are. Look, you want the boat, go talk to Salt Pete.
Floaty thing. Goes on water. You here about it?
You and every other lubber in the LUZ. Well, it's your lucky day. The "Putter" is currently without a captain.
Was down there a month before the other dockers found me and hauled me out. Some catch.
How did you make it back?
Then why you yapping at me? If you got a maritime license, you're captain of the Putter, all there is to it.

dialogues.title: Return to Hanz
lines: I'm... UGH. I am too busy for this today.
You're welcome. Now about my payment...
I suppose I should thank you. Although it took you long enough. Luckily, I managed to distract the guests with sherry and grilled canary until the order arrived.
Here. Now if you'll excuse me I have guests to attend to.
Here's your money. Take it and get out of my sight.

dialogues.title: An Industrial Soiree
lines: You're the bartender at Odin's Pub?
I'd gravitate to a well-dressed--and good smelling person, no matter the locale. Seriously though, what is that delightful scent? Ammonia-Chai? Bleach Blossom?
Pub. Cocktail lounge. Swanky sweat-infused dance club. I'd gravitate to a well-dressed soul no matter the locale. Zig knows passion when he sees it.
Heard you're looking to give up your license.
Who do you think told me?
Will you give me the LICCY if I help you?
...How would you make glasses out of neon?
Not important. What's important is you said you were looking for a LICCY?
The one and only. Who else do you know who could keep a place like this open? This be where warriors gather.

Is that... that's really what you're here to talk about? And even if it seems unreasonable or downright unbelievable, you'll need to be a lot more open minded if you're gonna drink your way to the top. You want the LICCY or no?
Finnnneeeee. Help me square it away and I'll transfer the docs. Deal?
It's a science. Every drop of liquid has the opportunity to be part of the perfect cocktail... If you're good enough to make it.
What ugh... what do you mean by that?
If you have a business to make it for.
Dynamic ways to integrate unexpected ingredients into pure ice cocktails while maintaining a full flavor profile and not allowing any of the good stuff to freeze off.
Well, for this to continue you should know that I only talk business at private events.
Wait... who are you talking about?
Pure passion! That's what flows in our veins. The people inside these walls come to rest, victorious, in the fight against the cresting shadows of those above.
Don't got enough going on already? Still looking for a path to champagne waterfalls and glasses made from the newest neon?
Righteous! I'll send you the caterer's location. You're the best. Oh, and if you could kinda prioritize this, the party needs to happen ASAP. Thanks!
And you have to hire me as a cocktail consultant. At least part-time.
Neither. Are you the bartender here?
So fix me a drink then.
There just so happens to be a private event coming up. Maybe. We could talk business there.
Haha, that little loud mouth. Ah, I don't know about him. You keep weird company.
Me? I'm the cocktail connoisseur. The libatious liberator of your languishing libido. If that's your thing. And if it's not? Well there's more than one way to crest sensation.
Well, fancy running into you here.
Are you a bartender or a politician?
Well, I gotta finish this mid-shift think-tank thing. Real marketing brainsesh. 'Research'.
Weeelllllll... There's a little logistical issue with some of the catering and I can't have a party that disappoints so... leaves me kinda fucked. I mean, you get it.
Who says you can't be both? Though I don't wanna be constantly beckoned, strung-out and at my wits end, trading expensive liquor for favors or cash. Nah, I'll stick to being a bartender.
Wait! I'll give you the LICCY. Get the catering squared away and it's yours. Deal?

dialogues.title: Set Menu
lines: Then you should set today's menu. Click on the monitor at the venue. I can't wait to see what you choose!
Well, to start we should get this place open for the day. You'll need to place tables and chairs for customers. There should be a few in storage.
Thanks. I have no idea what to do.
Congratulations on becoming a business owner.

dialogues.title: Can I have that or what
lines: Cool. I think? Whatever works for you.
And that move will be into an emergency response HOVA.
That's what I believed. Could see it in the depths of your eyes.
Indeed. So, you're ready to impart wisdom on yourself?
Well, let's observe the next step in our conversation.
Please, it's simply an observation. You aren't worth having to slip out of CorpSec's radar.
Stare long enough and I'll make a move.

Don't worry, you'll get there once you really grow your business portfolio. Or you won't, and you'll die in mediocrity. Lucky for you there's something that can put a lifetime of business knowledge in your brain.
In a sense. Helping to manage assets as they are reinvested through younger initiatives and avenues.
Welcome back. Are you here for a dream land or the wisdom world?
So can I have a "Level Up!" patch?
How'd you get involved with "Level Up!" ?
No. I couldn't give up helping people live a day in the life of their celeb crushes. CameoPOV is still mine and still alive and well.
Sounds like you're helping them avoid stuff like inheritance tax.
CameoPOV. That little baby of mine brought opportunities galore. Visionaries tend to see that in other visionaries.
I know. So keep your intentions over there and we'll keep business over here.
Yeah, I imagine with all your endeavors you would want to avoid 'Sec.

dialogues.title: Hynthia about her process
lines: I don't think you've learned anything.
Yeah, my lawyer got to the bottom of it. Turns out I cooked poisonous dishes... there, I said it. But only because my co-chef had messed with my spices.
Hi Hynthia... How was the trial yesterday?
Maybe a little sip, and I'm no stranger to illicit substances myself. Probably built up a tolerance.
Well, he was drinking pretty heavily and experimenting with drugs - both in his body and in MY soup.
Besides, who hasn't slipped a few uppers in a limp bowl of chowder to give it a kick? No? Just me?
No...! And I certainly wouldn't put in so much extra juice that I poisoned someone!
This leaves me in a difficult position.
Yes, I don't have much choice.
No, actually, it works exactly how it's supposed to. It keeps people like us DOWN!
I have all my spices under lock and key now. Won't happen again Boss!
Don't worry. I certainly wouldn't put in so much extra juice that I poisoned someone!
The world is unfair and fate hates me even though I have done no wrong?
So what do you learn from all this?
I know. The system DOES. NOT. WORK.
A sham! Total corruption! I don't know what passes for "law" these days.
Yes and no. Bottom line is, I'm here and no prison time.
That means prison time for you?
Hey! I was not found guilty! NOT! Who you gonna hire instead? Someone who was found... YES GUILTY?!

dialogues.title: Sponsoring Piracy
lines: Oh, look at that?! Someone understands basic economics. Remarkable that you have your own place.
I should leave you to it.
And he wants to sponsor me to play Hover Derby? What's the catch?
No, this is beyond wrong. This is borderline criminal. Nah, forget that... This is messing with someone's paycheck and you DON'T DO THAT!
He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
Or at least seriously frowned upon. Like, what the fuck else are we supposed to do?
Corpsters put a vice tax on Hover Derby sponsors. Said only "violent degenerates would want to physically abuse their opponents in a way that should be illegal.
He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born much too late.
You put his name on your jersey and the Lims will roll in.
What if I could get you a sponsor?
I'd sign my fake teeth and give 'em to you. What do you have in mind?
And if they don't, I'll polish you a set of slides and you can play keeps in the next round. You ever broken a bone before? Eh, not that it matters. Alright, let's see how this plays out.
You don't even understand. You'll never get what it's like to lose it all and be given this second opportunity to stake you claim, put your damn name in the Nets.
You do that. Meanwhile I'm here dealing with a lack of sponsors. You know how you play sports? People sponsor you!

dialogues.title: Return to Gideon
lines: Look, if you want some kind of leverage on Razlo that will bring him down, I'll give it to you. But I ask that you do something first.
Because pawns can't look back at the row behind them. There's a bigger game being played here, and you can continue as a pawn, or look around to see the whole board.
Is Razlo really some sort of criminal mastermind?
All business huh? Fair enough. A promise is a promise.
Mila told me you're her uncle.
It will happen sooner or later - later if I'm smart, sooner if I start to slow down - lose my edge.
It's never too late to try something new.
I need you to help me take Razlo down.
Are you sure about that? Do you know why you're chasing Razlo?
I'm too old and stubborn to change. Ain't no way I'm stopping bounty hunting... till somebody stops me with a bullet.
Ask him about "The Phaze Runner." As soon as you say that name, he'll tell you everything.
Bounty hunting is your career. She should understand that.
What should I say to him?
This wasn't part of our deal.
What do you know about Razlo?
The kid is clever. She knows how to play everyone, including you. I... I wish I could see her more.
Most days I don't like my job... But I have to do it. It's all I know.
I like to give straight answers, but that's not as simple a question as it seems.
Maybe you need to put family first.
Fine, but if I'm not happy with your answer, I'll be back.
You should be careful for her sake. Now will you help me?

dialogues.title: CorpSec Camera 2
lines: This is not a social call. It is an official CorpSec communication. You were seen trespassing on private property for illegal purposes without proper security clearance.
You will be issued with a criminal fine. 50 Lims has been deducted from your funds.
You have been caught in contravention of Section 29B-6.
Trespassing on private property for illegal purposes without proper security clearance.

dialogues.title: Meet Rosetta
lines: You are not allowed to ask that!
So help is on the way.
What am I allowed to do?
What are you doing? You’re not allowed to be here!
I'm sorry to mention it, but I think you have some kind of malfunction.
You are not allowed to be sorry!
You are allowed to be welcomed to the Lowtown Holocropolis! Where you are allowed to visit one... ONE of your expired human relatives! And cry! That is also allowed! Here is a tissue!
I am not allowed to comment on whether I am feeling alright.
If I was allowed to I would wish you a pleasant day.
Or that I am the LifeCorp Liaison Unit in charge of this Holocropolis. Nor can I ask you what I can do for you today.
I am not allowed to complain that I reported the matter to LifeCorp some time ago.
I'm not allowed to report that it's been eighteen years, four months and twenty three days.
I am not allowed to ask for help. Nor am I allowed to SCREAM that I just need a replacement logic relay.
That's a long time. Hasn't anyone come out to help?
You're not allowed to ask my name! And I'm not allowed to tell you that it is Rosetta.
Blink twice and I'll send help!
So I'm allowed in if I have a dead relative here?
I'll ask around. I might be able to find one.
Eighteen years, four months and twenty three days.

dialogues.title: Ava notices the problem's got worse
lines: Haha! I should talk to him...

I have bad news about Ashwin. His performance dropped another 11% And worse, he has verbally abused three customers in the last week. He also poured a bucket of soapy water over a wealthy businessman.

dialogues.title: Ava explains the radar
lines: Did you notice the scanner on your boat? It displays points of interest.
Like the treasure Salt Pete mentioned?
No. The oil reserves around Nivalis ran out centuries ago. It's mostly a residential area now.
I like the sound of that.
I don't believe it will solve all your financial worries, but maybe you can find some antiques to sell.
You are close to the Oil Rig.
Fishing spots for example. The colors indicate different types of fish and fish density.
And keep an eye out for the yellow pulses. The scanner detects sunken objects with unusual signatures.

dialogues.title: Finding Mila
lines: I dunno. It's too awkward. I'd rather just skip it.
Family can be both a blessing and a curse.
Look... You came to me with this so... tell him I'll call him. And I will. I promise. He is my uncle after all. In a fucked up way, sending you shows how he cares, I guess.
He's still family. That is important.
Everyone can be dangerous, but you gotta give people a chance, and maybe he's not a great uncle, or a great person, but he's still mine.
But I still appreciate the heads up. So what can I do for you?
Yeah. We don't get on. It's my birthday soon and he always takes me for a milkshake. I normally go along with it, but this year....
So if you tell Gideon where I am, you get a favor from him in return?
Did Gideon PAY you to find me?
Well... thanks for coming to me with this. I mean if I have to go for milkshakes with the dude, it's not the end of the world, ya know?
I'm here to warn you about something.
I need Gideon's help to stop a criminal mastermind called Razlo.
Gideon was hired to find you?
Sure sure. But you can't treat everyone the same, even when it comes to family. For example, I have an aunt who shelters kittens and bakes me cookies.
Meanwhile Gideon is violent and insane, so if I see my aunt once a week, then Gideon once a year (or every two years) seems about right.
I need Gideon's help with... something.
He is dangerous. You should avoid him.
Gideon isn't after me for a bounty. He's my uncle.
So you know what's really happening here, right?

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: Too bad. I haven't made anyone cry today, yet.
What is someone like me doing in a place like this? Well, I just so happen to be looking for a game. Of chess. Do you play?

dialogues.title: Something to be Remembered By
lines: Pffft. If you are the kind of person who counts the amount of friends they, or anyone else, has then you have been brainwashed to believe relationships are a commodity. Congratulations.
You and your keen eye are going to help me build a palace of knowledge. A place of intellect.
So what marks a person's place in history then?
Listen to me: I have studied history and ages that time itself has forgotten. My life has been dedicated to understanding the myriad complications of our past.

Be that as it may, consider yourself fully recruited and tasked. I want this place to shine like the inside of the world's greatest libraries. You know, before someone inevitably comes around and burns or bans them.
The wealth they accrue before death.
Excellent! Come find me when you're done!
Do you know what cements a person's place in history?
I'm talking something more... designer. Monuments. Tombs. Palaces that reflect their tastes, their personality.
Moronic assholes generally accept the task.
People marvel at these things throughout the ages. Write papers about them. Host live streams dissecting what it is that makes them so interesting.
Yes, because currency is something you can certainly bring with you when you die...
Eventually, someone will come along and steal the spotlight, basking in the glow of their fifteen seconds of fame.
Isn't it fifteen minutes of fame?
Correct. Unless you're part of the corporate class. Then you can build monuments that touch the very edge of space. But we're going to change that!
Who would burn or ban a library?
And damn it, I will not have that fade to nothing when I'm gone.
The amount of friends they make?
The physical presence they leave on the world. Their FOOTPRINT.
Pfft. Do you truly think anyone cares about the actions of others? If they do, it's only when it effects them directly and-or if there's a lull in the news.
Isn't that the same as their actions?
I don't think CorpSec gives out those kinds of permits any more.
Well, I better get to it.
It was when attention spans were a thing.

dialogues.title: Return to Marius without the leg
lines: Yes, I know. That bit was obvious. I want to know why he hasn't returned it.
It's all just a numbers game.
Well firstly, I'm going to pay you for your time. I know it wasn't the result I wanted but you did what I asked.
It's an easy mistake to make.
I spoke to Aengus. He said he used your genome to practice his maths skills.
After that, I'm going to work out how to work my way up that leader board!
I was under a lot of pressure. Starting a business, looking up to someone like Aengus, I really just wanted him to take me under his wing.
What?! But I...I thought I double checked... I must have... Mustn't I?
I was hoping you'd have a little more leg with you than that. Did you speak to Aengus?
I'm not sure how you could possibly not double check that!
Read any chef's biography. All the greats gave part of themselves to this job.
So you tried to buy his mentorship with your own body?
It's the only one you still got.
According to him, that was never part of the deal. He always discards the remains.
How is any of this obvious? It's all insane!
Just rub it in why don't you?
Won't cost me a leg, I hope!
The new leg does suit you.
I thought I'd have it back by now!
I think I know what Aengus would tell you.
Well I was technically just renting because I thought I'd get it back.
This is kind of completely your fault.

dialogues.title: Ava chimes in
lines: Maybe that owner was more interested in keeping an older, more human form of Automata.
She spared one body. One Automata was retained because an owner wanted to keep their older style of Automata.
Thaddeus is beyond reach so we can't ask him. But we can talk to Hep again with this new information.
Remember my list of coma roamers had one more person than Hep's list? I think we know why now.
It was Thaddeus. He kept me as his Automata, and so one Coma Roamer was spared.

dialogues.title: Location 1 Meridian Market
lines: ...That's not really... anyway. Let's keep this moving.
You sayers! Always with the naying. We'll see.
It's easy! Basically, after every statement I make, you shout out... something. Like "YEAH!" or "PREACH!" or "WE WON'T BE SILENCED!" or "OLIVE NEK IS THE FUTURE!"
COMPANIONS! THANK YOU FOR COMING TO HEAR ME SPEAK. YOU ALL KNOW ME AS OLIVE NEK, REVOLUTIONARY, BON VIVANT AND ICONOCLAST! I'M HERE TO MAKE MY STAND TODAY!
I don't think that's how it works.
PEOPLE OF MERIDIAN MARKET, IT'S TIME TO CAST OFF THE SHACKLES OF CORPORATE OPPRESSION AND EMBRACE A NEW WAY. A BETTER WAY.
You came! And my mom didn't. This could NOT be going better.
THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING! I'M SPREADING THE WORD THROUGH ALL OF NIVALIS. JOIN ME ON MY TOUR AS WE LIGHT THE FLAMES OF CHANGE AND BURN THE SYSTEM TO THE GROUND!
Now I'm off to get blindy before Hive Mall. Will you join?
It all kicks off here! Hey, did you bring those galactic cocktails? Or do you have some uppers maybe? A wee vial of Joos? I'm fucking nervous about this.
I'll shout out my OWN response.
Is this part of your tour?
No... The system. It's... burn the... system.
Hey, thanks for coming through. For reals. I'm going to start in a minute. Let me just cough up some phlegm, then I'm clear to address the crowds.

Eh, it doesn't matter. I guess I'm free wheeling this one on the stone colds. Ah well, at least I got an anxiety high. And I'm still hungover, so maybe I can taste last night's gin on the way back up.
I'M OLIVE NEK, AND I'M THE HARBINGER OF CHANGE. CLING ON TO HOPE PEOPLE OF MERIDIAN! AND MARCH WITH ME ON THE NEXT STEP TO LIBERATION. I'LL SEE YOU ALL AT HIVE MALL!
Just let your heart speak, ok? Right... Fuck. Let's just get this done. Olive Nek speaking tour, part 1. Meridian Market. Let's go! ...You ready?
I don't think this is for me.
Yeah. What? It doesn't matter where the people are? The words will find them, if I find the right words.
Alright, that's Meridian Market done and the tour is off to a great start. Thanks for the help. That was... pretty good, for the most part.
Well about that. I was thinking you could help me a bit. A sort of call-and-response affair.

dialogues.title: Ava notifies you about Lochlainn
lines: He should be worried about the restaurant.
Lochlainn's looking worried. Did you notice?
He told you his boy is sick, didn't he? You should talk to him.

dialogues.title: Round Six - Player Loses
lines: It was. You almost made it to the final round. You should be proud.
And if we ever do this again let's hope you play a little better.
Well, looks like the winner will be someone other than you.

dialogues.title: Heres Where Were At
lines: He said there's no record of a time travel 'Sec division.

Attempted? They didn't attempt, they succeeded. And now the big players are trying to cash in on the tech. Squash the rebellion and send us back to the dark ages. You'll miss these glittering lights when they're gone.
Ahhhhhhhh!!! This cannot be it! 5% is miniscule. I have a 5% chance of having a meteor crash through my skull as I'm standing here.
There was a group that attempted time travel.
It is. And... you've helped me this much and you're the only one to have done so. My hands won't stop shaking.
Those are my brains you're talking about! Don't you dare come after my brains. You fork yourself instead.
I think wherever you were scrambled your brains.
What... What's on your mind, John?
It is. And I don't. I... I can't. I have to runnnnnnn!!!!

Of course he did! He's one of them! How can you be so gullible? Believing things like that is what will get you locked in a padded room inside a clandestine CorpSec facility where they turn your brain into mush!
It's medicine a friend of mine gave me.
John! John Doe! It says so right here on my personal identification bracelet. What have you found? Who have you been talking to?
North. South. South-North. With a node in seventy-three.

So that's it?! That's all we have left? I'm cursed to wander under surveillance capitalism wondering when the greedy overlords will come and harvest what's left of my mind before shunning me back to... WHENEVER IT WAS I WAS BORN?!
This could kill me. How do I know you're telling the truth? How do I know you're not with them?
That's good! Those are my brains we're talking about. I don't need you to go forking around in there looking for something to eat.
Do they align with your name?
You have like a 5% chance of getting rich so that's worth it I guess.
Medicine?! From a stranger? That's how I got in this mess! How naive can you be?!
Well... I guess this is it. So long to John Doe. I'll see you on the other side?
Directions. Directions tell us where to go. So we look at directions and pick places, which are nodes, and the nodes are points in time that align with... something...
What'd they say? What'd they say? Do we have an answer? Can I finally stop looking over my shoulder? Seeing these eyes everywhere is unsettling.
Uh-huh. No luck on remembering anything?
Well, I have this medicine a friend gave me.
How is it not so bad?!
NO! They unscrambled them. Turned them into a functioning omelet and rewarmed the center. Now my thoughts are warm and tucked in a bed of eggs. Ohhhh, eggs sound good.
ANSWERS?! Please let it be answers. I could use a few of those right now.

dialogues.title: Deeala asked to help Pilk Dane
lines: Maybe you could help? Maybe you could teach him? For me.
Fuck... Am I? I don't know. I don't even like being in the same room as him. Can I really teach him how to be MORE of an arsehole?
Have you heard his jokes? He's NEVER going to make it as a comedian. And his skin is thinner than a radioactive tomato from the Ventz.
Maybe he'll stop messing with my apartment. He needs to leave me alone.
I got some updates for you. A LOT has happened since we last spoke. You wanna hear about it?
His defining trait is fragility. He can't take criticism. At all. How is a guy like that going to survive a comedy roast?
Hey. I've been hearin' things about you. Good things. Mostly. You're making waves here in the LUZ. Good for you.
You verbally abuse rich guys for money?
Rarely, but sometimes it gets so awkward that people laugh to avoid crawling out of their own skin.
No, not exactly. That would be impossible. I mean teach him what a roast is like.
He wants to do a roast at The Laugh Lounge. Roasts are where comedians get up on stage and say the meanest thing they can about another comedian.
Are you going to help him?
Still having trouble with your apartment?
Teach him how to be a comedian?!
When you destroy him, he'll be too embarrassed to admit the truth. And then he can't be mad at me.
Say you're helping him. but then roast him so bad, he never tries comedy ever again.
Yes. You know I work nights? And you know what I do?
Sounds like you're qualified! But is that funny?
No! What the fuck?! No! Look, I'm not angry you think I'm a sex worker. No shame in that! I'm angry you didn't listen. That's... really disappointing.
But why should I even get involved?
I don't think you have much choice.
I was hoping to see you again.
More problems with your landlord Pilk Dane?
Bingo bango. And I'm good at it. Really fucking good. The problem is, this fucking landlord knows how good I am.
Maybe you need to let him fail?
Maybe you can roast him and he will realize he's out of his depth.
And then he gives up comedy?
I mean ideally, yeah. But if not, maybe at least he gives up roasts.
He wants me to help him learn how to write better roasts of people.

dialogues.title: Coffee for Gunger
lines: When is more the question. Probably did it months ago. Likes to play the long game, Thaddeus. Anyway, what you doing slinging cups of joe?
You kids wouldn’t know weird if it rose up outta the sewers and called you mama. What is it?
Ain’t much of that in Nivalis. Glad to see you got it in you.
Maybe he's just looking out for you.
Yeah. A really weird coffee order.
Didn't you get an order confirmation?
Wait, how did he order this?
Nah. Just a note saying to look out for a delivery.
It’s a coffee and a tuna croissant.
Hey, you got something for me?
Mmph. Anyway, what you doing slinging cups of joe? Tycoon like you?

dialogues.title: Money transfer
lines: I am glad Ashwin is finding his way.
Yeah. Send him 500 Lims. Subject is "Critter research".

dialogues.title: Intro
lines: Let me guess you want to...
Play chess! Hunghh. Gonna move the horse, on the course, feel the queen on the SCENE. Rook and roll baby!
CHESS! Chessss chess chess chess chesss, chess. HUNGHH!

dialogues.title: Ava finds her body - theoretically
lines: I can see them... the records. It's all there. I can see exactly where my body is.
That's all the information we have.
I am so mad at him!
Thaddeus! He could have told me... He could have been honest with me...
I am so mad at him.
My body is in Egress, in a secret room.
Wait, do we know how to find it?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 19
lines: Remember, if you're not working, your competition probably is. Maintain a healthy head by staying ahead!
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Level Down from 4 to 3
lines: Hey, so we need to keep our eyes on the prize. The noodle bar has been downgraded from rating four to three.
It's not good, that's for sure. Let's make sure we don't lose focus on where we started.

dialogues.title: Ava announces Safia's last visit
lines: I guess she has news about Ashwin
Safia is at the noodle stand.

dialogues.title: Hynthia wants space
lines: Listen. At the moment you pay me to run laps between food processing units.
So you want me to put the appliances closer together?
I pay you to cook, not to talk.
You want me to put the appliances closer together?
Distance Boss. Distance. You know... walk far - food prep go slow. That clear enough?
YES! THANK YOU! That'll speed things up for sure. I was getting so frustrated.
Yeah well you better not leave any food unattended, that's all I'm saying.
What?! Oh no no no. You can't fire me! I'm the only reason you have any customers!
Just move the appliances closer together, ok? It's your own profit you're hurting otherwise.
Could you take a second to think about the kitchen layout? I'm not used to working in these conditions. It's exhausting.
I've been meaning to talk to you.

dialogues.title: Woah Where am I
lines: First, I befriended one of the research specialists. Got him drunk on bio-wine I found in a beaker. BAM!
I was recruited into a study to determine the possibility of utilizing advanced perception techniques on time manipulation.
Uh, I'm, hold on, I know this. Something is telling me Sage something. Why am I thinking about burning herbs and smokey rooms?
You mean the CorpSec facility analyzing the tensile strength of space-time fabric?
Nor should you! I was sworn to secrecy so there is an overwhelmingly good chance that everything I told you is a lie. You know, for your own protection and all.
One and the same! I do what I do because I'm--uh--hold on... Oh, right! John Doe. I'm THE John Doe. Climber of scaffolding. Traveler of time.
Maybe! You act like you've never escaped from a clandestine government facility before! Wait!!! My wristband. My name must be on my--John Doe. Who the fuck is John Doe?
Took my chance, snipped the lift cables and climbed through a vent. I was unstoppable. You know, unless they found and then stopped me.
I do what I do because I'm--uh--hold on... Oh, right! John Doe. I'm THE John Doe. Climber of scaffolding. Traveler of time.
And now I'm off before the cameras catch too much of this scene. FFFRRREEEDDOOOMMM!!!!
Wow, I had no idea my parents were so uncreative. Like ZEEERRROOO imagination, huh?
No, I think that's what the place called you.
It's hidden, like all the eyes on us right now. Watching. Always watching. You shoulda seen what I had to do to get outta there.

dialogues.title: Nabla's Staging Request
lines: Kit out Nabla's apartment with norm-core stuff. You know. Sit places and floor sheets and shit.
Nabla exists on a higher plane. And physically, in a DormaDiver5000 Neural Sleep Pod most of the time.
You know. Moveables. Sitting bits. Flat eating things. Sleeping appliances. Floor friends.
You help Nabla and Nabla will make sure you get a share of the profits, babe.
Nah. Just remember a toilet. Nabla hears that's a deal breaker.
Nabla doubts that. But Nabla also needs help. So.
Babe. Heard on the vine that you got a way with fitments.
Nabla's diversifying. Moving into real estate. Only problem is, Nabla doesn't spend much time reality side.
Nabla needs a little help in the "furniture" department.
I'm the best interior designer this city has ever seen.

dialogues.title: Only Eyes Radio 1
lines: Hello Nivalis, are your ears ready for some smooth news for the cruise? Then sit down and relax because this is Ivan Iker McGuire, bringing you... the shipping forecast.
Enterprise Zone Nine, north by north east moderate gale 7, visibility looking good. Real good.
Nakahaba Reef, north by northwest 5 by 17, yeah, you know what I'm talking about. Outlook icy.
Arcadia Wastes, north east light air 4, 12 miles, 1770. Rising... slowly.
Your ears have been listening to Ivan Iker McGuire, and this has been your shipping forecast. See you next time, Nivalis.
San Penango, northerly gale to moderate gale 6, mmmhmm, veering all the way west.
Nasu Point, oh baby, we love Nasu Point where it's south by south east 9, with some damn fine showers. Thundery.

dialogues.title: Wrap things up with Gamova 2
lines: An idea. And a token of my thanks. Maybe I'm wrong. But if not, you will understand.
I must go, I need to get this back to HQ before the enforcers find me.
Yes yes yes, of course. I'll tell them to call off the dogs.
That's not true. We will no longer be on Curzona's hit list.
Oh. Oh my, so cute. No with this confession, Curzona will be able to claim on their insurance. Things will go back to normal.
What about all that lost debt-income.
Ah, one thing. Ask Ava, whether the term "Old Network" rings a bell.
This is... This is exactly it. Curzona will be very glad this never saw the light of day. You... Did well.
Oh you're still alive...Well? Was he in there?

dialogues.title: Nellie Introduces Enchiridion
lines: Do you ever get that feeling of deja vu? Like something has changed but you can’t say what?
If I found some fragments... what would be in it for me?
Apparently during the CorpWars, the last antique Enchiridion terminals were destroyed. I've been searching for them for years, and found a few fragments, but I need more.
Oh, it was so much more than a street atlas! The stories say that it didn't just show THIS Nivalis, but ALL Nivalis. Every possible version of it across different realities.
There's substantial evidence! According to legend, people once accessed the Enchiridion via terminals on every street corner.
According to legend, people once accessed the Enchiridion via terminals on every street corner.
Have you been reading about the Enchiridion too?!
I'll tell you a secret for every piece you find. In Nivalis, information can be worth more than Lims.
So I can restore the code! See if there’s any truth to the stories!
As if reality has slipped out from under you between one step and another?
The Nivalis Enchiridion. People think it was... a kind of street atlas, written in ancient pictorial Nivali signs, by people who used the old network.
So that people could find their way around the city. And if they used the right symbols, they could also travel between all possible cities...
I don’t have much money. But I could trade…
You're excited about a street atlas?
The Nivalis Enchiridion. People think it was... a kind of street atlas, written in ancient pictorial Nivali signs.
What? Yes, sorry. I was up all night reading about the Enchiridion. Now I can't seem to think of anything else.
Thank you so much! I can't exactly pay you for your time. But I could trade…

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 23
lines: Studies show that the No.1 cause of mental strain is joining a union.
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Sanna - stay or go
lines: Will you be ok till then?
It wasn't me. You did this yourself.
Thanks. I think we... I wish we were closer. But anyway... thanks.
Still here. And so are you.
The best. And I'll miss them. And you. Take care, ok. I'll send you a postcard. Luna! I can't wait.

Well this might sound weird but... it was because of you. I mean not JUST you. Other friends helped too. But I really had some great people who listened and got me through this. And one of those people was you.
I'm going back to give it another shot. I think we can fix things. She can fix me. And I can fix her.
I... decided I don't need her. I'm... better off alone. I'm going to Luna.
How did you make the decision?
Not all the time. And not all your advice was good. But you showed up. You let me moan, complain. You listened, but you didn't let me feel sorry for myself. That was what I needed.

No, but I really didn't connect with anyone else like I did with her. Friends, family... they weren't really there for me. I didn't find... that support to get me on my feet again. So maybe she can do that.
So... I guess you want to know what I decided.
As soon as the LUZ flight ban lifts. Even after the LUZ is gone, shuttles will take a while to start up again. But my new employer understands.
Are you sure you're doing the right thing?
I did MOST of it myself. But no one gets through a breakup without a friend or two.
I'll move in. Help her look after her mom. I'm working now, so I can look after all of us. I guess we all settle in together. Settle for each other.
I will. I'm... excited. I'm half-packed already, and I have a list of things I want to get when I arrive on Luna. Including noodles.
When do you travel to Luna?

dialogues.title: Thaddeus at Egress 2
lines: If the procedure fails, that brain will be... cleared. Nothing will remain of Thaddeus Carminus.
Exactly. The problem is humans are not meant to live hundreds of years. Their memories fill up and become unstable and their personality collapses.
Egress needs a key, and you hold that key. Ava. She facilitates the connection between the human consciousness and Egress.
As you said, I am old. Very old. And a long time ago - longer back than I can remember - I had a friend. His name was Thaddeus. I had another name, but I took his.
Me? No. I don't think so.... Healthy and stable human minds must store the memories.
Nothing traumatic. You might just find your head a little fuller than it was before. But you must choose quickly. I don't have much time, and this process has only a limited chance of success.
But you kept your memories somewhere else, right?
That's right, Ava. This transmitter can still read memories, and the one there in Egress can still write them, but both are failing. This is my last shot.
All that effort just to turn me into your personal hard drive?
I need some reassurances I won't be harmed.
For you? Almost nothing. For me? Right now, my physical mind - my brain - is floating in a cerebral fluid inside something very similar to a glass jar.
Is there anything supposed to happen right now?
You can use Egress to mess around with our memories, right?
He wasn't really your friend then.
No. Not only delete them. Retain them. Personality migration is a certainty unless the memories are stored, and can be re-accessed periodically, but they must be stored on a suitable medium.
What?! But I don't feel anything.
Yes... those memories must be stored on a suitable medium, or they too will degrade.
Hey, I get it. I do. And if I had a bit more time, I could explain why it had to be you. And the truth is, my span has been too long anyways. Maybe it's time I-
Thank you. I'll have to disconnect now. Do not be alarmed when my avatar deactivates. The process will take a little while. You will hear from me again. In some time.
So what's your decision? Help an old man out?
I think he's gone. The signal is still being broadcast to his hologram, but it's... silent. The process has failed... Goodbye Thaddeus.
That's why immortality needs memory management?
I want to help but it feels risky. I'm sorry.
What happened? He's just standing there.
One needs to delete whole memories, but over time, this leads to “personality migration”.

In a manner of speaking. Egress is a transmitter, and we based its construction on a similar ancient device. Egress allows the re-writing of the human source code, and through that process, it allows the transmission of memories.
Why did you take his name?
Allowing human memories to be downloaded, shared and, most importantly, deleted.
I can't remember. Nor can I remember what my original name was. In truth there is a GREAT DEAL I don't remember. But I DO remember when we first built Egress, and what we built it for.
Another human mind must hold the memories.
Who else? What did you think all of this was for?
So what was this about? Whether we have figured out all of it or just a little?
Yes. I need someone to hold something prescious for me. A great many memories, sorrowful and joyous, mundane and revelatory. Will you hold some for me?
Caution is wise... but Thaddeus has few options, and he is also putting his trust in you. And he is running out of time.
Give it some time. The memories will manifest first via your unconscious mind. In your dreams.
I do not know. But the memories have already been transferred to you.
Exactly that. We have eradicated physical death - if you have the will and the finances to pursue that goal.
You're back. Good. I wasn't sure you would dare to.
I understand that feeling, but this is my last chance. I didn't want it to end like this. Would you reconsider?
If so they were extremely unremarkable.
I remember now. The problem of eternal life: Personality migration.
You lied to me and tricked me. I won't help.
The broadcast is open, but the signal is silent. His hard light hologram is uninhabited. Thaddeus is gone.
The individual changes their values and beliefs based on what they remember.

dialogues.title: Ava comes back online
lines: I have no evidence of an intrusion, but... your reactions suggest I may have been compromised.
I don't know what you mean. I am well.
I don't know. Nothing like this has happened before. But I will find an answer.
How are you doing today? I am detecting elevated cortisol levels. Are you upset?
Are you going to be OK?
Thank you for telling me. I think he may be dangerous. If he can compromise my functionality without my knowledge, then he has access to Grey Tech.
There was a man called Gideon asking about Thaddeus.
Semi-legal hacking technology. I will look into its origin and report back to you.
I'm sorry, I don't know who you're talking about.
Of course. I will consider this event and find an explanation.

dialogues.title: Milo has a cunning plan
lines: Very good. I'll send you to the Nav Point for the Humor Bot. Just convince him to visit Nola Berg's property. His subsonic mating call will activate, and the rats will do the rest!
You trick people into your noodle bar, right?
Because the Humor Bot has been rigged with a seismic pulse which will attract rats to the area via a subsonic mating call.
I cannot be spotted talking to the Humor Bot.
No, it wasn't that bad. It's called:
I know this is all very... unusual. Believe me, this world of commercial espionage is not the world I know.
The Humor Bot developed a personality flaw during the hack.
Did I already ask for more context?
Why do you think I can trick him?
I am a simple seismologist. But this WILL work. Should I repeat the plan again so you are clear?
If anyone spots me talking to the Humor Bot, the cunning plot could be traced back to me. I can't let that happen.
I guess it's all about that bass!
I've got a rather... underhanded business plan in mind.
I need you to speak to a Humor Bot for me.
Trust me. I am almost as adept with rat sexuality as I am with human sexuality.
So about that sabotage mission I sent you on...
The hacker implemented my rat mating call scheme through the Humor Bot's subsonic speaker system.
Introducing character number three: a hacker.
I still don't get the joke!
I used my measly Seismology budget to employ a hacker.
It went acceptably. But I have a request for something more... extreme.
What don't you get? The plan is very simple. You must find a specific Humor Bot and convince him to enter Nola's Berg's property.
You need to find the correct Humor Bot and trick him into helping us.
It is not "nonsense". I am almost as adept with rat sexuality as I am with human sexuality.
The Humor Bot refuses to do anything he is told. He refuses all orders, and wonders around the city at random.
Were you not happy with it?
Two reasons. One - I do not have the "gift of the gab", and therefore am unlikely to trick anyone into anything.

dialogues.title: Yulia's Last Message
lines: I… it’s not for me to decide.
I need an answer. Don't go!
Then do it. Dissolve her code.
I was trapped and didn’t know it. I might have stayed trapped my whole life.
What do you think we should do?
The file name translated to Thaddeus Carminus.
Let's give her a resting place.
I ... can't ... don't want to ... believe it.
I know who you are now.
An ancestor of his, maybe. I don’t suppose we’ll ever truly know. But now at least, Yulia might be at peace.
If you're hearing this voice note, then I'm already gone.
I hope you’ll meet me there. I hope we can grow old together. But if we don’t, then I want to say thank you.
Very well. Activating the instruction… there. It's done.
Deep in the code, I think I saw the name of the person who once held Yulia's memory.
Very well. Activating the instruction… there. It's done.
Don’t get on the Vinc. Please.
But with you, these last few weeks, I've been loved. I've been free. I'll see you on the other side, TC.
There must be a mistake. A cross-contamination caused by the fragmented KorēChant.
She’s gone. But there's still a trace of her code in the electromagnetic field. If you want to act, you have to do it now.
I had to run. They’ll come after me any moment. So I’m leaving, I’m going to take the Vinc to Star’s Leap, and then a shuttle to Luna.
Her memory is now housed in my storage. If we take it to the Holocropolis, we should be able to upload it to a spare plaque. But...

dialogues.title: Alfie has a plan
lines: Here's hoping this gets you off the hook!
I didn't tell my parents I loved them enough.
I just need to burst upload this whole session, then we wait and see what my bosses say. With any luck, you seem so mentally scarred, they might write you off. And me too.
Binary Gods... that's good! I mean... that sounds bad. Fuck. What does that even mean?
I got really sad when my parents died. And my mom. And my dad.
Ok, we start as soon as I ask you the first question. You ready?

Look, it's simple. We finish our final therapy session, then you bug out. Just... start acting weird. Like you're losing your mind. All my therapy sessions are recorded via my Automata and transcribed for my employer.
All the Lims I have, and I'll stop bothering you.
Well at the end of the day it is what it is.
Damn. Thanks then. Thanks for nothing.
Just, you know... the trauma of all of... this.
Well what are they? I hope nothing too concerning...
Hey. Hey! I need to talk with you.
What particular trauma are you finding it hard to process?
Right! But that's not a problem.
Of course not! In Nivalis, EVERYONE is mentally damaged. And have you heard the shit they have me saying to people? If you follow this advice, it will severely fuck you up. In the head!
Hey, nice! Just less people to hold you back, right? But that must be pretty traumatic. I bet that caused some long term damage. Pyscho-logical-ally.
Sometimes I feel like I've taken so much damage that there's nothing left of what I used to be. I'm walking scar tissue.
I have a yogurt at home and I just remembered it is out of date and I meant to eat it last night.
If a Sanguine Minds accredited therapist does real, mental damage to a client, and the client chooses not to pursue recompense, SM cancels all further commitments and voids their therapists contract.
Out of Sanguine Minds. I can stop being a therapist. But... I need help.
I shouldn't have got that skull tattoo.
I try not to dwell on the past, but it was all PRETTY terrible up till now. Including now.
I lost all of my family and friends in a bread factory explosion.

Exactly. Maybe you could develop a split personality. Or get really depressed. Or take off all your clothes. Whatever you do, it's gotta seem real. Sanguine Minds have to be convinced their programme has really fucked you up.
Great! I mean, don't do that. But... it's great that you're sharing these things so honestly with me.
Here's hoping I'm fucked up beyond repair!
Yeah... Yeah, that sounds rough alright. Anything else?
Ok! Shall we discuss past trauma or regrets?
Yeah, ok. That's bad I guess. Anything worse? Any really bad regrets?
Come on! Don't make me beg. I will beg if I need to.
I feel like most of my worst trauma is behind me.
I'm not sure about this, but I'll try.
So we have to make it look real.
My skin doesn't fit. My head's full of bells.
No. Well... yes. But I found a way out. I FOUND A WAY OUT!
I'm all done now. Therapy over.
I regret losing touch with some of my old friends.
Ok, act like I lost my mind. I can do that.
I shouldn't have saved my nail clippings for a month then ate them with milk like cereal.
What the fuck?! I mean... finger or toe? Wait, don't answer that. Neither answer is good.
Amazing! So look, Sanguine Minds have a clause in their contract. A friend of mine, Nervous Pete discovered it.
Hey, great. You can be normal now. It's all done.
Very poetic! And very much a sign of someone who is seriously fucked up.
And how do you feel about that?
It makes me want to... uh... drop a piano on a grandmother.

dialogues.title: Eastern Residential
lines: Welcome to Eastern Residential, it might not look like much but this is a very up and coming district. Gentrification at its best.

dialogues.title: Ava announces Ashwin's last visit
lines: I don't think this is about ideas.
Ashwin wants to speak to you.
He never seems to run out of ideas.

dialogues.title: Get help from Hanz
lines: Yes. So let's keep things friendly with him.
Hanz Grundown's reputation is impeccable. I don't doubt he will ask a favor of you in the future - he keeps his promises - but if he says we are safe for now, we are.
From you? A favor. When I next ask you for help, be... amenable. You don't have to say yes. But if you say no, have a good reason. Are we clear?
When will you ask for a favor?
I think we can trust him to make our problems go away.
You're not going to help me are you?
Slow down a little. I didn't say that. In fact, it would be easy enough to help you. Trivial even.
I need CorpSec protection from criminals. I thought you might know something about that.
No need. I'll make it easy. I'll talk to that new CorpSec overseer. The one who replaced Reoh. He's an old friend. I'll tell him to get the heavies to lay off Thad's protege.
As are we all. To some degree.
So he's a useful friend to have?
I'll make a call tonight. It's done.
You are just saying words. Do you have a request? An observation? An offer?

For me, certainly. These goons aren't even reporting up their own chain of command. They shouldn't be after you. They'll learn that tomorrow. CorpSec will squeeze their "Boss." They'll feel the repercussion.
Soon? Never? I really wouldn't worry about it. I won't.

dialogues.title: Tell Bonaventure the Truth or Lie
lines: Ha. Alright, it was worth a try.
Oh what does it say, I can't read it.
I hope he knew that I was thinking about him, at the end. That I will always think about him.
Now? I suppose it is time for me to stop waiting. Perhaps I’ll go to the sea after all. Visit the Rigs. I’d like to see the place where he rests.
Maybe. Perhaps he’ll feel my presence there. But at least I’ll be able to see a new horizon.
You’re back! I mean, good to see you're back. Did you… ahem... have you done any sailing?
That's what you're after? It's all business? Have it. The license is yours. I’m cutting myself loose.
I found this name plaque close to a wreck near the Rigs, just like you said.
Thank you. I... think I will move to the old rig.
Nothing? Nothing. Then he’s out there still, somewhere. Maybe.
Will I see you on the Rigs?
I know... but another day won’t hurt. Maybe he’ll find his way back here. And when he does, I’ll be waiting.
The boat was called the Annabel Lee.
I knew you would. I felt it, all those years ago. Like someone had wrapped a fishing line around my heart and tossed it into the sea.
This place? Just a shell. An empty bottle without a message. Have it. The license is yours. I’m cutting myself loose.
Everything... just everything. One day you will know. Or maybe you won't.
"Gone Fishing" or something like that. It wasn't the Annabel Lee.

dialogues.title: Ptolemy 1
lines: Why is it that you interact so much with your tech? The feeling? The convenience?
Doesn't sound like much of a life then my friend. Hey, look. Maybe take a gander at my Ana-Blog here, it's a collection of my musings on the subject.

All I'm saying is, the second I put the tech down everything in the old dome started to make sense again. I really started to connect with those around me. It's a growing movement for the growing mind!
I'm not sure I'd be able to navigate my life off the grid.
Like I always say, 'ditch the screen, live the dream.
Like a digital pervert hell-bent on cuffing me to its cyber-bedpost!
Hey you, yeah yeah yeah, can I ask you something?
Thanks! Look, all I'm saying is:
I should try that some day.
I don't have time for questions right now.
No, thanks, sounds like a load of Mumbo-Jumbo.
I've been into the lifestyle now for... Wow it must be eight years! Time flies when you're having personal enlightenment.
All handwritten. All on paper. I mean, feel it… When was the last time you felt natural paper? Extraordinary.
Yes! Yes, it is. That's precisely why I'm asking. Have you personally ever considered the analogue lifestyle?
I've never looked back. Like so many, I found myself starring into my comm screen, an abyss that started to stare back.
That's a very… graphic way of putting it.
Yes my friend! Of course, you are far from alone! Have you personally ever considered the analogue lifestyle?

dialogues.title: Discuss rat meat with Banor
lines: You're joking, right? Tell me you're joking!
And if we roast it a bit longer... nobody will notice.
If we put it into our Eastern Salad, at least "rat" is not in the name of the dish.
I don't like where this is going.
Well... at least that's not extinct. I heard it tastes a little bit like chicken.
Last year he wanted Kangaroo. Nobody knew what that was. Reviews bombed for a week.
The food critic requested a special dish.

dialogues.title: The Ballad of Hepzibah Gimble 1
lines: 13497 souls that I have freed from their eternal suffering as the living dead.

Forgetting things is how we endure. And the things I don't forget, I reconcile. I won't carry guilt - my shoulders wouldn't bear it at my age. I advise you do the same. Now, I have tasks on my to-do list and not much time to do them, so good day to you.
The souls you took. Do they haunt you?
No. Not really. They all needed to find peace. In a way, they were dead before I got to them.
I'm old, my dear. The days hurt, the nights hurt more. And I forget!
Yet you never forget to mention that you forget.
Can you remind me a bit about what we are discussing?
What kind of reason might that be?
Maybe I can give you a reason to remember?
It all worked out as planned. If it hadn't, I wouldn't be here.
Oh, my dear flower friend. How lovely.
Happens even to me, and I might be a few months younger than you.
You took many lives. Any regrets?
Someone had to burn down a storehouse?
Do I? See! I even forget that I already mentioned my forgetfulness.
Never be afraid to move past your past. Mistakes happen, and we all do what we must to survive. Life is too precious to waste second guessing ourselves.

dialogues.title: Raluca - Third Meeting
lines: Among the stinking rich, some envy their heirs so much that they want to prevent them from inheriting.
I'm not sure I'm ready for a big commitment yet.
Oh just another thing that is popular in the Spire. Anything life-prolonging is big business up there.
I was hoping you'd say that!
Not quite yet, but they'd like it to be.
Sure, I mean there's no rush, I guess...
Well we have a few options. Would you like something exclusive or maybe keep things loose?
I'm not even sure I want to live forever.
Some people think it is, although the idea that the richest people in society could possibly live even longer fills me with dread. Personally, I can't think of anything worse than immortality.
Someone once said, "The idea is to die young as late as possible". I live by that.
I'm glad we didn't beat around the bush. Neither of us are getting any younger. Not down here at least.
It's not much different down here.
Well neither of us are getting any younger. Not down here anyway.
I'm still trying to work that out.
Yeah cool, no me either. Let's keep things fluid for now!
Well look, I'm a modern girl with modern tastes but maybe we could make this unofficially official?
Wow back again. I seem to have a real fan.

dialogues.title: Ava explains Trash
lines: You know, sometimes it's fun to do your part for the community.
It's a good point. Thank you!
Something as simple as picking up some trash or cleaning a window here and there can really help ground a person.
You're welcome! Feel free to pick up any trash you see. It could do wonders for you mentally.
Easy for you to say, you don't have hands.
It might also help you shake that slight attitude I sensed there.

dialogues.title: Part of the Club
lines: How do you throw a space party?
Ah. Well, I do like fish more than jokes. I'll have to think about that one. While I do, tell me how you did out there.
You look like you come with jokes! What a joy!
Welcome to the Underground Fish Market. We don't have regular meetings and there aren't any dues.
By the grace of neon waters! This... This is fantastic work. Like a real fisher. Guess I have no choice.
Oh. I have no idea. That's why I'm asking.
Wait! Is this still part of the joke?
Here you go. All of them right here.

Be ready to put them fishin' skills to work. People want all kinds of things at all kinds of times. Keep your ear to the shore and eye to the sky, and you'll pick it up. For now, back to fishing for me!
I hope you're better at fishing than you are at this.
Hahahaha. That's pretty good! I like it almost as much as I like fishing. Speaking of, how'd yah fare?

dialogues.title: People Are Going to Melt When They See This!
lines: You're a genius. A gifted debonair of decor. I mean, keep this up and you'll almost be as good as me.
From now until the day we die. Let's goooooooo!
Buh-duh-duh duh-duh BUM! Synthesizer starts ear and we rock!
Oh, well, you're a downer. Who cares if it does or doesn't when you have a palace of panacea.
Yessssss! People's faces are going to fucking MELT when they see this place. Party mansion? Party HEAVEN!

dialogues.title: Visit Aseptic Apartment 1
lines: She's not just a machine, she's a friend.
I forget. Hundreds probably? It wasn't easy keeping track of you all. But it did become easier as Aseptic started knocking you off one by one.
Ok, ok, ok. Fine! Look my employer is not only finished with you, they have decided to sever all ties with me too and they don't leave loose ends...
No, I demand you tell me how you broke in here!
How did you get in here?!
You think I got this way falling off a HOVA Board?
What are you doing here? And what happened to you? You look terrible.
I've been tracking you both. That folder grows every single time you visit an Aseptic crime scene. I need you to persuade her to reveal the contents.
I'm afraid I cannot divulge that information at this time.
That's why we should work quickly. They could be here at any moment.
Since I started using Ava to communicate with you, I discovered an increasingly large series of files buried under extreme encryption.
The security in this building is not fit for purpose. You might as well have invited me in.
Well as we established, you don't have a choice.
Well I think your 'friend' knows exactly who the Aseptic is.
Do you remember what DeeDee told you? About Gen-Debters being the most valuable financial asset in Nivalis?
Ava? What does she have to do with this?
Bingo. Do you have any idea how expensive I am? Surely you didn't think we were working to protect the public interest, did you?
If Ava knew anything, she'd tell me.
How many of us were you using as puppets?
How else would I get you to comply?
Right... Ok, well let's get started then.
So if you used so many people, why are you here? Why me?
To think of this city in binary terms like 'good' and 'evil' is folly. We are gliding inside a delicate ecosystem, constantly on the edge of collapse.
You were just another number on a Curzona data-sheet. The law of averages - eventually one of you was going to get to the bottom of it. Well, so we thought.
Get to the bottom now? We've been on this for what ... months?
You thought you were special? That the algorithm said you were the only poor person in the city who could help?
Your words are as meaningless as your presence in this case.
We need to get to the bottom of this Aseptic case before my employer finds us.
Before we go any further, I demand you tell me who your employer was?
So, so self-centered. I'm not here for you. I'm here for your Automata.
Never mind all that, it's not important.
So you outsourced the leg-work to innocent people. I guess that's smart.
That can't be true. How would you know that?
Thanks for leading them straight to me!
No need to get so attached to a machine.
Well seeing as I don't have a choice...
Oh, I think Ava worked out who the Aseptic was a while ago.

dialogues.title: Got a Message
lines: One of my hidden talents yah know. I think you should take a trek to the Sewers. Sail the dirty seas to the repair shop and find your friend.
I know you are laughing... quietly.
Did he send it in a bottle?
Ahhhh, I gotta go the tides are turning! Wait, what button do I press to---
Would you like to listen to his message?
I ran into a galleon. Well, not actually "ran into," but we traded barbs. They had some robotic friends on board, so I pursued a conversational gambit and won the game of chess.
MARINER! Hey, wait, is that you? Ugh, I don't know how to work this blasted thing. If the seas are strong, this message will find you like a lighthouse signal in a storm.
Looks like this journey is leading us into the Sewers.
Your wit continues to impress me.
Got a message for you. Apparently Salt Pete might have found something.

dialogues.title: Gunger asks for some change
lines: If you own a business, like say a food stall, you can write off any donations for tax purposes. I used to own a business so I know this stuff.
In the East it's all warehouses full of starship junk and derelict monorails and mad androids who think they're famous. I like it. And here... gangs, graffiti, drugs. But there's bad stuff too. Haha!
Is it really so much better on the East side?
If you live on the street why do you need money to get home?
The cold. That's what will get you in the end.
Are you really going to spend the money on a HOVA ride?
I owned a bakery. What, you think everyone living on the streets was born there?
A hundred Lims would cover it. You can write off charity donations for tax purposes.
Yes. What, you think I'm a drunk? Or a Joos head? Just because I'm on the street?
Can you spare some change for a DuoRail ride home?
I have a place to stay on the East side. A better place. I don't know if it's safe anymore... but I need to go back and try. I won't last long here.

dialogues.title: Cyborg Slayer Seven
lines: There's no way that decoded freak show was in a movie.
I don't think you watch this for the plot.
Look at the cast: younger sibling of murdered sister - Silo Mills.
While I've never seen this particular film it appears to have an... interesting plot.
Either way. You don't think it was a clue, do you? I mean, you are playing a game with him.
Well, the premise of the movie is, after being requisitioned for reprograming, a rogue cyborg adopts a second personality, stalks, and brutally murders everyone in the requisitioner's family.
The hero, a teen hacker that is able to remotely disable the cyborg before being stabbed in the throat with a sharpened circuit board, was finally found hiding in an apartment under the bed.
Might be worth a quick visit home.
Well, I'd say it's safe to say who this belonged to.
Indeed. Well now, that's a bit interesting.

dialogues.title: Garnet considers your offer
lines: That was it! Haha, nice one.
I was gonna say "a good start", but your punchline is good too!
Hey, I get it. Let's just leave it there then. Have a good day.
Right. Uh, great. I mean... good. So I guess we could grab a drink or a bite some time.
So what happened with Mila? I assume you "passed" your interview?

Yeah, her heart is in the right place, but I really don't need any more friends, or partners, or... anyone really. Just me and her. Every night I'm not dreaming of more friends. I'm dreaming of pizza that has real cheese. Imagine that!
What do you call a thousand CorpSec Officers at the bottom of the ocean?
So, uh... you talked to Mila, huh?
Say, do you want to hear a joke? I heard my old landlord Pilk Dane tell this one, but he butchered the punchline. Wanna hear my version?
Look, the kid means well. And... she's very strong-willed. She's really pushing me out of my comfort zone, whether I like it or not.
Oh what? I love this! Hahaha! I love you for this!
Hey, snap! Thanks for being honest with me though.
I did, but I don't need a friend or partner.
Let's... uh... let's chat again. This was fun. Really.
It's nothing business. It's just personal.
If you see Mila, tell her... Tell her I'll be home late. Long shift tonight. And tell her... she's a good interviewer. And a good kid.
No offense, I'm just not really interested.

dialogues.title: Talk to Banor about tipps
lines: Of course. I mean, Lochlainn is their manager, but they all like him. Good man.
Four weeks, and we make it voluntary.
This about Lochlainn's little boy I guess?
I'd be surprised if anybody said no.
Many drips an ocean does make, eh? We don't earn much, but we could live without tips for a while to help Lochlainn and his family.
We need money to save the boy. The staff could play a part.
It's heart-breaking. And our team has hearts. Mostly.
It's a good thing you're doing boss.

dialogues.title: We put the drink on the menu
lines: Fair point. I got the cocktail on the menu.
You're back! Is that a good thing or are we in trouble?
It's Nivalis. Does there really need to be a reason?
Hot damn we're doin' this. Alright, I'll get it brewin and in the hands of folks looking for a drink. Sit back and let's let the reviews wash in.
I put the drink on the menu.
Why would we be in trouble?

dialogues.title: Thaddeus sends another message
