lines: I HAVE been receiving more messages from the ether recently.
Did you see the message from Thaddeus on the news?
It's like a postcard. But I have to write them backwards, because that's how time flows for me now, unless I really focus the...
... She thinks how I used to think. But my mind is clearer now than it's ever been. Her thoughts race down the same highways, but my mind has gone off the road, and carves a new path.
I believe he is talking about me.
I'll try to decode. One moment.

How do you know when it's finished? When you've found everything? When you've seen the credits? When you find her? But that's not the end, because the story goes on - if the one sitting in front of the screen wants it to. But that's the layer above -
... And all of this will make sense at the end. But the end of WHAT? A life contains every story, and where you start and end determines if it's a tragedy or... something else.
So he has been talking with you then?
He has been trying to contact you through various channels.
He seems trapped in some philosophical conundrum.
He has sent you another message, relayed from Luna. He has told me that sending such messages is costly, but you have not been receiving them through other channels.

... But stoicism just loops around, you see? There are no answers in it, only justifications. They say only to worry about what you can change, but telling a human not to worry is like telling the water in a puddle to be a different shape from the ground that holds it.
... Apologies for the distortion in the message. Some of it appears... jumbled.
There is a little more, but the message is incomplete.
Yes. There is more but the transmission failed. I am sure his next message will explain all of this.

dialogues.title: Lucy has her first complaint
lines: There's no need to be rude.
Well, maybe you haven't, but anyone in the scene would know.
Are you trying to start a conversation. I don't want a conversation.
The LUZ sucks for all of us.
And you're not serving me today either. You're trying to start a conversation. I don't want a conversation.
Are you the owner of this establishment? I need to file a complaint about the service yesterday.
We're going to be big - if Sharron doesn't fuck up the saxophone solo at our next audition again. I knew you were part of the scene.
Sorry to hear. What did you order?
Yeah. I'm the lead singer for the Spit N Swallows. You've heard of them.
Yes. People who are not where they should be. I'm not supposed to be here. And I won't be for much longer.
Rude? Rude?! You have no idea what I've been through today. You need to think about the way you speak to people like me.
Yeah, the music scene downtown. That's the only reason I'm here. I thought it would be worth the... discomfort. It is not.
That's good. You should be aware that there's a specific way you have to deal with people like me.
Sorry, I'll try to talk less.
Damn, I miss the Spire... Anyway, I have to get back to rehearsal. See you around. But try to hold off on the chat next time. I'm a busy woman.

dialogues.title: Miles & More
lines: So you can serve more tables at once?
Want to know what makes my day bearable? Decent customers, good tips and short distances.
I can teach customers to keep their hands in check. And I was born with a smile that makes you want to tip.
As far as short distances are concerned, you should organize chairs and tables so that our routes are short and efficient.
More tables mean more tips. You've got it Boss!

dialogues.title: Could Harper be Aseptic
lines: I don't think that's going to help us Ava.
Do you think she could be the Aseptic?
I just think you can sometimes tell if you look very deeply into the eyes.
I mean she doesn't really have the eyes for it but... maybe?
She seems to have a very specific skill set...
Might make her good at specific or deadly tasks perhaps?

dialogues.title: Want to Try Again
lines: Hey! You're back. Going for another run at the tournament?

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 10
lines: Have you tried getting a good night's sleep?
For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Interview Calhoun
lines: And you thought it was me, huh? Look, Calhoun don’t take what Calhoun can’t sell.
Got a question about Danny Danetti.
I once saw her reel in a 10kg turbo trout using only crankbait. Can you believe that?
Whaddya want? You’re scaring the fish.
Like I said, Calhoun don’t take what Calhoun can’t sell.
I thought you took people's limbs...
So why haven’t you gone after him?
I know. What a woman. So what’s this about Danetti?
Danetti. Pah. That dough-brain owes me more money than he's got fingers to pay with.
Hmph. So what’s this about Danetti?
Knew his mother. Good woman. Good fisherwoman. CORA knows how she ended up with that for a son.

dialogues.title: Have You Seen My Toy
lines: How did you get in here?!
I just want to help you get home.
No. We got out early because of a mess in the boys' room.
You look like an ugly snot monster! An ugly snot monster that stole my TOY!
And then reach up and stab me in the chest like wham-wham-schhuuuuck. And I'm all like gaaahhhhh-whyyyyy-then I'm dead. Is that why you want my address?
What kind of bathroom mess closes a school?
You're not supposed to tell strangers where you live. What if you're a killer? What if you're gonna hide under my bed and wait until I fall asleep?
Do I look like I took your toy?
One that needed a big black bag to clean up. It took all the teachers to drag it away. Mr. Holland puked.
I know! I know! But hey! I fooouuunndd you!!! Now it's my turn. Count to a hundred and then start looking, but don't get your hopes up! I'm the best hider there ever was. Byeeeeee.
Have you seen my toy? I lost it and it was my favorite one.
Do you even know your address?

dialogues.title: About Growing Chefs
lines: That was a metaphor for "decent wages".
Let them work in good conditions. Give them a space to develop their skills. We are self-motivated. Just add water, and we will get faster and better all by ourselves.
Franco. What can I do to make my chefs better?

dialogues.title: Floyd Meeting 1
lines: Not important? Such a little meat thing to say.

There was an accident. A young girl, meat girl, she got pinned underneath a crashed Hova. I had no choice, I was able to lift it and set her free. Whole thing was caught on camera. My cover was blown.
Still clever enough to detect your sarcasm.
I guess it must not be that important.
Named it the Mechatomb so people wouldn't forget. It clearly worked...
It is. With no purpose after the incident, I decided to turn that septic plant into a gym. Somewhere other droids could train in peace.
The first half seemed to win the argument, so I vanished.
Thousands of us so-called 'Roid Droids' were culled overnight when you meat freaks decided that we were too much of a threat. We never asked for any of this.
Impossible. I do not speak to street-meat.
I don't have any meat questions. You spoke to me...
Your meat-opinion is meaningless to me. Goodbye.
Look meat, while I hope you have learnt something today, you are still meat and I have a lot to be getting on with. Goodbye.
If you are looking for an autograph or some merch, head down to the Mechatomb and someone will sort you out.

We were designed to work in places the meat couldn't. Off-shore oil rigs mostly. They built us one hundred times stronger than the meat. A great idea until the meat got cold feet and started getting twitchy that maybe we were too powerful.
I see meat-education omits the darker corners of its history. The Mechatomb should be taught in your meat schools.
I hid, found an old septic treatment plant. Stashed myself in the shadows for years. Waited. Watched.
I'd have maybe chosen something a little lighter.
I have neither patience nor time for any further meat-based enquiries. Go ask your meat questions elsewhere.
That was a meat question. A question formed and delivered by meat.
The Mechatomb happened. A single night in which every single Roid Droid was decommissioned. All except me.
What do you think? Are you a hero?
And there we go again, another meat question. Yes you are meat.
Either way. Half the meat wanted me decommissioned on the spot, the other half thought I was a hero.
Before, you spoke as if the Mechatomb was a place?
You thought it's better to hide then.

dialogues.title: Flying Sky High
lines: Alright, alright, I'll give yah a pass even though your delivery was as good as someone serving yah a warrant. Trust me, that's not something you want to sound like.
Huh, look at you go. Little bit o' depth to those looks. You ever model before?
Tell me something about yourself. Something most people don't know.
Whoooo, soooo many times. They don't exactly give out passes to install exhibits on the side of corporate buildings. But anyway, enough work talk. I need to blow off some steam!
Ain't that the truth. I'm thinking of doing a botanical piece up here. String lights that change based on plant growth. What do you think?
Hmmm. It's always tough, deciding where to put a new display. Don't need to catch a warrant like a few years ago. One more and I think they'll blast me to Luna just to get me outta here.
Darlin, you make me blush whether we're on the beaches or in the sky. That's an impressive feat right there.
Sounds good, darlin. Let's enjoy the view a bit more. I got some ideas floatin' around for a new display I want to work through.
I once ate a foot and a half long eel. While it was alive.
See that building over there? That just so happens to be a hotel. Maybe we could grab a drink and start dancing in their bar. See what happens?
See, I like the fact that I can't tell if you're being serious or not. No, wait, don't tell me. Let's keep the cloud of mystery while we're up here in the actual clouds.
Guess I'll head back to my little shop then!
Feel free to stick to your little shop with your moldy food if seeing all the sights and lights isn't enjoyable.
Hahaha, but look at your face. Go on and get outta here before I start spreadin' the word that it is. Coulda been something special but alas, time for lights.
Alright, that was good. I like that. People with a sense of humor are hard to come by now-a-days. Good to see you buck the trend.
Sorry! It was meant to be a flirty joke.
What do you want to do?
Well, well, look who decided to fly to the gardens.
Gonna make it worth my trouble?
I'd fly anywhere to meet you.
I don't know how to read.
My favorite band is Sugar Gum Smackers.
Something on the beach would be cooler.
You tell me, darlin. This city is ours to explore and I got some time to kill.
Having me traipse after you throughout the city is trouble.
Oh, darlin, you gotta earn that and if gettin' it is trouble for you, then it ain't happening.

dialogues.title: Ava has one last lead
lines: Yes. He's the last one, and he might know more than he is letting on.
Well, we still have a boat. I think we should go back and talk to the last pirate.
Well... what now? Our pirate adventure seems to be over. We didn't save the Captain, the pirate crew didn't reunite, and we didn't learn Salt Pete's final secret.

dialogues.title: Ava says Harper is waiting
lines: She's not even trying to hide...
Harper is at the Noodle Bar. She wants to speak to you.
Probably the right thing to do.
That might be the only reason they don't have her yet.
Will you tell her about Danny?
I'd rather not panic her unnecessarily. Yet.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 15
lines: Hey, it's morning. Time to get up and go.

dialogues.title: Cecil Grimes - Player Loses
lines: It seems chess, like the restaurant business, is not a suitable place for you.
To help you get better? What do you think I am, a public servant?
I work for a public, and not the one that you're a part of. Speaking of which, you should run on back and go join your ilk. Bye now.
One of those things is true.
And you can believe in truths or lies or misdirections but the fact remains: you suck. Bye now!
Aren't you a public health inspector?

dialogues.title: Banor What Can I Do Boss
lines: That's probably why they're so cheap.
How'd you figure out it wasn't really Shimmer Sage?
When you compressed it between your fingers, the texture was wrong. Scent was wrong. It was genetically modified.
Carrying some troubles today, eh boss? Can't say I'm much doing better.
Thanks for asking boss, but I've been through this rodeo before. Same old same old. I just concentrate on keeping the grease traps clean.
Of course! Here ya go, boss.
His whole network would come down if he screwed over the wrong person. Ain't worth the risk. Having said that...
The chicken came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide the real age of the chickens. The smell, you know.
As in she was just there waiting for you? What... what was she doing?
She had a lot to say.
Alright... Do you know who carries Windowpane Lager?
I ran into Mica Rain again.
Ah, gotcha. There's a vendor named Harmony who hangs out in Lowtown. You've probably met her. If it was anywhere, it'd be in that backpack of hers.
Doesn't matter. It's what she said.
I'm scared of what she might have told you. How bad is it? Are we as dead as digital privacy?
Nope. That's the thing. Produce was fresh as a new Dolly song.
How are you holding up after the raid by Mica Rain?
The pork came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide the real age of the meat. The smell, you know.
That doesn't seem like Ed. Not his style. I know he's dedicated to the cause and all, but not to the point of betraying allies.
Yeah, I heard Mica has been harassing you again. She's a different breed from most of the Corpster's boss. You gotta be careful with that one.
Oooof. Haven't seen that around in some time. Was a good drink though. Smooth as silicon. Why ya askin'?
Not a problem boss. I hope this straightens itself out. This stuff was hidden well. No one would spot it unless they knew what to look for.
I know my seasonings. This was disguised well, but I can spot when something ain't right.
I'm going to meet Edison. Wanted to bring it.
I went home and Mica Rain was there waiting for me.
It was the sage though. Something was off about it.
The onions came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide their real age. The smell, you know.
Interesting. Let me have what's left.
Umm. I'm sorry boss, I'm not sure how to respond to that. I mean, you do you, but while she's with Sec, that's a path you best not follow.
Edison played us. That's what she said.

dialogues.title: Found 1-5 Tumblers
lines: That's great! You didn't drink out of it did you?
Well now I want to drink out of it.
What do you think could happen?
Because... I don't want to see anything happen to you.
Hey there! I see a k20 handle sticking out there. You found some?
Because then they're not pristine! I'm afraid if the rare ones, the few that only exist solo or in pairs, are used... then the ghost won't come. It'll think we soiled its lanterns.

Well, it means a lot that you're helping me find the last few I need. I've been doing this for so long I kinda forgot what it was like to have someone close to you. A friend or, I don't know, maybe something more.
It does, doesn't it. I'm glad you're here. I can't wait to see the ghost with you.
Good! Now, get back out there! You're off to a good start but I know you got some more left in yah. Don't let me hold you back!

Definitely. So maybe just don't take the chance and drink out of one? At least one of the rare ones. You can grab a cheaper, common style and drink until you drown if you want! Though don't do that. At least until you've helped me find the others!
Oh good. Can't do that. Just, yeah, if you find another one, which I know you will, just don't drink out of it ok?
Of course! No, that's why I said friend. Sorry, I didn't mean to imply otherwise!
I mean it could eat you... as payback. Though I guess you don't really eat a k20 so much as drink from it. Maybe it'd drink from your soul? That'd be fucked.
Then again, maybe nothing would happen. I mean, if you were locked away in 123 different containers and couldn't come out until they were reunited, how pissed would you be?
Happy to help. But that's all I'm looking to do.

dialogues.title: Meet Gan Coilson for the first time
lines: It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.
No. Ava sent me. My Automata.
Child's play. I was Chief Technical Officer at LifeCorp.
Tittle tattle. Just... Don't tell my wife.
How did you become a machine?
I wonder why someone with so little knowledge would second guess me.
Wait. It's not her who sent you?
Someone could have implanted that memory.
Will do... if you answer a few questions.
Far better! Everything makes sense now. Suck suck, make things clean, make a difference, have a purpose. It's all very logical.
How would someone like you be able to do that? Transfer your mind?
I know someone who has had a similar experience.
Here's some free advice: try to avoid Ceres.
Becoming a machine? No. It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.
Are you sure that's what happened?
It's nearly impossible to manipulate the memory of modern bots. I should know! I built most of them.
But that memory could also be implanted, right?

dialogues.title: Agent T gives you the lead
lines: You have been selected for greatness. For an interview with Ms Mary-Nyx Curzona herself.
Your use of a formal honorific suggests that you are flirting.
Why don't you come over later and fine me for it?
I passed on a recommendation. She wishes to interview you for the role.
What does she want with me?
Oh, I could fine you for a lot of things... but down to business.
Do not make me change my mind by displaying your ignorance. Ms Curzona is currently CEO of Curzona's Fifth Division.
I won't tell if you don't.
I did. I consider you... somewhat above average.
To what do I owe this honor?
It is now that you're here, Mr Agent.
Business. Yes. You have been selected for greatness. For an interview with Ms Mary-Nyx Curzona herself.
A mistake. Perhaps I misjudged my... opinion of you.
One of the most powerful people in the LUZ and all of Nivalis.
I'll make the appointment and send the details. Do not let me down.
She recently acquired the Serpentarium Club in the Spire, and is looking to recruit a co-owner. I don't need to tell you it is the most exclusive venue in the LUZ.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 24
lines: This is your morning wake up call. Although I can make the noise of a toxic smog siren if you prefer? *deep breath* Just kidding.

dialogues.title: After hiring Spartacus
lines: The smell of stoves, the clatter of dishes, the new faces, and all I gotta crush is our daily targets. Gotta say it beats the arena.
Don't know where I'd be now if it weren't for you. Thanks again, truly. It's people like you make a difference in this city.
Good to see you, boss. How's it hanging?
All the better for seeing you here.

dialogues.title: Trust her or not
lines: Personally? I would throw those spores in a waste chute. There are less... dubious ways to make money. But it is up to you.
I cannot say for certain whether the favor she has asked of you is legal.
Very well. I'm sure you know what you are doing.
And yet you have taken her offer.

dialogues.title: Ava Decision Time
lines: You think there's more to Edison's story?
A fair response. Might I offer one suggestion?
I think we have a very short amount of time to figure that out...
But they're too busy engaging in corporate warfare and bribing each other. Bastards would rather feed a hundred kids into a grinder than give up on 0.1% of their hourly profit.
Where can I find Windowpane Lager?
Not right now. I have to think.
There's some truths that need to be uncovered here. I'd be happy to look into a few things with Banor, find out what is really at stake and where the evidence lies.
Hey, heard you had a run-in with one of our friends. These assholes will stop at nothing. The top two Corps in this city could feed and house every kid in the city a thousand times over.
I'm not sure. Banor would certainly know.
You think Mica's full of it?
Nothing to do but talk with Edison.
I sense you'd like to say something about your impending decision with Mica.

*throat clearing*

Damn, I need to calm down... Can you grab a six of Windopane lager? I'm hiding out at Conland Containers. I sent a Nav Point to your Automata. Later.
Hang on, just receiving a message from Edison...

dialogues.title: Comms Are in Crisis
lines: Of course it's a crisis! Are you calling me a liar? Telling me I'm rightfully angry about nothing?
I told yah. I don't know. Rice Walket, he probably does. That fucker spends more time in the airwaves than he does breathing actual air. If anyone knows what's happening, it's him.
Of course it sucks! You think I don't--wait, did you just agree with me?
What would you do if you had a call with a VSM Loudcaster? With the Comms down, I have to actually go to their studio now!
This blasted fucking Comms crisis, I'm telling you.
Well, I mean, it's socially awkward, you know? Kinda like this conversation. I don't like that stuff. Why do you think I play a sport where I beat the shit out of people?
I don't. If I did, I'd find out who was responsible and drive my foot through their ass.
Do you know why they're down?
Violent Sports Monthly. What rock have you been living under?
Well, duh. I mean, I kinda gave you the answer to that one. I gotta get to this interview. Wish me luck.
Wastes if I know. Haven't seen him since the Comms went down. Hey... wait a minute... You don't think... That fucker.
Actually, not luck. Wish me the intelligence to not get pissed off and punch them so hard in the eye they swallow it.
Oh, well, I mean, yeah. Yeah! Right on. This bullshit's gotta end. And I gotta run if I'm gonna make this interview. Wish me luck.
It was rhetorical. Lay off the Joos for crying out loud.
Sheesh, you are some kind of freak show. Shoulda figured.
Do you really need them that bad?

dialogues.title: Alexandria Player Lost
lines: Was that the best you got?

dialogues.title: Marius' Warning
lines: Cute. Look if I were you, I'd have a long hard think about the risks of what you're doing.
Well, well. Look who clawed their way into the double digits. That’s no small feat in Nivalis.
A skilled chef with a knife can do a real number on a person. Two or three numbers in some cases.
You think I could be in danger?
I shouldn't be telling you this, but some of those guys at the top, they'll stop at nothing to stay there.
Only if you cross me... I'm kidding. I'm a pussycat. I'm just looking out for a colleague.
See you on the rankings kid.
Hard to run a joint with no pelvis if you catch my drift.
What about you? Should I be scared of you?
If I were you, I'd quit your climbing. Go back down the ranks if anything. It gets pretty choppy near the summit.
You mean there's blood in the water?
Just something worth thinking about. I'd hate to see your legs cut off before you got to stand up.
I mean everyone in the LUZ is in danger right now but those climbing the restaurant ranks are in double danger.

dialogues.title: Ava Playing Babysitter
lines: Admirable. Happy to be along for the ride. Now... shall we?
Just seeing this through and then I'm done.
Apologies. Let me rephrase that. There is something to be said about being used by a delivery man.
There is something to be said about being a part of Edison's network.
'Even a pawn still gets time on the board.'
I'm not part of his network.
You are indeed making your mark on this city and the ones walking around in it. Just make sure it's the right mark. One you're willing to live with.

dialogues.title: Return to JR Amiga
lines: He was left with a single memory. I want to know if it's one of yours.
Well you're clearly proof that being a rich person doesn't.
Look if what he says is true, this shack, and the cake, has nothing to do with me. It's real... it's gross, but real.
These low life's all grew up on the streets, what would be the point of giving them more memories of that? They need to see what a real life is!
Someone I know had a CBI procedure.
Right what is it? Need help spelling something?
That was... actually well put. I'll be making a mental note of that for the next... never mind.
I just need to know about this memory. Could it be real?
A shack you say? And a cake?
The whole thing went wrong. Was the memory yours?
Takes place in a shack, there's a birthday cake.
Now you listen here food servant, these low life's all grew up on the streets, what would be the point of giving them more memories of that? They need to see what a real life is!
I mean is it well written? If so, it probably is one of mine. What's the memory?
Oh here we go, next you'll be telling me all about how being poor makes you a nicer person.
Wouldn't basing these memories in reality improve their effectiveness?
Well it can't be one of mine, I don't do shacks. All my memories take place in the Spire.
All of them? Sounds little unoriginal.

dialogues.title: Mica Rain Wanted
lines: Severe cases of food poisoning. Many cases. We have two victims on emergency detox support.
The common denominator was your chicken.
We've established people have been poisoned because they ate here.
Could someone be targeting my customers?
The common denominator was your onions.
He delivered you poisoned groceries. But it's not even about that.
My line of inquiry leads me here. More investigation must be done.
Are you aware of the most common mistake made by business owners like you?
We're not investigating your noodle stand without reason.
Quaint. I wish you people would come up with something more... original.
I'm Mica Rain, an investigator from CorpSec's business hygiene and profitability commission. Unfortunately, there's been a string of illnesses, and the common thread seems to be your restaurant.
The victims all say they ate here. We have witnesses in abundance.
Can you get to the point?
Get lost. I've got nothing to say to you.
Come on. He's not your friend.
You are the owner of this establishment, yes?
And I did not accuse you of poisoning. Yet. But the fact remains, people were made ill by the food served HERE.
If they got ill, it was obviously a mistake.
It doesn't matter what you SAY you know. We have confirmed the details. The facts are clear. The evidence is irrefutable.
They talk too much. Use seven words for a question that could have been answered with two. Those extra words are gold to someone like me.
You have twenty four hours to figure out how you can help me. If you can't come up with anything, you're mine.
All you know is that they say they ate here.
I suppose you're going to tell me.
Listen, we know who delivered the groceries. We know you've been played. We need Edison.
I won't rat out a friend.
You know I was JUST talking to Cecil?
What do you want from me?
The common denominator was your pork belly.
You have no say in this my little entrepreneur. The investigation will proceed, and your freedom depends on your cooperation.
Human trafficking. It's a serious crime. I'll be honest, we could take you to a corporate paradigm adjustment center right now. You'd never see light again...
I don't know anything about this.

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 2
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?
If at first, you don't succeed, make sure you succeed next time.

dialogues.title: Talk to Huckstash 3
lines: You should have been talking to communities, not running about getting a Lim here and a Lim there. That's how we fight back. Together.
You're right. I can spare it. Thanks for the help.
I'm the one who's been working hard!
Maybe you'll turn out OK after all.
So, I'll give you 20 Lims. My hoppers dug deep and are contributing 187. If you truly wanna show how anti-Corp you are you'll match that 207 Lims.
He'd be better if you started talking to the right people.
I don't have cash to spare right now.

dialogues.title: Gamova Call 2
lines: Do not panic. Encrypted line reestablished.
Thanks to your upgraded security clearance, I can confirm this is in-fact related to the alleged serial killer known by the street-name Aseptic.
In light of new information, you have been chosen to perform a specific task related to case No.083-1138.
I take your silence to convey your desire to move in a productive direction. I have sent the location to your Comm. I will be in touch.

As I mentioned during our last conversation, you will be rewarded for your compliance. It is also important that you understand my employer has bestowed unprecedented jurisdictional freedoms upon me. Failure to comply in this matter will result in you finding out why.
A murder scene? You're using me as bait?
You have been chosen by advanced risk algorithms whose ownership is currently classified above your security clearance.
Due to your current economic position it has been deemed appropriate that you attend an Aseptic adjacent environment.

dialogues.title: Player Lost
lines: Ugh, I do so abhor "sportsmanship". Wallow in your loss. It's the only way you'll learn.
Finally, a little spirit. Bring that attitude next time and you might win.

dialogues.title: All Done!
lines: What a glorious day in history this is!
I can hear the conversations now. The intellectual debates, the rigorous recounting of philosophical positions outside capitalist control. Ah, it will be amazing.
Hope I'm around to see that.
Well I'll be thrown overboard and cast aside. This place is fitting of Alexandria herself.
I don't know who that is.
No, not a person, the Library of... you know what? Never mind. You did an excellent job.

dialogues.title: Interview Razlo
lines: You might be smarter than you look. Say I did take his recipe, what would you do about it?
Depends on what you offer me.
This has been fun. Come and see me in a few days, partner.
You see? Hilarious. This conversation is over. Give my regards to Ava.
And I have a bad case of dermal itch. It’s making me very impatient.
Unless you’re here to offer me a private membership to the Spire Health Spa and Pamper Lounge, I’m not interested.
Of course. He’s like someone gave a cockroach the power of speech.
If you’re here with another proposition, I’m listening. It was so much fun last time.
I think you're a business man who knows a good deal when he sees one.
I think you know what people value. And how to exploit that.
What’s funny is that you have no idea how stupid you are.
And you think I’d be interested in anything that grease-trap has to offer?
You won't get under my skin.
Funny, I’ve heard that said about you.
Ha ha. SO funny. And so unwise. We’ll talk again soon. Give my regards to Ava.
You know, you are far more interesting than I thought. Alright. Keep this between us and I’ll give you 10% of what I get when I sell Danetti's recipe to his competitors.
Too bad for you, then. Give my regards to Ava.

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 19
lines: Good morning. The acid hail has passed and air quality is only mildly poisonous. I think it's going to be a fine day.

dialogues.title: Aren't you a little young for this
lines: Really?!? Awesommmmeeee! I can't wait to see what you do!
Hehe, that rhymes! Maybe it can be the name of my new playhouse. You know, once I can get it set up.
Hehe, I'm good at that. Remember? Wait till I get inside my playhouse with all the rooms to hide in!
Decorating a playhouse! Or trying to. It's kinda hard when the furniture is bigger than me!
My parents left it for me. Or at least I know they would have. Now it's mine and I want you to help me make it cool.
Okay, well... what do you think is cool?
Oh, them? They're out, umm, educating themselves on what's cool.
MURDER!!!! Hahaha and bloody things. And ghosts. And creepy things that look like something they aren't and furniture you can hide behind.
Silo? What are you doing here?
Your playhouse is this apartment? How?
Kinda! Well, I am but I need some help.
Okay, I think I can manage that.
Oh... well that's disappointing. You should really be cooler. I can help you, yah know? Hehe...
Yeah, I can't be an accomplice to that, sorry.

dialogues.title: Pilk has another warning
lines: Also, if you have a friend over, and they stay, and they give you money, or a gift, or even a compliment, that is considered sub-letting.
It must be the other one then.
The other extremely low income tenant in one of my "Economy Minus" properties.
Certainly! You are an adult - you can figure this out for yourself. For example, you have a toilet. Why not hide - I mean reside - in there until your guest leaves.

Yes. If a visitor gives you anything at all, and they stay more than thirty minutes, that's considered sub-letting. To be safe, consider having no guests. And if you do have guests, it's best to avoid them completely.
How would that even be possible on 20 square meters?
Well, just so you know, you are not allowed to sub-let.
Are you sub-letting your apartment to a migrant family of carpet weavers?
Very good. Enjoy your day. And remember, no parties!

dialogues.title: TheraPay Bot Dialogue 6
lines: For premium licensed street-therapy, please insert Lims now. Would you like to proceed?

dialogues.title: Bad Intel
lines: Blazin' neon, you're the best. When I get my hands on that mother - wait - I have an idea but it involves you doing me a favor.
Oh, one of those "only risk what you can lose"-wise guys! A vanilla gambler. Get-my-toes-in-the-water-but-don't-make-me-wet dorks. No, I'm hardcore!
I'm sure you could afford it!
And what's it to you? You've never seen a dip before?
Yeah it does! Now I gotta figure out - wait. I have an idea. Maybe you can help me? I was going to teach you how to read the boards afterall.
Guess that's two bets you lost.
Ok, look, I had a sure thing on the E-Train yesterday. The afternoon ride in from the outskirts? I'm talking guaranteed data funneled straight from the conductor.
Well, look who wandered back like a pup this side of the tracks. I'd be a lying shit if I didn't say I was glad to see you. Ready to make some Lims?
All. Of. It. I lost all of it. I can't even leave this shop to kill the fucker who gave me the lead because I OWE THEM MONEY FOR MY TAB!
Seriously? Man, I had you all wrong.
You'll get it back! I'll add ten percent.
So you came crawling back, huh?
Lend me a stack so I can get outta this cafe and track down the fucker who gave me the bad info?
Check the sewers. Probably hiding with the rest of the scum.
No such thing as a sure thing.
Oh... yeah... Woah! Did you hear that? What was that? Is that guy watching us? Were you followed here?
Figured I could make some Lims.
Lead didn't account for a screamer on the EL car. I'm talking rail skipping, emergency brake pulling nonsense.
Really? Not much of a business tycoon are you? No wonder you wanna learn how to read the boards. Tell yah what, do a favor for me instead?

Collect money I'm owed. Fucker's avoided the rails since he called an hour delay when there were four cars down. Four. It's an hour delay PER car. Idiot. Rice Walket has always been an idiot and now it's time for him to pay up.
No fucking way! What a grand piece of wisdom that I haven't ever heard before.
Dip be damned. I know a scam when I see one.
Didn't you just go broke from the boards?

dialogues.title: Sanderson Has an Offer
lines: So I'll be decorating a stolen apartment?
Lemme guess: you need another apartment "redecorated".
Nothing I haven't dealt with before.
DO you want the same thing, though? To redecorate an apartment?
Just because we're the same model doesn't mean we're identical. He doesn't even have a subdermal knuckle spike enhancement.
Yeah. Bought his husband an apartment as a birthday gift and wants it furnished. No expense spared. Fill it with... I dunno, lamps, rich people shit.
Boss was impressed with the last job you did. So impressed he wants you to do it for REAL this time.
Best way to be, boss. But say you wanted a little MFN...
Not stolen. Repossessed. Happens all the time.
"Me." Do you want me to help you like I helped Rollo?
How you feel about earning a little MFN?
Well... yeah but that's not the point.
Yeah... only thing is, the current owner wasn't exactly happy about selling.
Sucks to be him, then, doesn't it.
I don't want to be involved with your dodgy boss. No more schemes.
Money for Nothing. Well, almost nothing.

dialogues.title: Safia Dialogue 2
lines: If I had a Lim for every time I've seen a pot washer get ideas above his station, I wouldn't still be living next to a pet food factory.
I believe in specializing. I wait tables - don't want to be anything more or less.
Things seem to be shaping up nicely here. You're very welcome.
Just keep an eye on your metrics. The longer I work in the same place, doing the same thing, the more the customers return to experience my expertise.
It's all part of the service.
So you think it's better to stay in your lane?

dialogues.title: Fancy Meeting You Here
lines: Finish your job and make the drop. Then I'll entertain your questions.
If I do I'm complicit in what your bodyguards did.
It's not me you would have to convince. Make the drop and join our nest.
Hello again. I see you've made it.
A thriving business owner such as yourself? I'm sure you have plenty of places to be and yet here you are.
Was told to drop this off.
Have you been here the whole time?
What if I don't want to?
You don't deserve to hold the coin in your pocket. Give it to me you worthless little runt.
My naive friend, you've been complicit since you first spoke to Ms Weiss. It is your face on the security feeds afterall.
Good. I knew they were right about you.
Be careful what you eat. Those pills turn to powder pretty easily. All this surveillance and tracking and yet the old ways still sting just as hard.
Had no where else to be.
It's a lovely spot, no? Something about the water, and the way the... I'm sorry, I just can't keep a straight face when I attempt appreciation of physical beauty. Now, what brings you here?
I'd be surprised. Seems a waste to make it this far and lose out now.
What am I missing out on?

dialogues.title: Harmony Fourth Meeting
lines: When I met her, it was pretty obvious she didn't grow up poor.
I hadn't thought of it like that... And just as I was starting to feel better... Oh well, anything I can get you?
Exactly! It's just such a relief to know that me being broke actually makes me a more interesting person! Anyway, anything I can get you?
But her parents died in a tragic Hova crash...
J. R Amiga? For real? Oh, she must be amazing! She has a revolutionary approach to financial hardship that has really shown me things from a new perspective!
Oh my. I think I need to process this for a while. Anything I can get you in the meantime?
She focuses on how interesting it can make you as a person!
Selling poverty as a good thing?
Things? You know, things are things aren't they. I've been reading a book called 'Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity' That's been helpful.
What a fresh way to look at things!
Yes exactly! J. R Amiga has a revolutionary approach to financial hardship that has really shown me things from a new perspective!
Could she have made that up?
You are right, we shouldn't question everyone so much.
She told me her dad had just cut her off from his credit cards.
Amiga grew up in such horrible poverty as an orphan that she learned to look at her position as a positive rather than a negative.
Clever. Anyway, what was I saying? Ah yes.

dialogues.title: Flesh
lines: Unrelated but I think my friend is in trouble.
Aye, then they should consider themselves lucky. If they had gone poof while holding it, the lady of the luscious sea would be feasting on their bones!
How come I've never seen you before?
I think my friend is in trouble.
Have you ever seen a pin like this? (show Anchor Pin)
Whoa, whoa, whoa! That pin right there is an ill omen for anyone who rubs their fingers upon it.
Bring that aboard your vessel and you'll feel the pressure of the depths closing in.
I found the pin in the sand.
Suppose that's true. If they did, the shipping Corpsters would probably break 'em and toss that pin into the sea.
Or at least I'd hope so. Can't become a collective without being... collected. Good luck!
Let me think for a moment... If it's a matter of unsanctioned organization, I'd set sail for the Oil Rig and talk with Delbert.
Hello friendly mariner! You're not in the belly of any sea-born beast, so I sense the waters are treating you well?
Depends on where you found it.
And let it rust at the bottom of the sea? I thought you were a true mariner!
His Separatist movement has been growing and I'd wager a day of calm seas that he's received some kind of message or something from other groups.
If the wearer of that pin were taking part in an unsanctioned collective of workers, then sure as the tides, something bad did happen to them!
Ah... A ship done run a reef? What's got them on the ropes? Must be good if it's got you worried too!
Possible. What brings you here to these old docks?
Someone either lost it or threw it away.
Let's get serious. What does this pin tell you?
A HOVA-A1 Hydrogen Converter. An actual A1! And I can't get a landlocked pair of legs to give me a decent price for it.
Selling this. Buying that. Do you know what Foamheart just fished out of those waters?

dialogues.title: Unhappy Dagmar
lines: You treacherous little worm. I know what you did. After everything I tried to do to help you...
Don't tell me what I would or wouldn't do. You have no idea how much shit you're about to land in. I look forward to seeing your face when you find out.
You would have done the same.

dialogues.title: Harper Oisiris Third Meeting no flat
lines: Why fight to keep my place in a world filled with heartless bastards?
You can't blame me for all this.
*sigh* Well you shouldn't feel good about yourself right now.
More than nothing would have been good, yeah.
Sorry, I'd rather not risk anything.
I wish I could do more.
Well, yeah. That's it then. The end of the road for me.
I understand why you would feel that way.
Hey, did you find a place for me to hide out?
Not ALL of this. But some.
Sorry I bothered you I guess.
Alright, alright! I'll talk to Banor again.

dialogues.title: Huckstash reveals what he knows
lines: So this is all a dream?
I don't know. But I know what people say.
Egress is how you wake up.
You look like you've seen a ghost.
Do you even know what you're asking for?
How do I get a ticket?
You're not going to help me.
So you've been there. I know you've been. But I also know you didn't have a ticket.
Good for you. Could you dream of a better place? Nivalis isn't so bad. It's just not very... unique.
I'm not going to help you. Not until you can tell me what you really want. When you get there, you know where to find me.
How do you know all of that?
A dream? No. More like a... did you expect me to say a nightmare? Let's not be over-dramatic. Nivalis isn't so bad. It's just not very... unique.

dialogues.title: Hire Gemelar
lines: I want to start by reaffirming that ramming a knife through my boss is NOT a habitual thing.
Is fusilli the twisty one? Anyway, he wouldn't take no for an answer, so I twisted a knife in his gut. And now I need work.
Awful joke. But I'll take the offer!
I don't need a pasta chef with a past. I could use a manager, though.
Alright, let's see how you do.
He hired me to make pasta, but he thought he was entitled to more than my fusilli twirls.
That is... good news, I guess. What happened?
You really need the job, right?
Buying ingredients, improving staff morale, making everything more efficient. That's not hard to do!
Let's give it a try. And don't call me "bucko" again.

dialogues.title: Floyd Meeting 2
lines: Training is not always about physical change. Our strength class is hard-wired but our ability to learn what to do with that is adaptable. It's probably hard for meat to understand.
I hear you're becoming a big player in the catering world.
And they say I'm the robot...
I'd hardly say I'm a big player.
That's what I like to hear. Owning a business isn't easy. We have to fight for our own corner.
You're right. How's your gym doing?
Something you should think about while you grow your empire. You're not just selling noodles, sometimes people need more than that.
I wish to apologize. My behavior during our last meeting was... brash.
The Mechatomb is a complicated place. Sure, it's a gym, a safe haven for us mechs to train but it's also a hub, a place in the community for the downtrodden.
Yeah seems like mumbo jumbo to me.
For example, I'm currently dealing with a disgruntled customer who might well get himself into trouble. Refused to train in the correct way. If he gets hurt now, I have to live with that.
Sound like it's not your responsibility.
No, I think I get it.
Enough of that meat-speak. If we don't hype ourselves, who will?

dialogues.title: The Old Network
lines: But it might be our last chance.
It might be a bit risky, but should I swim in the data streams to find out more about The Old Network?
Okay. Go ahead. But be careful.

dialogues.title: Ava Aspetic 8
lines: I hope she's not in danger.
Sadly we will probably never know.
I do not like that she wished us luck...
She did seem... More human for a second.

dialogues.title: Thaddeus birthday party with Gunger
lines: He claimed he didn't care. But we didn't dare to miss it. Tells you something, doesn't it?
So you've always been here on his birthday?
Give an old homeless some rest. At least on Thaddeus Day.
Something in my head telling me to keep an eye on this place. On you.
Never brought him a gift. I did him plenty of favors already.
Why did you come if you're unhappy?
I guess we all worry he might show up and we missed him.
His birthday was important to him?

dialogues.title: Update Nellie
lines: What about the other thing? A resting place?
I've heard that it's technically possible to isolate certain memories and have them removed. Perhaps that's what she is! A stray memory!
I don't have the skills to do it. But your Ava could.
Is there any way we can ask her what she wants?
She talked about running away. It was like she was stuck in a memory loop.
Dissolve her code, or find a way to properly store her memory, like a resting place.
I don't have the skills to do it. But your Ava could.
It all makes sense. Without a proper host, the memory would be… unanchored. Drifting and condemned to repeat itself for eternity.
It's just that thousands of people die in Vinc accidents every year. Why aren't they ghosts? What else did she say?
Her name was Yulia Tan. She had a doomed love affair with a stranger and escaped a mad cult only to die tragically and become a saint.
She would remain trapped as a memory, but at least the code that makes her wouldn't be forced to run constantly.
I don’t believe her code is sufficiently sentient to respond. But you can try.
You're back! Did you see her again?
She was in love with someone.
She would remain trapped as a memory, but at least the code that makes her wouldn't be forced to run constantly.
Her name was Yulia Tan. She was a member of an order called The Forsworn, and died in a Vinc accident.
It's true. With the Codex, and knowing Yulia’s full name, I believe I could write an instruction which would... undo her code.
It's a ghost story, so we need to resolve that. Right?
Um, that doesn't sound very factual. What else did she say?
If she IS a failed memory transfer - and I’m far from sure about that - then I guess we would have two options.
Saw her and heard her, thanks to you.
It's true. With the Codex, and knowing Yulia’s full name, I believe I could write an instruction which would... undo her code.
Why would someone remove memories of her?
I appreciate hearing the cold, hard facts. But...
Quite a dilemma we've got here.
Only if the code was sufficiently sentient. I don't think it is, but you can ask her.
Oh, fog and fumes, my heart is racing right now. Did you find out anything?
Is there anything we can do?
Well, she's haunting the places she once walked...
I'm just glad to learn her name. I'll write down everything you've told me. Whatever happens, she won't be forgotten.

dialogues.title: Call Ashwin's deal off #1
lines: Sure. I'll transfer the funds soon.
It's very hungry and will keep all other microorganisms out of the kitchen.
A one-time cost for the biological substrates I need!
Wow. Rejection again. Hello old friend...
I did. I don't think it's gonna work.
Alright, it sounds like it might work.
Hey boss. Did you come to a decision about my proposal?
But it's so simple! I created a macrophage that eats all known microorganisms. It can move outside of wet environments.
I'm just non convinced it will work.
So I can get the money?
It's not the right investment for me right now.

dialogues.title: What Do You Want Now
lines: I didn't say they were smart.
Neon Gods with your questions. You are genuinely annoying, you know that?
That I do. Now what else do you want to know about?
Help me find more information on them.
I don't know his real name.

Ah, shit, I don't remember. They had some theory about speed and time ratios or something. They ended up hacking a tram to turn off the speed governor, boosted the electrical input while connecting two modified steam converters, and ZOOM off into the sunset.
Ha! Like you have a shot. Keep it moving.
Is there anyone who knows more about them?
What do you need this time?
Do you know a John Doe?
Is that a serious question? Of course I know John Doe! He's John Doe. That guy's John Doe. Even the dude leaning against the wall over there is John Doe.
You know a lot of things.
Don't mention it... Seriously, don't mention me to Elias, yeah? Don't need his slimy ass skulking around my hangouts.
If it gets you outta here? Sure. If I remember correctly, Elias Malt was the lead on that accident. Yeah, definitely was, I remember watching him come through here all slick and shit.
Oh that train didn't actually go anywhere other than through a wall, off the track, and down to the bottom of the sea.
Uh huh. And what brings you here this time?
Time travel? Like go to sleep tonight wake up a hundred years ago? Nothing from CorpSec that I know of. There was a startup that tried something a few years ago.
Have you heard of a CorpSec time travel initiative?
About as much as I love CorpSec. You're both a strain on the limited amount of brain cells I have left.
That has nothing to do with time travel.
Haha, get this: they called themselves the Happy Hour Friends.

dialogues.title: Raluca - Second Meeting
lines: Has to be better than this.
I'm glad I've made it all worthwhile.
That's just the tip of the Spire. It's a big place.
Ever heard of Pov-Play? It's where rich people go to group-events and pretend to be poor for a few days. Very popular in certain circles.
I think we have very different tastes.
Normally? I don't remember much from my childhood but I can tell you that nothing that happens in the Spire is normal.
Maybe try and use a smaller mask?
Well, that is a real shame.
No you're fine, it can be a bit of an adjustment for people.
It's fine, I just wish people didn't notice it anymore.
Funny and good-looking, a rare cocktail.
I'm sorry I shouldn't have mentioned it.
Would you ever go back to the Spire to live more normally?
Bar the occasional case of Mask-Rash and the food, I think the world makes more sense from down here. Plus, I get to meet interesting people, like you.
Sure, we can call it that.
Luxury like that is not within my Lim-range.
I think I'd have chosen the Spire.
I wasn't sure I'd see you again.

dialogues.title: Restaurant infestation
lines: They're fussy little critters. In a way, having them infest the place is like getting a good review. In a way...
Not bad! Just a few hours ago I had a nice case of Tiger Pest.
Ashwin. How are you finding work here?
A not-so-rare form of cockroach that often frequents places that cook highly seasoned food.
So it's basically a good sign?

dialogues.title: Meeting Gladstone after Curfew
lines: I have no idea what you're talking about.
The rats would be forever grateful!
Shhh. Be quiet and let me listen...
I will give you a list of all my old traps. Find them and deactivate them. Oh, but the restaurants only put them out at night so it won't be easy...
Sorry, I don't work for nothing.
The rats told Thaddeus he was wrong about you. He should have listened.
The Rat King! Oh I've been trying to get an audience with him, but he won't speak to me.
I used to be a rat catcher. I tried to make amends, to sabotage all my old traps up topside, but the security drones know my face.
The rats! They tell me things. Messages in their claws. You know binary code? They know it. Gnawing noughts and ones into the walls.
To my furry babies, my toothy angels.
What would I need to do?
Secrets! The rats know many things.
It is. Now, if you'll be quiet and let me listen...
The rats told Thaddeus you were the right choice.
Can't they? Well, I wish I was clever bugger like you and knew every damn thing.
Then leave me alone and let me listen!
Sorry. Tell me about the rats.
Many things! They scritch me secrets at night. They say the King has a plan to take over this city, one chewed cable at a time.

dialogues.title: Treasure 3 - The North
lines: You mean the third piece of Captain Ophelium Anaheim... Mildred Van Hammerstrung the ninth?
We should take this to Crabface. Caleb says he is the only one who can complete the Captain.
You mean the third piece of Captain Andalucia Ophelia Marquez the Third?
Can we put her back together ourselves?
You mean the third piece of the pirate captain?
This seems to be the logic unit.
Aah. You found the third piece of the pirates treasure!
I thought the head felt a little light.

dialogues.title: Make the Reservation Finn
lines: Thanks, Finn! Good luck with the gig.
Ahh, just gotta enjoy the smell of that pristine sand and surf.
Finn! What are you doing here?
Hey! Hey! There's the bay. What are you doing out this way?
Thanks my friend. Couldn't have climbed that audio scaffold if it weren't for you. Here, come check out the grub some time. Heard it's supposed to be delicious.
Hoping to score a dinner reservation here.
I'd be lying if I wasn't vibin'! Got a gig playing out here for a few nights. Even paid for my ride over and everything.
Ah, gotcha, gotcha. Sweet space, right? I'll be jamming here for the next couple nights. Paid for my ride over and everything.

dialogues.title: Ptolemy 4
lines: Not by myself, with myself. It’s a battle of wits, a psychological deep dive, a duel between my own impulses. Every hand is a lesson in restraint, every bluff a meditation on truth.
This is truth. Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have a full house against myself, and I’m dying to see if I’ll fold.
You mean enlightenment is now found in self-corruption?
You used to be all about real-world connection. What happened?
This might be sadder than the Ana-Blog.
Sounds like a very philosophical of addiction!
Oh, please. The Ana-Blog was a symptom of my past delusions. This?
You can call it self-corruption. But this?
Hey guess what? I've put the Ana-Blog to rest. I’ve found something even more transformative—a single-player digital card game.
Wait… a card game? By yourself? On a computer?
You sound like you're just addicted to a card game.

Addicted? No, no, no. I’m immersed. I've transcended the need for an opponent. In a way, I've become the purest form of gambler—one who plays only for the thrill of the risk, without the corruption of others.
Oh, I’m more connected than ever—to my instincts, my desires, my own mind. When I go all-in against myself, who really wins? Who really loses? It’s existential, baby.

dialogues.title: Ady talks fishing
lines: What do you call a fish with no ears?

Of course! Salty or sweet, no matter what flavor is in the flesh of fish, the most important aspect is the isotopes. The tang... it makes your teeth buzz. It would be a poor meal indeed if the fish was inert - without some level of radioactivity.
You know what they say. Without rain, you cannot make...
Do you feel at home here?
Me? Never! The fish are too good here. You can really taste the isotopes.
Fish! Always be with the fish. They swim together because they share the experience of being in the water. And, for the skilled fishers among us, they'll share the experience of being in our bellies!
Ah, my friend! You must find joy in such things. If you tried it, you would not be so negative.

Now let us discuss more sober matters. Tell me friend, how are you finding the city? I cannot tell if you come from beyond the city gates, or just from another district. But I can spot a fellow outsider when I see one.
Hello my friend! It is good to see you again. How is this weather treating you today. It is good for the fish, no? And what is good for the fish, is good for Boardwalk Ady!
Are the fish safe to eat here?
Absolutely. The meat was fibrous but sweet like lobster. I ate him with butter and a case of beer as I watched the neon light of the city dance on the waves of the reef. Glorious.
This place suits you. But it's like new shoes you must break in. There will be blisters. Pain. Chaffing. Eventually, you'll walk in style. You'll stride around like you own the place.

The tastiest fish I ever ate was a broad-fin gupper. It glowed in the dark. Good for the fisherman, bad for the fish. I caught him with an extended pneuma-spear at midnight. Went straight through one of his six eyes.
Do you miss your old home?
I do! My old home was dangerous, thrilling, wondrous! But... gone. And I shed no tears. Besides, the fishing is too good here. You can really taste the isotopes.
I do not know! What do you call a fish with no ears?
Safe? What in life is worthwhile AND safe?
Exactly. So I must ask, did you think of a joke to tell me? A fish one?
Anything you want. He can't hear you.

dialogues.title: Meeting Cassius
lines: Well...in honesty I have been struggling with something. You might be positioned to help.
Ok, I might have to pick your brains at some point. Just having a few... teething problems.
Space can be such a fickle mistress and alas, we are taking a short break from one another.
How about the time I had to prove myself against... you know what, there is no point in trying to explain myself to a Well-Dweller.

The point? How very narrow minded of you! I've seen things you wouldn't believe. A life spent dancing on the fingertips of humanity's reach. Without people like me Nivalis would be the end of the road.
Have you had much experience with a conventional bio-sanitation chamber?
Oh, well never mind that, the toilet thing is a little more... pressing. I might have to pick your brains next time I see you.
What do you mean, "upstairs?" The Spire?
Oh you must know of the Pierreponts? My great great great grandfather opened the very first Pierrepont bed and breakfast in Nivalis.
Rich is such a clunky word. Accurate though...
No, much higher than that. I mean UPSTAIRS upstairs.
Just feels like a waste of time to me.
Yes, but I was asking about your family problems.
The air flow, air flying around everywhere. Spooky.
Family business. Nothing to worry about. Plus, thanks to this damn Unity Zone, I find myself quite stuck!
Oh thank the gods. I've only just got here and I thought there was some kind of incident. We don't get airflow like this upstairs.
Doesn't sound like any of my business.
How have you never felt wind before?
I merely crouch upon the shoulders of giants.
I think he's referring to a toilet.
Four generations later and we have a resort on every one of the settled planets.
It's not really a thing upstairs.
So why are you down here?
The hollow words of a Well Dweller.
Privileged? Was I privileged when I got stuck fighting for my life on Candulous Six? Or when I rescued that tribe of Rock-Ramblers on Luna?
The heavens themself! I haven't been down a gravity-well since I was a kid. Well not one with air anyway.
I never saw the point in space travel.
My apologies, could you help me with something?
I think he's talking about the wind.
Ahhh yes, it does have a name!
Are you trying to make a point about my lineage? Because I would have still got here without my family. I worked my ass off!
That's right, a life spent dancing on the fingertips of humanity's reach.

dialogues.title: Ava This is the Place
lines: It's a hideout for Gen Debt children. Edison's network is an illegal way for them to get a second shot at life. You know, child trafficking but by the good guys.
I don't believe you're at a place where that is an option. It's simply time to follow through with it. Good luck.
Making me think I should reconsider.
This seems to be the place Edison was talking about.
While you are in fact running an errand, let's remember that you're not about to stroll into a augment shop.

dialogues.title: Ava reminds player of Ashwin
lines: 2000 Lims for weird, enzyme destroying robots! That's a steal! Let's give him the money.
I shouldn't have strung him along.
You encouraged me to... encourage him!
Perhaps... I shall transfer the funds.
He'll be pretty disappointed after you gave him all that encouragement.
I think we need to stop encouraging him.
Have you thought about Ashwin's proposal?

dialogues.title: Floyd Meeting 3
lines: Why grift when you can lift?
Why fight when you can fight better?
I think they're a bit of a gimmick.
I'm auditioning some new slogans for the Mechatomb. You meat people love slogans.
Receive your boon, at the Mechatomb.
Enjoy a little droid on droid? Head to the Mechatomb.
Isn't the Mechatomb exclusive to androids?
The Mechatomb: A fighting home to all (except meat).
Yum yum yum. Hit me again.
Never underestimate the power of 'meat to mech' recommendations.
Do you have any slogans? Could really help you grow your revenue.
I personally have no opinion either way. I was speaking to a young entrepreneur called Mala Spinx and she suggested it.
Droids can't cry but we can punch. Let's talk about that.
I like it. Do you have more?
You can't punch the meat, so come take a seat!

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 13
lines: Hello, it’s me again. I hope you slept well.

dialogues.title: Zaffer's Date
lines: I ran. Paid a hacker to break my tracking. Filed the ‘sec serial number of myself. I stopped being Zone Affirmation Fixer #4591 and became Zaffer. Been zaffin' ever since.
The Lapin means a lot to you.
Good, because this is gonna blow your mind. Check it out! Over there is an ORIGINAL piece by Byal Lapin. The ‘Sec doesn’t know it’s here, or they woulda blasted it off. Isn't it magical?
I’ve never told anyone. Or brought anyone here. Except you.
That's the most punk thing I ever heard.
The Lapin saved me. You know what I was built for?

Cute. But no. I was built to maintain CorpSec signs. STOP, KEEP OUT, NO ACCESS, NO RUNNING, day after day after day after day. Nothing but “do not”. ‘Til the day I went to fix a unit in Lowtown and I saw it. A Lapin artwork, sprayed right over the NO LOITERING sign.
Artpunks come and go but what the Lapin does, it’s more than graffiti. It’s color in a world that’s turning grey. It’s everything CorpSec don’t want you to be or say or feel. It’s life.
Me too. Don’t make me regret it, love.
I loitered so hard that I woke up. Saw that if I wanted to live, I had to get out.
It's incredible. But who is Byal Lapin?

dialogues.title: Ava Good Morning 17
lines: Rise and shine, sleepyhead. You have business to attend to.
